name: 0.1% Triton X-100 Permeabilization Buffer

notes.en: Apply to PFA-fixed cells only. Incubate at RT for 10–15 min. Triton concentration can range 0.1–0.5%; higher concentrations increase permeabilization but reduce morphology preservation. Use 0.5% for nuclear antigens. Wash 3× with PBS before immunostaining.
notes.zh: 用于固定后的细胞透化 (PFA 固定后)。室温处理 10–15 min。Triton 浓度 0.1–0.5% 可选，浓度越高透化越强但形态保存越差。对于核抗原，0.5% 效果更好。使用后 PBS 洗 3 次再做免疫染色。

ref: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1–4.3.7

usage.en: See notes for usage.
usage.zh: 详见备注。

prepSteps.en: Add {v:100:µL} Triton X-100 to {v:100:mL} PBS
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:µL} Triton X-100 加入 {v:100:mL} PBS

prepSteps.en: Mix gently (avoid foaming)
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔混匀（避免起泡）

prepSteps.en: Apply to PFA-fixed cells, 10–15 min at RT
prepSteps.zh: 加至 PFA 固定的细胞上，室温 10–15 min

prepSteps.en: Wash 3× PBS before immunostaining
prepSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3 次后进行免疫染色

name: 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA Solution

note.en: Bring to 500 mL final volume
note.zh: 定容至 500 mL

notes.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm). Aliquot and store at −20°C; working aliquots at 4°C for up to 2 weeks. Pre-warm to 37°C before use. Optimize digestion time for each cell type (1–5 min). Neutralize with serum-containing medium. EDTA chelates Ca²⁺ to disrupt cell-cell junctions.
notes.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌。分装后 -20°C 保存，工作液 4°C (2 周内用完)。使用前预热至 37°C。消化时间需根据细胞类型优化 (1–5 min)。加含血清培养基终止消化。EDTA 螯合 Ca²⁺ 破坏细胞间连接辅助消化。

ref: Freshney (2010) Culture of Animal Cells, 6th ed., Wiley

usage.en: See notes for usage.
usage.zh: 详见备注。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve trypsin and EDTA·4Na in Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺-free PBS
prepSteps.zh: 将胰蛋白酶和 EDTA·4Na 溶于无 Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ 的 PBS

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm)
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

prepSteps.en: Aliquot 5–10 mL per tube, store -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装 5–10 mL/管，-20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Pre-warm to 37°C before use. Add to washed cells for 1–5 min
prepSteps.zh: 使用前预热至 37°C。加至洗过的细胞上消化 1–5 min

prepSteps.en: Neutralize with equal volume of serum-containing medium
prepSteps.zh: 加等体积含血清培养基中和

name: 1.5 M Tris-HCl pH 6.8

note.en: Approximate — fine-adjust to pH 6.8
note.zh: 大致用量，最终调 pH 至 6.8

notes.en: pH meter accuracy warning: many electronic pH meters cannot accurately read concentrated Tris solutions. Use a probe rated for high-ionic-strength solutions. Start with ~118 mL HCl and fine-tune. Also used for preparing 4× Laemmli sample buffer.
notes.zh: pH 计精度警告：许多电子 pH 计无法准确测量高浓度 Tris 溶液。使用适合高离子强度的探头。先加约 118 mL HCl 再微调。也用于配制 4× 上样缓冲液。

ref: Standard biochemistry protocol

usage.en: 1.5 M Tris-HCl pH 6.8 stock for SDS-PAGE stacking gel and sample buffer preparation.
usage.zh: 1.5 M Tris-HCl pH 6.8 母液，用于 SDS-PAGE 浓缩胶和上样缓冲液配制。

label.en: RT, 12 months (autoclave); Autoclave to sterilize. Store at RT.

prepSteps.en: Dissolve 181.65 g Tris base in 700 mL ddH₂O with stirring.
prepSteps.zh: Dissolve 181.65 g Tris base in 700 mL ddH₂O with stirring.

prepSteps.en: Add ~118 mL concentrated HCl to adjust pH to 6.8. Fine-adjust as needed. ⚠️ Many electronic pH meters are inaccurate with concentrated Tris solutions — use an appropriate probe.
prepSteps.zh: Add ~118 mL concentrated HCl to adjust pH to 6.8. Fine-adjust as needed. ⚠️ Many electronic pH meters are inaccurate with concentrated Tris solutions — use an appropriate probe.

prepSteps.en: Bring to 1000 mL final volume with ddH₂O.
prepSteps.zh: Bring to 1000 mL final volume with ddH₂O.

prepSteps.en: Autoclave to sterilize. Store at RT.
prepSteps.zh: Autoclave to sterilize. Store at RT.

name: 1× PBS

notes.en: Adjust pH to 7.4 with HCl or NaOH. Autoclave. Can also dilute from 10× PBS. Store at RT, stable for months.
notes.zh: 用 HCl 或 NaOH 调 pH 至 7.4。高压灭菌。也可由 10× PBS 稀释。室温保存，可稳定数月。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

usage.en: Isotonic phosphate-buffered saline; universal wash buffer for cells, tissues, and proteins.
usage.zh: 等渗磷酸盐缓冲液，用于细胞、组织和蛋白质的通用洗涤。

label.en: 4°C, 6 months (autoclave); Autoclave or sterile-filter for cell culture

prepSteps.en: Dilute {v:100:mL} 10× PBS into {v:900:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:mL} 10× PBS 加入 {v:900:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Mix well, check pH (~7.4)
prepSteps.zh: 混匀，检查 pH（应为 ~7.4）

prepSteps.en: Autoclave or filter-sterilize (0.22 µm) for cell culture use
prepSteps.zh: 若用于细胞培养需高压灭菌或 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

name: 1× Running Buffer (Tris-Glycine-SDS)

note.en: 25 mM
note.zh: 25 mM

note.en: 192 mM
note.zh: 192 mM

notes.en: pH should naturally reach ~8.3; no adjustment needed. Can also dilute from 10× stock.
notes.zh: pH 应自然达到 ~8.3，无需调 pH。也可由 10× 母液稀释。

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685; Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol Ch.10

usage.en: See notes for usage.
usage.zh: 详见备注。

prepSteps.en: Dilute {v:100:mL} 10× Running Buffer into {v:900:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:mL} 10× Running Buffer 加入 {v:900:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Mix well. Do NOT adjust pH
prepSteps.zh: 混匀。不要调 pH

prepSteps.en: Can reuse 2-3× for mini-gels but fresh is better
prepSteps.zh: Mini-gel 可重复使用 2-3 次，但建议用新鲜配的

name: 1× TBST

notes.en: Prepare fresh. Tween-20 at 0.05–0.1% is acceptable; adjust based on background signal.
notes.zh: 现配现用。Tween-20 终浓度 0.05–0.1% 均可，根据背景调整。

ref: Burnette (1981) Anal Biochem 112:195–203

usage.en: Tris-buffered saline + Tween-20; standard blocking and washing buffer for Western blot.
usage.zh: 含 Tween-20 的 Tris 缓冲盐水，WB 标准封闭和洗涤缓冲液。

label.en: RT, 1 month; Prepare fresh weekly if Tween-20 precipitates

prepSteps.en: Dilute {v:100:mL} 10× TBS into {v:900:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:mL} 10× TBS 加入 {v:900:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add {v:1:mL} Tween-20 (0.1% final)
prepSteps.zh: 加入 {v:1:mL} Tween-20（终浓度 0.1%）

prepSteps.en: Mix well. No pH adjustment needed
prepSteps.zh: 充分混匀，无需调 pH

name: 1× Transfer Buffer (Towbin)

note.en: 25 mM
note.zh: 25 mM

note.en: 192 mM
note.zh: 192 mM

notes.en: Add methanol last, bring to 1 L. For proteins >100 kDa, add 0.01–0.05% SDS. Use cold (4°C). Do not adjust pH.
notes.zh: 加入甲醇后定容至 1 L。转膜大蛋白 (>100 kDa) 可加 0.01–0.05% SDS。4°C 使用。不要调 pH。

ref: Towbin et al. (1979) PNAS 76:4350–4354

usage.en: Wet or semi-dry transfer buffer for moving proteins from SDS-PAGE gel to membrane.
usage.zh: 蛋白转膜缓冲液，用于 SDS-PAGE 后湿转或半干转膜。

label.en: 4°C, 1 month; Add methanol fresh; keep cold during wet transfer

prepSteps.en: Dilute 10× Running Buffer 1:10, add methanol to 20%
prepSteps.zh: 将 10× Running Buffer 1:10 稀释，加甲醇至 20%

prepSteps.en: Pre-chill to 4°C (transfer generates heat)
prepSteps.zh: 预冷至 4°C（转膜过程会产热）

prepSteps.en: For large proteins (>100 kDa): reduce methanol to 10%, add 0.01% SDS
prepSteps.zh: 大蛋白 (>100 kDa)：甲醇降至 10%，加 0.01% SDS

prepSteps.en: Do NOT adjust pH
prepSteps.zh: 不要调 pH

name: 10× Cresol Red Dye for PCR Gel Loading
nameCn: 10× 甲酚红 PCR 上样染料

note.en: Sucrose also occupies volume
note.zh: 蔗糖也占溶液体积

note.en: Adjust to 50 mL final volume
note.zh: 定容至 50 mL

notes.en: This is ONLY the dye — not PCR buffer. You still need colorless 10× PCR buffer. Add 10% volume of 10× Cresol red to the PCR master mix. Load PCR product directly onto gel — do NOT add additional loading dye. Cresol red runs at ~1000 bp in 1% agarose (between xylene cyanol ~5000 bp and bromophenol blue ~500 bp). Combining with transparent PCR buffer equals CoralLoad PCR Buffer (QIAGEN). If frozen, warm to 37°C or 55°C to fully thaw before use.
notes.zh: 这只是染料，不是 PCR 缓冲液！需要另外加无色 10× PCR buffer。在 PCR master mix 中加入总体积 10% 的 10× 甲酚红。PCR 后直接上样，无需额外 loading dye。甲酚红在 1% 琼脂糖凝胶中迁移位置约 1000 bp。冷冻后需 37°C 或 55°C 完全融化后使用。

ref: Gold Biotechnology Cresol Red guide; QIAGEN CoralLoad PCR Buffer product note

usage.en: Alternative loading dye for gel electrophoresis; can be added to PCR master mix before amplification and loaded directly onto gel without additional dye.
usage.zh: 琼脂糖凝胶电泳替代上样染料，可在 PCR 反应前加入 master mix，反应后直接上样无需额外加 loading dye。

label.en: 4°C, 6 months (0.22 µm filter); Also can aliquot and freeze at -20°C. Inspect before use — sucrose solution may grow bacteria; discard if cloudy.

prepSteps.en: Add water to beaker (~20 mL for 50 mL batch).
prepSteps.zh: Add water to beaker (~20 mL for 50 mL batch).

prepSteps.en: While stirring, add sucrose (30 g) and cresol red sodium salt (0.1 g).
prepSteps.zh: While stirring, add sucrose (30 g) and cresol red sodium salt (0.1 g).

prepSteps.en: Continue stirring until completely dissolved. Add water to reach 50 mL final volume.
prepSteps.zh: Continue stirring until completely dissolved. Add water to reach 50 mL final volume.

prepSteps.en: Filter through 0.22 µm filter in the hood.
prepSteps.zh: Filter through 0.22 µm filter in the hood.

prepSteps.en: Aliquot to 2 mL sterile tubes. Label '10X Cresol red'. Store at 4°C or freeze at -20°C.
prepSteps.zh: Aliquot to 2 mL sterile tubes. Label '10X Cresol red'. Store at 4°C or freeze at -20°C.

name: 10× MOPS Buffer (RNA Gel Running Buffer)
nameCn: 10× MOPS 缓冲液（RNA 凝胶电泳缓冲液）

note.en: 200 mM
note.zh: 200 mM

note.en: 50 mM
note.zh: 50 mM

note.en: 10 mM final
note.zh: 终浓度 10 mM

notes.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH. MOPS is light-sensitive — store in dark bottle at RT (or 4°C). Solution yellowing = degraded, prepare fresh. Autoclave or filter-sterilize. Dilute 1:10 to 1× for gel and running buffer.
notes.zh: NaOH 调 pH 至 7.0。MOPS 对光敏感——棕色瓶中 RT 或 4°C 保存。溶液变黄 = 降解，需重新配制。可高压灭菌或过滤除菌。用时稀释 10 倍至 1×（凝胶和电泳缓冲液）。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning 3rd ed.; Rio et al. (2010) RNA: A Laboratory Manual, CSHL Press

usage.en: 10× MOPS buffer for denaturing RNA agarose gel electrophoresis.
usage.zh: 10× MOPS 缓冲液，用于 RNA 变性凝胶电泳。

label.en: 4°C, 3 months; Light-sensitive; store in dark bottle; yellowing = degraded

prepSteps.en: Dissolve MOPS in ~700 mL DEPC-treated ddH₂O.
prepSteps.zh: Dissolve MOPS in ~700 mL DEPC-treated ddH₂O.

prepSteps.en: Add sodium acetate and EDTA.
prepSteps.zh: Add sodium acetate and EDTA.

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH.
prepSteps.zh: Adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH.

prepSteps.en: Bring to final volume of 1000 mL.
prepSteps.zh: Bring to final volume of 1000 mL.

prepSteps.en: Autoclave; solution will turn yellow — this is normal and acceptable.
prepSteps.zh: Autoclave; solution will turn yellow — this is normal and acceptable.

prepSteps.en: Store at room temperature in dark bottle.
prepSteps.zh: Store at room temperature in dark bottle.

name: 10× PBS

notes.en: Autoclave to sterilize. Dilute 1:10 with dH₂O for 1× PBS. Check pH after dilution — should be 7.4. Store at RT.
notes.zh: 高压灭菌。用 dH₂O 1:10 稀释得 1× PBS。稀释后需校 pH（应为 7.4）。室温保存。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press, Appendix 1

usage.en: Concentrated phosphate-buffered saline; dilute to 1× for universal wash and diluent.
usage.zh: 磷酸盐缓冲液浓缩液，稀释至 1× 后用于通用洗涤和稀释。

label.en: 4°C, 12 months (autoclave); Autoclave or sterile-filter for cell culture

prepSteps.en: Weigh NaCl, KCl, Na₂HPO₄, KH₂PO₄ into a {v:1:L} beaker
prepSteps.zh: 称取 NaCl、KCl、Na₂HPO₄、KH₂PO₄ 于 {v:1:L} 烧杯

prepSteps.en: Add ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O, stir until dissolved
prepSteps.zh: 加入约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O，搅拌至完全溶解

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.4 with HCl (usually needs very little)
prepSteps.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.4（通常只需极少量）

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL} with ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 用 ddH₂O 定容至 {v:1000:mL}

prepSteps.en: Autoclave 121°C 20 min. Store at RT
prepSteps.zh: 121°C 高压灭菌 20 min，室温保存

prepSteps.en: Dilute 1:10 to get 1× PBS before use
prepSteps.zh: 使用前 1:10 稀释得 1× PBS

name: 10× PCR Buffer (Qiagen-Equivalent, Dual-Cation)
nameCn: 10× PCR 缓冲液（仿 Qiagen 双阳离子）

notes.en: Use sterile nuclease-free stock solutions. Final 1× concentrations: 10 mM Tris-HCl, 50 mM KCl, 10 mM (NH₄)₂SO₄, 1.5 mM MgCl₂. Combine with 10× Cresol red dye for CoralLoad-equivalent PCR buffer.
notes.zh: 使用无菌无核酸酶的母液。1× 终浓度：10 mM Tris-HCl、50 mM KCl、10 mM (NH₄)₂SO₄、1.5 mM MgCl₂。可与 10× 甲酚红染料搭配使用。

ref: Reverse-engineered from Qiagen PCR Buffer specifications

usage.en: Dual-cation 10× PCR buffer functionally equivalent to Qiagen's standard buffer. K⁺ and NH₄⁺ ions increase the annealing window and reduce non-specific amplification.
usage.zh: 仿 Qiagen 标准缓冲液的双阳离子 10× PCR buffer。K⁺ 和 NH₄⁺ 扩大退火窗口、降低非特异性扩增。

prepSteps.en: Add 1.0 mL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.7 at 20°C).
prepSteps.zh: Add 1.0 mL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.7 at 20°C).

prepSteps.en: Add 2.5 mL of 2 M KCl.
prepSteps.zh: Add 2.5 mL of 2 M KCl.

prepSteps.en: Add 1.0 mL of 1 M (NH₄)₂SO₄.
prepSteps.zh: Add 1.0 mL of 1 M (NH₄)₂SO₄.

prepSteps.zh: Add 150 µL of 1 M MgCl₂.

prepSteps.zh: Add 5.35 mL nuclease-free water to reach 10.0 mL.

prepSteps.zh: Vortex thoroughly. Aliquot 1 mL/tube. Store at -20°C.

name: 10× RBC Lysis Buffer

note.en: Adjust to 1000 mL
note.zh: 定容至 1000 mL

notes.en: 1× working concentrations: 155 mM NH₄Cl, 10 mM KHCO₃, 1 mM EDTA. For tissue dissociation: add 1 mL 1× RBC lysis to pellet, incubate 1-5 min on ice, then quench with culture medium. Do not leave cells in lysis buffer too long — can damage white blood cells. If red blood cells persist, repeat lysis step.
notes.zh: 1× 工作浓度：155 mM NH₄Cl、10 mM KHCO₃、1 mM EDTA。组织消化用：加 1 mL 1× 裂解液至细胞沉淀，冰上 1-5 分钟，培养基终止。不要放置过久以免损伤白细胞。红细胞残留可重复裂解。

ref: Standard ammonium chloride RBC lysis protocol

usage.zh: 10× 氯化铵红细胞裂解液母液。使用前用无菌水稀释至 1×。

prepSteps.zh: Dissolve NH₄Cl (82.9 g), KHCO₃ (10 g), and EDTA-Na₂ (3.72 g) in ~800 mL ddH₂O.

prepSteps.en: Stir until fully dissolved.
prepSteps.zh: Stir until fully dissolved.

prepSteps.zh: Adjust pH to ~7.3 if needed (usually no adjustment required).

prepSteps.zh: Bring to 1000 mL with ddH₂O.

prepSteps.zh: Filter-sterilize through 0.22 µm (or autoclave). Store at 4°C.

prepSteps.zh: Dilute to 1× with sterile water (not PBS) immediately before use.

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris、甘氨酸和 SDS 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

usage.zh: 10× TBE 缓冲液，稀释至 0.5–1× 用于 DNA/RNA 凝胶电泳和 EMSA。

prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris 和硼酸溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.zh: 加入 0.5 M EDTA pH 8.0 母液

usage.en: Tris-buffered saline concentrate; dilute to 1× for WB membrane washing.

prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris base 和 NaCl 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.zh: 使用前加入 5% β-巯基乙醇或 100 mM DTT

prepSteps.en: Mix 1:1 with protein sample, boil 95°C × 5 min
prepSteps.zh: 与蛋白样品 1:1 混合，95°C 煮沸 5 min

name: 20× SSC Buffer

note.en: 3 M
note.zh: 3 M

note.en: 300 mM
note.zh: 300 mM

notes.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with HCl. Autoclave and store at room temperature. For Southern/Northern blot hybridization use 2×–6× SSC; for stringent washes use 0.1×–0.5× SSC. Also required for in situ hybridization (ISH).
notes.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.0。高压灭菌后室温保存。杂交 (Southern/Northern blot) 时使用 2×–6× SSC；严格洗膜用 0.1×–0.5× SSC。ISH (原位杂交) 也需要。

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8765; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: 20× SSC (saline-sodium citrate) concentrate for Northern blot, Southern blot, and FISH.
usage.zh: 20× SSC 浓缩液，用于 Northern blot、Southern blot 和 FISH 实验。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve NaCl and sodium citrate in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 NaCl 和柠檬酸钠溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with HCl
prepSteps.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.0

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}. Autoclave 121°C 20 min
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}。121°C 高压灭菌 20 min

prepSteps.en: Dilute as needed: 6× (hybridization), 2× (mild wash), 0.1× (stringent wash)
prepSteps.zh: 按需稀释: 6×（杂交）、2×（温和洗涤）、0.1×（严格洗涤）

name: 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA)

note.en: Add dropwise until clear (~1 mL)
note.zh: 逐滴加至澄清 (~1 mL)

notes.en: 60°C water bath to dissolve (do not exceed 70°C); add NaOH to clarify; cool and adjust pH to 7.4. Filter (0.45 µm). Aliquot at −20°C.
notes.zh: 60°C 水浴搅拌溶解 (勿超 70°C)，加 NaOH 至澄清，冷却后调 pH 至 7.4。过滤 (0.45 µm)。分装 -20°C 保存。⚠️ 通风橱操作！

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec11863; Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40

usage.en: 4% paraformaldehyde fixative for cells and tissue sections (IF, IHC, flow cytometry).
usage.zh: 4% 多聚甲醛固定液，用于细胞和组织切片固定（IF、IHC、流式）。

label.en: 4°C, 1 month; Toxic; fume hood required; -20°C for longer storage

prepSteps.en: ⚠️ Work in fume hood! PFA is toxic
prepSteps.zh: ⚠️ 在通风橱内操作！PFA 有毒

prepSteps.en: Heat PBS to 60°C (do NOT boil)
prepSteps.zh: 将 PBS 加热至 60°C（不要煮沸）

prepSteps.en: Add PFA powder, stir until dissolved
prepSteps.zh: 加入 PFA 粉末，搅拌至溶解

prepSteps.en: Add 1–2 drops 1N NaOH to clear solution
prepSteps.zh: 滴加 1–2 滴 1N NaOH 使溶液变澄清

prepSteps.en: Cool to RT, adjust pH to 7.2–7.4 with HCl
prepSteps.zh: 冷却至室温，用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.2–7.4

prepSteps.en: Filter (0.22 µm), aliquot, freeze at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤，分装，-20°C 冻存

name: 4× Laemmli Sample Buffer

note.en: Final concentration 250 mM
note.zh: 终浓度 250 mM

note.en: Final concentration 8%
note.zh: 终浓度 8%

note.en: Final concentration 40%
note.zh: 终浓度 40%

note.en: Final concentration 20%
note.zh: 终浓度 20%

note.en: Final concentration 0.04%

notes.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C. Dilute 1:4 before use (3 parts sample : 1 part buffer).
notes.zh: 分装保存 -20°C。上样时 1:4 稀释（样品:buffer = 3:1）。

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

usage.en: 4× concentrated SDS-PAGE sample buffer; mix 1:3 with protein sample.
usage.zh: SDS-PAGE 上样缓冲液（4×），与蛋白样品 1:3 混合。

label.en: -20°C, 12 months; Aliquot; add reducing agent fresh

prepSteps.en: Same as 2× but at double concentration
prepSteps.zh: 同 2× 配法，浓度翻倍

prepSteps.en: Mix 1 part buffer : 3 parts sample
prepSteps.zh: 1 份缓冲液 : 3 份样品混合

prepSteps.en: Boil 95°C × 5 min
prepSteps.zh: 95°C 煮沸 5 min

name: 5% BSA Blocking Buffer

notes.en: Suitable for phospho-protein detection. Add 0.02% NaN₃ to store at 4°C for ~1 week.
notes.zh: 适用于磷酸化蛋白检测。加 0.02% NaN₃ 可 4°C 保存约 1 周。

ref: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol Ch.10, Unit 10.2A

usage.en: 5% BSA blocking solution for WB; preferred for phospho-protein and phospho-antibody use.
usage.zh: BSA 封闭液，WB 用，特别适用于磷酸化蛋白和磷酸化抗体。

label.en: 4°C, 1 week; Prepare fresh weekly; add 0.02% NaN3 to extend to 2 weeks

prepSteps.en: Weigh {v:2.5:g} BSA (Fraction V or IgG-free)
prepSteps.zh: 称取 {v:2.5:g} BSA（Fraction V 或 IgG-free）

prepSteps.en: Dissolve in {v:50:mL} TBST. Rock gently, do NOT vortex vigorously
prepSteps.zh: 溶于 {v:50:mL} TBST，轻摇溶解，不要剧烈涡旋

prepSteps.en: Filter through 0.22 µm if needed
prepSteps.zh: 必要时 0.22 µm 过滤

name: 5% Skim Milk Blocking Buffer

notes.en: Prepare fresh. Do not use for phospho-protein detection (milk casein is phosphorylated). Use BSA blocking instead.
notes.zh: 现配现用。勿用于检测磷酸化蛋白（milk 中含酪蛋白磷酸化位点），改用 BSA。

ref: Burnette (1981) Anal Biochem 112:195–203

usage.en: 5% non-fat dry milk blocking solution; standard WB blocking buffer.
usage.zh: 脱脂奶粉封闭液，WB 标准封闭缓冲液。

label.en: 4°C, 3 days; Prepare fresh; milk degrades quickly

prepSteps.en: Weigh {v:2.5:g} skim milk powder
prepSteps.zh: 称取 {v:2.5:g} 脱脂奶粉

prepSteps.en: Add to {v:50:mL} TBST, vortex until dissolved
prepSteps.zh: 加入 {v:50:mL} TBST，涡旋至完全溶解

prepSteps.en: Use immediately. Discard after use
prepSteps.zh: 立即使用，用后丢弃

name: 5× Laemmli Sample Buffer

note.en: Or substitute β-mercaptoethanol
note.zh: 或替换为 β-巯基乙醇

note.en: Adjust to 15 mL
note.zh: 定容至 15 mL

notes.en: Dilute 1:4 with sample before loading (e.g. 5 µL buffer + 20 µL sample). Heat at 95-100°C for 5 min before loading gel.
notes.zh: 上样前 1:4 稀释（如 5 µL buffer + 20 µL 样品）。95-100°C 加热 5 分钟后上样。

ref: lifescience.net; Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680-685

usage.en: 5× concentrated SDS-PAGE sample buffer; mix 1:4 with protein sample before loading.
usage.zh: SDS-PAGE 上样缓冲液（5×），与蛋白样品 1:4 混合后上样。

prepSteps.en: Combine Tris-HCl, SDS, and glycerol.
prepSteps.zh: Combine Tris-HCl, SDS, and glycerol.

prepSteps.en: Add bromophenol blue and DTT. Mix until dissolved.
prepSteps.zh: Add bromophenol blue and DTT. Mix until dissolved.

prepSteps.en: Bring to 15 mL final volume with ddH₂O.
prepSteps.zh: Bring to 15 mL final volume with ddH₂O.

prepSteps.en: Aliquot 1 mL into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
prepSteps.zh: Aliquot 1 mL into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.

prepSteps.en: Store at -20°C.
prepSteps.zh: Store at -20°C.

name: 5× Q-Solution (Betaine GC-Enhancer)
nameCn: 5× Q-Solution（甜菜碱 GC 增强剂）

note.en: Adjust to 10 mL final volume
note.zh: 定容至 10 mL

notes.en: Use at 1× final concentration (1 M Betaine). For 50 µL PCR: add 10 µL of 5× Q-Solution and subtract from water volume. Use ONLY as troubleshooting additive for GC >60% or strong secondary structures (hairpins). Do NOT use Betaine-HCl — must be anhydrous Betaine.
notes.zh: 终浓度 1×（1 M 甜菜碱）。50 µL PCR 体系加 10 µL 5× Q-Solution（相应减少水量）。仅用于 GC 含量 >60% 或强二级结构的 troubleshooting。必须用无水甜菜碱，不可用盐酸甜菜碱。

ref: Qiagen Q-Solution equivalent recipe

usage.en: 5 M Betaine stock (Qiagen Q-Solution equivalent) for amplifying GC-rich templates. Equalizes AT and GC melting temperatures, prevents polymerase stalling on secondary structures.
usage.zh: 5 M 甜菜碱母液（等效 Qiagen Q-Solution），用于扩增 GC 富含模板。均衡 AT/GC 碱基对熔解温度，防止聚合酶在二级结构处停滞。

label.en: -20°C, 12 months (0.22 µm filter); Aliquot 1 mL/tube, store -20°C

prepSteps.en: Weigh exactly 5.86 g anhydrous Betaine (do NOT use Betaine-HCl).
prepSteps.zh: Weigh exactly 5.86 g anhydrous Betaine (do NOT use Betaine-HCl).

prepSteps.en: Add to 15 mL tube with ~5 mL nuclease-free water.
prepSteps.zh: Add to 15 mL tube with ~5 mL nuclease-free water.

prepSteps.en: Vortex/shake until completely dissolved.
prepSteps.zh: Vortex/shake until completely dissolved.

prepSteps.en: Adjust final volume to 10.0 mL with nuclease-free water.
prepSteps.zh: Adjust final volume to 10.0 mL with nuclease-free water.

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize through 0.22 µm syringe filter.
prepSteps.zh: Filter-sterilize through 0.22 µm syringe filter.

prepSteps.en: Aliquot 1 mL/tube, store at -20°C.
prepSteps.zh: Aliquot 1 mL/tube, store at -20°C.

name: 50× TAE

notes.en: Dilute to 1× (40 mM Tris-acetate, 1 mM EDTA) for gel electrophoresis. TAE gives better DNA recovery than TBE but lower buffering capacity — change buffer for long runs. Store 50× at RT.
notes.zh: 稀释至 1×（40 mM Tris-acetate, 1 mM EDTA）用于凝胶电泳。TAE 比 TBE DNA 回收率更高但缓冲能力较弱——长时间电泳需换液。50× 室温保存。

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8644; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: 50× TAE buffer concentrate; dilute to 1× for DNA agarose gel electrophoresis and gel extraction.
usage.zh: 50× TAE 缓冲液浓缩液，稀释至 1× 用于 DNA 凝胶电泳和胶回收。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris base in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris base 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add glacial acetic acid and EDTA stock
prepSteps.zh: 加入冰醋酸和 EDTA 母液

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}. No pH adjustment needed (~8.5)
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}。无需调 pH（~8.5）

prepSteps.en: Dilute 1:50 for working solution
prepSteps.zh: 使用时 1:50 稀释

name: 6× DNA Loading Dye

notes.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C; stable at 4°C for months. Mix 1:5 with sample (1 µL dye + 5 µL sample). Bromophenol blue co-migrates with ~300 bp in 1% agarose; xylene cyanol co-migrates with ~4 kb. Optionally add EDTA (10 mM final) to chelate DNases.
notes.zh: 分装后 -20°C 保存，4°C 可存数月。使用时 1:5 混合 (1 µL dye + 5 µL 样品)。Bromophenol Blue 在 1% 琼脂糖中迁移率 ~300 bp，Xylene Cyanol ~4 kb。可选加 EDTA (终浓度 10 mM) 螯合 DNase。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press, Appendix 1

usage.en: See notes for usage.
usage.zh: 详见备注。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Bromophenol Blue and Xylene Cyanol in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将溴酚蓝和二甲苯青 FF 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add glycerol to 30% final
prepSteps.zh: 加甘油至终浓度 30%

prepSteps.en: Mix well. Aliquot and store at 4°C or -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 充分混匀。分装后 4°C 或 -20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Use 1 µL per 5 µL DNA sample
prepSteps.zh: 每 5 µL DNA 样品加 1 µL

name: Anti-Fade Mounting Medium

note.en: 90% for fluorescence-only; 50% for DIC + fluorescence
note.zh: 纯荧光成像用 90%；DIC + 荧光用 50%

notes.en: Use 6-8 µL per 18mm coverslip — solution should slowly spread to edges. Too much will prevent nail polish seal. This medium does NOT harden — seal with nail polish to prevent drying. For fluorescence-only: use 90% glycerol (best resolution). For DIC + fluorescence: use 50% glycerol (preserves DIC contrast). Many fluorophores are brighter at higher pH — Tris pH 8.0 helps.
notes.zh: 每个 18mm 盖玻片用 6-8 µL。封片剂不会硬化——必须用指甲油密封防止干燥。纯荧光用 90% 甘油（最佳分辨率），DIC+荧光用 50% 甘油（保留 DIC 对比度）。高 pH 下多数荧光团更亮。

ref: Jackson ImmunoResearch; Harvard NIC

usage.en: Anti-fade mounting medium for fluorescence microscopy. Reduces photobleaching of fluorophores with n-propyl gallate in glycerol.
usage.zh: 荧光显微镜抗淬灭封片剂。含正丙基没食子酸酯（NPG）减少荧光漂白。

label.en: 4°C, 3 months; Store at 4°C protected from light.

prepSteps.en: Prepare 20% (w/v) n-propyl gallate stock in DMSO or DMF (NPG does not dissolve well in water).
prepSteps.zh: Prepare 20% (w/v) n-propyl gallate stock in DMSO or DMF (NPG does not dissolve well in water).

prepSteps.en: Mix 0.2 mL of 1 M Tris pH 8.0 with 9 mL glycerol (or 5 mL for 50% glycerol formulation).
prepSteps.zh: Mix 0.2 mL of 1 M Tris pH 8.0 with 9 mL glycerol (or 5 mL for 50% glycerol formulation).

prepSteps.en: Add 0.25 mL of 20% NPG stock dropwise with rapid stirring (0.5% final concentration).
prepSteps.zh: Add 0.25 mL of 20% NPG stock dropwise with rapid stirring (0.5% final concentration).

prepSteps.en: Warm to 37°C and vortex if needed to dissolve completely.
prepSteps.zh: Warm to 37°C and vortex if needed to dissolve completely.

prepSteps.en: Adjust to ~10 mL final volume. Store at 4°C protected from light.
prepSteps.zh: Adjust to ~10 mL final volume. Store at 4°C protected from light.

name: Antigen Retrieval Buffer (EDTA, pH 9.0)

note.en: 1 mM
note.zh: 1 mM

notes.en: Adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH. For nuclear antigens (Ki67, H3K4me3), membrane antigens (HER2), or when citrate pH 6.0 fails. Heat 95–100°C 20 min (pressure cooker or water bath). Cool 20 min at RT before use.
notes.zh: NaOH 调 pH 至 9.0。适用于核抗原（Ki67、H3K4me3）、膜抗原（HER2）及柠檬酸缓冲液效果差的情况。95–100°C 加热 20 min。冷却 20 min 后继续操作。

ref: Shi et al. (2001) J Histochem Cytochem 49:931–937; Ramos-Vara & Miller (2014) Vet Pathol 51:42–87

usage.en: EDTA antigen retrieval buffer (pH 9.0) for nuclear antigens in IHC (Ki67, H3K4me3).
usage.zh: EDTA 抗原修复缓冲液（pH 9.0），用于 IHC 中核抗原（Ki67、H3K4me3）的修复。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve EDTA in ~800 mL ddH₂O.
prepSteps.zh: Dissolve EDTA in ~800 mL ddH₂O.

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH (EDTA dissolves as pH rises).
prepSteps.zh: Adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH (EDTA dissolves as pH rises).

prepSteps.en: Bring to final volume of 1000 mL with ddH₂O.
prepSteps.zh: Bring to final volume of 1000 mL with ddH₂O.

prepSteps.en: Autoclave at 121°C for 20 min.
prepSteps.zh: Autoclave at 121°C for 20 min.

prepSteps.en: Store at room temperature.
prepSteps.zh: Store at room temperature.

name: Blue Native PAGE Cathode Buffer

note.en: 50 mM
note.zh: 50 mM

note.en: 50 mM
note.zh: 50 mM

notes.en: Do not adjust pH (~7.0). After the gel front has migrated ~1/3, switch to cathode buffer without CBB to reduce background.
notes.zh: 不调 pH (约 7.0)。电泳 1/3 后可换不含 CBB 的阴极缓冲液。

ref: Wittig et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:418–428

usage.en: Blue-native PAGE cathode buffer (CBB G-250) for membrane protein complex analysis.
usage.zh: 蓝色天然 PAGE 阴极缓冲液（CBB G-250），用于膜蛋白复合体分析。

label.en: 4°C, 1 week; Prepare fresh; CBB G-250 degrades

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tricine and Bis-Tris in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tricine 和 Bis-Tris 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add Coomassie G-250 to 0.02%
prepSteps.zh: 加入考马斯亮蓝 G-250 至 0.02%

prepSteps.en: Prepare fresh; use cold (4°C)
prepSteps.zh: 现配；冷用 (4°C)

name: Bradford Reagent (Coomassie Brilliant Blue G-250)
nameCn: Bradford 考马斯亮蓝 G-250 染料试剂

notes.en: Dissolve CBB G-250 in ethanol first, then add phosphoric acid, then water. Filter through Whatman No.1 paper. Store at RT protected from light; stable for months. Solution appears brown-red before reaction, shifting to blue with protein. Alternatively use commercial Bio-Rad Protein Assay (5× concentrate: dilute 1:5).
notes.zh: 先将 CBB G-250 溶于乙醇，再加磷酸，最后加水至定量。Whatman 1 号滤纸过滤。室温避光保存，稳定数月。试剂未与蛋白反应时呈棕红色，与蛋白结合后变蓝色。也可直接购买 Bio-Rad Protein Assay（5× 浓缩，1:5 稀释使用）。

ref: Bradford (1976) Anal Biochem 72:248–254; Bio-Rad Protein Assay Technical Note 1

usage.en: Coomassie G-250 dye solution for Bradford colorimetric protein quantification at A595.
usage.zh: 考马斯亮蓝 G-250 试剂，用于 Bradford 比色法蛋白定量（A595）。

label.en: RT, 3 months; Store in dark bottle

prepSteps.en: Dissolve 100 mg Coomassie Brilliant Blue G-250 in 50 mL 95% ethanol.
prepSteps.zh: Dissolve 100 mg Coomassie Brilliant Blue G-250 in 50 mL 95% ethanol.

prepSteps.en: Add 100 mL 85% phosphoric acid and mix well.
prepSteps.zh: Add 100 mL 85% phosphoric acid and mix well.

prepSteps.en: Bring to 1000 mL with ddH₂O.
prepSteps.zh: Bring to 1000 mL with ddH₂O.

prepSteps.en: Filter through Whatman No. 1 filter paper.
prepSteps.zh: Filter through Whatman No. 1 filter paper.

prepSteps.en: Store in dark bottle at 4°C.
prepSteps.zh: Store in dark bottle at 4°C.

prepSteps.en: Reagent should be brown/red; discard if it turns green.
prepSteps.zh: Reagent should be brown/red; discard if it turns green.

name: BSA Standard Curve Dilution Series (2 mg/mL Stock)
nameCn: BSA 标准曲线稀释系列（2 mg/mL 母液）

note.en: 2 mg/mL stock in ddH₂O or sample buffer; aliquot 200 µL at −20°C
note.zh: 2 mg/mL 储液（溶于 ddH₂O 或样品缓冲液）；分装 200 µL 存于 −20°C

note.en: Buffer only (blank)
note.zh: 仅缓冲液（空白对照）

notes.en: Prepare in same buffer as samples. BCA: 37°C 30 min, A562. Bradford: RT 5 min, A595. Triplicate.
notes.zh: 用与样品相同的缓冲液配制。BCA：37°C 30 min，A562。Bradford：室温 5 min，A595。三重复。

ref: Smith et al. (1985) Anal Biochem 150:76 / Bradford (1976) Anal Biochem 72:248

usage.en: Diluted BSA standard curve for protein quantification assays (BCA at 37°C A562, Bradford at RT A595).
usage.zh: BSA 标准曲线稀释系列，用于 BCA（A562）和 Bradford（A595）蛋白定量。

label.en: -20°C, 12 months; Aliquot 2 mg/mL stock; single-use aliquots

prepSteps.en: Prepare 2 mg/mL BSA stock: dissolve in ddH₂O or in the same buffer used for protein samples (important for matrix matching). (Aliquot 200 µL per tube; freeze at -20°C. Thaw fresh for each use.)
prepSteps.zh: Prepare 2 mg/mL BSA stock: dissolve in ddH₂O or in the same buffer used for protein samples (important for matrix matching). (Aliquot 200 µL per tube; freeze at -20°C. Thaw fresh for each use.)

prepSteps.en: Prepare dilution series in sample buffer. Pipette in duplicate or triplicate.
prepSteps.zh: Prepare dilution series in sample buffer. Pipette in duplicate or triplicate.

prepSteps.en: BCA assay: add 200 µL BCA working reagent; 37°C 30 min; read A562. Bradford: add 200 µL Bradford reagent; RT 5 min; read A595.
prepSteps.zh: BCA assay: add 200 µL BCA working reagent; 37°C 30 min; read A562. Bradford: add 200 µL Bradford reagent; RT 5 min; read A595.

prepSteps.en: Fit linear regression (R² > 0.99) to calculate unknown protein concentration.
prepSteps.zh: Fit linear regression (R² > 0.99) to calculate unknown protein concentration.

name: Buprenorphine Working Solution (0.01 mg/mL)

notes.en: Final concentration 0.01 mg/mL. Dosing: 0.05 mg/kg body weight. For a 20 g mouse, this equals 1 µg total = 100 µL of working solution. Follow institutional IACUC protocols for controlled substance handling.
notes.zh: 终浓度 0.01 mg/mL。给药：0.05 mg/kg 体重。20 g 小鼠用 1 µg = 100 µL 工作液。按 IACUC 规定操作管制药品。

ref: Flecknell P (2009) Laboratory Animal Anaesthesia, 3rd ed., Academic Press; Turner PV, Pekow C, Vasbinder MA, Brabb T (2011) J Am Assoc Lab Anim Sci 50:600–613; NRC (2011) Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals, 8th ed., National Academies Press

usage.en: Buprenorphine working solution for post-surgical analgesia in mice. Dose: 0.05 mg/kg (1 µg for a 20 g mouse).
usage.zh: 丁丙诺啡工作液，用于小鼠术后镇痛。剂量：0.05 mg/kg（20 g 小鼠约 1 µg）。

label.en: RT, 1 month; Aliquot ~15 mL into vacuum bottles from animal facility. Store per IACUC guidelines.

prepSteps.en: Transfer 1 mL buprenorphine (0.3 mg/mL) to a 50 mL conical tube.
prepSteps.zh: Transfer 1 mL buprenorphine (0.3 mg/mL) to a 50 mL conical tube.

prepSteps.en: Add 29 mL sterile PBS to total 30 mL volume (final: 0.01 mg/mL).
prepSteps.zh: Add 29 mL sterile PBS to total 30 mL volume (final: 0.01 mg/mL).

prepSteps.en: Mix well.
prepSteps.zh: Mix well.

prepSteps.en: Aliquot ~15 mL into each of 2 vacuum bottles (max 20 mL/bottle) using sterile syringe and needle.
prepSteps.zh: Aliquot ~15 mL into each of 2 vacuum bottles (max 20 mL/bottle) using sterile syringe and needle.

notes.en: Dissolve Ficoll in warm water (37°C) with gentle stirring — takes 1–2 h. Do NOT heat >60°C. Autoclave at 121°C 15 min (solution turns slightly yellow — normal). Final density: ~1.077 g/mL for PBMC isolation. Verify density with refractometer or weighing (1 mL should weigh ~1.077 g). Store at RT up to 6 months. For standard Ficoll-Paque density 1.077: mix 20% Ficoll with sodium diatrizoate solution to reach target density, or purchase Ficoll-Paque PLUS (GE). Commercial Ficoll-Paque: density 1.077 g/mL for human PBMC; 1.083 for mouse. Self-preparation tip: dissolve 9 g Ficoll-400 + 3.1 g sodium diatrizoate (NaDiatrizoate) in 100 mL pyrogen-free water → density ~1.077.
notes.zh: Ficoll 溶解缓慢，37°C 温热 ddH₂O 轻搅 1–2 h。勿超过 60°C。121°C 高压灭菌 15 min（溶液略微变黄——正常现象）。终密度：~1.077 g/mL 用于 PBMC 分离。用折射仪或称重验证密度（1 mL 应重约 1.077 g）。RT 保存 6 个月。商品 Ficoll-Paque PLUS 密度 1.077（人 PBMC）；1.083（小鼠）。自配方案：9 g Ficoll-400 + 3.1 g 泛影酸钠（NaDiatrizoate）溶于 100 mL 无热原水 → 密度 ~1.077。

At 1.077 g/mL: erythrocytes + granulocytes (1.08–1.09) sink; PBMCs (1.07–1.075) band at interface; platelets stay in plasma layer. pH 7.2–7.4. Osmolality: 290–310 mOsm. Warm to room temperature before use (critical for proper separation). Commercially available as Ficoll-Paque PLUS (Cytiva), Lymphoprep (Stem Cell Technologies), Histopaque-1077 (Sigma).
notes.zh: 目标密度：20°C 时 1.077 g/mL。用校准比重计或密度计验证。调整：增加 Ficoll → 密度升高；增加稀释液 → 密度降低。1.077 g/mL 时：红细胞 + 粒细胞（1.08–1.09）沉入底部；PBMC（1.07–1.075）在界面成带；血小板留在血浆层。pH 7.2–7.4。渗透压：290–310 mOsm。使用前务必恢复室温（对分离效果至关重要）。商品化产品：Ficoll-Paque PLUS（Cytiva）、Lymphoprep（Stem Cell Technologies）、Histopaque-1077（Sigma）。

notes.en:
Mix 9 parts Percoll + 1 part 10× PBS to create Isotonic Percoll Stock (IPS, density ~1.124 g/mL). Prepare working gradients by diluting IPS with 1× PBS:
- For PBMC (density 1.077): 77% IPS in 1× PBS → (0.77 × 1.124) + (0.23 × 1.007) = 1.077 g/mL
- For mitochondria: 18% and 30% IPS layers (see mitochondria_isolation)
- For neutrophils: 70% and 55% IPS layers (density 1.08 and 1.10)
Verify density of each layer by weighing 1.000 mL on analytical balance. Do NOT autoclave (degrades coating). Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm) for cell work. Store at 4°C; stable 1 year.
notes.zh:
9 份 Percoll + 1 份 10× PBS 配制等渗 Percoll 储液（IPS，密度 ~1.124 g/mL）。IPS 用 1× PBS 稀释配制工作梯度：
- PBMC（密度 1.077）：77% IPS in 1× PBS
- 线粒体：18% 和 30% IPS 层（参见 mitochondria_isolation）
- 中性粒细胞：70% 和 55% IPS 层（密度 1.08 和 1.10）
每层密度用分析天平称量 1.000 mL 验证。勿高压灭菌（破坏包被）。细胞实验用 0.22 µm 过滤除菌。4°C 保存，稳定 1 年。

ref: GE Healthcare Percoll Methodology and Applications Booklet; Böyum et al. (1991) Eur J Haematol 47:308; Pertoft (2000) J Biochem Biophys Methods 44:1–30

usage.en: Sodium orthovanadate phosphatase inhibitor stock for preserving phosphorylation in cell lysates.

name: Sucrose Gradient Solutions (10–70% for Organelle Isolation)
nameCn: 蔗糖密度梯度液（10–70%，细胞器分离用）

note.en: Prepare each density separately: 10%=10 g, 20%=20 g, 30%=30 g, 40%=40 g, 50%=50 g, 60%=60 g, 70%=70 g per 100 mL
10 mM final; or use 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4
note.zh: 终浓度 10 mM；或换用 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4

note.en: 1 mM final; Ca²⁺ chelation protects organelle membranes

notes.en:
Sucrose density (approx, 20°C): 10%=1.040 g/mL, 20%=1.083, 30%=1.130, 40%=1.179, 50%=1.230, 60%=1.286, 70%=1.347.
Common layer configurations:
- ER microsomes: 10/20/30/40% (step) or 15–45% linear
- Golgi apparatus: 10/25/35% or linear 10–50%
- Lysosomes: 14.3%/19%/26% step; pellet after 100,000×g 1 h
- Exosomes: 30%/45%/60% step (or 10–70% continuous)
Prepare continuous gradient with gradient maker or freeze-thaw method (layer, freeze −80°C, thaw at 4°C = diffusion gradient). Store at 4°C up to 2 weeks. Filter 0.22 µm for RNase-free applications.

ref: Graham (2002) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 3.6.1–3.6.13; de Duve et al. (1955) Biochem J 60:604–617; Bhatt & Bhatt (2021) STAR Protoc 2:100450

usage.en: See notes for usage.

prepSteps.zh: Dissolve sucrose in HEPES or Tris buffer to desired concentration.

prepSteps.zh: Verify density with refractometer.

prepSteps.zh: Store at 4°C; prepare fresh for best results.

Used as base buffer for step sucrose gradients (0.25 M / 0.86 M / 1.3 M / 2.0 M layered for ER/Golgi separation) or continuous gradient (0.25–2.0 M). Keep all solutions ice-cold throughout.

ref: Graham (2001) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 3.6.1; Bhatt et al. (2021) STAR Protoc 2:100450

usage.en: 250 mM sucrose buffer for cell homogenization and organelle isolation by density gradient.
usage.zh: 250 mM 蔗糖匀浆缓冲液，用于细胞匀浆和密度梯度法分离细胞器。

prepSteps.zh: Dissolve sucrose (0.25 M) in HEPES or Tris buffer.

prepSteps.zh: Add EDTA/EGTA and adjust pH to 7.4.

note.zh: 200 mM

notes.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 2.2。37°C 孵育 10–15 min × 2 次，然后 TBST 洗 3 次 × 10 min，重新封闭。

ref: Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40

usage.en: Western blot membrane stripping buffer for antibody removal and membrane re-probing.
usage.zh: WB 膜剥脱缓冲液，用于去除抗体后重新探针。

prepSteps.zh: 将甘氨酸、SDS、Tween-20 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 2.2

usage.zh: Western Blot 一抗稀释液。含 BSA 和叠氮钠——不可用于稀释 HRP 标记二抗。

prepSteps.zh: Add TBST to a clean bottle.

prepSteps.zh: Add 30% BSA stock (16.7 mL per 100 mL for 5% final) and mix.

prepSteps.zh: Add 5% sodium azide stock (1 mL per 100 mL for 0.05% final).

prepSteps.zh: Mix well. Store at 4°C.

name: 2×YT Medium

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

usage.en: 2× YT rich medium for high-yield E. coli culture and phage work.
usage.zh: 2× YT 富集培养基，用于大肠杆菌高产培养和噬菌体实验。

prepSteps.zh: 将胰蛋白胨、酵母提取物、NaCl 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

name: Bacterial Glycerol Stock

note.en: Final concentration 15–25%

notes.en: Mix gently by inversion (do not vortex). Label tube with strain name, plasmid, resistance marker, and date. Snap-freeze in liquid nitrogen or dry ice, store at −80°C. To recover, streak directly onto selective plate from frozen stock. Never freeze-thaw. Final glycerol concentration of 15–25% is acceptable.
notes.zh: 轻柔混匀 (不要涡旋)。标记菌株名、质粒、抗性、日期。速冻于液氮或干冰，-80°C 长期保存。复苏时直接划线至含抗生素 LB 平板，切勿反复冻融。终甘油浓度 15–25% 均可。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

usage.en: Long-term bacterial glycerol cryostock for preserving E. coli strains at -80°C.
usage.zh: 细菌甘油冻存液，用于 -80°C 长期保存大肠杆菌菌株。

label.en: -80°C, indefinite; Do not thaw — streak directly; avoid freeze-thaw

prepSteps.zh: 培养细菌至稳定期（过夜培养）

prepSteps.en: Mix gently by inversion. Do NOT vortex
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔颠倒混匀。不要涡旋

prepSteps.en: Label tube (strain, plasmid, resistance, date). Snap-freeze in liquid N₂
prepSteps.zh: 标记管子（菌株、质粒、抗性、日期）。液氮速冻

prepSteps.en: Store at -80°C. To recover: streak directly onto selective plate from frozen stock
prepSteps.zh: -80°C 保存。复苏时：直接从冻存管划线至选择性平板

name: Cell Freezing Medium (10% DMSO)

notes.en: Prepare fresh or pre-chill at 4°C. DMSO is a penetrating cryoprotectant that prevents ice crystal formation. After resuspending cells, transfer quickly to cryovials, use a controlled-rate freezing container (-1°C/min) to -80°C, then move to liquid nitrogen after 24h. DMSO is cytotoxic at 37°C — dilute promptly after thawing.
notes.zh: 使用前现配或 4°C 预冷。DMSO 是渗透性冷冻保护剂，防止冰晶形成。细胞重悬后迅速转移至冻存管，使用梯度降温盒 (-1°C/min) 放入 -80°C，24h 后转液氮。DMSO 在 37°C 对细胞有毒，解冻后尽快稀释。

ref: Freshney (2015) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th ed.

usage.en: Cryopreservation medium (DMSO + FBS) for long-term storage of cell lines in liquid nitrogen.
usage.zh: 冻存培养基（DMSO + FBS），用于液氮长期保存细胞系。

prepSteps.zh: 将 DMSO 加入灭活 FBS（90:10 比例）

prepSteps.en: Mix gently, pre-chill at 4°C before use
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔混匀，使用前 4°C 预冷

prepSteps.zh: 无菌条件下，向 DMEM 中加入 FBS 和双抗

note.zh: 10 mM（可选）

prepSteps.zh: 可选：加 HEPES 维持 pH 稳定

prepSteps.zh: Dissolve tryptone (10 g), yeast extract (5 g), and NaCl (10 g) in ~800 mL ddH₂O.

prepSteps.zh: Adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH.

prepSteps.zh: Bring to final volume of 1000 mL.

prepSteps.zh: Autoclave at 121°C for 20 min.

prepSteps.zh: Cool to <55°C before adding antibiotics.

note.zh: 37°C 融化，涡旋溶解沉淀

notes.en: Method 2 (alternative to ITS-G): use separate Insulin (0.005 mg/mL from 10 mg/mL stock, 250 µL per 500 mL), Transferrin (0.01 mg/mL from 2.2 mg/mL stock, 2.27 mL per 500 mL), and Sodium selenite (30 nM from 5 mg/mL stock, serial dilute 963,000×). Hydrocortisone and β-estradiol stocks are fluid even at -80°C. Useful calculator: selleckchem.com/molaritycalculator.jsp
notes.zh: 方法2（替代 ITS-G）：分别加 Insulin (0.005 mg/mL)、Transferrin (0.01 mg/mL)、Sodium selenite (30 nM)。氢化可的松和雌二醇母液在 -80°C 仍为液态。

ref: ATCC NCI-H660 culture guide

usage.en: Complete medium for NCI-H660 neuroendocrine prostate cancer cell line per ATCC recommendation.
usage.zh: NCI-H660 神经内分泌前列腺癌细胞系完全培养基（ATCC 推荐配方）。

label.en: 4°C, 1 month; Store at 4°C protected from light. Pre-warm to 37°C before use.

prepSteps.en: Add 5 mL ITS-G to 500 mL RPMI-1640 bottle.
prepSteps.zh: Add 5 mL ITS-G to 500 mL RPMI-1640 bottle.

prepSteps.en: Prepare hydrocortisone: serial dilute 10 mM stock 1,000,000× (1 µL into 1000 µL medium, then add 500 µL to bottle). Stock is fluid at -80°C — keep on ice. (Final 10 nM)
prepSteps.zh: Prepare hydrocortisone: serial dilute 10 mM stock 1,000,000× (1 µL into 1000 µL medium, then add 500 µL to bottle). Stock is fluid at -80°C — keep on ice. (Final 10 nM)

prepSteps.en: Prepare β-estradiol: vortex 50 mM stock to dissolve precipitates. Serial dilute 5,000,000× (1 µL into 1000 µL medium, then add 100 µL to bottle). (Final 10 nM)
prepSteps.zh: Prepare β-estradiol: vortex 50 mM stock to dissolve precipitates. Serial dilute 5,000,000× (1 µL into 1000 µL medium, then add 100 µL to bottle). (Final 10 nM)

prepSteps.en: Thaw L-glutamine at 37°C water bath, vortex to dissolve precipitates. Add 5 mL to bottle.
prepSteps.zh: Thaw L-glutamine at 37°C water bath, vortex to dissolve precipitates. Add 5 mL to bottle.

prepSteps.en: Add 25 mL FBS (5% final).
prepSteps.zh: Add 25 mL FBS (5% final).

prepSteps.en: Add 5 mL Pen/Strep (1% final).
prepSteps.zh: Add 5 mL Pen/Strep (1% final).

prepSteps.en: Mix gently by inversion. Store at 4°C.
prepSteps.zh: Mix gently by inversion. Store at 4°C.

note.en: Add after sterilization

usage.en: Rich recovery medium for bacteria post-electroporation or heat-shock transformation.

prepSteps.zh: 将 Tryptone/Yeast/NaCl/KCl 一起高压灭菌

name: Terrific Broth (TB)

notes.en: 2-3× higher density than LB. Glycerol = carbon source; phosphate prevents pH drop. Ideal for recombinant protein. Autoclave phosphate separately!

usage.zh: Terrific Broth 培养基，用于重组蛋白表达时的高密度大肠杆菌培养。

prepSteps.zh: Separately prepare 10× phosphate buffer: KH₂PO₄ (2.31 g) and K₂HPO₄ (12.54 g) in 100 mL ddH₂O; autoclave separately.

prepSteps.zh: Autoclave base medium at 121°C for 20 min.

prepSteps.zh: Cool to <55°C and add 100 mL sterile 10× phosphate buffer.

prepSteps.zh: Add antibiotics if needed.

prepSteps.zh: Store at 4°C.

prepSteps.zh: Dissolve Alizarin Red S (2 g per 100 mL, 2% w/v) in ddH₂O.

prepSteps.zh: Adjust pH to 4.1–4.3 with ammonium hydroxide (10%) or HCl.

prepSteps.en: Filter through 0.45 µm.
prepSteps.zh: Filter through 0.45 µm.

prepSteps.en: Store at room temperature protected from light for up to 6 months.
prepSteps.zh: Store at room temperature protected from light for up to 6 months.

name: Coomassie Blue Staining Solution

notes.en: Dissolve CBB in methanol first, then add acetic acid and water. Filter (0.45 µm) before use. Stain 1–4 h.
notes.zh: 先将 CBB 溶于甲醇，再加醋酸和水。使用前过滤 (0.45 µm)。染色 1–4 h。

ref: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol, Ch.10, Unit 10.6

usage.en: Coomassie Brilliant Blue R-250 staining solution for visualizing proteins in SDS-PAGE gels.
usage.zh: 考马斯亮蓝 R-250 染色液，用于 SDS-PAGE 胶中蛋白质可视化。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Coomassie Brilliant Blue R-250 in methanol first. ⚠️ Methanol is toxic — handle in fume hood.
prepSteps.zh: Dissolve Coomassie Brilliant Blue R-250 in methanol first. ⚠️ Methanol is toxic — handle in fume hood.

prepSteps.en: Add glacial acetic acid.
prepSteps.zh: Add glacial acetic acid.

prepSteps.en: Bring to final volume with ddH₂O.
prepSteps.zh: Bring to final volume with ddH₂O.

prepSteps.zh: Stir until dye is completely dissolved.

prepSteps.zh: Filter through Whatman No. 1 or 0.45 µm filter before use.

prepSteps.en: Store at room temperature; reuse multiple times.
prepSteps.zh: Store at room temperature; reuse multiple times.

usage.zh: 甲醇/乙酸脱色液，用于 SDS-PAGE 胶的考马斯蓝背景脱色。

prepSteps.zh: Combine methanol (100 mL, 10%) and glacial acetic acid (100 mL, 10%) in ~800 mL ddH₂O. ⚠️ Methanol is toxic — handle in fume hood.

prepSteps.en: Mix well.
prepSteps.zh: Mix well.

prepSteps.en: Store at room temperature.
prepSteps.zh: Store at room temperature.

prepSteps.en: Can be reused multiple times; add crumpled Kimwipes or sponge to absorb released dye.
prepSteps.zh: Can be reused multiple times; add crumpled Kimwipes or sponge to absorb released dye.

name: Crystal Violet Staining Solution

notes.en: Fix and stain adherent cells: wash with PBS, apply staining solution for 20 min at RT, rinse thoroughly with ddH₂O, air-dry. To quantify: dissolve stain in 10% acetic acid, read absorbance at OD₅₉₅. Used for colony formation assays and biofilm detection.
notes.zh: 固定并染色贴壁细胞: PBS 洗 → 加染色液覆盖 → 室温 20 min → ddH₂O 反复冲洗 → 晾干。定量: 加 10% 冰醋酸溶解结晶紫，OD₅₉₅ 测吸光度。适用于克隆形成实验 (colony formation assay) 和生物膜检测。

ref: Feoktistova et al. (2016) Cold Spring Harb Protoc 2016(4):pdb.prot087379

usage.en: Crystal violet cell stain for colony counting, cell viability, and migration assays.
usage.zh: 结晶紫细胞染色液，用于克隆计数、细胞活力和迁移实验。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve crystal violet in methanol first, then add ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 先将结晶紫溶于甲醇，再加 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Mix thoroughly. Store in dark bottle
prepSteps.zh: 充分混匀。避光瓶保存

name: DAPI Staining Solution

note.en: Final concentration 1 µg/mL
note.zh: 终浓度 1 µg/mL

notes.en: DAPI stock: dissolve 5 mg in 1 mL ddH₂O, aliquot and store at −20°C protected from light. Working solution (1 µg/mL) should be prepared fresh. For fixed/permeabilized cells: incubate 5–10 min at RT in the dark, wash 2× with PBS. Ex/Em: 358/461 nm (blue fluorescence). Membrane-impermeant in live cells — used for dead cell exclusion in flow cytometry (0.1–0.5 µg/mL). Mounting media with DAPI is more convenient for microscopy.
notes.zh: DAPI stock: 5 mg 溶于 1 mL ddH₂O，分装后 -20°C 避光保存。工作液 (1 µg/mL) 现配现用。固定透化后的细胞: 室温避光孵育 5–10 min，PBS 洗 2 次。Ex/Em: 358/461 nm (蓝色荧光)。活细胞不透膜，用于死细胞排除 (流式 0.1–0.5 µg/mL)。封片用含 DAPI 的封片剂更方便。

ref: Kapuscinski (1995) Biotech Histochem 70:220–233

usage.en: DAPI fluorescent nuclear counterstain for immunofluorescence and flow cytometry.
usage.zh: DAPI 荧光核染料，用于免疫荧光和流式细胞术的细胞核复染。

label.en: -20°C, 12 months; Light-sensitive; aliquot from 1 mg/mL stock

prepSteps.en: Prepare 5 mg/mL stock: dissolve 5 mg DAPI in 1 mL ddH₂O. Aliquot, store -20°C light-protected
prepSteps.zh: 配 5 mg/mL 母液: 5 mg DAPI 溶于 1 mL ddH₂O。分装，-20°C 避光保存

prepSteps.en: Dilute to 1 µg/mL in PBS for working solution (1:5000 from stock)
prepSteps.zh: 用 PBS 稀释至 1 µg/mL 工作液（母液 1:5000）

prepSteps.en: Apply to fixed/permeabilized cells. Incubate 5–10 min RT in dark
prepSteps.zh: 加至固定/透化的细胞。室温避光 5–10 min

prepSteps.en: Wash 2× PBS. Mount and image (Ex 358 nm / Em 461 nm = blue)
prepSteps.zh: PBS 洗 2 次。封片后成像 (Ex 358 nm / Em 461 nm = 蓝色)

name: Enhanced ECL (Homemade)

prepSteps.zh: Prepare Solution B: dilute 30% H₂O₂ in Tris-HCl pH 8.5. ⚠️ 30% H₂O₂ is a strong oxidizer — handle with care.

prepSteps.en: Mix Solution A and Solution B 1:1 immediately before use.
prepSteps.zh: Mix Solution A and Solution B 1:1 immediately before use.

prepSteps.en: Store Solutions A and B separately at 4°C protected from light.
prepSteps.zh: Store Solutions A and B separately at 4°C protected from light.

prepSteps.zh: Mixed working solution must be used within 1 hour.

usage.en: Oil Red O stain for detecting intracellular lipid droplets in adipocytes.
usage.zh: 油红 O 染色，用于检测脂肪细胞内的脂滴。

label.en: RT, 3 months; Filter before each use

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Oil Red O (0.5 g) in 100 mL isopropanol to make stock (0.5%).
prepSteps.zh: Dissolve Oil Red O (0.5 g) in 100 mL isopropanol to make stock (0.5%).

prepSteps.en: For working solution: mix 3 parts stock with 2 parts ddH₂O (0.3% final).
prepSteps.zh: For working solution: mix 3 parts stock with 2 parts ddH₂O (0.3% final).

prepSteps.en: Let stand 10 min, then filter through 0.22 µm.
prepSteps.zh: Let stand 10 min, then filter through 0.22 µm.

prepSteps.en: Prepare working solution fresh before each use.
prepSteps.zh: Prepare working solution fresh before each use.

prepSteps.en: Store stock at room temperature for up to 12 months.
prepSteps.zh: Store stock at room temperature for up to 12 months.

name: Ponceau S Staining Solution

notes.en: Soak PVDF/NC membrane for 1–5 min after transfer. Rinse with TBS or water to destain. Solution is reusable.
notes.zh: 转膜后浸泡 PVDF/NC 膜 1–5 min，TBS 或水洗即可脱色。可重复使用。

ref: Romero-Calvo et al. (2010) Anal Biochem 401:318–320

usage.en: Reversible red protein stain for verifying transfer efficiency on western blot membranes.
usage.zh: 可逆红色蛋白染色，用于验证 Western blot 转膜效率。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Ponceau S (0.1–0.2% w/v) in 5% acetic acid.
prepSteps.zh: Dissolve Ponceau S (0.1–0.2% w/v) in 5% acetic acid.

prepSteps.en: Mix until completely dissolved.
prepSteps.zh: Mix until completely dissolved.

prepSteps.en: Store at room temperature.
prepSteps.zh: Store at room temperature.

prepSteps.en: Solution can be reused many times; filter if precipitate forms.
prepSteps.zh: Solution can be reused many times; filter if precipitate forms.

name: 10X Genomics + CITE-seq Protocol

components.name: Step 1 (Dissociation): Prepare dissociation medium per Miltenyi kit. Mince 0.04-1 g tumor with razor. Transfer to tube, rotate 37°C 1 h.
Step 2: Centrifuge 400 g 4°C 5 min. Aspirate, add 10 mL cold PBS, filter through 40-70 µm strainer.
Step 3 (Percoll gradient): Resuspend pellet in 4 mL 70% Percoll. Layer 4 mL 37% Red Percoll on top. Layer 4 mL 30% Percoll on top.

note.en: Prepare Percoll day-of-use only. Keep at RT (22-25°C).
note.zh: Percoll 仅当天配制。保持室温 (22-25°C)。

components.name: Step 4: Centrifuge swinging bucket 800 g, 25 min, RT, LOWEST acceleration, NO BRAKE.

note.en: CRITICAL: Low acceleration and no brake prevent gradient disruption.
note.zh: 关键：低加速和无制动防止梯度破坏。

components.name: Step 5: Remove layers above buffy coat at 37%/70% interface (slowly, tip at surface). Extract buffy coat with wide-bore tip into new 15 mL tube.
Step 6: Wash to 15 mL with cold PBS. Centrifuge 400 g 7 min 4°C. Resuspend in staining buffer.
Step 7 (Fc block): Resuspend 0.5M cells in 50 µL FcR block (1:5 in staining buffer). Incubate 20 min on ice.
Step 8 (CITE-seq staining): Add 50 µL antibody cocktail (0.125 µg each CITE-seq Ab + unique HTO antibody per sample). Incubate 25 min on ice.

note.en: CRITICAL: Each sample must receive a UNIQUE HTO antibody for hashing.
note.zh: 关键：每个样本必须使用唯一的 HTO 抗体。

components.name: Step 9 (Washes): Wash with ≥5 mL staining buffer (350-400 g 5 min 4°C) → Wash A → Wash B → Wash C. Count cells during final wash.
Step 10: Resuspend at 1,600 cells/µL in staining buffer for 10X superloading.

notes.en: Percoll preparation: Working stock (WS) = 6.42 mL Percoll + 0.71 mL 10× HBSS. 70% = 3.5 mL WS + 1 mL 1× HBSS. 37% Red = 1.85 mL WS + 2.65 mL red HBSS. 30% = 1.5 mL WS + 3 mL 1× HBSS. Red HBSS enhances buffy coat visibility. Centrifuge Percoll within 10 min of layering. Minimize Percoll carryover when extracting buffy coat. Titrate antibodies by flow cytometry before CITE-seq.
notes.zh: Percoll 配制：工作液 (WS) = 6.42 mL Percoll + 0.71 mL 10× HBSS。70% = 3.5 mL WS + 1 mL 1× HBSS。37% 红 = 1.85 mL WS + 2.65 mL 含酚红 HBSS。30% = 1.5 mL WS + 3 mL 1× HBSS。分层后 10 分钟内离心。取 buffy coat 时减少 Percoll 带出。

ref: Adapted from 10X Genomics + CITE-seq protocol; BioLegend TotalSeq guidelines

usage.en: Single-cell preparation from solid tumor with Percoll gradient purification, CITE-seq antibody staining with hashing (HTO), and 10X Chromium loading.
usage.zh: 从实体瘤制备单细胞悬液，Percoll 密度梯度纯化，CITE-seq 抗体染色（含 hashing），10X Chromium 上样。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 5-6 hours，实操: 3 hours

materials.name: 1× HBSS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ (with and without Phenol Red)
CITE-seq staining buffer, Wash Buffers A/B/C

note.en: Cell pellet can be kept on ice in PBS for up to 30 min before Percoll gradient
note.zh: 细胞沉淀可在 PBS 中冰上保存 30 分钟后再做 Percoll 梯度

note.en: Washed single-cell suspension can be kept on ice for 1 h before staining
note.zh: 洗涤后的单细胞悬液可在冰上保存 1 小时后再染色

briefSteps.en: Dissociate tumor → filter → Percoll gradient → collect buffy coat → wash → Fc block → CITE-seq Ab + HTO staining → wash A/B/C → count → 10X Chromium load
briefSteps.zh: 肿瘤解离 → 过滤 → Percoll 梯度 → 收集 buffy coat → 洗涤 → Fc 封闭 → CITE-seq 抗体 + HTO 染色 → 洗涤 A/B/C → 计数 → 10X Chromium 上样

detailedSteps.en: **Tumor Dissociation & Single-Cell Prep**
detailedSteps.zh: **肿瘤解离与单细胞制备**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare enzyme mix per Miltenyi Tumor Dissociation Kit. Mince 0.04–1 g tumor tissue with a sterile razor blade into ~1 mm³ pieces
detailedSteps.zh: 按 Miltenyi 肿瘤解离试剂盒配制酶液。将 0.04–1 g 肿瘤组织用无菌刀片切成 ~1 mm³ 碎块

detailedSteps.en: Transfer minced tissue to gentleMACS C tube with enzyme mix. Rotate at 37°C for 1 h (or use gentleMACS Octo Dissociator)
detailedSteps.zh: 将碎块转入含酶液的 gentleMACS C 管。37°C 旋转孵育 1 h（或用 gentleMACS Octo 解离仪）

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 400×g, 5 min, 4°C. Aspirate supernatant. Add 10 mL cold PBS and filter through 40–70 µm strainer
detailedSteps.zh: 400×g 离心 5 min，4°C。吸去上清。加 10 mL 冷 PBS，过 40–70 µm 滤网

detailedSteps.en: **Percoll Density Gradient Purification**
detailedSteps.zh: **Percoll 密度梯度纯化**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare Percoll working stock (WS): 6.42 mL Percoll + 0.71 mL 10× HBSS. Make 70% (3.5 mL WS + 1 mL 1× HBSS), 37% Red (1.85 mL WS + 2.65 mL red HBSS), 30% (1.5 mL WS + 3 mL 1× HBSS)
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 Percoll 工作液 (WS): 6.42 mL Percoll + 0.71 mL 10× HBSS。配 70%（3.5 mL WS + 1 mL 1× HBSS）、37% 红色（1.85 mL WS + 2.65 mL 含酚红 HBSS）、30%（1.5 mL WS + 3 mL 1× HBSS）

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend cell pellet in 4 mL 70% Percoll. Layer 4 mL 37% Red Percoll gently on top, then 4 mL 30% Percoll on top of that
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞沉淀重悬于 4 mL 70% Percoll。缓慢覆加 4 mL 37% 红色 Percoll，再覆加 4 mL 30% Percoll

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge swinging-bucket rotor at 800×g, 25 min, RT. Use LOWEST acceleration and NO BRAKE
detailedSteps.zh: 摇摆转头 800×g 离心 25 min，室温。使用最低加速和无制动

detailedSteps.en: Carefully remove layers above buffy coat at the 37%/70% interface. Extract buffy coat with wide-bore tip into fresh 15 mL tube
detailedSteps.zh: 小心去除 37%/70% 界面上方液层。用宽口吸头提取 buffy coat 至新 15 mL 管

detailedSteps.en: Wash to 15 mL with cold PBS. Centrifuge 400×g, 7 min, 4°C. Resuspend pellet in staining buffer
detailedSteps.zh: 用冷 PBS 补至 15 mL。400×g 离心 7 min，4°C。用染色缓冲液重悬沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **CITE-seq Antibody Staining & Hashing**
detailedSteps.zh: **CITE-seq 抗体染色与 Hashing**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend 0.5×10⁶ cells in 50 µL FcR Blocking Reagent (1:5 in staining buffer). Incubate 20 min on ice
detailedSteps.zh: 将 0.5×10⁶ 细胞重悬于 50 µL FcR 封闭试剂（1:5 稀释于染色缓冲液）。冰上孵育 20 min

detailedSteps.en: Add 50 µL antibody cocktail (0.125 µg each CITE-seq Ab + unique HTO antibody per sample). Incubate 25 min on ice
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 50 µL 抗体混合液（每种 CITE-seq 抗体 0.125 µg + 每个样本唯一的 HTO 抗体）。冰上孵育 25 min

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3× with staining buffer: centrifuge 350–400×g, 5 min, 4°C. Perform sequential washes with Wash A, Wash B, and Wash C. Count cells during final wash
detailedSteps.zh: 用染色缓冲液洗涤 3 次：350–400×g 离心 5 min，4°C。依次用 Wash A、Wash B、Wash C 洗涤。最后一次洗涤时计数

detailedSteps.en: **10X Chromium Loading**
detailedSteps.zh: **10X Chromium 上样**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend cells at 1,600 cells/µL in staining buffer. Load onto 10X Chromium controller per manufacturer instructions
detailedSteps.zh: 用染色缓冲液将细胞浓度调至 1,600 cells/µL。按厂商说明上样至 10X Chromium 控制器

name: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis

components.name: 2. 微波加热至完全溶解 (注意防沸)

note.en: Add 5 µL/50 mL from 10,000× stock
note.zh: 10,000× stock 加 5 µL/50 mL

components.name: 4. 倒入胶板，插梳，室温凝固 20–30 min
5. 样品与 6× Loading Dye 混合 (5:1)

notes.en: TAE is better for large fragments and gel extraction (low ionic strength, easier to cut bands); TBE provides higher resolution for small fragments (<1 kb). EtBr is carcinogenic — use GelRed/SYBR Safe alternatives. Running buffer and gel buffer must match. Avoid air bubbles. RNA gels require formaldehyde denaturing agarose.
notes.zh: TAE 适合大片段和胶回收 (低离子强度，跑得慢易切胶)；TBE 分辨率更高适合小片段 (<1 kb)。EtBr 致癌，推荐用 GelRed/SYBR Safe 等替代品。电泳缓冲液和制胶缓冲液须一致。避免气泡。RNA 胶需用甲醛变性凝胶。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.; Lee et al. (2012) J Vis Exp 62:e3923

usage.en: Separate DNA fragments by size using agarose gel electrophoresis for analysis or extraction.
usage.zh: 琼脂糖凝胶电泳按大小分离 DNA 片段，用于分析或回收。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 hours，实操: 30 minutes

note.en: Use low-melt for gel extraction
note.zh: 胶回收用低熔点琼脂糖

note.en: 0.5 µg/mL EtBr or 1× SYBR Safe
note.zh: 0.5 µg/mL EtBr 或 1× SYBR Safe

note.en: Match expected fragment sizes
note.zh: 与目标片段大小匹配

materials.name: UV transilluminator or blue light imager

note.en: Wrapped in plastic wrap with buffer, 4°C (up to 1 week)
note.zh: Wrapped in plastic wrap with buffer, 4°C (最长 1 week)

note.en: Image immediately or store gel in buffer at 4°C (up to overnight)
note.zh: Image immediately or store gel in buffer at 4°C (最长 overnight)

briefSteps.en: Dissolve agarose in TAE/TBE buffer (0.8–2%), add DNA stain at ~55°C, pour and set gel, load samples with loading dye alongside DNA ladder, run at 5–8 V/cm for 30–60 min, then visualize under UV or blue light.
briefSteps.zh: 将琼脂糖溶于 TAE/TBE 缓冲液（0.8–2%），约 55°C 时加入核酸染料，倒胶凝固，加载含上样缓冲液的样品及 DNA Ladder，5–8 V/cm 电泳 30–60 min，紫外灯或蓝光灯下观察。

detailedSteps.en: Select appropriate agarose concentration based on expected fragment sizes: 0.8% for >1 kb, 1% for 0.5–7 kb, 1.5% for 0.2–3 kb, 2% for 0.1–2 kb. For gel extraction, use TAE buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 根据预期片段大小选择琼脂糖浓度：>1 kb 用 0.8%，0.5–7 kb 用 1%，0.2–3 kb 用 1.5%，0.1–2 kb 用 2%。用于胶回收时应使用 TAE 缓冲液。

detailedSteps.en: Weigh agarose powder and add to 1× TAE or TBE buffer (e.g., 0.5 g agarose in 50 mL buffer for a 1% gel). Heat in microwave in 30-second bursts, swirling between bursts, until fully dissolved and clear. Avoid boiling over.
detailedSteps.zh: 称量琼脂糖粉末，加入 1× TAE 或 TBE 缓冲液（如 1% 胶：0.5 g 琼脂糖加 50 mL 缓冲液）。微波炉每次 30 秒加热，每次间隔摇匀，至完全溶解透明。注意防止沸腾溢出。

detailedSteps.en: Allow agarose solution to cool to ~55°C (comfortable to hold). Add 5 µL GelRed or SYBR Safe (10,000× stock) per 50 mL gel. Swirl to mix. Alternatively, post-stain with EtBr after running.
detailedSteps.zh: 待琼脂糖溶液冷却至约 55°C（手持不烫）。每 50 mL 凝胶加入 5 µL GelRed 或 SYBR Safe（10,000× 储液）并摇匀。也可在电泳结束后再进行 EtBr 后染。

detailedSteps.en: Pour gel into casting tray with combs in place. Avoid air bubbles — pop any with a pipette tip. Allow to solidify at room temperature for 20–30 min until opaque.
detailedSteps.zh: 将凝胶倒入已插好梳子的胶槽中。用枪头戳破气泡。室温凝固 20–30 min 至不透明。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer gel to electrophoresis tank. Fill with the same buffer (TAE or TBE, matching gel buffer) until gel is submerged by 2–3 mm. Remove combs carefully.
detailedSteps.zh: 将凝胶移至电泳槽中，加入相同缓冲液（TAE 或 TBE，须与制胶缓冲液一致），使凝胶被淹没 2–3 mm。小心拔出梳子。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare samples: mix DNA with 6× loading dye at a 5:1 ratio (e.g., 5 µL DNA + 1 µL dye). Load 3–5 µL of appropriate DNA ladder into the first lane.
detailedSteps.zh: 准备样品：将 DNA 与 6× 上样缓冲液以 5:1 比例混合（如 5 µL DNA + 1 µL 缓冲液）。在第一泳道加入 3–5 µL 合适的 DNA Ladder。

detailedSteps.en: Load samples into wells carefully. Run electrophoresis at 5–8 V/cm (e.g., 100 V for a 13 cm gel) for 30–60 min. Run until bromophenol blue dye front has migrated 2/3 of the gel length.
detailedSteps.zh: 小心将样品加入上样孔。以 5–8 V/cm（如 13 cm 胶板用 100 V）电泳 30–60 min。至溴酚蓝染料前沿迁移至凝胶 2/3 处停止。

detailedSteps.en: Visualize DNA bands under UV transilluminator (for EtBr/GelRed) or blue-light box (for SYBR Safe/GelGreen). Photograph the gel. Wear UV-protective eyewear. Minimize UV exposure time to preserve DNA for gel extraction.
detailedSteps.zh: 在紫外灯下（用于 EtBr/GelRed）或蓝光灯下（用于 SYBR Safe/GelGreen）观察 DNA 条带，拍照记录。佩戴紫外防护眼镜。若需胶回收，尽量缩短紫外暴露时间以保护 DNA。

name: Annexin V / PI Apoptosis Assay
nameCn: Annexin V / PI 凋亡检测

components.name: 4. Add 5 µL FITC-Annexin V + 5 µL PI
7. Analyze by flow cytometry within 1 h

notes.en: AV⁻/PI⁻=live; AV⁺/PI⁻=early apoptosis; AV⁺/PI⁺=late apoptosis; AV⁻/PI⁺=necrosis. CaCl₂ essential. Positive control: staurosporine 1 µM 6 h.
notes.zh: AV⁻/PI⁻=活；AV⁺/PI⁻=早期凋亡；AV⁺/PI⁺=晚期凋亡；AV⁻/PI⁺=坏死。需含 CaCl₂。阳性对照：星形孢菌素 1 µM 6 h。

ref: Vermes et al. (1995) J Immunol Methods 184:39

usage.en: Detect early and late apoptosis by Annexin V/PI staining and flow cytometry.
usage.zh: 通过 Annexin V/PI 染色和流式细胞术检测早期和晚期凋亡。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: From apoptosis detection kit
note.zh: 凋亡检测试剂盒

note.en: 50 µg/mL working concentration
note.zh: 工作浓度 50 µg/mL

note.en: 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 140 mM NaCl, 2.5 mM CaCl₂
note.zh: 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 140 mM NaCl, 2.5 mM CaCl₂

note.en: 1 mM stock in DMSO (positive control)
note.zh: 1 mM DMSO 储液（阳性对照）

note.en: Cells remain in apoptosis-inducing treatment for the required duration (6–72 h depending on agent); plan staining the next morning if using overnight treatment
note.zh: 细胞在凋亡诱导处理中保留所需时长（6–72 h，取决于试剂）；过夜处理时可次日早上再染色

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells (floating + adherent) → wash cold PBS → resuspend 1×10⁵ cells in 100 µL binding buffer → add 5 µL Annexin V-FITC + 5 µL PI → incubate 15 min RT dark → add 400 µL binding buffer → analyze by flow cytometry within 1 h
briefSteps.zh: 收集细胞（漂浮 + 贴壁）→ 冷 PBS 洗涤 → 取 1×10⁵ 细胞重悬于 100 µL 结合缓冲液 → 加 5 µL Annexin V-FITC + 5 µL PI → 室温避光孵育 15 min → 加 400 µL 结合缓冲液 → 1 h 内流式分析

detailedSteps.en: Induce apoptosis with your agent of choice (e.g., staurosporine 1 µM for 6 h as positive control); do not discard floating cells as they contain early/late apoptotic populations.
detailedSteps.zh: 用目标试剂诱导凋亡（阳性对照：星形孢菌素 1 µM 孵育 6 h）；不要丢弃漂浮细胞，其中含早期/晚期凋亡群体。

detailedSteps.en: Collect floating cells from medium into a 15 mL tube; trypsinize adherent cells with 0.25% trypsin-EDTA for 2–3 min at 37°C and add to the same tube (combine floating + adherent populations).
detailedSteps.zh: 将培养基中漂浮细胞收集至 15 mL 离心管；用 0.25% 胰酶-EDTA 消化贴壁细胞（37°C 2–3 min），合并至同一管（漂浮 + 贴壁群体合并）。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C; carefully aspirate supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 300×g 离心 5 min；小心吸去上清。

detailedSteps.en: Wash pellet twice with ice-cold 1× PBS (300×g, 5 min, 4°C each wash); aspirate supernatant after each wash.
detailedSteps.zh: 用冰冷 1× PBS 洗涤沉淀两次（每次 300×g、5 min、4°C）；每次洗涤后吸去上清。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend 1×10⁵ cells per sample in 100 µL Annexin V binding buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 140 mM NaCl, 2.5 mM CaCl₂); CaCl₂ is essential for Annexin V binding.
detailedSteps.zh: 每管取 1×10⁵ 个细胞重悬于 100 µL Annexin V 结合缓冲液（10 mM HEPES pH 7.4、140 mM NaCl、2.5 mM CaCl₂）；CaCl₂ 是 Annexin V 结合所必需的。

detailedSteps.en: Add 5 µL FITC-conjugated Annexin V and 5 µL propidium iodide (PI, 50 µg/mL stock); mix gently; protect from light.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 5 µL FITC 偶联 Annexin V 和 5 µL PI（储液 50 µg/mL）；轻柔混匀；避光。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at room temperature for 15 min in the dark.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温避光孵育 15 min。

detailedSteps.en: Add 400 µL Annexin V binding buffer to each tube; gently mix.
detailedSteps.zh: 每管加入 400 µL Annexin V 结合缓冲液；轻柔混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Analyze by flow cytometry within 1 h on 488 nm laser; acquire ≥10,000 events; set up compensation controls (Annexin V single-stain and PI single-stain).
detailedSteps.zh: 1 h 内在 488 nm 激光流式细胞仪上分析；每样品采集 ≥10,000 个事件；设置补偿对照（Annexin V 单染和 PI 单染）。

detailedSteps.en: Gate and interpret quadrants: AV⁻/PI⁻ = live cells; AV⁺/PI⁻ = early apoptosis; AV⁺/PI⁺ = late apoptosis/secondary necrosis; AV⁻/PI⁺ = necrosis.
detailedSteps.zh: 分象限分析：AV⁻/PI⁻ = 活细胞；AV⁺/PI⁻ = 早期凋亡；AV⁺/PI⁺ = 晚期凋亡/继发性坏死；AV⁻/PI⁺ = 坏死。

name: ATAC-seq Library Preparation

components.name: 2. Lyse nuclei: cold lysis buffer + 0.1% NP-40

notes.en: Critical: fresh cells, do NOT over-lyse. Nucleosomal laddering = good library. 9-12 PCR cycles typical. ≥50M reads/sample.
notes.zh: 关键：新鲜细胞，不可过度裂解。核小体梯度条带 = 文库合格。通常 9-12 轮 PCR。≥50M reads/样品。

ref: Buenrostro et al. (2013) Nat Methods 10:1213

usage.en: Map open chromatin regions genome-wide using ATAC-seq (Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin).
usage.zh: ATAC-seq 全基因组开放染色质图谱分析。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 8 hours

note.en: Illumina Tagment DNA Enzyme and Buffer Kit (or homemade Tn5)
note.zh: Illumina Tagment DNA 酶及缓冲液试剂盒（或自制 Tn5）

note.en: Illumina Tagment DNA Buffer
note.zh: Illumina Tagment DNA 缓冲液

note.en: NEB #M0541
note.zh: NEB #M0541

note.en: 25 µM each, unique dual-index recommended
note.zh: 各 25 µM，建议使用独特双索引

note.en: Beckman Coulter
note.zh: Beckman Coulter

note.en: Qiagen #28004
note.zh: Qiagen #28004

note.en: For lysis buffer
note.zh: 用于裂解液

note.en: Purified tagmented DNA can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 week before PCR amplification.
note.zh: 纯化后的转座标记 DNA 可 −20°C 保存最长 1 周，待 PCR 扩增。

note.en: Final amplified and size-selected library can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month.
note.zh: 最终扩增并筛选大小后的文库可 −20°C 保存最长 1 个月。

briefSteps.en: Harvest 50,000 viable cells → wash → lyse nuclei in cold lysis buffer with 0.1% NP-40 → pellet nuclei → resuspend in transposition mix with Tn5 transposase (37°C, 30 min) → purify DNA → PCR amplify library (cycles determined by qPCR) → size-select 150–700 bp → QC on Bioanalyzer for nucleosomal ladder
briefSteps.zh: 收取 50,000 个活细胞 → 洗涤 → 冷裂解液（0.1% NP-40）裂解细胞核 → 离心收核 → Tn5 转座反应（37°C 30 min）→ DNA 纯化 → qPCR 确定循环数后 PCR 扩增文库 → 150–700 bp 片段选择 → Bioanalyzer QC 验证核小体梯度

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Nuclei Isolation and Tagmentation
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：细胞核分离与Tn5标记

detailedSteps.en: Harvest 50,000–100,000 viable cells (>90% viability). Pellet at 500×g for 5 min at 4°C; discard supernatant. Fresh cells are strongly preferred over frozen.
detailedSteps.zh: 收取 50,000–100,000 个活细胞（活率 >90%），500×g 4°C 离心 5 min 沉淀，弃上清。强烈建议使用新鲜细胞。

detailedSteps.en: Wash cells once with 50 µL ice-cold PBS; pellet at 500×g for 5 min at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 50 µL 冰冷 PBS 洗涤一次，500×g 4°C 离心 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Lyse nuclei: resuspend pellet in 50 µL cold lysis buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl₂, 0.1% NP-40); pipette 10× gently and immediately pellet nuclei at 500×g for 10 min at 4°C. Do NOT over-lyse.
detailedSteps.zh: 裂解细胞核：将沉淀重悬于 50 µL 冷裂解液（10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4、10 mM NaCl、3 mM MgCl₂、0.1% NP-40），轻柔吹打 10 次后立即 500×g 4°C 离心 10 min 收核。切勿过度裂解。

detailedSteps.en: Discard supernatant carefully; resuspend nuclei in 50 µL tagmentation reaction mix: 25 µL 2× Tagment DNA Buffer + 2.5 µL Tn5 Transposase (Illumina TDE1) + 22.5 µL nuclease-free water.
detailedSteps.zh: 小心弃上清；将细胞核重悬于 50 µL 转座反应液：25 µL 2× Tagment DNA Buffer + 2.5 µL Tn5 转座酶（Illumina TDE1）+ 22.5 µL 无核酸酶水。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate tagmentation reaction at 37°C for 30 min with gentle mixing (300 rpm on thermomixer). Stop by adding 5 µL 0.2% SDS.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 孵育转座反应 30 min（热混仪 300 rpm 轻摇）。加入 5 µL 0.2% SDS 终止反应。

detailedSteps.en: Purify tagmented DNA using MinElute PCR Purification Kit or Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator; elute in 10–12 µL elution buffer. Quantify by Qubit.
detailedSteps.zh: 使用 MinElute PCR 纯化试剂盒或 Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator 纯化标记 DNA，洗脱至 10–12 µL。Qubit 定量。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Library Amplification and QC
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天：文库扩增与质控

detailedSteps.en: Set up qPCR amplification side reaction (25 µL) with tagmented DNA + Nextera index primers + NEBNext HiFi PCR Master Mix; use Ct to determine optimal cycle number (Ct − 1 cycles; typically 9–12 cycles total).
detailedSteps.zh: 用 qPCR 侧管（25 µL）预扩增：标记 DNA + Nextera 索引引物 + NEBNext HiFi Master Mix；根据 Ct 值确定最优循环数（Ct−1 循环，通常共 9–12 个循环）。

detailedSteps.en: Amplify the main library: 72°C 5 min (extension), 98°C 30 s, then N cycles of (98°C 10 s, 63°C 30 s, 72°C 1 min). Use NEBNext Ultra II or similar high-fidelity polymerase.
detailedSteps.zh: 扩增主文库：72°C 5 min，98°C 30 s，再进行 N 个循环（98°C 10 s → 63°C 30 s → 72°C 1 min）。使用 NEBNext Ultra II 或同等高保真聚合酶。

detailedSteps.en: Purify amplified library with 1.2× AMPure XP (or SPRI) beads to remove primers and small fragments; size-select for 150–700 bp fragments. Elute in 20 µL EB.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 1.2× AMPure XP（SPRI）磁珠纯化文库，去除引物和小片段；保留 150–700 bp 片段。洗脱至 20 µL EB。

detailedSteps.en: QC library on Bioanalyzer (High Sensitivity DNA chip) or TapeStation: expected nucleosomal ladder pattern with peaks at ~200 bp (nucleosome-free), ~400 bp (mono-nucleosome), and ~600 bp (di-nucleosome). Quantify by qPCR for sequencing.
detailedSteps.zh: Bioanalyzer（高灵敏 DNA 芯片）或 TapeStation QC：预期出现核小体梯度条带，主要峰在约 200 bp（无核小体）、~400 bp（单核小体）、~600 bp（双核小体）。qPCR 定量后上机测序。

name: Bacterial Electroporation

components.name: 1. 冰上解冻电转感受态细胞 (10 min)

note.en: 2 mm cuvette: 2.5 kV; time constant should be 4–5 ms
note.zh: 2 mm 杯: 2.5 kV; 时间常数应为 4–5 ms

components.name: 7. 涂板 (含抗生素 LB 平板)

notes.en: High-efficiency transformation (10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg). 10–100× more efficient than chemical transformation. DNA must be desalted (salt causes arcing). Essential for large plasmids (>10 kb) and library construction. Pulse: 1.8 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω.
notes.zh: 高效转化 (10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg)。DNA 必须脱盐，否则放电弧光。时间常数应为 4–5 ms。适用于大质粒 (>10 kb) 和文库构建。

ref: Dower et al. (1988) Nucleic Acids Res 16:6127–6145; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

usage.en: Introduce DNA into bacterial or mammalian cells using high-voltage electroporation.
usage.zh: 高压电穿孔将 DNA 导入细菌或哺乳动物细胞。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 hours，实操: 1 hour

note.en: Wash buffer
note.zh: 洗涤缓冲液

note.en: DH10B, TOP10, or similar
note.zh: DH10B、TOP10 等

note.en: Pre-chilled
note.zh: 预冷

note.en: <5 µL, low salt
note.zh: <5 µL, 低盐

note.en: Plates with colonies can be sealed with Parafilm and stored at 4°C for up to 1 week.
note.zh: 长有菌落的平板用 Parafilm 封好，4°C 可保存最多 1 周。

briefSteps.en: Thaw electrocompetent cells on ice → add 1–5 µL desalted DNA → transfer to pre-chilled cuvette → pulse at 1.8 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω → immediately add 1 mL SOC → recover 37°C 1 h → plate on selective LB agar → incubate overnight
briefSteps.zh: 冰上解冻电转感受态细胞 → 加 1–5 µL 脱盐 DNA → 转移至预冷电转杯 → 1.8 kV、25 µF、200 Ω 电击 → 立即加 1 mL SOC → 37°C 恢复 1 h → 涂含抗生素 LB 平板 → 过夜培养

detailedSteps.en: Thaw one aliquot of electrocompetent cells (40–50 µL) on ice for 10 min. Keep on ice at all times. Pre-chill 1 mm electroporation cuvettes on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 将一管电转感受态细胞（40–50 µL）在冰上解冻 10 min，全程保持在冰上。将 1 mm 电转杯预冷于冰上。

detailedSteps.en: Add 1–5 µL of desalted DNA (plasmid, ligation product, or library) to the cells; mix by gentle flicking. DNA must be in low-salt buffer (water or 0.5× TE) — salt causes arcing.
detailedSteps.zh: 向细胞中加入 1–5 µL 脱盐 DNA（质粒、连接产物或文库），轻弹混匀。DNA 必须在低盐缓冲液（水或 0.5× TE）中，盐分会导致放弧。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer the cell-DNA mixture to the pre-chilled electroporation cuvette; tap gently to settle cells at the bottom between the electrodes. Keep on ice until electroporating.
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞-DNA 混合液转移至预冷电转杯，轻敲使细胞沉降至两极间底部，电击前保持在冰上。

detailedSteps.en: Set electroporator to: 1.8 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω (for 1 mm cuvette). For 2 mm cuvette: use 2.5 kV. Deliver a single pulse; the time constant should be 4–5 ms. A 'squeal' sound indicates arcing — discard and retry with better-desalted DNA.
detailedSteps.zh: 设置电转仪：1.8 kV、25 µF、200 Ω（1 mm 电转杯）；2 mm 杯用 2.5 kV。单次脉冲，时间常数应为 4–5 ms；若听到嗡鸣声表明放弧，须弃掉重试（提高 DNA 脱盐质量）。

detailedSteps.en: Immediately after the pulse, add 1 mL of pre-warmed SOC medium (37°C) to the cuvette; pipette up and down gently 2–3 times to resuspend cells.
detailedSteps.zh: 电击后立即向电转杯中加入 1 mL 预热至 37°C 的 SOC 培养基，轻柔吹打 2–3 次重悬细胞。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube or 15 mL culture tube; recover at 37°C, 225 rpm for 1 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞悬液转移至 1.5 mL 离心管或 15 mL 培养管，37°C、225 rpm 恢复培养 1 h。

detailedSteps.en: Plate 50–200 µL of recovery culture onto LB agar + antibiotic plates; for library construction, plate all cells after brief centrifugation and resuspension in 100 µL LB.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 50–200 µL 恢复菌液涂布含抗生素的 LB 平板；构建文库时，短暂离心后用 100 µL LB 重悬全部涂板。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate plates inverted at 37°C overnight (12–16 h). Expected transformation efficiency: 10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg DNA.
detailedSteps.zh: 倒置平板，37°C 过夜培养 12–16 h，预期转化效率：10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg DNA。

name: Bacterial Glycerol Stock Preparation

components.name: 1. 挑单克隆 → 接种 3–5 mL LB + 抗性
3. 取 500 µL 菌液 + 500 µL 50% 甘油

note.en: Final concentration 25% glycerol; or 15% DMSO
note.zh: 终浓度 25% 甘油; 或用 15% DMSO

components.name: 5. 标记管子（菌株、质粒、抗性、日期）

note.en: Do not pre-freeze at −20°C
note.zh: 不要预冻 -20°C

notes.en: Mix 500 µL overnight culture + 500 µL 50% glycerol (final 15-25%). Flash-freeze in liquid nitrogen. Store at -80°C for years. Recovery: streak on LB+antibiotic plate from frozen stock.
notes.zh: 复苏：用无菌枪头刮取少量冻存菌（不要完全解冻！），直接划板或接种液体培养基。正确保存可存活 >10 年。做 2 份备份放不同冰箱。甘油需灭菌。标签用防冻标记笔或防冻标签。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; Addgene Protocol: Making Glycerol Stocks

usage.en: Prepare and store long-term bacterial glycerol stocks at −80°C.
usage.zh: 制备细菌甘油保存管，−80°C 长期保存。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 20 minutes

note.en: Autoclaved
note.zh: 已灭菌

note.en: Autoclaved, sterile-filtered
note.zh: 灭菌、过滤除菌

note.en: e.g., ampicillin 100 mg/mL stock, kanamycin 50 mg/mL stock
note.zh: 如氨苄青霉素 100 mg/mL 储液，卡那霉素 50 mg/mL 储液

note.en: 1.5–2 mL, sterile, screw-cap
note.zh: 1.5–2 mL，无菌，螺旋盖

note.en: For flash-freezing
note.zh: 用于速冻

note.en: Overnight culture grows for 12–16 h
note.zh: 过夜培养 12–16 h

note.en: Glycerol stock stable at -80°C for >10 years
note.zh: 甘油菌 -80°C 可保存 >10 年

briefSteps.en: Pick single colony → grow overnight in LB + antibiotic → mix 500 µL culture with 500 µL 50% glycerol → label tube → snap-freeze → store at −80°C
briefSteps.zh: 挑单克隆 → LB + 抗生素过夜培养 → 500 µL 菌液与 500 µL 50% 甘油混合 → 标记管子 → 速冻 → −80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: Pick a single colony from a freshly streaked LB agar plate and inoculate into 3–5 mL LB medium supplemented with the appropriate antibiotic.
detailedSteps.zh: 从新鲜划线的 LB 琼脂平板上挑取单克隆，接种至含相应抗生素的 3–5 mL LB 培养基中。

detailedSteps.en: Grow the culture at 37°C, 225 rpm overnight (12–16 h) to late log/early stationary phase (OD₆₀₀ ≈ 0.5–2.0).
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、225 rpm 振荡过夜培养 12–16 h 至对数晚期/稳定早期（OD₆₀₀ ≈ 0.5–2.0）。

detailedSteps.en: Pipette 500 µL of overnight culture into a labeled 1.5–2 mL cryovial.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 500 µL 过夜菌液加入已标记的 1.5–2 mL 冻存管中。

detailedSteps.en: Add 500 µL of sterile 50% glycerol (final concentration 25% glycerol); mix by gently inverting 5–10 times. Do NOT vortex.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 500 µL 无菌 50% 甘油（终浓度 25% 甘油），轻柔颠倒混匀 5–10 次，切勿涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: Label the cryovial clearly with: strain name, plasmid name, antibiotic resistance, date, and your initials. Use a cryogenic-resistant marker or label.
detailedSteps.zh: 在冻存管上清晰标注：菌株名称、质粒名称、抗性、日期及操作者缩写，使用防冻标记笔或防冻标签。

detailedSteps.en: Snap-freeze by placing directly into liquid nitrogen for 30–60 s, or on a pre-cooled metal block. Do NOT use a −20°C pre-freeze step as this reduces viability.
detailedSteps.zh: 直接投入液氮速冻 30–60 s，或置于预冷金属架上，切勿先 −20°C 预冻（会降低存活率）。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer immediately to −80°C storage. Prepare at least two independent aliquots and store in separate locations. Stocks are stable for >10 years.
detailedSteps.zh: 立即转移至 −80°C 保存。至少制备 2 管独立备份存放于不同冰箱，正确保存可稳定 >10 年。

name: Bacterial Transformation (Heat Shock)

components.name: 1. Thaw competent cells on ice (5 min)

note.en: 1–50 ng; ≤10% of cell volume
note.zh: 1–50 ng；体积 ≤ 细胞总体积的 10%

components.name: 3. Mix gently by flicking. Ice 30 min
8. Plate on selective LB agar + antibiotic

notes.en: Use 5 µL of ligation product (1/4 to 1/2 of the reaction). DNA volume should not exceed 10% of competent cell volume. Heat shock at 42°C for exactly 30–60 s. SOC medium gives 2–5× better recovery than LB. For Amp resistance: 1 h recovery is sufficient; for Kan resistance: 1.5 h recommended. If transformation efficiency is low, check: (1) competent cell quality, (2) DNA purity, (3) heat shock timing.
notes.zh: 连接产物用 5 µL (= 整个连接体系的 1/4–1/2)。DNA 体积不超过感受态体积的 10%。42°C 热激时间严格控制在 30–60 s。SOC 比 LB 恢复效率高 2–5 倍。Amp 抗性: 1 h 恢复即可；Kan 抗性: 建议恢复 1.5 h。如转化效率低，检查: (1) 感受态效率 (2) DNA 纯度 (3) 热激时间。

ref: Hanahan (1983) J Mol Biol 166:557–580; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.

usage.en: Transform chemically competent E. coli with plasmid DNA by heat shock.
usage.zh: 热激法将质粒 DNA 转入化学感受态大肠杆菌。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours，实操: 1 hour

note.en: High purity, 1–50 ng
note.zh: 高纯度, 1–50 ng

note.en: Plates with colonies can be sealed with Parafilm and stored at 4°C for up to 1 week.
note.zh: 长有菌落的平板用 Parafilm 封好，4°C 可保存最多 1 周。

briefSteps.en: Thaw competent cells on ice → add plasmid DNA → ice 30 min → heat shock 42°C 45 s → ice 2 min → add SOC 950 µL → recover 37°C 1 h → plate on selective LB agar → incubate 37°C overnight
briefSteps.zh: 冰上解冻感受态细胞 → 加质粒 DNA → 冰浴 30 min → 42°C 热激 45 s → 冰浴 2 min → 加 950 µL SOC → 37°C 恢复 1 h → 涂含抗生素 LB 平板 → 37°C 过夜培养

detailedSteps.en: Thaw one aliquot of chemically competent cells (50 µL) on ice for 5–10 min. Do not thaw at room temperature or by hand-warming.
detailedSteps.zh: 将一管感受态细胞（50 µL）在冰上解冻 5–10 min，切勿室温或手温解冻。

detailedSteps.en: Add 1–5 µL of plasmid DNA (1–50 ng total) or 5 µL of ligation product directly to the cells. Gently flick the tube 3–4 times to mix — do not pipette up and down.
detailedSteps.zh: 向感受态细胞中加入 1–5 µL 质粒 DNA（1–50 ng 总量）或 5 µL 连接产物，轻弹管底 3–4 次混匀，切勿反复吹打。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate on ice for 30 min without agitation.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰浴静置孵育 30 min，不要晃动。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer tube to a 42°C water bath or heat block; heat shock for exactly 42–45 s. Do not exceed 60 s.
detailedSteps.zh: 将管子转移至 42°C 水浴或金属浴，准确热激 42–45 s，不超过 60 s。

detailedSteps.en: Immediately return the tube to ice and chill for exactly 2 min. This step is critical for recovery.
detailedSteps.zh: 立即将管子放回冰上，冰浴 2 min（此步骤至关重要，不可省略）。

detailedSteps.en: Add 950 µL of pre-warmed SOC medium (37°C) to the tube; cap and mix gently.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 950 µL 预热至 37°C 的 SOC 培养基，盖盖轻轻混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 225 rpm for 1 h (Amp resistance) or 1.5 h (Kan/Cm resistance) to allow expression of the antibiotic resistance gene.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、225 rpm 振荡恢复培养 1 h（Amp 抗性）或 1.5 h（Kan/Cm 抗性），使抗生素抗性基因得以表达。

detailedSteps.en: Plate 50–200 µL of the recovery culture onto LB agar plates containing the appropriate antibiotic; spread evenly with a cell spreader. For low-efficiency transformations, centrifuge and concentrate the cells before plating.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 50–200 µL 恢复菌液涂布含相应抗生素的 LB 琼脂平板，用涂板棒均匀铺开；若转化效率低，可离心浓缩后再涂板。

detailedSteps.en: Invert plates and incubate at 37°C overnight (12–16 h) until colonies are 1–2 mm in diameter.
detailedSteps.zh: 倒置平板，37°C 过夜培养 12–16 h 至菌落直径达 1–2 mm。

name: BCA Protein Assay

components.name: 1. 准备 BSA 标准品稀释系列
2. 配制 BCA 工作液 (Reagent A:B = 50:1)
3. 96 孔板加样：25 µL 标准品/样品 per well

note.en: 2–3 replicate wells per sample
note.zh: 每个做 2–3 复孔

components.name: 4. 加 200 µL BCA 工作液到每个孔

note.en: Seal the plate with film to prevent evaporation
note.zh: 板封膜防蒸发

components.name: 8. 标准曲线计算样品浓度

note.en: Four-parameter fit or linear regression
note.zh: 四参数拟合或线性回归

notes.en: BCA assay is compatible with up to 5% SDS but not with reducing agents (DTT, β-ME). Standard range: 25-2000 µg/mL. For low-concentration samples, use Micro BCA kit (0.5-20 µg/mL). R² > 0.99 for standard curve. Bradford assay is an alternative (Coomassie binding, 595 nm) but incompatible with detergents.
notes.zh: 比 Bradford 更耐去垢剂（兼容 1% SDS, 1% Triton X-100）。还原剂（DTT, β-ME）和 EDTA 会干扰——需用 BCA Compatible 试剂盒或预稀释。工作液可保持稳定 24 h。样品建议做 1:5 和 1:10 两个稀释度确保在标准曲线范围内。

ref: Smith et al. (1985) Anal Biochem 150:76–85; Thermo Scientific Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit manual

usage.en: Quantify total protein concentration using the BCA colorimetric assay.
usage.zh: BCA 比色法定量蛋白质总浓度。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 hour，实操: 30 minutes

note.en: Contains Reagent A, Reagent B, and BSA standard (e.g., Thermo Pierce #23225)
note.zh: 含试剂 A、试剂 B 和 BSA 标准品（如 Thermo Pierce #23225）

note.en: 2 mg/mL stock in appropriate buffer
note.zh: 适当缓冲液中的 2 mg/mL 储液

note.en: Clear, flat-bottom
note.zh: 透明平底

note.en: 562 nm filter
note.zh: 562 nm 滤光片
