note.en: Native conditions — no formaldehyde. Fresh or cryopreserved cells both OK. Low input possible (~5,000 cells).
note.zh: 天然条件——无需甲醛交联。新鲜或冻存细胞均可。最低 ~5,000 细胞。

components.name: 2. Wash 2× with Wash Buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM spermidine, protease inhibitors)

note.en: 600×g 3 min RT. Keep cells at RT (not ice) at this stage.
note.zh: 600×g 3 min RT。此阶段保持 RT（非冰上）。

components.name: 3. Bind cells to ConA magnetic beads: 10 µL beads/5×10⁵ cells, RT 10 min, rotate

note.en: Bangs Labs BioMag ConA beads. Magnetically capture cells in subsequent steps.
note.zh: Bangs Labs BioMag ConA 磁珠。后续步骤磁性捕获细胞。

components.name: 4. Permeabilize: add 0.01% digitonin in Wash Buffer, 5 min RT

note.en: Digitonin permeabilizes plasma membrane; nuclear envelope stays intact (unlike NP-40 or Triton X-100).
note.zh: Digitonin 透化细胞膜，核膜保持完整（区别于 NP-40 / Triton X-100）。

components.name: 5. Primary antibody: 1 µg/rxn in Antibody Buffer (Wash + 0.01% digitonin + 2 mM EDTA), 4°C 2 h or overnight

note.en: EDTA prevents premature MNase cleavage. Use ChIP-grade validated Ab. Controls: IgG neg, H3K4me3 pos.
note.zh: EDTA 防止 MNase 提前切割。用 ChIP-grade 验证抗体。对照：IgG 阴性，H3K4me3 阳性。

components.name: 6. Wash 2× Dig-Wash (Wash + 0.01% digitonin); remove unbound Ab

note.en: Magnetic capture between washes.
note.zh: 磁性捕获后洗涤。

components.name: 7. Bind pA-MNase (700 ng/mL) in Dig-Wash, 4°C 1 h

note.en: For mouse primary Ab: use pA/G-MNase or bridge anti-mouse secondary.
note.zh: 小鼠一抗需用 pA/G-MNase 或桥接抗小鼠二抗。

components.name: 9. Activate MNase: add 2 mM CaCl₂, incubate 0°C ice-water bath 30 min

note.en: Ca²⁺ activates MNase → targeted DNA cleavage. 0°C is critical for controlled digestion. Longer = smaller fragments.
note.zh: Ca²⁺ 激活 MNase → 靶向 DNA 切割。0°C 是控制消化的关键。时间越长片段越小。

components.name: 10. Stop: add STOP Buffer (340 mM NaCl, 20 mM EDTA, 4 mM EGTA, 0.01% digitonin, RNase A 0.05 mg/mL, spike-in 25 pg/mL)

note.en: EDTA/EGTA chelates Ca²⁺. E. coli spike-in DNA for normalization (optional).
note.zh: EDTA/EGTA 螯合 Ca²⁺ 终止反应。E. coli spike-in DNA 用于标准化（可选）。

note.en: Cut fragments diffuse out of nuclei.
note.zh: 切割片段从核内扩散到上清。

note.en: Pellet = uncut chromatin.
note.zh: 沉淀 = 未切割染色质。

components.name: 13. DNA extraction: 0.1% SDS + Proteinase K 100 µg/mL, 50°C 1 h; SPRI beads or column cleanup

note.en: Elute in 20–50 µL TE or ddH₂O.
note.zh: 20–50 µL TE 或 ddH₂O 洗脱。

components.name: 14. Library prep for sequencing or qPCR validation

note.en: Bioanalyzer: expect mono/dinucleosome (150/300 bp). NEBNext Ultra II; 10–14 cycles PCR amplification.
note.zh: Bioanalyzer：预期单/双核小体模式（150/300 bp）。NEBNext Ultra II 建库；PCR 10–14 个循环。

notes.en: Advantages over ChIP: no crosslinking artifacts, very low background, works with ≥500 cells, no sonication. Key: 0.01% digitonin only (not Triton), MNase at 0°C. Validate new antibodies with known marks (H3K4me3, H3K27ac) first.
notes.zh: 相比 ChIP 优势：无交联伪影、极低背景、≥500 细胞即可、无需超声。关键：仅用 0.01% digitonin（非 Triton）；MNase 在 0°C 激活。新抗体先用已知修饰（H3K4me3、H3K27ac）验证。

ref: Skene & Henikoff (2017) eLife 6:e21856; Meers et al. (2019) eLife 8:e46314; Kaya-Okur et al. (2019) Nat Commun 10:1930

usage.en: Profile histone modifications and transcription factor binding using CUT&RUN (cleavage under targets and release using nuclease).
usage.zh: CUT&RUN 技术分析组蛋白修饰和转录因子结合谱。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 6 hours

note.en: Bangs Labs, BP531
note.zh: Bangs Labs, BP531

note.en: EpiCypher 15-1016 or homemade
note.zh: EpiCypher 15-1016或自制

note.en: Sigma S2626, store -20°C
note.zh: Sigma S2626，-20°C保存

note.en: EMD Millipore 300410
note.zh: EMD Millipore 300410

note.en: Roche cOmplete EDTA-free
note.zh: Roche cOmplete 无EDTA

note.en: Validated for CUT&RUN
note.zh: 经CUT&RUN验证

note.en: Same species as primary Ab
note.zh: 与一抗同种属

note.en: DNase-free
note.zh: 无DNase

note.en: E. coli DNA or yeast DNA for normalization
note.zh: 大肠杆菌或酵母DNA用于标准化

note.en: Molecular biology grade
note.zh: 分子生物学级

note.en: Zymo or Qiagen MinElute
note.zh: Zymo或Qiagen MinElute

note.en: After overnight antibody incubation, beads can be held at 4°C for up to 2 h before proceeding to pA-MNase binding.
note.zh: 一抗孵育过夜后，磁珠可在 4°C 保存最多 2 h，再进行 pA-MNase 结合步骤。

note.en: Extracted and purified DNA can be stored at −20°C for up to 6 months before library preparation or qPCR.
note.zh: 提取纯化后的 DNA 可 −20°C 保存最长 6 个月，待文库制备或 qPCR。

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells (no crosslinking) → bind to ConA magnetic beads → permeabilize with 0.01% digitonin → incubate with primary antibody (4°C, overnight) → wash → bind pA-MNase (4°C, 1 h) → wash → activate MNase with 2 mM CaCl₂ at 0°C (30 min) → stop with EDTA/EGTA buffer → release fragments at 37°C (30 min) → collect supernatant → extract DNA → library prep or qPCR
briefSteps.zh: 收取细胞（无需交联）→ 结合 ConA 磁珠 → 0.01% digitonin 透化 → 一抗孵育（4°C 过夜）→ 洗涤 → pA-MNase 结合（4°C 1 h）→ 洗涤 → 2 mM CaCl₂ 在 0°C 激活 MNase（30 min）→ EDTA/EGTA 终止 → 37°C 释放片段（30 min）→ 收上清 → DNA 提取 → 文库制备或 qPCR

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Cell Binding and Antibody Incubation
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：细胞结合与抗体孵育

detailedSteps.en: Harvest 500,000 cells (range 5,000–5,000,000); no crosslinking required. Pellet at 600×g for 3 min at RT. Wash 2× with Wash Buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM spermidine, 1× protease inhibitors).
detailedSteps.zh: 收取 500,000 个细胞（范围 5,000–5,000,000），无需甲醛交联。600×g RT 离心 3 min，用洗涤缓冲液（20 mM HEPES pH 7.5、150 mM NaCl、0.5 mM 亚精胺、1× 蛋白酶抑制剂）洗涤 2 次。

detailedSteps.en: Activate ConA beads: wash with PBS + 0.1% BSA; resuspend to 10 µL per 500,000 cells. Add cells to beads and rotate 10 min at RT. Magnetically capture beads in all subsequent steps.
detailedSteps.zh: 活化 ConA 磁珠：用 PBS + 0.1% BSA 洗涤，每 500,000 个细胞用 10 µL 重悬。加入细胞，室温旋转 10 min。后续步骤均通过磁力架捕获磁珠。

detailedSteps.en: Permeabilize: resuspend bead-bound cells in 1 mL Dig-Wash Buffer (Wash Buffer + 0.01% digitonin); rotate 5 min at RT. Capture beads and discard supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 透化：将磁珠结合细胞重悬于 1 mL Dig-Wash 缓冲液（洗涤缓冲液 + 0.01% digitonin），RT 旋转 5 min。磁力捕获，弃上清。

detailedSteps.en: Add primary antibody (1 µg) diluted in 100 µL Antibody Buffer (Dig-Wash + 2 mM EDTA); rotate at 4°C overnight (minimum 2 h). EDTA prevents premature MNase activation. Include IgG negative and H3K4me3 positive controls.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 1 µg 一抗稀释于 100 µL 抗体缓冲液（Dig-Wash + 2 mM EDTA）中，4°C 旋转孵育过夜（至少 2 h）。EDTA 防止 MNase 提前激活。设 IgG 阴性对照和 H3K4me3 阳性对照。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: pA-MNase Binding, Cleavage, and DNA Extraction
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天：pA-MNase 结合、切割与DNA提取

detailedSteps.en: Capture beads; wash 2× with Dig-Wash Buffer (600×g, 3 min, 4°C). Add pA-MNase (protein A–MNase fusion) at 700 ng/mL in 100 µL Dig-Wash; rotate 1 h at 4°C. Note: use pA/G-MNase for mouse primary antibodies.
detailedSteps.zh: 磁力捕获，Dig-Wash 洗涤 2 次（600×g，3 min，4°C）。加入 pA-MNase（蛋白 A–MNase 融合蛋白），700 ng/mL，100 µL Dig-Wash，4°C 旋转孵育 1 h。小鼠一抗需用 pA/G-MNase。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with Dig-Wash Buffer to remove unbound pA-MNase. Resuspend in 100 µL Dig-Wash and place tubes in ice-water bath (0°C).
detailedSteps.zh: Dig-Wash 洗涤 2 次，去除未结合 pA-MNase。重悬于 100 µL Dig-Wash，置于冰水浴（0°C）。

detailedSteps.en: Activate MNase: add CaCl₂ to 2 mM final concentration. Incubate at 0°C (ice-water bath) for exactly 30 min. The 0°C temperature is critical for controlled, targeted cleavage.
detailedSteps.zh: 激活 MNase：加入 CaCl₂ 至终浓度 2 mM，在 0°C 冰水浴中准确孵育 30 min。0°C 是控制靶向切割的关键条件。

detailedSteps.en: Stop reaction by adding 100 µL 2× STOP Buffer (340 mM NaCl, 20 mM EDTA, 4 mM EGTA, 0.01% digitonin, 0.05 mg/mL RNase A, 25 pg/mL spike-in E. coli DNA). Mix by inversion.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 100 µL 2× STOP 缓冲液（340 mM NaCl、20 mM EDTA、4 mM EGTA、0.01% digitonin、0.05 mg/mL RNase A、25 pg/mL E. coli spike-in DNA）终止反应，翻转混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Release fragmented chromatin: incubate at 37°C for 30 min with gentle mixing (300 rpm). Cut DNA fragments diffuse out of nuclei into supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 释放切割片段：37°C 轻摇孵育 30 min（300 rpm）。切割的 DNA 片段从细胞核扩散至上清。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 16,000×g for 5 min at 4°C; carefully transfer supernatant (released DNA) to a new tube. Pellet = remaining uncut chromatin (discard).
detailedSteps.zh: 16,000×g 4°C 离心 5 min，小心转移上清（含释放 DNA）至新管。沉淀为未切割染色质（弃去）。

detailedSteps.en: Extract DNA: add SDS to 0.1% and Proteinase K to 100 µg/mL; incubate 50°C for 1 h. Purify with SPRI beads (1.2×) or column; elute in 20–50 µL TE or water. Quantify by Qubit.
detailedSteps.zh: DNA 提取：加 SDS 至 0.1%，Proteinase K 至 100 µg/mL，50°C 孵育 1 h。SPRI 磁珠（1.2×）或柱纯化，洗脱至 20–50 µL TE 或水。Qubit 定量。

detailedSteps.en: Validate by qPCR (target locus vs. IgG and negative-locus controls) or proceed to library preparation (NEBNext Ultra II, 10–14 PCR cycles). Bioanalyzer should show mono/dinucleosome peaks at ~150/300 bp.
detailedSteps.zh: qPCR 验证（目标位点 vs. IgG 及阴性位点对照），或直接进行文库制备（NEBNext Ultra II，10–14 个 PCR 循环）。Bioanalyzer 应呈单/双核小体峰（~150/300 bp）。

name: CyTOF Combined Surface & Intracellular Staining
nameCn: CyTOF 联合表面和胞内染色方案

components.name: Step 1 (Optional stimulation): Stimulate/treat 1×10⁶ cells per sample. To stop signaling: add 16% PFA 1:10 (100 µL/tube), 10 min RT. Spin 600 g 6 min 4°C. Wash 3× with wash buffer.

note.en: PFA fixation before surface staining may affect some antibody epitopes.
note.zh: 表面染色前 PFA 固定可能影响部分抗体表位。

components.name: Step 2 (Surface staining): Resuspend ≤1.5M cells in 35-40 µL staining buffer. Add Ab mix (10-15 µL, total 50 µL). Incubate 30-60 min RT.
Step 3: Wash 2-3× with 1.5 mL wash buffer. Vortex to mix.
Step 4 (Optional viability): Stain with 1:500 Rh103 in PBS for 20 min, OR 25 µM cisplatin for 1 min.
Step 5 (Fixation): Add 300-500 µL 1.6% PFA in PBS. Incubate 10 min (or 1 h) RT. Spin, discard supernatant (no wash needed).
Step 6 (Permeabilization): Leave ~100 µL on pellet, break up by vortexing. Add cold 100% methanol (0.9 mL per 10⁶ cells, final 90%). Incubate 10 min 4°C (prefer -20°C for 20 min).

note.en: Can store at -20°C up to 24 h, or -80°C up to 1 month.
note.zh: 可 -20°C 保存 24 h，-80°C 保存 1 个月。

components.name: Step 7: Wash 2-4× with >1 mL wash buffer.

note.en: BSA precipitates in methanol — add >1 mL buffer to dissolve.
note.zh: BSA 在甲醇中沉淀——加 >1 mL 缓冲液溶解。

components.name: Step 8 (Intracellular staining): Resuspend in 35-40 µL buffer + Ab mix (10-15 µL), total exactly 50 µL. Incubate 30-60 min RT with gentle agitation.
Step 10 (Ir-intercalator): Add 0.5 mL of 1:1000 Ir-intercalator in PBS + 1.6% PFA. Incubate ≥30 min RT (preferred: overnight at 4°C).
Step 11: Wash 2× with wash buffer. Wash 1× with MilliQ water (use 0.1% BSA in MilliQ if cells stick to plastic). Filter through 35 µm cap. Add EQ beads for acquisition.

notes.en: Staining concentrations matter especially for phospho-proteins. Ab bank mixes are designed for 50 µL final volume. Some cells stick to plastic in MilliQ water wash — add 0.1% BSA. For autosampler: resuspend in 50 µL MilliQ, add 50 µL EQ beads, transfer to 96-deep-well plate. Ideal: 0.5M cells per injection of 400 µL.
notes.zh: 染色浓度对磷酸化蛋白尤其重要。抗体库配方按 50 µL 终体积设计。某些细胞在 MilliQ 水洗涤时粘壁——加 0.1% BSA。自动进样：50 µL MilliQ 重悬 + 50 µL EQ beads。最佳：0.5M 细胞/400 µL。

ref: Bendall SC et al. (2011) Science 332:687–696; Spitzer MH & Nolan GP (2016) Cell 165:780–791; Fluidigm Helios/Hyperion User Guide (2020)

usage.en: Combined surface and intracellular staining protocol for mass cytometry (CyTOF) with optional stimulation, methanol permeabilization, and Ir-intercalator DNA staining.
usage.zh: 质谱流式（CyTOF）联合表面和胞内染色方案，包含可选刺激、甲醇通透和 Ir-intercalator DNA 染色。

label.en: Protocol — 6-8 hours (or overnight with Ir-intercalator), hands-on: 3 hours
label.zh: 实验方案 — 6-8 hours (or overnight with Ir-intercalator)，实操: 3 hours

materials.name: Wash buffer: PBS + 0.5% BSA + 0.02% sodium azide

note.en: -20°C in methanol (up to Up to 24 hours)
note.zh: -20°C in methanol (最长 Up to 24 hours)

note.en: -80°C in methanol (up to Up to 1 month)
note.zh: -80°C in methanol (最长 Up to 1 month)

note.en: 4°C in Ir-intercalator/PFA (up to Up to 1 week)
note.zh: 4°C in Ir-intercalator/PFA (最长 Up to 1 week)

briefSteps.en: Stimulate (opt.) → fix PFA → surface Ab 30–60 min RT → wash → viability dye (opt.) → fix 1.6% PFA → MeOH perm → wash → intracellular Ab 30–60 min → wash → Ir-intercalator O/N → wash → MilliQ → EQ beads → acquire
briefSteps.zh: 刺激（可选）→ PFA 固定 → 表面抗体 30–60 min RT → 洗 → 活力染色（可选）→ 1.6% PFA 固定 → 甲醇通透 → 洗 → 胞内抗体 30–60 min → 洗 → Ir-intercalator 过夜 → 洗 → MilliQ → EQ 珠 → 上机

detailedSteps.en: **Optional: Stimulation & Fixation**
detailedSteps.zh: **可选：刺激与固定**

detailedSteps.en: Stimulate/treat 1×10⁶ cells per sample as needed. To stop signaling: add 16% PFA 1:10 (100 µL per tube) for 10 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: 根据需要刺激/处理每管 1×10⁶ 细胞。终止信号：加 16% PFA 1:10（100 µL/管），RT 孵育 10 min

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 600×g, 6 min, 4°C. Wash 3× with wash buffer (PBS + 0.5% BSA + 0.02% NaN₃)
detailedSteps.zh: 600×g 离心 6 min，4°C。用洗涤液（PBS + 0.5% BSA + 0.02% NaN₃）洗涤 3 次

detailedSteps.en: **Surface Staining**
detailedSteps.zh: **表面染色**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend ≤1.5×10⁶ cells in 35–40 µL staining buffer (0.5% BSA/PBS). Add metal-conjugated antibody mix (10–15 µL, total 50 µL). Incubate 30–60 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: 将 ≤1.5×10⁶ 细胞重悬于 35–40 µL 染色缓冲液（0.5% BSA/PBS）。加金属标记抗体混合液（10–15 µL，总体积 50 µL）。RT 孵育 30–60 min

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2–3× with 1.5 mL wash buffer. Vortex briefly to resuspend
detailedSteps.zh: 用 1.5 mL 洗涤液洗涤 2–3 次。短暂涡旋重悬

detailedSteps.en: **Optional: Viability Staining**
detailedSteps.zh: **可选：活力染色**

detailedSteps.en: Stain with 1:500 Rh103 in PBS for 20 min on ice, OR 25 µM cisplatin for 1 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: 用 1:500 Rh103/PBS 冰上染色 20 min，或 25 µM 顺铂 RT 染色 1 min

detailedSteps.en: **Fixation & Methanol Permeabilization**
detailedSteps.zh: **固定与甲醇通透**

detailedSteps.en: Add 300–500 µL 1.6% PFA in PBS. Incubate 10 min at RT (or 1 h). Centrifuge and discard supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: 加 300–500 µL 1.6% PFA/PBS。RT 孵育 10 min（或 1 h）。离心弃上清

detailedSteps.en: Break up pellet by vortexing (~100 µL residual). Add cold 100% methanol (0.9 mL per 10⁶ cells, final ~90%). Incubate at 4°C for 10 min or −20°C for 20 min
detailedSteps.zh: 涡旋打散沉淀（保留 ~100 µL 残液）。加冷 100% 甲醇（0.9 mL/10⁶ 细胞，终浓度 ~90%）。4°C 10 min 或 −20°C 20 min

detailedSteps.en: **Intracellular Staining**
detailedSteps.zh: **胞内染色**

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2–4× with >1 mL wash buffer (to dissolve BSA precipitate from methanol)
detailedSteps.zh: 用 >1 mL 洗涤液洗涤 2–4 次（溶解甲醇中沉淀的 BSA）

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend in 35–40 µL buffer. Add intracellular Ab mix (10–15 µL, total 50 µL exactly). Incubate 30–60 min at RT with gentle agitation
detailedSteps.zh: 用 35–40 µL 缓冲液重悬。加胞内抗体混合液（10–15 µL，总体积恰好 50 µL）。RT 轻柔振荡孵育 30–60 min

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2–3× with wash buffer
detailedSteps.zh: 用洗涤液洗涤 2–3 次

detailedSteps.en: **Ir-Intercalator DNA Staining & Acquisition**
detailedSteps.zh: **Ir-Intercalator DNA 染色与上机**

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.5 mL of 1:1000 Ir-intercalator in PBS + 1.6% PFA. Incubate ≥30 min RT (preferred: overnight at 4°C)
detailedSteps.zh: 加 0.5 mL 1:1000 Ir-intercalator（PBS + 1.6% PFA）。RT 孵育 ≥30 min（推荐：4°C 过夜）

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with wash buffer. Wash 1× with MilliQ water (add 0.1% BSA if cells stick). Filter through 35 µm cap tube. Add EQ calibration beads. Acquire on CyTOF
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤液洗 2 次。MilliQ 水洗 1 次（细胞粘壁可加 0.1% BSA）。过 35 µm 滤帽管。加 EQ 校准珠。上 CyTOF

name: Density Gradient Centrifugation (Principles and Applications)
nameCn: 密度梯度离心（原理与应用指南）

components.name: 1. Choose gradient medium based on application

note.en: Sucrose: osmotic, inert, inexpensive. Use for organelles (ER, Golgi, lysosomes), viruses, ribosomes. Percoll (colloidal silica): iso-osmotic at all densities, low viscosity, self-forming. Use for cells, mitochondria, synaptosomes. Ficoll: high MW polymer, low osmolality. Use for PBMCs, leukocytes. Iodixanol (OptiPrep): iso-osmotic and iso-osmolal at all densities. Best for most organelles and EV sub-populations.
note.zh: 蔗糖：高渗透压，惰性，便宜。用于细胞器（ER、Golgi、溶酶体）、病毒、核糖体。Percoll（胶体二氧化硅）：所有密度等渗，低黏度，可自动成梯度。用于细胞、线粒体、突触体。Ficoll：高分子聚合物，低渗透压。用于 PBMC、白细胞。碘克沙醇（OptiPrep）：所有密度等渗等渗透压。最适合大多数细胞器和 EV 亚群。

components.name: 2. Gradient mode selection: rate-zonal (velocity) vs isopycnic (equilibrium)

note.en: Rate-zonal: short spin; particles separate by size + sedimentation coefficient (S). Best for: particles of similar density but different size (ribosomes, RNA). Isopycnic: long spin until equilibrium; particles band at their buoyant density. Best for: organelles, viruses, DNA/RNA.
note.zh: 速率区带（velocity）：短时间离心；按大小 + 沉降系数（S 值）分离。最适合：密度相似但大小不同的颗粒（核糖体、RNA）。等密度（isopycnic）：长时间离心至平衡；颗粒在其浮力密度处成带。最适合：细胞器、病毒、DNA/RNA。

note.en: Pipette denser solution first (bottom of tube), carefully layer less dense solution on top using slow pipetting against tube wall. Chill tube on ice between layers. Use ≥3 steps for good resolution. Typical: 4 layers in 11 mL SW-41 Ti tube.
note.zh: 先加最高密度溶液（管底），沿管壁缓慢加入较低密度溶液。加层间冰上冷却。≥3 层获得良好分辨率。典型：11 mL SW-41 Ti 管中 4 层。

note.en: Use gradient maker (two-chamber device). Pour high-density into mixing chamber, low-density into reservoir; pump into tube from bottom with peristaltic pump. Or: freeze-thaw a step gradient once at −80°C → thaw at 4°C generates linear gradient.
note.zh: 使用梯度仪（双腔装置）。高密度液加入混合腔，低密度液加入储液腔；蠕动泵从管底注入。或：将阶梯梯度 −80°C 冻 1 次 → 4°C 解冻自动形成线性梯度。

components.name: 5. Load sample (volume ≤10% of gradient volume) gently on top or bottom

note.en: Top loading: standard for rate-zonal. Bottom loading (injection): better for equilibrium banding (uses underlayer needle). Sample in same buffer as lightest gradient layer.
note.zh: 顶部上样：速率区带标准方式。底部注射：平衡成带效果更好（用针头在底部注入）。样品用最轻一层梯度相同的缓冲液配制。

components.name: 6. Centrifuge: use swing-bucket rotor (SW-41 Ti for 11 mL; SW-28 for 38 mL)

note.en: SW-41 Ti: 100,000×g (25,000 rpm) = RCF at tube bottom. For rate-zonal: 20,000–40,000×g 1–3 h. For isopycnic: 100,000×g 16–18 h. Always 4°C. No brake.

components.name: 7. Fractionate from top: use fractionator, syringe, or pipette

note.en: Automated: BioComp Gradient Station. Manual: pipette from top in 0.5–1 mL fractions. Alternative: needle puncture at tube bottom, collect drops. Number fractions sequentially from top (#1) to bottom (#n).
note.zh: 自动：BioComp Gradient Station。手动：从顶部吸取 0.5–1 mL 组分。替代：底部针穿刺，收集滴液。组分从顶部（#1）至底部（#n）顺序编号。

components.name: 8. Analyze fractions: assay-specific markers, measure density (refractometer), then assay activity or WB

note.en: Measure refractive index (RI) of each fraction to calculate density. Plot RI vs fraction number to confirm gradient profile. Then assay by WB, enzyme activity, or qPCR depending on application.
note.zh: 用折光仪测量各组分折射率（RI），计算密度。绘制 RI vs 组分编号图确认梯度分布。然后根据应用进行 WB、酶活力或 qPCR 分析。

notes.en: Density reference: nuclei 1.30–1.45, mitochondria 1.18, lysosomes 1.10–1.12, ER 1.14–1.17, Golgi 1.08–1.10, plasma membrane 1.06–1.10, cytoplasm 1.06, exosomes 1.10–1.18 (varies). Rotor k-factor: lower = more gentle separation. Iodixanol (OptiPrep 60% w/v) is currently preferred for most applications over sucrose due to iso-osmolality.
notes.zh: 密度参考：细胞核 1.30–1.45、线粒体 1.18、溶酶体 1.10–1.12、ER 1.14–1.17、Golgi 1.08–1.10、质膜 1.06–1.10、细胞质 1.06、外泌体 1.10–1.18（可变）。转子 k 因子越低 = 分离越温和。碘克沙醇（OptiPrep 60% w/v）因等渗透压特性，目前优先于蔗糖用于大多数实验。

ref: Graham (2001) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 3.6.1; Bhatt (2021) STAR Protoc 2:100450; Rickwood et al. (1994) Preparative Centrifugation (IRL Press); Griffiths (2018) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 78:3.1.1

usage.en: Separate cellular components or particles by density gradient centrifugation.
usage.zh: 密度梯度离心分离细胞组分或颗粒。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 4–20 hours，实操: 2–4 hours

materials.name: Sucrose, Percoll, or Ficoll gradient solutions
Sample (cell lysate, organelle suspension, or blood)
Gradient maker or manual layering pipettes

note.en: 4°C, do not disturb (up to 2 hours)
note.zh: 4°C, do not disturb (最长 2 hours)

note.en: 4°C or −80°C depending on application (up to varies)
note.zh: 4°C or −80°C depending on application (最长 varies)

briefSteps.en: Choose medium & mode → prepare step/continuous gradient → load sample → centrifuge (swing-bucket, 4°C, no brake) → fractionate from top → measure density (RI) → analyze fractions (WB/activity/qPCR)
briefSteps.zh: 选择介质与模式 → 制备阶梯/连续梯度 → 上样 → 离心（摇摆转头，4°C，无刹车） → 从顶部分级收集 → 测密度（RI） → 分析组分（WB/活性/qPCR）

detailedSteps.en: **Planning & Medium Selection**
detailedSteps.zh: **规划与介质选择**

detailedSteps.en: Choose gradient medium: Sucrose (organelles, viruses), Percoll (cells, mitochondria), Ficoll (PBMCs), or Iodixanol/OptiPrep (best for most organelles and EVs)
detailedSteps.zh: 选择梯度介质：蔗糖（细胞器、病毒）、Percoll（细胞、线粒体）、Ficoll（PBMC）或碘克沙醇/OptiPrep（适用于大多数细胞器和 EV）

detailedSteps.en: Select gradient mode: rate-zonal (short spin, separates by size/sedimentation coefficient) or isopycnic (long spin to equilibrium, separates by buoyant density)
detailedSteps.zh: 选择梯度模式：速率区带（短时间离心，按大小/沉降系数分离）或等密度（长时间离心至平衡，按浮力密度分离）

detailedSteps.en: **Gradient Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **梯度制备**

detailedSteps.en: For step (discontinuous) gradient: pipette densest solution first (tube bottom), carefully layer less dense solutions on top against tube wall. Use ≥3 steps for good resolution. Chill on ice between layers
detailedSteps.zh: 阶梯（不连续）梯度：先加最高密度溶液（管底），沿管壁缓慢覆加较低密度溶液。≥3 层获得良好分辨率。加层间冰上冷却

detailedSteps.en: For continuous gradient: use gradient maker (two-chamber device) with peristaltic pump. Alternative: freeze-thaw step gradient at −80°C once then thaw at 4°C to generate linear gradient
detailedSteps.zh: 连续梯度：使用梯度仪（双腔装置）配合蠕动泵。替代方法：阶梯梯度 −80°C 冻 1 次再 4°C 解冻形成线性梯度

detailedSteps.en: **Sample Loading & Centrifugation**
detailedSteps.zh: **上样与离心**

detailedSteps.en: Load sample gently on top (rate-zonal) or bottom (isopycnic). Sample volume should be ≤10% of total gradient volume
detailedSteps.zh: 轻柔地将样品加在顶部（速率区带）或底部（等密度）。样品体积应 ≤ 梯度总体积的 10%

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge in swing-bucket rotor (SW-41 Ti for 11 mL; SW-28 for 38 mL). Rate-zonal: 20,000–40,000×g, 1–3 h. Isopycnic: 100,000×g, 16–18 h. Always 4°C, no brake
detailedSteps.zh: 摇摆转头离心（SW-41 Ti 用于 11 mL；SW-28 用于 38 mL）。速率区带：20,000–40,000×g，1–3 h。等密度：100,000×g，16–18 h。全程 4°C，无刹车

detailedSteps.en: **Fractionation & Analysis**
detailedSteps.zh: **分级收集与分析**

detailedSteps.en: Fractionate from top: collect 0.5–1 mL fractions sequentially using pipette, fraction collector, or bottom-puncture needle. Number fractions from top (#1) to bottom (#n)
detailedSteps.zh: 从顶部收集：用移液器、分级收集器或底部穿刺针依次收集 0.5–1 mL 组分。从顶部（#1）到底部（#n）编号

detailedSteps.en: Measure refractive index (RI) of each fraction with refractometer to calculate density. Plot RI vs fraction number to confirm gradient profile
detailedSteps.zh: 用折光仪测量每个组分的折射率（RI）以计算密度。绘制 RI vs 组分编号图确认梯度分布

detailedSteps.en: Analyze fractions by Western blot, enzyme activity assay, or qPCR depending on application. Use organelle-specific markers to identify target fractions
detailedSteps.zh: 根据应用通过 Western blot、酶活性检测或 qPCR 分析各组分。使用细胞器特异性标记鉴定目标组分

name: DNA Ligation (T4 Ligase)

note.en: Dephosphorylation reduces self-ligation background
note.zh: 去磷酸化可降低自连背景

note.en: Molar ratio vector:insert = 1:3–1:5 (sticky ends) or 1:5–1:10 (blunt ends)
note.zh: 摩尔比 vector:insert = 1:3–1:5 (粘性末端) 或 1:5–1:10 (平末端)

note.en: Contains ATP; avoid repeated freeze-thaw
note.zh: 含 ATP, 勿反复冻融

note.en: 400 U (NEB) or 1 Weiss unit
note.zh: 400 U (NEB) 或 1 Weiss U

components.name: 2a. 粘性末端：室温 10 min 或 16°C 过夜
2b. 平末端：16°C 过夜（或室温 2 h 用高浓度酶）
4. 转化 2–5 µL 连接产物

notes.en: Controls: (1) no ligase → assess background; (2) no insert → assess vector self-ligation; (3) uncut vector → assess transformation efficiency. Insert calculation: ng insert = (ng vector × insert bp / vector bp) × molar ratio. Quick Ligation Kit (NEB) completes in 5 min.
notes.zh: 对照组：(1) 无连接酶对照 → 评估自连背景; (2) 无 insert 对照 → 评估载体自连; (3) 未切 vector 对照 → 评估转化效率。Insert 计算公式：ng insert = (ng vector × insert bp / vector bp) × molar ratio。Quick Ligation Kit (NEB) 可 5 min 完成。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; NEB T4 DNA Ligase protocol

usage.en: Ligate DNA insert into linearized vector using T4 DNA ligase.
usage.zh: T4 DNA 连接酶将 DNA 插入片段连接到线性化载体中。

label.en: Protocol — 2 hours or overnight, hands-on: 20 minutes
label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 hours or overnight，实操: 20 minutes

note.en: Contains 10 mM ATP; store at -20°C in aliquots (ATP degrades with freeze-thaw)
note.zh: 含 10 mM ATP；-20°C 分装保存（ATP 反复冻融会降解）

note.en: Restriction-digested, gel-purified or column-purified
note.zh: 限制性酶切后凝胶回收或柱纯化

note.en: Compatible ends with vector
note.zh: 与载体末端兼容

note.en: High efficiency (≥10⁸ CFU/µg)
note.zh: 高效（≥10⁸ CFU/µg）

note.en: Pre-warmed to 37°C
note.zh: 预热至 37°C

note.en: Appropriate selection
note.zh: 适当抗生素筛选

note.en: Ligation product can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 week before transformation.
note.zh: 连接产物可在 −20°C 保存最多 1 周再进行转化。

briefSteps.en: Calculate insert mass for 1:3–5 molar ratio, assemble vector + insert + T4 buffer + ligase on ice, incubate (sticky ends: RT 10 min or 16°C overnight; blunt ends: 16°C overnight), heat-inactivate at 65°C 10 min, then transform 2–5 µL.
briefSteps.zh: 计算 1:3–5 摩尔比所需 insert 用量，冰上配制 vector + insert + T4 buffer + 连接酶，孵育（粘性末端：室温 10 min 或 16°C 过夜；平末端：16°C 过夜），65°C 热灭活 10 min，转化 2–5 µL。

detailedSteps.en: Calculate insert mass needed: ng insert = (ng vector × insert bp / vector bp) × molar ratio. Use a 1:3–1:5 molar ratio (vector:insert) for sticky-end ligation, or 1:5–1:10 for blunt-end ligation. Typical reaction uses 50 ng linearized vector.
detailedSteps.zh: 计算所需 insert 质量：ng insert =（ng vector × insert bp / vector bp）× 摩尔比。粘性末端连接使用 1:3–1:5 摩尔比（vector:insert），平末端连接使用 1:5–1:10。典型反应使用 50 ng 线性化载体。

detailedSteps.en: Assemble ligation reaction on ice (20 µL total): 2 µL 10× T4 Ligase Buffer (contains ATP — do not freeze-thaw repeatedly), insert DNA, vector DNA (50 ng), 1 µL T4 DNA Ligase (400 U NEB), and nuclease-free water to 20 µL. Add ligase last.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上配制连接反应（总体积 20 µL）：2 µL 10× T4 连接酶 buffer（含 ATP——勿反复冻融）、insert DNA、载体 DNA（50 ng）、1 µL T4 DNA 连接酶（NEB 400 U）、无核酸酶水补至 20 µL。最后加入连接酶。

detailedSteps.en: Set up control reactions in parallel: (1) vector only + ligase (checks vector self-ligation background), (2) vector + insert without ligase (checks non-enzymatic ligation).
detailedSteps.zh: 同时设对照反应：（1）仅载体 + 连接酶（检测载体自连背景），（2）载体 + insert 但不加连接酶（检测非酶促连接）。

detailedSteps.en: For sticky-end ligation: incubate at room temperature for 10 min, or at 16°C overnight for maximum efficiency. For blunt-end ligation: incubate at 16°C overnight (or room temperature 2 hours with high-concentration ligase).
detailedSteps.zh: 粘性末端连接：室温孵育 10 min，或 16°C 过夜以获最佳效率。平末端连接：16°C 过夜（或使用高浓度连接酶时室温 2 小时）。

detailedSteps.en: Heat-inactivate the ligase at 65°C for 10 min. Allow reaction to cool to room temperature before transformation.
detailedSteps.zh: 65°C 热灭活连接酶 10 min。冷却至室温后再进行转化。

detailedSteps.en: Transform 2–5 µL of ligation product into 25–50 µL competent E. coli by heat-shock (42°C 30 s). Recover in 950 µL SOC at 37°C for 1 hour. Plate on selective LB agar.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 2–5 µL 连接产物转化至 25–50 µL 感受态大肠杆菌（42°C 热激 30 s）。在 950 µL SOC 中 37°C 恢复 1 小时，涂布含抗生素 LB 平板。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate plates at 37°C overnight. Count colonies. Compare test plates to control plates. Screen colonies by colony PCR or diagnostic restriction digest. Confirm positive clones by Sanger sequencing.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 过夜培育。计数菌落，与对照平板比较。用菌落 PCR 或诊断性酶切筛选菌落，Sanger 测序确认阳性克隆。

name: Dual-Luciferase Reporter Assay

components.name: 1. 共转染 Firefly 报告质粒 + Renilla 内参质粒

note.en: Ratio 10:1 (e.g. 500 ng Firefly + 50 ng Renilla per 24-well); co-transfect with experimental plasmid or miRNA mimics
note.zh: 比例 10:1 (如 500 ng Firefly + 50 ng Renilla/24 孔); 加实验质粒或 miRNA mimics

components.name: 2. 24–48 h 后弃培养基, PBS 洗 1×

note.en: 24-well: 100 µL/well; 96-well: 20 µL/well; shake 15 min at RT
note.zh: 24-well: 100 µL/孔; 96-well: 20 µL/孔; 摇床 15 min RT

components.name: 4. 取 20 µL 裂解液至检测板

note.en: White opaque plate reduces cross-talk
note.zh: 白色不透明板减少串扰

components.name: 5. 加 100 µL LAR II → 读 Firefly (2 s delay, 10 s read)
6. 加 100 µL Stop & Glo → 读 Renilla

note.en: Stop & Glo quenches Firefly while activating Renilla
note.zh: Stop & Glo 猝灭 Firefly 同时激发 Renilla

components.name: 7. 计算 Ratio = Firefly RLU / Renilla RLU

note.en: Compare groups after normalization
note.zh: 归一化后比较各组差异

notes.en: Firefly = experimental reporter, Renilla = internal control for transfection efficiency. LAR II and Stop & Glo should be at RT before use. Prepare only enough for immediate use (LAR II stable ~8h at RT). Background: <100 RLU. Triplicate wells minimum. For 3'UTR/miRNA target validation: clone target site into psiCHECK-2 (Renilla is the reporter).
notes.zh: Firefly = 实验报告基因，Renilla = 内参控制转染效率。LAR II 和 Stop & Glo 使用前恢复至室温。LAR II 室温稳定约 8h，现配现用。背景 <100 RLU。至少 3 个重复孔。3'UTR/miRNA 靶标验证：用 psiCHECK-2（Renilla 为报告基因）。

ref: Sherf et al. (1996) Promega Notes 57:2; Promega Dual-Luciferase Reporter Assay System Technical Manual TM040

usage.en: Measure promoter activity or pathway activation using dual luciferase reporter assay.
usage.zh: 双荧光素酶报告基因实验检测启动子活性或信号通路激活。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Promega #E1910 (LAR II, Stop & Glo, PLB)
note.zh: Promega #E1910（LAR II, Stop & Glo, PLB）

note.en: e.g., pGL3/pGL4 with promoter/enhancer of interest
note.zh: 如含目的启动子/增强子的 pGL3/pGL4

note.en: pRL-TK or pRL-SV40 (1/10–1/50 of reporter)
note.zh: pRL-TK 或 pRL-SV40（报告质粒的 1/10–1/50）

note.en: Lipofectamine 2000/3000 or PEI
note.zh: Lipofectamine 2000/3000 或 PEI

note.en: For luminescence reading
note.zh: 用于发光检测

note.en: With dual-injector capability preferred
note.zh: 优选带双注射器

note.en: Cell lysates in PLB can be snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at −80°C for up to 1 month before measurement. Thaw on ice and mix well before use.
note.zh: PLB 裂解液可液氮速冻后 −80°C 保存最长 1 个月再检测，使用前冰上解冻并充分混匀。

briefSteps.en: Co-transfect Firefly reporter and Renilla control plasmids → 24–48 h later wash cells → lyse with 1× PLB 15 min RT → transfer lysate to white plate → add LAR II and read Firefly RLU → add Stop & Glo and read Renilla RLU → calculate Firefly/Renilla ratio.
briefSteps.zh: 共转染 Firefly 报告质粒与 Renilla 内参质粒 → 24–48 h 后洗涤细胞 → 1× PLB 室温裂解 15 min → 裂解液转移至白色不透明板 → 加 LAR II 读 Firefly RLU → 加 Stop & Glo 读 Renilla RLU → 计算 Firefly/Renilla 比值。

detailedSteps.en: Seed cells at appropriate density in 24-well plate (or 96-well for high-throughput) 24 h before transfection so cells are 70–90% confluent. Use at least 3 replicate wells per condition.
detailedSteps.zh: 转染前 24 h 按合适密度铺细胞于 24 孔板（高通量实验用 96 孔），转染时汇合度约 70–90%，每组至少 3 个复孔。

detailedSteps.en: Co-transfect Firefly luciferase reporter plasmid and Renilla control plasmid (pRL-TK) at a 10:1 mass ratio (e.g., 500 ng Firefly + 50 ng Renilla per well of a 24-well plate). Also include the experimental plasmid (transcription factor, miRNA mimic, etc.) or empty vector control. Use your standard transfection reagent.
detailedSteps.zh: 按 10:1 质量比共转染 Firefly 荧光素酶报告质粒和 Renilla 对照质粒（pRL-TK）（24 孔板每孔 500 ng Firefly + 50 ng Renilla），同时加入实验质粒（转录因子、miRNA mimics 等）或空载体对照，使用常规转染试剂。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate cells at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 24–48 h post-transfection to allow reporter expression. The optimal time depends on the promoter and cell type.
detailedSteps.zh: 转染后 37°C、5% CO₂ 培养 24–48 h 使报告基因充分表达，最佳时间取决于启动子和细胞类型。

detailedSteps.en: Bring LAR II (Luciferase Assay Reagent II) and Stop & Glo Reagent to room temperature 30 min before use. Reconstitute LAR II by adding the supplied buffer to the lyophilized substrate; prepare only the volume needed (stable ~8 h at RT).
detailedSteps.zh: 使用前 30 min 将 LAR II 和 Stop & Glo 恢复至室温，向冻干底物中加入随附缓冲液复溶 LAR II，仅配制当次所需用量（室温稳定约 8 h）。

detailedSteps.en: Aspirate culture medium from cells. Wash gently once with 1× PBS. Aspirate PBS completely to avoid diluting the lysis buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 吸除培养基，用 1× PBS 轻柔洗涤一次，彻底吸净 PBS 以免稀释裂解液。

detailedSteps.en: Add 1× Passive Lysis Buffer (PLB) directly to cells: 100 µL/well (24-well) or 20 µL/well (96-well). Rock plate on a rocking platform for 15 min at room temperature to ensure complete lysis.
detailedSteps.zh: 直接向细胞孔中加入 1× 被动裂解缓冲液（PLB）：24 孔板每孔 100 µL，96 孔板每孔 20 µL，室温摇床摇晃 15 min 确保充分裂解。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer 20 µL of cell lysate to a white opaque 96-well plate (or luminometer cuvette). Include a lysis-buffer-only blank to verify background (<100 RLU). Centrifuge lysate at 12,000×g for 1 min first if the lysate is turbid.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 20 µL 裂解液转移至白色不透明 96 孔板（或发光仪比色杯），设置仅含裂解缓冲液的空白孔验证本底（<100 RLU），若裂解液浑浊可先 12,000×g 离心 1 min。

detailedSteps.en: Add 100 µL LAR II to each well. Mix briefly. Measure Firefly luciferase luminescence immediately (2 s integration delay, 10 s measurement).
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加入 100 µL LAR II，短暂混匀，立即测定 Firefly 荧光素酶发光值（2 s 积分延迟，10 s 测量）。

detailedSteps.en: Without removing the plate, add 100 µL Stop & Glo Reagent to each well. Mix briefly. Measure Renilla luciferase luminescence using the same integration settings. Stop & Glo simultaneously quenches Firefly and activates Renilla.
detailedSteps.zh: 不移动检测板，每孔加入 100 µL Stop & Glo 试剂，短暂混匀，按相同积分设置测量 Renilla 荧光素酶发光值（Stop & Glo 同时猝灭 Firefly 并激活 Renilla）。

detailedSteps.en: Calculate the normalized reporter activity: Firefly RLU / Renilla RLU for each well. Average the triplicates and compare across experimental groups. For statistical analysis, perform at least 3 independent biological replicates.
detailedSteps.zh: 计算归一化报告基因活性：各孔 Firefly RLU / Renilla RLU，取三个复孔均值后各组比较，统计分析需至少 3 次独立生物学重复。

name: Electrocompetent E. coli Preparation
nameCn: 电转感受态大肠杆菌的制备

components.name: 1. Inoculate 5 mL LB from glycerol stock; 37°C 250 rpm overnight

note.en: Use DH10B, DH5α, or XL1-Blue for cloning; BL21 for expression. Pre-chill centrifuge to 4°C the night before.
note.zh: 克隆用 DH10B、DH5α 或 XL1-Blue；表达用 BL21。提前将离心机预冷至 4°C。

components.name: 2. Dilute 1:100 into 500 mL fresh LB; shake 37°C 250 rpm to OD₆₀₀ = 0.4–0.6

note.en: This takes 2–3 h. Monitor every 30 min after OD = 0.3. Do not exceed OD 0.6 — competence declines.
note.zh: 通常需要 2–3 h。OD 到 0.3 后每 30 min 监测一次。不超过 OD 0.6 — 感受态下降。

components.name: 3. Chill culture on ice 15–30 min; pre-chill all equipment (tubes, buffers, rotors)

note.en: Every step from here is at 4°C or on ice. Electrocompetent cells are highly temperature-sensitive.
note.zh: 从此步起所有操作在 4°C 或冰上进行。电转感受态细胞对温度极敏感。

note.en: Use pre-chilled bottles. Decant carefully — pellet is loose. Remove as much supernatant as possible (residual salt impairs electroporation).
note.zh: 使用预冷离心瓶。小心倾倒——沉淀松散。尽量去除上清（残留盐分影响电穿孔）。

note.en: Wash 1: resuspend in 500 mL 10% glycerol; spin 4,000×g 15 min 4°C. Wash 2: 250 mL. Wash 3: 50 mL. Then resuspend in 2 mL 10% glycerol. Conductivity must be <100 µS/cm (critical for electroporation efficiency).
note.zh: 洗涤 1：500 mL 10% 甘油重悬；4,000×g 15 min 4°C。洗涤 2：250 mL。洗涤 3：50 mL。最后 2 mL 10% 甘油重悬。电导率需 <100 µS/cm（电穿孔效率关键）。

components.name: 6. Aliquot 50 µL per tube; snap-freeze in liquid N₂; store −80°C

note.en: Single-use aliquots (do not refreeze). Efficiency should be ≥10⁹ CFU/µg pUC19 (verify with test transformation).
note.zh: 50 µL 单次用量分装（勿重复冻融）。效率应 ≥10⁹ CFU/µg pUC19（测试转化验证）。

note.en: Electroporate 1 µL pUC19 (10 pg/µL) with 25 µL cells. Time constant: ≥5 ms (1 mm cuvette). Expect ≥10⁸–10⁹ colonies/µg pUC19 for good batch.
note.zh: 用 1 µL pUC19（10 pg/µL）+ 25 µL 细胞测试电穿孔（1 mm 比色杯，时间常数 ≥5 ms）。优质批次应有 ≥10⁸–10⁹ 菌落/µg pUC19。

notes.en: Electrocompetent cells are 10–100× more efficient than chemical competent (CaCl₂) cells. Useful for: large libraries, low-concentration ligation products, fosmid/BAC transformation. Key: eliminate all salt from cells (LB → salt → arc during electroporation = cell death).
notes.zh: 电转感受态效率比化学法（CaCl₂）高 10–100 倍。适用于：大型文库、低浓度连接产物、fosmid/BAC 转化。关键：彻底去除细胞中所有盐分（LB→盐分→电穿孔时放弧 = 细胞死亡）。

ref: Dower et al. (1988) Nucleic Acids Res 16:6127–6145; Green & Sambrook (2012) Molecular Cloning 4th ed.; Sheng et al. (1995) Nucleic Acids Res 23(9):1826

usage.en: Prepare electrocompetent E. coli cells for high-efficiency electroporation.
usage.zh: 制备电转化感受态大肠杆菌，用于高效电转化。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 6 hours，实操: 5 hours

note.en: Overnight culture grows while you sleep
note.zh: 过夜培养是自然停顿点

note.en: Aliquoted electrocompetent cells stored at −80°C are stable for 6 months
note.zh: 分装的电转感受态细胞 −80°C 保存可达 6 个月

briefSteps.en: Overnight culture → dilute 1:100 → grow to OD 0.4–0.6 → ice chill → spin → wash 3× with ice-cold 10% glycerol (500→250→50 mL) → resuspend 2 mL → aliquot 50 µL → snap-freeze → −80°C → test efficiency
briefSteps.zh: 过夜培养 → 1:100 稀释 → 培养至 OD 0.4–0.6 → 冰上冷却 → 离心 → 冰冷 10% 甘油洗涤 3 次（500→250→50 mL）→ 2 mL 重悬 → 50 µL 分装 → 液氮速冻 → −80°C → 测试效率

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Overnight Culture**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 过夜培养**

detailedSteps.en: Inoculate 5 mL LB from glycerol stock. Shake at 37°C, 250 rpm overnight. Pre-chill centrifuge to 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 从甘油菌接种 5 mL LB。37°C 250 rpm 摇菌过夜。提前将离心机预冷至 4°C

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Cell Growth & Washing**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 菌体生长与洗涤**

detailedSteps.en: Dilute overnight culture 1:100 into 500 mL fresh LB. Shake at 37°C, 250 rpm until OD₆₀₀ = 0.4–0.6 (~2–3 h). Monitor every 30 min after OD 0.3
detailedSteps.zh: 过夜菌液 1:100 稀释至 500 mL 新鲜 LB。37°C 250 rpm 摇至 OD₆₀₀ = 0.4–0.6（~2–3 h）。OD 到 0.3 后每 30 min 监测

detailedSteps.en: Chill culture on ice for 15–30 min. Pre-chill all tubes, buffers, and rotors to 4°C. All subsequent steps on ice
detailedSteps.zh: 菌液冰上冷却 15–30 min。预冷所有管、缓冲液和转头至 4°C。此后全程冰上操作

detailedSteps.en: Pellet cells at 4,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Decant supernatant carefully — pellet is loose
detailedSteps.zh: 4,000×g 离心 15 min，4°C。小心倾倒上清——沉淀松散

detailedSteps.en: Wash 1: resuspend pellet in 500 mL ice-cold 10% glycerol; spin 4,000×g 15 min 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤 1：用 500 mL 冰冷 10% 甘油重悬沉淀；4,000×g 15 min 4°C 离心

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2: resuspend in 250 mL ice-cold 10% glycerol; spin 4,000×g 15 min 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤 2：用 250 mL 冰冷 10% 甘油重悬；4,000×g 15 min 4°C 离心

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3: resuspend in 50 mL ice-cold 10% glycerol; spin 4,000×g 15 min 4°C. Resuspend final pellet in 2 mL ice-cold 10% glycerol
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤 3：用 50 mL 冰冷 10% 甘油重悬；4,000×g 15 min 4°C 离心。最终沉淀用 2 mL 冰冷 10% 甘油重悬

detailedSteps.en: **Aliquoting & Storage**
detailedSteps.zh: **分装与保存**

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot 50 µL per pre-chilled tube. Snap-freeze in liquid nitrogen. Store at −80°C (single-use aliquots, do not refreeze)
detailedSteps.zh: 每管分装 50 µL（预冷管）。液氮速冻。−80°C 保存（单次使用，勿重复冻融）

detailedSteps.en: **Test Transformation Efficiency**
detailedSteps.zh: **测试转化效率**

detailedSteps.en: Electroporate 1 µL pUC19 (10 pg/µL) with 25 µL cells in 1 mm cuvette. Time constant should be ≥5 ms. Expect ≥10⁸–10⁹ colonies/µg pUC19
detailedSteps.zh: 取 1 µL pUC19（10 pg/µL）+ 25 µL 细胞于 1 mm 比色杯中电穿孔。时间常数应 ≥5 ms。预期效率 ≥10⁸–10⁹ 菌落/µg pUC19

name: EMSA / Electrophoretic Mobility Shift Assay (Gel Shift)
nameCn: 凝胶阻滞实验（EMSA / 电泳迁移率变动分析）

components.name: 1. Prepare labeled probe (dsDNA or ssRNA, 20–40 bp)

note.en: Fluorescent (IRDye 700/800, FAM): anneal complementary oligos 95°C 5 min → slow cool to RT in TE. ³²P: T4 PNK 5'-end labeling 37°C 30 min; purify G-25 spin column. Final probe: 1–10 nM.
note.zh: 荧光标记（IRDye 700/800、FAM）：互补寡核苷酸 95°C 5 min → 缓慢降温至 RT。³²P 标记：T4 PNK 5' 末端标记 37°C 30 min；G-25 柱纯化。探针终浓度 1–10 nM。

note.en: emsa_binding_buffer + 1 µg poly(dI:dC) as nonspecific competitor. Titrate protein: 0, 10, 50, 100, 500 nM. Add all except probe/protein first.
note.zh: emsa_binding_buffer + 1 µg poly(dI:dC) 非特异性竞争。蛋白梯度：0、10、50、100、500 nM。先加除探针和蛋白外的所有组分。

components.name: 3. Add protein (last before probe); mix gently

note.en: Protein titration: 0.1 nM–1 µM. Add probe after protein. Do not vortex.
note.zh: 蛋白梯度 0.1 nM–1 µM。加完蛋白后再加探针。勿涡旋。

components.name: 4. Incubate 20–30 min, RT (or ice for unstable complexes)

note.en: RT for most TF-DNA. 4°C if RT gives smear (unstable complex).
note.zh: 大多数转录因子-DNA 互作在 RT。不稳定复合物在 4°C。

components.name: 5. Cast & pre-run native PAGE (5–10% acrylamide, 0.5× TBE)

note.en: Pre-run 100 V, 1 h, 4°C. 5% for large complexes; 8–10% for small probes (<100 bp).
note.zh: 预电泳 100 V，1 h，4°C。5% 适合大复合物；8–10% 适合小探针（<100 bp）。

components.name: 6. Load samples (no SDS); use 50% glycerol as loading aid

note.en: Add 2 µL 50% glycerol. Load free-probe-only control in last lane.
note.zh: 加 2 µL 50% 甘油助沉。最后泳道加游离探针对照。

note.en: Run slowly — complexes are fragile. BPB should migrate to ~¾ gel length.
note.zh: 慢速电泳（复合物脆弱）。溴酚蓝迁移至凝胶 ~¾ 处停止。

note.en: Fluorescent: scan wet or dry gel (LI-COR). ³²P: fix in 10% MeOH + 10% AcOH 30 min, vacuum dry, expose overnight. Shifted band = complex; free probe at bottom.
note.zh: 荧光：LI-COR 直接扫描。³²P：10% MeOH + 10% AcOH 固定 30 min，真空干燥，曝光过夜。上移条带 = 复合物；底部 = 游离探针。

components.name: 9. Supershift (optional): add antibody 1–5 µg, incubate 30 min before loading

note.en: Supershift = further retardation (confirms protein identity). Disruption = loss of shift.
note.zh: 超阻滞 = 进一步迁移率降低（确认蛋白身份）。抗体干扰 = 阻滞消失。

note.en: Specific competitor → signal disappears. Scrambled sequence → signal maintained. Proves binding specificity.
note.zh: 特异性竞争 → 信号消失。乱序序列 → 信号保留。证明结合特异性。

notes.en: Controls: (1) no protein, (2) excess unlabeled specific probe, (3) scrambled competitor. Kd ≈ [protein] at 50% probe shifted. Troubleshooting: no shift → more protein; smear → run at 4°C or reduce ionic strength.
notes.zh: 对照：(1) 无蛋白、(2) 过量未标记特异探针、(3) 乱序竞争。Kd ≈ 50% 探针阻滞时的蛋白浓度。排查：无阻滞 → 增加蛋白；拖尾 → 4°C 电泳或降低离子强度。

ref: Hellman & Fried (2007) Nat Protoc 2:1849–1861; Fried & Liu (1994) Mol Microbiol 14:1083

usage.en: Detect protein-DNA interactions by electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA/gel shift).
usage.zh: 电泳迁移率变动实验（EMSA）检测蛋白质-DNA 相互作用。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 4–5 hours，实操: 3 hours

note.en: Complementary oligos annealed, PAGE-purified
note.zh: 互补寡核苷酸退火，PAGE纯化

note.en: NEB M0201, with 10× buffer
note.zh: NEB M0201，含10×缓冲液

note.en: 10 mCi/mL, 3000 Ci/mmol
note.zh: 10 mCi/mL，3000 Ci/mmol

note.en: 1 mg/mL stock, Sigma P4929
note.zh: 1 mg/mL储液，Sigma P4929

note.en: Prepare fresh or thaw from -80°C
note.zh: 新鲜制备或从-80°C解冻

note.en: For non-denaturing gel
note.zh: 用于非变性凝胶

note.en: Dilute to 0.5× for gel and running buffer
note.zh: 稀释至0.5×用于凝胶和电泳缓冲液

note.en: 40% glycerol, 0.01% bromophenol blue in water
note.zh: 40%甘油，0.01%溴酚蓝水溶液

note.en: For probe purification
note.zh: 用于探针纯化

note.en: Annealed and labeled probe can be stored at −20°C (fluorescent) or −80°C (³²P, use within 2 weeks) until needed.
note.zh: 退火后的标记探针可 −20°C 保存（荧光探针）或 −80°C 保存（³²P，需在 2 周内使用）。

briefSteps.en: Prepare labeled DNA probe (fluorescent or ³²P) → set up binding reactions with titrated protein and poly(dI:dC) competitor → incubate 20–30 min at RT → pre-run native PAGE (5–10% acrylamide, 0.5× TBE) at 100 V for 1 h at 4°C → load samples and run gel 100–150 V, 1–2 h at 4°C → visualize shifted bands by fluorescent imager or phosphorimager → optional supershift or competition assay
briefSteps.zh: 制备标记 DNA 探针（荧光或 ³²P）→ 加入梯度蛋白和 poly(dI:dC) 竞争剂配制结合反应 → RT 孵育 20–30 min → 天然 PAGE（5–10% 丙烯酰胺、0.5× TBE）4°C 100 V 预电泳 1 h → 上样，4°C 100–150 V 电泳 1–2 h → 荧光成像仪或磷光成像仪检测迁移条带 → 可选超阻滞或竞争实验

detailedSteps.en: Prepare labeled DNA probe: anneal complementary oligonucleotides (20–40 bp) at 95°C for 5 min, then slow-cool to RT over 45–60 min. For fluorescent probes (IRDye 700/800 or FAM), use at 1–10 nM. For ³²P: label with T4 PNK at 37°C for 30 min; purify on G-25 spin column.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备标记 DNA 探针：互补寡核苷酸（20–40 bp）95°C 退火 5 min，缓慢降温至室温（45–60 min）。荧光探针（IRDye 700/800 或 FAM）终浓度 1–10 nM；³²P 标记：T4 PNK 37°C 30 min，G-25 柱纯化。

detailedSteps.en: Cast and pre-run native PAGE: 5% acrylamide for large complexes or 8–10% for small probes (<100 bp), 0.5× TBE buffer, 4°C. Pre-run at 100 V for 1 h at 4°C to equilibrate gel and remove charged impurities.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备天然 PAGE 凝胶并预电泳：大分子复合物用 5%，小探针（<100 bp）用 8–10%，0.5× TBE 缓冲液，4°C，100 V 预电泳 1 h。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare binding reactions (10–20 µL each): combine EMSA binding buffer + 1 µg poly(dI:dC) nonspecific competitor + protein at 0, 10, 50, 100, and 500 nM. Add all components except protein and probe first; add protein last, then probe.
detailedSteps.zh: 配制结合反应（每管 10–20 µL）：EMSA 结合缓冲液 + 1 µg poly(dI:dC) 非特异竞争剂 + 蛋白梯度（0、10、50、100、500 nM）。先加除蛋白和探针外的所有组分，最后加蛋白，再加探针。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate binding reactions 20–30 min at RT. For unstable complexes, incubate at 4°C. Do NOT vortex; mix gently by flicking tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 结合反应室温孵育 20–30 min；不稳定复合物可在 4°C 孵育。勿涡旋，轻弹管壁混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Add 2 µL of 50% glycerol to each reaction as loading aid (final ~6–8% glycerol to sink samples). Load samples without SDS. Load free-probe-only control in the last lane.
detailedSteps.zh: 每管加入 2 µL 50% 甘油作为上样辅助（终浓度约 6–8%）。勿加 SDS。最后泳道加游离探针对照。

detailedSteps.en: Run electrophoresis at 100–150 V for 1–2 h at 4°C. Run slowly — complexes are fragile. Stop when bromophenol blue has migrated ~¾ of the gel length.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 100–150 V 电泳 1–2 h。慢速电泳，避免复合物解离。溴酚蓝迁移至凝胶约 3/4 处停止。

detailedSteps.en: Visualize results: Fluorescent probes — scan gel wet on LI-COR infrared scanner. ³²P probes — fix gel in 10% methanol + 10% acetic acid for 30 min, vacuum dry, expose to phosphorimager screen overnight. Shifted band = protein-DNA complex; free probe at bottom of gel.
detailedSteps.zh: 结果检测：荧光探针——LI-COR 红外扫描仪直接扫描湿凝胶。³²P——10% 甲醇 + 10% 乙酸固定 30 min，真空干燥，磷光成像板曝光过夜。上移条带 = 蛋白-DNA 复合物；底部 = 游离探针。

detailedSteps.en: Optional supershift: before loading, add 1–5 µg antibody against the protein of interest to the binding reaction; incubate additional 30 min at RT. A further-shifted band confirms protein identity.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选超阻滞验证：上样前向结合反应中加入 1–5 µg 靶蛋白抗体，RT 再孵育 30 min。产生更明显的阻滞条带可确认蛋白身份。

detailedSteps.en: Optional competition assay: add 10×–100× molar excess of unlabeled specific (same sequence) or nonspecific (scrambled) competitor DNA before adding labeled probe. Specific competitor eliminates shift; scrambled sequence maintains shift. This confirms binding specificity.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选竞争实验：加标记探针前加入 10–100 倍摩尔过量的未标记特异性（同序列）或非特异性（乱序）竞争 DNA。特异性竞争使信号消失；乱序竞争信号保留，证明结合特异性。

name: Enzyme Kinetics Assay (Michaelis-Menten)
nameCn: 酶动力学分析（米氏方程法）

components.name: 1. Purify enzyme to >90% homogeneity; determine concentration

note.en: SDS-PAGE + Coomassie; BCA/Bradford. Use freshly purified or aliquoted protein.
note.zh: SDS-PAGE + 考马斯蓝确认纯度；BCA/Bradford 定量。使用新鲜纯化或分装冻存蛋白。

note.en: Typical: 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 1–10 mM MgCl₂ (kinases/ATPases), 1 mM DTT, 0.01% BSA. Use kinase_buffer as start; optimize pH, ions, cofactors.
note.zh: 典型：50 mM HEPES pH 7.5、1–10 mM MgCl₂（激酶/ATPase）、1 mM DTT、0.01% BSA。以 kinase_buffer 为起点优化 pH、离子、辅因子。

note.en: Measure product vs time at saturating [S]. Ensure: (a) <10% substrate consumed, (b) linear product formation. Typical: 0–30 min, sample at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 min.
note.zh: 饱和底物浓度下测产物随时间变化。确保：(a) 底物消耗 <10%，(b) 产物线性生成。典型：0–30 min，在 0、5、10、15、20、30 min 取样。

note.en: E.g., 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 µM. Include [S]=0 (background). Prepare in assay buffer.

components.name: 5. Start reactions: add enzyme last; fixed temperature (25–37°C)

note.en: Fixed [E] (10–100 nM). ≥3 replicates per [S]. Water bath or thermocycler for temperature control.
note.zh: 固定 [E]（10–100 nM）。每个 [S] ≥3 重复。水浴或 PCR 仪控温。

components.name: 6. Stop reactions at fixed timepoint (within linear range)

note.en: Methods: (a) NADH-linked: continuous A₃₄₀ reading; (b) colorimetric: add TCA/HCl; (c) fluorescence: quench buffer; (d) radioactive: spot on P81 paper.
note.zh: 停止方法：(a) NADH 偶联：连续读 A₃₄₀；(b) 比色法：加 TCA/HCl；(c) 荧光：加淬灭液；(d) 放射性：点样于 P81 纸。

components.name: 7. Measure signal; calculate initial velocity V₀

note.en: V₀ = Δ[product]/Δtime in linear range. NADH: ε₃₄₀ = 6,220 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ (Beer-Lambert).
note.zh: V₀ = Δ[产物]/Δ时间（线性范围）。NADH 偶联：ε₃₄₀ = 6,220 M⁻¹cm⁻¹（Beer-Lambert 定律）。

components.name: 8. Fit V₀ vs [S] to Michaelis-Menten equation

note.en: V₀ = Vmax × [S] / (Km + [S]). Nonlinear regression: GraphPad Prism, scipy.optimize.curve_fit, or R nls(). Derive Km and Vmax.
note.zh: V₀ = Vmax × [S] / (Km + [S])。非线性回归：GraphPad Prism、scipy.optimize.curve_fit 或 R nls()。获得 Km 和 Vmax。

note.en: kcat (s⁻¹) = catalytic constant. kcat/Km (M⁻¹s⁻¹) = catalytic efficiency. Typical: kcat 0.001–10,000 s⁻¹; kcat/Km up to 10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹ (diffusion limit).
note.zh: kcat（s⁻¹）= 催化常数。kcat/Km（M⁻¹s⁻¹）= 催化效率。典型范围：kcat 0.001–10,000 s⁻¹；kcat/Km 最高 10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹（扩散极限）。

note.en: Competitive: Km↑, Vmax same. Noncompetitive: Vmax↓, Km same. Uncompetitive: both↓. Use Lineweaver-Burk or global fitting.
note.zh: 竞争性：Km↑、Vmax 不变。非竞争性：Vmax↓、Km 不变。反竞争性：两者↓。用 Lineweaver-Burk 双倒数图或全局拟合分析。

notes.en: Common coupled assays: LDH for pyruvate-generating; PK-LDH for ATPases; NADH at 340 nm. Controls: (a) no enzyme, (b) heat-inactivated, (c) no substrate. Report: Km, Vmax, kcat, kcat/Km, temp, pH, buffer.
notes.zh: 常用偶联法：LDH 偶联丙酮酸生成酶；PK-LDH 偶联 ATPase；NADH 340 nm。对照：(a) 无酶、(b) 热灭活、(c) 无底物。报告：Km、Vmax、kcat、kcat/Km、温度、pH、缓冲条件。

ref: Johnson & Goody (2011) Biochemistry 50(39):8264–8269; Copeland (2000) Enzymes 2nd ed. Wiley-VCH; Bisswanger (2014) Perspect Sci 1:41–55

usage.en: Determine enzyme kinetic parameters (Km, Vmax) by Michaelis-Menten analysis.
usage.zh: Michaelis-Menten 分析测定酶动力学参数（Km、Vmax）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 4 hours

note.en: Known concentration, >90% purity
note.zh: 已知浓度，纯度>90%

note.en: Highest available purity, freshly prepared
note.zh: 最高纯度，新鲜配制

note.en: 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4 or enzyme-specific buffer
note.zh: 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4或酶特异性缓冲液

note.en: Clear for absorbance, black for fluorescence
note.zh: 透明用于吸光度，黑色用于荧光

note.en: Kinetic mode with appropriate filter
note.zh: 动力学模式，配适当滤光片

note.en: For simultaneous reaction initiation
note.zh: 用于同时启动反应

note.en: GraphPad Prism, Python, or R
note.zh: GraphPad Prism、Python或R

note.en: Purified enzyme aliquots can be snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at −80°C until use.
note.zh: 纯化酶可分装后液氮速冻，−80°C 保存备用。

note.en: Stopped reactions (in TCA or HCl) can be stored on ice for up to 2 h before reading; for colorimetric products, read promptly.
note.zh: TCA 或 HCl 终止的反应可在冰上放置最长 2 h 再读数；比色法产物应尽快读数。

briefSteps.en: Purify and quantify enzyme → establish buffer conditions → determine linear reaction range → prepare substrate concentration series (0.1×–10×Km) → run reactions at fixed [E] and temperature → stop at linear-range timepoint → measure signal → fit V₀ vs [S] to Michaelis-Menten → calculate Km, Vmax, kcat.
briefSteps.zh: 纯化并定量酶 → 确定缓冲条件 → 确定线性反应范围 → 配制底物浓度系列（0.1×–10×Km）→ 固定 [E] 和温度下进行反应 → 在线性范围时间点终止 → 检测信号 → V₀ vs [S] 米氏方程拟合 → 计算 Km、Vmax、kcat。

detailedSteps.en: Confirm enzyme purity by SDS-PAGE and Coomassie staining (>90% homogeneity). Quantify enzyme concentration by BCA or Bradford assay. Use freshly purified enzyme or thaw an aliquot on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: SDS-PAGE + 考马斯蓝染色确认酶纯度（>90%），BCA 或 Bradford 定量酶浓度，使用新鲜纯化酶或在冰上解冻分装品。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare assay buffer: typically 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl₂, 1 mM DTT, 0.01% BSA. Optimize pH, ionic strength, and cofactors for your specific enzyme if needed.
detailedSteps.zh: 配制反应缓冲液：通常为 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5、5 mM MgCl₂、1 mM DTT、0.01% BSA，根据酶的特性优化 pH、离子强度和辅因子。

detailedSteps.en: Determine the linear reaction range: measure product formation vs time at saturating substrate (10×Km). Sample at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 min. Choose a timepoint where <10% substrate is consumed and product is linear.
detailedSteps.zh: 确定线性范围：在饱和底物浓度（10×Km）下测量产物随时间的生成量，在 0、5、10、15、20、30 min 取样，选择底物消耗 <10% 且产物线性增加的时间点。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare a substrate concentration series covering 0.1×Km to 10×Km (6–8 points, e.g., 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 µM). Include a no-substrate control ([S]=0). Prepare in assay buffer at 2× final concentration.
detailedSteps.zh: 配制底物浓度系列，覆盖 0.1×Km 至 10×Km（6–8 点，如 1、5、10、25、50、100、250、500 µM），包含无底物对照（[S]=0），以反应缓冲液配制至 2× 终浓度。

detailedSteps.en: Set up reactions in 96-well plate or cuvettes. Add buffer, substrate, and any cofactors. Pre-equilibrate to assay temperature (25–37°C) for 5 min. Start all reactions simultaneously by adding enzyme (10–100 nM final) last. Include ≥3 replicates per substrate concentration.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 96 孔板或比色杯中依次加入缓冲液、底物和辅因子，在反应温度（25–37°C）预平衡 5 min，最后加酶（终浓度 10–100 nM）启动反应，每个底物浓度设 ≥3 个重复。

detailedSteps.en: Stop all reactions at the predetermined linear-range timepoint using the appropriate method: add TCA (10% final) or HCl for colorimetric assays, or switch to continuous kinetics mode (NADH-linked assay at A₃₄₀). Include a heat-inactivated enzyme control.
detailedSteps.zh: 在预定线性范围时间点统一终止反应：比色法加 TCA（终浓度 10%）或 HCl；NADH 偶联法采用连续监测 A₃₄₀ 模式。包含热灭活酶对照。

detailedSteps.en: Measure signal by spectrophotometry or fluorescence. Convert absorbance to product concentration using the molar extinction coefficient (e.g., NADH: ε₃₄₀ = 6,220 M⁻¹cm⁻¹). Calculate initial velocity V₀ = Δ[product]/Δtime.
detailedSteps.zh: 分光光度法或荧光法检测信号，用摩尔消光系数（如 NADH：ε₃₄₀ = 6,220 M⁻¹cm⁻¹）将吸光度换算为产物浓度，计算初速率 V₀ = Δ[产物]/Δ时间。

detailedSteps.en: Plot V₀ versus [S] and fit to the Michaelis-Menten equation: V₀ = Vmax × [S] / (Km + [S]) using nonlinear regression (GraphPad Prism, scipy.optimize.curve_fit, or R nls()). Extract Km and Vmax from the fit.
detailedSteps.zh: 以 V₀ 对 [S] 作图，用非线性回归拟合米氏方程 V₀ = Vmax × [S] / (Km + [S])（GraphPad Prism、scipy.optimize.curve_fit 或 R nls()），从拟合结果获得 Km 和 Vmax。

detailedSteps.en: Calculate kcat = Vmax / [E]total (s⁻¹) and catalytic efficiency kcat/Km (M⁻¹s⁻¹). Report values with 95% confidence intervals. Typical ranges: Km µM–mM; kcat 0.001–10,000 s⁻¹; kcat/Km up to 10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹.
detailedSteps.zh: 计算 kcat = Vmax / [E]total（s⁻¹）和催化效率 kcat/Km（M⁻¹s⁻¹），报告值附 95% 置信区间。典型范围：Km µM–mM；kcat 0.001–10,000 s⁻¹；kcat/Km 最高 10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹。

detailedSteps.en: Optional: determine inhibition kinetics by repeating the substrate series at 2–3 inhibitor concentrations. Distinguish inhibition mechanism (competitive, noncompetitive, uncompetitive) by Lineweaver-Burk plot or global curve fitting.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选：在 2–3 个抑制剂浓度下重复底物系列实验，通过 Lineweaver-Burk 双倒数图或全局拟合区分抑制类型（竞争性、非竞争性、反竞争性）。

name: ER and Golgi Isolation by Sucrose Density Gradient
nameCn: 内质网与高尔基体分离（蔗糖密度梯度法）

components.name: 1. Seed 1–2×10⁸ cells; wash 2× PBS; scrape in cold sucrose_gradient_homog buffer

note.en: Use 5 mL buffer per 10⁸ cells. Soft tissue (liver): 100–500 mg tissue, mince and wash. All steps 4°C.
note.zh: 每 10⁸ 细胞用 5 mL 缓冲液。软组织（肝脏）：100–500 mg，切碎后洗涤。全程 4°C。

components.name: 2. Homogenize: 30–40 Dounce strokes (tight pestle) until >80% cell lysis

note.en: Check by trypan blue every 10 strokes. ER is fragile — do not over-homogenize. N₂ cavitation (600–800 psi, 15 min) is gentler and gives higher ER yield.
note.zh: 每 10 次检查台盼蓝。ER 脆弱——勿过度匀浆。氮气空化（600–800 psi，15 min）更温和，ER 产量更高。

note.en: Postnuclear supernatant (PNS) contains all organelles except nuclei.
note.zh: 核后上清（PNS）含除核以外的所有细胞器。

note.en: Post-mitochondrial supernatant (PMS). Save 100 µL for WB input.
note.zh: 线粒体后上清（PMS）。保存 100 µL 作 WB 投入量对照。

components.name: 5. Crude microsome pellet: 100,000×g, 60 min, 4°C (Ti-70.1 or SW-55)

note.en: Pellet = crude microsomes (ER + Golgi + endosomes + plasma membrane fragments). Supernatant = cytosol. Resuspend crude microsomes in 0.5 mL 250 mM sucrose buffer.
note.zh: 沉淀 = 粗微粒体（ER + Golgi + 内体 + 质膜碎片）。上清 = 细胞质。粗微粒体用 0.5 mL 250 mM 蔗糖缓冲液重悬。

components.name: 6. Prepare discontinuous sucrose gradient in ultracentrifuge tube (SW-41 Ti, 11 mL)

note.en: Layer from bottom (pipette carefully, do not mix): 2.0 M sucrose (1.5 mL) → 1.3 M (3 mL) → 1.15 M (3 mL) → 0.86 M (2 mL). Load sample on top (0.5 mL). Place on ice.
note.zh: 从底部开始（小心不混层）：2.0 M 蔗糖（1.5 mL）→ 1.3 M（3 mL）→ 1.15 M（3 mL）→ 0.86 M（2 mL）。样品（0.5 mL）加在顶部。置于冰上。

components.name: 7. Ultracentrifuge: 100,000×g (25,000 rpm SW-41), 16–18 h, 4°C, no brake

note.en: Long spin for equilibrium banding. Slow acceleration (accel 3) and no brake (decel 0).
note.zh: 长时间离心达到平衡成带。慢加速（3 档）、无刹车（0 档）。

components.name: 8. Collect fractions from top (0.5–1 mL/fraction) using fraction collector or manual pipetting

note.en: Expected positions: Golgi (1.08–1.10 g/mL, at 0.86 M/1.15 M interface) and rough ER (1.17–1.20 g/mL, at 1.3 M/2.0 M interface). Smooth ER bands lighter (~1.14 g/mL).
note.zh: 预期位置：高尔基体（1.08–1.10 g/mL，0.86 M/1.15 M 界面）；粗面内质网（1.17–1.20 g/mL，1.3 M/2.0 M 界面）。光面 ER 较轻（~1.14 g/mL）。

components.name: 9. Identify fractions by Western blot markers

note.en: ER markers: Calnexin (transmembrane), PDI/PDIA3 (luminal), KDEL (lumenal). Golgi markers: GM130 (cis-Golgi), TGN46 (trans-Golgi). Dilute fractions 5× in PBS before WB.
note.zh: ER 标记：Calnexin（跨膜）、PDI/PDIA3（腔内）、KDEL（腔内序列）。高尔基标记：GM130（顺式）、TGN46（反式）。Western blot 前将组分用 PBS 稀释 5 倍。

components.name: 10. Pool and pellet organelle fractions: dilute 5×; 100,000×g 60 min 4°C

note.en: Removes sucrose. Resuspend in desired buffer (e.g., 50 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA). Protein yield: ~5–50 µg ER per 10⁷ cells.
note.zh: 去除蔗糖。用目标缓冲液（如 50 mM HEPES pH 7.4、150 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA）重悬。蛋白产量：约 5–50 µg ER/10⁷ 细胞。

notes.en: Alternative for Golgi: immunoprecipitation of Golgi membranes using anti-GM130 coated beads (faster, requires antibody). For live-cell ER/Golgi imaging: ER-Tracker (Thermo) or BODIPY-ceramide. Cross-contamination monitoring is essential — include mitochondria (COX IV), PM (Na/K-ATPase), lysosome (LAMP1) markers.
notes.zh: 高尔基体替代法：anti-GM130 磁珠免疫沉淀（更快，需要抗体）。活细胞 ER/Golgi 成像：ER-Tracker（Thermo）或 BODIPY-ceramide。必须监测交叉污染——包含线粒体（COX IV）、质膜（Na/K-ATPase）、溶酶体（LAMP1）标记。

ref: Graham (2001) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 3.8.1; Barr (2013) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 59:3.29.1

usage.en: Isolate endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi membrane fractions by sucrose density gradient centrifugation.
usage.zh: 蔗糖密度梯度离心分离内质网和高尔基体膜组分。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 days，实操: 6 hours

materials.name: Cells or tissue (>10⁸ cells or >1 g tissue)
Sucrose gradient solutions (0.25 M, 0.5 M, 0.86 M, 1.3 M)

note.en: Post-nuclear supernatant (PNS) can be kept on ice for up to 1 h before further fractionation
note.zh: 核后上清（PNS）可在冰上保存 1 h 后再进一步分级

note.en: Crude microsome pellet can be snap-frozen at −80°C for up to 1 week
note.zh: 粗微粒体沉淀可 −80°C 速冻保存 1 周

note.en: Purified ER/Golgi fractions in aliquots can be stored at −80°C for up to 1 month
note.zh: 纯化的 ER/Golgi 组分分装后可 −80°C 保存 1 个月

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → Dounce homogenize → 600×g remove nuclei → 5,000×g remove mito → 100,000×g pellet microsomes → sucrose gradient (0.86/1.15/1.3/2.0 M) → ultracentrifuge 16–18 h → collect Golgi & ER fractions → WB validate → pool & pellet
briefSteps.zh: 收获细胞 → Dounce 匀浆 → 600×g 去核 → 5,000×g 去线粒体 → 100,000×g 沉淀微粒体 → 蔗糖梯度（0.86/1.15/1.3/2.0 M）→ 超离 16–18 h → 收集 Golgi 和 ER 组分 → WB 验证 → 合并沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **Cell Harvest & Homogenization**
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞收获与匀浆**

detailedSteps.en: Seed 1–2×10⁸ cells. Wash 2× with cold PBS. Scrape cells in cold sucrose homogenization buffer (5 mL per 10⁸ cells). For tissue: mince 100–500 mg, wash with cold buffer
detailedSteps.zh: 准备 1–2×10⁸ 细胞。冷 PBS 洗 2 次。用冷蔗糖匀浆缓冲液（每 10⁸ 细胞 5 mL）刮取细胞。组织：切碎 100–500 mg，冷缓冲液洗涤

detailedSteps.en: Homogenize with 30–40 Dounce strokes (tight pestle) until >80% cell lysis. Check by trypan blue every 10 strokes. Alternatively: N₂ cavitation (600–800 psi, 15 min) for gentler ER-preserving lysis
detailedSteps.zh: Dounce 匀浆器 30–40 次（紧配研杵）直至 >80% 细胞裂解。每 10 次用台盼蓝检查。替代方法：氮气空化（600–800 psi，15 min）更温和保护 ER

detailedSteps.en: **Differential Centrifugation**
detailedSteps.zh: **差速离心**

detailedSteps.en: Remove nuclei/debris: 600×g, 10 min, 4°C. Repeat once. Keep post-nuclear supernatant (PNS)
detailedSteps.zh: 去除细胞核/碎片：600×g 离心 10 min，4°C。重复 1 次。保留核后上清（PNS）

detailedSteps.en: Remove mitochondria: 5,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Keep post-mitochondrial supernatant (PMS). Save 100 µL for WB input
detailedSteps.zh: 去除线粒体：5,000×g 离心 10 min，4°C。保留线粒体后上清（PMS）。取 100 µL 作 WB 投入量

detailedSteps.en: Pellet crude microsomes: 100,000×g, 60 min, 4°C. Resuspend pellet in 0.5 mL 250 mM sucrose buffer. Supernatant = cytosol (save aliquot)
detailedSteps.zh: 沉淀粗微粒体：100,000×g 离心 60 min，4°C。用 0.5 mL 250 mM 蔗糖缓冲液重悬沉淀。上清 = 细胞质（留样）

detailedSteps.en: **Sucrose Density Gradient Separation**
detailedSteps.zh: **蔗糖密度梯度分离**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare discontinuous sucrose gradient in SW-41 Ti tube (11 mL): layer from bottom — 2.0 M (1.5 mL) → 1.3 M (3 mL) → 1.15 M (3 mL) → 0.86 M (2 mL). Load sample (0.5 mL) on top
detailedSteps.zh: 在 SW-41 Ti 管（11 mL）中制备不连续蔗糖梯度：从底部分层 — 2.0 M（1.5 mL）→ 1.3 M（3 mL）→ 1.15 M（3 mL）→ 0.86 M（2 mL）。样品（0.5 mL）加在顶部

detailedSteps.en: Ultracentrifuge: 100,000×g (25,000 rpm SW-41), 16–18 h, 4°C. Slow acceleration (setting 3), no brake (decel 0)
**Fraction Collection & Validation**
detailedSteps.zh: **组分收集与验证**

detailedSteps.en: Collect 0.5–1 mL fractions from top. Golgi bands at 0.86 M/1.15 M interface (density 1.08–1.10 g/mL). Rough ER bands at 1.3 M/2.0 M interface (density 1.17–1.20 g/mL). Smooth ER ~1.14 g/mL
detailedSteps.zh: 从顶部收集 0.5–1 mL 组分。Golgi 在 0.86 M/1.15 M 界面（密度 1.08–1.10 g/mL）。粗面 ER 在 1.3 M/2.0 M 界面（密度 1.17–1.20 g/mL）。光面 ER ~1.14 g/mL

detailedSteps.en: Validate by Western blot: ER markers (Calnexin, PDI, KDEL), Golgi markers (GM130, TGN46). Include contamination controls: COX IV (mito), Na/K-ATPase (PM), LAMP1 (lysosome)
detailedSteps.zh: Western blot 验证：ER 标记（Calnexin、PDI、KDEL），Golgi 标记（GM130、TGN46）。包含污染对照：COX IV（线粒体）、Na/K-ATPase（质膜）、LAMP1（溶酶体）

detailedSteps.en: Pool target fractions, dilute 5× in PBS, pellet at 100,000×g 60 min 4°C to remove sucrose. Resuspend in desired buffer. Aliquot and store at −80°C
detailedSteps.zh: 合并目标组分，PBS 稀释 5 倍，100,000×g 离心 60 min 4°C 去除蔗糖。用目标缓冲液重悬。分装 −80°C 保存

name: Ethanol Precipitation of Nucleic Acids

note.en: DNA precipitation: NaCl or NH₄OAc can substitute
note.zh: DNA 也可用 NaCl 或 NH₄OAc

components.name: 2. 加 2.5 vol 冰冷 100% 乙醇

note.en: RNA or low-yield DNA: add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) as carrier
note.zh: RNA 或低浓度 DNA: 加 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) 做载体

note.en: Overnight incubation improves recovery of low-concentration samples
note.zh: 过夜可提高低浓度样品回收率

components.name: 5. 弃上清 → 加 500 µL 冰冷 70% 乙醇

note.en: Pipette carefully; do not disturb the pellet
note.zh: 吸管小心吸, 勿碰沉淀

components.name: 9. 溶解于 TE 或 H₂O

notes.en: 70% ethanol wash removes residual salts. Isopropanol precipitation (0.7 vol, no salt needed) uses less volume, good for large samples, but pellet contains more salt — wash extra. SDS co-precipitates — remove with KOAc or phenol-chloroform first. Do not use ethanol precipitation to recover DNA from <10 µL volumes.
notes.zh: 70% 乙醇洗涤去除残余盐。异丙醇沉淀 (0.7 vol, 无需加盐) 体积更小，适合大体积样品，但沉淀含更多盐需多洗一次。SDS 会共沉淀——需先用 KOAc 沉淀去除或酚氯仿提取。不要使用乙醇沉淀从 <10 µL 体积回收 DNA。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; Green & Sambrook (2012) Molecular Cloning, 4th Ed

usage.en: Concentrate and purify DNA or RNA by ethanol precipitation.
usage.zh: 乙醇沉淀法浓缩和纯化 DNA 或 RNA。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours，实操: 30 minutes

note.en: For DNA/RNA precipitation
note.zh: 用于DNA/RNA沉淀

note.en: Alternative for DNA; reduces dNTP carry-over
note.zh: DNA替代盐；减少dNTP残留

note.en: Molecular biology grade, pre-chilled to −20°C
note.zh: 分子生物学级，预冷至 −20°C

note.en: Ice-cold, for wash step
note.zh: 冰冷，用于洗涤步骤

note.en: Co-precipitant for low amounts
note.zh: 低量核酸共沉淀剂

note.en: For resuspension
note.zh: 用于重悬

note.en: Sample in ethanol can be stored at −20°C overnight
note.zh: 乙醇中样品可 −20°C 过夜保存

note.en: Pellet in 70% ethanol can be stored at −20°C for weeks
note.zh: 沉淀在70%乙醇中可 −20°C 保存数周

briefSteps.en: Add 1/10 vol 3 M NaOAc pH 5.2 and 2.5 vol ice-cold 100% ethanol (add glycogen carrier for dilute samples), precipitate at −20°C ≥30 min, pellet by centrifugation at 14,000×g for 15–30 min at 4°C, wash with 70% ethanol, air-dry briefly, and resuspend in TE or water.
briefSteps.zh: 加入 1/10 体积 3 M NaOAc（pH 5.2）和 2.5 倍体积冰冷 100% 乙醇（稀释样品需加 glycogen 载体），−20°C 沉淀 ≥30 min，4°C 14,000×g 离心 15–30 min，70% 乙醇洗涤，短暂风干，最后溶于 TE 或水中。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer nucleic acid sample to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. For dilute samples (<20 ng/µL) or RNA, add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) as a co-precipitant to improve pellet visibility and recovery.
detailedSteps.zh: 将核酸样品转移至干净的 1.5 mL 离心管中。对于稀释样品（<20 ng/µL）或 RNA，加入 1 µL glycogen（20 mg/mL）作为共沉淀剂，提高沉淀可见度和回收率。

detailedSteps.en: Add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 (e.g., 5 µL per 50 µL sample). For DNA, alternatives include 0.2 M NaCl or 2 M ammonium acetate (helps remove dNTPs). Mix thoroughly.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 1/10 体积的 3 M 醋酸钠（pH 5.2）（如每 50 µL 样品加 5 µL）。DNA 可替换为 0.2 M NaCl 或 2 M 醋酸铵（可去除 dNTP）。充分混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Add 2.5 volumes of ice-cold 100% ethanol (e.g., 137.5 µL per 55 µL sample after salt addition). Mix by vortexing or inverting 10 times.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 2.5 倍体积冰冷 100% 乙醇（如 55 µL 样品加 137.5 µL）。涡旋振荡或颠倒混匀 10 次。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at −20°C for at least 30 min. For low-abundance nucleic acids or short fragments (<100 bp), incubate overnight at −20°C or 30 min at −80°C to maximize recovery.
detailedSteps.zh: −20°C 孵育至少 30 min。对于低丰度核酸或短片段（<100 bp），在 −20°C 孵育过夜或 −80°C 孵育 30 min 以最大化回收率。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 14,000×g for 15–30 min at 4°C. DNA/RNA pellet will form at the bottom of the tube (may be invisible for dilute samples — mark the outer side of tube before centrifugation to track pellet location).
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C、14,000×g 离心 15–30 min。DNA/RNA 沉淀在管底形成（稀释样品可能肉眼不可见——离心前在管外侧做标记以定位沉淀）。

detailedSteps.en: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant by pipetting or decanting without disturbing the pellet. If using glycogen, the pellet will appear white or blue.
detailedSteps.zh: 用吸管小心吸去或倾倒上清，勿触碰沉淀。加入 glycogen 时，沉淀呈白色或蓝色。

detailedSteps.en: Add 500 µL ice-cold 70% ethanol to wash the pellet and remove residual salt. Centrifuge at 14,000×g for 5 min at 4°C. Carefully remove supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 500 µL 冰冷 70% 乙醇洗涤沉淀，去除残余盐。4°C、14,000×g 离心 5 min，小心去除上清。

detailedSteps.en: Briefly air-dry the pellet at room temperature for 5–10 min (or dry in a vacuum concentrator at low heat for 2 min). Do not over-dry — a translucent pellet indicates it is ready; a white, powdery pellet is over-dried and may be difficult to dissolve.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温风干沉淀 5–10 min（或真空浓缩仪低温干燥 2 min）。不要过度干燥——半透明沉淀表示干燥程度合适；白色粉末状沉淀表示过度干燥，可能难以溶解。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate volume of TE buffer (for long-term storage) or nuclease-free water (for enzymatic reactions). Pipette gently and incubate at 55°C for 5 min if pellet is difficult to dissolve. Quantify by NanoDrop.
detailedSteps.zh: 将沉淀溶于适量 TE 缓冲液（长期保存）或无核酸酶水（酶促反应）中。若沉淀难以溶解，轻柔吹打并于 55°C 孵育 5 min。用 NanoDrop 定量。

name: Exosome / Extracellular Vesicle Isolation (Differential Ultracentrifugation)
nameCn: 外泌体/胞外囊泡分离（差速超速离心法）

components.name: 1. Culture cells in EV-depleted medium (48–72 h conditioned medium)

note.en: EV-free FBS: ultracentrifuge commercial FBS at 100,000×g 18 h 4°C; collect supernatant. Or use serum-free medium for last 24–48 h (lower contamination, lower yield). Volume: ≥50 mL conditioned medium needed.
note.zh: 去 EV 血清：商业 FBS 100,000×g 4°C 18 h 超速离心；取上清。或最后 24–48 h 改无血清培养基（污染少，产量低）。需 ≥50 mL 条件培养基。

note.en: Remove cells. Keep supernatant.
note.zh: 去除细胞。保留上清。

note.en: Pellet = apoptotic bodies (discard). Keep supernatant.
note.zh: 沉淀 = 凋亡小体（弃去）。保留上清。

note.en: Pellet = large microvesicles/MVBs (200–1,000 nm). Can collect separately. Keep supernatant for exosome isolation.
note.zh: 沉淀 = 大型微囊泡/MVB（200–1,000 nm，可单独收集）。保留上清用于外泌体分离。

note.en: Removes residual large particles. PES membrane (low protein binding). Keep filtrate.
note.zh: 去除残余大颗粒。用低蛋白结合 PES 膜。保留滤液。

components.name: 6. Exosome pellet: 100,000×g, 70–90 min, 4°C (Ti-45 or SW-41 Ti rotor)

note.en: First 100k spin pellets exosomes (30–200 nm). Discard supernatant (cytosol + soluble proteins).
note.zh: 第一次 100k 离心沉淀外泌体（30–200 nm）。弃去上清（细胞质 + 可溶蛋白）。

components.name: 7. Wash: resuspend pellet in 10 mL cold PBS; 100,000×g, 70 min, 4°C

note.en: Removes contaminating soluble proteins. Repeat once more for higher purity.
note.zh: 去除污染的可溶蛋白。再重复一次可提高纯度。

components.name: 8. Resuspend final pellet in PBS or appropriate buffer (50–200 µL)

note.en: Pipette gently. Do not vortex. Store at −80°C (single-use aliquots) or use fresh. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw.
note.zh: 轻柔吸打重悬。不涡旋。−80°C 单次分装保存或新鲜使用。避免反复冻融。

note.en: MISEV2018 guidelines (Théry 2018): report at least 3 markers. NTA (NanoSight, ZetaView): size 50–200 nm, report concentration/mL. TEM: cup-shaped morphology. Negative markers: GM130 (no Golgi contamination), Cytochrome C (no mitochondria).
note.zh: MISEV2018 指南（Théry 2018）：至少报告 3 个标记。NTA（NanoSight、ZetaView）：尺寸 50–200 nm，报告浓度/mL。透射电镜：杯形形态。阴性标记：GM130（无 Golgi 污染）、细胞色素 c（无线粒体）。

notes.en: This protocol yields crude exosome preparation. For higher purity: further fractionate on iodixanol (OptiPrep) density gradient (top-loading, 40,000×g 18 h). Typical yield: 10⁹–10¹⁰ particles/mL from 50 mL conditioned medium. Alternative methods: SEC (size exclusion on qEV columns), precipitation (ExoQuick, fast but impure), immunoaffinity (anti-CD63 beads). All reported per MISEV2018 guidelines.
notes.zh: 本方案获得粗制外泌体制品。更高纯度：碘克沙醇（OptiPrep）密度梯度进一步分离（顶部上样，40,000×g 18 h）。典型产量：50 mL 条件培养基 → 10⁹–10¹⁰ 颗粒/mL。替代方法：SEC（qEV 柱分子排阻）、沉淀法（ExoQuick，快速但不纯）、免疫亲和法（anti-CD63 磁珠）。所有报告遵循 MISEV2018 指南。

ref: Théry et al. (2006) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 3.22.1; Théry et al. (2018) J Extracell Vesicles 7:1535750 (MISEV2018); Witwer et al. (2021) J Extracell Vesicles 10:e12080

usage.en: Isolate exosomes/small extracellular vesicles from cell culture medium by differential ultracentrifugation.
usage.zh: 差速超离法从细胞培养液中分离外泌体/小细胞外囊泡。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 4 hours

materials.name: Conditioned cell culture medium (48–72 h, serum-free or exosome-depleted FBS)

note.en: Conditioned medium can be stored at −80°C for up to 3 months before processing
note.zh: 条件培养基可 −80°C 保存 3 个月后再处理

note.en: Filtered supernatant (post 0.22 µm) can be stored at 4°C overnight before ultracentrifugation
note.zh: 过滤后上清（0.22 µm 后）可 4°C 过夜保存再超离

note.en: Resuspended exosome pellet can be stored at −80°C in single-use aliquots for 1 month
note.zh: 重悬的外泌体沉淀可 −80°C 单次分装保存 1 个月

briefSteps.en: Collect conditioned medium → 300×g remove cells → 2,000×g remove debris → 10,000×g remove large MVs → 0.22 µm filter → 100,000×g pellet exosomes → PBS wash 100,000×g → resuspend → characterize (NTA/TEM/WB)
briefSteps.zh: 收集条件培养基 → 300×g 去细胞 → 2,000×g 去碎片 → 10,000×g 去大 MV → 0.22 µm 过滤 → 100,000×g 沉淀外泌体 → PBS 洗 100,000×g → 重悬 → 表征（NTA/TEM/WB）

detailedSteps.en: **Conditioned Medium Collection**
detailedSteps.zh: **条件培养基收集**

detailedSteps.en: Culture cells in exosome-depleted FBS medium (or serum-free for last 24–48 h). Collect 48–72 h conditioned medium (≥50 mL needed)
detailedSteps.zh: 在去外泌体 FBS 培养基中培养细胞（或最后 24–48 h 改无血清）。收集 48–72 h 条件培养基（需 ≥50 mL）

detailedSteps.en: **Serial Differential Centrifugation**
detailedSteps.zh: **连续差速离心**

detailedSteps.en: Remove live cells: 300×g, 10 min, 4°C. Transfer supernatant to new tube
detailedSteps.zh: 去除活细胞：300×g 离心 10 min，4°C。转移上清至新管

detailedSteps.en: Remove dead cells/apoptotic bodies: 2,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Discard pellet, keep supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: 去除死细胞/凋亡小体：2,000×g 离心 10 min，4°C。弃沉淀，保留上清

detailedSteps.en: Remove large microvesicles: 10,000×g, 30 min, 4°C. Pellet = large MVs (200–1,000 nm, collect separately if needed). Keep supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: 去除大型微囊泡：10,000×g 离心 30 min，4°C。沉淀 = 大 MV（200–1,000 nm，需要时可单独收集）。保留上清

detailedSteps.en: Filter supernatant through 0.22 µm PES membrane (low protein binding) to remove residual large particles
detailedSteps.zh: 将上清过 0.22 µm PES 膜（低蛋白结合）去除残余大颗粒

detailedSteps.en: **Exosome Pelleting**
detailedSteps.zh: **外泌体沉淀**

detailedSteps.en: Ultracentrifuge at 100,000×g, 70–90 min, 4°C (Ti-45 or SW-41 Ti rotor). Discard supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: 100,000×g 超速离心 70–90 min，4°C（Ti-45 或 SW-41 Ti 转头）。弃上清

detailedSteps.en: Wash pellet: resuspend in 10 mL cold PBS, ultracentrifuge again at 100,000×g, 70 min, 4°C. Repeat once for higher purity
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤沉淀：用 10 mL 冷 PBS 重悬，再次 100,000×g 离心 70 min，4°C。重复一次以提高纯度

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend final exosome pellet in 50–200 µL PBS (pipette gently, do not vortex). Store at −80°C in single-use aliquots
detailedSteps.zh: 用 50–200 µL PBS 轻柔重悬最终外泌体沉淀（勿涡旋）。−80°C 单次分装保存

detailedSteps.en: **Characterization (per MISEV2018)**
detailedSteps.zh: **表征（按 MISEV2018 指南）**

detailedSteps.en: NTA (NanoSight/ZetaView): confirm size 50–200 nm, report concentration/mL. TEM: verify cup-shaped morphology. Western blot: positive markers CD63/CD9/CD81/Alix; negative markers GM130 (Golgi), Cytochrome C (mito)
detailedSteps.zh: NTA（NanoSight/ZetaView）：确认尺寸 50–200 nm，报告浓度/mL。TEM：验证杯形形态。Western blot：阳性标记 CD63/CD9/CD81/Alix；阴性标记 GM130（Golgi）、细胞色素 c（线粒体）

name: FBS Heat Inactivation & Aliquoting SOP
nameCn: FBS 热灭活与分装标准操作规程

components.name: Day 1 PM: Thaw FBS bottles (up to 4 × 500 mL) overnight at room temperature. Turn on 56°C water bath. Verify temperature with thermometer reads ~56°C.
Day 2 AM: Gently rotate thawed FBS (avoid excessive bubbles). Place bottles in 56°C water bath.

note.en: Confirm thermometer inside bath reads ~56°C before starting.
note.zh: 开始前确认浴槽内温度计显示 ~56°C。

components.name: Set timer. Heat-inactivate for EXACTLY 30 minutes. Do NOT exceed 30 min.

note.en: CRITICAL: Exceeding 30 min degrades growth factors.
note.zh: 关键：超过 30 分钟会降解生长因子。

components.name: Remove bottles. Turn off water bath.
Wipe bottles dry, spray with 70% ethanol, bring into biosafety cabinet.
Layout 25 × 50 mL tubes. Label caps 'FBS'. Aliquot ~40 mL per tube (2 bottles = ~25 tubes).

note.en: Aseptic technique is critical — change serological pipette at any sign of contamination.
note.zh: 无菌操作至关重要——如怀疑污染立即更换移液管。

components.name: Label storage with date and tube count.

notes.en: Heat inactivation at 56°C for 30 min destroys complement proteins while preserving growth factors. Do NOT heat-inactivate for longer — it reduces serum quality. Typical FBS: Characterized, Canadian origin (e.g. Cytiva SH30396.03). Each 500 mL bottle yields ~12 aliquots at 40 mL each.
notes.zh: 56°C 30 分钟热灭活破坏补体蛋白同时保留生长因子。不可加热过久——降低血清质量。每瓶 500 mL 约分装 12 管（每管 40 mL）。

ref: van der Valk J et al. (2010) Biotechnol Adv 28:693–701; Freshney RI (2016) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th Ed., Wiley

usage.en: Standard operating procedure for heat-inactivating and aliquoting fetal bovine serum for cell culture use.
usage.zh: 胎牛血清热灭活及分装标准操作规程。

label.en: Protocol — 2 days (overnight thaw + processing), hands-on: 2 hours
label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days (overnight thaw + processing)，实操: 2 hours

note.en: RT thawing (up to Overnight)
note.zh: RT thawing (最长 Overnight)

note.en: -30°C or -20°C (up to 12 months)
note.zh: -30°C or -20°C (最长 12 months)

briefSteps.en: Thaw FBS overnight RT → 56°C water bath exactly 30 min → cool → aseptic aliquot ~40 mL/tube in BSC → −20/−30°C freezer
briefSteps.zh: 室温过夜解冻 FBS → 56°C 水浴恰好 30 min → 冷却 → 生物安全柜无菌分装 ~40 mL/管 → −20/−30°C 冻存

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 PM — Thaw & Prepare**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天下午 — 解冻与准备**

detailedSteps.en: Place FBS bottles (up to 4 × 500 mL) at room temperature to thaw overnight. Turn on 56°C water bath and verify temperature with thermometer
detailedSteps.zh: 将 FBS（最多 4 × 500 mL）置于室温过夜解冻。打开 56°C 水浴锅，温度计确认温度

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 AM — Heat Inactivation**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天上午 — 热灭活**

detailedSteps.en: Gently rotate thawed FBS bottles to mix (avoid excessive bubbles). Confirm water bath thermometer reads ~56°C
detailedSteps.zh: 轻柔旋转已解冻的 FBS 瓶混匀（避免过多气泡）。确认水浴温度计显示 ~56°C

detailedSteps.en: Place FBS bottles in 56°C water bath. Start timer. Heat-inactivate for EXACTLY 30 min. DO NOT exceed 30 min — this degrades growth factors
detailedSteps.zh: 将 FBS 瓶放入 56°C 水浴。开始计时。热灭活恰好 30 分钟。不可超过 30 分钟 — 会降解生长因子

detailedSteps.en: Remove bottles immediately at 30 min. Turn off water bath
detailedSteps.zh: 30 分钟到后立即取出。关闭水浴锅

detailedSteps.en: **Aliquoting**
Wipe bottles dry, spray with 70% ethanol. Bring into biosafety cabinet. Arrange 25 × 50 mL conical tubes and label caps 'FBS'
detailedSteps.zh: 擦干瓶身，喷 70% 乙醇。转入生物安全柜。排列 25 × 50 mL 锥形管，标记管盖 'FBS'

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot ~40 mL per tube using sterile 50 mL serological pipette (2 bottles ≈ 25 tubes). Change pipette at any sign of contamination
detailedSteps.zh: 用无菌 50 mL 移液管分装，每管 ~40 mL（2 瓶 ≈ 25 管）。如有污染嫌疑立即更换移液管

detailedSteps.en: Tighten caps securely. Transfer to −20°C or −30°C freezer. Label storage box with date and tube count
detailedSteps.zh: 拧紧管盖。转入 −20°C 或 −30°C 冰箱。在存储盒上标注日期和管数

name: Flow Cytometry Surface Staining
nameCn: 流式细胞术表面染色流程

components.name: 3. Fc Block (人: Human TruStain; 鼠: anti-CD16/32)

note.en: Add according to titration result
note.zh: 按滴度滴定结果加

notes.en: For intracellular staining: fix with 4% PFA 20 min, then permeabilize with 0.1% saponin. Titrate each antibody individually. Compensation controls required.
notes.zh: 胞内染色需先固定 (4% PFA 20 min) 再透化 (0.1% saponin)。每个抗体需单独滴度实验。compensation controls 必需。FMO controls 用于 gating。

ref: Cossarizza et al. (2019) Eur J Immunol 49:1457–1973; Perfetto et al. (2004) Nat Rev Immunol 4:648–655

usage.en: Analyze cell surface or intracellular markers by multi-color flow cytometry.
usage.zh: 多色流式细胞术分析细胞表面或胞内标志物。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: For intracellular staining fixation
note.zh: 用于胞内染色的固定

note.en: Human TruStain FcX / mouse anti-CD16/32
note.zh: Human TruStain FcX / 小鼠 anti-CD16/32

note.en: Titrate each Ab individually first!
note.zh: 每个抗体需先单独做滴度实验！

note.en: DAPI, PI, or fixable Live/Dead
note.zh: DAPI、PI 或可固定 Live/Dead 染料

note.en: After the final wash, cells can be fixed with 1–4% PFA for 20 min at RT, then stored at 4°C in the dark for up to 24 hours before acquisition. Note: fixation precludes use of viability dyes sensitive to fixation.
note.zh: 末次洗涤后，可用 1–4% PFA 室温固定 20 min，4°C 避光保存最多 24 h 后再上机检测。注意：固定后不可使用对固定剂敏感的活死染料。

briefSteps.en: Harvest ≥1×10⁵ cells → wash with PBS → Fc block → incubate with fluorochrome-conjugated antibody cocktail at 4°C → wash twice → add viability dye → resuspend in FACS buffer → acquire ≥10,000 events on flow cytometer.
briefSteps.zh: 收集 ≥1×10⁵ 细胞 → PBS 洗涤 → Fc 封闭 → 4°C 孵育荧光抗体混合物 → 洗涤两次 → 加活死染料 → 重悬于 FACS 缓冲液 → 流式细胞仪采集 ≥10,000 events。

detailedSteps.en: Cell Preparation
detailedSteps.zh: 细胞制备

detailedSteps.en: Harvest ≥1×10⁵ cells per sample (1×10⁶ recommended for rare populations). For adherent cells, detach with 2 mM EDTA in PBS or Accutase to preserve surface antigens; avoid trypsin for sensitive markers.
detailedSteps.zh: 每个样品收集 ≥1×10⁵ 细胞（稀有群体建议 1×10⁶）。贴壁细胞用 PBS 中 2 mM EDTA 或 Accutase 脱落以保护表面抗原；敏感标志物避免使用胰蛋白酶。

detailedSteps.en: Wash cells once with cold PBS (300×g, 5 min, 4°C). Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 100 µL FACS buffer (PBS + 1–2% FBS + 2 mM EDTA) per sample.
detailedSteps.zh: 用冷 PBS 洗涤细胞一次（300×g，5 min，4°C）。弃上清，每个样品用 100 µL FACS 缓冲液（PBS + 1–2% FBS + 2 mM EDTA）重悬沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Staining
detailedSteps.zh: 染色

detailedSteps.en: Add Fc blocking reagent (2 µL human TruStain FcX or 1 µg anti-mouse CD16/32 per 10⁶ cells) and incubate at 4°C for 10 min to prevent non-specific antibody binding via Fc receptors.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 Fc 封闭试剂（每 10⁶ 细胞加 2 µL 人 TruStain FcX 或 1 µg 抗小鼠 CD16/32），4°C 孵育 10 min，防止抗体通过 Fc 受体非特异性结合。

detailedSteps.en: Without washing, add pre-titrated fluorochrome-conjugated antibody cocktail (prepared in FACS buffer) directly to cells. Mix gently by pipetting.
detailedSteps.zh: 不洗涤，直接向细胞中加入预先滴定好的荧光素标记抗体混合物（用 FACS 缓冲液稀释）。轻柔吹打混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 4°C in the dark for 20–30 min. Protect from light throughout all subsequent steps.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 避光孵育 20–30 min。后续所有步骤均需避光。

detailedSteps.en: Wash cells twice with 2 mL FACS buffer per wash (300×g, 5 min, 4°C) to remove unbound antibodies.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 FACS 缓冲液洗涤细胞两次，每次 2 mL（300×g，5 min，4°C），去除未结合的抗体。

detailedSteps.en: Acquisition
detailedSteps.zh: 上机检测

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend cells in 200–500 µL FACS buffer. If using a viability dye (DAPI 1 µg/mL, PI 2 µg/mL, or LIVE/DEAD fixable dye), add per manufacturer instructions and incubate 10–15 min on ice before acquisition.
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞重悬于 200–500 µL FACS 缓冲液。如使用活死染料（DAPI 1 µg/mL、PI 2 µg/mL 或 LIVE/DEAD 固定活死染料），按说明书加入，冰上孵育 10–15 min 后上机。
