detailedSteps.en: Filter cells through a 35 µm cell strainer cap into a 5 mL FACS tube to remove aggregates. Run single-color compensation controls (compensation beads or single-stained cells) and FMO controls for gating.
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞通过 35 µm 滤网过滤至 5 mL FACS 管中以去除聚集体。运行单色补偿对照（补偿磁珠或单染细胞）和 FMO 对照用于设门。

detailedSteps.en: Acquire at least 10,000 events (50,000+ for rare populations) on the flow cytometer. Use FSC/SSC to gate live singlets, then apply sequential gating strategy. Export FCS files for analysis with FlowJo or Cytobank.
detailedSteps.zh: 在流式细胞仪上至少采集 10,000 events（稀有群体需 50,000+ events）。用 FSC/SSC 设门活细胞单细胞，再依次设门分析。导出 FCS 文件，用 FlowJo 或 Cytobank 分析。

name: Gel Extraction (DNA Recovery)

components.name: 1. 琼脂糖凝胶电泳分离 DNA 片段
2. UV/蓝光灯下切取目的条带

note.en: Use low power and brief exposure to minimize UV damage; blue light is safer
note.zh: 低功率短时间暴露, 减少 UV 损伤; 蓝光更安全

components.name: 3. 称重胶块 → 加 3 vol Buffer QG

note.en: 100 mg ≈ 100 µL; add 300 µL lysis buffer
note.zh: 100 mg ≈ 100 µL; 加 300 µL buffer

components.name: 4. 50°C 孵育 10 min, 每 2–3 min 涡旋

note.en: Dissolve completely; solution should be yellow (pH ≤7.5)
note.zh: 完全溶解, 颜色应为黄色 (pH ≤7.5)

components.name: 5. 加 1 gel vol 异丙醇 (>4 kb 片段可选)
6. 转移至柱, 离心 1 min
7. 洗涤 Buffer PE 750 µL, 离心 1 min
8. 空转离心 1 min 去残留乙醇
9. 洗脱: 30 µL EB 或 H₂O, 静置 1 min → 离心

note.en: Pre-warming to 50°C improves recovery of large fragments
note.zh: 预热至 50°C 可提高大片段回收率

notes.en: Typical recovery 70-80%. Small fragments (<100 bp) recover poorly — use AMPure XP beads instead. Low-melting-point (LMP) agarose melts at 37°C, reducing DNA damage. TAE gels give better recovery than TBE. Do not use >2% agarose for large fragment recovery.
notes.zh: 回收率通常 70–80%。小片段 (<100 bp) 回收率低，建议用 Agencourt AMPure XP 磁珠代替。低熔点琼脂糖 (LMP agarose) 可直接在 37°C 溶解，减少 DNA 损伤。TAE 胶回收率优于 TBE。勿使用 >2% 琼脂糖凝胶做大片段回收。

ref: QIAGEN QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit Handbook; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: Purify specific DNA fragments from agarose gels by gel extraction.
usage.zh: 从琼脂糖胶中切胶回收纯化特定 DNA 片段。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 30 minutes，实操: 30 minutes

note.en: 1–2%, in TAE or TBE buffer
note.zh: 1–2%，TAE或TBE缓冲液

note.en: e.g. QIAquick, Monarch, Zymo
note.zh: 如 QIAquick、Monarch、Zymo

note.en: Solubilization/binding buffer (kit component)
note.zh: 溶胶/结合缓冲液（试剂盒组分）

note.en: Wash buffer with ethanol (kit component)
note.zh: 含乙醇洗涤缓冲液（试剂盒组分）

note.en: 10 mM Tris-Cl, pH 8.5 (elution)
note.zh: 10 mM Tris-Cl, pH 8.5（洗脱）

note.en: Molecular biology grade
note.zh: 分子生物学级

note.en: Clean, for excising bands
note.zh: 干净，用于切胶

note.en: Excised gel slices can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month before processing.
note.zh: 切取的凝胶片可在 −20°C 保存最多 1 个月再进行处理。

note.en: Purified DNA can be stored at −20°C for up to 6 months.
note.zh: 纯化后的 DNA 可在 −20°C 保存最多 6 个月。

briefSteps.en: Run agarose gel (TAE, 1%), excise target band under UV/blue light, weigh gel slice, dissolve in 3 vol Buffer QG at 50°C, bind to spin column, wash with Buffer PE, dry spin, then elute with 30 µL warm water or EB buffer.
briefSteps.zh: 跑 1% TAE 琼脂糖凝胶，UV/蓝光灯下切取目的条带，称重胶块，加 3 倍体积 Buffer QG 于 50°C 溶解，上柱结合，Buffer PE 洗涤，空转干燥，最后用 30 µL 温水或 EB 缓冲液洗脱。

detailedSteps.en: Run samples on a 1% TAE agarose gel (TAE preferred over TBE for gel extraction — higher recovery). Use enough wells to separate fragments cleanly. Run at 5–8 V/cm.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 1% TAE 琼脂糖凝胶上电泳（胶回收优先使用 TAE 而非 TBE，回收率更高）。上样孔需足够分离片段。以 5–8 V/cm 电泳。

detailedSteps.en: Place gel on UV transilluminator (or blue-light box). Using a clean scalpel or razor blade, rapidly excise the target band with minimal exposure to UV (UV damages DNA — keep exposure under 30 seconds). For cloning purposes, blue-light transilluminators are preferred.
detailedSteps.zh: 将凝胶放置于紫外灯（或蓝光灯）上。用干净的手术刀或刀片迅速切取目的条带，尽量减少紫外暴露时间（紫外会损伤 DNA——暴露控制在 30 秒以内）。克隆用途优先使用蓝光灯。

detailedSteps.en: Weigh the gel slice in a pre-weighed 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. Add 3 volumes of Buffer QG per 100 mg gel (e.g., 300 µL QG for 100 mg gel). For fragments >4 kb, also add 1 gel volume of isopropanol to improve recovery.
detailedSteps.zh: 在预先称重的 1.5 mL 离心管中称量胶块。每 100 mg 凝胶加入 3 倍体积 Buffer QG（如 100 mg 凝胶加 300 µL QG）。对于 >4 kb 的片段，另加 1 倍体积异丙醇以提高回收率。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 50°C for 10 min with vortexing every 2–3 min until gel is completely dissolved. The solution should appear yellow (pH ≤7.5). If orange/purple, add 10 µL 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.0) to lower pH.
detailedSteps.zh: 50°C 孵育 10 min，每 2–3 min 涡旋一次，至凝胶完全溶解。溶液应呈黄色（pH ≤7.5）。若呈橙色或紫色，加入 10 µL 3 M 醋酸钠（pH 5.0）降低 pH。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer dissolved gel solution to a QIAquick (or equivalent) spin column in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge at 13,000×g for 1 min. Discard flow-through.
detailedSteps.zh: 将溶解后的凝胶溶液转移至放置在 2 mL 收集管中的 QIAquick（或同类）离心柱上，13,000×g 离心 1 min，弃流穿液。

detailedSteps.en: Add 750 µL Buffer PE (ethanol-containing wash buffer) to the column. Let stand 2–5 min, then centrifuge at 13,000×g for 1 min. Discard flow-through.
detailedSteps.zh: 向离心柱加入 750 µL Buffer PE（含乙醇洗涤缓冲液）。静置 2–5 min 后，13,000×g 离心 1 min，弃流穿液。

detailedSteps.en: Perform a dry spin: centrifuge column at 13,000×g for 1 min to remove residual ethanol. Residual ethanol will inhibit downstream enzymatic reactions.
detailedSteps.zh: 空转离心：将离心柱以 13,000×g 离心 1 min，去除残留乙醇。残留乙醇会抑制下游酶反应。

detailedSteps.en: Place column in a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. Add 30 µL elution buffer (EB) or nuclease-free water (pre-warmed to 50°C improves recovery of large fragments). Let stand for 1 min, then centrifuge at 13,000×g for 1 min to elute DNA.
detailedSteps.zh: 将离心柱置于干净的 1.5 mL 离心管中。加入 30 µL 洗脱缓冲液（EB）或无核酸酶水（预热至 50°C 可提高大片段回收率）。静置 1 min 后，13,000×g 离心 1 min 洗脱 DNA。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify recovered DNA by NanoDrop or Qubit. Typical recovery is 70–80%. Use immediately for downstream applications (ligation, sequencing) or store at −20°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 NanoDrop 或 Qubit 定量回收的 DNA。回收率通常为 70–80%。立即用于下游实验（连接、测序），或存于 −20°C 备用。

name: Genomic DNA Extraction (Cells/Tissue)
nameCn: 基因组 DNA 提取（细胞/组织）

components.name: 1. 裂解：加 Lysis Buffer + Proteinase K

note.en: Incubate at 56°C for 1–3 h or overnight; mince tissue first
note.zh: 56°C 孵育 1–3 h 或过夜; 组织需剪碎

components.name: 2. RNase A 处理 (可选, 37°C 30 min)
3. 蛋白沉淀 (加 Protein Precipitation Sol)

note.en: Vortex 20 s → ice 5 min → centrifuge 16,000×g 3 min
note.zh: 涡旋 20 s → 冰上 5 min → 离心 16,000×g 3 min

note.en: Add equal volume isopropanol to supernatant, gently invert
note.zh: 加等体积异丙醇到上清, 轻柔翻转

components.name: 7. 风干 5–15 min → 溶解于 TE

note.en: Incubate at RT or 65°C to aid dissolution; do not vortex to avoid shearing
note.zh: 室温或 65°C 孵育助溶解; 勿涡旋以避免剪切

notes.en: Phenol-chloroform method: replace step 3 with equal volume phenol:chloroform:IAA (25:24:1) extraction → chloroform:IAA extraction → ethanol precipitation. Use wide-bore tips for high-MW gDNA to avoid shearing. Blood samples: lyse RBCs first. FFPE tissue: deparaffinize first. Column extraction (DNeasy) is faster but yields lower MW DNA.
notes.zh: 酚氯仿提取法：步骤 3 换为等体积 phenol:chloroform:IAA (25:24:1) 提取 → 再用 chloroform:IAA 提取 → 乙醇沉淀。高分子量 gDNA 用宽口枪头操作，避免剪切。血液样品需先裂解红细胞。FFPE 组织需去石蜡。柱提取法 (DNeasy) 更快但产量和分子量较低。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; QIAGEN DNeasy Blood & Tissue Handbook

usage.en: Extract high-molecular-weight genomic DNA from cells or tissues.
usage.zh: 从细胞或组织中提取高分子量基因组 DNA。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Molecular biology grade
note.zh: 分子生物学级

note.en: DNase-free
note.zh: 无DNase

note.en: Kit component or saturated NaCl
note.zh: 试剂盒组分或饱和NaCl

note.en: Molecular biology grade
note.zh: 分子生物学级

note.en: Ice-cold
note.zh: 冰冷

note.en: Lysate with Proteinase K can be incubated overnight at 56°C or stored at 4°C for up to 24 h.
note.zh: Proteinase K 裂解液可 56°C 过夜孵育，或 4°C 保存最多 24 h。

note.en: DNA pellet in 70% ethanol can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month before continuing.
note.zh: 70% 乙醇中的 DNA 沉淀可 −20°C 保存最多 1 个月，再继续后续步骤。

note.en: Dissolved gDNA can be stored at 4°C (short-term, up to 1 week) or −20°C (long-term, years) in TE buffer.
note.zh: 溶于 TE 缓冲液的 gDNA 可 4°C 短期保存（1 周内），或 −20°C 长期保存（数年）。

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells/tissue with lysis buffer + Proteinase K (56°C, 1–3 h or overnight) → optional RNase A treatment → precipitate proteins → collect supernatant → isopropanol precipitation of DNA → centrifuge → 70% ethanol wash (×2) → air-dry pellet → dissolve in TE buffer → quantify (A260/280 ≈ 1.8)
briefSteps.zh: 裂解缓冲液 + Proteinase K 裂解样品（56°C，1–3 h 或过夜）→ 可选 RNase A 处理 → 蛋白沉淀 → 取上清 → 异丙醇沉淀 DNA → 离心 → 70% 乙醇洗涤 2 次 → 风干沉淀 → 溶解于 TE 缓冲液 → 定量（A260/280 ≈ 1.8）

detailedSteps.en: Place sample (1–5 × 10⁶ cells, 25 mg tissue, or one tail clip) into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. For tissue, mince with scissors into pieces <1 mm. Add 500 µL lysis buffer (100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, 5 mM EDTA, 0.2% SDS, 200 mM NaCl) and 10 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL, final ~400 µg/mL).
detailedSteps.zh: 将样品（1–5 × 10⁶ 细胞、25 mg 组织或一段鼠尾）放入 1.5 mL 离心管。组织需用剪刀剪至 <1 mm 碎片。加入 500 µL 裂解缓冲液（100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5、5 mM EDTA、0.2% SDS、200 mM NaCl）和 10 µL Proteinase K（20 mg/mL，终浓度约 400 µg/mL）。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 56°C with shaking (300–400 rpm) for 1–3 h, or overnight for tough tissue/tail clips, until the sample is completely lysed (solution turns clear).
detailedSteps.zh: 56°C 振荡孵育（300–400 rpm）1–3 h，坚硬组织或鼠尾可孵育过夜，直至样品完全裂解（溶液变澄清）。

detailedSteps.en: Optional: add 5 µL RNase A (10 mg/mL, final 100 µg/mL); incubate 37°C for 30 min. This removes contaminating RNA and improves A260/280 ratio.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选：加入 5 µL RNase A（10 mg/mL，终浓度 100 µg/mL），37°C 孵育 30 min，去除 RNA 污染，改善 A260/280 比值。

detailedSteps.en: Precipitate proteins: add 150 µL Protein Precipitation Solution (7.5 M ammonium acetate) or 200 µL saturated NaCl. Vortex vigorously for 20 s. Incubate on ice 5 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 蛋白沉淀：加入 150 µL 蛋白沉淀液（7.5 M 醋酸铵）或 200 µL 饱和 NaCl，强力涡旋 20 s，冰上放置 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 16,000×g for 3 min at RT; carefully transfer supernatant (containing DNA) to a new tube. Avoid disturbing the protein pellet.
detailedSteps.zh: 16,000×g 室温离心 3 min，小心将含 DNA 的上清转移至新管，勿扰动蛋白沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Add equal volume (500 µL) of room-temperature 100% isopropanol to the supernatant; gently invert 10–15 times until white DNA strands are visible (high-MW DNA). Do NOT vortex.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入等体积（500 µL）室温 100% 异丙醇，轻柔翻转 10–15 次，可见白色 DNA 丝状沉淀（高分子量 DNA）。勿涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 16,000×g for 5 min at RT; carefully pour off supernatant. DNA pellet may be white or invisible.
detailedSteps.zh: 16,000×g 室温离心 5 min，倾出上清。DNA 沉淀可能为白色或不可见。

detailedSteps.en: Wash pellet 2× with 500 µL 70% ethanol (room temperature): add ethanol, gently invert 5 times, centrifuge 16,000×g for 2 min, discard ethanol. This removes salt contamination.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 500 µL 70% 乙醇（室温）洗涤沉淀 2 次：加乙醇 → 轻翻 5 次 → 16,000×g 离心 2 min → 倒去乙醇。去除盐污染。

detailedSteps.en: Air-dry pellet for 5–15 min at RT (or 37°C) until all ethanol has evaporated. Do NOT over-dry — this makes DNA difficult to dissolve. No visible ethanol should remain.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温（或 37°C）风干沉淀 5–15 min，待乙醇完全挥发。切勿过度干燥，否则 DNA 难以溶解。

detailedSteps.en: Dissolve DNA pellet in 50–200 µL TE buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA). Incubate at 65°C for 10–30 min with occasional gentle mixing to aid dissolution. Use wide-bore pipette tips to avoid shearing.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 DNA 沉淀溶解于 50–200 µL TE 缓冲液（10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0、1 mM EDTA）。65°C 孵育 10–30 min 并轻柔混匀助溶。使用宽口枪头避免剪切。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify DNA by NanoDrop (A260/280 ≈ 1.8 for pure DNA; A260/230 >2.0) or Qubit fluorometer. Check integrity by running 100 ng on a 0.8% agarose gel — high-quality gDNA should appear as a single sharp band above 10 kb.
detailedSteps.zh: NanoDrop 定量（纯 DNA：A260/280 ≈ 1.8，A260/230 >2.0）或 Qubit 荧光定量。0.8% 琼脂糖凝胶（100 ng）验证完整性——高质量 gDNA 应呈单一清晰条带，位于 10 kb 以上。

name: Gibson Assembly

components.name: 1. 设计引物 (15-25 bp 重叠区)
3. 冰上配制反应: Master Mix + DNA 片段

notes.en: Seamless, scarless DNA assembly. Joins 2-6 fragments with 15-25 bp overlaps in a single isothermal reaction. No restriction enzymes or ligase needed separately — T5 exonuclease, Phusion polymerase, and Taq ligase work together in one tube.
notes.zh: 无缝无疤 DNA 组装。通过 15-25 bp 重叠区在单一等温反应中连接 2-6 个片段。无需单独使用限制酶或连接酶——T5 外切酶、Phusion 聚合酶和 Taq 连接酶在同一管中协同工作。

ref: Gibson et al. (2009) Nat Methods 6:343–345; NEB Protocol E5510 (protocols.io doi:10.17504/protocols.io.bdddi226)

usage.en: Assemble multiple DNA fragments seamlessly using Gibson isothermal assembly.
usage.zh: Gibson 等温组装法无缝连接多个 DNA 片段。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 hour，实操: 20 minutes

note.en: NEB E5510 or homemade
note.zh: NEB E5510 或自配

note.en: 2-3 fold molar excess
note.zh: 2-3 倍摩尔过量

note.en: −20°C (up to 1 week)
note.zh: −20°C (最长 1 week)

note.en: 4°C (plates) (up to 1 week)
note.zh: 4°C (plates) (最长 1 week)

briefSteps.en: Design primers with 15–30 bp overlapping homology arms, PCR-amplify and gel-purify all fragments, mix fragments with Gibson Assembly Master Mix on ice (2:1 to 5:1 insert:vector molar ratio), incubate at 50°C for 15–60 min, chill on ice, then transform 2 µL into competent cells.
briefSteps.zh: 设计含 15–30 bp 重叠同源臂的引物，PCR 扩增并凝胶纯化所有片段，冰上将片段与 Gibson Assembly Master Mix 混合（insert:vector 摩尔比 2:1 至 5:1），50°C 孵育 15–60 min，冰上冷却，取 2 µL 转化感受态细胞。

detailedSteps.en: Design primers for all fragments using NEBuilder (nebuilder.neb.com) or manually. Each junction requires 15–30 bp overlapping homology (20–25 bp recommended). The overlap Tm should be ≥48°C. For 2-fragment assemblies, 15 bp overlaps are sufficient; for ≥4 fragments, use 25–30 bp overlaps.
detailedSteps.zh: 使用 NEBuilder（nebuilder.neb.com）或手动设计所有片段引物。每个连接处需要 15–30 bp 重叠同源区（推荐 20–25 bp）。重叠区 Tm 应 ≥48°C。2 片段组装 15 bp 重叠即可；≥4 片段建议使用 25–30 bp 重叠。

detailedSteps.en: PCR-amplify each fragment using a high-fidelity polymerase (Q5 or Phusion). Purify PCR products by column purification or gel extraction. Quantify each fragment by NanoDrop.
detailedSteps.zh: 使用高保真聚合酶（Q5 或 Phusion）PCR 扩增每个片段。通过柱纯化或凝胶回收纯化 PCR 产物。NanoDrop 定量每个片段。

detailedSteps.en: Linearize the vector backbone by restriction digest or PCR (inverse PCR). Purify and quantify. Ensure the vector has compatible ends with the first and last insert fragments.
detailedSteps.zh: 通过限制酶酶切或 PCR（反向 PCR）线性化载体骨架。纯化并定量。确保载体末端与第一个和最后一个插入片段兼容。

detailedSteps.en: Calculate DNA amounts: use a 2:1 to 5:1 molar ratio of insert to vector. Recommended: 50–200 ng total DNA per 20 µL reaction, with vector at 50–100 ng. For a 2-fragment assembly: use 0.03–0.2 pmol of each fragment.
detailedSteps.zh: 计算 DNA 用量：insert 与 vector 摩尔比为 2:1 至 5:1。推荐每 20 µL 反应总 DNA 50–200 ng，载体 50–100 ng。对于 2 片段组装：每种片段用量为 0.03–0.2 pmol。

detailedSteps.en: Set up Gibson Assembly reaction on ice: mix 10 µL 2× Gibson Assembly Master Mix (contains T5 exonuclease, Phusion polymerase, Taq ligase), the appropriate volume of each DNA fragment, and nuclease-free water to 20 µL total. Mix gently.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上配制 Gibson 组装反应：混合 10 µL 2× Gibson Assembly Master Mix（含 T5 外切酶、Phusion 聚合酶、Taq 连接酶）、各 DNA 片段适量及无核酸酶水至总体积 20 µL。轻柔混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate reaction at 50°C for 15 min (2 fragments) to 60 min (3–6 fragments) in a thermocycler. For assemblies with >4 fragments or fragments >6 kb, extend incubation to 60 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 在热循环仪中 50°C 孵育：2 片段孵育 15 min，3–6 片段孵育 60 min。超过 4 个片段或片段 >6 kb 时延长孵育至 60 min。

detailedSteps.en: Place reaction on ice immediately after incubation. Transform 2 µL of the assembly reaction into 25–50 µL chemically competent E. coli. Heat-shock at 42°C for 30 s. Recover in 950 µL SOC at 37°C for 1 hour with shaking.
detailedSteps.zh: 孵育结束后立即置于冰上。取 2 µL 组装产物转化 25–50 µL 化学感受态大肠杆菌。42°C 热激 30 s。在 950 µL SOC 中 37°C 振荡恢复 1 小时。

detailedSteps.en: Plate 100 µL onto LB agar + antibiotic plates. Incubate at 37°C overnight (16–18 hours). Screen colonies by colony PCR using primers flanking the junction sites.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 100 µL 涂布于含抗生素 LB 平板。37°C 过夜培育（16–18 小时）。用跨越连接位点的引物进行菌落 PCR 筛选。

detailedSteps.en: Perform miniprep on positive colonies. Verify correct assembly by Sanger sequencing across all junction regions and throughout the entire insert.
detailedSteps.zh: 对阳性菌落进行质粒小提。通过 Sanger 测序验证所有连接区域及整个插入片段的正确组装。

name: GST-Tag Protein Purification (Glutathione Sepharose)
nameCn: GST 标签蛋白纯化（谷胱甘肽琼脂糖亲和层析）

components.name: 1. Express GST-fusion protein in E. coli BL21(DE3)

note.en: IPTG 0.1–0.5 mM; 18°C overnight for soluble expression (preferred over 37°C 4 h). Harvest: 5,000×g 10 min 4°C.
note.zh: IPTG 0.1–0.5 mM；18°C 过夜低温诱导（优于 37°C 4 h 高温诱导）。5,000×g 10 min 4°C 收菌。

components.name: 2. Resuspend pellet in GST Lysis Buffer

note.en: PBS pH 7.4 + 1% Triton X-100 + 1 mM DTT + protease inhibitors + 1 mM PMSF; 5 mL/g wet weight
note.zh: PBS pH 7.4 + 1% Triton X-100 + 1 mM DTT + 蛋白酶抑制剂 + 1 mM PMSF；每克湿重加 5 mL

components.name: 3. Lyse: sonicate on ice (5 × 30 s, 40% amplitude, 1 min rest)

note.en: Keep sample below 10°C throughout. Pre-cool probe.
note.zh: 全程保持样品 <10°C。预冷超声探头。

note.en: Keep supernatant. Optional: 0.45 µm filter to protect column.
note.zh: 保留上清。可选：0.45 µm 过滤保护柱子。

components.name: 5. Equilibrate Glutathione Sepharose 4B: 10 CV PBS pH 7.4

note.en: Use 1 mL resin per 10 mg expected fusion protein. Or use GSTrap FF 5 mL column (AKTA).
note.zh: 每 10 mg 预估融合蛋白用 1 mL 树脂。或使用 GSTrap FF 5 mL 柱（AKTA）。

components.name: 6. Bind: load cleared lysate, flow rate ≤1 mL/min, 4°C

note.en: Gravity or peristaltic pump. Collect flow-through for SDS-PAGE.
note.zh: 重力法或蠕动泵上样。收集穿透液做 SDS-PAGE 检测。

components.name: 7. Wash: 10–20 CV PBS pH 7.4 until A280 baseline

note.en: Optional high-salt wash: PBS + 500 mM NaCl, 5 CV.
note.zh: 可选高盐洗涤：PBS + 500 mM NaCl，5 CV。

components.name: 8. Elute: 5–10 CV gst_elution_reduced (10 mM GSH, 50 mM Tris pH 8.0)

note.en: Collect 0.5 mL fractions; protein peak in fractions 2–6.
note.zh: 收集 0.5 mL 组分；蛋白峰通常在第 2–6 组分。

note.en: dialysis_buffer_generic; 3× changes at 4°C. Or desalt by HiTrap Desalting.
note.zh: dialysis_buffer_generic 透析换液；4°C 换 3 次。或 HiTrap Desalting 脱盐柱。

components.name: 10. Optional: cleave GST-tag (thrombin or PreScission protease)

note.en: Thrombin: 1 U/100 µg, RT 2 h or 4°C overnight. PreScission: 1 U/µg, 4°C overnight. Reverse purification: pass through GSTrap → cleaved protein flows through.
note.zh: 凝血酶：1 U/100 µg，RT 2 h 或 4°C 过夜。PreScission：1 U/µg，4°C 过夜。反向纯化：过 GSTrap 柱 → 切割后蛋白在穿透液中。

note.en: Typical yield: 2–20 mg/L culture.
note.zh: 典型产量：2–20 mg/L 培养液。

notes.en: GST (26 kDa) may affect folding — consider PreScission cleavage. GST often dimerizes. Lower IPTG (0.1 mM) + 18°C dramatically improves solubility. Avoid detergents >0.1% in binding buffer (strips GST from beads).
notes.zh: GST 标签（26 kDa）可能影响蛋白折叠，建议 PreScission 蛋白酶切除。GST 易二聚化。低 IPTG（0.1 mM）+ 低温（18°C）显著提高可溶性。结合缓冲液洗涤剂 ≤0.1%。

ref: Harper & Speicher (2011) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 6.6.1–26; GE Healthcare Glutathione Sepharose Handbook; Smith & Johnson (1988) Gene 67:31–40

usage.en: Purify GST-tagged recombinant proteins using glutathione affinity chromatography.
usage.zh: 谷胱甘肽亲和层析纯化 GST 标签重组蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 days，实操: 6 hours

note.en: 10 mM in elution buffer, make fresh
note.zh: 洗脱缓冲液中10 mM，新鲜配制

note.en: Sigma T8787
note.zh: Sigma T8787

note.en: Store at -20°C in aliquots
note.zh: 分装-20°C保存

note.en: Roche cOmplete EDTA-free
note.zh: Roche cOmplete 无EDTA

note.en: For tag cleavage (optional)
note.zh: 用于标签切除（可选）

note.en: Bio-Safe or InstantBlue
note.zh: Bio-Safe或InstantBlue

note.en: Clarified lysate can be stored at 4°C overnight before affinity purification.
note.zh: 澄清裂解液可在 4°C 保存过夜后再进行亲和纯化。

note.en: Eluted protein in glutathione buffer can be held at 4°C overnight before dialysis or tag cleavage.
note.zh: 含谷胱甘肽的洗脱蛋白可在 4°C 保存过夜，次日再透析或切除标签。

note.en: Dialyzed purified protein can be aliquoted and stored at −80°C with 10% glycerol for up to 12 months.
note.zh: 透析后的纯化蛋白加 10% 甘油分装，可于 −80°C 保存 12 个月。

briefSteps.en: Express GST-fusion protein at 18°C → lyse cells (PBS + 1% Triton X-100) → clarify lysate → equilibrate Glutathione Sepharose → bind → wash with PBS → elute with 10 mM reduced glutathione → dialyze → optionally cleave GST tag → store at −80°C
briefSteps.zh: 18°C 表达 GST 融合蛋白 → 裂解细胞（PBS + 1% Triton X-100）→ 澄清裂解液 → 平衡谷胱甘肽琼脂糖 → 结合 → PBS 洗涤 → 10 mM 还原型谷胱甘肽洗脱 → 透析 → 可选切除 GST 标签 → −80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Expression and Lysis
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天：表达与裂解

detailedSteps.en: Transform and express GST-fusion protein in E. coli BL21(DE3). Induce with 0.1–0.5 mM IPTG at 18°C overnight to maximize solubility. Harvest cells at 5,000×g for 10 min at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 E. coli BL21(DE3) 中转化并表达 GST 融合蛋白。用 0.1–0.5 mM IPTG 在 18°C 过夜诱导以最大化可溶性。5,000×g、4°C 离心 10 min 收菌。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend cell pellet in GST lysis buffer (PBS pH 7.4 + 1% Triton X-100 + 1 mM DTT + protease inhibitors + 1 mM PMSF) at 5 mL per gram wet weight. Keep on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 每克湿菌体加 5 mL GST 裂解液（PBS pH 7.4 + 1% Triton X-100 + 1 mM DTT + 蛋白酶抑制剂 + 1 mM PMSF）重悬，冰上操作。

detailedSteps.en: Lyse cells by sonication on ice: 5 cycles of 30 s pulse at 40% amplitude with 1 min rest between pulses. Keep sample temperature below 10°C throughout.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰浴超声裂解：40% 振幅，5 次 × 30 s，每次间隔 1 min。全程保持样品温度低于 10°C。

detailedSteps.en: Clarify lysate at 20,000×g for 30 min at 4°C. Collect supernatant. Optional: pass through 0.45 µm filter to protect column. Save aliquot for SDS-PAGE.
detailedSteps.zh: 20,000×g、4°C 离心 30 min 澄清裂解液。收集上清。可选：0.45 µm 过滤保护柱子。留样做 SDS-PAGE。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1–2: Purification
detailedSteps.zh: 第一至二天：纯化

detailedSteps.en: Equilibrate Glutathione Sepharose 4B (1 mL resin per 10 mg expected protein) with 10 CV PBS pH 7.4. For AKTA, use GSTrap FF 5 mL column.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 10 CV PBS pH 7.4 平衡谷胱甘肽琼脂糖 4B（每 10 mg 预估蛋白用 1 mL 树脂）。AKTA 可用 GSTrap FF 5 mL 柱。

detailedSteps.en: Load cleared lysate onto equilibrated resin at ≤1 mL/min (gravity or peristaltic pump). Collect flow-through fraction for SDS-PAGE verification.
detailedSteps.zh: 以 ≤1 mL/min 流速（重力法或蠕动泵）将澄清裂解液上树脂。收集穿透液做 SDS-PAGE 验证。

detailedSteps.en: Wash with 10–20 CV PBS pH 7.4 until A280 returns to baseline. Optional: additional 5 CV high-salt wash (PBS + 500 mM NaCl) to remove ionic contaminants.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 10–20 CV PBS pH 7.4 洗涤至 A280 基线。可选：5 CV 高盐洗涤（PBS + 500 mM NaCl）去除离子性杂质。

detailedSteps.en: Elute with 5–10 CV GST elution buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0 + 10 mM reduced glutathione). Collect 0.5 mL fractions; protein peak typically in fractions 2–6.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 5–10 CV GST 洗脱缓冲液（50 mM Tris pH 8.0 + 10 mM 还原型谷胱甘肽）洗脱。收集 0.5 mL 组分；蛋白峰通常在第 2–6 组分。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Post-purification
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天：纯化后处理

detailedSteps.en: Pool peak fractions and dialyze against storage buffer (PBS or desired buffer) at 4°C with 3 buffer changes, or desalt using HiTrap Desalting column to remove glutathione.
detailedSteps.zh: 合并峰值组分，对储存缓冲液（PBS 或所需缓冲液）在 4°C 换液 3 次透析，或用 HiTrap Desalting 柱去除谷胱甘肽。

detailedSteps.en: Optional GST tag cleavage: incubate with thrombin (1 U per 100 µg) at RT for 2 h, or PreScission protease (1 U/µg) at 4°C overnight. Perform reverse GSTrap purification — cleaved protein flows through; GST and uncleaved protein bind.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选 GST 标签切除：凝血酶（1 U/100 µg）室温 2 h，或 PreScission 蛋白酶（1 U/µg）4°C 过夜。反向 GSTrap 纯化——切割后蛋白流过，GST 和未切割蛋白结合。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify by BCA or Bradford assay. Run SDS-PAGE with Coomassie staining to confirm purity (expect 2–20 mg/L culture yield). Aliquot, snap-freeze in liquid N₂, and store at −80°C with 10% glycerol.
detailedSteps.zh: BCA 或 Bradford 法定量。考马斯蓝染色 SDS-PAGE 确认纯度（预期产量 2–20 mg/L 培养液）。分装后液氮速冻，加 10% 甘油 −80°C 保存。

name: GST/His Pull-Down Assay (Protein-Protein Interaction)
nameCn: GST/His Pull-Down 蛋白互作实验

components.name: 1. Express and purify GST-bait protein (or His-bait) from E. coli

note.en: gst_tag_purification or his_tag_purification. Need ≥5 µg purified bait per reaction. Also purify GST-alone as negative control.
note.zh: gst_tag_purification 或 his_tag_purification。每个反应需 ≥5 µg 纯化诱饵蛋白。同时纯化 GST 单独作为阴性对照。

components.name: 2. Prepare prey protein: cell lysate or purified recombinant

note.en: Cell lysate: lyse 10⁷ cells in 500 µL NP-40 lysis buffer (np40_lysis + protease inhibitors), 30 min ice. Clarify: 16,000×g 15 min 4°C. Pre-clear lysate with empty beads (glutathione or Ni-NTA) 1 h 4°C.
note.zh: 细胞裂解物：10⁷ 细胞加 500 µL NP-40 裂解液（np40_lysis + 蛋白酶抑制剂），冰上 30 min。16,000×g 15 min 4°C 澄清。空白磁珠预清除 1 h 4°C。

components.name: 3. Immobilize bait: 5 µg GST-bait + 20 µL glutathione beads (or 5 µg His-bait + Ni-NTA beads)

note.en: Rotate 1 h 4°C in binding buffer (PBS + 0.1% NP-40 + 1 mM DTT). Wash beads 3× to remove unbound bait.
note.zh: 结合缓冲液（PBS + 0.1% NP-40 + 1 mM DTT）中 4°C 旋转 1 h。洗涤 3 次去除未结合诱饵。

components.name: 4. Add prey: 500 µg cell lysate (or 5 µg purified prey) to bait-beads

note.en: Final volume ~500 µL in binding buffer. Controls: (a) GST-alone beads + same prey (negative); (b) GST-bait beads + lysate buffer only (no-prey control).
note.zh: 终体积 ~500 µL 结合缓冲液。对照：(a) GST 空白磁珠 + 同样猎物（阴性）；(b) GST-诱饵磁珠 + 仅缓冲液（无猎物对照）。

note.en: Longer incubation = more background. Start with 2 h; optimize.
note.zh: 孵育时间越长背景越高。先试 2 h；后续优化。

components.name: 6. Wash beads 4–5× with wash buffer (PBS + 0.1–0.5% NP-40 + 150–300 mM NaCl)

note.en: High NaCl/detergent washes reduce background. Typical: 3× with 0.1% NP-40 + 150 mM NaCl; then 2× with 0.5% NP-40 + 300 mM NaCl. Centrifuge 2,500×g 2 min between washes.
note.zh: 高盐/高去污剂减少背景。典型：3× 0.1% NP-40 + 150 mM NaCl；2× 0.5% NP-40 + 300 mM NaCl。洗涤间离心 2,500×g 2 min。

components.name: 7. Elute: add 30 µL 2× Laemmli + boil 95°C 5 min; or 50 µL glutathione elution (10 mM GSH)

note.en: SDS elution: fast and complete but denatures proteins (no downstream native assay). Glutathione elution: native, lower yield.
note.zh: SDS 洗脱：快速完全但蛋白变性（无法用于后续天然条件实验）。谷胱甘肽洗脱：非变性条件，产量低。

components.name: 8. Western blot: detect prey protein with specific antibody

note.en: Load: 5% input, GST-bait pull-down, GST-alone pull-down. Blot for prey protein AND bait (Coomassie or anti-GST to show equal loading). Interaction confirmed if prey band appears only in bait lane (not GST-alone).
note.zh: 上样：5% input、GST-诱饵 pull-down、GST 空白 pull-down。检测猎物蛋白和诱饵蛋白（考马斯或 anti-GST 证明等量上样）。猎物条带仅在诱饵泳道出现（非 GST 空白）即确认互作。

notes.en: Pull-down is the in vitro version of Co-IP — uses purified recombinant bait. Advantages: no cross-reactivity of IP antibodies, controls for direct vs indirect interaction. Limitations: bait is bacterially expressed (no PTMs); overexpression artifacts. For in vivo interaction, use coip_protocol. For transient interactions: crosslink (DSP, 0.5 mM) before lysis.
notes.zh: Pull-down 是 Co-IP 的体外版——使用纯化重组诱饵蛋白。优势：避免 IP 抗体交叉反应，可区分直接/间接互作。局限：诱饵蛋白为原核表达（无 PTM）；过表达伪影。体内互作用 coip_protocol。短暂互作：裂解前交联（DSP，0.5 mM）。

ref: Brymora et al. (2004) Methods Mol Biol 261:247–262; Louche et al. (2017) Methods Mol Biol 1615:553–564

usage.en: Detect direct protein-protein interactions using an in vitro pulldown assay with tagged bait protein.
usage.zh: 体外 pulldown 实验检测标签蛋白与靶蛋白的直接相互作用。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 4 hours

note.en: Purified bait protein can be stored at −80°C in aliquots for months
note.zh: 纯化的诱饵蛋白可 −80°C 分装保存数月

note.en: Pre-cleared cell lysate can be snap-frozen at −80°C for later use
note.zh: 预清除的细胞裂解物可 −80°C 速冻保存

note.en: Eluted samples in Laemmli buffer can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month before WB
note.zh: Laemmli 缓冲液中的洗脱样品可 −20°C 保存 1 个月后再 WB

briefSteps.en: Purify GST-bait + GST control → prepare prey lysate → immobilize bait on beads → add prey → rotate 2–4 h 4°C → wash 4–5× (low/high stringency) → elute (Laemmli or GSH) → WB detect
briefSteps.zh: 纯化 GST-诱饵 + GST 对照 → 制备猎物裂解物 → 诱饵固定于珠上 → 加猎物 → 4°C 旋转 2–4 h → 洗涤 4–5 次（低/高严格度）→ 洗脱（Laemmli 或 GSH）→ WB 检测

detailedSteps.en: **Bait & Prey Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **诱饵与猎物蛋白制备**

detailedSteps.en: Express and purify GST-bait (or His-bait) protein from E. coli. Need ≥5 µg per reaction. Also purify GST-alone as negative control
detailedSteps.zh: 从大肠杆菌表达并纯化 GST-诱饵（或 His-诱饵）蛋白。每个反应需 ≥5 µg。同时纯化 GST 空白作为阴性对照

detailedSteps.en: Prepare prey: lyse 10⁷ cells in 500 µL NP-40 lysis buffer + protease inhibitors, 30 min on ice. Clarify at 16,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Pre-clear lysate with empty beads for 1 h at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 制备猎物蛋白：10⁷ 细胞加 500 µL NP-40 裂解液 + 蛋白酶抑制剂，冰上 30 min。16,000×g 离心 15 min，4°C 澄清。空白珠子 4°C 预清除 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Bait Immobilization**
detailedSteps.zh: **诱饵蛋白固定**

detailedSteps.en: Mix 5 µg GST-bait with 20 µL glutathione beads (or His-bait with Ni-NTA beads) in binding buffer (PBS + 0.1% NP-40 + 1 mM DTT). Rotate 1 h at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 将 5 µg GST-诱饵与 20 µL 谷胱甘肽珠（或 His-诱饵与 Ni-NTA 珠）在结合缓冲液（PBS + 0.1% NP-40 + 1 mM DTT）中混合。4°C 旋转 1 h

detailedSteps.en: Wash bait-loaded beads 3× with binding buffer to remove unbound bait protein
detailedSteps.zh: 用结合缓冲液洗涤已结合诱饵的珠子 3 次，去除未结合的诱饵蛋白

detailedSteps.en: **Binding & Pull-Down**
detailedSteps.zh: **结合与 Pull-Down**

detailedSteps.en: Add 500 µg pre-cleared cell lysate (or 5 µg purified prey) to bait-beads in ~500 µL total. Set up controls: (a) GST-alone beads + prey; (b) bait-beads + buffer only
detailedSteps.zh: 将 500 µg 预清除裂解物（或 5 µg 纯化猎物）加入诱饵珠中，总体积 ~500 µL。设置对照：(a) GST 空白珠 + 猎物；(b) 诱饵珠 + 仅缓冲液

detailedSteps.en: Incubate with rotation at 4°C for 2–4 h (start with 2 h; longer incubation increases background)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 旋转孵育 2–4 h（先试 2 h；孵育时间越长背景越高）

detailedSteps.en: **Washes & Elution**
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤与洗脱**

detailedSteps.en: Wash beads 4–5×: 3× with PBS + 0.1% NP-40 + 150 mM NaCl, then 2× with PBS + 0.5% NP-40 + 300 mM NaCl. Spin 2,500×g 2 min between washes
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤珠子 4–5 次：3× PBS + 0.1% NP-40 + 150 mM NaCl，再 2× PBS + 0.5% NP-40 + 300 mM NaCl。洗涤间 2,500×g 离心 2 min

detailedSteps.en: Elute: add 30 µL 2× Laemmli buffer, boil at 95°C for 5 min. Alternative: 50 µL glutathione elution (10 mM reduced GSH) for native elution
detailedSteps.zh: 洗脱：加 30 µL 2× Laemmli，95°C 煮 5 min。替代方法：50 µL 谷胱甘肽洗脱液（10 mM 还原型 GSH）用于非变性洗脱

detailedSteps.en: **Western Blot Detection**
detailedSteps.zh: **Western Blot 检测**

detailedSteps.en: Load on SDS-PAGE: 5% input, GST-bait pull-down, GST-alone pull-down. Blot for prey protein and bait (anti-GST or Coomassie). Interaction confirmed if prey band present only in bait lane
detailedSteps.zh: SDS-PAGE 上样：5% input、GST-诱饵 pull-down、GST 空白 pull-down。检测猎物蛋白和诱饵（anti-GST 或考马斯）。猎物条带仅在诱饵泳道出现即确认互作

name: His-Tag Protein Purification (Ni-NTA IMAC)
nameCn: His 标签蛋白纯化（Ni-NTA IMAC 亲和层析）

note.en: See bacterial_protein_expression; IPTG induction; harvest cells 5,000×g 10 min 4°C
note.zh: 参见 bacterial_protein_expression；IPTG 诱导；5,000×g 10 min 4°C 收菌

note.en: ~5 mL per gram wet pellet; lysis_buffer_mild or 50 mM NaH₂PO₄, 300 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, pH 8.0
note.zh: 每克湿菌体加 ~5 mL；lysis_buffer_mild 或 50 mM NaH₂PO₄、300 mM NaCl、10 mM imidazole，pH 8.0

components.name: 3. Lyse cells by sonication on ice

note.en: 3–5 × 30 s pulses, 30–40% amplitude, 60 s rest between pulses, ice bath; or French press 18,000 psi × 2 passes; or freeze-thaw 3× (−80°C/37°C)
Keep supernatant (soluble fraction). Save pellet for inclusion body protocol if needed. Optional: add 0.1% Triton X-100 before spin.
note.zh: 上清为可溶组分。保留沉淀做包涵体纯化（如需要）。可选：离心前加 0.1% Triton X-100 减少非特异结合。

components.name: 5. Equilibrate Ni-NTA resin with Binding Buffer

note.en: 1–2 mL resin per 50 mL lysate (batch) or 5 mL column for FPLC. Wash 5 CV his_binding buffer (20 mM imidazole)
note.zh: 批量法：每 50 mL 裂解液用 1–2 mL 树脂；FPLC 用 5 mL 柱。5 CV his_binding 缓冲液（20 mM imidazole）平衡

components.name: 6. Bind: incubate lysate with resin, 4°C rotate 1 h

note.en: Batch: rotate 1 h 4°C; Column: load 0.5–1 mL/min. Keep flow-through for SDS-PAGE.
note.zh: 批量法：4°C 旋转 1 h；柱层析：0.5–1 mL/min 上样。保留穿透液做 SDS-PAGE 检测。

components.name: 7. Wash 1: 10 CV Binding Buffer (20 mM imidazole)

note.en: Remove bulk contaminants. Collect fractions for SDS-PAGE monitoring.
note.zh: 去除大部分杂蛋白。收集洗涤液做 SDS-PAGE 监测。

components.name: 8. Wash 2 (optional): 5 CV high-salt wash (500 mM NaCl, 50 mM imidazole)

note.en: imac_wash_highsalt; removes DnaK. Optional: add 1 mM ATP + 5 mM MgCl₂.
note.zh: imac_wash_highsalt 高盐洗涤；去除 DnaK。可选加 1 mM ATP + 5 mM MgCl₂。

note.en: imac_elution_500; collect 0.5–1 mL fractions. Pool peak A280 fractions; run SDS-PAGE.
note.zh: imac_elution_500；收集 0.5–1 mL 组分。合并 A280 峰组分；SDS-PAGE 检测。

note.en: dialysis_buffer_generic, 2× changes 2 h 4°C; or HiTrap Desalting on FPLC (5 min). Imidazole absorbs UV and inhibits some assays.
note.zh: dialysis_buffer_generic 透析换液，4°C 每次 2 h 换 2 次；或 HiTrap Desalting 脱盐柱（5 min）。咪唑有紫外吸收且抑制部分实验。

note.en: Expect >90% purity from single Ni-NTA step; 1–10 mg/L culture typical yield.
note.zh: 单步 Ni-NTA 纯度 >90%；典型产量 1–10 mg/L 培养液。

note.en: TEV: 1:50 enzyme:substrate, 4°C overnight or 30°C 2 h (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.5 mM EDTA, 1 mM DTT). Reverse Ni-NTA: cleaved protein in flow-through; His-tag + uncleaved bind.
note.zh: TEV: 酶:底物 = 1:50，4°C 过夜或 30°C 2 h（50 mM Tris pH 8.0、0.5 mM EDTA、1 mM DTT）。反向 Ni-NTA：切割后蛋白在穿透液中；His-tag 和未切割蛋白结合。

note.en: Add 10% glycerol for cryoprotection. Stable 6–12 months at −80°C. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw.
note.zh: 加 10% 甘油冻存保护。−80°C 稳定 6–12 个月。避免反复冻融。

notes.en: Yield: 1–10 mg/L E. coli culture. For inclusion bodies: solubilize with 8 M urea or 6 M GuHCl; bind under denaturing conditions; refold by dialysis against decreasing denaturant. Monitor all fractions by SDS-PAGE. Use Bradford/BCA for quantification.
notes.zh: 产量：每升 E. coli 培养液 1–10 mg。包涵体蛋白：加 8 M 尿素或 6 M 盐酸胍溶解，变性条件下结合，通过梯度透析复性。全程收集 SDS-PAGE 监测。BCA 或 Bradford 定量。

ref: Kimple et al. (2013) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 73:9.9.1–23; Bornhorst & Falke (2000) Methods Enzymol 326:245; QIAGEN Ni-NTA Manual 5th ed.; Hochuli et al. (1988) Bio/Technology 6:1321

usage.en: Purify His-tagged recombinant proteins by Ni-NTA (IMAC) affinity chromatography.
usage.zh: Ni-NTA 亲和层析（IMAC）纯化 His 标签重组蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 days，实操: 6 hours

note.en: Qiagen 30210 or Cytiva
note.zh: Qiagen 30210或Cytiva

note.en: Sigma I5513, prepare stocks in water pH-adjusted to 8.0
note.zh: Sigma I5513，用水配制储液并调pH至8.0

note.en: 1 mg/mL final in lysis buffer
note.zh: 裂解缓冲液中终浓度1 mg/mL

note.en: EDTA-free (EDTA strips Ni²⁺)
note.zh: 无EDTA（EDTA会螯合Ni²⁺）

note.en: For storage buffer
note.zh: 用于储存缓冲液

note.en: Clarified lysate can be stored at 4°C overnight or frozen at −80°C before proceeding to affinity purification.
note.zh: 澄清裂解液可在 4°C 保存过夜或 −80°C 冷冻后再进行亲和纯化。

note.en: Eluted protein (in high imidazole) can be held at 4°C overnight before dialysis. Proceed to dialysis the next day.
note.zh: 洗脱蛋白（高咪唑缓冲液中）可在 4°C 保存过夜，次日再透析。

note.en: Dialyzed purified protein can be aliquoted and stored at −80°C with 10% glycerol for up to 12 months.
note.zh: 透析后的纯化蛋白加 10% 甘油分装后可于 −80°C 保存 12 个月。

briefSteps.en: Express His-tagged protein → lyse cells → clarify lysate → equilibrate Ni-NTA resin → bind → wash with 20–50 mM imidazole → elute with 250–500 mM imidazole → dialyze → quantify and store at −80°C
briefSteps.zh: 表达 His 标签蛋白 → 裂解细胞 → 澄清裂解液 → 平衡 Ni-NTA 树脂 → 结合 → 20–50 mM 咪唑洗涤 → 250–500 mM 咪唑洗脱 → 透析 → 定量后 −80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Expression and Lysis
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天：表达与裂解

detailedSteps.en: Induce His-tagged protein expression in E. coli BL21(DE3) with 0.5 mM IPTG. Harvest cells by centrifugation at 5,000×g for 10 min at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 0.5 mM IPTG 诱导 E. coli BL21(DE3) 表达 His 标签蛋白。5,000×g、4°C 离心 10 min 收菌。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend cell pellet in lysis buffer (50 mM NaH₂PO₄, 300 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, pH 8.0 + protease inhibitors) at ~5 mL per gram wet pellet. Keep on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 每克湿菌体加 ~5 mL 裂解液（50 mM NaH₂PO₄、300 mM NaCl、10 mM imidazole、pH 8.0 + 蛋白酶抑制剂）重悬，冰上操作。

detailedSteps.en: Lyse cells by sonication on ice: 3–5 cycles of 30 s pulse at 30–40% amplitude with 60 s rest between pulses. Alternatively, use French press at 18,000 psi × 2 passes.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰浴超声裂解：30–40% 振幅，3–5 次 × 30 s，每次间隔 60 s。或用法压机 18,000 psi × 2 次。

detailedSteps.en: Clarify lysate by centrifugation at 20,000×g for 30 min at 4°C. Collect supernatant (soluble fraction). Save an aliquot for SDS-PAGE analysis.
detailedSteps.zh: 20,000×g、4°C 离心 30 min 澄清裂解液。收集上清（可溶性组分）。留样做 SDS-PAGE 分析。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1–2: Purification
detailedSteps.zh: 第一至二天：纯化

detailedSteps.en: Equilibrate Ni-NTA agarose resin (1–2 mL resin per 50 mL lysate) with 5 column volumes (CV) of binding buffer (50 mM NaH₂PO₄, 300 mM NaCl, 20 mM imidazole, pH 8.0).
detailedSteps.zh: 用 5 CV 结合缓冲液（50 mM NaH₂PO₄、300 mM NaCl、20 mM imidazole、pH 8.0）平衡 Ni-NTA 树脂（每 50 mL 裂解液用 1–2 mL 树脂）。

detailedSteps.en: Bind: load cleared lysate onto equilibrated resin. For batch method, rotate at 4°C for 1 h. For column, load at 0.5–1 mL/min. Collect flow-through for SDS-PAGE.
detailedSteps.zh: 结合：将澄清裂解液上树脂。批量法：4°C 旋转 1 h。柱层析：0.5–1 mL/min 上样。收集穿透液做 SDS-PAGE。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 1: apply 10 CV binding buffer (20 mM imidazole) to remove bulk contaminants. Collect wash fractions for SDS-PAGE monitoring.
detailedSteps.zh: 第一次洗涤：用 10 CV 结合缓冲液（20 mM imidazole）去除大量杂蛋白。收集洗涤液做 SDS-PAGE 监测。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2 (optional): apply 5 CV high-salt wash buffer (50 mM NaH₂PO₄, 500 mM NaCl, 50 mM imidazole, pH 8.0) to remove chaperone DnaK. Optionally add 1 mM ATP + 5 mM MgCl₂.
detailedSteps.zh: 第二次洗涤（可选）：5 CV 高盐洗涤缓冲液（50 mM NaH₂PO₄、500 mM NaCl、50 mM imidazole、pH 8.0）去除伴侣蛋白 DnaK。可选加 1 mM ATP + 5 mM MgCl₂。

detailedSteps.en: Elute: apply 5–10 CV elution buffer (50 mM NaH₂PO₄, 300 mM NaCl, 250–500 mM imidazole, pH 8.0). Collect 0.5–1 mL fractions. Pool peak A280 fractions and verify by SDS-PAGE.
detailedSteps.zh: 洗脱：用 5–10 CV 洗脱缓冲液（50 mM NaH₂PO₄、300 mM NaCl、250–500 mM imidazole、pH 8.0）。收集 0.5–1 mL 组分。合并 A280 峰组分并 SDS-PAGE 验证。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Post-purification
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天：纯化后处理

detailedSteps.en: Dialyze pooled eluate against storage buffer (e.g., 50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT) at 4°C with 2 buffer changes of 2 h each, or use HiTrap Desalting column to remove imidazole.
detailedSteps.zh: 将合并洗脱液对储存缓冲液（如 50 mM Tris pH 7.5、150 mM NaCl、1 mM DTT）于 4°C 透析，换液两次每次 2 h，或用 HiTrap Desalting 脱盐柱去除咪唑。

detailedSteps.en: Optional tag cleavage: add TEV protease at 1:50 enzyme:substrate ratio in 50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.5 mM EDTA, 1 mM DTT. Incubate at 4°C overnight. Perform reverse Ni-NTA: cleaved protein flows through; His-tag and uncleaved protein bind.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选标签切除：加 TEV 蛋白酶（酶:底物 = 1:50），50 mM Tris pH 8.0、0.5 mM EDTA、1 mM DTT，4°C 过夜。反向 Ni-NTA：切割后蛋白在穿透液中，His-tag 和未切割蛋白结合。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify protein by BCA or Bradford assay. Run SDS-PAGE with Coomassie staining to confirm purity (expect >90% from single Ni-NTA step). Aliquot, snap-freeze in liquid N₂, and store at −80°C with 10% glycerol.
detailedSteps.zh: BCA 或 Bradford 法定量蛋白。考马斯蓝染色 SDS-PAGE 确认纯度（单步 Ni-NTA 纯度 >90%）。分装后液氮速冻，加 10% 甘油于 −80°C 保存。

name: Immunofluorescence (IF) Protocol

components.name: 7. 封闭 (3% BSA + 5% serum) 1 h RT
8. 一抗 (稀释于封闭液) 4°C 过夜
10. 荧光二抗 1 h RT 避光

note.en: 1 µg/mL in PBS
note.zh: 1 µg/mL（溶于 PBS）

notes.en: Secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647. Protect from light. Tissue sections require antigen retrieval (heat-induced or enzymatic). Confocal: recommend 63× oil immersion.
notes.zh: 二抗选择: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647 等。避光操作。组织切片需抗原修复 (热修复或酶消化)。共聚焦推荐 63× oil 物镜。

ref: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1; Im et al. (2019) STAR Protoc 1:100023; CSH Protocols

usage.en: Visualize protein localization in fixed cells using fluorescent antibody staining and microscopy.
usage.zh: 免疫荧光染色可视化固定细胞中蛋白质的定位。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 3 hours

note.en: 1 mg/mL stock → 1:1000 in PBS
note.zh: 1 mg/mL 母液 → PBS 中 1:1000

note.en: ProLong Gold / Vectashield
note.zh: ProLong Gold / Vectashield

note.en: #1.5 thickness for confocal
note.zh: #1.5 厚度，适合共聚焦

note.en: Fixed and permeabilized cells can be stored at 4°C in PBS for up to 24 hours before proceeding to blocking and antibody staining.
note.zh: 固定并透化后的细胞可在 4°C PBS 中保存最多 24 h，之后再进行封闭和抗体染色。

note.en: Slides with primary antibody applied can be kept at 4°C in a sealed humidity chamber for an extended overnight incubation (up to 18 h) — this is the standard overnight step.
note.zh: 加了一抗的样品可在密封湿盒中 4°C 保存过夜（最长 18 h）——这是标准的过夜孵育步骤。

note.en: Mounted and sealed slides can be stored at 4°C in the dark for up to 1 week (with ProLong Gold, up to several months after full curing).
note.zh: 封片并封边后的载玻片可在 4°C 避光保存最多 1 周（使用 ProLong Gold 完全固化后可保存数月）。

briefSteps.en: Seed cells on coverslips → wash with PBS → fix in 4% PFA → permeabilize with 0.1% Triton X-100 → block with BSA/serum → incubate primary antibody overnight at 4°C → wash → incubate fluorescent secondary antibody → wash → counterstain with DAPI → mount with anti-fade medium → image by fluorescence/confocal microscopy.
briefSteps.zh: 细胞爬片培养 → PBS 洗涤 → 4% PFA 固定 → 0.1% Triton X-100 透化 → BSA/血清封闭 → 4°C 孵育一抗过夜 → 洗涤 → 孵育荧光二抗 → 洗涤 → DAPI 染核 → 抗淬灭封片 → 荧光/共聚焦显微镜成像。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天

detailedSteps.en: Seed cells onto poly-L-lysine-coated glass coverslips (18 mm, #1.5) or chamber slides at 30–70% confluence. Allow cells to attach and grow for 24–48 h before staining.
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞接种于多聚赖氨酸包被的玻璃盖玻片（18 mm，#1.5）或 chamber slide 上，密度 30–70%。染色前培养 24–48 h 使细胞充分贴壁铺展。

detailedSteps.en: Wash cells gently twice with cold PBS (1 mL per coverslip) to remove culture medium and loosely adherent debris.
detailedSteps.zh: 用冷 PBS（每个盖玻片 1 mL）轻柔洗涤细胞两次，去除培养基和松散碎屑。

detailedSteps.en: Fix cells in freshly prepared 4% PFA (in PBS) for 15 min at room temperature. Do not over-fix (>20 min can mask epitopes).
detailedSteps.zh: 用新鲜配制的 4% PFA（溶于 PBS）室温固定 15 min。不要过度固定（>20 min 可能遮蔽表位）。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3 times with PBS, 5 min each, on a rocker. This removes residual PFA.
detailedSteps.zh: 在摇床上用 PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 5 min，去除残余 PFA。

detailedSteps.en: Permeabilize cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 10 min at room temperature. For membrane-associated or nuclear targets, adjust to 0.2–0.5% Triton X-100 or use 0.1% saponin for milder permeabilization.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 PBS 中 0.1% Triton X-100 室温透化细胞 10 min。膜相关或核靶点可调至 0.2–0.5% Triton X-100；需较温和透化时用 0.1% saponin。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3 times with PBS, 5 min each.
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Block non-specific binding with blocking buffer (3% BSA + 5% normal serum from the same species as the secondary antibody in PBS) for 1 h at room temperature in a humidity chamber.
detailedSteps.zh: 在湿盒中用封闭液（PBS 中 3% BSA + 5% 与二抗同种属的正常血清）室温封闭 1 h，防止非特异性结合。

detailedSteps.en: Without washing, aspirate excess blocking buffer. Apply primary antibody diluted in blocking buffer (typical dilution 1:100–1:500, per datasheet). Incubate overnight at 4°C in a sealed humidity chamber.
detailedSteps.zh: 不洗涤，吸去多余封闭液。加入封闭液稀释的一抗（通常 1:100–1:500，参考说明书）。在密封湿盒中 4°C 孵育过夜。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3 times with PBS, 5 min each, to remove unbound primary antibody.
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 5 min，去除未结合的一抗。

detailedSteps.en: Apply fluorescent secondary antibody (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488, 555, or 647; 1:500–1:1000 in blocking buffer) and incubate for 1 h at room temperature in the dark. Protect all subsequent steps from light.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入荧光二抗（如 Alexa Fluor 488、555 或 647；封闭液 1:500–1:1000 稀释），室温避光孵育 1 h。后续所有步骤均需避光。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3 times with PBS, 5 min each.
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Counterstain nuclei with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) for 5 min at room temperature, then wash once with PBS.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 DAPI（PBS 中 1 µg/mL）室温染核 5 min，PBS 洗涤一次。

detailedSteps.en: Mount coverslips onto glass slides using a small drop (5–10 µL) of anti-fade mounting medium (e.g., ProLong Gold, Vectashield). Allow to cure overnight at RT in the dark, then seal edges with clear nail polish. Image by fluorescence or confocal microscopy (63× oil immersion recommended).
detailedSteps.zh: 用一小滴（5–10 µL）抗淬灭封片剂（如 ProLong Gold、Vectashield）将盖玻片封片于载玻片上。室温避光固化过夜，用指甲油封边。荧光或共聚焦显微镜成像（推荐 63× 油镜）。

name: Immunofluorescence Staining for Cryostat Sections
nameCn: 冰冻切片免疫荧光染色方案

components.name: Step 1: Fix tissue sections with 3.2% PFA (prewarmed at 37°C) for 15 min.
Step 2: Rinse 3× with PBS, 5 min each.
Step 3: Block for 30 min with blocking buffer (PBS + 0.5% saponin + 2% BSA + 1% goat serum).
Step 4: Prepare primary antibody in blocking buffer.

note.en: Typical: 1:200. Some antibodies (e.g. Ly6G 2 mg/mL): 1:800. Titrate if high background.
note.zh: 通常 1:200。某些抗体（如 Ly6G 2 mg/mL）：1:800。背景高则滴定优化。

components.name: Step 5: Incubate primary antibody overnight at 4°C.
Step 6: Wash 3× with PBS, 5 min each.
Step 7: Prepare secondary antibody (1:500 typical) in blocking buffer with DAPI (1:1000). Incubate 1 h at RT.

note.en: Some antibodies may need higher dilution to reduce background.
note.zh: 某些二抗可能需更高稀释倍数减少背景。

components.name: Step 9: Mount in anti-fade mounting buffer. Seal with nail polish. Dry overnight at RT.
Step 10: Image on fluorescence microscope, or store at -20°C for later use.

notes.en: Saponin-based blocking buffer is suitable for intracellular targets. For membrane-only targets, 0.1% Triton X-100 can substitute for saponin. Keep sections moist throughout — never let them dry. Use a humid dark box during antibody incubations.
notes.zh: 皂苷通透适合细胞内靶标。仅膜靶标可用 0.1% Triton X-100 替代皂苷。全程保持切片湿润——切勿干燥。抗体孵育时使用避光湿盒。

ref: Donaldson JG (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1–4.3.30; Harlow E & Lane D (1988) Antibodies: A Laboratory Manual, CSHL Press

usage.en: Immunofluorescence staining protocol for cryostat-sectioned frozen tissue with saponin-based permeabilization.
usage.zh: 冰冻切片免疫荧光染色方案，使用皂苷通透。

label.en: Protocol — 2 days (overnight primary antibody), hands-on: 2 hours
label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days (overnight primary antibody)，实操: 2 hours

materials.name: Blocking buffer: PBS + 0.5% saponin + 2% BSA + 1% goat serum

note.en: 4°C in humidity chamber (up to Overnight (required))
note.zh: 4°C in humidity chamber (最长 Overnight (required))

note.en: -20°C protected from light (up to Weeks)
note.zh: -20°C protected from light (最长 Weeks)

briefSteps.en: Fix PFA 15 min → wash 3× PBS → block 30 min (saponin/BSA/serum) → primary Ab overnight 4°C → wash 3× → secondary Ab + DAPI 1 h RT → wash 3× → mount anti-fade → seal → image
briefSteps.zh: PFA 固定 15 min → PBS 洗 3 次 → 封闭 30 min（皂苷/BSA/血清）→ 一抗 4°C 过夜 → 洗 3 次 → 二抗 + DAPI RT 1 h → 洗 3 次 → 抗淬灭封片 → 封边 → 成像

detailedSteps.en: **Fixation & Washing**
detailedSteps.zh: **固定与洗涤**

detailedSteps.en: Fix cryostat tissue sections with 3.2% PFA (prewarmed to 37°C) for 15 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: 用 3.2% PFA（预热至 37°C）固定冰冻切片，RT 孵育 15 min

detailedSteps.en: Rinse slides 3× with PBS, 5 min each wash
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗涤载玻片 3 次，每次 5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Blocking & Permeabilization**
detailedSteps.zh: **封闭与通透**

detailedSteps.en: Block for 30 min with blocking buffer (PBS + 0.5% saponin + 2% BSA + 1% goat serum) in humidity chamber
detailedSteps.zh: 在湿盒中用封闭液（PBS + 0.5% 皂苷 + 2% BSA + 1% 山羊血清）封闭 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Primary Antibody Incubation**
detailedSteps.zh: **一抗孵育**

detailedSteps.en: Dilute primary antibody in blocking buffer (typical 1:200; titrate for specific antibodies). Apply to sections
detailedSteps.zh: 用封闭液稀释一抗（通常 1:200；特定抗体需滴定优化）。涂覆于切片上

detailedSteps.en: Incubate overnight at 4°C in sealed humidity chamber (dark box with water to prevent drying)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 避光湿盒中过夜孵育（盒内加水防止干燥）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Secondary Antibody & Mounting**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 二抗与封片**

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3× with PBS, 5 min each
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Prepare secondary antibody (1:500 typical) in blocking buffer with DAPI (1:1000). Apply to sections. Incubate 1 h at RT in humidity chamber, protected from light
detailedSteps.zh: 用封闭液配制二抗（通常 1:500）+ DAPI（1:1000）。涂覆于切片。RT 避光湿盒中孵育 1 h

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3× with PBS, 5 min each. Keep slides moist — never let sections dry
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 5 min。保持载玻片湿润——切勿让切片干燥

detailedSteps.en: Mount with anti-fade mounting medium. Seal edges with nail polish. Dry overnight at RT protected from light
detailedSteps.zh: 用抗荧光淬灭封片剂封片。指甲油封边。RT 避光过夜晾干

detailedSteps.en: Image on fluorescence/confocal microscope, or store slides at −20°C protected from light
detailedSteps.zh: 荧光/共聚焦显微镜成像，或 −20°C 避光保存

name: Immunohistochemistry on Paraffin Sections (IHC-P)

note.en: 4–5 µm FFPE on positively charged slides (Superfrost Plus). Ensures adhesion & melts paraffin.
note.zh: 4–5 µm FFPE 切片贴附于正电荷载玻片（Superfrost Plus）。确保贴附并熔化石蜡。

components.name: 2. Deparaffinize: 3 × 5 min xylene → rehydrate: 100% EtOH × 2 → 95% → 70% → ddH₂O × 2

note.en: Each step 5 min. Fume hood for xylene.
note.zh: 每步 5 min。二甲苯需在通风橱操作。

note.en: Citrate pH 6.0 (citrate_buffer_ar): most cytoplasmic/ER antigens. EDTA pH 9.0 (ar_edta_ph9): nuclear/membrane antigens. Pressure cooker (15 psi, 3–4 min) or water bath (98°C, 20 min). Cool 20 min RT.
note.zh: 柠檬酸 pH 6.0（citrate_buffer_ar）：多数胞质/内质网抗原。EDTA pH 9.0（ar_edta_ph9）：核/膜抗原。高压锅（15 psi，3–4 min）或水浴（98°C，20 min）。RT 冷却 20 min。

components.name: 4. Block endogenous peroxidase: 3% H₂O₂ in PBS, 10–15 min RT

note.en: Prevents background from blood/liver peroxidases. Rinse 3× PBS.
note.zh: 防止血液/肝脏内源性过氧化物酶背景。PBS 冲洗 3 次。

components.name: 5. Block: 5–10% normal serum (same species as secondary Ab) in TBS, 1 h RT

note.en: Do NOT wash after — aspirate excess, apply primary Ab directly. Optional: avidin/biotin block if using ABC system.
note.zh: 封闭后不洗——吸去多余血清直接加一抗。ABC 系统需先做 avidin/biotin 封闭。

components.name: 6. Primary Ab: diluted in TBS + 1% BSA; 1 h RT or 4°C overnight (humidity chamber)

note.en: Typical 1:100–1:1000. PAP pen barrier. 4°C overnight often gives better S/N.
note.zh: 通常 1:100–1:1000 稀释。PAP 笔画疏水圈。4°C 过夜通常信噪比更好。

note.en: Do not let sections dry.
note.zh: 切勿让切片干燥。

note.en: Polymer-based (EnVision+, Dako) preferred over biotin-streptavidin (less background). Species-matched.
note.zh: 聚合物法（EnVision+，Dako）优于生物素-链霉亲和素（更低背景）。种属匹配。

components.name: 10. DAB development: apply DAB + H₂O₂, 2–10 min RT; monitor under microscope; stop in ddH₂O

note.en: Brown = positive signal. Do not over-develop. Fresh DAB only.
note.zh: 棕色 = 阳性信号。勿过度显色。DAB 需新鲜配制。

components.name: 11. Counterstain: Hematoxylin 1–5 min → differentiate in acid-alcohol → blue in running water 5 min

note.en: Harris or Mayer's Hematoxylin. Blue in tap water or Scott's Water (2 g MgSO₄ + 0.2 g NaHCO₃/L).
note.zh: Harris 或 Mayer 苏木精。自来水返蓝或 Scott's 水（2 g MgSO₄ + 0.2 g NaHCO₃/L）。

note.en: Each 2–5 min. Avoid air bubbles. Cure 24 h before imaging.
note.zh: 每步 2–5 min。避免气泡。封片后 24 h 再镜检。

notes.en: Controls: (1) positive tissue; (2) isotype control replacing primary Ab; (3) H&E on sequential section. Scoring: H-score = intensity(0–3) × %positive. Quantitative: QuPath/HALO software. For multiplex: Opal tyramide system (TSA amplification).
notes.zh: 对照：(1) 阳性组织；(2) 同型对照替代一抗；(3) 相邻切片 H&E。评分：H-score = 强度(0–3) × 阳性率。定量：QuPath/HALO 图像分析。多重免疫组化：Opal tyramide 系统（TSA 信号放大）。

ref: Ramos-Vara & Miller (2014) Vet Pathol 51:42–87; Taylor & Rudbeck (2013) Dako Education Guide; Shi et al. (1991) J Histochem Cytochem 39:741

usage.en: Detect protein expression in paraffin-embedded tissue sections using immunohistochemistry.
usage.zh: 免疫组化检测石蜡包埋组织切片中的蛋白表达。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 4 hours

materials.name: FFPE tissue sections on charged slides

note.en: 4–5 µm sections on Superfrost Plus slides
note.zh: 4-5 µm切片，Superfrost Plus载玻片

note.en: Histology grade
note.zh: 组织学级

note.en: For dehydration/rehydration
note.zh: 用于脱水/复水

note.en: For heat-induced antigen retrieval
note.zh: 用于热诱导抗原修复

note.en: Prepare fresh
note.zh: 新鲜配制

note.en: From same species as secondary Ab
note.zh: 与二抗同源种属

note.en: IHC-validated, with datasheet dilution
note.zh: IHC验证，按说明书稀释

note.en: Match host species of primary Ab
note.zh: 匹配一抗宿主种属

note.en: Vector Labs SK-4100 or equivalent
note.zh: Vector Labs SK-4100或同等品

note.en: For nuclear counterstain
note.zh: 用于核复染

note.en: Permanent, xylene-based
note.zh: 永久封片，二甲苯基

note.en: Deparaffinized and rehydrated slides can be kept in 1× PBS at room temperature for up to 1 hour before proceeding to antigen retrieval.
note.zh: 脱蜡复水后的载玻片可在室温 1× PBS 中保存最多 1 h，之后再进行抗原修复。

note.en: Sections with primary antibody applied are incubated overnight at 4°C as a standard step — this is the intended safe stop between Day 1 and Day 2.
note.zh: 加了一抗的切片 4°C 孵育过夜是标准流程——这是第一天和第二天之间的预设暂停点。

briefSteps.en: Bake FFPE sections → deparaffinize in xylene → rehydrate through graded ethanol → heat-induced antigen retrieval → block endogenous peroxidase with 3% H₂O₂ → serum block → primary antibody overnight at 4°C → wash → HRP-polymer secondary antibody → DAB chromogen development → hematoxylin counterstain → dehydrate → mount.
briefSteps.zh: 烘烤 FFPE 切片 → 二甲苯脱蜡 → 梯度乙醇复水 → 热修复抗原 → 3% H₂O₂ 封闭内源性过氧化物酶 → 血清封闭 → 4°C 孵育一抗过夜 → 洗涤 → HRP 聚合物二抗 → DAB 显色 → 苏木精复染 → 脱水 → 封片。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天

detailedSteps.en: Bake 4–5 µm FFPE sections on positively charged slides (e.g., Superfrost Plus) in a 60°C oven for 1 h to melt paraffin and improve tissue adhesion.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 4–5 µm FFPE 切片（贴于 Superfrost Plus 正电荷载玻片）置于 60°C 烤箱中 1 h，熔化石蜡并增强组织贴附。

detailedSteps.en: Deparaffinize in xylene: 3 × 5 min. Rehydrate through graded ethanol in fume hood: 100% EtOH × 2 → 95% EtOH → 70% EtOH → ddH₂O × 2, each step 5 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 通风橱内二甲苯脱蜡：3 × 5 min。梯度乙醇复水：100% EtOH × 2 → 95% EtOH → 70% EtOH → 蒸馏水 × 2，每步 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Heat-induced epitope retrieval (HIER): submerge slides in antigen retrieval buffer (citrate pH 6.0 for cytoplasmic antigens; EDTA pH 9.0 for nuclear/membrane antigens). Heat in water bath at 98°C for 20 min or pressure cooker at 15 psi for 3–4 min. Cool to room temperature for 20 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 热修复表位（HIER）：将载玻片浸入抗原修复缓冲液（胞质抗原用柠檬酸 pH 6.0；核/膜抗原用 EDTA pH 9.0）。水浴 98°C 加热 20 min 或高压锅 15 psi 3–4 min。室温冷却 20 min。

detailedSteps.en: Block endogenous peroxidase: incubate sections in 3% H₂O₂ in PBS for 10–15 min at room temperature. Rinse 3 × 2 min in TBS.
detailedSteps.zh: 封闭内源性过氧化物酶：PBS 中 3% H₂O₂ 室温孵育 10–15 min。TBS 冲洗 3 × 2 min。

detailedSteps.en: Draw a hydrophobic barrier around each section with a PAP pen. Block non-specific binding with 5–10% normal serum (same species as secondary antibody) in TBS for 1 h at room temperature in a humidity chamber. Aspirate excess, do not wash.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 PAP 笔在切片周围画疏水圈。在湿盒中用 TBS 中 5–10% 正常血清（与二抗同种属）室温封闭 1 h。吸去多余封闭液，不要洗涤。

detailedSteps.en: Apply primary antibody diluted in TBS + 1% BSA (typical dilution 1:100–1:1000, per datasheet). Incubate overnight at 4°C in a sealed humidity chamber. 4°C overnight generally gives better signal-to-noise than 1 h at RT.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 TBS + 1% BSA 中稀释一抗（参考说明书，通常 1:100–1:1000）。在密封湿盒中 4°C 孵育过夜。4°C 过夜通常比室温 1 h 信噪比更好。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天

detailedSteps.en: Wash sections 3 × 5 min in TBS or TBST on a rocker. Do not allow sections to dry at any point.
detailedSteps.zh: 在摇床上 TBS 或 TBST 洗涤 3 × 5 min。任何时候不要让切片干燥。

detailedSteps.en: Apply species-matched HRP-polymer secondary antibody (e.g., Dako EnVision+) undiluted or at manufacturer-recommended concentration. Incubate 30–60 min at room temperature.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入种属匹配的 HRP 聚合物二抗（如 Dako EnVision+），按说明书浓度或直接使用。室温孵育 30–60 min。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3 × 5 min in TBS.
detailedSteps.zh: TBS 洗涤 3 × 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare fresh DAB chromogen per kit instructions. Apply DAB + H₂O₂ substrate to sections and monitor color development under a light microscope. Develop for 2–10 min (positive signal = brown precipitate). Stop reaction immediately by rinsing in ddH₂O.
detailedSteps.zh: 按试剂盒说明新鲜配制 DAB 显色液。将 DAB + H₂O₂ 底物加至切片上，在光学显微镜下监控显色。显色 2–10 min（阳性信号 = 棕色沉淀）。立即用蒸馏水冲洗终止反应。

detailedSteps.en: Counterstain nuclei with hematoxylin (Harris or Mayer's) for 1–5 min. Differentiate in 1% acid-alcohol (1% HCl in 70% EtOH) for 5–10 seconds. Blue nuclei by rinsing in running tap water for 5 min or Scott's Water (2 g/L MgSO₄ + 0.2 g/L NaHCO₃).
detailedSteps.zh: 苏木精（Harris 或 Mayer's）复染细胞核 1–5 min。在 1% 酸性乙醇（70% EtOH 中 1% HCl）中分化 5–10 秒。自来水冲洗 5 min 或 Scott's 水（2 g/L MgSO₄ + 0.2 g/L NaHCO₃）返蓝。

detailedSteps.en: Dehydrate: 70% → 95% EtOH × 2 → 100% EtOH × 2 → xylene × 2, each 2–5 min. Mount coverslip with xylene-based medium (DPX or Permount) using minimal medium to avoid bubbles. Allow to cure 24 h before imaging.
detailedSteps.zh: 脱水：70% → 95% EtOH × 2 → 100% EtOH × 2 → 二甲苯 × 2，每步 2–5 min。用少量二甲苯封固剂（DPX 或 Permount）封片，避免气泡。封片后 24 h 再进行显微镜成像。

name: Immunoprecipitation (IP)

components.name: 1. 裂解细胞 (IP Lysis Buffer + protease inhibitors)

note.en: 30 min on ice with intermittent vortexing
note.zh: 冰上 30 min, 间歇涡旋

components.name: 3. 定量 → 取 500 µg–1 mg 总蛋白

note.en: Removes non-specific binding; optional
note.zh: 去除非特异结合; 可选

components.name: 6. 加抗体 (1–5 µg) → 4°C 旋转孵育 2–4 h 或过夜
7. 加 Protein A/G beads (20–40 µL) → 4°C 旋转 1–2 h

note.en: 1 mL per wash, rotate 5 min, capture on magnetic rack
note.zh: 每次 1 mL, 旋转 5 min, 磁力架吸附

components.name: 9. 洗脱: 2× SDS Loading Buffer, 95°C 5 min

note.en: IP sample + Input + IgG isotype control
note.zh: IP 样品 + Input + IgG 对照

notes.en: Controls: (1) Normal IgG (same species) negative control; (2) Input positive control. For Co-IP: use mild lysis buffer (avoid SDS). Ab light/heavy chain interference in WB: use Clean-Blot IP Detection Reagent or crosslink Ab to beads. Magnetic beads have lower background than agarose. Endogenous IP is more physiologically relevant than overexpression IP.
notes.zh: 对照：(1) Normal IgG (同种属) 阴性对照; (2) Input 阳性对照。共免疫沉淀 (Co-IP)：使用温和裂解液（避免 SDS）。抗体轻链/重链干扰 WB 检测：用 Clean-Blot IP Detection Reagent 或交联抗体到 beads。磁珠比琼脂糖珠背景更低。内源性 IP 比 overexpression IP 更有生理意义。

ref: Harlow & Lane (1988) Antibodies: A Laboratory Manual; Cell Signaling Technology IP Protocol

usage.en: Immunoprecipitate a target protein from cell lysates using antibody-bead capture.
usage.zh: 抗体-磁珠捕获法从细胞裂解液中免疫沉淀靶蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 4 hours

note.en: 100× stock, add fresh
note.zh: 100× 母液，现用现加

note.en: e.g. Dynabeads, Pierce
note.zh: 如 Dynabeads、Pierce

note.en: 1–5 µg per IP
note.zh: 每次 IP 1–5 µg

note.en: Species-matched isotype control
note.zh: 同种属同型对照

note.en: Clarified cell lysate can be snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at −80°C for up to 1 month.
note.zh: 澄清的细胞裂解液可液氮速冻后 −80°C 保存最长 1 个月。

note.en: IP eluates in Laemmli buffer can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month before Western blot analysis.
note.zh: Laemmli 缓冲液中的 IP 洗脱液可 −20°C 保存最长 1 个月，再进行 Western Blot。

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells in IP lysis buffer → centrifuge and clarify → quantify lysate, save input → pre-clear with beads → add target antibody overnight at 4°C → add Protein A/G beads 1–2 h → wash 3–5× → elute with 2× SDS loading buffer at 95°C → Western blot.
briefSteps.zh: IP 裂解液裂解细胞 → 离心澄清 → 定量裂解液并留取 Input → beads 预清除 → 加目标抗体 4°C 过夜 → Protein A/G beads 孵育 1–2 h → 洗涤 3–5 次 → 2× SDS 上样缓冲液 95°C 洗脱 → Western Blot 检测。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天

detailedSteps.en: Wash cells twice with ice-cold PBS. Add IP lysis buffer (150 mM NaCl, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1% NP-40, 0.5% sodium deoxycholate, 1 mM EDTA) supplemented with protease inhibitor cocktail and phosphatase inhibitors if needed. Use 300–500 µL per 10-cm dish. Lyse on ice for 30 min with occasional vortexing.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰冷 PBS 洗细胞两次，加 IP 裂解液（150 mM NaCl、50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5、1% NP-40、0.5% 脱氧胆酸钠、1 mM EDTA + 蛋白酶抑制剂，必要时加磷酸酶抑制剂），10 cm 皿用 300–500 µL，冰上裂解 30 min，间歇涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 14,000×g for 15 min at 4°C. Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new pre-chilled Eppendorf tube. Discard the pellet.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min，小心将上清转移至新的预冷 Eppendorf 管，弃去沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify protein concentration by BCA or Bradford assay. Use 500 µg–1 mg total protein per IP reaction. Remove 5–10% of the lysate as Input control and add 1× Laemmli loading buffer; boil and store at −20°C.
detailedSteps.zh: BCA 或 Bradford 法定量蛋白浓度，每个 IP 反应取 500 µg–1 mg 总蛋白，留取 5–10% 裂解液作为 Input 对照，加 1× Laemmli 缓冲液后煮沸，−20°C 保存。

detailedSteps.en: Pre-clear the lysate: add 20 µL of Protein A/G magnetic beads (pre-washed 3× in lysis buffer) and rotate at 4°C for 1 h. Apply magnetic rack and transfer supernatant to a new tube, discarding beads.
detailedSteps.zh: 预清除：加 20 µL Protein A/G 磁珠（预洗 3 次），4°C 旋转孵育 1 h，用磁力架吸附磁珠，将上清转移至新管。

detailedSteps.en: Add 1–5 µg of target antibody to the pre-cleared lysate. Prepare an isotype-matched IgG negative control in a parallel tube with the same amount of normal IgG. Rotate all tubes at 4°C overnight.
detailedSteps.zh: 向预清除后的裂解液中加入 1–5 µg 目标抗体，平行设置同量同种属 IgG 阴性对照管，4°C 旋转孵育过夜。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天

detailedSteps.en: Add 20–40 µL of pre-washed Protein A/G magnetic beads to each tube. Rotate at 4°C for 1–2 h to capture the antibody-antigen complex.
detailedSteps.zh: 每管加入 20–40 µL 预洗 Protein A/G 磁珠，4°C 旋转孵育 1–2 h 捕获抗体-抗原复合物。

detailedSteps.en: Place tubes on magnetic rack. Remove and discard supernatant. Wash beads 3–5 times: add 1 mL cold lysis buffer, rotate for 5 min at 4°C, apply magnetic rack, discard supernatant. Final wash: use PBS for a cleaner elution.
detailedSteps.zh: 置于磁力架上弃上清，洗涤 beads 3–5 次：加 1 mL 冰冷裂解液，4°C 旋转 5 min，磁力架吸附后弃上清，末次可用 PBS 洗涤使洗脱更干净。

detailedSteps.en: Elute by adding 40–50 µL of 2× Laemmli sample buffer to beads. Boil at 95°C for 5 min. Apply magnetic rack and carefully transfer supernatant (eluate) to a new tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 向 beads 中加入 40–50 µL 2× Laemmli 上样缓冲液，95°C 煮沸 5 min，磁力架吸附后小心将上清（洗脱液）转入新管。

detailedSteps.en: Resolve IP eluates (IP sample, IgG control) and Input by SDS-PAGE, then transfer to membrane and perform Western blot. Probe for the target protein. Include Input as positive control to verify antibody and protein expression.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 IP 洗脱液（IP 样品、IgG 对照）和 Input 跑 SDS-PAGE 后转膜，Western Blot 检测目标蛋白，以 Input 为阳性对照验证抗体和蛋白表达。

name: Inclusion Body Solubilization and Protein Refolding
nameCn: 包涵体溶解与蛋白复性

components.name: 1. Isolate inclusion bodies: lyse cells, wash pellet 3× with wash buffer

note.en: Lyse in lysis_buffer_mild + 1% Triton X-100. Sonicate 3× 30 s on ice. Centrifuge 15,000×g 15 min 4°C. Keep pellet. Wash pellet 3× with wash buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5% Triton X-100) then 1× without Triton. Pellet = purified inclusion bodies.
note.zh: lysis_buffer_mild + 1% Triton X-100 裂解。冰上超声 3× 30 s。15,000×g 15 min 4°C。保留沉淀。洗涤缓冲液（50 mM Tris pH 8.0、100 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA、0.5% Triton X-100）洗 3 次，再无 Triton 洗 1 次。沉淀 = 纯化的包涵体。

components.name: 2. Solubilize: resuspend inclusion body pellet in denaturing buffer

note.en: Denaturing buffer: 6 M GuHCl (or 8 M urea), 50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM β-ME (or 5 mM DTT). Resuspend at 5–20 mg/mL. Stir/rotate at RT 1–2 h until completely dissolved (solution clears).
note.zh: 变性缓冲液：6 M 盐酸胍（或 8 M 尿素）、50 mM Tris pH 8.0、100 mM NaCl、10 mM β-ME（或 5 mM DTT）。5–20 mg/mL 重悬。RT 搅拌 1–2 h 至完全溶解（溶液变透明）。

note.en: Remove insoluble debris. Supernatant = denatured soluble protein. Check purity by SDS-PAGE.
note.zh: 去除不溶性碎片。上清 = 变性可溶蛋白。SDS-PAGE 检测纯度。

components.name: 4. Optional: Ni-NTA purification under denaturing conditions

note.en: Bind buffer: 6 M GuHCl, 50 mM NaH₂PO₄ pH 8.0, 300 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole. Wash: same + 20 mM imidazole. Elute: same + 250 mM imidazole. Pool eluted fractions.
note.zh: 结合缓冲液：6 M GuHCl、50 mM NaH₂PO₄ pH 8.0、300 mM NaCl、10 mM imidazole。洗涤：同上 + 20 mM imidazole。洗脱：同上 + 250 mM imidazole。合并洗脱组分。

note.en: Dilute protein dropwise into 50–100× volume ice-cold refolding buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM oxidized glutathione, 5 mM reduced glutathione, 10% glycerol) with constant stirring. Final protein: 0.01–0.1 mg/mL. Stir 4°C, 12–24 h.
note.zh: 蛋白逐滴加入 50–100 倍体积的冰冷复性缓冲液（50 mM Tris pH 8.0、150 mM NaCl、0.5 mM 氧化型谷胱甘肽、5 mM 还原型谷胱甘肽、10% 甘油），持续搅拌。终浓度 0.01–0.1 mg/mL。4°C 搅拌 12–24 h。

components.name: 6. Refolding Method B: Stepwise dialysis (higher yield)

note.en: Dialyze denatured protein against decreasing denaturant: 4 M → 2 M → 1 M → 0.5 M → 0 M urea in refolding buffer. Each step: 4°C, ≥4 h (or overnight). Slow removal of denaturant allows gradual refolding. protein_dialysis tubing or Slide-A-Lyzer.
note.zh: 变性蛋白对梯度去变性剂透析：4 M → 2 M → 1 M → 0.5 M → 0 M 尿素复性缓冲液。每步：4°C，≥4 h（或过夜）。缓慢去除变性剂促进逐步复性。protein_dialysis 透析袋或 Slide-A-Lyzer。

components.name: 7. Remove aggregates: centrifuge 20,000×g 30 min 4°C; filter 0.22 µm

note.en: Aggregated/misfolded protein pellets. Supernatant = soluble refolded protein. SEC (sec_purification) can separate properly folded monomers from misfolded aggregates.
note.zh: 聚集/错误折叠蛋白在沉淀中。上清 = 可溶复性蛋白。SEC（sec_purification）可分离正确折叠单体和错误折叠聚集体。

components.name: 8. Concentrate and verify activity: Amicon Ultra, then functional assay

note.en: protein_concentration_amicon. Verify folding: SEC (single peak), CD spectroscopy, thermal shift assay (DSF), enzyme activity assay. Typical refolding yield: 5–30% of total denatured protein.
note.zh: protein_concentration_amicon 浓缩。验证折叠：SEC（单峰）、CD 光谱、热迁移分析（DSF）、酶活力测定。典型复性产率：变性蛋白总量的 5–30%。

notes.en: Key factors affecting refolding: (1) Protein concentration during refolding (lower = better, ≤0.1 mg/mL); (2) Redox pair (GSH:GSSG 5:0.5 mM for disulfide-containing proteins); (3) Temperature (4°C preferred); (4) Additives: L-arginine (0.4–0.8 M) dramatically reduces aggregation (Tsumoto et al. 2004). Screen conditions with small-scale (1 mL) refolding trials before scale-up.
notes.zh: 影响复性的关键因素：(1) 复性时蛋白浓度（越低越好，≤0.1 mg/mL）；(2) 氧化还原对（含二硫键蛋白用 GSH:GSSG 5:0.5 mM）；(3) 温度（首选 4°C）；(4) 添加剂：L-精氨酸（0.4–0.8 M）显著减少聚集（Tsumoto et al. 2004）。大规模复性前先做小规模（1 mL）条件筛选。

ref: Singh (2015) Microb Cell Fact 14:41; Tsumoto et al. (2004) Biotechnol Prog 20:1301; Clark (2001) Curr Opin Biotechnol 12:202–207

usage.en: Solubilize and refold proteins from bacterial inclusion bodies using denaturant dilution or dialysis.
usage.zh: 变性剂稀释或透析法溶解和复性细菌包涵体蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 days，实操: 6 hours

materials.name: Solubilization buffer (6–8 M urea or guanidine HCl)

note.en: Solubilized inclusion bodies in denaturing buffer can be stored at −80°C for up to 1 month
note.zh: 变性缓冲液中的包涵体溶解液可 −80°C 保存最长 1 个月

note.en: Denatured protein purified by Ni-NTA can be stored at −80°C in elution buffer
note.zh: Ni-NTA 纯化的变性蛋白可在洗脱缓冲液中 −80°C 保存

note.en: Refolded, concentrated protein can be stored at 4°C short-term (days) or flash-frozen at −80°C with 10% glycerol for months
note.zh: 复性浓缩蛋白可 4°C 短期保存（数天）或加 10% 甘油液氮速冻后 −80°C 保存数月

briefSteps.en: Lyse bacteria → Wash IB pellet 3× → Solubilize in 6M GuHCl/8M urea → Clarify 20,000×g → (Optional Ni-NTA) → Refold by rapid dilution or stepwise dialysis → Remove aggregates → Concentrate → Verify folding by SEC/activity assay
briefSteps.zh: 裂解细菌 → 洗涤包涵体 3× → 6M GuHCl/8M 尿素溶解 → 20,000×g 澄清 → （可选 Ni-NTA）→ 快速稀释或逐步透析复性 → 去除聚集体 → 浓缩 → SEC/活性验证折叠

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Inclusion body isolation & solubilization**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 包涵体分离与溶解**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend bacterial pellet (from 500 mL–1 L culture) in 20 mL lysis buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1% Triton X-100, 1 mM PMSF, lysozyme 0.2 mg/mL). Incubate on ice 30 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 将细菌沉淀（来自 500 mL–1 L 培养物）重悬于 20 mL 裂解缓冲液（50 mM Tris pH 8.0、100 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA、1% Triton X-100、1 mM PMSF、溶菌酶 0.2 mg/mL）。冰上孵育 30 min。

detailedSteps.en: Sonicate on ice: 3 cycles × 30 s ON / 30 s OFF at 40% amplitude. Keep sample cold throughout.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上超声：3 个循环 × 30 s 开 / 30 s 关，40% 振幅。全程保持低温。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge lysate at 15,000×g for 15 min at 4°C. Discard supernatant. Keep pellet (inclusion bodies).
detailedSteps.zh: 15,000×g 离心 15 min，4°C。弃上清，保留沉淀（包涵体）。

detailedSteps.en: Wash pellet 3× with wash buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5% Triton X-100): resuspend by vortex, centrifuge 15,000×g 10 min 4°C each. Final wash without Triton.
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤缓冲液洗沉淀 3 次（50 mM Tris pH 8.0、100 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA、0.5% Triton X-100）：涡旋重悬，15,000×g 离心 10 min 4°C。最后一次洗不加 Triton。

detailedSteps.en: Solubilize IB pellet in denaturing buffer (6 M GuHCl or 8 M urea, 50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM β-ME) at 5–20 mg/mL. Stir/rotate at RT for 1–2 h until solution clears.
detailedSteps.zh: 将包涵体沉淀溶于变性缓冲液（6 M 盐酸胍或 8 M 尿素、50 mM Tris pH 8.0、100 mM NaCl、10 mM β-ME），浓度 5–20 mg/mL。室温搅拌 1–2 h 至溶液变透明。

detailedSteps.en: Clarify by centrifugation at 20,000×g for 30 min at 4°C. Collect supernatant (solubilized denatured protein). Check purity by SDS-PAGE.
detailedSteps.zh: 20,000×g 离心 30 min，4°C 澄清。收集上清（溶解的变性蛋白）。SDS-PAGE 检查纯度。

detailedSteps.en: **(Optional)** Purify under denaturing conditions by Ni-NTA: bind in 6 M GuHCl + 10 mM imidazole → wash 20 mM imidazole → elute 250 mM imidazole. Pool eluted fractions.
detailedSteps.zh: **（可选）**变性条件下 Ni-NTA 纯化：6 M GuHCl + 10 mM imidazole 结合→ 20 mM imidazole 洗涤→ 250 mM imidazole 洗脱。合并洗脱组分。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Refolding**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 蛋白复性**

detailedSteps.en: **Method A (Rapid dilution):** Dilute denatured protein dropwise into 50–100× volume ice-cold refolding buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM GSSG, 5 mM GSH, 10% glycerol) with constant stirring. Final protein ≤0.1 mg/mL. Stir at 4°C for 12–24 h.
detailedSteps.zh: **方法 A（快速稀释）：**将变性蛋白逐滴加入 50–100 倍体积冰冷复性缓冲液（50 mM Tris pH 8.0、150 mM NaCl、0.5 mM GSSG、5 mM GSH、10% 甘油），持续搅拌。终蛋白浓度 ≤0.1 mg/mL。4°C 搅拌 12–24 h。

detailedSteps.en: **Method B (Stepwise dialysis):** Dialyze against decreasing urea: 4 M → 2 M → 1 M → 0.5 M → 0 M in refolding buffer. Each step ≥4 h or overnight at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: **方法 B（逐步透析）：**对梯度尿素透析：4 M → 2 M → 1 M → 0.5 M → 0 M 复性缓冲液。每步 ≥4 h 或过夜，4°C。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2–3 — Aggregate removal & QC**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二至三天 — 去除聚集体与质检**

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge refolded protein at 20,000×g for 30 min at 4°C. Collect supernatant. Filter through 0.22 µm membrane.
detailedSteps.zh: 复性蛋白 20,000×g 离心 30 min，4°C。收集上清，0.22 µm 过滤。

detailedSteps.en: Concentrate using Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter (appropriate MWCO). Quantify by BCA or Bradford assay.
detailedSteps.zh: Amicon Ultra 超滤管（合适 MWCO）浓缩。BCA 或 Bradford 定量。

detailedSteps.en: Verify folding by SEC (single monomer peak), CD spectroscopy, thermal shift assay (DSF), or functional/enzyme activity assay. Typical refolding yield: 5–30%.
detailedSteps.zh: 验证折叠：SEC（单体单峰）、CD 光谱、热迁移分析（DSF）或功能/酶活力测定。典型复性产率：5–30%。

name: Ion Exchange Chromatography (IEX)

components.name: 1. Choose ion exchange type based on protein pI

note.en: Anion exchange (Q/DEAE): protein pI < buffer pH → protein (−) binds to resin (+). Cation exchange (SP/CM): protein pI > buffer pH → protein (+) binds to resin (−). For unknown pI: run at two pH values.
note.zh: 阴离子交换（Q/DEAE）：蛋白 pI < 缓冲液 pH → 蛋白带负电结合正电树脂。阳离子交换（SP/CM）：蛋白 pI > 缓冲液 pH → 蛋白带正电结合负电树脂。pI 未知时：在两个 pH 条件下试运行。

components.name: 2. Prepare sample: dialyze into low-salt IEX buffer; centrifuge 20,000×g 20 min; filter 0.22 µm

note.en: Anion: 20 mM Tris pH 8.0. Cation: 20 mM sodium acetate pH 5.5 or 20 mM MES pH 6.0. Conductivity <5 mS/cm for binding.
note.zh: 阴离子：20 mM Tris pH 8.0。阳离子：20 mM 醋酸钠 pH 5.5 或 20 mM MES pH 6.0。电导率 <5 mS/cm 以确保结合。

note.en: Flow rate: 1–2 mL/min (1 mL column) or 2–5 mL/min (5 mL column). Monitor A280 baseline stable.
note.zh: 流速：1–2 mL/min（1 mL 柱）或 2–5 mL/min（5 mL 柱）。监测 A280 基线稳定。

components.name: 4. Load sample: apply at 0.5–1 mL/min; collect flow-through for SDS-PAGE

note.en: Loading at ≤1 mL/min maximizes binding. Capacity: ~20 mg protein/mL resin (depends on charge/size).
note.zh: 上样流速 ≤1 mL/min 以最大化结合。容量：约 20 mg 蛋白/mL 树脂（取决于电荷/大小）。

components.name: 5. Wash: 5–10 CV binding buffer until A280 returns to baseline

note.en: Removes loosely bound contaminants.
note.zh: 去除弱结合的杂蛋白。

components.name: 6. Elute with linear gradient: 0–100% elution buffer over 20 CV

note.en: Elution buffer: binding buffer + 1 M NaCl. Gradient: 0→100% over 20 CV (e.g., 0→500 mM NaCl). Collect 1 mL fractions. Alternative: step gradient (0, 100, 250, 500 mM).
note.zh: 洗脱缓冲液：结合缓冲液 + 1 M NaCl。梯度：0→100% 20 CV（如 0→500 mM NaCl）。收集 1 mL 组分。也可阶梯梯度（0、100、250、500 mM）。

components.name: 7. Pool peak fractions; verify by SDS-PAGE

note.en: Pool symmetric peak. Asymmetric = multiple species.
note.zh: 合并对称峰。不对称 = 多种组分。

components.name: 8. Dialyze or desalting to remove salt for storage

note.en: dialysis_buffer_generic or HiTrap Desalting. Add 10% glycerol for storage.
note.zh: dialysis_buffer_generic 或 HiTrap Desalting 脱盐。加 10% 甘油保存。

notes.en: IEX is excellent for separating proteins by surface charge. Typically used after IMAC/GST (polishing step). Binding capacity: 10–40 mg/mL resin. Resolution depends on gradient length (longer = better). Run at 4°C for labile proteins. Buffer pH should be ≥1 pH unit away from protein pI for strong binding.
notes.zh: IEX 非常适合按表面电荷分离蛋白。通常在 IMAC/GST 后使用（精修步骤）。结合容量：10–40 mg/mL 树脂。分辨率取决于梯度长度（越长越好）。不稳定蛋白在 4°C 运行。缓冲液 pH 应距离蛋白 pI ≥1 个 pH 单位以确保强结合。

ref: GE Healthcare Ion Exchange Chromatography Manual; Shukla & Cramer (2011) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 67:8.2.1

usage.en: Separate proteins by charge using anion or cation exchange chromatography.
usage.zh: 阴离子/阳离子交换层析按电荷分离蛋白质。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 2 hours

materials.name: Q Sepharose or SP Sepharose resin

note.en: Strong anion/cation exchanger; HiTrap prepacked recommended
note.zh: 强阴离子/阳离子交换剂；推荐HiTrap预装柱

note.en: For anion exchange Buffer A
note.zh: 用于阴离子交换缓冲液A

note.en: For cation exchange Buffer A
note.zh: 用于阳离子交换缓冲液A

note.en: For elution gradient
note.zh: 用于洗脱梯度

note.en: For buffer and sample filtration
note.zh: 用于缓冲液和样品过滤

note.en: Or gravity flow for manual runs
note.zh: 或重力流用于手动操作

note.en: Amicon Ultra, appropriate MWCO
note.zh: Amicon Ultra，适当截留分子量

note.en: Dialyzed protein in low-salt buffer can be stored at 4°C overnight or at −80°C before loading onto the IEX column.
note.zh: 低盐缓冲液中的透析蛋白可在 4°C 保存过夜或 −80°C 冷冻后再上 IEX 柱。

note.en: Equilibrated column can be stored at 4°C in binding buffer overnight before sample loading.
note.zh: 已平衡的柱子可在 4°C 结合缓冲液中保存过夜后再上样。

note.en: Collected elution fractions can be stored at 4°C overnight or at −80°C before pooling and desalting.
note.zh: 收集到的洗脱组分可在 4°C 保存过夜或 −80°C 冷冻，合并脱盐后再处理。

briefSteps.en: Select anion (Q/DEAE, pI < pH) or cation (SP/CM, pI > pH) exchange resin → dialyze protein into low-salt buffer (conductivity <5 mS/cm) → equilibrate column → load sample → wash to baseline → elute with 0–500 mM NaCl linear gradient → pool and verify fractions by SDS-PAGE → desalt for storage
briefSteps.zh: 选择阴离子（Q/DEAE，pI < pH）或阳离子（SP/CM，pI > pH）交换树脂 → 将蛋白透析至低盐缓冲液（电导率 <5 mS/cm）→ 平衡柱子 → 上样 → 洗涤至基线 → 0–500 mM NaCl 线性梯度洗脱 → 合并峰组分并 SDS-PAGE 验证 → 脱盐后保存

detailedSteps.en: Determine appropriate ion exchange type based on protein pI: use anion exchange (Q or DEAE resin) if protein pI < buffer pH (protein is negatively charged); use cation exchange (SP or CM resin) if protein pI > buffer pH (protein is positively charged). Buffer pH should be ≥1 unit away from pI for strong binding.
detailedSteps.zh: 根据蛋白 pI 选择离子交换类型：若蛋白 pI < 缓冲液 pH（蛋白带负电），选阴离子交换（Q 或 DEAE 树脂）；若蛋白 pI > 缓冲液 pH（蛋白带正电），选阳离子交换（SP 或 CM 树脂）。缓冲液 pH 应距 pI ≥1 个单位以确保强结合。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare protein sample: dialyze into low-salt binding buffer (anion exchange: 20 mM Tris pH 8.0; cation exchange: 20 mM sodium acetate pH 5.5 or 20 mM MES pH 6.0). Centrifuge at 20,000×g for 20 min at 4°C, then filter through 0.22 µm. Conductivity must be <5 mS/cm.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备蛋白样品：透析至低盐结合缓冲液（阴离子交换：20 mM Tris pH 8.0；阳离子交换：20 mM 醋酸钠 pH 5.5 或 20 mM MES pH 6.0）。20,000×g、4°C 离心 20 min 后过 0.22 µm 膜。电导率须 <5 mS/cm。

detailedSteps.en: Equilibrate IEX column with 5 CV binding buffer at 1–2 mL/min (1 mL column) or 2–5 mL/min (5 mL column). Monitor A280 until baseline is stable and conductivity matches binding buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 5 CV 结合缓冲液以 1–2 mL/min（1 mL 柱）或 2–5 mL/min（5 mL 柱）平衡 IEX 柱。监测 A280 至基线稳定，且电导率与结合缓冲液一致。

detailedSteps.en: Load protein sample at ≤1 mL/min to maximize binding (capacity: ~20 mg protein/mL resin). Collect flow-through fraction — save an aliquot for SDS-PAGE to assess binding efficiency.
detailedSteps.zh: 以 ≤1 mL/min 上样以最大化结合（容量：约 20 mg 蛋白/mL 树脂）。收集穿透液组分——留样做 SDS-PAGE 评估结合效率。

detailedSteps.en: Wash with 5–10 CV binding buffer until A280 returns to baseline. This removes unbound and weakly bound contaminants. Collect wash fractions for SDS-PAGE analysis.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 5–10 CV 结合缓冲液洗涤至 A280 返回基线，去除未结合和弱结合的杂蛋白。收集洗涤液做 SDS-PAGE 分析。

detailedSteps.en: Elute bound protein with a linear gradient of 0–100% elution buffer (binding buffer + 1 M NaCl) over 20 CV (e.g., 0→500 mM NaCl). Collect 1 mL fractions. Alternative: step gradient at 100, 250, 500 mM NaCl.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 0–100% 洗脱缓冲液（结合缓冲液 + 1 M NaCl）在 20 CV 内线性梯度洗脱（如 0→500 mM NaCl）。收集 1 mL 组分。也可用阶梯梯度（100、250、500 mM NaCl）。

detailedSteps.en: Pool symmetric peak fractions. Run SDS-PAGE on all fractions spanning the peak to verify protein identity and purity. Asymmetric or split peaks indicate multiple protein species.
detailedSteps.zh: 合并对称峰组分。对覆盖峰值的所有组分进行 SDS-PAGE，验证蛋白身份和纯度。不对称或分裂峰表明存在多种蛋白组分。

detailedSteps.en: Desalt pooled fractions by dialysis against storage buffer (dialysis_buffer_generic) with 2 buffer changes at 4°C, or use HiTrap Desalting column. Add 10% glycerol and store at −80°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 将合并组分对储存缓冲液（dialysis_buffer_generic）于 4°C 换液 2 次透析脱盐，或用 HiTrap Desalting 柱脱盐。加 10% 甘油后 −80°C 保存。

name: Lentiviral Functional Titer (Infectious Units/mL)
nameCn: 慢病毒功能性滴度测定（感染单位/mL）

components.name: 1. Day 0: Seed HEK293T or HeLa cells in 24-well plate

note.en: 1×10⁵ cells/well (HEK293T) or 0.5×10⁵ (HeLa). Cells should be 20–30% confluent at time of infection (exponential growth). Avoid antibiotics.
note.zh: HEK293T：每孔 1×10⁵；HeLa：0.5×10⁵。感染时细胞汇合度 20–30%（指数生长期）。不加抗生素。

components.name: 2. Day 1: Prepare serial dilutions of virus (10-fold series)

note.en: In complete medium: undiluted, 1:10, 1:100, 1:1,000, 1:10,000. Add polybrene (8 µg/mL final). Infect in duplicate wells per dilution. Total volume: 500 µL/well.
note.zh: 完全培养基中：原液、1:10、1:100、1:1,000、1:10,000。加 Polybrene（终浓度 8 µg/mL）。每稀释度双复孔感染。每孔总体积 500 µL。

note.en: Increases transduction efficiency 2–5×. Preferred for hard-to-infect cells.
note.zh: 感染效率提高 2–5 倍。推荐用于难感染细胞。

components.name: 4. Day 2 (24 h): replace medium with fresh complete medium (remove virus)

note.en: Remove virus-containing medium to reduce toxicity.
note.zh: 去除含病毒培养基以减少毒性。

components.name: 5. Day 4–5 (72–96 h post-transduction): harvest cells for analysis

note.en: GFP/reporter virus: analyze by flow cytometry. Antibiotic resistance: fix at 72 h, select with antibiotic for 7 days, count colonies.
note.zh: GFP/报告基因病毒：流式细胞仪分析。抗生素抗性：72 h 固定，抗生素筛选 7 天，克隆计数。

note.en: Count % GFP+ cells (FITC channel). Gate on live cells (FSC/SSC + DAPI-). Use dilutions where 1–20% cells are GFP+ (linear range, MOI ≤0.2 ensures single integration).
note.zh: 计数 GFP+ 细胞百分比（FITC 通道）。门控活细胞（FSC/SSC + DAPI-）。使用 1–20% GFP+ 的稀释度（线性范围，MOI ≤0.2 确保单次整合）。

note.en: IU/mL = (% GFP+ / 100) × total cell count × dilution factor / volume infected (mL). Example: 10% GFP+, 10⁵ cells, 1:1,000 dilution, 0.5 mL → (0.10 × 10⁵ × 1,000) / 0.5 = 2×10⁷ IU/mL.

notes.en: Functional titer reports true infectious units (transducing units, TU). More accurate than p24 ELISA for biological experiments. Use MOI ≤0.2 for titer calculation (Poisson distribution: ensures single integration events). For non-GFP vectors, use qPCR-based titer: measure proviral DNA copies per cell at 72 h post-transduction.
notes.zh: 功能性滴度报告真实感染单位（转导单位，TU）。生物学实验比 p24 ELISA 更准确。计算滴度时 MOI ≤0.2（泊松分布确保单次整合事件）。非 GFP 载体可用 qPCR 法：72 h 后测每个细胞中病毒 DNA 拷贝数。

ref: Kutner et al. (2009) Nat Protoc 4:495–505; Geraerts et al. (2006) Gene Ther 13:1294–1304; Salmon & Trono (2006) Curr Protoc Hum Genet 12.10.1

usage.en: Determine functional lentiviral titer by serial dilution and colony counting or antibiotic selection.
usage.zh: 连续稀释法通过菌落计数或抗生素筛选测定慢病毒功能性滴度。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 4–5 days，实操: 3 hours

note.en: After seeding cells (Day 0), cells attach overnight — natural stopping point
note.zh: 接种细胞后（第 0 天），细胞过夜贴壁 — 自然停止点
