note.en: After medium change (Day 2), wait 48–72 h for reporter expression before analysis
note.zh: 换液后（第 2 天），等待 48–72 h 报告基因表达后再分析

briefSteps.en: Seed cells (Day 0) → serial dilution + polybrene transduction (Day 1) → medium change (Day 2) → flow cytometry for GFP⁺ % (Day 4–5) → calculate IU/mL
briefSteps.zh: 接种细胞（第 0 天）→ 梯度稀释 + Polybrene 转导（第 1 天）→ 换液（第 2 天）→ 流式检测 GFP⁺ %（第 4–5 天）→ 计算 IU/mL

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0 — Seed Target Cells**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 0 天 — 接种靶细胞**

detailedSteps.en: Seed HEK293T (1×10⁵/well) or HeLa (0.5×10⁵/well) in 24-well plate with 500 µL complete DMEM. Cells should be 20–30% confluent at time of infection. Do not add antibiotics
detailedSteps.zh: 在 24 孔板中接种 HEK293T（1×10⁵/孔）或 HeLa（0.5×10⁵/孔），500 µL 完全 DMEM。感染时细胞汇合度应为 20–30%。不加抗生素

detailedSteps.en: Incubate overnight at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for cell attachment
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 过夜孵育使细胞贴壁

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Viral Transduction**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 1 天 — 病毒转导**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare 10-fold serial dilutions of viral supernatant in complete medium: undiluted, 1:10, 1:100, 1:1,000, 1:10,000. Add polybrene to 8 µg/mL final concentration
detailedSteps.zh: 用完全培养基配制 10 倍梯度稀释的病毒上清：原液、1:10、1:100、1:1,000、1:10,000。加入 Polybrene 至终浓度 8 µg/mL

detailedSteps.en: Replace medium with 500 µL virus dilution per well (duplicate wells per dilution). Include uninfected control wells
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔换 500 µL 病毒稀释液（每个稀释度双复孔）。设未感染对照孔

detailedSteps.en: Optional: spinoculation at 800×g, 30 min at RT to enhance transduction 2–5×
detailedSteps.zh: 可选：800×g 室温离心 30 min 以增强转导效率 2–5 倍

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ overnight
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 过夜孵育

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Medium Change**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 2 天 — 换液**

detailedSteps.en: Remove virus-containing medium. Replace with 500 µL fresh complete DMEM (no polybrene) to reduce cytotoxicity
detailedSteps.zh: 去除含病毒培养基。换 500 µL 新鲜完全 DMEM（不加 Polybrene）以减少细胞毒性

detailedSteps.en: **Day 4–5 — Harvest & Analysis**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 4–5 天 — 收获与分析**

detailedSteps.en: Trypsinize cells and resuspend in FACS buffer. For GFP/fluorescent reporters: analyze by flow cytometry (FITC channel). Gate on live cells (FSC/SSC + DAPI⁻)
detailedSteps.zh: 胰酶消化细胞并用 FACS 缓冲液重悬。GFP/荧光报告基因：流式细胞仪分析（FITC 通道）。门控活细胞（FSC/SSC + DAPI⁻）

detailedSteps.en: Use dilutions where 1–20% of cells are GFP⁺ (linear range, MOI ≤0.2 ensures single integration events per Poisson distribution)
detailedSteps.zh: 选择 1–20% GFP⁺ 的稀释度（线性范围，MOI ≤0.2 确保泊松分布下的单次整合事件）

detailedSteps.en: Calculate titer: IU/mL = (% GFP⁺ / 100) × total cell count × dilution factor / volume infected (mL). Report average of duplicate wells
detailedSteps.zh: 计算滴度：IU/mL = (% GFP⁺ / 100) × 细胞总数 × 稀释倍数 / 感染体积 (mL)。报告双复孔的平均值

name: Lentiviral Titer Determination by p24 ELISA
nameCn: 慢病毒滴度测定（p24 ELISA 法）

components.name: 1. Prepare standard: serial dilutions of p24 antigen (0–2,000 pg/mL)

note.en: Use kit-provided p24 standard. Typical 8-point curve: 2000, 1000, 500, 250, 125, 62.5, 31.25, 0 pg/mL in assay diluent. Prepare fresh each time.
note.zh: 使用试剂盒提供的 p24 标准品。典型 8 点曲线：2000、1000、500、250、125、62.5、31.25、0 pg/mL（用稀释液配制）。每次新鲜配制。

components.name: 2. Lyse virus: add Triton X-100 to virus sample (final 0.5%); incubate RT 1 h

note.en: Lysis disrupts viral envelope and releases p24 from intact virions. Mix gently. Dilute sample in assay diluent: test 1:10, 1:100 dilutions to fall within standard curve range.
note.zh: 裂解破坏病毒包膜，释放完整病毒颗粒中的 p24。轻柔混合。用稀释液稀释样品：测试 1:10、1:100 稀释，使读数落在标准曲线范围内。

components.name: 3. Coat ELISA plate: add anti-p24 capture antibody (2 µg/mL, 100 µL/well), 4°C overnight

note.en: Or use pre-coated kit plates (skip this step). Coating buffer: 0.05 M carbonate pH 9.6. Seal plate.
note.zh: 或使用试剂盒预包被板（跳过此步）。包被缓冲液：0.05 M 碳酸盐 pH 9.6。封板。

components.name: 4. Block: 200 µL/well 5% BSA in PBS-T; RT 1 h; wash 3× PBST

note.en: PBST: PBS + 0.05% Tween-20. Washing: 300 µL/well, 3×; flick and blot each wash.
note.zh: PBST：PBS + 0.05% Tween-20。洗涤：每孔 300 µL，3 次；每次甩干并吸干。

components.name: 5. Add standards and samples (100 µL/well); RT 2 h or 4°C overnight

note.en: Duplicates for all. Shake plate gently at 150 rpm during incubation (orbital shaker).
note.zh: 所有样品做双复孔。孵育期间轻摇（150 rpm，摇床）。

components.name: 6. Wash 5× PBST; add detection antibody (anti-p24-HRP, 100 µL/well); RT 1 h

note.en: Dilute HRP-conjugated secondary per kit instructions (typically 1:1,000–1:5,000 in blocking buffer).
note.zh: 按试剂盒说明稀释 HRP 偶联二抗（通常封闭液 1:1,000–1:5,000）。

components.name: 7. Wash 5× PBST; add TMB substrate (100 µL/well); RT 15–30 min (dark)

note.en: Monitor color development (blue). Stop when highest standard is deep blue (~OD 2.0 at 450 nm).
note.zh: 监测显色（蓝色）。最高标准品显深蓝色时终止（450 nm OD ~2.0）。

components.name: 8. Stop reaction: add 50 µL 2 M H₂SO₄ (solution turns yellow)

note.en: Read A₄₅₀ nm within 30 min of stopping.
note.zh: 终止后 30 min 内读取 A₄₅₀ nm。

components.name: 9. Calculate titer: read pg/mL from standard curve; convert to IU/mL

note.en: Conversion: 1 ng p24 ≈ 10⁶–10⁷ IU (varies by vector/envelope). Accurate IU requires functional titer (lentiviral_titer_functional). ng/mL → pg/µL; multiply by dilution factor.
note.zh: 转换：1 ng p24 ≈ 10⁶–10⁷ IU（随载体/包膜变化）。精确 IU 需功能性滴度（lentiviral_titer_functional）。ng/mL → pg/µL；乘以稀释倍数得原液浓度。

notes.en: p24 ELISA measures total physical particles (infectious + non-infectious). Ratio of physical particles to infectious units: ~100:1. Recommended kits: Alliance HIV-1 p24 ANTIGEN ELISA (Perkin Elmer), INNOTEST HIV Antigen mAb. Typical unconcentrated lentiviral supernatant: 50–200 ng/mL p24 = ~5×10⁷–2×10⁸ physical particles/mL.
notes.zh: p24 ELISA 测定物理颗粒总数（含感染性和非感染性）。物理颗粒与感染单位比例约 100:1。推荐试剂盒：Alliance HIV-1 p24 ANTIGEN ELISA（Perkin Elmer）、INNOTEST HIV Antigen mAb。典型未浓缩慢病毒上清：50–200 ng/mL p24 ≈ 5×10⁷–2×10⁸ 物理颗粒/mL。

ref: Kutner et al. (2009) Nat Protoc 4:495–505; Geraerts et al. (2006) Gene Ther 13:1294–1299; Perkin Elmer Alliance p24 ELISA kit manual

usage.en: Quantify lentiviral particles using p24 capsid protein ELISA.
usage.zh: p24 衣壳蛋白 ELISA 定量慢病毒颗粒数。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 3 hours

note.en: Lysed virus samples can be stored at -80°C before ELISA
note.zh: 裂解后的病毒样品可在 -80°C 保存后再进行 ELISA

note.en: After coating plate overnight at 4°C — plate is ready for blocking next morning
note.zh: 4°C 过夜包被后 — 次日早晨即可进行封闭

note.en: After sample incubation, plate can be stored at 4°C overnight before detection antibody step
note.zh: 样品孵育后，板可 4°C 过夜保存，次日再加检测抗体

briefSteps.en: Lyse virus (Triton X-100) → prepare p24 standards → coat ELISA plate O/N → block → add samples 2 h → detection Ab 1 h → TMB substrate → stop (H₂SO₄) → read A₄₅₀ → calculate titer
briefSteps.zh: 裂解病毒（Triton X-100）→ 配标准品 → ELISA 板过夜包被 → 封闭 → 加样品 2 h → 检测抗体 1 h → TMB 底物 → 终止（H₂SO₄）→ 读取 A₄₅₀ → 计算滴度

detailedSteps.en: **Virus Lysis & Standard Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **病毒裂解与标准品制备**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare p24 standard serial dilutions: 2000, 1000, 500, 250, 125, 62.5, 31.25, 0 pg/mL in assay diluent. Prepare fresh each time
Lyse viral samples: add Triton X-100 to 0.5% final concentration. Incubate at RT for 1 h to disrupt viral envelope and release p24 from intact virions
detailedSteps.zh: 裂解病毒样品：加入 Triton X-100 至终浓度 0.5%。室温孵育 1 h 以破坏病毒包膜释放 p24

detailedSteps.en: Prepare sample dilutions in assay diluent: test 1:10 and 1:100 to ensure readings fall within standard curve range
detailedSteps.zh: 用检测稀释液配制样品稀释液：测试 1:10 和 1:100 以确保读数在标准曲线范围内

detailedSteps.en: **ELISA Plate Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **ELISA 板制备**

detailedSteps.en: Coat 96-well ELISA plate with anti-p24 capture antibody (2 µg/mL in 0.05 M carbonate buffer pH 9.6, 100 µL/well). Seal plate and incubate at 4°C overnight (or use pre-coated kit plate — skip to blocking)
detailedSteps.zh: 96 孔 ELISA 板包被 anti-p24 捕获抗体（2 µg/mL，0.05 M 碳酸盐缓冲液 pH 9.6，100 µL/孔）。封板 4°C 过夜（或使用试剂盒预包被板 — 跳至封闭步骤）

detailedSteps.en: Block with 200 µL/well 5% BSA in PBS-T (PBS + 0.05% Tween-20) at RT for 1 h. Wash 3× with 300 µL/well PBST (flick and blot)
detailedSteps.zh: 200 µL/孔 5% BSA-PBST（PBS + 0.05% Tween-20）封闭，室温 1 h。300 µL/孔 PBST 洗涤 3 次（甩干并吸干）

detailedSteps.en: **Sample Incubation & Detection**
detailedSteps.zh: **样品孵育与检测**

detailedSteps.en: Add 100 µL/well of standards and diluted samples (in duplicate). Incubate at RT for 2 h on orbital shaker at 150 rpm (or 4°C overnight)
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 100 µL 标准品和稀释样品（双复孔）。室温摇床 150 rpm 孵育 2 h（或 4°C 过夜）

detailedSteps.en: Wash 5× with PBST. Add 100 µL/well HRP-conjugated anti-p24 detection antibody (diluted per kit instructions, typically 1:1,000–1:5,000 in blocking buffer). Incubate at RT for 1 h
detailedSteps.zh: PBST 洗涤 5 次。每孔加 100 µL HRP 偶联的 anti-p24 检测抗体（按试剂盒说明稀释，通常封闭液 1:1,000–1:5,000）。室温孵育 1 h

detailedSteps.en: Wash 5× with PBST. Add 100 µL/well TMB substrate. Incubate at RT for 15–30 min in the dark, monitoring color development (blue). Stop when highest standard reaches OD ~2.0 at 450 nm
detailedSteps.zh: PBST 洗涤 5 次。每孔加 100 µL TMB 底物。室温避光孵育 15–30 min，监测显色（蓝色）。最高标准品 OD 450 nm 达 ~2.0 时终止

detailedSteps.en: Add 50 µL/well 2 M H₂SO₄ to stop reaction (color turns yellow). Read absorbance at 450 nm within 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 50 µL 2 M H₂SO₄ 终止反应（颜色变黄）。30 min 内读取 450 nm 吸光度

detailedSteps.en: **Data Analysis**
detailedSteps.zh: **数据分析**

detailedSteps.en: Plot standard curve (4-parameter logistic fit). Calculate p24 concentration (pg/mL) from sample OD values. Convert: 1 ng p24 ≈ 10⁶–10⁷ IU (varies by vector). Multiply by dilution factor for stock concentration
detailedSteps.zh: 绘制标准曲线（四参数 Logistic 拟合）。从样品 OD 值计算 p24 浓度 (pg/mL)。换算：1 ng p24 ≈ 10⁶–10⁷ IU（因载体而异）。乘以稀释倍数得到原液浓度

name: Lentivirus Production & Transduction

components.name: 1. Day −1: Seed 4×10⁶ HEK293T cells in 10 cm dish (DMEM + 10% FBS)

note.en: Cells should be 70–80% confluent on Day 0. Do not use antibiotics (impairs transfection).
note.zh: Day 0 细胞汇合度应为 70–80%。不用抗生素（影响转染效率）。

note.en: DNA ratio: Transfer vector : psPAX2 : pMD2.G = 4:3:1 (µg). E.g., 10 µg : 7.5 µg : 2.5 µg per 10 cm dish. Total DNA: 20 µg. Dilute in 500 µL Opti-MEM.
note.zh: 质粒比例：转移载体 : psPAX2 : pMD2.G = 4:3:1（µg）。10 cm 皿：10 µg : 7.5 µg : 2.5 µg。总 DNA：20 µg。加入 500 µL Opti-MEM 稀释。

components.name: 3. Day 0: Prepare transfection reagent (PEI or Lipo2000)

note.en: PEI (1 mg/mL linear PEI, MW 25,000): add 60 µL (3:1 PEI:DNA ratio by µg) to 500 µL Opti-MEM; mix 5 min RT. Add PEI+Opti-MEM to DNA+Opti-MEM; mix gently; incubate 20 min RT. Add dropwise to cells.
note.zh: PEI（1 mg/mL 线性 PEI，MW 25,000）：60 µL PEI（PEI:DNA = 3:1 质量比）加入 500 µL Opti-MEM，RT 5 min。PEI+Opti-MEM 加入 DNA+Opti-MEM，轻柔混合，RT 20 min。逐滴加入细胞。

components.name: 4. Day 1 (16–18 h): Replace medium with 12 mL fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 10 mM HEPES

note.en: HEPES stabilizes virus at neutral pH. Medium change reduces transfection reagent toxicity. Do gently to avoid detaching 293T cells.
note.zh: HEPES 在中性 pH 下稳定病毒。换液减少转染试剂毒性。操作要轻柔，避免 293T 细胞脱落。

components.name: 5. Day 2 (48 h): First harvest — collect all supernatant; add 12 mL fresh medium

note.en: Filter through 0.45 µm PES membrane (NOT nitrocellulose — binds VSV-G). Keep harvest at 4°C or process immediately.
note.zh: 0.45 µm PES 膜过滤（不用硝酸纤维素膜——会结合 VSV-G）。上清 4°C 保存或立即处理。

components.name: 6. Day 3 (72 h): Second harvest — collect supernatant; pool with Day 2

note.en: Pool Day 2 + Day 3 harvests. Day 3 typically higher titer.
note.zh: 合并 Day 2 + Day 3 上清。Day 3 通常滴度更高。

components.name: 7. Concentrate virus (optional): 10,000×g 4°C 16 h (ultracentrifuge) or PEG precipitation

note.en: Ultracentrifugation: 25,000 rpm (SW-28 rotor) 2 h 4°C; resuspend pellet in PBS + 1% BSA. PEG-it (System Bio): add 1:4 PEG-it, 4°C overnight, 1,500×g 30 min 4°C.
note.zh: 超速离心：25,000 rpm（SW-28 转头）4°C 2 h；沉淀用 PBS + 1% BSA 重悬。PEG-it 沉淀：1:4 PEG-it，4°C 过夜，1,500×g 4°C 30 min。

components.name: 8. Titer determination: p24 ELISA or functional titer (IU/mL)

note.en: See lentiviral_titer_p24 or lentiviral_titer_functional. Typical unconcentrated: 10⁶–10⁷ IU/mL; concentrated: 10⁸–10⁹ IU/mL.
note.zh: 参见 lentiviral_titer_p24 或 lentiviral_titer_functional。未浓缩：10⁶–10⁷ IU/mL；浓缩后：10⁸–10⁹ IU/mL。

components.name: 9. Transduce target cells: virus + polybrene (8 µg/mL); MOI 0.3–5

note.en: MOI 0.3–1 for stable integration (low MOI ensures single integration). MOI 5–10 for transient or high-expression needs. Spinoculation optional (800×g 30 min RT) to increase efficiency.
note.zh: MOI 0.3–1 用于稳转（低 MOI 确保单拷贝整合）。MOI 5–10 用于瞬时或高表达需求。离心感染（800×g 30 min RT）可选，提高效率。

components.name: 10. Day 2 post-transduction: replace medium; Day 3+: add selection (Puromycin 1–2 µg/mL)

note.en: Kill curve: first establish Puromycin kill curve in untransduced cells (48–72 h for clean kill). GFP-virus: verify by flow cytometry before antibiotic selection.
note.zh: 先在未转导细胞中建立嘌呤霉素杀灭曲线（48–72 h 彻底杀灭）。GFP 病毒：抗生素筛选前先用流式细胞仪验证。

components.name: 11. Store virus: −80°C in single-use aliquots; avoid freeze-thaw

note.en: VSV-G lentivirus loses ~50% titer per freeze-thaw cycle. Add 10% trehalose or sucrose as cryoprotectant.
note.zh: VSV-G 慢病毒每次冻融损失约 50% 滴度。可加 10% 海藻糖或蔗糖作冻存保护剂。

notes.en: BSL-2 work: use BSL-2 practices for VSV-G pseudotyped virus. HEK293T must be >85% confluent at transfection. P24 ELISA: 1 ng p24 ≈ 10⁷ IU/mL (approximate). Typical issues: low titer → check psPAX2/pMD2.G ratio, 293T health; no selection → confirm antibiotic resistance in plasmid.
notes.zh: 生物安全：VSV-G 假型慢病毒需 BSL-2 操作。转染时 HEK293T 需 >85% 汇合度。P24 ELISA：1 ng p24 ≈ 10⁷ IU/mL（近似）。常见问题：滴度低→检查包装质粒比例、293T 细胞状态；无筛选→确认质粒含抗生素耐药基因。

ref: Tiscornia et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:241–245; Mochizuki et al. (1998) J Virol 72:8873; Kutner et al. (2009) Nat Protoc 4:495–505

usage.en: Produce lentiviral particles by transient transfection of HEK293T cells with packaging plasmids.
usage.zh: 瞬时转染 HEK293T 细胞生产慢病毒颗粒。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 5–7 days，实操: 3 hours

note.en: For transfection complex
note.zh: 用于转染复合物

note.en: Or PEI (1:3 DNA:PEI ratio)
note.zh: 或 PEI（DNA:PEI = 1:3）

note.en: 15 µg per 10 cm dish
note.zh: 每 10 cm 皿 15 µg

note.en: 10 µg
note.zh: 10 µg

note.en: 5 µg
note.zh: 5 µg

note.en: For transduction
note.zh: 用于转导

note.en: For selection
note.zh: 用于筛选

note.en: PES or PVDF
note.zh: PES 或 PVDF

note.en: After Day 1 medium change, cells incubate overnight; Day 2 harvest proceeds next morning.
note.zh: Day 1 换液后细胞过夜孵育，次日进行 Day 2 收获。

note.en: Filtered Day 2 harvest can be held at 4°C up to 48 h while awaiting the Day 3 harvest before pooling and processing.
note.zh: Day 2 过滤上清可 4°C 保存最长 48 h，等 Day 3 收获后合并处理。

note.en: Aliquoted virus at −80°C is stable for up to 12 months; transduce target cells at any convenient time.
note.zh: 分装病毒 −80°C 保存，最长可稳定 12 个月，可在合适时间转导靶细胞。

briefSteps.en: Day −1: seed HEK293T → Day 0: prepare 3-plasmid mix (transfer:psPAX2:pMD2.G = 4:3:1) + PEI, transfect → Day 1: replace medium → Day 2 & 3: harvest supernatant, filter 0.45 µm → concentrate (optional) → titer → transduce target cells with polybrene → select stable integrants
briefSteps.zh: Day −1 接种 HEK293T → Day 0 制备三质粒混合液（4:3:1）+ PEI 转染 → Day 1 换液 → Day 2 & 3 收获上清 0.45 µm 过滤 → 可选浓缩 → 滴度测定 → 聚凝胺协助转导靶细胞 → 筛选稳转株

detailedSteps.en: Day −1 — Packaging
detailedSteps.zh: Day −1 — 病毒包装准备

detailedSteps.en: Day −1: Seed 4×10⁶ HEK293T cells (passage <20) per 10 cm dish in 10 mL complete DMEM without antibiotics; cells should reach 70–80% confluency by Day 0.
detailedSteps.zh: Day −1：在无抗生素完全 DMEM 中将 4×10⁶ HEK293T 细胞（代次 <20）接种至 10 cm 皿，Day 0 汇合度应达 70–80%。

detailedSteps.en: Day 0 — Transfection
detailedSteps.zh: Day 0 — 转染

detailedSteps.en: Day 0: Prepare DNA mix in 500 µL Opti-MEM: transfer vector 10 µg + psPAX2 7.5 µg + pMD2.G 2.5 µg (ratio 4:3:1; total 20 µg). Mix gently.
detailedSteps.zh: Day 0：在 500 µL Opti-MEM 中制备质粒混合液：转移载体 10 µg + psPAX2 7.5 µg + pMD2.G 2.5 µg（比例 4:3:1，总计 20 µg），轻混。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare PEI solution: add 60 µL of 1 mg/mL linear PEI (MW 25,000) to 500 µL Opti-MEM; mix 5 min at RT, then combine with DNA tube; mix gently and incubate 20 min at RT to form PEI-DNA complexes.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备 PEI 溶液：60 µL 1 mg/mL 线性 PEI（MW 25,000）加入 500 µL Opti-MEM，RT 混合 5 min，然后与 DNA 混合管合并，轻混后 RT 孵育 20 min 形成 PEI-DNA 复合物。

detailedSteps.en: Add PEI-DNA complex dropwise to HEK293T cells; gently swirl to distribute. Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 PEI-DNA 复合物逐滴加入 HEK293T 细胞，轻柔晃动，37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1 — Medium Change
detailedSteps.zh: Day 1 — 换液

detailedSteps.en: Day 1 (16–18 h post-transfection): Carefully aspirate medium and replace with 12 mL fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 10 mM HEPES. Work gently to avoid detaching 293T cells.
detailedSteps.zh: Day 1（转染后 16–18 h）：轻柔吸去培养基，换成 12 mL 新鲜 DMEM + 10% FBS + 10 mM HEPES，操作要轻避免 293T 细胞脱落。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2–3 — Harvest
detailedSteps.zh: Day 2–3 — 收获

detailedSteps.en: Day 2 (48 h): Collect all supernatant; immediately filter through a 0.45 µm PES syringe filter (NOT nitrocellulose). Store filtrate at 4°C. Add 12 mL fresh medium back to cells.
detailedSteps.zh: Day 2（48 h）：收集全部上清，立即经 0.45 µm PES 注射器滤膜过滤（不用硝酸纤维素膜）。滤液 4°C 保存。补回 12 mL 新鲜培养基。

detailedSteps.en: Day 3 (72 h): Collect second harvest supernatant; filter through 0.45 µm PES and pool with Day 2 harvest. Day 3 typically gives higher titer.
detailedSteps.zh: Day 3（72 h）：收集第二次上清，0.45 µm PES 过滤后与 Day 2 上清合并，Day 3 通常滴度更高。

detailedSteps.en: Concentration & Titration (optional)
detailedSteps.zh: 浓缩与滴度测定（可选）

detailedSteps.en: Optional concentration: ultracentrifuge at 25,000 rpm (SW-28 rotor), 4°C, 2 h; resuspend pellet in PBS + 1% BSA. Expected titer: unconcentrated 10⁶–10⁷ IU/mL; concentrated 10⁸–10⁹ IU/mL.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选浓缩：25,000 rpm（SW-28 转头）4°C 超速离心 2 h；PBS + 1% BSA 重悬沉淀。预期滴度：未浓缩 10⁶–10⁷ IU/mL；浓缩后 10⁸–10⁹ IU/mL。

detailedSteps.en: Determine viral titer by p24 ELISA or functional transduction assay. Aliquot virus into single-use tubes; store at −80°C. Add 10% trehalose or sucrose as cryoprotectant to minimize freeze-thaw loss.
detailedSteps.zh: 通过 p24 ELISA 或功能滴度检测病毒滴度。分装至一次性用量管 −80°C 保存，加 10% 海藻糖或蔗糖作冻存保护剂减少冻融损失。

detailedSteps.en: Transduction of Target Cells
detailedSteps.zh: 靶细胞转导

detailedSteps.en: Transduce target cells with lentivirus at MOI 0.3–1 (for stable single-integration) in the presence of 8 µg/mL polybrene. Optional spinoculation: 800 × g, 30 min, RT to increase efficiency.
detailedSteps.zh: 用慢病毒以 MOI 0.3–1（稳转单拷贝整合）在 8 µg/mL 聚凝胺存在下转导靶细胞。可选离心感染：800 × g、RT 30 min 提高效率。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2 post-transduction: replace medium. Day 3+: begin antibiotic selection (e.g., puromycin 1–2 µg/mL; first establish a kill curve in untransduced cells).
detailedSteps.zh: 转导后 Day 2 换液；Day 3 起加抗生素筛选（如嘌呤霉素 1–2 µg/mL；先在未转导细胞中建立杀灭曲线）。

name: Lipofection Transfection Protocol

components.name: 1. 转染前一天铺板 (60–80% 汇合度)
2. 管 A: 质粒 DNA in Opti-MEM

note.en: Per well of 6-well plate
note.zh: 每孔 6-well

note.en: DNA:Lipofectamine = 1:3
note.zh: DNA 与脂质体比例 = 1:3

components.name: 6. 6–8 h 后换新鲜完全培养基

notes.en: siRNA: 25–50 pmol per well + 5 µL Lipo RNAiMAX. Switching to serum-free medium before transfection improves efficiency.
notes.zh: siRNA 转染: 每孔 25–50 pmol siRNA + 5 µL Lipo RNAiMAX。转染前换无血清培养基效果更好。DNA:Lipo 比例需优化 (1:2–1:4)。

ref: Dalby et al. (2004) Methods 33:95–103; Thermo Fisher Lipofectamine Protocol

usage.en: Introduce exogenous DNA or RNA into mammalian cells using lipid-based transfection.
usage.zh: 脂质体法将外源 DNA 或 RNA 导入哺乳动物细胞。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 days，实操: 1 hour

note.en: Serum-free media for complex formation
note.zh: 无血清培养基，用于复合物形成

note.en: Or RNAiMAX for siRNA
note.zh: 或 RNAiMAX（用于 siRNA）

note.en: Endotoxin-free prep
note.zh: 无内毒素制备

note.en: For recovery after transfection
note.zh: 转染后恢复培养用

note.en: Cells plate overnight to reach optimal confluency; proceed next morning
note.zh: 细胞过夜铺板至最佳汇合度；次日早上继续

note.en: After replacing media, cells incubate 24–72 h for expression; harvest time is flexible
note.zh: 换液后细胞孵育 24–72 h 待表达；收获时间灵活

briefSteps.en: Plate cells day before → prepare DNA/Lipofectamine in Opti-MEM separately → mix and incubate 15–20 min → add complex dropwise to cells → replace medium after 6–8 h → harvest at 24–72 h
briefSteps.zh: 前一天铺板 → 分别在 Opti-MEM 中稀释 DNA 和 Lipofectamine → 混合孵育 15–20 min → 逐滴加入细胞 → 6–8 h 后换液 → 24–72 h 后检测表达

detailedSteps.en: Day −1: Seed cells in antibiotic-free complete medium in a 6-well plate (~3–5×10⁵ cells/well) to reach 60–80% confluency by next day.
detailedSteps.zh: 前一天（Day −1）：在不含抗生素的完全培养基中将细胞接种至 6 孔板（约 3–5×10⁵ 个/孔），使次日汇合度达 60–80%。

detailedSteps.en: Day 0 — Tube A: Dilute 2.5 µg plasmid DNA (per well) in 125 µL Opti-MEM; mix gently. For siRNA: use 25–50 pmol siRNA in 125 µL Opti-MEM.
detailedSteps.zh: Day 0 — 管 A：将 2.5 µg 质粒 DNA（每孔）稀释至 125 µL Opti-MEM，轻柔混匀。siRNA 转染：25–50 pmol siRNA 稀释至 125 µL Opti-MEM。

detailedSteps.en: Tube B: Dilute 7.5 µL Lipofectamine 2000 (or 3000) in 125 µL Opti-MEM; mix gently and incubate 5 min at room temperature.
detailedSteps.zh: 管 B：将 7.5 µL Lipofectamine 2000（或 3000）稀释至 125 µL Opti-MEM，轻混后室温孵育 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Combine Tube A and Tube B; mix gently by pipetting 3–5 times; incubate the combined mixture at room temperature for 15–20 min to form lipoplexes.
detailedSteps.zh: 将管 A 和管 B 混合，轻柔吹打 3–5 次，室温孵育 15–20 min 形成脂质复合物。

detailedSteps.en: Optional: Replace cell medium with 1.5 mL fresh Opti-MEM (serum-free) per well immediately before adding the complex to improve efficiency.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选：加入复合物前立即将细胞培养基换成每孔 1.5 mL 新鲜 Opti-MEM（无血清），以提高转染效率。

detailedSteps.en: Add the 250 µL lipoplex complex dropwise to each well; gently rock the plate to distribute evenly. Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 250 µL 脂质复合物逐滴加入每孔，轻柔晃动培养板使其均匀分布，37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育。

detailedSteps.en: After 6–8 h, replace the medium with fresh complete medium (with antibiotics and serum) to reduce lipofection toxicity.
detailedSteps.zh: 6–8 h 后，换成含抗生素和血清的新鲜完全培养基，以减少脂质体转染毒性。

detailedSteps.en: Assess transfection efficiency at 24 h (e.g., GFP fluorescence, reporter assay) and harvest cells at 24–72 h post-transfection depending on the protein turnover rate.
detailedSteps.zh: 转染后 24 h 评估转染效率（如 GFP 荧光、报告基因检测），根据蛋白周转速率在 24–72 h 收获细胞。

name: Lysosome Isolation by Differential and Density Gradient Centrifugation
nameCn: 溶酶体分离（差速离心 + 密度梯度法）

components.name: 1. Seed 5×10⁷–1×10⁸ cells; wash 2× ice-cold PBS; scrape on ice

note.en: Use HeLa, HEK293, fibroblasts or liver tissue (100–200 mg). Scale up for low-yield cell types. Pre-chill all equipment at 4°C overnight.
note.zh: 使用 HeLa、HEK293、成纤维细胞或肝组织（100–200 mg）。低产量细胞类型需放大规模。所有器材 4°C 预冷过夜。

components.name: 2. Resuspend in 1 mL cold sucrose_gradient_homog buffer (250 mM sucrose, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4)

note.en: Per 5×10⁷ cells. Include protease inhibitors + 1 mM PMSF.
note.zh: 每 5×10⁷ 细胞用 1 mL。加蛋白酶抑制剂 + 1 mM PMSF。

components.name: 3. Lyse cells with Dounce homogenizer: 25–30 strokes with tight pestle, 4°C

note.en: Monitor lysis by trypan blue (~80% cells ruptured, nuclei intact). Syringe method: 25G needle × 10 passes. Do NOT sonicate (destroys lysosomes).
note.zh: 台盼蓝监测裂解（~80% 细胞破裂，核完整）。注射器法：25G 针头 × 10 次。不可超声（会破坏溶酶体）。

note.en: Keep postnuclear supernatant (PNS). Save 100 µL PNS as total homogenate control.
note.zh: 保留核后上清（PNS）。保存 100 µL PNS 作为总匀浆对照。

note.en: Pellet = mitochondria-rich. Supernatant = post-mitochondrial supernatant (PMS).
note.zh: 沉淀富含线粒体。上清 = 线粒体后上清（PMS）。

note.en: Pellet contains lysosomes, ER fragments, mitochondrial contaminants. Supernatant = cytosol + microsomes.
note.zh: 沉淀含溶酶体、ER 碎片、线粒体污染物。上清 = 细胞质 + 微粒体。

components.name: 7. Resuspend crude pellet in 0.5 mL 250 mM sucrose buffer; layer on Percoll/sucrose gradient

note.en: Step gradient (bottom to top in 10 mL SW-41 tube): 2 mL 2.0 M sucrose → 3 mL 1.3 M → 3 mL 0.86 M → 2 mL 0.25 M → load sample on top. OR: use 20% Percoll in sucrose buffer, self-generate gradient at 40,000×g 30 min 4°C.
note.zh: 阶梯梯度（从下到上，10 mL SW-41 管）：2 mL 2.0 M 蔗糖 → 3 mL 1.3 M → 3 mL 0.86 M → 2 mL 0.25 M → 顶部加样。或：20% Percoll 溶于蔗糖缓冲液，40,000×g 30 min 4°C 自动成梯度。

components.name: 8. Ultracentrifuge: 30,000×g (25,000 rpm SW-41), 60 min, 4°C, slow brake

note.en: Lysosome density: 1.10–1.12 g/mL → bands between 0.86 M and 1.3 M layers. Mitochondria (1.18 g/mL) pellet. ER (1.07 g/mL) bands higher. Collect 0.5–1 mL fractions from top.
note.zh: 溶酶体密度 1.10–1.12 g/mL → 在 0.86 M 和 1.3 M 层间成带。线粒体（1.18 g/mL）沉底。ER（1.07 g/mL）成带位置更高。从顶部收集 0.5–1 mL 组分。

components.name: 9. Identify lysosome fractions: assay β-hexosaminidase or LAMP1 western blot

note.en: β-hexosaminidase activity assay: add 10 µL fraction + 90 µL substrate (4-methylumbelliferyl-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranoside, 1 mM in citrate buffer pH 4.5), 37°C 30 min → stop with 1 M Glycine pH 10.5 → read fluorescence Ex 365/Em 450. Western blot: LAMP1 (lysosomal), Cathepsin D.
note.zh: β-半乳糖苷酶活性法：10 µL 组分 + 90 µL 底物（4-甲基伞形酮 β-D-氨基葡萄糖苷，1 mM 柠檬酸缓冲液 pH 4.5），37°C 30 min → 1 M 甘氨酸 pH 10.5 终止 → 荧光（Ex 365/Em 450）。Western blot：LAMP1（溶酶体）、Cathepsin D。

components.name: 10. Pool lysosome fractions; dilute 5× with PBS; re-pellet 17,000×g 20 min 4°C

note.en: Removes sucrose/Percoll from lysosome fraction. Resuspend in desired assay buffer. Yield: ~1–5 µg lysosome protein per 10⁷ cells. Use immediately or flash-freeze in liquid N₂.
note.zh: 去除溶酶体组分中的蔗糖/Percoll。用目标实验缓冲液重悬。产量：~1–5 µg 溶酶体蛋白/10⁷ 细胞。立即使用或液氮快速冷冻。

notes.en: Alternative method: LysoIP (Ballabio lab, Nat Methods 2019) — express TMEM192-HA, immunoprecipitate with anti-HA beads (10 min, 4°C); rapid and specific but requires stable cell line. Marker verification: LAMP1/LAMP2 (membrane), Cathepsin B/D (luminal), ATP6V1A (vacuolar ATPase). Purity assessment: minimize mitochondrial (COX IV) and ER (PDI) markers.
notes.zh: 替代法：LysoIP（Ballabio 实验室，Nat Methods 2019）——表达 TMEM192-HA，anti-HA 磁珠免疫沉淀（4°C 10 min）；快速特异但需要稳转细胞系。标记蛋白验证：LAMP1/LAMP2（膜）、Cathepsin B/D（腔内）、ATP6V1A（液泡 ATPase）。纯度评估：尽量减少线粒体（COX IV）和 ER（PDI）标记。

ref: Graham (2001) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 3.9.1; Abu-Remaileh et al. (2017) Science 358:807–813 (LysoIP); Walkley (2009) J Inherit Metab Dis 32:181

usage.en: Isolate lysosome-enriched fractions by differential and density gradient centrifugation.
usage.zh: 差速和密度梯度离心分离富集溶酶体组分。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 6 hours

note.en: Keep on ice, process immediately (up to 1 hour)
note.zh: Keep on ice, process immediately (最长 1 hour)

note.en: −80°C (up to 1 month)
note.zh: −80°C (最长 1 month)

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → Dounce homogenize → 600×g remove nuclei → 3,000×g remove mito → 17,000×g pellet crude lysosomes → Sucrose/Percoll gradient ultracentrifuge → Collect lysosome band → Verify by LAMP1/β-hex → Pool & wash
briefSteps.zh: 收获细胞 → Dounce 匀浆 → 600×g 去核 → 3,000×g 去线粒体 → 17,000×g 粗溶酶体 → 蔗糖/Percoll 梯度超速离心 → 收集溶酶体带 → LAMP1/β-hex 验证 → 合并洗涤

detailedSteps.en: **Cell harvesting & homogenization**
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞收获与匀浆**

detailedSteps.en: Seed 5×10⁷–1×10⁸ cells (or use 100–200 mg liver tissue). Wash 2× with ice-cold PBS. Scrape cells on ice and pellet at 300×g, 5 min, 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 接种 5×10⁷–1×10⁸ 细胞（或用 100–200 mg 肝组织）。冰冷 PBS 洗 2 次。冰上刮取细胞，300×g 离心 5 min，4°C。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend pellet in 1 mL cold homogenization buffer (250 mM sucrose, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, protease inhibitors, 1 mM PMSF) per 5×10⁷ cells.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 5×10⁷ 细胞用 1 mL 冷匀浆缓冲液（250 mM 蔗糖、10 mM HEPES pH 7.4、蛋白酶抑制剂、1 mM PMSF）重悬沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Lyse with Dounce homogenizer: 25–30 strokes with tight pestle on ice. Verify ~80% lysis by trypan blue (nuclei should remain intact). Do NOT sonicate.
detailedSteps.zh: Dounce 匀浆器冰上裂解：紧密杵 25–30 次。台盼蓝验证约 80% 裂解（核应完整）。不可超声。

detailedSteps.en: **Differential centrifugation**
detailedSteps.zh: **差速离心**

detailedSteps.en: Remove nuclei/debris: centrifuge 600×g, 10 min, 4°C. Transfer supernatant to new tube. Repeat once. This is the postnuclear supernatant (PNS). Save 100 µL PNS as total homogenate control.
detailedSteps.zh: 去核/碎片：600×g 离心 10 min，4°C。上清转新管。重复一次。此为核后上清（PNS）。保存 100 µL PNS 作为总匀浆对照。

detailedSteps.en: Remove mitochondria: centrifuge PNS at 3,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Keep supernatant (post-mitochondrial supernatant, PMS).
detailedSteps.zh: 去线粒体：PNS 3,000×g 离心 10 min，4°C。保留上清（线粒体后上清，PMS）。

detailedSteps.en: Pellet crude lysosomes: centrifuge PMS at 17,000×g, 20 min, 4°C. Pellet = crude lysosome/endosome fraction.
detailedSteps.zh: 沉淀粗溶酶体：PMS 17,000×g 离心 20 min，4°C。沉淀 = 粗溶酶体/内体组分。

detailedSteps.en: **Density gradient separation**
detailedSteps.zh: **密度梯度分离**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend crude pellet in 0.5 mL 250 mM sucrose buffer. Layer on top of step gradient in SW-41 tube: 2 mL 2.0 M → 3 mL 1.3 M → 3 mL 0.86 M → 2 mL 0.25 M sucrose. OR: load on 20% Percoll in sucrose buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 将粗沉淀重悬于 0.5 mL 250 mM 蔗糖缓冲液。层叠于 SW-41 管梯度上：2 mL 2.0 M → 3 mL 1.3 M → 3 mL 0.86 M → 2 mL 0.25 M 蔗糖。或：加载至 20% Percoll 蔗糖缓冲液。

detailedSteps.en: Ultracentrifuge at 30,000×g (25,000 rpm SW-41 rotor) for 60 min at 4°C with slow brake. Lysosomes band at density 1.10–1.12 g/mL (between 0.86 M and 1.3 M layers).
detailedSteps.zh: 超速离心 30,000×g（SW-41 转子 25,000 rpm），60 min，4°C，慢刹车。溶酶体在密度 1.10–1.12 g/mL 处成带（0.86 M 和 1.3 M 层之间）。

detailedSteps.en: Collect 0.5–1 mL fractions from top. Identify lysosome-enriched fractions by β-hexosaminidase activity assay or LAMP1 western blot.
detailedSteps.zh: 从顶部收集 0.5–1 mL 组分。β-半乳糖苷酶活性测定或 LAMP1 Western blot 鉴定溶酶体富集组分。

detailedSteps.en: **Cleanup & storage**
detailedSteps.zh: **清洗与保存**

detailedSteps.en: Pool lysosome-positive fractions. Dilute 5× with PBS. Re-pellet at 17,000×g, 20 min, 4°C. Resuspend in assay buffer. Yield: ~1–5 µg lysosome protein per 10⁷ cells.
detailedSteps.zh: 合并溶酶体阳性组分。PBS 稀释 5 倍。17,000×g 再沉淀 20 min，4°C。用实验缓冲液重悬。产量：~1–5 µg 溶酶体蛋白/10⁷ 细胞。

detailedSteps.en: Use immediately for downstream assays, or flash-freeze aliquots in liquid N₂ and store at −80°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 立即用于下游实验，或液氮速冻分装保存于 −80°C。

name: Mitochondria Isolation by Differential Centrifugation
nameCn: 差速离心法分离线粒体

components.name: 1. Collect tissue (0.5–2 g liver/heart) or cells (≥5×10⁷); keep ice-cold

note.en: All steps at 4°C. Pre-chill all tools, buffers, centrifuge rotors.
note.zh: 全程 4°C 操作。预冷所有工具、缓冲液、离心转头。

note.en: Transfer to Dounce homogenizer, 5–10 mL buffer/g tissue.
note.zh: 转入 Dounce 匀浆器，每克组织加 5–10 mL 缓冲液。

note.en: Gentle, even pressure. Over-homogenization destroys mitochondria. Cells: N₂ cavitation (1,000 psi, 10 min, 4°C) or 25G syringe needle × 10 strokes.
note.zh: 轻柔均匀推拉。过度匀浆破坏线粒体。细胞：氮气空化（1,000 psi，10 min，4°C）或 25G 针头 × 10 次。

note.en: Keep supernatant (PNS). Discard pellet (nuclei, unbroken cells). Repeat if pellet is large.
note.zh: 保留上清（PNS）。弃沉淀（核、未破碎细胞）。沉淀大时重复一次。

note.en: Supernatant = cytoplasmic fraction. Pellet = crude mitochondria.
note.zh: 上清 = 细胞质组分。沉淀 = 粗线粒体。

components.name: 6. Wash: resuspend pellet in 5 mL buffer; repeat 7,000×g spin (×2–3)

note.en: Pellet becomes tighter and less brownish with each wash.
note.zh: 每次洗涤后沉淀更紧实、颜色更浅（去除肌红蛋白和细胞色素 c）。

components.name: 7. Optional: Percoll gradient for pure mitochondria

note.en: 18%/30% Percoll gradient in buffer. 95,000×g 30 min 4°C (SW-41 Ti). Mitochondria at 18/30% interface. Wash 2× at 6,000×g 10 min.
note.zh: 18%/30% Percoll 梯度（缓冲液配制）。95,000×g 30 min 4°C（SW-41 Ti 转头）。线粒体在 18/30% 界面。6,000×g 洗 2 次。

components.name: 8. Resuspend in assay buffer (without BSA for functional assays); quantify by BCA

note.en: 1–10 mg/mL protein. Integrity: cytochrome c oxidase activity ± detergent.
note.zh: 蛋白浓度 1–10 mg/mL。完整性验证：细胞色素 c 氧化酶活性（± 去污剂）。

components.name: 9. Functional integrity check: OCR (Seahorse/Clark electrode) or JC-1/TMRM

note.en: Healthy mito: JC-1 red aggregates; depolarized: green monomers. Use within 4–6 h of isolation.
note.zh: 健康线粒体：JC-1 红色聚集体；去极化：绿色单体。分离后 4–6 h 内使用。

notes.en: Differential centrifugation gives ~70% pure mitochondria. For functional studies, Percoll gradient recommended. Keep at 4°C; use within 4–6 h. WB markers: VDAC/TOMM20 (outer membrane), HSP60 (matrix), cytochrome c (IMS).
notes.zh: 差速离心纯度约 70%。功能性实验推荐 Percoll 梯度纯化。4°C 保存，4–6 h 内使用。WB 标记：VDAC/TOMM20（外膜）、HSP60（基质）、细胞色素 c（膜间隙）。

ref: Frezza et al. (2007) Nat Protoc 2:287–295; Wieckowski et al. (2009) Nat Protoc 4:1582–1590

usage.en: Isolate intact mitochondria from cells or tissues by differential centrifugation.
usage.zh: 差速离心从细胞或组织中分离完整线粒体。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 3 hours

note.en: 220 mM in isolation buffer
note.zh: 分离缓冲液中220 mM

note.en: 70 mM in isolation buffer
note.zh: 分离缓冲液中70 mM

note.en: pH adjusted to 7.0 with NaOH
note.zh: 用NaOH调pH至7.0

note.en: Sigma A7030, 0.2% in isolation buffer
note.zh: Sigma A7030，分离缓冲液中0.2%

note.en: Roche cOmplete EDTA-free
note.zh: Roche cOmplete 无EDTA

note.en: 2 mL or 7 mL, tight-fitting pestle (B pestle)
note.zh: 2 mL或7 mL，紧密研杵（B型研杵）

note.en: Washed mitochondrial pellet can be snap-frozen in liquid N₂ and stored at −80°C in isolation buffer for up to 1 month. Note: freeze-thaw disrupts inner membrane integrity; do not use frozen mitochondria for functional assays.
note.zh: 洗涤后的线粒体沉淀可液氮速冻后 −80°C 储存最多 1 个月。注意：冻融破坏内膜完整性，冷冻线粒体不可用于功能性实验。

briefSteps.en: Collect tissue or cells on ice → mince and wash in isolation buffer → Dounce homogenize → remove debris at 600×g → pellet mitochondria at 7,000×g → wash pellet 2–3× → optional Percoll gradient purification → resuspend in assay buffer → verify integrity by JC-1 or cytochrome c oxidase activity → use within 4–6 h
briefSteps.zh: 冰上收集组织或细胞 → 切碎并用分离缓冲液清洗 → Dounce 匀浆 → 600×g 去除细胞碎片 → 7,000×g 沉淀线粒体 → 洗涤沉淀 2–3 次 → 可选 Percoll 梯度纯化 → 重悬于检测缓冲液 → JC-1 或细胞色素 c 氧化酶活性验证完整性 → 4–6 h 内使用

detailedSteps.en: Collect 0.5–2 g tissue (liver or heart) or ≥5×10⁷ cultured cells. Keep samples on ice at all times. Pre-chill all equipment: Dounce homogenizer, centrifuge tubes, rotors, and buffers. All steps must be performed at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 收集 0.5–2 g 组织（肝脏或心脏）或 ≥5×10⁷ 培养细胞，全程冰上保存。预冷所有设备：Dounce 匀浆器、离心管、转头和缓冲液。所有步骤须在 4°C 进行。

detailedSteps.en: For tissue: mince with scissors into small pieces (<1 mm) in isolation buffer (250 mM sucrose, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 1 mM EGTA, 0.1% BSA). Wash 3× with ice-cold buffer to remove blood and fat. Transfer to prechilled Dounce homogenizer with 5–10 mL buffer per gram tissue.
detailedSteps.zh: 组织：用剪刀切成小块（<1 mm），置于分离缓冲液（250 mM 蔗糖、10 mM HEPES pH 7.4、1 mM EGTA、0.1% BSA）中。冰冷缓冲液洗涤 3 次去除血液和脂肪。转入预冷 Dounce 匀浆器，每克组织加 5–10 mL 缓冲液。

detailedSteps.en: Homogenize with 10–15 strokes using the tight-fitting (type B) pestle with gentle, even pressure. Over-homogenization damages mitochondrial membranes. For cultured cells: use N₂ cavitation at 1,000 psi for 10 min at 4°C, or pass through 25G needle × 10 strokes.
detailedSteps.zh: 用紧配合（B 型）杵轻柔均匀推拉 10–15 次匀浆。过度匀浆损伤线粒体膜。培养细胞：氮气空化（1,000 psi，4°C 10 min），或 25G 注射针头推拉 10 次。

detailedSteps.en: Remove cell debris and unbroken cells: centrifuge at 600×g for 10 min at 4°C. Carefully transfer supernatant (post-nuclear supernatant, PNS) to a new tube. Discard pellet (nuclei and unbroken cells). Repeat if pellet is large.
detailedSteps.zh: 去除细胞碎片和未破碎细胞：600×g、4°C 离心 10 min。小心将上清（核后上清，PNS）转至新管。弃沉淀（细胞核和未破碎细胞）。沉淀较大时重复一次。

detailedSteps.en: Pellet crude mitochondria: centrifuge PNS at 7,000×g for 10 min at 4°C. The resulting supernatant is the cytoplasmic/ER fraction. Carefully discard supernatant without disturbing the reddish-brown mitochondrial pellet.
detailedSteps.zh: 沉淀粗线粒体：PNS 在 7,000×g、4°C 离心 10 min。上清为细胞质/内质网组分。小心去除上清，勿扰动红棕色线粒体沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Wash mitochondria: gently resuspend pellet in 5 mL isolation buffer and centrifuge again at 7,000×g for 10 min at 4°C. Repeat 2–3 times until the pellet is tighter and the supernatant is clear (removes myoglobin, cytochrome c, and ER contamination).
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤线粒体：轻柔重悬沉淀于 5 mL 分离缓冲液，再次 7,000×g、4°C 离心 10 min。重复 2–3 次直至沉淀更紧实且上清澄清（去除肌红蛋白、细胞色素 c 和内质网污染）。

detailedSteps.en: Optional Percoll gradient purification for higher purity: layer sample over 18%/30% discontinuous Percoll gradient in isolation buffer. Centrifuge at 95,000×g for 30 min at 4°C (SW-41 Ti rotor). Mitochondria band at 18/30% interface. Collect band, dilute 1:5 in buffer, wash by centrifugation at 6,000×g × 10 min (×2).
detailedSteps.zh: 可选 Percoll 梯度纯化（提高纯度）：将样品铺于 18%/30% 不连续 Percoll 梯度（分离缓冲液配制）上。95,000×g、4°C 离心 30 min（SW-41 Ti 转头）。线粒体聚集在 18/30% 界面。收集条带，1:5 稀释后 6,000×g × 10 min 洗涤 2 次。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend final mitochondrial pellet in assay buffer (250 mM sucrose, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 1 mM EGTA; omit BSA for functional assays). Quantify protein by BCA assay. Typical yield: 1–10 mg/mL protein.
detailedSteps.zh: 将最终线粒体沉淀重悬于检测缓冲液（250 mM 蔗糖、10 mM HEPES pH 7.4、1 mM EGTA；功能实验不加 BSA）。BCA 法定量蛋白。典型产量：1–10 mg/mL 蛋白。

detailedSteps.en: Assess mitochondrial integrity and function: stain with JC-1 (healthy: red aggregates at >590 nm; depolarized: green monomers at 529 nm) or measure cytochrome c oxidase activity ± detergent. Alternatively, measure oxygen consumption rate (OCR) using Seahorse XF analyzer or Clark electrode. Use isolated mitochondria within 4–6 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 评估线粒体完整性和功能：JC-1 染色（健康：>590 nm 红色聚集体；去极化：529 nm 绿色单体）或 ± 去污剂测细胞色素 c 氧化酶活性。也可用 Seahorse XF 仪或 Clark 电极测氧耗速率（OCR）。分离后 4–6 h 内使用。

name: Mouse Genotyping PCR Workflow
nameCn: 小鼠基因分型 PCR 流程

components.name: Step 1 (Tail lysis): Spin plate 3000 rpm, 4°C, 3 min to position tails. Prepare fresh lysis buffer: 17.5 µL 10 M NaOH + 14 µL 0.5 M EDTA + H₂O to 10 mL (per 130 tails). Add 75 µL per well.

note.en: Scale down to 5 mL for 65 tails.
note.zh: 65 个样本可缩至 5 mL。

components.name: Step 2: Seal plate. Run 'Tail-Lyse' thermal cycler protocol (~46 min).
Step 3: Spin 1000 rpm, 4°C, 1 min. Add 75 µL 40 mM Tris-HCl. Mix with pipette. Seal. Spin 1000 rpm, 4°C, 2 min. Store plate at 4°C.
Step 4 (Master mix): Prepare gene-specific master mix. Add Taq polymerase last.

note.en: Do NOT vortex or shake enzymes!
note.zh: 绝对不要涡旋或摇晃酶！

components.name: Step 5 (PCR setup): Add 22.5 µL master mix + Taq per well. Add 2.5 µL lysate sample. Seal and spin down briefly.
Step 6: Run PCR program (~2.5 h). Store at 4°C.
Step 7 (Gel): Prepare 2% agarose-TAE gel (4 g agarose + 200 mL TAE + 5 µL EtBr for large gel). Some genes need 3%.

note.en: Check gene-specific gel % requirements.
note.zh: 查阅各基因所需凝胶浓度。

components.name: Step 8: Load 20 µL sample per well (8 µL 100 bp ladder in middle well). Run at 150-200 V for 15-20 min.
Step 9 (Imaging): Select 'Nucleic Acids / Ethidium Bromide', optimize 'Faint Bands', Filter 1. Position gel, run protocol, invert to view.

notes.en: Lysis buffer composition: ~17.5 mM NaOH + ~0.7 mM EDTA. After lysis, Tris-HCl neutralizes the NaOH. Master mix recipes are gene-specific — refer to genotyping database for primer sequences and PCR conditions. Some genes (2C-TCR, Pygo2) require overnight high-quality DNA isolation with proteinase K instead of quick alkaline lysis.
notes.zh: 裂解液组成：约 17.5 mM NaOH + 0.7 mM EDTA。裂解后 Tris-HCl 中和 NaOH。Master mix 配方因基因而异——参考基因分型数据库获取引物序列和 PCR 条件。某些基因（如 2C-TCR、Pygo2）需过夜 proteinase K 高质量 DNA 提取。

ref: Truett GE et al. (2000) Biotechniques 29:52–54; Sambrook J & Russell DW (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

usage.en: Complete workflow for mouse genotyping from tail lysis through PCR and gel electrophoresis.
usage.zh: 小鼠基因分型完整流程：尾巴裂解 → PCR → 琼脂糖凝胶电泳。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Neutralized tail lysate can be stored at 4°C for up to 1 week or -20°C long-term
note.zh: 中和后的尾巴裂解液可 4°C 保存 1 周或 -20°C 长期保存

note.en: PCR products can be stored at 4°C overnight or -20°C before gel analysis
note.zh: PCR 产物可 4°C 过夜或 -20°C 保存后再进行凝胶分析

briefSteps.en: Tail snips → alkaline lysis (46 min) → Tris-HCl neutralize → gene-specific PCR (~2.5 h) → 2% agarose gel (150–200 V) → UV imaging → genotype call
briefSteps.zh: 尾尖 → 碱裂解（46 min）→ Tris-HCl 中和 → 基因特异性 PCR（~2.5 h）→ 2% 琼脂糖凝胶（150–200 V）→ UV 成像 → 基因型判定

detailedSteps.en: **Tail Lysis**
detailedSteps.zh: **尾巴裂解**

detailedSteps.en: Place tail snips in 96-well plate. Spin at 3,000 rpm, 4°C, 3 min to position tails at bottom
detailedSteps.zh: 将尾尖放入 96 孔板。3,000 rpm，4°C，离心 3 min 使尾尖沉至底部

detailedSteps.en: Prepare fresh alkaline lysis buffer: 17.5 µL 10 M NaOH + 14 µL 0.5 M EDTA + H₂O to 10 mL (for ~130 tails; scale to 5 mL for ~65 tails). Add 75 µL per well
detailedSteps.zh: 新鲜配制碱裂解液：17.5 µL 10 M NaOH + 14 µL 0.5 M EDTA + H₂O 至 10 mL（约 130 个尾巴；约 65 个缩至 5 mL）。每孔加 75 µL

detailedSteps.en: Seal plate with adhesive film. Run 'Tail-Lyse' thermal cycler program (~46 min)
detailedSteps.zh: 用封板膜密封。运行 'Tail-Lyse' 热循环程序（约 46 min）

detailedSteps.en: Spin at 1,000 rpm, 4°C, 1 min. Add 75 µL 40 mM Tris-HCl to neutralize. Mix by pipetting. Seal. Spin at 1,000 rpm, 4°C, 2 min. Store lysate plate at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 1,000 rpm，4°C 离心 1 min。加 75 µL 40 mM Tris-HCl 中和。吹打混匀。密封。1,000 rpm，4°C 离心 2 min。裂解液板 4°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **PCR Setup & Amplification**
detailedSteps.zh: **PCR 配制与扩增**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare gene-specific master mix (22.5 µL per reaction). Add Taq polymerase last — do NOT vortex or shake enzymes
detailedSteps.zh: 配制基因特异性 Master Mix（每个反应 22.5 µL）。最后加 Taq 聚合酶 — 绝不涡旋或摇晃酶

detailedSteps.en: Dispense 22.5 µL master mix + Taq per well in new PCR plate. Add 2.5 µL tail lysate per well. Seal plate, spin down briefly
detailedSteps.zh: 新 PCR 板中每孔分装 22.5 µL Master Mix + Taq。每孔加 2.5 µL 尾巴裂解液。封板，短暂离心

detailedSteps.en: Run gene-specific PCR program (~2.5 h). Store products at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 运行基因特异性 PCR 程序（约 2.5 h）。产物 4°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Gel Electrophoresis & Imaging**
detailedSteps.zh: **凝胶电泳与成像**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare 2% agarose gel in TAE (4 g agarose + 200 mL TAE + 5 µL EtBr for large gel). Some genes require 3% gel — check gene-specific protocol
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 2% 琼脂糖凝胶（4 g 琼脂糖 + 200 mL TAE + 5 µL EtBr，大胶）。部分基因需 3% 凝胶 — 查阅基因特异性方案

detailedSteps.en: Load 20 µL PCR product per well. Load 8 µL 100 bp DNA ladder in reference well. Run at 150–200 V for 15–20 min
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加载 20 µL PCR 产物。参考孔加 8 µL 100 bp DNA ladder。150–200 V 电泳 15–20 min

detailedSteps.en: Image gel under UV: select 'Nucleic Acids / Ethidium Bromide' protocol, optimize for faint bands. Record genotyping results
detailedSteps.zh: UV 下成像凝胶：选择 '核酸 / 溴化乙锭' 程序，优化弱条带显示。记录基因分型结果

name: MTT Cell Viability Assay

components.name: 1. Seed cells in 96-well plate (5,000–10,000 cells/well, 100 µL)

note.en: Add PBS to all outer-edge wells (replace medium) to prevent evaporation. Triplicate wells per condition. Allow cells to attach overnight at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
note.zh: 96 孔板边缘孔加 PBS（替代培养基）防蒸发。每组处理设三复孔。37°C 5% CO₂ 过夜贴壁。

note.en: Dilute drugs in complete medium. Include: (a) untreated control, (b) blank (medium only, no cells), (c) solvent control (DMSO ≤0.1%). Volume per well: 100 µL. Refresh medium at 48 h if treatment >48 h.
note.zh: 药物用完全培养基稀释。设置：(a) 未处理对照；(b) 空白（仅培养基，无细胞）；(c) 溶剂对照（DMSO ≤0.1%）。每孔 100 µL。处理超过 48 h 时在 48 h 换液。

components.name: 3. Prepare MTT stock: 5 mg/mL in PBS; filter-sterilize (0.22 µm); protect from light

note.en: Store at 4°C (≤4 weeks) or −20°C (months). MTT is light-sensitive (keep foil-covered). Warm to 37°C before use. Do NOT use if solution is purple (pre-reduced).
note.zh: 4°C 保存（≤4 周）或 −20°C（数月）。MTT 避光（锡纸包裹）。使用前温热至 37°C。如溶液已变紫色（预还原）则弃用。

components.name: 4. Add 10 µL MTT stock (5 mg/mL) to each well; final 0.5 mg/mL

note.en: Use multi-channel pipette. Add directly to medium — do NOT remove medium first. Mix gently by pipetting once.
note.zh: 用多道移液器加入。直接加入培养基中——不要先去除培养基。轻柔吸打一次混匀。

components.name: 5. Incubate 2–4 h at 37°C, 5% CO₂ (monitor purple crystal formation)

note.en: Stop when crystals visible under microscope but medium still orange (2–4 h typical). Over-incubation: crystals dissolve back, false low readings. Under-incubation: insufficient signal.
note.zh: 显微镜可见紫色结晶且培养基仍呈橙色时终止（通常 2–4 h）。过度孵育：结晶重溶，读数假低。孵育不足：信号不够。

components.name: 6. Remove ALL medium carefully by aspiration (do not disturb crystals)

note.en: Tilt plate, aspirate from corner of well. Residual phenol-red medium interferes with absorbance. Blot plate on paper towel gently.
note.zh: 倾斜培养板，从孔角吸液。残余酚红培养基会干扰吸光度。将板轻扣在纸巾上吸干。

components.name: 7. Add 100–150 µL DMSO per well; shake 10 min RT to dissolve crystals

note.en: Orbital shaker 150–200 rpm. Crystals should fully dissolve (solution homogeneous purple). If crystals persist: warm plate to 37°C briefly.
note.zh: 150–200 rpm 振荡器。结晶应完全溶解（溶液均匀紫色）。结晶未溶：短暂温热至 37°C。

components.name: 8. Read absorbance at 570 nm (reference: 630–650 nm) within 30 min

note.en: OD must be read within 30 min (DMSO-formazan degrades). Reference wavelength corrects for plate/background. % Viability = (OD_treated − OD_blank) / (OD_control − OD_blank) × 100.
note.zh: 30 min 内读数（DMSO-甲臜降解）。参考波长校正背景。% 活力 = (OD处理 − OD空白) / (OD对照 − OD空白) × 100。

notes.en: MTT is endpoint assay — cells are killed by DMSO. For non-destructive repeated measurement use CCK-8 (cck8_proliferation) or resazurin_assay. MTT can give false positives with: strong reducing agents (NAC, ascorbic acid, β-ME), high serum, some antioxidants. Verify cytotoxicity with morphology (phase contrast) or trypan blue.
notes.zh: MTT 是终点法——DMSO 杀死细胞。需重复测量同一孔用 CCK-8（cck8_proliferation）或 resazurin_assay。假阳性干扰物：强还原剂（NAC、维生素 C、β-ME）、高血清、抗氧化剂。结合形态学（相差显微镜）或台盼蓝验证细胞毒性。

ref: Mosmann (1983) J Immunol Methods 65:55–63; van Meerloo et al. (2011) Methods Mol Biol 731:237–245; Stockert et al. (2012) Acta Histochem 114:785–796

usage.en: Measure cell viability and proliferation using MTT colorimetric assay.
usage.zh: MTT 比色法检测细胞活力和增殖。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–3 days，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Solubilization
note.zh: 溶解结晶用

note.en: Seeded 24h prior
note.zh: 提前 24h 接种

note.en: 570 nm
note.zh: 570 nm 波长

note.en: Cells attach overnight at 37°C before adding treatment
note.zh: 细胞 37°C 过夜贴壁后再加药处理

note.en: Treatment incubation (24–72 h) is a natural overnight stopping point
note.zh: 药物处理孵育（24–72 h）为自然过夜停顿点

briefSteps.en: Seed cells in 96-well plate → overnight attachment → add drug treatment → incubate 24–72 h → add MTT (0.5 mg/mL final) → incubate 2–4 h at 37°C → aspirate medium → dissolve formazan in DMSO → read A₅₇₀ nm → calculate % viability
briefSteps.zh: 铺细胞至 96 孔板 → 过夜贴壁 → 加药处理 → 孵育 24–72 h → 加 MTT（终浓度 0.5 mg/mL）→ 37°C 孵育 2–4 h → 吸去培养基 → DMSO 溶解甲臜 → 读 A₅₇₀ nm → 计算活力百分比

detailedSteps.en: Day 0 – Cell Seeding
detailedSteps.zh: 第 0 天 – 铺板

detailedSteps.en: Seed 5,000–10,000 cells per well in 100 µL complete medium in a 96-well plate; fill all outer-edge wells with PBS (no cells) to prevent evaporation; set up triplicate wells per condition.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔铺 5,000–10,000 个细胞（100 µL 完全培养基）；边缘孔加 PBS（不铺细胞）防蒸发；每组处理设三复孔。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate overnight at 37°C, 5% CO₂ (12–18 h) to allow complete cell attachment.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 过夜培养（12–18 h），使细胞充分贴壁。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1 – Treatment
detailedSteps.zh: 第 1 天 – 给药

detailedSteps.en: Prepare MTT stock at 5 mg/mL in PBS; filter-sterilize through 0.22 µm membrane; protect from light; store at 4°C (≤4 weeks) or −20°C long-term; warm to 37°C immediately before use; discard if solution appears purple (pre-reduced).
detailedSteps.zh: 用 PBS 配制 MTT 储液（5 mg/mL）；0.22 µm 过滤除菌；避光保存（4°C ≤4 周，−20°C 长期）；使用前回温至 37°C；溶液变紫色（已预还原）则弃用。

detailedSteps.en: Replace medium with 100 µL complete medium containing test compounds at desired concentrations (DMSO ≤0.1%); include untreated control, blank (medium only, no cells), and solvent control.
detailedSteps.zh: 换液至含受试化合物的完全培养基（每孔 100 µL，DMSO ≤0.1%）；设未处理对照、空白孔（仅培养基）及溶剂对照。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 24–72 h; refresh medium and re-add drug at 48 h for treatments lasting >48 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育 24–72 h；处理时间 >48 h 时，在 48 h 换液并重新给药。

detailedSteps.en: Assay Day – MTT Detection
detailedSteps.zh: 检测日 – MTT 显色

detailedSteps.en: Add 10 µL MTT stock (5 mg/mL) to each well using a multichannel pipette (final concentration 0.5 mg/mL); do NOT remove medium first; mix gently by pipetting once.
detailedSteps.zh: 用多道移液器向每孔加入 10 µL MTT 储液（5 mg/mL，终浓度 0.5 mg/mL）；不去除培养基；轻柔吸打一次混匀。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 2–4 h; monitor under microscope — stop when purple formazan crystals are visible but medium is still orange; over-incubation causes crystals to re-dissolve, producing false-low readings.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育 2–4 h；用显微镜监测，当可见紫色甲臜结晶且培养基仍呈橙色时终止；过度孵育导致结晶重溶，读数偏低。

detailedSteps.en: Tilt the plate and carefully aspirate ALL medium from the corner of each well; blot plate gently on paper towel to remove residual phenol-red medium that would interfere with absorbance.
detailedSteps.zh: 倾斜培养板，从孔角小心吸除全部培养基；将板轻扣在纸巾上，去除残余含酚红培养基（会干扰吸光度）。

detailedSteps.en: Add 100–150 µL DMSO per well; shake on orbital shaker at 150–200 rpm for 10 min at room temperature until crystals fully dissolve (homogeneous purple solution); if crystals persist, warm plate briefly at 37°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加入 100–150 µL DMSO；室温 150–200 rpm 振荡 10 min 直至结晶完全溶解（均匀紫色）；结晶未溶时短暂温热至 37°C。

detailedSteps.en: Read absorbance at 570 nm (reference wavelength 630–650 nm) within 30 min; calculate % viability: (OD_treated − OD_blank) / (OD_control − OD_blank) × 100.
detailedSteps.zh: 30 min 内读取 570 nm 吸光度（参考波长 630–650 nm）；计算活力百分比：(OD处理 − OD空白) / (OD对照 − OD空白) × 100。

name: Multi-Color Flow Cytometry Surface & Intracellular Staining
nameCn: 多色流式细胞术（表面 + 胞内蛋白染色）

components.name: 1. Prepare single-cell suspension; count and adjust to 2–5×10⁶/mL

note.en: Dissociate tissue with gentleMACS or collagenase/trypsin. Pellet: 400×g 5 min. Resuspend in FACS buffer (facs_buffer). Aliquot 100 µL (2–5×10⁵ cells) per staining tube.
note.zh: 组织用 gentleMACS 或胶原酶/胰酶解离。400×g 5 min 沉淀。FACS 缓冲液重悬。每管分 100 µL（2–5×10⁵ 细胞）。

components.name: 2. Fc block: add anti-FcγIII/II receptor (BD Fc Block, 5 µg/mL), 15 min, 4°C

note.en: Prevents non-specific binding of antibodies to Fc receptors on monocytes/macrophages/NK cells. For human cells: CD16/CD32 block. For mouse: 2.4G2 clone. Omit for epithelial/cancer cell lines.
note.zh: 防止单核细胞/巨噬细胞/NK 细胞 Fc 受体非特异性结合。人细胞：CD16/CD32 封闭。小鼠：2.4G2 克隆。上皮/肿瘤细胞系可省略。

components.name: 3. Viability dye staining: add Live/Dead dye (DAPI 1 µg/mL or Zombie dye), 15–30 min, RT or 4°C

note.en: Must stain before surface antibodies (in PBS only — no serum/BSA). DAPI (UV), 7-AAD (PE channel), Live/Dead Aqua (DAPI channel), Zombie dyes (various). Dead cells = high staining.
note.zh: 必须在表面抗体染色前进行（仅用 PBS——不含血清/BSA）。DAPI（UV 激发）、7-AAD（PE 通道）、Live/Dead Aqua（DAPI 通道）、Zombie 染料（多种）。死细胞染色强。

components.name: 4. Surface antibody staining: add antibody cocktail in FACS buffer (50–100 µL/tube), 20–30 min, 4°C, dark

note.en: Pre-titrate each antibody (typical: 0.1–1 µg/mL). Keep cold throughout. Label/mark tubes. Prepare single-color controls and FMO (fluorescence minus one) controls.
note.zh: 每种抗体需预先滴定（通常 0.1–1 µg/mL）。全程保持冷冻。准备单色对照和 FMO（少一荧光）对照。

components.name: 5. Wash 2×: add 3 mL FACS buffer; 400×g 5 min 4°C; decant; repeat

note.en: Decant briskly or aspirate. Do not disrupt pellet. Residual wash is OK.
note.zh: 快速倾倒或抽吸。勿破坏沉淀。少量残余洗液无影响。

components.name: 6. For surface-only panel: fix in 100 µL 1–4% PFA, 20 min RT, wash 2×

note.en: Skip fixation if: (a) running live cells, (b) calcium flux assay, (c) sorting for downstream culture. Fixed cells: stable ≥48 h at 4°C in dark.
note.zh: 如需活细胞（钙流、分选后培养）则跳过固定。固定细胞：4°C 避光稳定 ≥48 h。

components.name: 7. Intracellular staining (if needed): fix+permeabilize with Cytofix/Cytoperm or FoxP3 buffer set

note.en: Cytofix/Cytoperm (BD): 4°C 20 min, wash 2× in Perm/Wash, then add intracellular Ab (cytokines, Ki67) in Perm/Wash, 30 min 4°C. For transcription factors (FoxP3, T-bet): FoxP3/Transcription Factor Staining Buffer Set (eBioscience), 4°C overnight.
note.zh: Cytofix/Cytoperm（BD）：4°C 20 min，Perm/Wash 洗 2 次，胞内抗体（细胞因子、Ki67）加入 Perm/Wash，4°C 30 min。转录因子（FoxP3、T-bet）：FoxP3/转录因子染色缓冲液套装（eBioscience），4°C 过夜。

components.name: 8. Final wash: 2× FACS buffer; resuspend in 200–500 µL FACS buffer; run on cytometer

note.en: Run within 4 h for best results. Acquire ≥10,000 cells (lymphocytes) or 50,000 events in gate of interest. Set voltages using unstained controls.
note.zh: 4 h 内上机效果最佳。采集 ≥10,000 个细胞（淋巴细胞）或门内 ≥50,000 个事件。用无染色对照设置电压。

notes.en: Panel design rules: (1) brightest fluorochrome (PE, APC) for lowest-expression markers; (2) avoid spectral overlap of similar channels; (3) tandem dyes degrade (use fresh, avoid freeze-thaw). Compensation: required for all multicolor panels. Use UltraComp eBeads or anti-mouse Igκ beads for compensation controls. Analysis: FlowJo, FCS Express, Cytobank.
notes.zh: 面板设计原则：(1) 最亮荧光素（PE、APC）用于低表达标记；(2) 避免相邻通道光谱重叠；(3) 串联染料易降解（新鲜使用，避免冻融）。补偿校正：多色面板必须做。用 UltraComp eBeads 或抗小鼠 Igκ 磁珠做补偿对照。分析软件：FlowJo、FCS Express、Cytobank。

ref: Mahnke & Roederer (2007) Clin Lab Med 27:469–485; Cossarizza et al. (2021) Eur J Immunol 51:2708

usage.en: Perform multi-parameter flow cytometry staining panel for immunophenotyping.
usage.zh: 多参数流式染色 panel 进行免疫表型分析。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 4–6 hours，实操: 3 hours

note.en: After surface staining and fixation in PFA, cells can be stored at 4°C in the dark for up to 1 week
note.zh: 表面染色并 PFA 固定后，细胞可 4°C 避光保存最长 1 周

note.en: After intracellular staining, samples should be acquired within 24 h for best signal (store 4°C, dark)
note.zh: 胞内染色后，样品应在 24 h 内采集以获最佳信号（4°C 避光保存）

briefSteps.en: Prepare single cells → Fc block 15 min → Viability dye 15–30 min → Surface Ab cocktail 20–30 min 4°C → Wash 2× → Fix (PFA or Cytofix/Cytoperm) → (Optional: Perm + intracellular Ab 30 min) → Wash → Acquire on cytometer
briefSteps.zh: 制备单细胞 → Fc 封闭 15 min → 活力染料 15–30 min → 表面抗体 20–30 min 4°C → 洗 2× → 固定（PFA 或 Cytofix/Cytoperm）→（可选：透化 + 胞内抗体 30 min）→ 洗涤 → 上机采集

detailedSteps.en: **Sample preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **样品制备**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare single-cell suspension from tissue (collagenase/trypsin digestion) or blood (Ficoll gradient). Pellet at 400×g, 5 min. Resuspend in FACS buffer to 2–5×10⁶ cells/mL. Aliquot 100 µL (2–5×10⁵ cells) per FACS tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 从组织（胶原酶/胰酶消化）或血液（Ficoll 梯度）制备单细胞悬液。400×g 离心 5 min。FACS 缓冲液重悬至 2–5×10⁶/mL。每管分装 100 µL（2–5×10⁵ 细胞）。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare controls: unstained, single-color compensation (beads or cells), FMO controls for each channel.
detailedSteps.zh: 准备对照：未染色对照、单色补偿对照（磁珠或细胞）、每个通道的 FMO 对照。

detailedSteps.en: **Fc block & viability staining**
detailedSteps.zh: **Fc 封闭与活力染色**

detailedSteps.en: Add Fc block (anti-CD16/CD32, 5 µg/mL) to each tube. Incubate 15 min at 4°C. No wash needed.
detailedSteps.zh: 每管加 Fc 封闭液（anti-CD16/CD32，5 µg/mL）。4°C 孵育 15 min。无需洗涤。

detailedSteps.en: Add viability dye (Live/Dead Aqua, Zombie dye, or DAPI 1 µg/mL) in PBS (no BSA/serum). Incubate 15–30 min at RT or 4°C in the dark.
detailedSteps.zh: PBS（无 BSA/血清）中加活力染料（Live/Dead Aqua、Zombie 染料或 DAPI 1 µg/mL）。RT 或 4°C 避光孵育 15–30 min。

detailedSteps.en: Wash once: add 3 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge 400×g 5 min 4°C, decant.
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤一次：加 3 mL FACS 缓冲液，400×g 离心 5 min 4°C，倾去上清。

detailedSteps.en: **Surface antibody staining**
detailedSteps.zh: **表面抗体染色**

detailedSteps.en: Add pre-titrated antibody cocktail (50–100 µL in FACS buffer) to each tube. Incubate 20–30 min at 4°C in the dark.
detailedSteps.zh: 每管加预滴定的抗体混合液（50–100 µL FACS 缓冲液中）。4°C 避光孵育 20–30 min。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2×: add 3 mL FACS buffer, 400×g 5 min 4°C, decant. Repeat.
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤 2×：加 3 mL FACS 缓冲液，400×g 离心 5 min 4°C，倾去上清。重复。

detailedSteps.en: **Fixation (surface-only panel)**
detailedSteps.zh: **固定（仅表面染色 panel）**

detailedSteps.en: For surface-only: fix in 100 µL 1–4% PFA for 20 min at RT. Wash 2× with FACS buffer. Resuspend in 200–500 µL FACS buffer. Proceed to acquisition or store at 4°C in dark ≤48 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 仅表面染色：100 µL 1–4% PFA 固定 20 min RT。FACS 缓冲液洗 2 次。重悬于 200–500 µL FACS 缓冲液。上机或 4°C 避光保存 ≤48 h。

detailedSteps.en: **Intracellular staining (optional)**
detailedSteps.zh: **胞内染色（可选）**

detailedSteps.en: Fix/permeabilize with Cytofix/Cytoperm (BD): 250 µL per tube, 4°C for 20 min. Wash 2× with 1× Perm/Wash buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: Cytofix/Cytoperm（BD）固定/透化：每管 250 µL，4°C 20 min。1× Perm/Wash 缓冲液洗 2 次。

detailedSteps.en: Add intracellular antibodies (cytokines, Ki67) diluted in Perm/Wash buffer. Incubate 30 min at 4°C in the dark. For transcription factors (FoxP3, T-bet): use eBioscience FoxP3 buffer set, fix/perm overnight at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: Perm/Wash 缓冲液稀释的胞内抗体（细胞因子、Ki67）。4°C 避光孵育 30 min。转录因子（FoxP3、T-bet）：用 eBioscience FoxP3 缓冲液套装，4°C 过夜固定/透化。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with Perm/Wash buffer. Resuspend in 200–500 µL FACS buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: Perm/Wash 缓冲液洗 2 次。重悬于 200–500 µL FACS 缓冲液。

detailedSteps.en: **Acquisition**
detailedSteps.zh: **上机采集**

detailedSteps.en: Run on flow cytometer within 4 h. Set voltages using unstained control. Run compensation with single-color controls. Acquire ≥10,000 events in lymphocyte gate or ≥50,000 total events.
detailedSteps.zh: 4 h 内上流式细胞仪。未染色对照设电压。单色对照做补偿。淋巴细胞门 ≥10,000 个事件或总 ≥50,000 个事件。

name: Multiple Immunofluorescence Protocol (FFPE & Frozen)
nameCn: 多重免疫荧光染色方案（石蜡切片及冰冻切片）

components.name: Section A — FFPE Deparaffinize: 3×5 min xylene → 2×5 min 100% EtOH → 5 min 95% → 1 min 70% → 1 min 50% → 2×5 min dH₂O.
Section B — Antigen Unmasking: Place in citrate buffer pH 6.0. Pressure cooker: 95°C 30 min (slow cook, vent open), then 115°C 1 min (close vent). Cool ≥30 min before opening.

note.en: For frozen fixed tissue: rewarm 20 min RT, then go to staining. For unfixed frozen: fix with 4% PFA 15 min, wash 3×5 min TBST.
note.zh: 冰冻固定组织：室温复温 20 分钟后直接染色。未固定冰冻：4% PFA 固定 15 分钟，TBST 洗 3×5 分钟。

components.name: Section C Step 1: Wash in dH₂O 5 min.
Step 2: Draw rectangle around tissue with liquid blocker pen.
Step 4: Block with 100–200 µL blocking buffer for 1 h.

note.en: Choose blocking serum from host species of secondary antibody (e.g. goat serum for goat anti-rabbit/mouse secondaries).
note.zh: 封闭血清选二抗的宿主（如山羊二抗用山羊血清封闭）。

components.name: Step 5: Apply 100 µL primary antibody mixture (in antibody dilution buffer) overnight at 4°C in dark humid box.
Step 7: Apply 100 µL fluorochrome-conjugated secondary antibody mixture, 1–2 h at RT in dark.
Step 9 (if using conjugated primary Ab): After secondary staining, incubate conjugated primary antibody 1–2 h RT in dark, then wash 3×5 min TBST.
Step 10: Aspirate liquid outside tissue. Apply 20 µL anti-fade mounting medium along rectangle margin. Carefully place coverslip (avoid bubbles). Seal with nail polish.
Step 11: Image after ≥4 h. Best results: cure overnight at RT. Long-term storage: 4°C protected from light.

notes.en: Panel design: ensure primary antibodies are from different host species (or use directly conjugated primaries). Match secondary antibodies to primary host species. Cannot use goat serum blocking if a primary antibody is raised in goat. Do not let sections dry at any point — use humid box with water during all incubations.
notes.zh: 面板设计：确保一抗来自不同宿主（或使用直接标记一抗）。二抗与一抗宿主匹配。一抗是山羊来源时不能用山羊血清封闭。整个过程切勿让切片干燥——所有孵育使用加水的避光湿盒。

ref: Gerdes MJ et al. (2013) Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 110:11982–11987; Tsujikawa T et al. (2017) Cell Rep 19:203–217; Cell Signaling Technology Immunofluorescence Protocol

usage.en: Multiplex immunofluorescence staining of FFPE or frozen tissue sections with multiple primary antibodies and fluorochrome-conjugated secondaries in a single tissue section.
usage.zh: FFPE 或冰冻切片的多重免疫荧光染色方案，在同一组织切片上使用多种一抗和荧光标记二抗。

label.en: Protocol — 2 days (overnight primary antibody), hands-on: 3–4 hours
label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days (overnight primary antibody)，实操: 3–4 hours

materials.name: Citrate unmasking buffer (10 mM sodium citrate pH 6.0)
Antibody dilution buffer: 1% BSA + 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS, pH 8
Blocking buffer: 5% normal goat serum in TBST (or 2-5% FBS + 0.3% Triton in PBS)

note.en: Primary antibody incubation is an overnight step at 4°C — required pause
note.zh: 一抗 4°C 过夜孵育——必需的暂停步骤

note.en: Mounted slides can be stored at 4°C protected from light for weeks
note.zh: 封片后的载玻片可 4°C 避光保存数周

note.en: After antigen retrieval and rehydration, slides can be held in TBST at RT for up to 30 min
note.zh: 抗原修复和复水后，载玻片可在 TBST 中 RT 保存最多 30 min

briefSteps.en: Deparaffinize (FFPE) → Antigen retrieval (citrate pH 6.0, pressure cooker) → Block 1 h → Primary Ab mixture O/N 4°C → Wash → Secondary Ab 1–2 h RT → Wash → (Optional: conjugated primary Ab) → Mount with anti-fade → Image
briefSteps.zh: 脱蜡（石蜡切片）→ 抗原修复（柠檬酸 pH 6.0 压力锅）→ 封闭 1 h → 一抗混合液 4°C 过夜 → 洗涤 → 二抗 1–2 h RT → 洗涤 →（可选：直标一抗）→ 抗淬灭封片 → 成像

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Deparaffinization, antigen retrieval, & primary antibody**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 脱蜡、抗原修复与一抗孵育**

detailedSteps.en: (FFPE only) Deparaffinize slides: 3×5 min xylene → 2×5 min 100% ethanol → 5 min 95% → 1 min 70% → 1 min 50% → 2×5 min dH₂O.
detailedSteps.zh: （仅石蜡切片）脱蜡：3×5 min 二甲苯 → 2×5 min 100% 乙醇 → 5 min 95% → 1 min 70% → 1 min 50% → 2×5 min 蒸馏水。

detailedSteps.en: Antigen unmasking: submerge slides in citrate buffer pH 6.0. Pressure cooker: 95°C 30 min (vent open), then 115°C 1 min (close vent). Cool ≥30 min at RT. For frozen sections: rewarm 20 min RT; if unfixed, fix 4% PFA 15 min then wash 3×5 min TBST.
detailedSteps.zh: 抗原修复：载玻片浸入柠檬酸缓冲液 pH 6.0。压力锅：95°C 30 min（通风口开放），115°C 1 min（关闭通风口）。室温冷却 ≥30 min。冰冻切片：RT 复温 20 min；未固定切片先 4% PFA 固定 15 min 再 TBST 洗 3×5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Wash in dH₂O 5 min. Draw hydrophobic barrier around tissue with PAP pen. Wash 2×5 min in TBST.
detailedSteps.zh: 蒸馏水洗 5 min。PAP 笔在组织周围画疏水屏障。TBST 洗 2×5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Block with 100–200 µL blocking buffer (5% normal goat serum in TBST) for 1 h at RT in humidity chamber. Do not wash after blocking.
detailedSteps.zh: 封闭液（5% 山羊血清/TBST）100–200 µL 封闭 1 h，RT，湿盒中。封闭后不洗。

detailedSteps.en: Apply 100 µL primary antibody mixture (diluted in 1% BSA + 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) to each section. Incubate overnight at 4°C in dark humidity chamber.
detailedSteps.zh: 每个切片加 100 µL 一抗混合液（1% BSA + 0.3% Triton X-100/PBS 稀释）。4°C 避光湿盒中过夜孵育。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Secondary antibody, mounting, & imaging**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 二抗、封片与成像**

detailedSteps.en: Remove primary antibody. Wash 3×5 min in TBST.
detailedSteps.zh: 去除一抗。TBST 洗 3×5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Apply 100 µL fluorochrome-conjugated secondary antibody mixture (1:200–1:500 in blocking buffer). Incubate 1–2 h at RT in the dark.
detailedSteps.zh: 加 100 µL 荧光标记二抗混合液（封闭液 1:200–1:500 稀释）。RT 避光孵育 1–2 h。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min in TBST.
detailedSteps.zh: TBST 洗 3×5 min。

detailedSteps.en: (Optional) If using directly conjugated primary antibodies: apply after secondary staining, 1–2 h RT in dark, wash 3×5 min TBST.
detailedSteps.zh: （可选）如使用直接标记一抗：二抗后加入，RT 避光 1–2 h，TBST 洗 3×5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Aspirate excess liquid. Apply 20 µL anti-fade mounting medium along tissue margin. Place coverslip carefully (avoid bubbles). Seal edges with nail polish.
detailedSteps.zh: 吸去多余液体。沿组织边缘加 20 µL 抗淬灭封片剂。小心放置盖玻片（避免气泡）。指甲油封边。

detailedSteps.en: Allow mounting medium to cure ≥4 h (overnight best) at RT in the dark before imaging. Store long-term at 4°C protected from light.
detailedSteps.zh: 封片剂 RT 避光固化 ≥4 h（过夜最佳）后成像。长期保存 4°C 避光。

name: Mycoplasma Detection by PCR

components.name: 6. 判读: ~270 bp 条带 = 阳性

notes.en: Fast, sensitive PCR-based detection of mycoplasma contamination in cell cultures. Uses universal primers GPO-3/MGSO targeting 16S rRNA gene. Positive result: ~270 bp band. Test every cell line every 2-4 weeks.
notes.zh: 快速灵敏的 PCR 法检测细胞培养支原体污染。使用靶向 16S rRNA 基因的通用引物 GPO-3/MGSO。阳性结果：约 270 bp 条带。每 2-4 周检测一次。

ref: van Kuppeveld et al. (1994) Appl Environ Microbiol 60:149-152; Young et al. (2010) Nat Protoc 5:929-934

usage.en: Detect mycoplasma contamination in cell cultures by PCR amplification of mycoplasma 16S rRNA genes.
usage.zh: PCR 扩增支原体 16S rRNA 基因检测细胞培养物支原体污染。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 1 hour

note.en: 48-72h conditioned
note.zh: 48-72h 条件培养基

note.en: Standard Taq, not HF
note.zh: 普通 Taq，非高保真

note.en: GPO-3: 5'-GGGAGCAAACAGGATTAGATACCCT-3'
note.zh: GPO-3 引物

note.en: MGSO: 5'-TGCACCATCTGTCACTCTGTTAACCTC-3'
note.zh: MGSO 引物

note.en: For detection of ~270 bp band
note.zh: 检测约 270 bp 条带

note.en: Boiled lysate can be stored at -20°C for weeks before PCR
note.zh: 煮沸裂解液可 -20°C 保存数周后再行 PCR

note.en: PCR products can be stored at 4°C overnight or -20°C for weeks before gel electrophoresis
note.zh: PCR 产物可 4°C 过夜或 -20°C 保存数周后再电泳

briefSteps.en: Collect 48–72 h conditioned medium → centrifuge to concentrate mycoplasma → boil at 95°C 10 min to lyse → PCR with GPO-3/MGSO primers targeting 16S rRNA → run on 2% agarose gel → interpret: ~270 bp band = positive
briefSteps.zh: 收集 48–72 h 条件培养基 → 离心富集支原体 → 95°C 煮沸裂解 10 min → GPO-3/MGSO 引物 PCR 扩增 16S rRNA → 2% 琼脂糖凝胶电泳 → 判读：~270 bp 条带 = 阳性

detailedSteps.en: Culture cells for 48–72 h without antibiotics in standard growth medium. Antibiotics can mask low-level mycoplasma contamination.
detailedSteps.zh: 在标准培养基中不含抗生素条件下培养细胞 48–72 h，抗生素会掩盖低水平支原体污染。

detailedSteps.en: Collect 1–2 mL of conditioned cell culture supernatant (avoid disturbing cells); transfer to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 收集 1–2 mL 条件培养基上清（避免扰动细胞），转移至 1.5 mL 离心管。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 250×g for 5 min to pellet any floating cells; transfer supernatant to a new tube, then centrifuge at 16,000×g for 10 min to concentrate mycoplasma.
detailedSteps.zh: 250×g 离心 5 min 沉淀浮动细胞，转移上清至新管，再 16,000×g 离心 10 min 富集支原体。

detailedSteps.en: Discard supernatant; resuspend the pellet in 50–100 µL sterile water. Heat at 95°C for 10 min to lyse mycoplasma cells and release DNA. Briefly centrifuge and use 2–5 µL of supernatant as PCR template.
detailedSteps.zh: 弃去上清，用 50–100 µL 无菌水重悬沉淀，95°C 加热 10 min 裂解支原体并释放 DNA，短暂离心后取 2–5 µL 上清作为 PCR 模板。

detailedSteps.en: Set up a 25 µL PCR reaction: 2–5 µL template lysate, 0.5 µM each of primer GPO-3 (5'-ACTCCTACGGGAGGCAGCAGTA-3') and MGSO (5'-TGCACCATCTGTCACTCTGTTAACCTC-3'), 200 µM dNTPs, 1.5 mM MgCl₂, 0.5 U Taq polymerase. Include a positive control and a no-template control (NTC).
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 25 µL PCR 体系：2–5 µL 裂解模板、0.5 µM GPO-3 引物（5'-ACTCCTACGGGAGGCAGCAGTA-3'）和 MGSO 引物（5'-TGCACCATCTGTCACTCTGTTAACCTC-3'）各、200 µM dNTPs、1.5 mM MgCl₂、0.5 U Taq 聚合酶；须设阳性对照和无模板对照（NTC）。

detailedSteps.en: Run PCR: initial denaturation 95°C 5 min; 35 cycles of 95°C 30 s → 55°C 30 s → 72°C 30 s; final extension 72°C 7 min.
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 程序：95°C 预变性 5 min；35 个循环（95°C 30 s → 55°C 30 s → 72°C 30 s）；72°C 终延伸 7 min。

detailedSteps.en: Cast a 2% agarose gel in 1× TAE with ethidium bromide (0.5 µg/mL) or SYBR Safe. Load 10–15 µL of each PCR product with loading dye alongside a 100 bp DNA ladder.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备含 0.5 µg/mL EB（或 SYBR Safe）的 2% 琼脂糖凝胶（1× TAE），每孔上样 10–15 µL PCR 产物（加上样缓冲液），同时上 100 bp DNA Ladder。

detailedSteps.en: Run electrophoresis at 100 V for 30–40 min; visualize under UV light. A band of ~270 bp in the sample lane (and positive control) with no band in the NTC confirms mycoplasma contamination. No band = negative.
detailedSteps.zh: 100 V 电泳 30–40 min，紫外灯下观察：样品泳道（及阳性对照）出现约 270 bp 条带且 NTC 无条带 = 支原体阳性；无条带 = 阴性。

name: Mycoplasma Testing and Cell Authentication (STR Profiling)
nameCn: 支原体检测与细胞鉴定（STR 图谱分析）

components.name: 1. Mycoplasma PCR: collect 1 mL conditioned medium (48–72 h culture)

note.en: From 70–90% confluent culture, 48–72 h without medium change. Centrifuge 250×g 5 min to pellet cells. Keep supernatant. Boil 100 µL supernatant 10 min at 95°C → template.
note.zh: 70–90% 汇合度培养物，48–72 h 不换液。250×g 5 min 去除细胞。保留上清。取 100 µL 上清 95°C 煮 10 min → 模板。

note.en: Use mycoplasma_pcr protocol. Universal primers targeting 16S rRNA: Forward 5'-GGGAGCAAACAGGATTAGATACCCT-3', Reverse 5'-TGCACCATCTGTCACTCTGTTAACCTC-3'. Product: ~280 bp (positive). Positive control: MycoAlert PLUS or spiked DNA.
note.zh: 参考 mycoplasma_pcr。通用引物靶向 16S rRNA：正向/反向引物（见英文）。产物：~280 bp（阳性）。阳性对照：MycoAlert PLUS 或阳性 DNA。

components.name: 3. Agarose gel: run 2% gel; check for ~280 bp amplicon

note.en: Positive: band at ~280 bp → contamination confirmed. Negative: no band → clean. Repeat test monthly.
note.zh: 阳性：~280 bp 条带 → 确认污染。阴性：无条带 → 无污染。建议每月检测一次。

note.en: Faster (20 min): measures mycoplasma enzymes in supernatant. Add 100 µL MycoAlert Reagent to 100 µL supernatant; read luminescence (Reading A). Add 100 µL MycoAlert Substrate; incubate 10 min; read again (Reading B). Ratio B/A < 0.9 = negative; 0.9–1.2 = borderline; >1.2 = positive.
note.zh: 更快（20 min）：检测上清中支原体酶活性。100 µL MycoAlert 试剂 + 100 µL 上清；读数（A）。加 100 µL 底物；10 min；再读数（B）。比值 B/A < 0.9 = 阴性；0.9–1.2 = 可疑；>1.2 = 阳性。

components.name: 5. If positive: treat with Plasmocin (InvivoGen) 25 µg/mL × 2 weeks OR discard and thaw clean stock

note.en: BM Cyclin (Roche): treatment 1 (3 days) → treatment 2 (4 days) × 2 cycles. Verify clearance by re-testing 2 weeks after treatment ends. If persistent: discard cells entirely.
note.zh: BM Cyclin（Roche）：处理 1（3 天）→ 处理 2（4 天）× 2 个循环。停药 2 周后重新检测确认清除。持续阳性：彻底丢弃细胞。

components.name: 6. STR profiling for cell authentication (send to service)

note.en: Collect ≥10⁶ cells; extract gDNA (genomic_dna_extraction). Send to service (ATCC, DSMZ, or in-house). Compare STR profile against ATCC/DSMZ/Cellosaurus database (≥80% match = same cell line). Must authenticate before publication.
note.zh: 收集 ≥10⁶ 细胞；提取 gDNA（genomic_dna_extraction）。送检服务（ATCC、DSMZ 或自行检测）。比对 STR 图谱数据库（≥80% 匹配 = 同一细胞系）。发表前必须鉴定。

notes.en: ICCLC/NIH require mycoplasma testing before publication. Test every cell line monthly. Cross-contamination of cell lines (especially HeLa) is widespread — STR authentication is mandatory per NIH/ATCC guidelines. Common mycoplasma species: M. hyorhinis, M. arginini, M. orale, Acholeplasma laidlawii.
notes.zh: ICCLC/NIH 要求发表前进行支原体检测。每月检测所有细胞系。细胞系交叉污染（特别是 HeLa）普遍存在——NIH/ATCC 指南要求 STR 鉴定。常见支原体：M. hyorhinis、M. arginini、M. orale、Acholeplasma laidlawii。

ref: Drexler & Uphoff (2002) Cytotechnology 39:75–90; Young et al. (2010) Nat Protoc 5:929–937; ATCC Cell Line Authentication Technical Bulletin; Reid et al. (2017) Int J Cancer 140:1209

usage.en: Test cell cultures for mycoplasma contamination using PCR or biochemical assay.
usage.zh: PCR 或生化法检测细胞培养物是否存在支原体污染。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 2 hours

materials.name: Cell culture supernatant (48 h without antibiotics)

note.en: Boiled supernatant template can be stored at -20°C for weeks before PCR
note.zh: 煮沸的上清模板可在 -20°C 保存数周后再进行 PCR

note.en: Extracted gDNA for STR profiling can be stored at -20°C for months
note.zh: 用于 STR 分析的提取 gDNA 可 -20°C 保存数月

briefSteps.en: Conditioned medium → boil template → mycoplasma PCR (16S rRNA primers) → 2% gel (280 bp = positive) → treat/discard if contaminated → STR profiling for authentication
briefSteps.zh: 条件培养基 → 煮沸制模板 → 支原体 PCR（16S rRNA 引物）→ 2% 凝胶（280 bp = 阳性）→ 阳性则治疗/丢弃 → STR 分析鉴定

detailedSteps.en: **Mycoplasma PCR Testing**
detailedSteps.zh: **支原体 PCR 检测**

detailedSteps.en: Collect 1 mL conditioned medium from 70–90% confluent culture grown 48–72 h without medium change or antibiotics
detailedSteps.zh: 从 70–90% 汇合度的培养物中收集 1 mL 条件培养基（48–72 h 不换液、不加抗生素）

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 250×g for 5 min to pellet cells. Transfer supernatant to new tube. Boil 100 µL supernatant at 95°C for 10 min to prepare template DNA
detailedSteps.zh: 250×g 离心 5 min 沉淀细胞。转移上清至新管。取 100 µL 上清 95°C 煮沸 10 min 制备模板 DNA

detailedSteps.en: Set up PCR with mycoplasma-specific 16S rRNA primers (Forward: 5'-GGGAGCAAACAGGATTAGATACCCT-3', Reverse: 5'-TGCACCATCTGTCACTCTGTTAACCTC-3'). Include positive and negative controls
detailedSteps.zh: 使用支原体特异性 16S rRNA 引物进行 PCR（正向/反向引物见英文）。设置阳性和阴性对照

detailedSteps.en: Run PCR products on 2% agarose gel. Positive result: band at ~280 bp (contamination confirmed). Negative: no band (clean culture)
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 产物在 2% 琼脂糖凝胶上电泳。阳性：~280 bp 条带（确认污染）。阴性：无条带（培养无污染）

detailedSteps.en: **Alternative: MycoAlert Bioluminescence Assay**
detailedSteps.zh: **替代方案：MycoAlert 生物发光检测**

detailedSteps.en: Mix 100 µL MycoAlert Reagent + 100 µL cell culture supernatant. Read luminescence (Reading A). Add 100 µL MycoAlert Substrate, incubate 10 min, read again (Reading B). Interpret: B/A < 0.9 = negative; 0.9–1.2 = borderline (re-test); >1.2 = positive
detailedSteps.zh: 100 µL MycoAlert 试剂 + 100 µL 培养上清混合。读发光值（读数 A）。加 100 µL MycoAlert 底物，孵育 10 min，再读（读数 B）。判读：B/A < 0.9 = 阴性；0.9–1.2 = 可疑（重测）；>1.2 = 阳性

detailedSteps.en: **If Positive: Treatment or Discard**
detailedSteps.zh: **若阳性：治疗或丢弃**

detailedSteps.en: Option A: Treat with Plasmocin (InvivoGen) 25 µg/mL for 2 weeks. Option B: BM Cyclin (Roche) treatment cycle (3 days treatment 1 → 4 days treatment 2 × 2 cycles). Re-test 2 weeks after treatment ends. If persistent, discard cells entirely
detailedSteps.zh: 方案 A：Plasmocin（InvivoGen）25 µg/mL 处理 2 周。方案 B：BM Cyclin（Roche）处理循环（处理 1 三天 → 处理 2 四天 × 2 个循环）。停药 2 周后重新检测。持续阳性则彻底丢弃细胞

detailedSteps.en: **Cell Authentication — STR Profiling**
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞鉴定 — STR 分析**

detailedSteps.en: Collect ≥10⁶ cells and extract genomic DNA. Send DNA to STR profiling service (ATCC, DSMZ, or in-house). Compare against Cellosaurus/ATCC database (≥80% match confirms identity). Required before publication per NIH/ATCC guidelines
detailedSteps.zh: 收集 ≥10⁶ 细胞并提取基因组 DNA。送 STR 分析服务（ATCC、DSMZ 或内部检测）。与 Cellosaurus/ATCC 数据库比对（≥80% 匹配确认身份）。NIH/ATCC 指南要求发表前必须鉴定

name: Ngn2 Induced Neuron Differentiation from Human ES/iPS Cells
nameCn: Ngn2 诱导人 ES/iPS 细胞神经元分化方案

components.name: Day -1: Coat matrigel ≥1 h. Split ES/iPS with accutase (1 mL/well 6-well, check at 3 min). Collect, spin 1000 rpm 5 min, count. Plate 30–45k cells/mL in mTeSR + Thiazovivin. Infect with lentivirus (TetO-Ngn2-Puro + Ubi-rtTA).

note.en: Cell density depends on cell line fragility. For H1: 0.5–1M per 24-well plate.
note.zh: 密度取决于细胞系脆弱程度。H1: 0.5–1M/24 孔板。

components.name: Day 0: Switch to N2 medium + BDNF (10 ng/mL) + NT3 (10 ng/mL) + Laminin (0.2 µg/mL) + Doxycycline (2 µg/mL).
Day 1: Add Puromycin (1 µg/mL) to N2 medium with BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox.
Day 3: Add glia (1 confluent T75 glia for 2–3 × 24-well plates) in B27 medium + BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox + Ara-C (2 µM).
Day 4–7: Change half B27 medium (with BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox/Ara-C) every 2–3 days.
Day 7–10: Change half medium with neuronal growth medium + Ara-C (± Dox).
Day 10–21: Add neuronal growth medium to 1 mL, change 1/3 medium weekly.
After Day 21: Change ≥75% medium at least once per week for maintenance.

notes.en: N2 medium: DMEM/F12 + 1× N2 supplement + 1× NEAA. B27 medium: Neurobasal-A + 1× Glutamax + 1× B27. Neuronal growth medium: Neurobasal-A + 1× Glutamax + 1× B27 + 5% FBS. Glia can be p0 or p1, dissociated with trypsin. Virus volume may need optimization per batch (~0.3 µL concentrated virus per well of 24-well).
notes.zh: N2 培养基：DMEM/F12 + 1× N2 + 1× NEAA。B27 培养基：Neurobasal-A + 1× Glutamax + 1× B27。神经元生长液：Neurobasal-A + 1× Glutamax + 1× B27 + 5% FBS。胶质细胞用 p0 或 p1，胰蛋白酶消化。病毒用量需按批次优化。

usage.en: Doxycycline-inducible Ngn2 overexpression protocol for rapid generation of glutamatergic neurons from human ES or iPS cells, with glia co-culture for maturation.
usage.zh: 多西环素诱导 Ngn2 过表达方案，从人 ES 或 iPS 细胞快速生成谷氨酸能神经元，配合胶质细胞共培养促进成熟。

label.en: Protocol — 21+ days, hands-on: Intermittent, ~30 min per media change
label.zh: 实验方案 — 21+ days，实操: Intermittent, ~30 min per media change

materials.name: Neuronal growth medium: Neurobasal-A + 1× Glutamax + 1× B27 + 5% FBS

note.en: After lentiviral infection overnight, cells are committed; switch medium on Day 0 as scheduled
note.zh: 慢病毒过夜感染后细胞已定型；按计划在第 0 天换液

note.en: After glia addition on Day 3, the culture system is established — continue with scheduled feeds
note.zh: 第 3 天加入胶质细胞后培养体系建立——按计划继续喂养

note.en: Mature neurons (Day 14–21+) can be maintained long-term; cells cannot be frozen and re-plated at this stage
note.zh: 成熟神经元（第 14–21+ 天）可长期维持；此阶段不能冻存后重新接种

briefSteps.en: Day −1: Plate iPSC + lentivirus → Day 0: N2 + Dox/BDNF/NT3 → Day 1: Add Puro → Day 3: Add glia + B27 + Ara-C → Day 4–7: Half-change B27 q2–3d → Day 7–10: Switch to growth medium → Day 10–21: 1/3 change weekly → Day 21+: Maintain
briefSteps.zh: 第 −1 天：接种 iPSC + 慢病毒 → 第 0 天：N2 + Dox/BDNF/NT3 → 第 1 天：加 Puro → 第 3 天：加胶质 + B27 + Ara-C → 第 4–7 天：B27 半换 q2–3d → 第 7–10 天：换生长培养基 → 第 10–21 天：每周换 1/3 → 第 21 天后：维持

detailedSteps.en: **Day −1 — Plating & lentiviral infection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 −1 天 — 接种与慢病毒感染**

detailedSteps.en: Coat plates with Matrigel (1:50 dilution in cold DMEM/F12) for ≥1 h at 37°C or overnight at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: Matrigel（1:50 冷 DMEM/F12 稀释）包被培养板，37°C ≥1 h 或 4°C 过夜。

detailedSteps.en: Dissociate ES/iPS cells with Accutase (1 mL per 6-well, check at 3 min). Collect cells, spin 1000 rpm 5 min, count. Plate at 30–45k cells/mL in mTeSR + 2 µM Thiazovivin.
detailedSteps.zh: Accutase 消化 ES/iPS 细胞（每 6 孔 1 mL，3 min 检查）。收集细胞，1000 rpm 离心 5 min，计数。mTeSR + 2 µM Thiazovivin 接种 30–45k/mL。

detailedSteps.en: Add concentrated lentivirus (TetO-Ngn2-Puro + Ubi-rtTA) to cells. ~0.3 µL concentrated virus per well of 24-well plate. Incubate overnight.
detailedSteps.zh: 向细胞中加入浓缩慢病毒（TetO-Ngn2-Puro + Ubi-rtTA）。24 孔板每孔约 0.3 µL 浓缩病毒。过夜孵育。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0 — Induction**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 0 天 — 诱导**

detailedSteps.en: Replace medium with N2 medium (DMEM/F12 + 1× N2 + 1× NEAA) supplemented with BDNF (10 ng/mL), NT3 (10 ng/mL), Laminin (0.2 µg/mL), and Doxycycline (2 µg/mL).
detailedSteps.zh: 换为 N2 培养基（DMEM/F12 + 1× N2 + 1× NEAA），添加 BDNF（10 ng/mL）、NT3（10 ng/mL）、Laminin（0.2 µg/mL）和多西环素（2 µg/mL）。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Puromycin selection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 1 天 — 嘌呤霉素筛选**

detailedSteps.en: Add Puromycin (1 µg/mL) to N2 medium with BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox. Non-transduced cells die within 24–48 h.
detailedSteps.zh: N2 培养基（含 BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox）中加入嘌呤霉素（1 µg/mL）。未转导细胞在 24–48 h 内死亡。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3 — Add glia co-culture**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 3 天 — 加入胶质细胞共培养**

detailedSteps.en: Dissociate primary mouse glia (p0 or p1) with trypsin. Add glia (~1 confluent T75 per 2–3 × 24-well plates) in B27 medium (Neurobasal-A + Glutamax + B27) + BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox + Ara-C (2 µM).
detailedSteps.zh: 胰蛋白酶消化小鼠原代胶质细胞（p0 或 p1）。B27 培养基（Neurobasal-A + Glutamax + B27）+ BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox + Ara-C（2 µM），加入胶质细胞（约 1 个 T75 汇合的量对应 2–3 块 24 孔板）。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 4–7 — B27 medium maintenance**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 4–7 天 — B27 培养基维持**

detailedSteps.en: Change half the B27 medium (with BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox/Ara-C) every 2–3 days. Neurons begin extending processes.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 2–3 天换半量 B27 培养基（含 BDNF/NT3/Laminin/Dox/Ara-C）。神经元开始伸出突起。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 7–10 — Switch to neuronal growth medium**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 7–10 天 — 换为神经元生长培养基**

detailedSteps.en: Change half medium with neuronal growth medium (Neurobasal-A + Glutamax + B27 + 5% FBS) + Ara-C. Doxycycline optional after Day 7.
detailedSteps.zh: 换半量为神经元生长培养基（Neurobasal-A + Glutamax + B27 + 5% FBS）+ Ara-C。第 7 天后多西环素可选。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 10–21 — Maturation**
Add neuronal growth medium to 1 mL per well. Change 1/3 medium weekly. Neurons develop synaptic connections and electrophysiological activity by Day 14–21.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔补至 1 mL 神经元生长培养基。每周换 1/3 培养基。神经元在第 14–21 天发育突触连接和电生理活性。

detailedSteps.en: **After Day 21 — Long-term maintenance**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 21 天后 — 长期维持**

detailedSteps.en: Change ≥75% medium at least once per week. Neurons can be maintained for months with proper feeding. Perform downstream assays (electrophysiology, IF, calcium imaging).
detailedSteps.zh: 每周至少换 ≥75% 培养基。适当喂养可维持数月。进行下游实验（电生理、IF、钙成像）。

name: Northern Blot

components.name: 1. RNA 提取 + 定量 (5–30 µg total RNA)
2. 变性琼脂糖凝胶（1.2% + 甲醛）

note.en: MOPS running buffer
note.zh: MOPS 电泳缓冲液

components.name: 3. RNA 变性：65°C 15 min + 冰上

note.en: Add formaldehyde loading dye
note.zh: 加 formaldehyde loading dye

components.name: 6. 毛细转印至尼龙膜 (过夜, 20× SSC)

note.en: Or vacuum transfer for 1–2 h
note.zh: 或真空转印 1–2 h

note.en: Hybridization buffer containing 50% formamide
note.zh: 含 50% 甲酰胺的杂交液

components.name: 9. 杂交 (探针 + 杂交液, 42°C 过夜)

note.en: DIG-labeled or ³²P-labeled probe
note.zh: DIG 标记或 ³²P 标记探针

components.name: 10. 低严格洗涤 (2× SSC/0.1% SDS, RT, 2×5 min)
12. 检测（放射自显影 / DIG 化学发光）

notes.en: Use RNase-free reagents and equipment throughout. Run formaldehyde gel in fume hood. DIG-labeled probes are safer than radioactive, slightly less sensitive. Positive control: housekeeping gene (GAPDH, β-actin). RNA quality assessed by 28S/18S ratio (~2:1).
