notes.zh: 所有操作使用 RNase-free 试剂和器具。甲醛凝胶在通风橱中操作。DIG 标记探针比放射性标记更安全，灵敏度稍低。阳性对照：管家基因（GAPDH, β-actin）。RNA 质量可通过 28S/18S 比值（~2:1）评估。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, Ch. 7; Alwine et al. (1977) PNAS 74:5350

usage.en: Detect specific RNA transcripts by size separation on denaturing gel, membrane transfer, and hybridization.
usage.zh: Northern blot 检测特定 RNA 转录本：变性胶分离、转膜、杂交。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 8 hours

note.en: High-quality, RIN > 7
note.zh: 高质量，RIN > 7

note.en: Molecular biology grade, use in fume hood
note.zh: 分子生物学级，通风橱中使用

note.en: e.g. Hybond-N+, Amersham
note.zh: 如 Hybond-N+, Amersham

note.en: ULTRAhyb or Church buffer
note.zh: ULTRAhyb 或 Church 缓冲液

note.en: ³²P, DIG, or biotin-labeled
note.zh: ³²P、DIG 或生物素标记

note.en: For radioactive detection
note.zh: 用于放射性检测

note.en: UV-crosslinked membrane can be stored dry at RT or −20°C for months
note.zh: UV交联后的膜可室温或 −20°C 干燥保存数月

note.en: Hybridization can proceed overnight (standard)
note.zh: 杂交可过夜进行（标准操作）

note.en: Washed membrane can be wrapped in plastic wrap and exposed later
note.zh: 洗涤后的膜可用保鲜膜包裹后延后曝光

briefSteps.en: Extract and quantify total RNA (5–30 µg) → denature RNA at 65°C with formaldehyde loading dye → separate on 1.2% formaldehyde-agarose gel (5 V/cm, 2–3 h) → equilibrate gel in 20× SSC → capillary transfer to positively-charged nylon membrane overnight → UV crosslink (120 mJ/cm²) → pre-hybridize at 42°C (1 h) → hybridize with labeled probe overnight at 42°C → low-then-high stringency washes → detect by phosphorimager or chemiluminescence
briefSteps.zh: 提取总 RNA 并定量（5–30 µg）→ 65°C 甲醛上样液变性 → 1.2% 甲醛琼脂糖凝胶分离（5 V/cm，2–3 h）→ 20× SSC 平衡凝胶 → 毛细虹吸转膜至带正电尼龙膜（过夜）→ UV 交联（120 mJ/cm²）→ 42°C 预杂交 1 h → 42°C 标记探针杂交过夜 → 低严格至高严格洗涤 → 磷光成像或化学发光检测

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: RNA Separation and Transfer
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：RNA 分离与转膜

detailedSteps.en: Extract total RNA using TRIzol or RNeasy kit; quantify by NanoDrop (A260/280 ≥ 2.0) and assess integrity on a formaldehyde gel or Bioanalyzer (RIN ≥ 7). Use 5–30 µg per lane. All work must be RNase-free.
detailedSteps.zh: TRIzol 或 RNeasy 提取总 RNA；NanoDrop 定量（A260/280 ≥ 2.0），甲醛凝胶或 Bioanalyzer 评估完整性（RIN ≥ 7）。每泳道 5–30 µg。全程 RNase-free 操作。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare 1.2% formaldehyde-agarose gel: dissolve 1.2 g agarose in 72 mL DEPC-water, cool to 65°C, add 10 mL 10× MOPS buffer and 18 mL 37% formaldehyde. Pour in fume hood; allow to set 30–45 min. Run in 1× MOPS buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备 1.2% 甲醛琼脂糖凝胶：1.2 g 琼脂糖溶于 72 mL DEPC 水，冷却至 65°C，加入 10 mL 10× MOPS 缓冲液和 18 mL 37% 甲醛，在通风橱中倒胶，凝固 30–45 min。使用 1× MOPS 电泳。

detailedSteps.en: Denature RNA samples: mix RNA with 2× RNA loading dye containing formaldehyde (50% deionized formamide, 7% formaldehyde, 1× MOPS); heat at 65°C for 15 min, then immediately chill on ice for 2 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 变性 RNA：将 RNA 与含甲醛的 2× RNA 上样缓冲液混合（50% 去离子甲酰胺、7% 甲醛、1× MOPS），65°C 加热 15 min，立即冰上冷却 2 min。

detailedSteps.en: Load samples and RNA size ladder; electrophorese at 5 V/cm (typically 80–100 V for a 20 cm gel) for 2–3 h in 1× MOPS buffer. Run in fume hood due to formaldehyde. 28S and 18S rRNA bands should be visible by EtBr or SYBR Gold staining (~4.7 and 1.9 kb).
detailedSteps.zh: 上样及 RNA 分子量标准；在 1× MOPS 缓冲液中 5 V/cm（约 80–100 V）电泳 2–3 h。操作在通风橱中进行。EtBr 或 SYBR Gold 染色可见 28S 和 18S rRNA 条带（约 4.7 kb 和 1.9 kb）。

detailedSteps.en: Equilibrate gel 2× in 20× SSC for 10 min each at RT to remove formaldehyde before transfer.
detailedSteps.zh: 将凝胶在 20× SSC 中平衡 2 次，每次 10 min，去除甲醛后再转膜。

detailedSteps.en: Assemble capillary transfer stack: paper wick soaked in 20× SSC → gel (inverted) → positively-charged nylon membrane → 3 layers Whatman 3MM paper → paper towels → weight. Transfer overnight (~16 h) in 20× SSC. Alternatively, use vacuum blotter (1–2 h at 50 mbar).
detailedSteps.zh: 组装毛细虹吸转移装置：浸 20× SSC 的滤纸桥 → 凝胶（倒置）→ 带正电尼龙膜 → 3 层 Whatman 3MM 滤纸 → 纸巾 → 重物。20× SSC 中过夜转移（约 16 h）。也可用真空转印仪（50 mbar，1–2 h）。

detailedSteps.en: After transfer, mark orientation on membrane with pencil. UV-crosslink RNA to membrane in Stratalinker at 120 mJ/cm² (auto-crosslink setting) or bake at 80°C for 2 h. Store dry membrane at RT until hybridization.
detailedSteps.zh: 转膜后用铅笔在膜上标记方向。Stratalinker 120 mJ/cm² UV 交联（自动交联程序），或 80°C 烘烤 2 h。干燥膜可室温保存待杂交。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Hybridization and Detection
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天：杂交与检测

detailedSteps.en: Pre-hybridize: wet membrane in 2× SSC, place in hybridization bottle with 10–20 mL pre-hybridization buffer (50% deionized formamide, 5× SSC, 5× Denhardt's, 0.5% SDS, 100 µg/mL salmon sperm DNA). Rotate at 42°C for 1 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 预杂交：用 2× SSC 润湿膜，放入杂交管，加 10–20 mL 预杂交液（50% 去离子甲酰胺、5× SSC、5× Denhardt's、0.5% SDS、100 µg/mL 鲑鱼精 DNA），42°C 旋转孵育 1 h。

detailedSteps.en: Add denatured labeled probe (DIG-labeled: 25–50 ng/mL; ³²P-labeled: 1–2 × 10⁶ cpm/mL) directly to hybridization bottle without replacing buffer. Hybridize at 42°C overnight (16–20 h) with rotation.
detailedSteps.zh: 将变性标记探针（DIG 标记：25–50 ng/mL；³²P 标记：1–2 × 10⁶ cpm/mL）直接加入杂交管（不换杂交液）。42°C 过夜旋转杂交（16–20 h）。

detailedSteps.en: Low-stringency washes: 2× in 2× SSC / 0.1% SDS, 5 min each at RT. High-stringency washes: 2× in 0.1× SSC / 0.1% SDS, 15 min each at 65°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 低严格洗涤：2× SSC / 0.1% SDS，室温洗涤 2 次，每次 5 min。高严格洗涤：0.1× SSC / 0.1% SDS，65°C 洗涤 2 次，每次 15 min。

detailedSteps.en: Detect signal: ³²P — wrap membrane in plastic wrap; expose to phosphorimager screen 1–16 h or X-ray film overnight at −80°C. DIG — perform anti-DIG-AP antibody incubation and chemiluminescence (CDP-Star) per manufacturer protocol; expose to film or image on chemiluminescent imager.
detailedSteps.zh: 信号检测：³²P——保鲜膜包裹，磷光成像板曝光 1–16 h 或 X 光胶片 −80°C 过夜。DIG——按说明书进行抗 DIG-AP 抗体孵育和化学发光检测（CDP-Star），感光胶片或化学发光成像仪检测。

name: Patient-Derived Xenograft (PDX) Subcutaneous Implantation

components.name: Step 1 (Thaw frozen tissue): Roll vial between hands 10–15 s. Thaw in 37°C water bath until small ice crystal remains (~2 min). Spray with 70% ethanol.

note.en: Wear eye protection — vials may explode from LN₂ storage.
note.zh: 戴护目镜——液氮储存的冻存管可能爆裂。

components.name: Step 2 (Wash): Pour tissue into 50 mL tube. Slowly add 10 mL culture medium. Mix gently. Spin 200×g, 5 min, RT. Remove supernatant. Repeat wash once.

note.en: Add medium slowly to prevent osmotic shock.
note.zh: 缓慢加培养基防止渗透冲击。

components.name: Step 3: Resuspend in 0.5 mL PBS. Keep on ice. ~0.5 cm³ tissue per implant.
Step 4: Anesthetize mouse — ketamine 10 mg/mL, 100 µL per 10 g body weight (IP), or isoflurane per institutional protocol.
Step 5: Shave between shoulder blades. Spray shaved area with 70% ethanol.
Step 6: Make 2–3 mm skin incision. Insert curved mosquito forceps 1–1.5 cm into deep fascia toward flank.
Step 7: Implant ~0.5 cm³ prepared tumor tissue into pocket. Collect spilled cells with 1 mL syringe (no needle) and inject into pocket.
Step 8: Close with 1–2 wound clips. Monitor 24 h for distress or missing clips. Remove clips at 10–14 days (manual restraint only).
Step 9 (Propagation): Harvest tumors at ≤1.5 cm longest dimension (3–12 weeks). Clean tumor of connective/necrotic tissue. Cut into ~0.5 cm³ pieces. Implant into new recipients.

Step 10 (Freezing): Cut tumor into ~0.5 cm³ pieces. Place in cryovials with 1.5 mL freezing medium (50% FBS + 40% DMEM + 10% DMSO). Slow-freeze in Nalgene container at −80°C overnight, then transfer to liquid nitrogen.

notes.en: Tumor growth varies by xenograft line (3–12 weeks to 1.5 cm). Monitor twice weekly. Save representative tissue for histology (formalin), protein/RNA (snap freeze), and OCT embedding. Freezing medium: 50% FBS, 40% DMEM, 10% DMSO — prepare fresh.
notes.zh: 肿瘤生长因品系而异（3–12 周至 1.5 cm）。每周检查两次。保留代表性组织用于组织学（福尔马林）、蛋白/RNA（速冻）和 OCT 包埋。冻存液：50% FBS、40% DMEM、10% DMSO——现配现用。

ref: Adapted from NCI PDXNet recommendations; JoVE Protocol 54393

usage.en: Subcutaneous implantation of frozen or fresh patient-derived tumor xenograft tissue into immunodeficient mice, with propagation and tissue banking procedures.
usage.zh: 将冻存或新鲜的 PDX 肿瘤组织皮下移植到免疫缺陷小鼠，包括传代和组织冻存流程。

label.en: Protocol — 2–3 hours (surgery); 3–12 weeks (growth), hands-on: 30 min per mouse
label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours (surgery); 3–12 weeks (growth)，实操: 30 min per mouse

materials.name: Sterile surgical tools, clean surgical blades
1 mL syringe (no needle, for spilled cells)
Cryogenic vials and freezing container (Nalgene Cryo 1°C)

note.en: Keep tissue on ice in PBS (up to 1-2 hours)
note.zh: Keep tissue on ice in PBS (最长 1-2 hours)

note.en: Liquid nitrogen (up to Years)
note.zh: Liquid nitrogen (最长 Years)

briefSteps.en: Thaw frozen tumor → Wash 2× in medium → Prepare ~0.5 cm³ pieces on ice → Anesthetize mouse → Shave & disinfect → Incise skin → Create SC pocket → Implant tissue → Clip wound → Monitor 2×/week → Harvest at ≤1.5 cm → Propagate or freeze-bank
briefSteps.zh: 融化冻存肿瘤 → 培养基洗 2× → 冰上准备 ~0.5 cm³ 组织块 → 麻醉小鼠 → 剃毛消毒 → 切开皮肤 → 制作皮下口袋 → 植入组织 → 夹闭伤口 → 每周 2 次监测 → ≤1.5 cm 取材 → 传代或冻存

detailedSteps.en: **Tissue preparation (from frozen stock)**
detailedSteps.zh: **组织准备（冻存组织）**

detailedSteps.en: Roll cryovial between hands 10–15 s. Thaw in 37°C water bath until a small ice crystal remains (~2 min). Spray with 70% ethanol. Wear eye protection.
detailedSteps.zh: 手掌间滚动冻存管 10–15 s。37°C 水浴融化至残留小冰晶（约 2 min）。70% 乙醇喷雾消毒。戴护目镜。

detailedSteps.en: Pour tissue into 50 mL tube. Slowly add 10 mL warm culture medium (DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS) to prevent osmotic shock. Mix gently. Spin 200×g, 5 min, RT. Remove supernatant. Repeat wash once.
detailedSteps.zh: 将组织倒入 50 mL 管。缓慢加入 10 mL 温培养基（DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS）防渗透冲击。轻柔混匀。200×g 离心 5 min，RT。去上清。重复洗涤一次。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend tissue in 0.5 mL sterile PBS. Keep on ice. Prepare ~0.5 cm³ tissue pieces per implant.
detailedSteps.zh: 组织重悬于 0.5 mL 无菌 PBS。置于冰上。每个移植位点准备 ~0.5 cm³ 组织块。

detailedSteps.en: **Surgical implantation**
detailedSteps.zh: **手术移植**

detailedSteps.en: Anesthetize mouse: ketamine 10 mg/mL, 100 µL per 10 g body weight (IP), or isoflurane (2–3% induction, 1–1.5% maintenance) per IACUC protocol. Confirm anesthesia by loss of toe-pinch reflex.
detailedSteps.zh: 麻醉小鼠：氯胺酮 10 mg/mL，每 10 g 体重 100 µL（腹腔注射），或异氟烷（2–3% 诱导，1–1.5% 维持）按 IACUC 方案。夹趾反射消失确认麻醉。

detailedSteps.en: Shave area between shoulder blades with electric clipper. Disinfect shaved area with 70% ethanol.
detailedSteps.zh: 电推剪剃除肩胛骨间毛发。70% 乙醇消毒。

detailedSteps.en: Make 2–3 mm skin incision with sterile scalpel. Insert curved mosquito forceps 1–1.5 cm into deep subcutaneous fascia toward the flank to create a pocket.
detailedSteps.zh: 无菌手术刀切 2–3 mm 皮肤切口。弯蚊式钳深入皮下筋膜 1–1.5 cm 向侧腹方向形成口袋。

detailedSteps.en: Implant ~0.5 cm³ tumor tissue into pocket using forceps. If tissue fragments spill, collect with 1 mL syringe (no needle) and reinject into pocket.
detailedSteps.zh: 钳子将 ~0.5 cm³ 肿瘤组织植入口袋。如组织碎片溢出，用 1 mL 注射器（无针头）收集注入口袋。

detailedSteps.en: Close incision with 1–2 wound clips. Apply topical antibiotic if per protocol. Administer buprenorphine (0.05–0.1 mg/kg SC) for analgesia.
detailedSteps.zh: 1–2 个伤口夹闭合切口。如方案要求外用抗生素。皮下注射丁丙诺啡（0.05–0.1 mg/kg）镇痛。

detailedSteps.en: **Post-operative monitoring**
detailedSteps.zh: **术后监测**

detailedSteps.en: Place mouse on warm pad until recovery from anesthesia (~30 min). Monitor 24 h for distress, wound dehiscence, or missing clips. Remove wound clips at 10–14 days (manual restraint only, no anesthesia).
detailedSteps.zh: 将小鼠放在加温垫上直到麻醉苏醒（约 30 min）。24 h 监测是否有不适、伤口裂开或夹子脱落。10–14 天后徒手保定拆除伤口夹（无需麻醉）。

detailedSteps.en: Measure tumors 2× weekly with calipers. Volume = (length × width²) / 2. Harvest at ≤1.5 cm longest dimension (typically 3–12 weeks).
detailedSteps.zh: 游标卡尺每周 2 次测量肿瘤。体积 =（长 × 宽²）/ 2。最长径 ≤1.5 cm 时取材（通常 3–12 周）。

detailedSteps.en: **Propagation & tissue banking**
detailedSteps.zh: **传代与组织冻存**

detailedSteps.en: Harvest tumor aseptically. Remove connective tissue and necrotic areas. Cut into ~0.5 cm³ pieces. For propagation: implant fresh tissue into new recipient mice.
detailedSteps.zh: 无菌取出肿瘤。去除结缔组织和坏死区域。切成 ~0.5 cm³ 块。传代：将新鲜组织植入新受体小鼠。

detailedSteps.en: For banking: place ~0.5 cm³ pieces in cryovials with 1.5 mL freezing medium (50% FBS + 40% DMEM + 10% DMSO). Slow-freeze in Nalgene Mr. Frosty at −80°C overnight, then transfer to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
detailedSteps.zh: 冻存：~0.5 cm³ 组织块放入冻存管，加 1.5 mL 冻存液（50% FBS + 40% DMEM + 10% DMSO）。Nalgene Mr. Frosty −80°C 过夜慢速降温，后转移至液氮长期保存。

detailedSteps.en: Save representative tissue: formalin-fix for histology (H&E), snap-freeze for protein/RNA, embed in OCT for cryosection.
detailedSteps.zh: 保留代表性组织：福尔马林固定用于组织学（H&E）、速冻用于蛋白/RNA、OCT 包埋用于冰冻切片。

name: PBMC Isolation by Density Gradient Centrifugation (Ficoll)
nameCn: 密度梯度离心法分离 PBMC（外周血单个核细胞）

components.name: 1. Collect blood into EDTA or heparin tube; process within 2 h at RT

note.en: EDTA: 1.8 mg/mL (purple-top Vacutainer). Heparin: 10–20 U/mL (green-top). Do NOT use SST (serum-separator) or clotted blood. Keep at RT (not on ice — cold causes platelet/lymphocyte aggregation).
note.zh: EDTA（紫色管）或肝素（绿色管）采血管。禁用 SST（血清分离管）或已凝固血液。室温保存（不可冰上——冷藏导致血小板/淋巴细胞聚集）。采血后 2 h 内处理。

components.name: 2. Dilute blood 1:1 with RT DPBS (without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺)

note.en: Dilution reduces viscosity and improves separation. Use DPBS at RT (not cold). Gently invert to mix. 20 mL diluted blood is typical starting volume.
note.zh: 稀释降低黏度，改善分离效果。用室温 DPBS（不用冷的）。轻柔颠倒混匀。典型起始体积：20 mL 稀释血液。

components.name: 3. Add Ficoll-Paque (1.077 g/mL) to conical tube: 10 mL Ficoll per 20 mL diluted blood

note.en: Warm Ficoll-Paque to RT (critical — cold Ficoll gives poor separation). For SepMate tubes (Stem Cell Tech): add Ficoll first, then pour blood on top — faster and cleaner. Use 15 mL Ficoll for 50 mL tube; 3 mL for 15 mL tube.
note.zh: Ficoll-Paque 必须恢复至室温（关键——冷的会导致分离失败）。SepMate 管（Stem Cell Tech）：先加 Ficoll 再倒血液——更快更干净。50 mL 管用 15 mL Ficoll；15 mL 管用 3 mL。

components.name: 4. Layer diluted blood slowly over Ficoll (do not mix layers)

note.en: Tilt tube 45°; pipette diluted blood down the tube wall so it floats gently on top of Ficoll. Two distinct layers must be visible. Alternatively, underlay Ficoll under blood using a long needle.
note.zh: 将管倾斜 45°，沿管壁缓慢加入稀释血液，使其轻轻漂浮在 Ficoll 上方。必须可见明显两层界面。也可用长针在血液下方注入 Ficoll（倒置法）。

components.name: 5. Centrifuge: 400×g, 30–35 min, RT (no brake, no acceleration ramp)

note.en: CRITICAL: acceleration = 9 (slow), brake = 0 (NO BRAKE). Deceleration with brake disrupts the density interface. RT (18–25°C). Most centrifuges: set to slowest decel (0 or 1).
note.zh: 关键：加速度 = 9（慢速），刹车 = 0（无刹车）。刹车会扰乱密度界面。室温（18–25°C）。大多数离心机：设置最慢减速（0 或 1）。

note.en: Top: plasma + platelets. Buffy coat (white ring at Ficoll interface): PBMCs. Ficoll layer: granulocytes settling. Pellet (red): erythrocytes + granulocytes. PBMC band may be thin — collect carefully.
note.zh: 顶层：血浆 + 血小板。白膜层（Ficoll 界面白色环）：PBMC。Ficoll 层：粒细胞。红色沉淀：红细胞 + 粒细胞。PBMC 带可能较薄——小心收集。

components.name: 7. Collect buffy coat (PBMC layer): insert pipette just above Ficoll interface; aspirate 2–4 mL

note.en: Collect in a clean 15 or 50 mL tube. Taking ≤1 mL of Ficoll is acceptable. Avoid disturbing lower layers.
note.zh: 收集到干净的 15 或 50 mL 管中。带入少量（≤1 mL）Ficoll 可接受。避免扰动下层。

components.name: 8. Wash 1: add 40 mL RT DPBS; 300×g 10 min RT (WITH brake); decant supernatant

note.en: This wash removes residual Ficoll and platelets. Pellet should be white/cream (PBMCs). If red → erythrocyte contamination → add 2 mL ACK lysis buffer (150 mM NH₄Cl, 10 mM KHCO₃, 0.1 mM EDTA, pH 7.2), 5 min RT.
note.zh: 此步去除残余 Ficoll 和血小板。沉淀应为白色/奶油色（PBMC）。如偏红 → 红细胞污染 → 加 2 mL ACK 裂解液（150 mM NH₄Cl、10 mM KHCO₃、0.1 mM EDTA，pH 7.2），RT 5 min。

components.name: 9. Wash 2: resuspend in 10 mL DPBS; 200×g 10 min RT; decant

note.en: Second wash at lower g-force to remove most remaining platelets (platelets sediment at higher g, are discarded with supernatant).
note.zh: 第二次洗涤用较低离心力去除残余血小板（血小板在较高 g 时沉淀，随上清丢弃）。

components.name: 10. Resuspend in RPMI-1640 + 10% FBS or DPBS; count and assess viability

note.en: cell_counting_hemocytometer with trypan blue. Typical yield: 1–2×10⁶ PBMCs/mL blood. Viability should be >90%. PBMC composition: ~80% lymphocytes (T, B, NK), ~15% monocytes, ~5% dendritic cells.
note.zh: cell_counting_hemocytometer 台盼蓝计数。典型产量：每毫升血液 1–2×10⁶ PBMC。活率应 >90%。PBMC 组成：约 80% 淋巴细胞（T、B、NK）、约 15% 单核细胞、约 5% 树突状细胞。

notes.en: Critical success factors: (1) Fresh blood at RT throughout; (2) Ficoll at RT; (3) NO BRAKE on centrifuge deceleration; (4) Careful harvesting of buffy coat. For cryopreservation: resuspend at 10–20×10⁶ cells/mL in 90% FBS + 10% DMSO (cell_freezing); rapid cooling in Mr. Frosty to −80°C; transfer to liquid N₂. For immediate downstream: proceed to magnetic bead depletion (MACS), activation, or flow staining (flow_panel_staining).
notes.zh: 成功关键因素：(1) 全程血液保持室温；(2) Ficoll 恢复至室温；(3) 离心减速无刹车；(4) 小心收集白膜层。冻存：10–20×10⁶ cells/mL 重悬于 90% FBS + 10% DMSO（cell_freezing），Mr. Frosty 缓慢降温至 −80°C，后转液氮。下游实验：磁珠分选（MACS）、细胞激活或流式染色（flow_panel_staining）。

ref: Boyum (1968) Scand J Clin Lab Invest Suppl 97:77–89; Ulmer et al. (1984) Immunobiology 166:238–250; Kleiveland (2015) Handbook of Cell Biology; STEMCELL Technologies EasySep Manual

usage.en: Isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from whole blood by Ficoll density gradient centrifugation.
usage.zh: Ficoll 密度梯度离心从全血中分离外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours，实操: 2 hours

materials.name: Whole blood (anticoagulated with EDTA or heparin)

note.en: After centrifugation, layers are stable for 15–30 min at RT. Do not delay harvesting beyond 30 min.
note.zh: 离心后，分层可在室温下稳定 15–30 分钟。不要延迟超过 30 分钟再收集。

note.en: Washed PBMCs can be cryopreserved in 90% FBS + 10% DMSO and stored in liquid N₂ indefinitely.
note.zh: 洗涤后的 PBMC 可用 90% FBS + 10% DMSO 冻存于液氮中，可长期保存。

briefSteps.en: Collect blood → dilute 1:1 with DPBS → layer over Ficoll → centrifuge 400×g 30 min (no brake) → harvest buffy coat → wash 2× → resuspend & count
briefSteps.zh: 采血 → 1:1 DPBS 稀释 → 铺于 Ficoll 上 → 400×g 离心 30 min（无刹车）→ 收集白膜层 → 洗涤 2 次 → 重悬计数

detailedSteps.en: **Blood Collection & Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **采血与准备**

detailedSteps.en: Collect whole blood into EDTA (purple-top) or heparin (green-top) tube. Keep at room temperature and process within 2 hours.
detailedSteps.zh: 将全血采集到 EDTA（紫色管）或肝素（绿色管）采血管中。室温保存，2 小时内处理。

detailedSteps.en: Dilute blood 1:1 with room-temperature DPBS (without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺). Gently invert to mix.
detailedSteps.zh: 用室温 DPBS（不含 Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺）将血液 1:1 稀释。轻柔颠倒混匀。

detailedSteps.en: **Ficoll Density Gradient Setup**
detailedSteps.zh: **Ficoll 密度梯度铺层**

detailedSteps.en: Add room-temperature Ficoll-Paque (1.077 g/mL) to a conical tube: 10 mL Ficoll per 20 mL diluted blood.
detailedSteps.zh: 向离心管中加入室温 Ficoll-Paque（1.077 g/mL）：每 20 mL 稀释血液加 10 mL Ficoll。

detailedSteps.en: Tilt tube 45° and slowly layer diluted blood over Ficoll along the tube wall. Two distinct layers must be visible — do not mix.
detailedSteps.zh: 将管倾斜 45°，沿管壁缓慢将稀释血液铺在 Ficoll 上方。必须可见两层清晰界面——不可混合。

detailedSteps.en: **Density Gradient Centrifugation**
detailedSteps.zh: **密度梯度离心**

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 400×g for 30–35 min at RT. CRITICAL: set acceleration to slow (9), brake OFF (0). Braking disrupts the density interface.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温 400×g 离心 30–35 分钟。关键：加速度设为慢速（9），刹车关闭（0）。刹车会破坏密度界面。

detailedSteps.en: Identify layers: top = plasma/platelets; white ring at Ficoll interface = PBMCs (buffy coat); red pellet = erythrocytes/granulocytes.
detailedSteps.zh: 辨认各层：顶层 = 血浆/血小板；Ficoll 界面白色环 = PBMC（白膜层）；红色沉淀 = 红细胞/粒细胞。

detailedSteps.en: **PBMC Harvesting**
detailedSteps.zh: **PBMC 收集**

detailedSteps.en: Carefully insert pipette just above the Ficoll interface and aspirate the buffy coat (2–4 mL) into a clean conical tube. Avoid disturbing lower layers.
detailedSteps.zh: 将移液管小心插入 Ficoll 界面上方，吸取白膜层（2–4 mL）至干净离心管。避免扰动下层。

detailedSteps.en: **Washing**
Wash 1: Add 40 mL RT DPBS to collected PBMCs. Centrifuge at 300×g for 10 min with brake ON. Decant supernatant. If pellet is red, add 2 mL ACK lysis buffer for 5 min at RT.
detailedSteps.zh: 第一次洗涤：向收集的 PBMC 中加入 40 mL 室温 DPBS。300×g 离心 10 分钟（开刹车）。倒掉上清。若沉淀偏红，加 2 mL ACK 裂解液室温处理 5 分钟。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2: Resuspend in 10 mL DPBS. Centrifuge at 200×g for 10 min at RT to remove platelets. Decant supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 第二次洗涤：重悬于 10 mL DPBS。200×g 离心 10 分钟去除血小板。倒掉上清。

detailedSteps.en: **Cell Counting & Downstream**
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞计数与下游处理**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend PBMCs in complete RPMI or DPBS. Count cells with trypan blue exclusion. Typical yield: 1–2×10⁶ PBMCs per mL whole blood; viability should be >90%.
detailedSteps.zh: 用完全 RPMI 或 DPBS 重悬 PBMC。台盼蓝排除法计数。典型产量：每毫升全血 1–2×10⁶ PBMC；活率应 >90%。

name: Plasmid Maxiprep (Alkaline Lysis)

components.name: 1. 过夜培养 100–500 mL LB + 抗性

note.en: Contains RNase A; resuspend thoroughly with no visible particles
note.zh: 含 RNase A, 彻底重悬无颗粒

note.en: Invert gently 4–6 times, ≤5 min at room temperature
note.zh: 轻柔翻转 4–6 次, 室温 ≤5 min

note.en: Invert immediately to mix, then on ice for 15–20 min
note.zh: 立即翻转混匀, 冰上 15–20 min

components.name: 12. 70% 乙醇洗涤 → 风干 → TE 溶解

notes.en: Typical yield: 100 mL high-copy plasmid culture → 500-1000 µg DNA. Endotoxin-free plasmid for transfection/in vivo use requires endotoxin removal column. Avoid excessive vortexing to prevent genomic DNA contamination.
notes.zh: 典型产量：100 mL 高拷贝质粒 → 500–1000 µg DNA。Endotoxin-free 质粒用于转染/体内实验需使用 endotoxin removal column。避免过度涡旋导致基因组 DNA 污染。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd Ed; QIAGEN Plasmid Purification Handbook

usage.zh: 大量提取高纯度质粒 DNA，用于转染等应用。

note.en: e.g. Ampicillin 100 mg/mL

note.zh: 过夜培养（第一天→第二天）

note.zh: 中和裂解液可在上柱前 −20°C 保存
