briefSteps.en: Grow 100–500 mL culture overnight → pellet bacteria → alkaline lysis (P1/P2/P3) → centrifuge → bind to column → wash twice → elute → isopropanol precipitate → wash → dissolve in TE → quantify
briefSteps.zh: 100–500 mL 过夜培养 → 离心收菌 → 碱裂解（P1/P2/P3）→ 离心 → 上柱结合 → 洗涤 2 次 → 洗脱 → 异丙醇沉淀 → 洗涤 → TE 溶解 → 定量

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Inoculate a single confirmed colony into 5 mL LB + antibiotic; grow at 37°C, 225 rpm for 6–8 h, then transfer to 100–500 mL LB + antibiotic and continue overnight (12–16 h).
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：挑单克隆接种至 5 mL LB + 抗生素，37°C、225 rpm 培养 6–8 h，再转接至 100–500 mL LB + 抗生素过夜培养 12–16 h。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2 — Pellet bacteria by centrifugation at 6,000×g for 15 min at 4°C; discard supernatant completely.
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天 — 4°C、6,000×g 离心 15 min 收集菌体，彻底弃去上清。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend the pellet in Buffer P1 (containing RNase A) at 4 mL per gram wet cell weight; pipette until fully homogeneous with no visible clumps.
detailedSteps.zh: 用含 RNase A 的 Buffer P1 重悬菌体（4 mL/g 湿重），反复吹打至无可见颗粒，完全均匀。

detailedSteps.en: Add an equal volume of Buffer P2 (0.2 M NaOH, 1% SDS); gently invert 4–6 times and incubate at room temperature for exactly 3–5 min until solution turns clear and viscous. Do NOT vortex.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入等体积 Buffer P2（0.2 M NaOH、1% SDS），轻柔颠倒 4–6 次，室温静置 3–5 min 至溶液变清亮黏稠，切勿涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.75 volumes of pre-chilled Buffer P3 (3 M potassium acetate, pH 5.5); immediately invert 4–6 times, then incubate on ice for 15–20 min until a large white precipitate forms.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 0.75 倍体积预冷 Buffer P3（3 M 乙酸钾，pH 5.5），立即颠倒混匀 4–6 次，冰浴 15–20 min 至形成大量白色沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 20,000×g for 30 min at 4°C to pellet cellular debris. Filter the supernatant through gauze if needed.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C、20,000×g 离心 30 min 沉淀细胞碎片，如需可通过纱布过滤上清。

detailedSteps.en: Equilibrate the maxiprep column with the provided equilibration buffer (QBT or equivalent); apply the cleared supernatant and allow it to flow through by gravity.
detailedSteps.zh: 用平衡缓冲液（QBT 或等效液）平衡大提柱，将澄清上清液上柱，重力流过。

detailedSteps.en: Wash the column twice with wash buffer (QC or equivalent), 30–60 mL per wash, allowing complete drainage by gravity between washes.
detailedSteps.zh: 用洗涤缓冲液（QC 或等效液）洗柱 2 次，每次 30–60 mL，每次重力排尽后再洗。

detailedSteps.en: Elute DNA with 15 mL elution buffer (QF or equivalent) pre-warmed to 65°C; collect eluate in a 50 mL tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 15 mL 预热至 65°C 的洗脱缓冲液（QF 或等效液）洗脱 DNA，收集洗脱液于 50 mL 离心管。

detailedSteps.en: Precipitate DNA by adding 0.7 volumes (~10.5 mL) of room-temperature isopropanol; mix well and incubate at −20°C for 30 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 0.7 倍体积（约 10.5 mL）室温异丙醇，充分混匀，−20°C 孵育 30 min 沉淀 DNA。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 15,000×g for 30 min at 4°C; carefully decant supernatant. A white or translucent pellet should be visible.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C、15,000×g 离心 30 min，小心倒去上清，应可见白色或半透明沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Wash the pellet with 5 mL of 70% ethanol; centrifuge at 15,000×g for 5 min at 4°C and remove supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 5 mL 70% 乙醇洗涤沉淀，4°C、15,000×g 离心 5 min，去除上清。

detailedSteps.en: Air-dry the pellet at room temperature for 10–15 min, then dissolve in 200–500 µL TE buffer (pH 8.0). Heat at 65°C for 5 min to aid dissolution if needed.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温风干沉淀 10–15 min，用 200–500 µL TE 缓冲液（pH 8.0）溶解；如需可 65°C 加热 5 min 助溶。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify by NanoDrop: A260/280 ≈ 1.8, A260/230 > 2.0. Expected yield: 500–1000 µg from 100 mL high-copy plasmid culture.
detailedSteps.zh: NanoDrop 定量：A260/280 ≈ 1.8，A260/230 > 2.0。100 mL 高拷贝质粒培养物预期产量 500–1000 µg。

name: Plasmid Miniprep (Alkaline Lysis)

components.name: 3. 250 µL Buffer P2 裂解 (颠倒混匀)
4. 350 µL Buffer P3 中和 (颠倒混匀)
7. 加 0.7 倍体积异丙醇沉淀
10. 风干 → 30–50 µL TE/H₂O 溶解

notes.en: Dilute to 1× before use. Classic alkaline lysis method. Yields 5–20 µg from 3 mL overnight culture. A260/280 should be 1.8–2.0 for pure DNA.
notes.zh: 经典碱裂解法。3 mL 过夜培养物可获 5–20 µg 质粒 DNA。A260/280 应为 1.8–2.0。如需更高纯度，使用商业柱提试剂盒。

ref: Birnboim & Doly (1979) Nucleic Acids Res 7:1513–1523; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

usage.en: Isolate small-scale plasmid DNA from E. coli cultures using alkaline lysis.
usage.zh: 碱裂解法小量提取大肠杆菌质粒 DNA。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 30 minutes，实操: 30 minutes

note.en: For DNA precipitation
note.zh: 用于 DNA 沉淀

note.en: For wash
note.zh: 洗涤用

note.en: For elution
note.zh: 用于洗脱

note.en: Bacterial pellet can be frozen at −20°C for up to 1 month before continuing.
note.zh: 菌体沉淀可 −20°C 冻存最多 1 个月后继续操作。

note.en: Purified plasmid DNA can be stored at −20°C for years or at 4°C for several months.
note.zh: 纯化的质粒 DNA 可 −20°C 保存多年，或 4°C 保存数月。

briefSteps.en: Pellet bacteria → resuspend in P1 → lyse with P2 → neutralize with P3 → centrifuge → precipitate DNA with isopropanol → wash with 70% EtOH → air-dry → dissolve in TE
briefSteps.zh: 离心收菌 → P1 重悬 → P2 碱裂解 → P3 中和 → 离心 → 异丙醇沉淀 DNA → 70% 乙醇洗涤 → 风干 → TE 溶解

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Inoculate a single colony into 3–5 mL LB + antibiotic; grow at 37°C, 225 rpm for 12–16 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：挑单克隆接种至 3–5 mL LB + 抗生素，37°C、225 rpm 过夜培养 12–16 h。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2 — Transfer 1.5–2 mL overnight culture to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 6,000×g for 2 min; discard supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天 — 取 1.5–2 mL 过夜菌液至 1.5 mL 离心管，6,000×g 离心 2 min，弃上清。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend the bacterial pellet completely in 250 µL ice-cold Buffer P1 (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 10 mM EDTA, 100 µg/mL RNase A) by pipetting until no clumps remain.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 250 µL 冰冷 Buffer P1（50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0、10 mM EDTA、100 µg/mL RNase A）彻底重悬菌体至无颗粒。

detailedSteps.en: Add 250 µL Buffer P2 (0.2 M NaOH, 1% SDS); invert tube 4–6 times gently. Incubate at room temperature for exactly 2–3 min until solution clears. Do NOT vortex.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 250 µL Buffer P2（0.2 M NaOH、1% SDS），轻柔颠倒混匀 4–6 次，室温孵育 2–3 min 至溶液变清亮，切勿涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: Add 350 µL Buffer P3 (3 M potassium acetate, pH 5.5); immediately invert 4–6 times until white precipitate forms. Place on ice for 5 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 350 µL Buffer P3（3 M 乙酸钾，pH 5.5），立即颠倒混匀 4–6 次至白色絮状沉淀形成，冰浴 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 13,000×g for 10 min at room temperature to pellet cell debris and precipitated proteins/genomic DNA.
detailedSteps.zh: 13,000×g 室温离心 10 min，沉淀细胞碎片及蛋白质/基因组 DNA。

detailedSteps.en: Carefully transfer the clear supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube, avoiding the white pellet.
detailedSteps.zh: 小心吸取上清液至新的 1.5 mL 离心管，避免触碰白色沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.7 volumes (~700 µL) of room-temperature isopropanol to the supernatant; mix by inverting 10 times.
detailedSteps.zh: 向上清中加入 0.7 倍体积（约 700 µL）室温异丙醇，颠倒混匀 10 次。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 13,000×g for 15 min at room temperature; carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the DNA pellet.
detailedSteps.zh: 13,000×g 室温离心 15 min，小心弃去上清，避免扰动 DNA 沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Wash the pellet with 500 µL of 70% ethanol; centrifuge at 13,000×g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 500 µL 70% 乙醇洗涤沉淀，13,000×g 离心 5 min，弃上清。

detailedSteps.en: Air-dry the pellet for 5–10 min at room temperature (or 37°C for 3 min) until no ethanol odor remains. Do not over-dry.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温风干 5–10 min（或 37°C 3 min）至乙醇气味消失，勿过度干燥。

detailedSteps.en: Dissolve the pellet in 30–50 µL TE buffer (pH 8.0) or nuclease-free water. Quantify by NanoDrop; A260/280 should be 1.8–2.0.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 30–50 µL TE 缓冲液（pH 8.0）或无核酸酶水溶解沉淀，NanoDrop 定量，A260/280 应为 1.8–2.0。

name: Protein Concentration by Centrifugal Ultrafiltration (Amicon Ultra)
nameCn: 离心超滤浓缩蛋白（Amicon Ultra）

note.en: MWCO should be 3–6× smaller than protein MW. Common: 3 kDa (peptides/small proteins), 10 kDa (general), 30 kDa (>60 kDa proteins), 50 kDa (>100 kDa). Amicon Ultra-4 (4 mL), Ultra-15 (15 mL), Ultra-0.5 (0.5 mL) available.
note.zh: MWCO 应为蛋白 MW 的 1/3–1/6。常用：3 kDa（多肽/小蛋白）、10 kDa（通用）、30 kDa（>60 kDa 蛋白）、50 kDa（>100 kDa）。可选 Amicon Ultra-4（4 mL）、Ultra-15（15 mL）、Ultra-0.5（0.5 mL）。

components.name: 2. Pre-wet membrane: add 500 µL storage buffer; spin 2 min at 4,000×g; discard

note.en: Removes glycerol storage solution from new membranes. Some protocols skip this step.
note.zh: 去除新膜上的甘油储存液。部分方案可跳过此步。

components.name: 3. Load protein sample into concentrator (do not exceed max volume)

note.en: Max fill: 4 mL (Ultra-4), 15 mL (Ultra-15). Leave 10% headspace. Apply sample gently (do not pipette directly onto membrane).
note.zh: 最大体积：Ultra-4 为 4 mL，Ultra-15 为 15 mL。留 10% 空间。轻柔加样（勿直接往膜上吸打）。

note.en: Do NOT exceed 4,000×g (damages membrane). 4°C preferred for protein stability. Check volume every 5–10 min — do not let membrane go dry (protein aggregates irreversibly on dry membrane).
note.zh: 不超过 4,000×g（损坏膜）。4°C 保护蛋白稳定性。每 5–10 min 检查一次体积——绝不让膜干燥（蛋白会不可逆地聚集在干膜上）。

components.name: 5. Continue centrifugation until desired volume reached

note.en: Typical: 50-fold concentration takes ~30–60 min. Stop at ≥50 µL (Amicon Ultra-4) to allow easy recovery. Mix gently by pipetting up/down every 15–20 min to prevent boundary layer effect.
note.zh: 典型 50 倍浓缩约 30–60 min。停在 ≥50 µL（Ultra-4）以便回收。每 15–20 min 轻柔吸打混匀，防止边界层效应。

note.en: Invert device, place in recovery tube, spin 2 min at 1,000×g. Typical recovery: 90–95%. Rinse membrane with 20–50 µL buffer for maximum recovery.
note.zh: 倒置装置，放入回收管，1,000×g 离心 2 min。典型回收率：90–95%。用 20–50 µL 缓冲液冲洗膜，最大化回收。

components.name: 7. Buffer exchange (optional): dilute 10× in new buffer, repeat concentration (×3 cycles)

note.en: 3 cycles of 10× dilution + concentration removes >99.9% of original buffer components. Equivalent to dialysis but much faster (30 min vs 6–12 h).
note.zh: 3 次 10 倍稀释 + 浓缩循环，去除 >99.9% 原缓冲液成分。效果等同透析，但速度快（30 min vs 6–12 h）。

components.name: 8. Quantify concentrated protein (BCA or Bradford); run SDS-PAGE QC

note.en: Compare before and after by SDS-PAGE to check for aggregation or protein loss.
note.zh: 浓缩前后 SDS-PAGE 对比，检查是否有聚集或蛋白损失。

notes.en: Troubleshooting: Slow filtration → protein aggregating on membrane (reduce concentration, add mild detergent 0.01% Tween-20, or switch to lower MWCO). Protein in filtrate → wrong MWCO or membrane integrity issue. Sticky proteins: add BSA 0.1% carrier, or use PES membranes instead of regenerated cellulose.
notes.zh: 排查：过滤慢→蛋白在膜上聚集（降低浓度、加 0.01% Tween-20 或换更小 MWCO）；蛋白在滤液中→MWCO 选错或膜破损；粘性蛋白：加 0.1% BSA 载体蛋白，或换 PES 膜替代再生纤维素膜。

ref: Millipore Amicon Ultra User Guide; Wingfield (2015) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 80:A.3F.1

usage.en: Concentrate and buffer-exchange proteins using Amicon centrifugal ultrafiltration units.
usage.zh: Amicon 超滤离心管浓缩和换液蛋白质。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 hours，实操: 1 hour

note.en: Concentrated protein can be stored at 4°C for days or at −80°C with 10% glycerol for months
note.zh: 浓缩蛋白可 4°C 保存数天或加 10% 甘油 −80°C 保存数月

note.en: After buffer exchange, protein can be used immediately or stored at −80°C
note.zh: 换液后的蛋白可立即使用或 −80°C 保存

briefSteps.en: Pre-wet membrane → Load sample (≤max vol) → Spin 3,500–4,000×g 4°C, check q15 min → Recover by inverting & spin 1,000×g 2 min → (Optional: buffer exchange ×3 cycles) → Quantify & SDS-PAGE QC
briefSteps.zh: 预湿膜 → 加样（≤最大体积）→ 3,500–4,000×g 4°C 离心，每 15 min 检查 → 倒置 1,000×g 2 min 回收 →（可选：3 次换液循环）→ 定量 + SDS-PAGE 质检

detailedSteps.en: **Preparation**
Select appropriate Amicon Ultra filter based on protein molecular weight. MWCO should be 3–6× smaller than the protein MW. Available sizes: Ultra-0.5 (0.5 mL), Ultra-4 (4 mL), Ultra-15 (15 mL).
detailedSteps.zh: 根据蛋白分子量选择合适的 Amicon Ultra 滤器。MWCO 应为蛋白 MW 的 1/3–1/6。规格：Ultra-0.5（0.5 mL）、Ultra-4（4 mL）、Ultra-15（15 mL）。

detailedSteps.en: Pre-wet new membrane: add 500 µL of your storage buffer (or water) to the concentrator. Centrifuge at 4,000×g, 2 min, 4°C. Discard flow-through.
detailedSteps.zh: 新膜预湿：向浓缩器中加 500 µL 储存缓冲液（或水）。4,000×g 离心 2 min，4°C。弃滤过液。

detailedSteps.en: **Sample loading & concentration**
detailedSteps.zh: **加样与浓缩**

detailedSteps.en: Load protein sample into the concentrator. Do not exceed maximum volume: 4 mL (Ultra-4) or 15 mL (Ultra-15). Leave ~10% headspace. Apply sample gently — do not pipette directly onto the membrane.
detailedSteps.zh: 将蛋白样品加入浓缩器。不超过最大体积：Ultra-4 为 4 mL，Ultra-15 为 15 mL。留约 10% 空间。轻柔加样——勿直接往膜上吹打。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 3,500–4,000×g in a swinging-bucket rotor at 4°C. Check every 5–10 min. Do NOT exceed 4,000×g — this damages the membrane and causes protein leakage.
detailedSteps.zh: 摆桶转子 3,500–4,000×g 离心，4°C。每 5–10 min 检查一次。不超过 4,000×g——会损坏膜并导致蛋白漏过。

detailedSteps.en: Every 15–20 min, stop centrifuge and gently pipette sample up/down 2–3 times to resuspend any concentrated protein at the membrane bottom (boundary layer effect). Return to centrifuge.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 15–20 min 停止离心，轻柔吸打样品 2–3 次重悬膜底部的浓缩蛋白（边界层效应）。放回离心机。

detailedSteps.en: Continue centrifugation until desired concentration is reached. For Amicon Ultra-4: stop at ≥50 µL to allow easy recovery. For Amicon Ultra-15: stop at ≥200 µL.
detailedSteps.zh: 继续离心直到达到目标浓度。Ultra-4：停在 ≥50 µL 以便回收。Ultra-15：停在 ≥200 µL。

detailedSteps.en: **Recovery**
To recover concentrated protein: invert the device in a clean collection tube. Centrifuge at 1,000×g for 2 min at 4°C. The concentrate will collect in the bottom of the collection tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 回收浓缩蛋白：将装置倒置放入干净的收集管。1,000×g 离心 2 min，4°C。浓缩液会聚集在收集管底部。

detailedSteps.en: For maximum recovery: add 20–50 µL of your desired buffer to the membrane, pipette up/down to rinse, then invert and spin again at 1,000×g for 1 min. Combine with main concentrate.
detailedSteps.zh: 最大化回收：膜上加 20–50 µL 目标缓冲液，吸打冲洗，倒置 1,000×g 再离心 1 min。与主浓缩液合并。

detailedSteps.en: **Buffer exchange (optional)**
detailedSteps.zh: **换液（可选）**

detailedSteps.en: For buffer exchange: add the desired buffer to bring the sample back to the original volume (e.g., add 4 mL to Ultra-4). Concentrate again to the desired volume. Repeat 3× to achieve >99.9% buffer exchange.
detailedSteps.zh: 换液：加目标缓冲液恢复原始体积（如 Ultra-4 加 4 mL）。再浓缩到目标体积。重复 3 次以实现 >99.9% 换液。

detailedSteps.en: **Quality control**
detailedSteps.zh: **质量控制**

detailedSteps.en: Quantify concentrated protein by BCA or Bradford assay. Run SDS-PAGE before and after concentration to check for aggregation or protein loss. Store at 4°C (short-term) or −80°C with 10% glycerol (long-term).
detailedSteps.zh: BCA 或 Bradford 法测定浓缩蛋白浓度。浓缩前后 SDS-PAGE 检查聚集或蛋白损失。4°C 保存（短期）或 −80°C 加 10% 甘油保存（长期）。

name: Protein Dialysis and Buffer Exchange

components.name: 1. Prepare dialysis tubing or membrane device

note.en: Tubing: boil in 2% NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA 10 min, rinse thoroughly. Slide-A-Lyzer: soak in buffer 2 min. MWCO: 3.5 kDa (<20 kDa protein), 12–14 kDa (most proteins), 50 kDa (large complexes).
note.zh: 透析袋：2% NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA 煮 10 min，彻底冲洗。Slide-A-Lyzer：缓冲液浸泡 2 min。MWCO：3.5 kDa（<20 kDa 蛋白）、12–14 kDa（大多数蛋白）、50 kDa（大型复合体）。

note.en: Sample expands ~10–20% by osmosis. Seal securely.
note.zh: 渗透作用导致样品膨胀 ~10–20%。密封牢固。

components.name: 3. Dialyze change 1: 500 mL buffer, 2 h, 4°C, gentle stirring

note.en: ≥200× volume ratio. Slow stir bar (no foam = no protein denaturation).
note.zh: ≥200 倍体积比。慢速搅拌（无泡沫 = 无蛋白变性）。

components.name: 4. Dialyze change 2: fresh 500 mL buffer, 2 h, 4°C

note.en: Each change removes >90% of target small molecule.
note.zh: 每次换液去除 >90% 的目标小分子。

note.en: Add 10% glycerol to final buffer if storing at −80°C.
note.zh: 若需 −80°C 保存，末次透析液加 10% 甘油。

note.en: Volume may increase. Quantify: Bradford or BCA. Concentrate if needed: Amicon Ultra (4,000×g, 4°C).
note.zh: 体积可能增加。Bradford 或 BCA 定量。如需浓缩：Amicon Ultra（4,000×g，4°C）。

notes.en: Faster alternatives: (a) HiTrap Desalting column (5 mL, 5 min on AKTA); (b) Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter + dilution (3 cycles removes >99.9%); (c) ZebaSpin Desalting Column (2 min spin). Amicon: do not let protein dry on membrane.
notes.zh: 更快替代方案：(a) HiTrap Desalting 脱盐柱（5 mL，AKTA 5 min）；(b) Amicon Ultra 离心浓缩管 + 稀释换液（3 次去除 >99.9%）；(c) ZebaSpin 脱盐柱（2 min）。Amicon 注意勿让蛋白干在膜上。

ref: Scopes (1994) Protein Purification 3rd ed.; Wingfield (2001) Curr Protoc Protein Sci A.3B.1; ThermoFisher Slide-A-Lyzer Manual

usage.en: Remove small molecules, exchange buffer, or desalt proteins by dialysis.
usage.zh: 透析法去除小分子、换液或蛋白脱盐。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 6–12 hours，实操: 1 hour

note.en: Choose MWCO ≤ ½ protein MW. SnakeSkin or Slide-A-Lyzer (Thermo)
note.zh: 选择截留分子量≤蛋白MW的½。SnakeSkin或Slide-A-Lyzer（Thermo）

note.en: 2 per tube, weighted
note.zh: 每管2个，加重型

note.en: For membrane preparation
note.zh: 用于膜准备

note.en: 1 mM for membrane preparation
note.zh: 1 mM用于膜准备

note.en: 500× sample volume, pre-chilled
note.zh: 500×样品体积，预冷

note.en: For gentle agitation during dialysis
note.zh: 透析时轻柔搅拌用

note.en: Amicon Ultra, if concentration needed
note.zh: Amicon Ultra，如需浓缩

note.en: Loaded and sealed dialysis unit can be placed at 4°C and left for up to 1 h before starting dialysis.
note.zh: 装好密封的透析单元可在 4°C 放置最长 1 h 再开始透析。

note.en: Recovered protein can be stored at 4°C overnight, or aliquoted and frozen at −80°C for long-term storage.
note.zh: 回收的蛋白可 4°C 暂存过夜，或分装 −80°C 长期保存。

briefSteps.en: Prepare and pre-wet dialysis tubing/cassette (appropriate MWCO) → load protein sample with headspace → dialyze in ≥200× volume dialysis buffer at 4°C with gentle stirring, changing buffer 3 times (2 h + 2 h + overnight) → recover sample and quantify.
briefSteps.zh: 准备并预湿透析袋/透析盒（选适当 MWCO）→ 留出膨胀空间装入蛋白样品 → 4°C 轻柔搅拌下在 ≥200 倍体积透析液中透析，换液 3 次（2 h + 2 h + 过夜）→ 回收样品并定量。

detailedSteps.en: Select dialysis tubing or membrane cassette with appropriate MWCO: 3.5 kDa for proteins <20 kDa, 12–14 kDa for most proteins, 50 kDa for large complexes. For traditional tubing: boil in 2% NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA for 10 min, then rinse thoroughly with ddH₂O. For Slide-A-Lyzer cassettes: pre-wet by soaking in dialysis buffer for 2 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 根据目标蛋白大小选择 MWCO：<20 kDa 蛋白用 3.5 kDa，大多数蛋白用 12–14 kDa，大型复合体用 50 kDa。传统透析袋：2% NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA 煮 10 min 后彻底冲洗；Slide-A-Lyzer 透析盒：透析液浸泡 2 min 预湿。

detailedSteps.en: Load protein sample into dialysis tubing or cassette, leaving 15–20% headspace to accommodate the 10–20% volume expansion that occurs by osmosis. Seal tubing securely with dialysis clips at both ends.
detailedSteps.zh: 将蛋白样品装入透析袋或透析盒，留 15–20% 顶空以容纳渗透作用导致的 10–20% 体积膨胀，两端用透析夹牢固密封。

detailedSteps.en: Submerge sealed dialysis unit in 500 mL (or ≥200× sample volume) of dialysis buffer in a beaker at 4°C. Stir gently with a magnetic stir bar (low speed — no foam to prevent protein denaturation). Dialyze for 2 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 将密封透析单元置于 500 mL（或 ≥200 倍样品体积）透析液中，4°C 磁力搅拌（低速、无泡沫以防蛋白变性），透析 2 h。

detailedSteps.en: Replace with fresh 500 mL dialysis buffer. Continue dialyzing at 4°C for another 2 h. Each buffer change removes >90% of the remaining small molecules.
detailedSteps.zh: 换入新鲜 500 mL 透析液，继续 4°C 透析 2 h。每次换液去除 >90% 的目标小分子。

detailedSteps.en: Replace with a third 500 mL fresh dialysis buffer. Dialyze overnight at 4°C (8–12 h). If the final protein will be stored at −80°C, add 10% glycerol to this last dialysis buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 换入第三批新鲜透析液（500 mL），4°C 过夜透析（8–12 h）。若蛋白需 −80°C 保存，在末次透析液中加入 10% 甘油。

detailedSteps.en: Carefully remove the dialysis unit, dry the outside, and extract the protein sample with a pipette. Note that the sample volume may have increased due to osmotic water uptake.
detailedSteps.zh: 小心取出透析单元，擦干外壁，用移液器抽取蛋白样品，注意样品体积可能因渗透吸水而增加。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify the recovered protein concentration by BCA or Bradford assay. If the sample is too dilute, concentrate using an Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter (4,000×g, 4°C) with the same MWCO as the dialysis membrane. Aliquot and store at −80°C.
detailedSteps.zh: BCA 或 Bradford 法定量回收蛋白浓度。若样品过稀，用 Amicon Ultra 离心浓缩管（4,000×g，4°C，选与透析袋相同 MWCO）浓缩，分装后 −80°C 保存。

name: Proximity Ligation Assay (PLA)

notes.en: Each fluorescent dot = one interaction (<40 nm). Include single-Ab controls. Quantify dots per cell with ImageJ.
notes.zh: 每个荧光点 = 一次互作（<40 nm）。包含单抗体对照。用 ImageJ 定量每细胞点数。

ref: Söderberg et al. (2006) Nat Methods 3:995

usage.en: Detect protein-protein interactions in situ using proximity ligation assay (PLA/Duolink).
usage.zh: 原位邻近连接实验（PLA/Duolink）检测蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 5 hours

note.en: 0.1–0.5% in PBS for permeabilization
note.zh: 0.1–0.5% PBS 溶液用于透化

note.en: Includes blocking solution, antibody diluent, PLA probes, ligation, amplification reagents, wash buffers, mounting medium
note.zh: 包含封闭液、抗体稀释液、PLA探针、连接、扩增试剂、洗涤缓冲液、封片剂

note.en: Mouse anti-target (validated for IF)
note.zh: 鼠抗目标蛋白（IF验证）

note.en: Rabbit anti-target (validated for IF)
note.zh: 兔抗目标蛋白（IF验证）

note.en: For 37°C incubations
note.zh: 用于37°C孵育

note.en: Fixed and permeabilized slides can be stored at 4°C in PBS overnight before blocking and antibody incubation.
note.zh: 固定并通透后的切片可在 4°C PBS 中保存过夜，次日再封闭和孵育抗体。

note.en: Slides with primary antibodies applied can be left at 4°C overnight in a humidity chamber — this is the standard overnight incubation step.
note.zh: 已加一抗的切片可在湿盒中 4°C 保存过夜——这是标准过夜孵育步骤。

note.en: Mounted and sealed slides can be stored at −20°C in the dark for several weeks before imaging.
note.zh: 封片并密封的切片可避光 −20°C 保存数周后再成像。

briefSteps.en: Fix and permeabilize cells → block with Duolink solution → incubate two primary antibodies (different species) overnight → add PLA PLUS and MINUS probes → ligate to form circular DNA template → amplify by rolling circle amplification → mount with DAPI → image by fluorescence microscopy and quantify dots per cell
briefSteps.zh: 固定并通透细胞 → Duolink 封闭液封闭 → 过夜孵育两种一抗（不同种属）→ 加 PLA PLUS 和 MINUS 探针 → 连接形成环状 DNA 模板 → 滚环扩增 → DAPI 封片 → 荧光显微镜成像并定量每细胞荧光点数

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Sample Preparation
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天：样品制备

detailedSteps.en: Seed cells on glass coverslips (or use tissue sections on slides). Fix with 4% PFA in PBS for 15 min at room temperature. Wash 3× with PBS.
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞培养于玻璃盖玻片上（或使用组织切片）。用 4% PFA/PBS 室温固定 15 min。PBS 洗涤 3 次。

detailedSteps.en: Permeabilize with 0.2–0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS for 10 min at room temperature. Wash 3× with PBS. For membrane proteins, skip permeabilization.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 0.2–0.3% Triton X-100/PBS 室温通透 10 min。PBS 洗涤 3 次。膜蛋白可跳过通透步骤。

detailedSteps.en: Block with Duolink blocking solution in a pre-heated humidity chamber at 37°C for 1 h. Do not allow slides to dry at any point. Apply 40 µL blocking solution per coverslip.
detailedSteps.zh: 在预热湿盒中用 Duolink 封闭液 37°C 封闭 1 h。全程勿让切片干燥。每张盖玻片加 40 µL 封闭液。

detailedSteps.en: Without washing, remove excess blocking solution and apply both primary antibodies diluted in Duolink antibody diluent (typically 1:100–1:500). Incubate overnight at 4°C in a humidity chamber. Use antibodies from two different host species (e.g., rabbit anti-Protein A + mouse anti-Protein B).
detailedSteps.zh: 不洗涤，去除多余封闭液，加用 Duolink 抗体稀释液稀释的两种一抗（通常 1:100–1:500）。湿盒中 4°C 过夜孵育。两种抗体须来自不同宿主（如兔抗蛋白 A + 鼠抗蛋白 B）。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: PLA Reaction
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天：PLA 反应

detailedSteps.en: Wash slides 2× with Wash Buffer A (10 min each) at room temperature with gentle agitation. Apply PLA PLUS and MINUS probes (species-matched secondary antibodies conjugated to oligonucleotides) diluted 1:5 in antibody diluent. Incubate at 37°C for 1 h in humidity chamber.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 Wash Buffer A 室温振荡洗涤 2 次（每次 10 min）。将 PLA PLUS 和 MINUS 探针（与寡核苷酸偶联的种属匹配二抗）1:5 稀释于抗体稀释液中。湿盒中 37°C 孵育 1 h。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with Wash Buffer A (10 min each). Apply freshly prepared ligation solution (ligase diluted 1:40 in ligation buffer). Incubate at 37°C for 30 min. This step ligates the two PLA probe oligonucleotides when proteins are within <40 nm.
detailedSteps.zh: Wash Buffer A 洗涤 2 次（每次 10 min）。加新鲜配制的连接液（连接酶 1:40 稀释于连接缓冲液中）。37°C 孵育 30 min。此步骤当两蛋白距离 <40 nm 时将两个 PLA 探针寡核苷酸连接成环。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with Wash Buffer A (10 min each). Apply freshly prepared amplification solution (polymerase diluted 1:80 in amplification buffer + fluorescently labeled detection probes). Incubate at 37°C for 100 min in the dark.
detailedSteps.zh: Wash Buffer A 洗涤 2 次（每次 10 min）。加新鲜配制的扩增液（聚合酶 1:80 稀释于扩增缓冲液 + 荧光标记检测探针中）。避光 37°C 孵育 100 min。

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with Wash Buffer B (10 min each) at room temperature in the dark, then 1× with 0.01× Wash Buffer B for 1 min. Allow slides to air-dry briefly in the dark.
detailedSteps.zh: 避光室温用 Wash Buffer B 洗涤 2 次（每次 10 min），再用 0.01× Wash Buffer B 洗涤 1 min。避光短暂晾干。

detailedSteps.en: Mount coverslips with Duolink In Situ Mounting Medium with DAPI. Seal edges with nail varnish after DAPI sets (~15 min). Image by fluorescence microscopy using appropriate filter sets. Each fluorescent dot represents one protein-protein interaction event (<40 nm proximity).
detailedSteps.zh: 用含 DAPI 的 Duolink In Situ 封片剂封片。DAPI 定型（约 15 min）后用指甲油封边。使用合适滤光片组荧光显微镜成像。每个荧光点代表一次蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用事件（<40 nm 邻近）。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify fluorescent dots per cell using ImageJ (FIJI) with Cell Counter plugin, or automated software (Blobfinder, CellProfiler). Express as dots per cell. Include controls: single primary antibody controls (should give near-zero signal) and positive interaction control.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 ImageJ（FIJI）Cell Counter 插件或自动化软件（Blobfinder、CellProfiler）定量每细胞荧光点数。以每细胞点数表示结果。包含对照：单一一抗对照（应近乎零信号）和阳性互作对照。

name: Recombinant Protein Expression in E. coli
nameCn: 大肠杆菌重组蛋白表达

note.en: Heat shock (heat_shock_transformation): 42°C 30 s → 2 min ice → 200 µL SOC → 37°C 45 min. Plate on LB+antibiotic agar, 37°C overnight.
note.zh: 热激（heat_shock_transformation）：42°C 30 s → 2 min 冰 → 200 µL SOC → 37°C 45 min。涂 LB+抗生素平板，37°C 过夜。

components.name: 2. Inoculate starter culture: 5–10 mL LB+antibiotic, 37°C, 200 rpm, overnight

note.en: Pick single colony. Grow 12–16 h.
note.zh: 挑单克隆。培养 12–16 h。

components.name: 3. Dilute 1:50–1:100 into expression medium (LB or TB), shake 37°C 200 rpm

note.en: 10 mL starter into 500 mL TB (tb_media) in 2 L flask. TB gives ~2× higher cell density than LB.
note.zh: 10 mL 过夜培养物加入 500 mL TB（tb_media），2 L 摇瓶。TB 培养密度比 LB 高 ~2 倍。

components.name: 4. Monitor OD₆₀₀; at OD 0.6–0.8 cool to induction temperature

note.en: Soluble: cool to 18°C (~15 min ice-water bath). High yield/inclusion body: stay at 37°C.
note.zh: 可溶表达：降温至 18°C（~15 min 冰水浴）。高产量/包涵体：保持 37°C。

note.en: Soluble: 0.1–0.5 mM, 18°C, 16–20 h overnight. Inclusion body: 1 mM, 37°C, 3–4 h. Test conditions for new proteins!
note.zh: 可溶：0.1–0.5 mM IPTG，18°C，16–20 h 过夜。包涵体：1 mM IPTG，37°C，3–4 h。新蛋白务必先做条件摸索！

note.en: Discard supernatant. Pellets storable at −80°C (weeks–months). Weigh pellet.
note.zh: 弃上清。菌体沉淀可 −80°C 保存数周至数月。称量湿重。

components.name: 7. Check expression: SDS-PAGE on pre/post-induction samples

note.en: Take 1 mL at OD 0.6 (T=0) and post-induction. Pellet → SDS buffer → boil 5 min. Expect new band at target MW.
note.zh: 分别取 OD 0.6 时（T=0）和诱导后各 1 mL。离心收菌 → SDS 上样缓冲液 → 煮 5 min。应见目标 MW 新带。

components.name: 8. Solubility check: lyse aliquot → 20,000×g 10 min 4°C → SDS-PAGE pellet vs supernatant

note.en: Protein in pellet = inclusion body. Try: lower temp (16°C), less IPTG (0.05 mM), co-express chaperones (GroEL/ES, DnaK), or different strains (Rosetta, SoluBL21, ArcticExpress).
note.zh: 蛋白在沉淀 = 包涵体。试：更低温度（16°C）、更少 IPTG（0.05 mM）、共表达分子伴侣（GroEL/ES、DnaK）、或换菌株（Rosetta、SoluBL21、ArcticExpress）。

note.en: See his_tag_purification or gst_tag_purification.
note.zh: 参见 his_tag_purification 或 gst_tag_purification。

notes.en: Troubleshooting: Low expression → verify plasmid, antibiotic. Insoluble → lower temp, auto-induction (ZYM-5052), solubility tags (MBP, SUMO, NusA). Proteolysis → protease inhibitors, BL21 strain. Codon optimization for eukaryotic genes.
notes.zh: 排查：表达低→检查质粒、抗生素；包涵体→降温、自诱导培养基（ZYM-5052）、可溶性标签（MBP、SUMO、NusA）；降解→加蛋白酶抑制剂、用 BL21 菌株。真核基因注意密码子优化。

ref: Rosano & Ceccarelli (2014) Front Microbiol 5:172; Studier (2005) Protein Expr Purif 41:207–234; Graslund et al. (2008) Nat Methods 5:135–146

usage.en: Express recombinant proteins in E. coli using IPTG induction.
usage.zh: 通过 IPTG 诱导在大肠杆菌中表达重组蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 days，实操: 4 hours

note.en: Or Rosetta/SHuffle as needed
note.zh: 或按需用 Rosetta/SHuffle

note.en: pET, pGEX, pMAL series, etc.
note.zh: pET、pGEX、pMAL 系列等

note.en: Match to plasmid resistance marker
note.zh: 与质粒抗性标记匹配

note.en: Filter-sterilized, store at −20°C
note.zh: 过滤除菌，−20°C 保存

note.en: 50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 300 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole (for His-tag)
note.zh: 50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 300 mM NaCl, 10 mM 咪唑（His-tag）

note.en: 1 mg/mL final
note.zh: 终浓度 1 mg/mL

note.en: Add fresh, 1 mM final
note.zh: 现配现用，终浓度 1 mM

note.en: EDTA-free for IMAC purification
note.zh: 无EDTA，用于IMAC纯化

note.en: Transformation plates at 4°C for up to 1 week
note.zh: 转化平板4°C保存最长1周

note.en: Expression can proceed overnight at 16°C for soluble protein
note.zh: 可溶蛋白可16°C过夜表达

note.en: Cell pellet can be flash-frozen and stored at −80°C for weeks
note.zh: 菌体可速冻后 −80°C 保存数周

note.en: Clarified lysate can be stored at −80°C briefly if needed
note.zh: 澄清裂解液如需可短期 −80°C 保存

briefSteps.en: Transform plasmid into BL21(DE3) → overnight starter culture → dilute 1:50–1:100 into expression medium → grow to OD₆₀₀ 0.6–0.8 → cool to induction temp → add 0.1–1 mM IPTG → induce 3–20 h → harvest cells → check expression by SDS-PAGE
briefSteps.zh: 质粒转入 BL21(DE3) → 过夜种子培养 → 1:50–1:100 接种表达培养基 → 培养至 OD₆₀₀ 0.6–0.8 → 降温 → 加 0.1–1 mM IPTG → 诱导 3–20 h → 收集菌体 → SDS-PAGE 检测表达

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Transform the expression vector into BL21(DE3) by heat shock (42°C, 30 s). Plate on LB + antibiotic agar and grow at 37°C overnight.
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：热激（42°C、30 s）将表达载体转入 BL21(DE3），涂 LB + 抗生素平板，37°C 过夜培养。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Pick a single colony into 5–10 mL LB + antibiotic; grow overnight at 37°C, 200 rpm (12–16 h) as a starter culture.
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天：挑单克隆接种至 5–10 mL LB + 抗生素，37°C、200 rpm 过夜培养 12–16 h 作为种子液。

detailedSteps.en: Day 3: Dilute starter culture 1:50–1:100 into 500 mL LB or TB medium in a 2 L baffled flask; shake at 37°C, 200 rpm.
detailedSteps.zh: 第3天：将种子液 1:50–1:100 接种至 2 L 挡板摇瓶中的 500 mL LB 或 TB 培养基，37°C、200 rpm 振荡培养。

detailedSteps.en: Monitor OD₆₀₀ every 30 min; when OD reaches 0.6–0.8 (approximately 2–3 h), take a 1 mL pre-induction sample and pellet for SDS-PAGE.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 30 min 监测 OD₆₀₀，当 OD 达 0.6–0.8（约 2–3 h 后），取 1 mL 诱导前样品离心备 SDS-PAGE 检测。

detailedSteps.en: For soluble expression: cool culture to 16–18°C by transferring to an ice-water bath (~15 min) or cold incubator. For inclusion body/high-yield: remain at 37°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 可溶表达：将培养物转至冰水浴（约 15 min）或冷培养箱降温至 16–18°C；包涵体/高产量：保持 37°C。

detailedSteps.en: Induce expression by adding IPTG from a 1 M stock: 0.1–0.5 mM for soluble expression at 16–18°C (16–20 h overnight); 0.5–1 mM for high-yield/inclusion body at 37°C (3–4 h).
detailedSteps.zh: 从 1 M IPTG 储液中加入诱导：可溶表达 0.1–0.5 mM，16–18°C 诱导 16–20 h（过夜）；高产量/包涵体 0.5–1 mM，37°C 诱导 3–4 h。

detailedSteps.en: At the end of induction, take a 1 mL post-induction sample for SDS-PAGE comparison. Harvest cells by centrifugation at 5,000×g for 10 min at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 诱导结束时取 1 mL 诱导后样品用于 SDS-PAGE 对比，4°C、5,000×g 离心 10 min 收集菌体。

detailedSteps.en: Discard supernatant; weigh the wet cell pellet. Pellets can be stored at −80°C for weeks to months.
detailedSteps.zh: 弃去上清，称量菌体湿重。菌体沉淀可 −80°C 保存数周至数月。

detailedSteps.en: Check expression: resuspend pre- and post-induction samples in SDS loading buffer, boil at 95°C for 5 min, run SDS-PAGE. A new band at the target molecular weight confirms expression.
detailedSteps.zh: 检查表达：将诱导前后样品用 SDS 上样缓冲液重悬，95°C 煮 5 min，跑 SDS-PAGE，出现目标分子量新条带即确认表达。

detailedSteps.en: Optional solubility check: lyse a small aliquot (sonication or lysozyme), centrifuge at 20,000×g for 10 min at 4°C, run SDS-PAGE on pellet vs. supernatant to determine if protein is soluble.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选溶解性检测：取少量菌体裂解（超声或溶菌酶法），4°C、20,000×g 离心 10 min，分别取沉淀和上清跑 SDS-PAGE，判断蛋白是否可溶。

detailedSteps.en: Proceed to protein purification by affinity chromatography (His-tag: Ni-NTA resin; GST-tag: glutathione resin). See his_tag_purification or gst_tag_purification protocols.
detailedSteps.zh: 进行亲和层析纯化蛋白（His 标签：Ni-NTA 树脂；GST 标签：谷胱甘肽树脂），参见 his_tag_purification 或 gst_tag_purification 方案。

name: Resazurin (alamarBlue) Cell Viability Assay

components.name: 1. Seed cells in 96-well plate; overnight attachment

note.en: 5,000–20,000 cells/well, 100 µL complete medium. Fill edge wells with PBS. For bacteria/yeast: use 200 µL/well. Same edge-effect precautions as MTT/CCK-8.
note.zh: 每孔 5,000–20,000 细胞，100 µL 完全培养基。边缘孔加 PBS。细菌/酵母用 200 µL/孔。与 MTT/CCK-8 相同的边缘效应注意事项。

components.name: 2. Prepare resazurin stock: 0.15 mg/mL (440 µM) in PBS; filter-sterilize 0.22 µm

note.en: Stock: dissolve 1.5 mg resazurin sodium salt (MW 251.17) in 10 mL PBS. Sterile filter. Store 4°C in dark (stable 3 months) or −20°C long-term. Solution should be dark blue/purple (oxidized = non-fluorescent).
note.zh: 母液：1.5 mg 刃天青钠盐（MW 251.17）溶于 10 mL PBS。0.22 µm 过滤除菌。4°C 避光保存（稳定 3 个月）或 −20°C 长期保存。溶液应为深蓝/紫色（氧化态 = 无荧光）。

note.en: Same controls as MTT: untreated cells, blank (medium only), solvent control. For multi-timepoint: plate separate plates per timepoint.
note.zh: 与 MTT 相同对照：未处理细胞、空白孔（仅培养基）、溶剂对照。多时间点测定：每个时间点单独铺板。

components.name: 4. Add resazurin: 10 µL of 0.15 mg/mL stock per 100 µL medium (final 0.015 mg/mL = 10% v/v)

note.en: OR: use commercial alamarBlue (BioRad) at 10% v/v directly. Do NOT remove medium. Wrap plate in foil.
note.zh: 或：直接用商品化 alamarBlue（BioRad）按 10% v/v 加入。不去除培养基。用锡纸包裹培养板。

components.name: 5. Incubate 1–4 h at 37°C, 5% CO₂ (or overnight for slow metabolizers)

note.en: Monitor color shift: blue → pink/red = reduction by viable cells. Optimal: 20–40% reduction at midpoint. Bacteria/yeast: 2–6 h at appropriate growth temperature.
note.zh: 监测颜色变化：蓝色→粉红/红色 = 活细胞还原。最佳：中间时间点还原率 20–40%。细菌/酵母：在适当生长温度下 2–6 h。

components.name: 6A. Fluorometric reading (preferred): Ex 560 nm / Em 590 nm

note.en: 10–100× more sensitive than absorbance. Use black-sided clear-bottom 96-well plates. Gain: set to give RFU ~50,000–100,000 for controls.
note.zh: 灵敏度比比色法高 10–100 倍。使用黑边透明底 96 孔板。增益：设定使对照孔 RFU 约 50,000–100,000。

note.en: Less sensitive but works with standard plate reader. % Reduction = [(εox at 600 × A570) − (εox at 570 × A600)] / [(εred at 570 × A600_control) − (εred at 600 × A570_control)] × 100. Or use simplified: OD570/OD600 ratio.
note.zh: 灵敏度较低但普通酶标仪即可。公式见英文（需使用摩尔吸收系数）。简化版：OD570/OD600 比值。

note.en: % Viability = (RFU_treated − RFU_blank) / (RFU_control − RFU_blank) × 100. Non-destructive: can remove 10 µL aliquot for reading, return plate to incubator, re-read at later timepoints.
note.zh: % 活力 = (RFU处理 − RFU空白) / (RFU对照 − RFU空白) × 100。非破坏性：取 10 µL 读完后放回孵育箱，可在不同时间点重复读取。

notes.en: Key advantages: (1) Fully non-destructive — can continue culturing after reading; (2) Fluorometric mode: highly sensitive for low cell numbers (100–500 cells); (3) Works with all cell types including primary cells, bacteria, yeast, fungi. Pitfalls: some compounds (quinones, flavonoids) directly reduce resazurin (false positive) — confirm with alternative assay. Stable endpoint: resorufin (pink) is stable for hours; fully reduced = colorless (false low if over-reduced).
notes.zh: 关键优势：(1) 完全非破坏性——读取后可继续培养；(2) 荧光模式灵敏度极高，适合低细胞数（100–500 个细胞）；(3) 适用于所有细胞类型，包括原代细胞、细菌、酵母、真菌。注意：某些化合物（醌类、黄酮类）可直接还原刃天青（假阳性）——用其他方法验证。终点稳定：resorufin（粉红色）稳定数小时；过度还原会变无色（假阴性）。

ref: O'Brien et al. (2000) Eur J Biochem 267:5421–5426; Rampersad (2012) Sensors 12:12347–12360; alamarBlue Assay User Guide (BioRad #BUL0012)

usage.en: Measure cell viability and proliferation using resazurin (alamarBlue) fluorometric assay.
usage.zh: 刃天青（alamarBlue）荧光法检测细胞活力和增殖。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–3 days，实操: 1 hour

materials.name: Microplate reader (fluorescence: Ex 560 nm / Em 590 nm, or absorbance 570/600 nm)

note.en: Seeded plate with attached cells can be stored at 37°C/5% CO₂ overnight before adding treatments
note.zh: 已接种并贴壁的细胞板可在 37°C/5% CO₂ 过夜保存，次日再加药物处理

note.en: After drug treatment (24–72 h), plate can be processed immediately or within 1–2 h for resazurin addition
note.zh: 药物处理（24–72 h）后，可立即处理或 1–2 h 内加入刃天青

briefSteps.en: Seed cells (96-well) → attach O/N → add drug/treatment (24–72 h) → add resazurin (10% v/v) → incubate 1–4 h → read fluorescence (Ex 560/Em 590) → calculate % viability
briefSteps.zh: 接种细胞（96 孔板）→ 过夜贴壁 → 加药物处理（24–72 h）→ 加刃天青（10% v/v）→ 孵育 1–4 h → 读荧光（Ex 560/Em 590）→ 计算 % 活力

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0 — Cell Seeding**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 0 天 — 细胞接种**

detailedSteps.en: Seed 5,000–20,000 cells/well in 96-well plate with 100 µL complete medium. Fill edge wells with PBS to minimize evaporation (edge effect). Include blank wells (medium only, no cells)
detailedSteps.zh: 96 孔板中接种 5,000–20,000 细胞/孔，100 µL 完全培养基。边缘孔加 PBS 减少蒸发（边缘效应）。设置空白孔（仅培养基，无细胞）

detailedSteps.en: Incubate overnight at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for cell attachment
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 过夜孵育使细胞贴壁

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Treatment**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 1 天 — 处理**

detailedSteps.en: Add drug/treatment at desired concentrations. Include controls: untreated cells, solvent control (vehicle), blank wells. Incubate 24–72 h as per experimental design
detailedSteps.zh: 加入药物/处理至所需浓度。设置对照：未处理细胞、溶剂对照（载体）、空白孔。按实验设计孵育 24–72 h

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2–4 — Resazurin Addition & Reading**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 2–4 天 — 加入刃天青与读数**

detailedSteps.en: Add 10 µL resazurin stock (0.15 mg/mL) per 100 µL medium (final 0.015 mg/mL, 10% v/v). Do NOT remove existing medium. Wrap plate in foil to protect from light
detailedSteps.zh: 每 100 µL 培养基加 10 µL 刃天青母液（0.15 mg/mL）（终浓度 0.015 mg/mL，10% v/v）。不去除现有培养基。锡纸避光包裹

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 1–4 h. Monitor color change from blue (oxidized) to pink/red (reduced by viable cells). Optimal: 20–40% reduction at reading time
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育 1–4 h。监测颜色从蓝色（氧化态）到粉红/红色（活细胞还原）的变化。最佳：读取时还原率 20–40%

detailedSteps.en: Read fluorescence (preferred): Ex 560 nm / Em 590 nm (use black-sided clear-bottom plates). OR read absorbance: A₅₇₀ nm with A₆₀₀ nm reference
detailedSteps.zh: 读取荧光（首选）：激发 560 nm / 发射 590 nm（使用黑边透明底板）。或读取吸光度：A₅₇₀ nm，A₆₀₀ nm 参考

detailedSteps.en: Calculate % viability: (RFU_treated − RFU_blank) / (RFU_control − RFU_blank) × 100. Non-destructive assay: plate can be returned to incubator for re-reading at later timepoints
detailedSteps.zh: 计算 % 活力：(RFU处理 − RFU空白) / (RFU对照 − RFU空白) × 100。非破坏性检测：培养板可放回孵育箱在后续时间点再次读取

name: Restriction Enzyme Digestion

note.en: Plasmid: 0.5–1 µg; genomic DNA: 5–10 µg
note.zh: 质粒 0.5–1 µg; 基因组 DNA 5–10 µg

note.en: 5–10 U per µg DNA; volume ≤10% of total reaction (avoid glycerol inhibition)
note.zh: 5–10 U per µg DNA; 体积 ≤10% 总反应 (避免甘油抑制)

note.en: Add enzyme last
note.zh: 最后加酶

components.name: 2. 37°C 孵育 1–2 h（或按酶推荐温度）

note.en: Some enzymes cannot be heat-inactivated; column purification required
note.zh: 部分酶不可热灭活，需柱纯化

notes.en: For double digestion, confirm buffer compatibility (NEB recommends rCutSmart universal buffer). Star activity: avoid excess enzyme, prolonged incubation, high glycerol. Methylation-sensitive enzymes (DpnI cuts only methylated DNA, used for template removal). Some sticky ends may need blunting (Klenow) before ligation.
notes.zh: 双酶切时确认 buffer 兼容性（NEB 推荐使用 rCutSmart 通用 buffer）。Star activity：避免过量酶、长时间孵育、高甘油浓度。甲基化敏感酶（DpnI 仅切甲基化 DNA，用于去除模板）。部分粘性末端可能需要补平（Klenow）后连接。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; NEB Technical Reference: Restriction Enzymes

usage.en: Cut DNA at specific recognition sites using restriction endonucleases.
usage.zh: 限制性内切酶在特定识别位点切割 DNA。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 hours，实操: 20 minutes

note.en: 5–20 U per reaction, store at −20°C
note.zh: 每反应 5–20 U，−20°C 保存

note.en: Enzyme-specific or CutSmart (NEB)
note.zh: 酶特异性缓冲液或 CutSmart（NEB）

note.en: 0.5–1 µg plasmid or 5–10 µg gDNA
note.zh: 质粒 0.5–1 µg 或 gDNA 5–10 µg

note.en: For reaction setup
note.zh: 用于配反应体系

note.en: Phosphatase for vector dephosphorylation
note.zh: 磷酸酶用于载体去磷酸化

note.en: 0.8–1.5%, TAE buffer
note.zh: 0.8–1.5%，TAE缓冲液

note.en: 1 kb or 100 bp as appropriate
note.zh: 1 kb 或 100 bp，视需要选择

note.en: Digest can incubate overnight at 37°C for genomic DNA applications
note.zh: 基因组DNA酶切可37°C过夜

note.en: Heat-inactivated digest can be stored at −20°C
note.zh: 热灭活后的酶切产物可 −20°C 保存

briefSteps.en: Assemble digestion on ice (DNA + buffer + enzyme ≤10% vol), incubate at 37°C for 1–2 h, heat-inactivate at 65°C for 20 min, then verify by agarose gel electrophoresis.
briefSteps.zh: 冰上配制酶切反应（DNA + buffer + 酶量 ≤总体积 10%），37°C 孵育 1–2 h，65°C 热灭活 20 min，最后琼脂糖凝胶电泳验证。

detailedSteps.en: Thaw all components on ice. Calculate the required amount of enzyme: use 5–10 U per µg of DNA. Enzyme volume must not exceed 10% of total reaction volume to avoid glycerol-mediated star activity.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上解冻所有组分。计算用酶量：每微克 DNA 使用 5–10 U 酶。酶体积不得超过总反应体积的 10%，以避免甘油引起的 star activity。

detailedSteps.en: Assemble reaction on ice in order: nuclease-free water, then 5 µL 10× restriction buffer (1× final in 50 µL reaction), then DNA (0.5–1 µg plasmid or 5–10 µg genomic DNA), and finally the restriction enzyme(s). Add enzyme last to prevent degradation.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上按顺序配制反应：无核酸酶水、5 µL 10× 限制酶缓冲液（50 µL 反应中终浓度 1×）、DNA（质粒 0.5–1 µg 或基因组 DNA 5–10 µg），最后加入限制酶。酶最后加以防降解。

detailedSteps.en: Mix gently by pipetting and briefly spin down. Incubate at the enzyme's optimal temperature (typically 37°C) for 1–2 hours. For complete digestion of genomic DNA, incubate up to 4 hours.
detailedSteps.zh: 轻柔吹打混匀后短暂离心。在酶的最适温度（通常 37°C）孵育 1–2 小时。基因组 DNA 完全酶切可孵育至 4 小时。

detailedSteps.en: For double digestion, confirm buffer compatibility using NEB's website or use rCutSmart universal buffer. Perform simultaneous digestion if enzymes share a compatible buffer; otherwise perform sequential digestion.
detailedSteps.zh: 双酶切时，通过 NEB 网站确认 buffer 兼容性，或使用 rCutSmart 通用缓冲液。若两种酶共用兼容 buffer 则同步酶切，否则进行顺序酶切。

detailedSteps.en: Heat-inactivate the enzyme at 65°C for 20 min (check enzyme datasheet — not all enzymes are heat-inactivatable; for those, purify by column or phenol-chloroform extraction).
detailedSteps.zh: 65°C 热灭活酶 20 min（查阅酶的数据手册——并非所有酶均可热灭活；不可热灭活的酶需用柱纯化或酚氯仿提取去除）。

detailedSteps.en: Mix 5 µL digested DNA with 1 µL 6× loading dye. Load onto a 1% agarose TAE gel alongside an appropriate DNA ladder. Run at 5–8 V/cm for 30–45 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 5 µL 酶切 DNA 与 1 µL 6× 上样缓冲液混合，与 DNA Ladder 上样至 1% 琼脂糖 TAE 凝胶，5–8 V/cm 跑胶 30–45 min。

detailedSteps.en: Visualize gel under UV or blue-light transilluminator. Confirm expected fragment sizes. If fragments need to be isolated for cloning, proceed to gel extraction or PCR purification.
detailedSteps.zh: 在紫外灯或蓝光灯下观察凝胶。确认预期片段大小。若需分离片段用于克隆，进行凝胶回收或 PCR 纯化。

name: RNA Agarose Gel Electrophoresis (Denaturing)
nameCn: RNA 琼脂糖凝胶电泳（变性条件）

note.en: Wipe gel tank, comb, tray with RNase Away (RNaseZap). Use RNase-free water (DEPC-treated or nuclease-free). Wear gloves throughout.
note.zh: 用 RNase Away（RNaseZap）擦拭电泳槽、梳子、胶托。使用 RNase-free 水（DEPC 水或无核酸酶水）。全程戴手套。

components.name: 2. Prepare 1% formaldehyde agarose gel (50 mL, fume hood)

note.en: Melt 0.5 g agarose in 40 mL DEPC-ddH₂O; cool to 55°C. Add: 5 mL 10× MOPS buffer + 5 mL 37% formaldehyde (fume hood!). Mix, pour immediately, let solidify 30 min RT. Formaldehyde denatures RNA secondary structure.
note.zh: 0.5 g 琼脂糖溶于 40 mL DEPC 水；冷至 55°C。通风橱中加：5 mL 10× MOPS 缓冲液 + 5 mL 37% 甲醛。混合后立即倒胶，RT 凝固 30 min。甲醛变性 RNA 二级结构。

components.name: 3. Prepare RNA samples: denature with formaldehyde loading buffer

note.en: Mix: RNA (0.5–5 µg) + 5× formaldehyde loading buffer (formamide:formaldehyde:10×MOPS = 500:165:100 µL, + 35 µL DEPC water + 1 µg/mL EtBr). Heat 65°C 15 min; chill on ice 2 min. Add 1 µL 6× DNA loading dye.
note.zh: 混合：RNA（0.5–5 µg）+ 5× 甲醛上样缓冲液（甲酰胺:甲醛:10×MOPS = 500:165:100 µL，+ 35 µL DEPC 水 + 1 µg/mL EtBr）。65°C 15 min 变性；冰 2 min 急冷。加 1 µL 6× DNA 上样缓冲液。

components.name: 4. Pre-run gel in 1× MOPS running buffer, 5 min at 100 V

note.en: MOPS buffer must be fresh (yellowing indicates degradation). Fill tank until buffer just covers gel.
note.zh: MOPS 缓冲液需新鲜配制（变黄表示降解）。缓冲液液面刚好覆盖凝胶。

components.name: 5. Load samples + RNA ladder (e.g., 0.2–10 kb); run at 80 V, ~1.5 h

note.en: Constant voltage 80 V. Running in fume hood recommended (formaldehyde fumes). BPB should run 2/3 of gel.
note.zh: 恒压 80 V。推荐在通风橱中电泳（甲醛挥发）。BPB 跑至凝胶 2/3 处。

note.en: Intact total RNA: 28S band ~2× intensity of 18S. Degraded RNA: smear below 18S, no discrete bands. mRNA appears as smear 0.5–10 kb. Note: 28S (4,718 bp), 18S (1,868 bp) for human.
note.zh: 完整总 RNA：28S 带约为 18S 的 2 倍亮度。降解 RNA：18S 以下有拖尾，无清晰条带。mRNA 呈 0.5–10 kb 弥散带。参考：人类 28S（4,718 bp）、18S（1,868 bp）。

notes.en: Alternative (faster): non-denaturing 1% agarose gel in 1× TAE — suitable for checking RNA integrity only (not size accuracy). Bioanalyzer (Agilent 2100) or TapeStation is more sensitive and quantitative (RIN score). Discard gel and buffer containing formaldehyde in hazardous waste.
notes.zh: 替代方案（更快）：1% 琼脂糖凝胶 1× TAE 非变性电泳——仅用于检查 RNA 完整性（尺寸不准确）。Bioanalyzer（Agilent 2100）或 TapeStation 更灵敏定量（RIN 评分）。含甲醛的凝胶和缓冲液作为危险废弃物处置。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning 3rd ed. Ch. 7.14; Masek et al. (2005) Electrophoresis 26:4709

usage.en: Assess RNA integrity and size by denaturing formaldehyde agarose gel electrophoresis.
usage.zh: 变性甲醛琼脂糖胶电泳检测 RNA 完整性和大小。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours，实操: 1.5 hours

note.en: Solidified gel can be wrapped in cling film with 1× MOPS and stored at 4°C for up to 24 h
note.zh: 凝固后的凝胶可用保鲜膜包裹并加 1× MOPS，4°C 保存最多 24 h

briefSteps.en: Clean with RNase Away → cast 1% formaldehyde-MOPS agarose gel → denature RNA (65°C 15 min) → pre-run gel → load & run 80 V 1.5 h → UV image → assess 28S:18S ratio
briefSteps.zh: RNase Away 清洁 → 灌制 1% 甲醛-MOPS 琼脂糖凝胶 → RNA 变性（65°C 15 min）→ 预电泳 → 上样 80 V 1.5 h → UV 成像 → 评估 28S:18S 比值

detailedSteps.en: **Preparation (RNase-free Environment)**
detailedSteps.zh: **准备工作（无 RNase 环境）**

detailedSteps.en: Wipe gel tank, comb, and tray with RNase Away (RNaseZap). Use only RNase-free water (DEPC-treated or nuclease-free). Wear fresh gloves throughout
detailedSteps.zh: 用 RNase Away（RNaseZap）擦拭电泳槽、梳子和胶托。全程使用 RNase-free 水（DEPC 处理或无核酸酶水）。全程戴新手套

detailedSteps.en: **Gel Preparation (Fume Hood)**
detailedSteps.zh: **凝胶制备（通风橱内操作）**

detailedSteps.en: Melt 0.5 g agarose in 40 mL DEPC-treated water by microwaving. Cool to 55°C. In fume hood: add 5 mL 10× MOPS buffer + 5 mL 37% formaldehyde. Mix, pour immediately into tray with comb. Let solidify at RT for 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 微波溶解 0.5 g 琼脂糖于 40 mL DEPC 水中。冷却至 55°C。通风橱中：加入 5 mL 10× MOPS 缓冲液 + 5 mL 37% 甲醛。混合后立即倒入带梳胶托。室温凝固 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Sample Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **样品制备**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare RNA samples (0.5–5 µg each): mix RNA with 5× formaldehyde loading buffer (formamide:formaldehyde:10×MOPS = 500:165:100 µL + 35 µL DEPC water + 1 µg/mL EtBr). Heat denature at 65°C for 15 min, then chill on ice 2 min. Add 1 µL 6× DNA loading dye for tracking
detailedSteps.zh: 制备 RNA 样品（各 0.5–5 µg）：RNA 与 5× 甲醛上样缓冲液混合（甲酰胺:甲醛:10×MOPS = 500:165:100 µL + 35 µL DEPC 水 + 1 µg/mL EtBr）。65°C 变性 15 min，冰上急冷 2 min。加 1 µL 6× DNA 上样缓冲液用于示踪

detailedSteps.en: **Electrophoresis**
Fill tank with 1× MOPS running buffer (fresh — yellowing indicates degradation). Pre-run gel at 100 V for 5 min
detailedSteps.zh: 电泳槽中加入 1× MOPS 电泳缓冲液（新鲜配制 — 变黄表示降解）。100 V 预电泳 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Load denatured RNA samples and RNA ladder (0.2–10 kb). Run at 80 V constant voltage for ~1.5 h (until BPB migrates 2/3 of gel). Run in fume hood due to formaldehyde fumes
detailedSteps.zh: 上样变性 RNA 和 RNA 分子量标准（0.2–10 kb）。恒压 80 V 电泳约 1.5 h（BPB 迁移至凝胶 2/3 处）。因甲醛挥发需在通风橱中电泳

detailedSteps.en: **Visualization & Interpretation**
detailedSteps.zh: **可视化与结果判读**

detailedSteps.en: Visualize on UV transilluminator and photograph. Intact total RNA: 28S rRNA band should be ~2× intensity of 18S band. Degraded RNA: smear below 18S with no discrete bands. Dispose of formaldehyde-containing gel and buffer as hazardous waste
detailedSteps.zh: UV 透射仪下观察并拍照。完整总 RNA：28S rRNA 条带亮度约为 18S 的 2 倍。降解 RNA：18S 以下弥散拖尾无清晰条带。含甲醛的凝胶和缓冲液作为危险废弃物处置

name: RNA Column Extraction (Silica-based)

components.name: 1. 裂解：加 Buffer RLT + β-ME，涡旋

note.en: ≤5×10⁶ cells or 30 mg tissue
note.zh: ≤5×10⁶ cells 或 30 mg tissue

components.name: 2. 匀浆（组织用匀浆器/针头 5–10 次）
3. 加等体积 70% 乙醇，混匀
4. 转移至 RNeasy 柱，离心 15 s ≥8,000×g
6. On-column DNase I 消化（可选）

note.en: Add 80 µL DNase I mix, incubate 15 min at RT
note.zh: 加 80 µL DNase I mix, 室温 15 min

note.en: Second spin for 2 min to dry membrane
note.zh: 第二次离心 2 min 干燥膜

note.en: Stand 1 min → centrifuge; repeat once to improve yield
note.zh: 静置 1 min → 离心, 可重复一次提高产量

notes.en: Fast (~30 min) and reproducible. Lower yield than TRIzol but higher purity, ideal for RT-qPCR/RNA-seq. Small RNAs (<200 nt, including miRNA) require miRNA enrichment column. Tissue must be stored in RNAlater or flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen.
notes.zh: 快速（~30 min）且重现性好。产量低于 TRIzol，但纯度高，适合 RT-qPCR/RNA-seq。小量 RNA（<200 nt, 含 miRNA）需用 miRNA enrichment column。组织需在 RNAlater 中保存或液氮速冻。

ref: QIAGEN RNeasy Mini Handbook; Chomczynski & Sacchi (2006) Nat Protoc 1:581

usage.en: Extract total RNA from cells or tissues using silica column-based purification.
usage.zh: 硅胶柱法从细胞或组织中提取总 RNA。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 30 minutes，实操: 30 minutes

note.en: Includes RLT, RW1, RPE buffers, spin columns
note.zh: 含 RLT、RW1、RPE 缓冲液、离心柱

note.en: Add 10 µL per 1 mL RLT before use
note.zh: 使用前每 1 mL RLT 加 10 µL

note.en: RNase-Free DNase Set (QIAGEN) or equivalent
note.zh: 无 RNase DNase Set（QIAGEN）或等效品

note.en: For homogenization (optional)
note.zh: 用于匀浆（可选）

note.en: Prepared with RNase-free water
note.zh: 用无RNase水配制

note.en: For elution
note.zh: 用于洗脱

note.en: Lysate in RLT can be stored at −80°C before column binding
note.zh: RLT裂解液可在柱结合前 −80°C 保存

note.en: Purified RNA should be stored at −80°C; avoid repeated freeze-thaw
note.zh: 纯化RNA应 −80°C 保存；避免反复冻融

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells in guanidinium buffer → add 70% ethanol → bind RNA to silica column → wash with RW1 → optional on-column DNase I digestion → wash with RPE twice → elute with RNase-free water → quantify by NanoDrop.
briefSteps.zh: 异硫氰酸胍缓冲液裂解细胞 → 加 70% 乙醇 → RNA 结合至硅胶柱 → RW1 洗涤 → 可选柱上 DNase I 消化 → RPE 洗涤两次 → RNase-free 水洗脱 → NanoDrop 定量。

detailedSteps.en: Lysis
detailedSteps.zh: 裂解

detailedSteps.en: Add 350 µL Buffer RLT (supplemented with 10 µL/mL β-mercaptoethanol) to ≤5×10⁶ cells or ≤30 mg tissue. Vortex vigorously for 1 min to fully homogenize.
detailedSteps.zh: 向 ≤5×10⁶ 细胞或 ≤30 mg 组织中加入 350 µL Buffer RLT（含 10 µL/mL β-巯基乙醇）。剧烈涡旋 1 min 充分匀浆。

detailedSteps.en: For tissue: homogenize lysate with a rotor-stator or pass through a 20-gauge needle 5–10 times to shear genomic DNA and reduce viscosity. Centrifuge at ≥10,000×g for 3 min; transfer clear supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 组织样品：用匀浆器研磨或 20 号针头反复穿过 5–10 次以剪断基因组 DNA、降低粘度。≥10,000×g 离心 3 min，转移上清。

detailedSteps.en: Column Binding
detailedSteps.zh: 柱结合

detailedSteps.en: Add an equal volume (350 µL) of 70% RNase-free ethanol to the lysate and mix by pipetting. Do not centrifuge.
detailedSteps.zh: 向裂解液中加入等体积（350 µL）70% 无 RNase 乙醇，吹打混匀。不要离心。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer up to 700 µL of the sample to an RNeasy spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge at ≥8,000×g for 15 seconds at RT. Discard flow-through.
detailedSteps.zh: 将最多 700 µL 样品转移至置于 2 mL 收集管中的 RNeasy 离心柱。室温 ≥8,000×g 离心 15 s，弃流出液。

detailedSteps.en: Washing & DNase Digestion
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤与 DNase 消化

detailedSteps.en: Add 700 µL Buffer RW1 to the column. Centrifuge at ≥8,000×g for 15 seconds. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 向柱中加入 700 µL Buffer RW1，≥8,000×g 离心 15 s，弃流出液和收集管。

detailedSteps.en: Optional on-column DNase I digestion: pipette 80 µL DNase I incubation mix (10 µL DNase I stock + 70 µL Buffer RDD) directly onto the silica membrane. Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选柱上 DNase I 消化：将 80 µL DNase I 孵育液（10 µL DNase I 储液 + 70 µL Buffer RDD）直接加至硅胶膜上。室温孵育 15 min。

detailedSteps.en: Add 350 µL Buffer RW1. Centrifuge at ≥8,000×g for 15 seconds. Discard flow-through.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 350 µL Buffer RW1，≥8,000×g 离心 15 s，弃流出液。

detailedSteps.en: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE. Centrifuge at ≥8,000×g for 15 seconds. Discard flow-through. Repeat with another 500 µL RPE and centrifuge for 2 min to dry the membrane.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 500 µL Buffer RPE，≥8,000×g 离心 15 s，弃流出液。再加 500 µL RPE 离心 2 min 干燥膜。

detailedSteps.en: Elution & QC
detailedSteps.zh: 洗脱与质检

detailedSteps.en: Transfer column to a fresh 1.5 mL RNase-free tube. Pipette 30–50 µL RNase-free water directly onto the membrane. Let stand 1 min, then centrifuge at ≥8,000×g for 1 min to elute. Repeat elution for higher yield.
detailedSteps.zh: 将柱转移至新的 1.5 mL 无 RNase 管中。直接向膜上加 30–50 µL 无 RNase 水，静置 1 min，≥8,000×g 离心 1 min 洗脱。重复一次可提高产量。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify RNA by NanoDrop (A260/280 ≈ 2.0; A260/230 ≥ 1.8). For accurate downstream quantification, use Qubit RNA HS assay. Store RNA at −80°C.
detailedSteps.zh: NanoDrop 定量（A260/280 ≈ 2.0；A260/230 ≥ 1.8）。精确定量建议 Qubit RNA HS。−80°C 保存。

name: RNA-seq Library Preparation (PolyA Selection)

note.en: trizol_extraction or rna_column_extraction. Bioanalyzer RIN ≥7.0 (≥8 preferred). Nanodrop: A260/280 ≥2.0, A260/230 ≥1.8. Qubit RNA HS for accurate quantification.
note.zh: trizol_extraction 或 rna_column_extraction。Bioanalyzer RIN ≥7.0（≥8 优选）。Nanodrop：A260/280 ≥2.0、A260/230 ≥1.8。Qubit RNA HS 精确定量。

components.name: 2. Input: 100 ng–1 µg total RNA (optimal 500 ng)

note.en: Degraded RNA: use RiboZero rRNA depletion instead of polyA. Single-cell: 10× Chromium or Smart-seq2.
note.zh: 降解 RNA：用 RiboZero rRNA 去除替代 polyA。单细胞：10× Chromium 或 Smart-seq2。

components.name: 3. PolyA selection: oligo-dT magnetic beads, 65°C 5 min → RT 5 min → wash × 2 → elute 80°C 2 min; repeat once

note.en: 2× binding buffer: 10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 500 mM LiCl, 1 mM EDTA. Double selection reduces rRNA contamination to <5%.
note.zh: 2× 结合缓冲液：10 mM Tris pH 7.5、500 mM LiCl、1 mM EDTA。双次选择将 rRNA 污染降至 <5%。

components.name: 4. Fragmentation: 94°C, 2–8 min in First Strand Buffer

note.en: Target 150–300 bp inserts for Illumina short-read. Stop with 0.5 M EDTA. 2 min → ~300 bp; 8 min → ~130 bp.
note.zh: 目标片段 150–300 bp（Illumina 短读）。0.5 M EDTA 终止。2 min → ~300 bp；8 min → ~130 bp。

components.name: 5. First-strand cDNA: random hexamers + RT (SuperScript III/IV)

note.en: 65°C 5 min (denature) → ice 1 min → add RT mix (1× FS Buffer, 5 mM DTT, RNaseOUT, RT enzyme) → 25°C 10 min → 50°C 50 min → 70°C 15 min → RNase H 37°C 20 min.
note.zh: 65°C 5 min（变性）→ 冰 1 min → 加 RT 混合物（1× FS 缓冲液、5 mM DTT、RNaseOUT、逆转录酶）→ 25°C 10 min → 50°C 50 min → 70°C 15 min → RNase H 37°C 20 min。

components.name: 6. Second-strand cDNA: DNA Pol I + E. coli ligase + RNase H, 16°C 2.5 h

note.en: For strand-specific: replace dTTP with dUTP. Purify with 1.8× AMPure XP (SPRI) beads.
note.zh: 链特异性建库：将 dTTP 替换为 dUTP。1.8× AMPure XP（SPRI）磁珠纯化。

note.en: End repair: T4 DNA Pol + T4 PNK + Klenow, 30°C 30 min. dA-tailing: Klenow (exo-), 37°C 30 min. Purify 1× AMPure XP.
note.zh: 末端修复：T4 DNA Pol + T4 PNK + Klenow，30°C 30 min。加 A 尾：Klenow（exo-），37°C 30 min。1× AMPure XP 纯化。

components.name: 8. Adapter ligation: dual-index Y-adapters, T4 ligase, RT 15 min

note.en: Adapter:insert 10:1 molar. Heat inactivate 65°C 10 min. Size select: 0.8× then 0.2× AMPure XP (removes adapter-dimers at ~130 bp).
note.zh: 接头:插入片段 10:1 摩尔比。65°C 10 min 灭活。双面选择：0.8× + 0.2× AMPure XP（去除 ~130 bp 接头二聚体）。

note.en: 8 cycles for 500 ng input; 12–14 for <100 ng. KAPA HiFi or Q5 polymerase. 1× AMPure XP cleanup.
note.zh: 500 ng 投入量 8 个循环；<100 ng 用 12–14 个循环。KAPA HiFi 或 Q5 聚合酶。1× AMPure XP 纯化。

note.en: Expect ~280–350 bp (insert + adapters). No adapter-dimer (<1% at 130 bp). Qubit dsDNA HS + NEBNext Library Quant qPCR. Sequence: 20–50 M 150 bp PE reads/sample.
note.zh: 预期 ~280–350 bp（插入片段 + 接头）。无接头二聚体（130 bp 处 <1%）。Qubit dsDNA HS + NEBNext Library Quant qPCR 定量。测序：每样品 2,000–5,000 万条 150 bp PE reads。

notes.en: Strand-specific: replace dTTP with dUTP, then UNG digest before PCR → preserves strand info. Low input (<10 ng): Smart-seq2 or NEBNext Single Cell. rRNA depletion (RiboZero) for degraded RNA or non-polyA transcripts (lncRNA, histone mRNA).
notes.zh: 链特异性：第二链合成 dTTP→dUTP，PCR 前 UNG 酶切 → 保留链信息。低投入（<10 ng）：Smart-seq2 或 NEBNext Single Cell。降解 RNA 或非 polyA 转录本：RiboZero rRNA 去除。

ref: Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Reference Guide 15031047; Adiconis et al. (2013) Nat Methods 10:623–629

usage.en: Prepare strand-specific RNA-seq libraries for next-generation sequencing.
usage.zh: 链特异性 RNA-seq 文库构建，用于下一代测序。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 8 hours

note.en: 100 ng – 1 µg, DNase-treated
note.zh: 100 ng - 1 µg，DNase处理过

note.en: NEBNext Poly(A) or Illumina
note.zh: NEBNext Poly(A)或Illumina

note.en: Invitrogen 18080093
note.zh: Invitrogen 18080093

note.en: 50 µM stock
note.zh: 50 µM储液

note.en: Include dUTP for strand-specific
note.zh: 链特异性方案含dUTP

note.en: Beckman Coulter A63881
note.zh: Beckman Coulter A63881

note.en: Illumina TruSeq or NEBNext
note.zh: Illumina TruSeq或NEBNext

note.en: NEB M0202 or included in kit
note.zh: NEB M0202或试剂盒中包含

note.en: KAPA HiFi or NEBNext Q5
note.zh: KAPA HiFi或NEBNext Q5

note.en: For final library quantification
note.zh: 用于最终文库定量

note.en: Murine RNase inhibitor, 40 U/µL
note.zh: 鼠RNase抑制剂，40 U/µL

note.en: For RNA QC and library size
note.zh: 用于RNA质控和文库大小评估

note.en: First-strand cDNA can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 week before proceeding to second-strand synthesis.
note.zh: 第一链 cDNA 可在 −20°C 保存最多 1 周，之后再进行第二链合成。

note.en: Adapter-ligated, size-selected library can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month before PCR amplification.
note.zh: 连接接头并筛选大小后的文库可在 −20°C 保存最多 1 个月，之后再进行 PCR 扩增。

note.en: Final PCR-amplified library can be stored at −20°C for up to 12 months. Verify quality before submitting for sequencing.
note.zh: 最终 PCR 扩增文库可在 −20°C 保存最多 12 个月。送测序前务必验证质量。

briefSteps.en: QC total RNA (RIN ≥7) → polyA select with oligo-dT beads → fragment mRNA at 94°C → reverse transcribe to first-strand cDNA → second-strand synthesis → end repair + dA-tail → ligate dual-index adapters → size select with AMPure XP → PCR amplify 8–14 cycles → QC library by Bioanalyzer and qPCR.
briefSteps.zh: 总 RNA 质检（RIN ≥7）→ oligo-dT 磁珠 polyA 富集 → 94°C 热片段化 → 逆转录为第一链 cDNA → 第二链合成 → 末端修复加 A 尾 → 连接双索引接头 → AMPure XP 筛选 → PCR 扩增 8–14 个循环 → Bioanalyzer 和 qPCR 质检文库。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天

detailedSteps.en: Assess RNA quality by Bioanalyzer or TapeStation (RIN ≥7.0, ideally ≥8.0). Quantify with Qubit RNA HS assay. Input: 100 ng – 1 µg total RNA in ≤10 µL RNase-free water.
detailedSteps.zh: Bioanalyzer 或 TapeStation 评估 RNA 质量（RIN ≥7.0，理想 ≥8.0）。Qubit RNA HS 定量。投入量：100 ng–1 µg 总 RNA，溶于 ≤10 µL 无 RNase 水中。

detailedSteps.en: PolyA mRNA selection: incubate RNA with oligo-dT magnetic beads in 2× binding buffer (10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 500 mM LiCl, 1 mM EDTA) at 65°C for 5 min, cool to RT 5 min, wash beads twice, elute at 80°C for 2 min. Repeat selection once to reduce rRNA to <5%.
detailedSteps.zh: PolyA mRNA 富集：在 2× 结合缓冲液（10 mM Tris pH 7.5、500 mM LiCl、1 mM EDTA）中将 RNA 与 oligo-dT 磁珠 65°C 孵育 5 min，室温冷却 5 min，洗涤磁珠两次，80°C 洗脱 2 min。重复一次以将 rRNA 降至 <5%。

detailedSteps.en: Fragment enriched mRNA by heating in First Strand Buffer at 94°C for 2–8 min (2 min → ~300 bp; 8 min → ~130 bp; target 200–300 bp for standard library). Immediately stop with 0.5 M EDTA and place on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 在第一链缓冲液中 94°C 加热 2–8 min 片段化富集后的 mRNA（2 min → ~300 bp；8 min → ~130 bp；标准建库目标 200–300 bp）。立即用 0.5 M EDTA 终止并置冰上。

detailedSteps.en: First-strand cDNA synthesis: add random hexamers, denature at 65°C for 5 min, snap cool on ice 1 min. Add RT mix (1× First Strand Buffer, 5 mM DTT, 40 U RNaseOUT, SuperScript III/IV). Incubate: 25°C 10 min → 50°C 50 min → 70°C 15 min. Add RNase H (2 U) and incubate 37°C 20 min to remove RNA template.
detailedSteps.zh: 第一链 cDNA 合成：加入随机六聚体引物，65°C 变性 5 min，冰上快速冷却 1 min。加入 RT 混合物（1× 第一链缓冲液、5 mM DTT、40 U RNaseOUT、SuperScript III/IV）。孵育：25°C 10 min → 50°C 50 min → 70°C 15 min。加 RNase H（2 U），37°C 20 min 去除 RNA 模板。

detailedSteps.en: Second-strand cDNA synthesis: add second-strand reaction mix containing DNA Pol I (10 U), E. coli DNA ligase (10 U), and RNase H (2 U) in Second Strand Buffer. Incubate at 16°C for 2.5 h. For strand-specific libraries, use dUTP instead of dTTP. Purify with 1.8× AMPure XP beads.
detailedSteps.zh: 第二链 cDNA 合成：加入含 DNA Pol I（10 U）、大肠杆菌 DNA 连接酶（10 U）和 RNase H（2 U）的第二链反应混合物。16°C 孵育 2.5 h。链特异性建库将 dTTP 替换为 dUTP。1.8× AMPure XP 磁珠纯化。

detailedSteps.en: End repair and dA-tailing: incubate ds-cDNA with T4 DNA Polymerase, T4 PNK, and Klenow fragment in end-repair buffer at 30°C for 30 min. Then add dATP and Klenow (exo-) and incubate at 37°C for 30 min to add 3′ A overhang. Purify with 1× AMPure XP beads.
detailedSteps.zh: 末端修复与加 A 尾：将双链 cDNA 与 T4 DNA 聚合酶、T4 PNK 和 Klenow 片段在末端修复缓冲液中 30°C 孵育 30 min。加入 dATP 和 Klenow（exo-），37°C 孵育 30 min 添加 3′ A 突出端。1× AMPure XP 磁珠纯化。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天

detailedSteps.en: Adapter ligation: ligate dual-index Y-shaped adapters (10:1 molar adapter:insert ratio) with T4 DNA Ligase at room temperature for 15 min. Heat-inactivate at 65°C for 10 min. Size-select with double-sided AMPure XP (0.8× then add 0.2× to supernatant) to remove adapter-dimers (~130 bp) and retain 200–500 bp inserts.
detailedSteps.zh: 接头连接：双索引 Y 形接头与插入片段以 10:1 摩尔比用 T4 DNA 连接酶室温连接 15 min。65°C 热灭活 10 min。双面 AMPure XP 筛选（先 0.8×，再向上清中加 0.2×）去除接头二聚体（~130 bp），保留 200–500 bp 插入片段。

detailedSteps.en: PCR library amplification: 98°C 30 s initial denaturation → [98°C 10 s, 60°C 30 s, 72°C 30 s] × 8–14 cycles → 72°C 5 min final extension. Use 8 cycles for 500 ng input and 12–14 cycles for <100 ng. Use KAPA HiFi or Q5 high-fidelity polymerase. Purify with 1× AMPure XP beads.
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 文库扩增：98°C 30 s 预变性 → [98°C 10 s、60°C 30 s、72°C 30 s] × 8–14 循环 → 72°C 5 min 末端延伸。500 ng 投入量用 8 个循环，<100 ng 用 12–14 个循环。使用 KAPA HiFi 或 Q5 高保真聚合酶。1× AMPure XP 磁珠纯化。

detailedSteps.en: Library QC: verify size distribution on Bioanalyzer or TapeStation (expected peak 280–350 bp). Confirm absence of adapter-dimers (<1% at 130 bp). Quantify by Qubit dsDNA HS and NEBNext Library Quant qPCR. Pool samples at equimolar ratio and sequence at 20–50 M paired-end 150 bp reads per sample.
detailedSteps.zh: 文库质检：Bioanalyzer 或 TapeStation 验证片段分布（预期主峰 280–350 bp）。确认无接头二聚体（130 bp 处 <1%）。Qubit dsDNA HS 和 NEBNext Library Quant qPCR 定量。等摩尔混样，每样品测序 2,000–5,000 万条 150 bp PE reads。

note.zh: 或 TaqMan 探针

note.en: Sealed qPCR plate can be stored at 4°C in the dark for up to 2 hours before running.
note.zh: 封好的 qPCR 板可在 4°C 避光保存最多 2 小时后再上机运行。

briefSteps.en: Extract and quantify RNA → treat with DNase I → reverse transcribe 500 ng–2 µg RNA to cDNA → dilute cDNA 1:5–1:20 → set up 20 µL SYBR Green qPCR reactions in triplicate → run 95°C/60°C cycling → analyze melt curve and calculate expression by 2^(−ΔΔCt).
briefSteps.zh: 提取并定量 RNA → DNase I 处理 → 反转录 500 ng–2 µg RNA 至 cDNA → cDNA 1:5–1:20 稀释 → 三孔设置 20 µL SYBR Green qPCR 反应 → 运行 95°C/60°C 循环 → 分析溶解曲线并用 2^(-ΔΔCt) 法计算表达量。

detailedSteps.en: Extract total RNA using TRIzol or a silica-column kit. Quantify by NanoDrop: A260/280 ratio should be ~2.0. A260/230 ratio should be >1.8. Acceptable RNA concentration: ≥50 ng/µL.
detailedSteps.zh: 使用 TRIzol 或硅胶柱试剂盒提取总 RNA。NanoDrop 定量：A260/280 应约为 2.0，A260/230 应 >1.8，可接受 RNA 浓度 ≥50 ng/µL。

detailedSteps.en: Optional: treat RNA with DNase I (1 U per µg RNA, 37°C 30 min, then inactivate at 75°C 10 min with EDTA) to eliminate genomic DNA contamination.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选：用 DNase I（每微克 RNA 加 1 U，37°C 30 min，加 EDTA 后 75°C 10 min 灭活）处理 RNA，去除基因组 DNA 污染。

detailedSteps.en: Set up reverse transcription: use 500 ng–2 µg RNA with a combination of oligo-dT (for mRNA) and random hexamers. Follow manufacturer's protocol (e.g., SuperScript IV, 55°C 10 min; M-MLV, 42°C 50 min). Final volume: 20 µL.
detailedSteps.zh: 配制反转录反应：使用 500 ng–2 µg RNA，搭配 oligo-dT（针对 mRNA）和随机六聚体引物。按厂家说明操作（如 SuperScript IV：55°C 10 min；M-MLV：42°C 50 min）。终体积 20 µL。

detailedSteps.en: Dilute cDNA 1:5 to 1:20 with nuclease-free water. For highly expressed genes use 1:20; for low-abundance transcripts use 1:5. Store diluted cDNA at −20°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 用无核酸酶水将 cDNA 稀释 1:5 至 1:20。高表达基因用 1:20，低丰度转录本用 1:5。稀释后的 cDNA 存于 −20°C。

detailedSteps.en: Set up 20 µL qPCR reactions in triplicate: 10 µL 2× SYBR Green Master Mix, 0.4 µL forward primer (10 µM, 200 nM final), 0.4 µL reverse primer (10 µM, 200 nM final), 2 µL cDNA, 7.2 µL nuclease-free water. Include NTC (water instead of cDNA) and reference gene wells.
detailedSteps.zh: 三孔设置 20 µL qPCR 反应：10 µL 2× SYBR Green Master Mix、0.4 µL 正向引物（10 µM，终浓度 200 nM）、0.4 µL 反向引物（10 µM，终浓度 200 nM）、2 µL cDNA、7.2 µL 无核酸酶水。同时设无模板对照（NTC）和内参基因孔。

detailedSteps.en: Seal the plate with optical adhesive film. Centrifuge briefly at 1,000×g for 1 min to eliminate bubbles.
detailedSteps.zh: 用光学封膜密封孔板。短暂 1,000×g 离心 1 min 消除气泡。

detailedSteps.en: Run qPCR program: polymerase activation at 95°C for 10 min, then 40 cycles of denaturation 95°C for 15 s and annealing/extension at 60°C for 60 s.
detailedSteps.zh: 运行 qPCR 程序：酶激活 95°C 10 min，然后 40 个循环：变性 95°C 15 s，退火/延伸 60°C 60 s。

detailedSteps.en: Run melt curve analysis (65–95°C, 0.5°C increments) after cycling. A single sharp peak confirms amplification specificity; multiple peaks or broad peaks indicate non-specific products.
detailedSteps.zh: 循环结束后进行溶解曲线分析（65–95°C，每步 0.5°C）。单一尖锐峰确认扩增特异性；多峰或宽峰提示非特异扩增。

detailedSteps.en: Analyze Ct values: ΔCt = Ct(gene of interest) − Ct(reference gene). ΔΔCt = ΔCt(treated) − ΔCt(control). Relative expression = 2^(−ΔΔCt). Report mean ± SD from ≥3 biological replicates.
detailedSteps.zh: 分析 Ct 值：ΔCt = Ct（目的基因）− Ct（内参基因）；ΔΔCt = ΔCt（处理组）− ΔCt（对照组）；相对表达量 = 2^(-ΔΔCt)。报告 ≥3 个生物学重复的均值 ± SD。

name: Sandwich ELISA

notes.en: 7-point standard curve + blank. High-binding plates. Wash 3-5× PBST between steps. R² > 0.99.
notes.zh: 7 点标准曲线 + 空白。高结合力板。每步间用 PBST 洗 3-5 次。R² > 0.99。

ref: Engvall & Perlmann (1971) Immunochemistry 8:871

usage.en: Quantify target protein in samples using sandwich ELISA with capture and detection antibody pair.
usage.zh: 夹心 ELISA 法定量样品中的靶蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 day，实操: 4 hours

note.en: e.g., Corning #9018 or Nunc MaxiSorp
note.zh: 如 Corning #9018 或 Nunc MaxiSorp

note.en: Purified, matched pair with detection antibody
note.zh: 纯化的，与检测抗体配对

note.en: Matched pair with capture antibody
note.zh: 与捕获抗体配对

note.en: e.g., R&D Systems DY998
note.zh: 如 R&D Systems DY998

note.en: For standard curve
note.zh: 用于标准曲线

note.en: e.g., R&D Systems DY999
note.zh: 如 R&D Systems DY999

note.en: e.g., R&D Systems DY994
note.zh: 如 R&D Systems DY994

note.en: 0.05 M carbonate-bicarbonate pH 9.6 or PBS
note.zh: 0.05 M 碳酸盐缓冲液 pH 9.6 或 PBS

note.en: PBS + 0.05% Tween-20
note.zh: PBS + 0.05% Tween-20

note.en: 1% BSA in PBS
note.zh: 1% BSA-PBS

note.en: Coated plate can be sealed and stored at 4°C for up to 48 h before proceeding to blocking.
note.zh: 包被完成后可密封 4°C 保存至 48 h，再进行封闭步骤。

note.en: Blocked plate can be stored at 4°C sealed for up to 24 h before adding samples.
note.zh: 封闭完成后可密封 4°C 保存最长 24 h，再加样品。

briefSteps.en: Coat plate with capture antibody overnight at 4°C → block 1 h → incubate standards and samples 2 h → wash → add biotinylated detection antibody 1 h → wash → add streptavidin-HRP 30 min → wash → add TMB substrate → stop with H₂SO₄ → read OD₄₅₀.
briefSteps.zh: 捕获抗体 4°C 包被过夜 → 封闭 1 h → 标准品和样品孵育 2 h → 洗板 → 生物素化检测抗体孵育 1 h → 洗板 → 链霉亲和素-HRP 孵育 30 min → 洗板 → 加 TMB 底物 → H₂SO₄ 终止 → 读 OD₄₅₀。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天

detailedSteps.en: Dilute capture antibody to 1–4 µg/mL in coating buffer (50 mM carbonate-bicarbonate, pH 9.6). Add 100 µL per well to a high-binding 96-well ELISA plate. Seal plate and incubate overnight at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 将捕获抗体用包被缓冲液（50 mM 碳酸盐-碳酸氢盐，pH 9.6）稀释至 1–4 µg/mL，每孔加 100 µL，密封后 4°C 过夜孵育。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天

detailedSteps.en: Discard coating solution. Wash plate 3× with PBST (0.05% Tween-20 in PBS), 300 µL/well each time. Pat dry on paper towels.
detailedSteps.zh: 弃去包被液，用 PBST（含 0.05% Tween-20 的 PBS）洗板 3 次，每次 300 µL/孔，在纸巾上拍干。

detailedSteps.en: Block plate with 200 µL/well of 1% BSA in PBS (or 3% non-fat milk). Seal and incubate at room temperature for 1 h with gentle shaking.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 200 µL 封闭液（1% BSA in PBS 或 3% 脱脂奶粉），密封后室温轻摇孵育 1 h。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare a 7-point standard curve by serial 2-fold dilution of the recombinant target protein (typically 2000–15.6 pg/mL) plus a blank (diluent only). Dilute unknown samples in the same assay diluent.
detailedSteps.zh: 将重组靶蛋白倍比稀释制备 7 点标准曲线（通常 2000–15.6 pg/mL）加空白对照，待测样品用同一稀释液处理。

detailedSteps.en: Wash plate 3× with PBST. Add 100 µL standards and samples per well in duplicate or triplicate. Seal and incubate at room temperature for 2 h with gentle shaking.
detailedSteps.zh: PBST 洗板 3 次，每孔加 100 µL 标准品或样品，设置双复孔或三复孔，密封后室温轻摇孵育 2 h。

detailedSteps.en: Wash plate 3–5× with PBST. Dilute biotinylated detection antibody (typically 0.5–2 µg/mL in 1% BSA-PBS) and add 100 µL per well. Seal and incubate at room temperature for 1 h.
detailedSteps.zh: PBST 洗板 3–5 次，将生物素化检测抗体稀释至 0.5–2 µg/mL（1% BSA-PBS），每孔加 100 µL，密封后室温孵育 1 h。

detailedSteps.en: Wash plate 3–5× with PBST. Add streptavidin-HRP conjugate (diluted 1:200–1:1000 in 1% BSA-PBS) at 100 µL per well. Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
detailedSteps.zh: PBST 洗板 3–5 次，链霉亲和素-HRP（1% BSA-PBS 稀释 1:200–1:1000）每孔加 100 µL，室温孵育 30 min。

detailedSteps.en: Wash plate 5× with PBST. Add 100 µL TMB substrate solution per well. Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15–30 min until the highest standard turns dark blue. Do not exceed 30 min.
detailedSteps.zh: PBST 洗板 5 次，每孔加 100 µL TMB 底物液，室温避光孵育 15–30 min 直至最高浓度标准品孔呈深蓝色，不超过 30 min。

detailedSteps.en: Add 50 µL of 2N H₂SO₄ stop solution per well. The solution should turn from blue to yellow. Read OD₄₅₀ nm (with reference at 570 nm) within 30 min using a microplate reader.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 50 µL 2N H₂SO₄ 终止液，溶液由蓝变黄，30 min 内用酶标仪读 OD₄₅₀（570 nm 参比），

detailedSteps.en: Plot OD₄₅₀ vs standard concentration and fit to a 4-parameter logistic (4PL) curve (R² >0.99). Back-calculate sample concentrations from the curve, accounting for any dilution factors.
detailedSteps.zh: 以 OD₄₅₀ 对标准品浓度作图并进行四参数 logistic（4PL）拟合（R² >0.99），代入方程计算样品浓度，乘以稀释倍数得实际浓度。

name: Sanger Sequencing Sample Preparation

components.name: 1. Prepare DNA template: miniprep or PCR product

note.en: Plasmid (miniprep): 100–500 ng/µL recommended. PCR product: must be gel-purified (gel_extraction) or ExoSAP-IT cleaned (incubate PCR product with ExoSAP-IT 37°C 15 min → 80°C 15 min inactivate). Residual primers/dNTPs interfere with sequencing.
note.zh: 质粒（miniprep）：100–500 ng/µL。PCR 产物：必须胶回收纯化（gel_extraction）或 ExoSAP-IT 处理（37°C 15 min → 80°C 15 min 灭活）。残留引物/dNTP 会干扰测序。

note.en: Most providers require 3.2 pmol/µL (= 3.2 µM). Common universal primers: M13F (-20): 5'-GTAAAACGACGGCCAGT-3'; M13R: 5'-CAGGAAACAGCTATGAC-3'; T7: 5'-TAATACGACTCACTATA-3'; SP6: 5'-ATTTAGGTGACACTATAG-3'. Custom primers: Tm 55–65°C, length 18–24 nt, GC content 40–60%.
note.zh: 多数服务商要求 3.2 pmol/µL（= 3.2 µM）。通用引物：M13F (-20)、M13R、T7、SP6（见英文）。自定义引物：Tm 55–65°C，长度 18–24 nt，GC 40–60%。

note.en: Premix submission (Genewiz/Azenta): 5 µL DNA (100–500 ng plasmid or 5–20 ng/100 bp PCR) + 5 µL primer (3.2 pmol/µL) = 10 µL total. Tube-only submission: DNA and primer in separate tubes. Follow provider-specific guidelines.
note.zh: 预混提交（Genewiz/Azenta）：5 µL DNA（100–500 ng 质粒或 5–20 ng/100 bp PCR）+ 5 µL 引物（3.2 pmol/µL）= 10 µL。独立管提交：DNA 和引物分管。按服务商说明操作。

components.name: 4. Label tubes clearly; keep on ice; submit same day

note.en: Label with date, sample ID, primer name. Avoid freeze-thaw of sequencing samples. Most sequencing services: results in 24–48 h.
note.zh: 清晰标注日期、样品编号、引物名称。避免冻融。多数测序服务 24–48 h 出结果。

components.name: 5. Analyze results: align chromatogram to expected sequence

note.en: Tools: Benchling, SnapGene Viewer, 4Peaks, ApE. BLAST against reference. Check: (a) expected insert present, (b) correct reading frame, (c) no frame-shift mutations from PCR. Reliable reads typically start at bp 50–100, end at bp 700–900.
note.zh: 工具：Benchling、SnapGene Viewer、4Peaks、ApE。BLAST 比对参考序列。检查：(a) 预期插入片段存在；(b) 正确阅读框；(c) 无 PCR 引入移码突变。可靠读取通常从第 50–100 bp 开始，到第 700–900 bp 结束。

notes.en: Read length: typical Sanger = 700–1,000 bp per reaction. For long inserts: design primers every 600–700 bp (primer walking). Troubleshooting: no reads → check DNA purity (A260/280 ≥1.8, no salt/ethanol contamination); noisy reads → secondary structure (use DMSO additive); short reads → primer-template mismatch.
notes.zh: 读取长度：典型 Sanger = 700–1,000 bp/反应。长插入片段：每 600–700 bp 设计一个引物（引物步进法）。排查：无读取→检查 DNA 纯度（A260/280 ≥1.8，无盐/乙醇污染）；噪声大→二级结构（加 DMSO 添加剂）；读取短→引物-模板不匹配。

ref: Sanger et al. (1977) PNAS 74:5463–5467; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning 3rd ed.; Genewiz/Azenta Sequencing Guidelines

usage.en: Prepare DNA samples and primers for Sanger sequencing submission.
usage.zh: 准备 DNA 样品和引物，提交 Sanger 测序。

label.en: Protocol — 30 minutes + 24–48 h service, hands-on: 30 minutes
label.zh: 实验方案 — 30 minutes + 24–48 h service，实操: 30 minutes

materials.name: 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes or strip tubes

note.en: Diluted primers at 3.2 pmol/µL can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month; avoid repeated freeze-thaw
note.zh: 3.2 pmol/µL 稀释引物 −20°C 可保存 1 个月；避免反复冻融

note.en: Prepared sequencing samples can be stored at 4°C overnight or −20°C for up to 1 week before submission
note.zh: 制备好的测序样品可 4°C 过夜或 −20°C 保存最多 1 周后再提交

briefSteps.en: Prepare DNA (miniprep 100–500 ng/µL or gel-purified PCR) → Dilute primer to 3.2 pmol/µL → Mix 5 µL DNA + 5 µL primer = 10 µL → Label & keep on ice → Submit same day → Analyze .ab1 chromatogram
briefSteps.zh: 制备 DNA（miniprep 100–500 ng/µL 或胶回收 PCR）→ 引物稀释至 3.2 pmol/µL → 5 µL DNA + 5 µL 引物混匀 = 10 µL → 标注冰上保存 → 当日提交 → 分析 .ab1 色谱图

detailedSteps.en: **DNA template preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **DNA 模板制备**

detailedSteps.en: For plasmid DNA: purify with miniprep or midiprep kit. Quantify by NanoDrop (A260/280 should be 1.8–2.0). Dilute to 100–500 ng/µL in nuclease-free water or TE buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 质粒 DNA：miniprep 或 midiprep 试剂盒纯化。NanoDrop 定量（A260/280 应为 1.8–2.0）。稀释至 100–500 ng/µL（无核酸酶水或 TE 缓冲液）。

detailedSteps.en: For PCR products: run 5 µL on agarose gel to confirm single band. Purify by gel extraction (gel_extraction) or ExoSAP-IT cleanup. ExoSAP-IT: add 2 µL ExoSAP-IT per 5 µL PCR product, incubate 37°C 15 min → 80°C 15 min to inactivate.
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 产物：取 5 µL 琼脂糖凝胶电泳确认单一条带。胶回收（gel_extraction）或 ExoSAP-IT 纯化。ExoSAP-IT：每 5 µL PCR 产物加 2 µL ExoSAP-IT，37°C 15 min → 80°C 15 min 灭活。

detailedSteps.en: Check DNA purity: A260/280 ≥1.8 (minimal protein/salt contamination), A260/230 ≥2.0 (minimal phenol/ethanol contamination). Re-purify if needed.
detailedSteps.zh: 检查 DNA 纯度：A260/280 ≥1.8（蛋白/盐污染少），A260/230 ≥2.0（酚/乙醇污染少）。如需要重新纯化。

detailedSteps.en: **Primer preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **引物制备**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend primers to 100 µM in nuclease-free water (add volume = nmol × 10). Store at −20°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 引物重悬至 100 µM（加入体积 = nmol × 10）。−20°C 保存。

detailedSteps.en: Dilute to 3.2 pmol/µL (3.2 µM) for sequencing submission. For example: 1 µL of 100 µM primer + 30 µL nuclease-free water = 3.2 pmol/µL.
detailedSteps.zh: 稀释至 3.2 pmol/µL（3.2 µM）用于测序提交。例如：1 µL 100 µM 引物 + 30 µL 无核酸酶水 = 3.2 pmol/µL。

detailedSteps.en: Common universal sequencing primers (dilute to 3.2 pmol/µL): M13F (-20): GTAAAACGACGGCCAGT; M13R: CAGGAAACAGCTATGAC; T7: TAATACGACTCACTATA; SP6: ATTTAGGTGACACTATAG.
detailedSteps.zh: 常用通用测序引物（稀释至 3.2 pmol/µL）：M13F (-20)：GTAAAACGACGGCCAGT；M13R：CAGGAAACAGCTATGAC；T7：TAATACGACTCACTATA；SP6：ATTTAGGTGACACTATAG。

detailedSteps.en: **Submission mix preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **提交混合液制备**

detailedSteps.en: For premix submission (most providers): combine in a 1.5 mL tube: 5 µL DNA template + 5 µL primer (3.2 pmol/µL) = 10 µL total per reaction. Mix gently by pipetting. Keep on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 预混提交（多数服务商）：1.5 mL 管中混合：5 µL DNA 模板 + 5 µL 引物（3.2 pmol/µL）= 每反应 10 µL。移液器轻柔混匀。置于冰上。

detailedSteps.en: Label tubes clearly with sample name, primer name, and date. For multiple samples, use 8-strip tubes. Include a sample submission form per provider instructions.
detailedSteps.zh: 清晰标注管子：样品名、引物名、日期。多样品用 8 连管。按服务商说明填写提交表。

detailedSteps.en: **Shipping & analysis**
detailedSteps.zh: **运输与分析**

detailedSteps.en: Submit samples on ice or at 4°C (gel ice pack) the same day. Most services deliver results in 24–48 h. For long-distance shipping: dry ice may be required.
detailedSteps.zh: 当日冰上或 4°C（凝胶冰袋）提交样品。多数服务 24–48 h 出结果。远途运输可能需要干冰。

detailedSteps.en: Download chromatogram (.ab1) files. Open in sequence analysis software (Benchling, SnapGene Viewer, 4Peaks, ApE). Check quality scores (QV ≥20 for reliable base calls).
detailedSteps.zh: 下载色谱图文件（.ab1）。序列分析软件打开（Benchling、SnapGene Viewer、4Peaks、ApE）。检查质量分数（QV ≥20 为可靠碱基读取）。

detailedSteps.en: Align to expected reference sequence. Verify: (a) target region sequenced in full, (b) no unexpected mutations, (c) no mixed signals (heterozygote peaks = contamination or polyclonal sample). BLAST any unexpected variants.
detailedSteps.zh: 与预期参考序列比对。验证：(a) 目标区域完整测序，(b) 无意外突变，(c) 无混合信号（杂合峰 = 污染或多克隆样品）。任何意外变体做 BLAST。

name: Silver Stain (SDS-PAGE)

components.name: 1. Fix gel: 50% MeOH + 12% AcOH + 0.05% formaldehyde, ≥1 h (overnight OK), RT

note.en: Fix in 200 mL fixer per standard mini gel. Removes SDS and stops protein migration. Minimum 1 h; overnight improves sensitivity.
note.zh: 每块标准 mini 胶用 200 mL 固定液。去除 SDS 并停止蛋白迁移。最少 1 h；过夜固定可提高灵敏度。

note.en: Removes acetic acid and most methanol. Fresh EtOH each wash.
note.zh: 去除乙酸和大部分甲醇。每次用新鲜乙醇。

components.name: 3. Sensitize: 0.02% Na₂S₂O₃ (sodium thiosulfate) in water, exactly 1 min, RT

note.en: CRITICAL: exactly 1 min. Sensitization enhances silver binding to proteins. Immediately wash 3 × 20 s ddH₂O after.
note.zh: 关键：精确计时 1 min。增强银与蛋白的结合。立即用 ddH₂O 洗 3 × 20 s。

note.en: Rapid rinses only — do not over-wash here.
note.zh: 快速冲洗——此步不可过长。

components.name: 5. Silver impregnation: 0.2% AgNO₃ + 0.075% formaldehyde, 20 min, 4°C or RT

note.en: Prepare fresh: 0.2 g AgNO₃/100 mL ddH₂O + 75 µL 37% formaldehyde. 4°C gives more uniform staining. Protect from light.
note.zh: 新鲜配制：0.2 g AgNO₃/100 mL 水 + 75 µL 37% 甲醛。4°C 染色更均匀。避光操作。

note.en: Removes unbound silver. Do not over-rinse.
note.zh: 去除未结合的银。不可过长冲洗。

components.name: 7. Develop: 6% Na₂CO₃ + 0.05% formaldehyde + 0.0004% Na₂S₂O₃, RT; monitor until bands appear

note.en: Develop time: 30 s – 10 min. Monitor carefully — over-development gives dark background. Fresh developer required. Swirl gently throughout.
note.zh: 显影时间：30 s – 10 min。仔细监控——过度显影导致背景过深。需新鲜配制显影液。轻柔摇动。

components.name: 8. Stop: 50% MeOH + 12% AcOH, 10 min; rinse 3 × ddH₂O, 5 min each

note.en: Immediately add stop solution as soon as desired staining intensity is reached. Final rinse in ddH₂O before imaging.
note.zh: 达到所需染色强度后立即加终止液。成像前用 ddH₂O 末次冲洗。

components.name: 9. Image gel on white-light transilluminator or scanner

note.en: Use flatbed scanner (600 dpi minimum) or gel documentation system with white light. For densitometry: Image Lab or ImageJ.
note.zh: 用平板扫描仪（至少 600 dpi）或凝胶成像系统（白光）拍照。密度扫描：Image Lab 或 ImageJ。

notes.en: Sensitivity: 1–10 ng protein/band (10–100× more sensitive than Coomassie). MS-compatible silver stain: omit glutaraldehyde and formaldehyde (use Shevchenko MS-compatible protocol: sensitizer = sodium thiosulfate, developer = Na₂CO₃ only). Interference: keratin (skin) gives false bands — wear gloves, use clean reagents. Contamination with dust/fingerprints ruins gel.
notes.zh: 灵敏度：1–10 ng 蛋白/条带（比考马斯蓝灵敏 10–100 倍）。质谱兼容银染：省去戊二醛和甲醛（用 Shevchenko MS 兼容方案：仅用硫代硫酸钠增敏，Na₂CO₃ 显影）。干扰：角蛋白（皮肤来源）产生假阳性条带——戴手套，使用清洁试剂。灰尘/指纹会损坏结果。

ref: Shevchenko et al. (1996) Anal Chem 68:850–858; Blum et al. (1987) Electrophoresis 8:93–99; Mortz et al. (2001) Proteomics 1:1359

usage.en: Silver stain for SDS-PAGE gels to detect proteins at nanogram sensitivity (1–10 ng/band), 10–100× more sensitive than Coomassie blue.
usage.zh: SDS-PAGE 凝胶银染检测蛋白，灵敏度 1–10 ng/条带，比考马斯亮蓝高 10–100 倍。

label.en: Protocol — 3–4 hours (excluding overnight fixation), hands-on: 3 hours
label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours (excluding overnight fixation)，实操: 3 hours
