note.en: Fixed gel in 50% MeOH/12% AcOH can be stored at RT for up to 1 week before proceeding
note.zh: 固定后的胶在 50% MeOH/12% AcOH 中 RT 可保存最多 1 周再继续处理

note.en: Stained gel in stop solution can be stored at RT for several days; image as soon as possible for best quality
note.zh: 终止液中的染色胶 RT 可保存数天；尽快成像以获得最佳质量

briefSteps.en: Fix gel 1 h–O/N → 50% EtOH wash 3× → Sensitize 1 min (Na₂S₂O₃) → Rinse → Silver nitrate 20 min → Rinse → Develop (monitor bands) → Stop → Image
briefSteps.zh: 固定胶 1 h–过夜 → 50% EtOH 洗 3× → 增敏 1 min（Na₂S₂O₃）→ 冲洗 → 硝酸银 20 min → 冲洗 → 显影（监控条带）→ 终止 → 成像

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — SDS-PAGE & Fixation**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — SDS-PAGE 与固定**

detailedSteps.en: Run SDS-PAGE gel according to standard protocol. Rinse gel in ddH₂O briefly to remove SDS.
detailedSteps.zh: 按标准方案 SDS-PAGE 电泳。短暂 ddH₂O 冲洗胶去除 SDS。

detailedSteps.en: Fix gel: place in container with 200 mL fixative (50% MeOH + 12% AcOH + 0.05% formaldehyde) per mini gel. Incubate on shaker at RT for ≥1 h (overnight is fine — increases sensitivity).
detailedSteps.zh: 固定：每块 mini 胶加 200 mL 固定液（50% MeOH + 12% AcOH + 0.05% 甲醛）。RT 摇床孵育 ≥1 h（过夜更好——提高灵敏度）。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Washing & sensitization**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 洗涤与增敏**

detailedSteps.en: Wash in 50% EtOH: 3 × 20 min on shaker at RT. Use fresh EtOH for each wash.
detailedSteps.zh: 50% EtOH 洗涤：3 × 20 min，RT 摇床。每次用新鲜 EtOH。

detailedSteps.en: Sensitize: 0.02% sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) in ddH₂O. CRITICAL: soak exactly 1 min. Longer = high background. Immediately proceed to rinses.
detailedSteps.zh: 增敏：ddH₂O 中 0.02% 硫代硫酸钠（Na₂S₂O₃）。关键：精确 1 min。过长 = 高背景。立即进入冲洗步骤。

detailedSteps.en: Rinse: ddH₂O, 3 × 20 s rapid washes. Do not over-rinse.
detailedSteps.zh: 冲洗：ddH₂O，3 × 20 s 快速冲洗。不可过长。

detailedSteps.en: **Silver impregnation**
detailedSteps.zh: **银浸染**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare silver nitrate solution fresh: 0.2 g AgNO₃ dissolved in 100 mL ddH₂O + 75 µL 37% formaldehyde. Protect from light. Can be used at RT or pre-chilled to 4°C for more uniform staining.
detailedSteps.zh: 新鲜配制硝酸银溶液：0.2 g AgNO₃ 溶于 100 mL ddH₂O + 75 µL 37% 甲醛。避光。RT 使用或预冷至 4°C 可使染色更均匀。

detailedSteps.en: Impregnate gel in silver solution: 20 min at RT (or 4°C) on shaker. Protect from light throughout.
detailedSteps.zh: 银溶液中浸染：RT（或 4°C）摇床 20 min。全程避光。

detailedSteps.en: Rinse gel in ddH₂O: 2 × 20 s to remove unbound silver.
detailedSteps.zh: ddH₂O 冲洗胶：2 × 20 s 去除未结合银。

detailedSteps.en: **Development**
Prepare developer fresh: 6% Na₂CO₃ + 0.05% formaldehyde + 0.0004% Na₂S₂O₃ in ddH₂O. For 100 mL: 6 g Na₂CO₃ + 50 µL 37% formaldehyde + 400 µL of 0.1% Na₂S₂O₃.
detailedSteps.zh: 新鲜配制显影液：ddH₂O 中 6% Na₂CO₃ + 0.05% 甲醛 + 0.0004% Na₂S₂O₃。100 mL 用量：6 g Na₂CO₃ + 50 µL 37% 甲醛 + 400 µL 0.1% Na₂S₂O₃。

detailedSteps.en: Develop gel: immerse in developer, gently shake. Bands appear in 30 s – 10 min. Monitor closely — over-development causes dark background and high noise. When bands reach desired intensity, immediately proceed to stop solution.
detailedSteps.zh: 显影：胶浸入显影液，轻柔摇动。条带在 30 s – 10 min 内出现。密切监控——过度显影导致背景深、噪声高。条带达到所需强度时立即进入终止液。

detailedSteps.en: **Stop & imaging**
detailedSteps.zh: **终止与成像**

detailedSteps.en: Stop reaction: transfer gel to stop solution (50% MeOH + 12% AcOH). Incubate 10 min on shaker.
detailedSteps.zh: 终止反应：胶转移至终止液（50% MeOH + 12% AcOH）。摇床孵育 10 min。

detailedSteps.en: Rinse gel in ddH₂O: 3 × 5 min to remove acid.
detailedSteps.zh: ddH₂O 冲洗胶：3 × 5 min 去除酸。

detailedSteps.en: Image gel using flatbed scanner (≥600 dpi) with white light transillumination, or gel documentation system. For densitometry quantification: use Image Lab or ImageJ.
detailedSteps.zh: 平板扫描仪（至少 600 dpi）白光透射成像，或凝胶成像系统。密度定量：Image Lab 或 ImageJ。

name: Single Colony Picking and Screening

components.name: 1. Prepare transformation plates: use LB agar + appropriate antibiotic

note.en: Plate density: 50–200 colonies/plate is ideal. Too dense (>500) → colonies too small; too sparse → wasted space. Cool agar to 55°C before pouring (25 mL/plate for 10 cm). Pre-warm plates at 37°C 30 min before use.
note.zh: 理想菌落密度：50–200 个/板。过密（>500）菌落太小；过稀浪费空间。琼脂冷至 55°C 后倒板（10 cm 皿约 25 mL）。用前 37°C 预热 30 min。

note.en: Add 40 µL X-gal (20 mg/mL in DMF) + 4 µL IPTG (100 mM) per plate; spread, let dry 30 min. White colonies = insert present; blue = self-ligation/empty vector. Requires lacZα vectors (pUC, pGEM, pBlueScript).
note.zh: 每板加 40 µL X-gal（20 mg/mL in DMF）+ 4 µL IPTG（100 mM）；涂抹，晾干 30 min。白色 = 含插入片段；蓝色 = 自连/空载体。需要 lacZα 载体（pUC、pGEM、pBlueScript）。

note.en: Move plates to 4°C after 16 h if not picking immediately — colonies stop growing and are easier to distinguish. Blue-white screen: return to 4°C 1–2 h to develop color.
note.zh: 16 h 后如不立即挑取，移至 4°C——菌落停止生长，更易分辨。蓝白筛选：返回 4°C 1–2 h 充分显色。

components.name: 4. Prepare culture tubes: 1.5–2 mL LB + antibiotic per clone

note.en: Use 14 mL round-bottom or 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes. Label carefully. Prepare 10–24 clones per ligation to ensure ≥1 correct clone.
note.zh: 使用 14 mL 圆底管或 1.5 mL Eppendorf 管。认真标记。每次连接挑 10–24 个克隆以确保 ≥1 个正确克隆。

components.name: 5. Pick colonies with sterile toothpick or 10 µL pipette tip

note.en: Touch colony center with toothpick tip. Inoculate tube AND streak onto numbered grid on a fresh LB+antibiotic plate (master plate). Master plate: incubate 37°C overnight, store at 4°C as backup.
note.zh: 用牙签或 10 µL 枪头尖端触碰菌落中心。同时接种培养管并在备用板（主板）上划线编号。主板：37°C 过夜，4°C 保存备用。

note.en: Eppendorf tubes: tape closed at angle, place in shaker. Round-bottom: use at 45° angle in rack.
note.zh: Eppendorf 管：斜插入摇床。圆底管：45° 角放置。

components.name: 7. Screen by colony PCR or diagnostic restriction digest

note.en: Colony PCR (colony_pcr): take 1 µL of overnight culture as template; use vector-based primers (M13/T7/SP6) or gene-specific primers flanking insert. Expect correct band size. Restriction digest: miniprep first, then diagnostic digest with 1–2 enzymes that distinguish insert orientation/size.
note.zh: 菌落 PCR（colony_pcr）：取 1 µL 过夜培养液作模板；用载体通用引物（M13/T7/SP6）或跨插入片段的基因特异引物。预期正确条带大小。限制酶消化：先 miniprep，再用 1–2 种酶进行诊断性酶切，区分插入方向/大小。

components.name: 8. Select positive clones; send for Sanger sequencing

note.en: sanger_sequencing_prep. Send miniprep DNA (50–100 ng/µL) + sequencing primer. Verify full insert sequence, no PCR errors. Select 2–3 positive + sequencing-confirmed clones.
note.zh: sanger_sequencing_prep。送 miniprep DNA（50–100 ng/µL）+ 测序引物。验证完整插入序列，无 PCR 错误。选择 2–3 个阳性且测序确认的克隆。

components.name: 9. Prepare glycerol stocks from confirmed positive clones

note.en: bacterial_glycerol_stock: 1 mL overnight culture + 1 mL 50% glycerol → store −80°C. Label with: clone ID, date, insert, antibiotic.
note.zh: bacterial_glycerol_stock：1 mL 过夜培养液 + 1 mL 50% 甘油 → −80°C 保存。标注：克隆编号、日期、插入片段、抗生素。

notes.en: Colony number vs insert probability: ligation efficiency ~20–50% with directional cloning; ~5–15% without blue-white selection. Colony appearance timing: Amp resistance ~ 12 h; Kan/Cm ~ 14–16 h. White colonies in blue-white: ~50% correct by PCR; confirm all positives by sequencing.
notes.zh: 菌落数 vs 插入概率：定向克隆连接效率约 20–50%；无蓝白筛选约 5–15%。菌落出现时间：Amp 约 12 h；Kan/Cm 约 14–16 h。蓝白筛选白色菌落约 50% PCR 阳性；测序确认所有候选。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed. Ch. 1; Green & Sambrook (2012) Molecular Cloning 4th ed.; Ausubel et al. Current Protocols in Molecular Biology Unit 1.5

usage.en: Pick isolated bacterial colonies for liquid culture and downstream analysis.
usage.zh: 挑取单克隆菌落进行液体培养和下游分析。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 1 hour

note.en: Transformation plates can be stored at 4°C for up to 1 week (wrap in parafilm). Colonies remain viable but stop growing
note.zh: 转化平板可 4°C 保存最多 1 周（封口膜密封）。菌落保持活性但停止生长

note.en: Master plate (re-streaked grid) can be stored at 4°C for 1–2 weeks as backup. Overnight cultures can be used for miniprep next morning
note.zh: 主板（划线网格板）可 4°C 保存 1–2 周作为备份。过夜培养液次日早晨即可用于 miniprep

note.en: Glycerol stocks at -80°C are permanent safe stops — viable for years
note.zh: 甘油菌 -80°C 保存为永久安全停止点 — 可存活数年

briefSteps.en: Transform → plate on LB+antibiotic O/N → pick 10–24 colonies → liquid culture O/N → colony PCR / miniprep + restriction digest → Sanger sequencing → glycerol stock (-80°C)
briefSteps.zh: 转化 → LB+抗生素平板过夜 → 挑取 10–24 个菌落 → 液体过夜培养 → 菌落 PCR / miniprep + 酶切 → Sanger 测序 → 甘油菌（-80°C）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Plate Preparation & Colony Growth**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 1 天 — 平板准备与菌落生长**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare LB agar plates with appropriate antibiotic (pre-warm at 37°C for 30 min before plating). Ideal colony density: 50–200 colonies per 10 cm plate
detailedSteps.zh: 配制含适当抗生素的 LB 琼脂平板（铺板前 37°C 预热 30 min）。理想菌落密度：10 cm 平板 50–200 个菌落

detailedSteps.en: Optional blue-white screening: spread 40 µL X-gal (20 mg/mL in DMF) + 4 µL IPTG (100 mM) per plate. Let dry 30 min before plating transformed bacteria
detailedSteps.zh: 可选蓝白筛选：每板涂 40 µL X-gal（20 mg/mL in DMF）+ 4 µL IPTG（100 mM）。晾干 30 min 后再铺转化菌

detailedSteps.en: Plate transformed bacteria and incubate at 37°C overnight (12–16 h). Move to 4°C after 16 h if not picking immediately. For blue-white: 4°C 1–2 h to develop color
detailedSteps.zh: 铺转化菌并 37°C 过夜培养（12–16 h）。如不立即挑取，16 h 后移至 4°C。蓝白筛选：4°C 1–2 h 充分显色

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Colony Picking & Liquid Culture**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 2 天 — 挑取菌落与液体培养**

detailedSteps.en: Prepare culture tubes: 1.5–2 mL LB + antibiotic per clone. Label carefully. Prepare 10–24 clones per ligation
detailedSteps.zh: 准备培养管：每个克隆 1.5–2 mL LB + 抗生素。认真标记。每次连接准备 10–24 个克隆

detailedSteps.en: Pick colonies with sterile toothpick or 10 µL pipette tip: touch colony center, inoculate culture tube, AND streak onto numbered master plate (fresh LB + antibiotic plate). Incubate master plate at 37°C overnight, then store at 4°C as backup
detailedSteps.zh: 用无菌牙签或 10 µL 枪头挑取菌落：触碰菌落中心，接种培养管，同时在主板（新 LB + 抗生素平板）上划线编号。主板 37°C 过夜后 4°C 保存备用

detailedSteps.en: Grow overnight cultures at 37°C, 200–250 rpm, 12–16 h
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、200–250 rpm 振荡过夜培养 12–16 h

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3 — Screening & Verification**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 3 天 — 筛选与验证**

detailedSteps.en: Screen by colony PCR (1 µL overnight culture as template, vector primers M13/T7/SP6 or gene-specific primers) and/or miniprep followed by diagnostic restriction digest
detailedSteps.zh: 菌落 PCR 筛选（1 µL 过夜培养液为模板，载体引物 M13/T7/SP6 或基因特异引物）和/或 miniprep 后诊断性酶切

detailedSteps.en: Select positive clones. Send miniprep DNA (50–100 ng/µL) + sequencing primer for Sanger sequencing. Verify full insert sequence with no PCR-introduced mutations
detailedSteps.zh: 选择阳性克隆。送 miniprep DNA（50–100 ng/µL）+ 测序引物进行 Sanger 测序。验证完整插入序列无 PCR 引入突变

detailedSteps.en: Prepare glycerol stocks from 2–3 confirmed positive clones: mix 1 mL overnight culture + 1 mL 50% glycerol. Label (clone ID, date, insert, antibiotic). Store at -80°C
detailedSteps.zh: 从 2–3 个确认阳性克隆制备甘油菌：1 mL 过夜培养液 + 1 mL 50% 甘油混合。标注（克隆编号、日期、插入片段、抗生素）。-80°C 保存

name: siRNA-Mediated Gene Knockdown
nameCn: siRNA 基因沉默（RNAi 干扰）

components.name: 1. Design siRNA: order 2–3 independent siRNAs per target gene

note.en: 19–21 nt duplex with 2 nt 3' overhangs. Sources: Qiagen, Dharmacon, IDT. Resuspend 20 µM in RNase-free water; store −80°C.
note.zh: 19–21 nt 双链，3' 端 2 nt 突出。来源：Qiagen、Dharmacon、IDT。RNase-free 水溶解至 20 µM；−80°C 保存。

components.name: 2. Day 0: seed cells in antibiotic-free media

note.en: 24-well: 5–8×10⁴ cells; 6-well: 2–4×10⁵; 10 cm: 1.5–2×10⁶. Target 40–70% confluency at transfection.
Tube A: 3 µL RNAiMAX + 47 µL Opti-MEM, 5 min RT. Tube B: 1 µL siRNA (20 µM) + 49 µL Opti-MEM. Combine A+B, mix gently, 20 min RT. [24-well scale; final siRNA ~20 nM].
note.zh: 管 A：3 µL RNAiMAX + 47 µL Opti-MEM，RT 5 min。管 B：1 µL siRNA（20 µM）+ 49 µL Opti-MEM。A+B 混合，轻混，RT 20 min。[24 孔规模；siRNA 终浓度 ~20 nM]。

components.name: 4. Add complex dropwise to cells; gentle plate rocking

note.en: Remove old media; add 400 µL fresh (no antibiotics) + 100 µL complex = 500 µL total. Do NOT change media for 6 h.
note.zh: 去旧培养基；加 400 µL 新鲜培养基（无抗生素）+ 100 µL 复合物 = 500 µL。6 h 内不换液。

note.en: 48 h: fast-turnover proteins. 72 h: most targets. 96 h + re-transfection at 48 h: stable proteins.
note.zh: 48 h：快速周转蛋白。72 h：大多数靶标。96 h + 48 h 时再转染：稳定蛋白。

note.en: qpcr_protocol for mRNA (≥70% reduction expected). wb_protocol for protein (≥60% reduction). Include siNC + siGAPDH controls.
note.zh: qpcr_protocol 检测 mRNA（预期 ≥70% 下调）。wb_protocol 检测蛋白（预期 ≥60% 下调）。对照：siNC + siGAPDH。

note.en: Proliferation: cck8_proliferation; Migration: scratch_assay/transwell_migration; Apoptosis: annexin_v_apoptosis.
note.zh: 增殖：cck8_proliferation；迁移：scratch_assay / transwell_migration；凋亡：annexin_v_apoptosis。

notes.en: Controls: (1) siNC (non-targeting); (2) siGAPDH (positive KD); (3) untreated; (4) lipid-only (toxicity). Toxicity high? Reduce RNAiMAX to 1.5 µL/well. Hard-to-transfect cells: Nucleofection, electroporation, or lentiviral shRNA.
notes.zh: 对照：(1) siNC（非靶向）；(2) siGAPDH（阳性 KD）；(3) 未处理；(4) 仅脂质体（毒性）。毒性大？减少 RNAiMAX 至 1.5 µL/孔。难转染细胞：核转染、电穿孔或慢病毒 shRNA。

ref: Elbashir et al. (2001) Nature 411:494–498; Reynolds et al. (2004) Nat Biotechnol 22:326; Qiagen siRNA Transfection Handbook

usage.en: Knock down target gene expression using small interfering RNA (siRNA) transfection.
usage.zh: 小干扰 RNA（siRNA）转染敲低靶基因表达。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 days，实操: 2 hours

note.en: 25 nmol, HPLC-purified. Design using Dharmacon, IDT, or Sigma tools
note.zh: 25 nmol，HPLC纯化。使用Dharmacon、IDT或Sigma工具设计

note.en: Same provider as targeting siRNA
note.zh: 与靶向siRNA同一供应商

note.en: Thermo 13778150
note.zh: Thermo 13778150

note.en: Thermo 31985070
note.zh: Thermo 31985070

note.en: DMEM/RPMI + 10% FBS, no pen/strep
note.zh: DMEM/RPMI + 10% FBS，不加青/链霉素

note.en: For RNA extraction
note.zh: 用于RNA提取

note.en: + protease/phosphatase inhibitors
note.zh: + 蛋白酶/磷酸酶抑制剂

note.en: Reverse transcriptase, SYBR Green or TaqMan, primers
note.zh: 反转录酶、SYBR Green或TaqMan、引物

note.en: After seeding on Day 0, cells incubate overnight; proceed with transfection reagent preparation next morning (Day 1).
note.zh: Day 0 铺板后细胞过夜孵育，次日早上（Day 1）准备转染试剂继续操作。

note.en: After transfection, cells incubate 48–72 h for knockdown; harvest time can be adjusted based on target protein half-life.
note.zh: 转染后细胞孵育 48–72 h 待敲低生效；收获时间可根据靶蛋白半衰期灵活调整。

briefSteps.en: Design 2–3 siRNAs per target → seed cells in antibiotic-free medium → prepare siRNA-RNAiMAX complex in Opti-MEM → add to cells → incubate 48–72 h → verify knockdown by qPCR and/or WB → run functional assays
briefSteps.zh: 设计 2–3 条靶向 siRNA → 无抗生素培养基铺板 → Opti-MEM 中制备 siRNA-RNAiMAX 复合物 → 加入细胞 → 孵育 48–72 h → qPCR/WB 验证敲低效率 → 开展功能实验

detailedSteps.en: Design or order 2–3 independent siRNAs per target gene (19–21 nt duplexes with 2 nt 3' overhangs). Include a non-targeting control (siNC) and a positive knockdown control (e.g., siGAPDH). Resuspend lyophilised siRNA in RNase-free water to 20 µM; aliquot and store at −80°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 针对每个靶基因设计或订购 2–3 条独立 siRNA（19–21 nt 双链，3' 端 2 nt 突出）。包含非靶向对照（siNC）和阳性敲低对照（如 siGAPDH）。冻干 siRNA 用 RNase-free 水溶解至 20 µM，分装后 −80°C 保存。

detailedSteps.en: Day 0: Seed cells in antibiotic-free complete medium. 24-well: 5–8×10⁴ cells; 6-well: 2–4×10⁵ cells; 10 cm dish: 1.5–2×10⁶ cells. Target 40–70% confluency at transfection (Day 1).
detailedSteps.zh: Day 0：将细胞接种于不含抗生素的完全培养基中。24 孔板：5–8×10⁴；6 孔板：2–4×10⁵；10 cm 皿：1.5–2×10⁶。目标转染时（Day 1）汇合度为 40–70%。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1 — Tube A: Dilute 3 µL Lipofectamine RNAiMAX into 47 µL Opti-MEM (for 24-well scale); mix gently and incubate 5 min at room temperature.
detailedSteps.zh: Day 1 — 管 A：将 3 µL Lipofectamine RNAiMAX 稀释至 47 µL Opti-MEM（24 孔板规模），轻混后室温孵育 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Tube B: Dilute 1 µL of 20 µM siRNA into 49 µL Opti-MEM (final ~20 nM siRNA). For higher concentrations adjust accordingly.
detailedSteps.zh: 管 B：将 1 µL 20 µM siRNA 稀释至 49 µL Opti-MEM（终浓度约 20 nM）。如需更高浓度按比例调整。

detailedSteps.en: Combine Tube A and Tube B; mix gently by pipetting 3–5 times; incubate at room temperature for 20 min to form siRNA-lipid complexes.
detailedSteps.zh: 合并管 A 和管 B，轻柔吹打 3–5 次，室温孵育 20 min 形成 siRNA-脂质复合物。

detailedSteps.en: Aspirate cell medium; add 400 µL fresh antibiotic-free medium per 24-well; add 100 µL complex dropwise (total 500 µL). Gently rock plate to distribute. Do NOT change medium for at least 6 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 吸去旧培养基，每孔加 400 µL 新鲜无抗生素培养基，逐滴加入 100 µL 复合物（共 500 µL），轻摇培养板使其分布均匀。6 h 内不换液。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 48–72 h. Most targets: 72 h. Fast-turnover proteins: 48 h. Long-lived proteins: 96 h with a second transfection at 48 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育 48–72 h。大多数靶标：72 h；快速周转蛋白：48 h；稳定蛋白：96 h，48 h 时再次转染。

detailedSteps.en: Verify knockdown efficiency by qPCR (mRNA level; expect ≥70% reduction) and/or Western blot (protein level; expect ≥60% reduction). Always include siNC and siGAPDH controls.
detailedSteps.zh: 通过 qPCR（mRNA 水平，预期 ≥70% 下调）和/或 Western blot（蛋白水平，预期 ≥60% 下调）验证敲低效率。始终包含 siNC 和 siGAPDH 对照。

detailedSteps.en: Proceed with downstream functional assays (proliferation, migration, apoptosis, etc.) at 48–72 h post-transfection when knockdown is confirmed.
detailedSteps.zh: 确认敲低效率后，在转染后 48–72 h 开展下游功能实验（增殖、迁移、凋亡等）。

name: Site-Directed Mutagenesis (Q5/KLD)

components.name: 2. Q5 反向 PCR 扩增

notes.en: Introduce point mutations, insertions, or deletions into plasmid DNA. Based on inverse PCR with phosphorylation, ligation, and DpnI digestion of template in a single KLD step.
notes.zh: 在质粒 DNA 中引入点突变、插入或缺失。基于反向 PCR，在单一 KLD 步骤中完成磷酸化、连接和 DpnI 消化模板。

ref: NEB Q5 SDM Kit Protocol E0554 (protocols.io doi:10.17504/protocols.io.bddei23e)

usage.en: Introduce specific point mutations into plasmid DNA by site-directed mutagenesis.
usage.zh: 定点突变在质粒 DNA 中引入特定点突变。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Or similar HF polymerase
note.zh: 或类似高保真聚合酶

note.en: Design with NEBaseChanger
note.zh: 用 NEBaseChanger 设计

note.en: Kinase + Ligase + DpnI
note.zh: 激酶 + 连接酶 + DpnI

note.en: PCR product (linearized plasmid) can be stored at 4°C overnight or −20°C for up to 1 week before KLD reaction.
note.zh: PCR 产物（线性化质粒）可在 4°C 保存过夜，或 −20°C 保存最多 1 周，再进行 KLD 反应。

note.en: KLD reaction product can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 week if transformation cannot be done immediately.
note.zh: 若无法立即转化，KLD 反应产物可在 −20°C 保存最多 1 周。

briefSteps.en: Design back-to-back mutagenic primers via NEBaseChanger → inverse PCR with Q5 polymerase → verify PCR product by gel → KLD reaction (kinase + ligase + DpnI, 5 min) → transform competent cells → pick colonies and sequence-verify.
briefSteps.zh: 通过 NEBaseChanger 设计背靠背突变引物 → Q5 聚合酶反向 PCR → 凝胶验证 PCR 产物 → KLD 反应（激酶+连接酶+DpnI，5 min）→ 转化感受态细胞 → 挑克隆测序验证。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1 — Design mutagenic primers using NEBaseChanger (nebasechangergui.neb.com). Primers should be back-to-back (5' ends facing away), with the mutation(s) at the 5' end of the forward primer. Recommended Tm ≥ 60°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天 — 使用 NEBaseChanger（nebasechangergui.neb.com）设计突变引物。引物应背靠背排列（5' 端相互背离），突变位点在正向引物的 5' 端。推荐 Tm ≥ 60°C。

detailedSteps.en: Set up Q5 inverse PCR (25 µL): 12.5 µL Q5 Hot Start 2× Master Mix, 1.25 µL forward primer (10 µM), 1.25 µL reverse primer (10 µM), 1–10 ng plasmid template, nuclease-free water to 25 µL.
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 Q5 反向 PCR（25 µL）：12.5 µL Q5 Hot Start 2× Master Mix、1.25 µL 正向引物（10 µM）、1.25 µL 反向引物（10 µM）、1–10 ng 质粒模板、无核酸酶水补至 25 µL。

detailedSteps.en: Run thermocycler: initial denaturation 98°C for 30 s; 25 cycles of 98°C for 10 s, Tm for 30 s, 72°C for 20–30 s/kb; final extension 72°C for 2 min; hold at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 热循环程序：初始变性 98°C 30 s；25 个循环：98°C 10 s，Tm 30 s，72°C 20–30 s/kb；终末延伸 72°C 2 min；4°C 保温。

detailedSteps.en: Verify PCR product by running 5 µL on a 1% agarose gel. Expect a linearized plasmid-sized band. If no band or multiple bands, optimize annealing temperature.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 5 µL 跑 1% 琼脂糖凝胶验证 PCR 产物。预期出现线性质粒大小的条带。若无条带或多条带，需优化退火温度。

detailedSteps.en: Set up KLD reaction (5 µL total): 1 µL PCR product, 2 µL 5× KLD Reaction Buffer, 1 µL 10× KLD Enzyme Mix (T4 polynucleotide kinase + T4 ligase + DpnI), 1 µL nuclease-free water. Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 KLD 反应（总体积 5 µL）：1 µL PCR 产物、2 µL 5× KLD 反应缓冲液、1 µL 10× KLD 酶混合液（T4 多核苷酸激酶 + T4 连接酶 + DpnI）、1 µL 无核酸酶水。室温孵育 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Transform 1–5 µL KLD product into 25–50 µL chemically competent E. coli (e.g., NEB 5-alpha). Heat shock at 42°C for 30 s, recover in 950 µL SOC at 37°C for 1 hour with shaking.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 1–5 µL KLD 产物转化至 25–50 µL 化学感受态大肠杆菌（如 NEB 5-alpha）。42°C 热激 30 s，在 950 µL SOC 中 37°C 振荡恢复 1 小时。

detailedSteps.en: Plate 100 µL of transformed cells onto LB agar + antibiotic plates. Incubate at 37°C overnight (16–18 hours).
detailedSteps.zh: 将 100 µL 转化菌液涂布于含抗生素的 LB 琼脂平板。37°C 培育过夜（16–18 小时）。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2 — Pick 4–8 individual colonies. Inoculate into 5 mL LB + antibiotic liquid medium. Grow overnight at 37°C with shaking at 250 rpm.
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天 — 挑取 4–8 个单菌落，接种至 5 mL LB + 抗生素液体培养基中，37°C、250 rpm 振荡过夜培养。

detailedSteps.en: Perform miniprep to isolate plasmid. Submit DNA for Sanger sequencing using a primer flanking the mutation site. Confirm the desired mutation and the absence of unwanted secondary mutations.
detailedSteps.zh: 质粒小提纯化。用覆盖突变位点的引物进行 Sanger 测序。确认目的突变引入且无意外的二次突变。

name: Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC / Gel Filtration)
nameCn: 分子排阻色谱（SEC / 凝胶过滤）蛋白纯化

components.name: 1. Prepare sample: ≥1 mg/mL, centrifuge 20,000×g 20 min 4°C, filter 0.22 µm

note.en: Remove aggregates before injection. Analytical: ≤500 µL; preparative: ≤5 mL (16/60 column).
note.zh: 进样前去除聚集体。分析型：≤500 µL；制备型：≤5 mL（16/60 柱）。

components.name: 2. Select SEC column by MW range

note.en: Superdex 75 (3–70 kDa), Superdex 200 (10–600 kDa), Superose 6 (5–5,000 kDa). Analytical: 10/300 GL (24 mL). Preparative: 16/60 (120 mL) or 26/60 (320 mL).
note.zh: Superdex 75（3–70 kDa）、Superdex 200（10–600 kDa）、Superose 6（5–5,000 kDa）。分析型：10/300 GL（24 mL）。制备型：16/60（120 mL）。

note.en: Flow rate: 0.4–0.5 mL/min (10/300 GL); 1.0–1.5 mL/min (16/60). Pressure limit: 1.5–1.8 MPa. Monitor A280 baseline stability.

components.name: 4. Inject sample via clean sample loop

note.en: Rinse loop with water then running buffer before injection. Inject at 0.5 mL/min.
note.zh: 上样环先用水再用运行缓冲液冲洗。0.5 mL/min 注入。

components.name: 5. Run: 1.2 CV at constant flow; collect 0.5 mL (analytical) or 1–2 mL (preparative) fractions

note.en: Monitor A280 (protein), A260 (nucleic acids). V₀ ≈ 0.35 CV; Vt ≈ CV.
note.zh: 监测 A280（蛋白）、A260（核酸）。V₀ ≈ 0.35 CV；Vt ≈ CV。

components.name: 6. Pool symmetric peak fractions; verify by SDS-PAGE

note.en: Asymmetric tailing = aggregation or multiple species. Only pool the main symmetric peak.
note.zh: 不对称拖尾 = 聚集体或多组分。仅合并对称峰组分。

components.name: 7. Optional: run MW calibration standards (first time per column)

note.en: GE LMW/HMW kit. Plot log(MW) vs Kav = (Ve−V₀)/(Vt−V₀). Couple with SEC-MALS for absolute MW.
note.zh: GE LMW/HMW 校准套装。绘 log(MW) vs Kav = (Ve−V₀)/(Vt−V₀)。联用 SEC-MALS 可测绝对分子量。

components.name: 8. Clean column: 1 CV 2 M NaCl, re-equilibrate; store in 20% EtOH at 4°C

note.en: Never run column dry. Monthly: 0.5 CV 0.5 M NaOH for biofilm removal (check column compatibility).
note.zh: 切勿让柱子跑干。每月：0.5 CV 0.5 M NaOH 清除生物膜（需确认柱子兼容性）。

notes.en: SEC is gold-standard polishing step. Separates by hydrodynamic radius. Excellent for: removing aggregates, determining oligomeric state, buffer exchange. Keep sample:column volume ≤1–2% for best resolution. Run at 4°C for labile proteins.
notes.zh: SEC 是蛋白精修的金标准。按流体力学半径分离。适合去除聚集体、确定寡聚状态、换液。样品:柱体积 ≤1–2% 以获最佳分辨率。不稳定蛋白在 4°C 进行。

ref: Wyatt et al. (2017) Nat Protoc 12:1683–1701; GE Healthcare SEC Application Note 18-1114-02

usage.en: Separate proteins by size using size-exclusion (gel filtration) chromatography.
usage.zh: 分子筛（凝胶过滤）层析按蛋白质大小分离。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Superdex 75/200 or Superose 6, 10/300 GL or 16/600
note.zh: Superdex 75/200或Superose 6，10/300 GL或16/600

note.en: 20 mM Tris pH 7.5 + 150 mM NaCl or PBS, filtered and degassed
note.zh: 20 mM Tris pH 7.5 + 150 mM NaCl或PBS，过滤脱气

note.en: With UV, conductivity detectors and fraction collector
note.zh: 配备UV、电导率检测器和馏分收集器

note.en: Amicon Ultra, MWCO ≤ ½ target MW
note.zh: Amicon Ultra，MWCO ≤ 目标MW的½

note.en: For sample and buffer
note.zh: 用于样品和缓冲液

note.en: Bio-Rad 1511901 (optional)
note.zh: Bio-Rad 1511901（可选）

note.en: Prepared and filtered protein sample can be held at 4°C for up to 24 hours before injection.
note.zh: 制备并过滤好的蛋白样品可在 4°C 保存最多 24 小时后再进样。

note.en: Pooled peak fractions can be stored at 4°C overnight or snap-frozen at −80°C with 10% glycerol.
note.zh: 合并的峰值组分可在 4°C 保存过夜，或加 10% 甘油后液氮速冻于 −80°C 保存。

briefSteps.en: Concentrate and filter protein sample → select appropriate SEC column by MW range → equilibrate column with 1.5 CV running buffer → inject sample → run at constant flow collecting 0.5–2 mL fractions → pool symmetric peak → verify by SDS-PAGE → clean and store column in 20% EtOH
briefSteps.zh: 浓缩并过滤蛋白样品 → 按分子量选择合适 SEC 柱 → 1.5 CV 运行缓冲液平衡柱子 → 进样 → 恒流运行收集 0.5–2 mL 组分 → 合并对称峰 → SDS-PAGE 验证 → 清洗柱子并储存于 20% EtOH

detailedSteps.en: Prepare protein sample: concentrate to ≥1 mg/mL, centrifuge at 20,000×g for 20 min at 4°C to remove aggregates, then filter through 0.22 µm membrane. Analytical injection: ≤500 µL; preparative (16/60 column): ≤5 mL.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备蛋白样品：浓缩至 ≥1 mg/mL，20,000×g、4°C 离心 20 min 去除聚集体，再过 0.22 µm 膜。分析型进样 ≤500 µL；制备型（16/60 柱）≤5 mL。

detailedSteps.en: Select SEC column appropriate for the target protein MW: Superdex 75 (3–70 kDa), Superdex 200 (10–600 kDa), or Superose 6 (5–5,000 kDa). For analytical runs use 10/300 GL (24 mL); for preparative use 16/60 (120 mL) or 26/60 (320 mL).
detailedSteps.zh: 按目标蛋白 MW 选柱：Superdex 75（3–70 kDa）、Superdex 200（10–600 kDa）或 Superose 6（5–5,000 kDa）。分析型用 10/300 GL（24 mL），制备型用 16/60（120 mL）或 26/60（320 mL）。

detailedSteps.en: Equilibrate column with 1.5 CV SEC running buffer (e.g., 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT). Flow rate: 0.4–0.5 mL/min (10/300 GL) or 1.0–1.5 mL/min (16/60). Pressure limit 1.5–1.8 MPa. Monitor A280 until baseline is stable.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 1.5 CV SEC 运行缓冲液（如 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5、150 mM NaCl、1 mM DTT）平衡柱子。流速：0.4–0.5 mL/min（10/300 GL）或 1.0–1.5 mL/min（16/60）。压力限 1.5–1.8 MPa。监测 A280 至基线稳定。

detailedSteps.en: Rinse sample loop with water then running buffer. Load sample into loop and inject at 0.5 mL/min. Note the injection volume precisely for later Kav calculation.
detailedSteps.zh: 样品环先用水冲洗再用运行缓冲液平衡。将样品装入上样环并以 0.5 mL/min 注入。精确记录进样体积以备 Kav 计算。

detailedSteps.en: Run 1.2 CV at constant flow. Collect 0.5 mL fractions (analytical) or 1–2 mL fractions (preparative). Monitor A280 (protein) and A260 (nucleic acid contamination). Void volume V₀ ≈ 0.35 CV; total column volume Vt ≈ CV.
detailedSteps.zh: 恒流运行 1.2 CV。收集 0.5 mL（分析型）或 1–2 mL（制备型）组分。监测 A280（蛋白）和 A260（核酸污染）。空体积 V₀ ≈ 0.35 CV；总柱体积 Vt ≈ CV。

detailedSteps.en: Pool symmetric, non-tailing peak fractions. Asymmetric tailing indicates aggregation or multiple species — pool only the main symmetric peak. Verify composition and purity by SDS-PAGE.
detailedSteps.zh: 合并对称、无拖尾的峰组分。不对称拖尾表明有聚集体或多组分——仅合并主对称峰。SDS-PAGE 验证组成和纯度。

detailedSteps.en: Optional: run MW calibration standards (GE LMW/HMW kit) on first use of new column. Plot log(MW) vs Kav = (Ve−V₀)/(Vt−V₀). Couple with SEC-MALS for absolute molecular weight determination.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选：新柱首次使用时跑 MW 校准标准品（GE LMW/HMW 套装）。绘制 log(MW) vs Kav = (Ve−V₀)/(Vt−V₀)。联用 SEC-MALS 测定绝对分子量。

detailedSteps.en: Clean column with 1 CV 2 M NaCl at reduced flow rate, then re-equilibrate with 1.5 CV running buffer. Store column in 20% ethanol at 4°C. Never allow column to run dry.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 1 CV 2 M NaCl 低流速清洗柱子，再用 1.5 CV 运行缓冲液重新平衡。柱子储存于 4°C 的 20% 乙醇中。切勿让柱子跑干。

name: Soft Agar Colony Formation

components.name: 4. Stain with crystal violet or MTT

notes.en: Gold standard for anchorage-independent growth. Noble agar at exactly 42°C. Colony >50 µm scored.
notes.zh: 锚定非依赖性生长金标准。Noble 琼脂精确 42°C。克隆 >50 µm 计数。

ref: Borowicz et al. (2014) J Vis Exp 92:e51998

usage.en: Assess anchorage-independent growth as a hallmark of transformation using soft agar colony formation assay.
usage.zh: 软琼脂克隆形成实验评估细胞的锚定非依赖性生长（转化标志）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–4 weeks，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Difco-grade, autoclave before use
note.zh: Difco 级，使用前高压灭菌

note.en: 2× DMEM/RPMI + 20% FBS + 2× Pen/Strep
note.zh: 2× DMEM/RPMI + 20% FBS + 2× 青链霉素

note.en: Tissue culture treated
note.zh: 组织培养处理

note.en: To ensure single-cell suspension
note.zh: 确保单细胞悬液

note.en: For maintaining molten agar
note.zh: 保持琼脂融化状态

note.en: Cells embedded in soft agar can be maintained at 37°C for 2–4 weeks with regular medium overlays; this is the normal incubation period
note.zh: 细胞嵌入软琼脂后可在 37°C 维持 2–4 周，定期覆盖培养基；这是正常的孵育期

briefSteps.en: Prepare 0.5% base agar layer in medium → solidify at RT → prepare 0.35% top agar mixed with 5,000–10,000 cells/well → pour over base layer → solidify → culture 2–4 weeks at 37°C with weekly medium overlay → stain with crystal violet or MTT → count colonies >50 µm
briefSteps.zh: 配制 0.5% 底层琼脂（含培养基）→ 室温凝固 → 配制含 5,000–10,000 细胞/孔的 0.35% 顶层琼脂 → 铺于底层上 → 凝固 → 37°C 培养 2–4 周（每周覆盖培养基）→ 结晶紫或 MTT 染色 → 计数 >50 µm 的克隆

detailedSteps.en: Preparation Day
detailedSteps.zh: 准备日

detailedSteps.en: Autoclave Noble agar at 1% and 0.7% stock solutions in water; keep molten at 42°C in a water bath; also warm complete medium to 42°C. Work quickly — agar solidifies below 38°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 高压灭菌制备 1% 和 0.7% Noble 琼脂储液（水溶液）；置于 42°C 水浴中保温待用；同时将完全培养基预热至 42°C。动作要快——琼脂在 38°C 以下即凝固。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare base layer: mix equal volumes of 1% agar stock and 2× complete medium to yield 0.5% agar in 1× medium; add 2 mL per well of a 6-well plate; allow to solidify at room temperature for 20–30 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备底层：等量混合 1% 琼脂储液和 2× 完全培养基，得到含 1× 培养基的 0.5% 琼脂液；每孔加 2 mL（6 孔板）；室温凝固 20–30 min。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare single-cell suspension at 1–2×10⁴ cells/mL in complete medium (warmed to 37°C); verify single cells under microscope — clumps will form false large colonies.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 37°C 完全培养基制备 1–2×10⁴ 细胞/mL 的单细胞悬液；镜下验证为单细胞——团块会形成假大克隆。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare top layer: mix 0.7% molten agar (42°C) with an equal volume of 2× complete medium containing cells (yielding 0.35% agar with 5,000–10,000 cells/well); mix quickly and add 1.5 mL per well on top of solidified base layer.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备顶层：将 0.7% 融化琼脂（42°C）与等量含细胞的 2× 完全培养基混合（得到 0.35% 琼脂，每孔含 5,000–10,000 细胞）；迅速混匀，每孔加 1.5 mL 铺于已凝固底层上。

detailedSteps.en: Allow top agar to solidify at room temperature for 20–30 min, then transfer to 37°C, 5% CO₂ incubator.
detailedSteps.zh: 顶层琼脂室温凝固 20–30 min，然后转入 37°C、5% CO₂ 培养箱。

detailedSteps.en: Colony Growth (Weeks 2–4)
detailedSteps.zh: 克隆生长（第 2–4 周）

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.5 mL complete medium overlay per well twice per week (do not disturb agar); replace medium overlay weekly; monitor colony formation from week 2 onward.
detailedSteps.zh: 每周两次每孔覆盖 0.5 mL 完全培养基（不要扰动琼脂）；每周更换培养基覆盖层；从第 2 周起监测克隆形成。

detailedSteps.en: Staining and Counting
detailedSteps.zh: 染色与计数

detailedSteps.en: When colonies reach ≥50 µm (typically 2–4 weeks), stain with 0.5 mL 0.005% crystal violet in PBS or add 500 µL MTT (1 mg/mL in PBS) per well; incubate overnight at 37°C for MTT staining (formazan turns colonies visible purple).
detailedSteps.zh: 克隆达到 ≥50 µm 时（通常 2–4 周），每孔加 0.5 mL 0.005% 结晶紫（PBS）染色；或每孔加 500 µL MTT（PBS 中 1 mg/mL），37°C 过夜孵育（甲臜使克隆变为可见紫色）。

detailedSteps.en: Count colonies ≥50 µm per well using a microscope or colony counter (ImageJ with particle analysis); express results as number of colonies per well normalized to control.
detailedSteps.zh: 用显微镜或克隆计数仪（ImageJ 颗粒分析）计数每孔 ≥50 µm 的克隆；结果以每孔克隆数归一化至对照组表示。

name: Southern Blot

components.name: 1. Digest 10 µg gDNA with restriction enzyme O/N
4. Capillary transfer to nylon membrane O/N

notes.en: Classic DNA detection. Named after Edwin Southern. Church buffer for hybridization. Use DIG-labeled probes for non-radioactive.
notes.zh: 经典 DNA 检测方法。以 Edwin Southern 命名。Church 缓冲液杂交。非放射性可用 DIG 标记探针。

ref: Southern (1975) J Mol Biol 98:503

usage.en: Detect specific genomic DNA sequences by restriction digestion, gel separation, transfer, and hybridization.
usage.zh: Southern blot：限制性酶切、胶分离、转膜、杂交检测特定基因组 DNA 序列。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3 days，实操: 8 hours

note.en: Intact, high MW
note.zh: 完整高分子量

note.en: High-fidelity preferred
note.zh: 优选高保真酶

note.en: TAE buffer, wide comb
note.zh: TAE缓冲液，宽齿梳

note.en: Positively charged nylon
note.zh: 带正电尼龙膜

note.en: 0.5 M Na₂HPO₄ pH 7.2, 7% SDS, 1 mM EDTA
note.zh: 0.5 M Na₂HPO₄ pH 7.2, 7% SDS, 1 mM EDTA

note.en: e.g. DECAprime II, Megaprime
note.zh: 如 DECAprime II、Megaprime

note.en: For probe labeling
note.zh: 用于探针标记

note.en: For radioactive detection
note.zh: 用于放射性检测

note.en: 0.5 M NaOH, 1.5 M NaCl
note.zh: 0.5 M NaOH, 1.5 M NaCl

note.en: 0.5 M Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1.5 M NaCl
note.zh: 0.5 M Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1.5 M NaCl

note.en: Digestion can run overnight at 37°C
note.zh: 酶切可37°C过夜

note.en: Transfer runs overnight (12–18 h)
note.zh: 转膜过夜（12–18 h）

note.en: UV-crosslinked membrane can be stored dry at RT or −20°C for months
note.zh: UV交联膜可室温或 −20°C 干燥保存数月

note.en: Hybridization runs overnight at 65°C
note.zh: 杂交65°C过夜

briefSteps.en: Digest 10 µg gDNA with restriction enzyme overnight → separate on 0.8% agarose gel → depurinate (0.25 M HCl), denature (0.5 M NaOH/1.5 M NaCl), and neutralize gel → capillary transfer to nylon membrane overnight in 20× SSC → UV crosslink → pre-hybridize (Church buffer, 65°C, 1 h) → hybridize with labeled probe overnight at 65°C → wash → detect by phosphorimager or chemiluminescence
briefSteps.zh: 10 µg gDNA 限制性酶切（过夜）→ 0.8% 琼脂糖凝胶分离 → 依次去嘌呤（0.25 M HCl）、变性（0.5 M NaOH/1.5 M NaCl）、中和凝胶 → 20× SSC 毛细虹吸转膜至尼龙膜（过夜）→ UV 交联 → Church 缓冲液 65°C 预杂交 1 h → 标记探针 65°C 杂交过夜 → 洗涤 → 磷光成像或化学发光检测

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Restriction Digest and Gel Electrophoresis
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：限制性酶切与凝胶电泳

detailedSteps.en: Digest 10 µg genomic DNA with 20–50 U appropriate restriction enzyme(s) in a total volume of 50–100 µL overnight at 37°C (or enzyme-appropriate temperature). Include uncut DNA as molecular weight reference.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 10 µg 基因组 DNA 用 20–50 U 限制性内切酶在 50–100 µL 反应体系中 37°C（或酶适合温度）酶切过夜。保留未酶切 DNA 作为分子量参考。

detailedSteps.en: Run digested DNA on a 0.8% agarose gel in 1× TAE at 30–40 V overnight (or 3–4 h at 60 V) for good separation of large fragments (1–15 kb). Stain with ethidium bromide (0.5 µg/mL, 30 min) and photograph under UV.
detailedSteps.zh: 将酶切 DNA 在 0.8% 琼脂糖凝胶（1× TAE）中以 30–40 V 电泳过夜（或 60 V 电泳 3–4 h），以实现大片段（1–15 kb）的良好分离。溴化乙锭染色（0.5 µg/mL，30 min），紫外照相记录。

detailedSteps.en: Depurinate the gel in 0.25 M HCl for 10–15 min at RT with gentle agitation until bromophenol blue turns yellow. This nicks large DNA fragments for efficient transfer.
detailedSteps.zh: 将凝胶在 0.25 M HCl 中室温轻摇去嘌呤 10–15 min，直至溴酚蓝变黄。此步骤切割大片段 DNA，提高转移效率。

detailedSteps.en: Rinse gel briefly with dH₂O; denature in denaturation solution (0.5 M NaOH, 1.5 M NaCl) for 2× 15 min at RT with agitation. Rinse with dH₂O.
detailedSteps.zh: 清水短暂漂洗凝胶；在变性液（0.5 M NaOH、1.5 M NaCl）中室温轻摇变性 2 次，每次 15 min。清水漂洗。

detailedSteps.en: Neutralize gel in neutralization solution (0.5 M Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1.5 M NaCl) for 2× 15 min at RT with agitation. Rinse with 2× SSC.
detailedSteps.zh: 在中和液（0.5 M Tris-HCl pH 7.5、1.5 M NaCl）中室温轻摇中和 2 次，每次 15 min。2× SSC 漂洗。

detailedSteps.en: Assemble upward capillary transfer: glass plate over buffer trough → paper wick in 20× SSC → gel (wells facing down) → positively-charged nylon membrane → 3 layers Whatman 3MM → paper towels → weight (~200 g). Transfer overnight (16 h) in 20× SSC.
detailedSteps.zh: 组装向上毛细虹吸转移：玻璃板架于缓冲液槽上 → 滤纸桥（浸 20× SSC）→ 凝胶（孔朝下）→ 带正电尼龙膜 → 3 层 Whatman 3MM 滤纸 → 纸巾 → 重物（~200 g）。20× SSC 中转移过夜（16 h）。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Hybridization and Detection
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天：杂交与检测

detailedSteps.en: Disassemble transfer, mark DNA side of membrane with pencil. UV-crosslink at 120 mJ/cm² (Stratalinker auto-crosslink) or bake at 80°C for 2 h in vacuum oven. Photograph membrane if needed to verify transfer efficiency.
detailedSteps.zh: 拆解转移装置，铅笔标记膜的 DNA 面。Stratalinker 120 mJ/cm² UV 交联（自动程序）或 80°C 真空干燥箱烘烤 2 h。必要时对膜拍照验证转移效率。

detailedSteps.en: Pre-hybridize membrane in Church buffer (0.5 M sodium phosphate pH 7.2, 7% SDS, 1 mM EDTA, 100 µg/mL salmon sperm DNA) for 1 h at 65°C in hybridization oven with rotation.
detailedSteps.zh: 将膜在 Church 缓冲液（0.5 M 磷酸钠 pH 7.2、7% SDS、1 mM EDTA、100 µg/mL 鲑鱼精 DNA）中 65°C 预杂交 1 h（杂交炉旋转）。

detailedSteps.en: Denature labeled probe (boil 5 min, chill on ice). Add probe to hybridization bottle (DIG probe: 25 ng/mL; ³²P probe: 1–2 × 10⁶ cpm/mL). Hybridize overnight at 65°C (DNA:DNA probe) with rotation.
detailedSteps.zh: 变性标记探针（煮沸 5 min，冰上骤冷）。将探针加入杂交管（DIG：25 ng/mL；³²P：1–2 × 10⁶ cpm/mL），65°C 过夜旋转杂交（DNA:DNA 探针）。

detailedSteps.en: Wash membrane: 2× in 2× SSC / 0.1% SDS for 5 min at RT; 2× in 0.1× SSC / 0.1% SDS for 15 min at 65°C. Check radioactivity with Geiger counter if using ³²P (background should approach ~2× ambient).
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤：2× SSC / 0.1% SDS 室温洗 2 次，每次 5 min；0.1× SSC / 0.1% SDS 65°C 洗 2 次，每次 15 min。使用 ³²P 时用盖革计数器检测背景（应接近本底 ~2×）。

detailedSteps.en: Detect signal: ³²P — wrap membrane in plastic wrap, expose phosphorimager screen 1–24 h or X-ray film at −80°C overnight. DIG — perform anti-DIG-AP immunodetection with CDP-Star chemiluminescent substrate per manufacturer protocol; expose to film or digital imager.
detailedSteps.zh: 信号检测：³²P——保鲜膜包裹，磷光成像板曝光 1–24 h 或 X 光胶片 −80°C 过夜显影。DIG——按说明书进行抗 DIG-AP 抗体检测，CDP-Star 底物化学发光，胶片或数字成像仪记录。

name: Stable Cell Line Generation (Antibiotic Selection + Single Clone Isolation)
nameCn: 稳定细胞系建立（抗生素筛选 + 单克隆分离）

components.name: 1. Establish kill curve for parental cells (before transfection/transduction)

note.en: Seed 2×10⁵ cells/well in 6-well plate. Next day, add antibiotic at 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 µg/mL (Puro) or 0, 100, 200, 400, 800 µg/mL (G418). Check daily × 7 days. Optimal = lowest dose achieving 100% kill by day 3–5 (Puro) or day 7–10 (G418).
note.zh: 6 孔板每孔接种 2×10⁵ 细胞。次日加抗生素梯度：Puromycin 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 µg/mL 或 G418 0, 100, 200, 400, 800 µg/mL。每日观察 × 7 天。最佳浓度 = 第 3–5 天（Puro）或第 7–10 天（G418）实现 100% 杀灭的最低浓度。

components.name: 2. Transfect or transduce cells with expression construct

note.en: Plasmid: cell_transfection (Lipofectamine/PEI). Lentivirus: lentivirus_production (MOI 0.3–1 for single integration). Wait 48 h before adding selection.
note.zh: 质粒：cell_transfection（Lipofectamine/PEI）。慢病毒：lentivirus_production（MOI 0.3–1 确保单拷贝整合）。48 h 后开始加筛选药物。

components.name: 3. Begin selection: add antibiotic at kill-curve concentration; change medium every 2–3 days

note.en: Puromycin: typical 1–2 µg/mL; kills in 24–48 h (fast-acting). G418 (Geneticin): typical 200–800 µg/mL; kills in 5–7 days. Hygromycin: 100–400 µg/mL; 3–5 days. Blasticidin: 2–10 µg/mL; 3–5 days. Remove dead cells by medium change.
note.zh: Puromycin：通常 1–2 µg/mL；24–48 h 杀灭（快速）。G418：200–800 µg/mL；5–7 天杀灭。Hygromycin：100–400 µg/mL；3–5 天。Blasticidin：2–10 µg/mL；3–5 天。换液去除死细胞。

components.name: 4. Maintain selection 7–14 days until resistant colonies appear

note.en: Colonies visible by eye at ~100+ cells. Avoid disturbing plates. If too many colonies → high starting MOI; if none → kill curve, DNA quality, or transfection efficiency.
note.zh: 菌落生长至 ~100+ 细胞时肉眼可见。避免移动培养皿。过多 → 初始 MOI 过高；无菌落 → 检查杀灭曲线、DNA 质量、转染效率。

components.name: 5. Pick single clones (Method A: cloning ring)

note.en: Wash plate with PBS. Place autoclaved glass cloning ring (8 mm dia.) over isolated colony; seal with sterile silicone grease. Add 50 µL trypsin inside ring, 3–5 min 37°C. Transfer dissociated cells to 24-well plate well (500 µL complete medium).
note.zh: PBS 洗板。灭菌玻璃克隆环（8 mm）对准单个克隆放置，无菌硅脂密封。环内加 50 µL 胰酶，37°C 3–5 min。转移解离细胞到 24 孔板（500 µL 完全培养基）。

note.en: Trypsinize mixed population, count, dilute to 0.5 cells/well in 96-well plate (200 µL/well). Seed multiple plates (200+ wells needed for ~50 clones). Mark wells with single cell by microscopy next day. Expand single-cell wells over 2–3 weeks.
note.zh: 胰酶消化混合细胞，计数，稀释至 0.5 个细胞/孔接种 96 孔板（200 µL/孔）。铺多板（200+ 孔获得 ~50 个克隆）。次日显微镜标记单细胞孔。2–3 周扩增。

note.en: Sort single cells directly into 96-well plate (complete medium + 20% FBS conditioned medium). GFP+ gating if reporter available. Pre-coat wells with poly-D-lysine for poorly adherent cells. ~30–50% survival for most cell lines.
note.zh: 流式分选单细胞直接入 96 孔板（完全培养基 + 20% FBS 条件培养基）。有 GFP 报告基因可门控。弱贴壁细胞预包被多聚赖氨酸。大多数细胞系存活率约 30–50%。

components.name: 8. Expand clones: 96-well → 24-well → 6-well → T25; maintain selection throughout

note.en: Passage when 80–90% confluent. Each expansion takes 3–7 days. Keep selection antibiotic at maintenance dose (half kill dose). Freeze early passage aliquots.
note.zh: 80–90% 汇合时传代。每次扩增 3–7 天。维持剂量（杀灭浓度的一半）持续加药。早期传代冻存分装。

components.name: 9. Validate clones: WB, qPCR, genomic PCR, functional assay

note.en: WB: target protein expression (wb_protocol). qPCR: mRNA level (qpcr_protocol). Genomic PCR: integration site/copy number. Functional: phenotypic assay. Screen ≥10 clones; select 2–3 best.
note.zh: WB：目标蛋白表达（wb_protocol）。qPCR：mRNA 水平（qpcr_protocol）。基因组 PCR：整合位点/拷贝数。功能验证：表型分析。筛 ≥10 个克隆，选最优 2–3 个。

notes.en: Timeline: transfection → selection (2 weeks) → clone picking (1 day) → expansion (3–4 weeks) → validation (1 week) = ~6–8 weeks total. Always freeze early-passage validated clones at P2–P3. Compare ≥2 independent clones to rule out clonal variation. For CRISPR knockouts: validate by WB + Sanger sequencing of target region.
notes.zh: 时间线：转染→筛选（2 周）→挑克隆（1 天）→扩增（3–4 周）→验证（1 周）= 共 ~6–8 周。验证后在 P2–P3 冻存。至少比较 ≥2 个独立克隆排除克隆变异。CRISPR 基因敲除：WB + 靶区域 Sanger 测序双重验证。

ref: Freshney (2016) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th ed., Ch. 13; Kim (2020) Nat Protoc 15:3199–3230

usage.en: Generate stable cell lines by antibiotic selection after transfection or transduction.
usage.zh: 转染或转导后通过抗生素筛选建立稳定细胞系。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 6–8 weeks，实操: 4 hours total

note.en: Cells can be maintained under antibiotic selection at 37°C for 1–3 weeks — change medium every 2–3 days
note.zh: 细胞可在 37°C 抗生素筛选下维持 1–3 周——每 2–3 天换液

note.en: Validated clones frozen at P2–P3 in LN₂ can be stored indefinitely
note.zh: P2–P3 验证克隆冻存于液氮中可无限期保存

note.en: Expanded clones at any passage can be frozen as backup stocks
note.zh: 任何传代的扩增克隆都可冻存作为备份

briefSteps.en: Kill curve (1 week) → Transfect/transduce cells → 48 h expression → Add antibiotic, select 7–14 d → Pick single clones (ring/limiting dilution/FACS) → Expand 96→24→6-well → Maintain selection → Freeze P2–P3 → Validate by WB/qPCR/functional assay
briefSteps.zh: 杀灭曲线（1 周）→ 转染/转导细胞 → 48 h 表达 → 加抗生素筛选 7–14 天 → 挑单克隆（环/有限稀释/FACS）→ 扩增 96→24→6 孔 → 维持筛选 → P2–P3 冻存 → WB/qPCR/功能验证

detailedSteps.en: **Week 1 — Kill curve establishment**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一周 — 杀灭曲线建立**

detailedSteps.en: Seed parental cells (not transfected) at 2×10⁵ cells/well in a 6-well plate (2 mL/well complete medium). Incubate overnight at 37°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 亲本细胞（未转染）按 2×10⁵/孔接种 6 孔板（2 mL/孔完全培养基）。37°C 过夜孵育。

detailedSteps.en: Next day, add antibiotics at serial dilutions: for Puromycin: 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 µg/mL; for G418: 0, 100, 200, 400, 800 µg/mL. Return to incubator.
detailedSteps.zh: 次日加梯度抗生素：Puromycin：0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 µg/mL；G418：0, 100, 200, 400, 800 µg/mL。放回培养箱。

detailedSteps.en: Check cells daily for 7 days. Record % cell death at each concentration. The optimal antibiotic concentration = lowest dose that kills 100% of cells by day 3–5 (Puromycin) or day 7–10 (G418).
detailedSteps.zh: 每日检查 7 天。记录每个浓度下的细胞死亡百分比。最佳抗生素浓度 = 第 3–5 天（Puro）或第 7–10 天（G418）100% 杀灭的最低浓度。

detailedSteps.en: **Week 1–2 — Transfection/Transduction**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一至二周 — 转染/转导**

detailedSteps.en: Transfect cells with plasmid DNA (cell_transfection protocol) or transduce with lentivirus (lentivirus_production) at MOI 0.3–1 for single integration. Return to incubator.
detailedSteps.zh: 质粒 DNA 转染（cell_transfection 方案）或慢病毒转导（lentivirus_production），MOI 0.3–1 以确保单拷贝整合。放回培养箱。

detailedSteps.en: Wait 48 h after transfection/transduction for expression before starting antibiotic selection.
detailedSteps.zh: 转染/转导后等待 48 h 表达，再开始抗生素筛选。

detailedSteps.en: **Week 2–3 — Selection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二至三周 — 筛选**

detailedSteps.en: Add antibiotic at the kill-curve concentration to the culture. Change medium + antibiotic every 2–3 days. Dead cells will round up and detach.
detailedSteps.zh: 按杀灭曲线浓度向培养物加抗生素。每 2–3 天换液加药。死细胞变圆脱落。

detailedSteps.en: Continue selection for 7–14 days until resistant colonies appear (~100+ cells, visible by eye). Do not disturb plates during this period.
detailedSteps.zh: 持续筛选 7–14 天直到抗性菌落出现（约 100+ 细胞，肉眼可见）。此期间勿移动培养皿。

detailedSteps.en: **Single clone isolation (choose one method)**
detailedSteps.zh: **单克隆分离（选一种方法）**

detailedSteps.en: Method A (Cloning ring): Wash plate with PBS. Place autoclaved glass cloning ring (8 mm) over an isolated colony. Seal with sterile silicone grease. Add 50 µL trypsin inside ring, 3–5 min at 37°C. Transfer dissociated cells to one well of a 24-well plate with 500 µL complete medium + antibiotic.
detailedSteps.zh: 方法 A（克隆环）：PBS 洗板。灭菌玻璃克隆环（8 mm）对准单个克隆放置。无菌硅脂密封。环内加 50 µL 胰酶，37°C 3–5 min。转移解离细胞到 24 孔板（500 µL 完全培养基 + 抗生素）。

detailedSteps.en: Method B (Limiting dilution): Trypsinize entire population, count cells. Dilute to 0.5 cells/200 µL/well in 96-well plate. Seed multiple plates (200+ wells needed to obtain ~50 clones). Check next day under microscope; mark wells with exactly one cell. Expand over 2–3 weeks.
detailedSteps.zh: 方法 B（有限稀释）：胰酶消化全部细胞，计数。稀释至 0.5 个细胞/200 µL/孔，接种 96 孔板。铺多板（200+ 孔以获得约 50 个克隆）。次日显微镜检查；标记仅有一个细胞的孔。2–3 周扩增。

detailedSteps.en: Method C (FACS sorting): Trypsinize, resuspend in complete medium + 20% FBS conditioned medium. Sort single cells directly into 96-well plates using FACS. Pre-coat plates with poly-D-lysine for poorly adherent cells. Return to incubator.
detailedSteps.zh: 方法 C（FACS 分选）：胰酶消化，完全培养基 + 20% FBS 条件培养基重悬。流式细胞仪分选单细胞入 96 孔板。弱贴壁细胞预先包被多聚赖氨酸。放回培养箱。

detailedSteps.en: **Clone expansion & validation**
detailedSteps.zh: **克隆扩增与验证**

detailedSteps.en: Expand clones stepwise: 24-well → 12-well → 6-well → T25 flask. Passage when 80–90% confluent. Maintain antibiotic selection at maintenance dose (½ kill-curve concentration) throughout expansion.
detailedSteps.zh: 逐步扩增克隆：24 孔 → 12 孔 → 6 孔 → T25 瓶。80–90% 汇合时传代。全程维持抗生素（杀灭浓度的 ½）筛选。

detailedSteps.en: Freeze early-passage clones (P2–P3): trypsinize, count, resuspend at 1–5×10⁶ cells/mL in 90% FBS + 10% DMSO. Slow-freeze at −80°C in Mr. Frosty, transfer to LN₂.
detailedSteps.zh: 早期传代克隆（P2–P3）冻存：胰酶消化，计数，90% FBS + 10% DMSO 重悬至 1–5×10⁶/mL。Mr. Frosty −80°C 慢速降温，转液氮。

detailedSteps.en: Validate by WB: check target protein expression (wb_protocol). By qPCR: check mRNA level (qpcr_protocol). Genomic PCR: confirm integration. Functional assay: verify phenotype. Screen ≥10 clones; select 2–3 best for further use.
detailedSteps.zh: WB 验证：检查目标蛋白表达（wb_protocol）。qPCR：检查 mRNA 水平（qpcr_protocol）。基因组 PCR：确认整合。功能验证：表型分析。筛选 ≥10 个克隆；选最优 2–3 个进一步使用。

name: Standard PCR Amplification

note.en: Contains Taq, dNTPs, MgCl₂, buffer
note.zh: 含 Taq, dNTPs, MgCl₂, buffer

note.en: Final concentration 0.2 µM
note.zh: 终浓度 0.2 µM

note.en: Final concentration 0.2 µM
note.zh: 终浓度 0.2 µM

note.en: 1–100 ng gDNA; 1–10 ng plasmid
note.zh: 基因组 DNA 1–100 ng；质粒 1–10 ng

note.en: Bring total volume to 50 µL
note.zh: 至 50 µL 总体积

components.name: 1. 冰上配制反应体系 (做 master mix)

note.en: Take 5 µL + loading dye; run on 1–2% agarose gel
note.zh: 取 5 µL + loading dye, 1–2% 琼脂糖凝胶

notes.en: Use Q5/Phusion for high-fidelity PCR (proofreading, 100× lower error rate). Tm calculator: NEB Tm Calculator (tmcalculator.neb.com). NTC (no template control) required. Multiple bands: reduce primer concentration, raise annealing temp, reduce cycles. Smear: optimize Mg²⁺. No product: lower annealing temp, increase template, check primer orientation. GC-rich templates: add 3-5% DMSO or GC enhancer.
notes.zh: 高保真 PCR 用 Q5/Phusion（校对功能, 错误率低 100×）。Tm 计算：NEB Tm Calculator (tmcalculator.neb.com)。无模板对照 (NTC) 必须。多条带：降低引物浓度、提高退火温度、减少循环数。涂片：优化 Mg²⁺ 浓度。无产物：降低退火温度、增加模板量、检查引物方向。GC-rich 模板加 3–5% DMSO 或用 GC enhancer。

ref: Saiki et al. (1988) Science 239:487; NEB PCR Protocol (neb.com)

usage.en: Amplify specific DNA sequences using standard polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
usage.zh: 标准聚合酶链反应（PCR）扩增特定 DNA 序列。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours，实操: 30 minutes

note.en: Contains Taq, dNTPs, MgCl₂, buffer
note.zh: 含 Taq、dNTPs、MgCl₂、缓冲液

note.en: Desalted or HPLC-purified
note.zh: 脱盐或HPLC纯化

note.en: Desalted or HPLC-purified
note.zh: 脱盐或HPLC纯化

note.en: 1–100 ng genomic or 0.1–1 ng plasmid
note.zh: 基因组DNA 1–100 ng 或质粒 0.1–1 ng

note.en: For reaction setup
note.zh: 用于配反应体系

note.en: 1–2%, in TAE buffer
note.zh: 1–2%，TAE缓冲液

note.en: 100 bp or 1 kb, as appropriate
note.zh: 100 bp 或 1 kb，视需要选择

note.en: PCR product can be stored at 4°C overnight or at −20°C for up to 1 week before gel analysis.
note.zh: PCR 产物可在 4°C 保存过夜，或在 −20°C 保存最多 1 周，再进行凝胶分析。

briefSteps.en: Assemble reaction on ice (template + primers + master mix + water) → thermocycle (initial denaturation 95°C 3 min, 30–35 cycles of 95°C/Tm-5°C/72°C, final extension 72°C 5 min) → verify by agarose gel.
briefSteps.zh: 冰上配制反应体系（模板+引物+master mix+水）→ 热循环（初始变性 95°C 3 min，30–35 循环 95°C/Tm-5°C/72°C，终延伸 72°C 5 min）→ 琼脂糖凝胶验证。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare reaction master mix on ice: combine 25 µL 2× Taq Master Mix, 1 µL forward primer (10 µM, 0.2 µM final), 1 µL reverse primer (10 µM, 0.2 µM final), and 22 µL nuclease-free water per 50 µL reaction.
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上配制 master mix：每 50 µL 反应加入 25 µL 2× Taq Master Mix、1 µL 正向引物（10 µM，终浓度 0.2 µM）、1 µL 反向引物（10 µM，终浓度 0.2 µM）和 22 µL 无核酸酶水。

detailedSteps.en: Add 1 µL template DNA (1–100 ng genomic DNA or 0.1–10 ng plasmid). Mix gently and briefly centrifuge. Include a no-template control (NTC).
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 1 µL 模板 DNA（基因组 DNA 1–100 ng 或质粒 0.1–10 ng）。轻柔混匀后短暂离心。同时设无模板对照（NTC）。

detailedSteps.en: Run thermocycler program: initial denaturation 95°C for 3 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 运行热循环程序：初始变性 95°C，3 min。

detailedSteps.en: Cycle 30–35 times: denaturation 95°C for 30 s, annealing at Tm−5°C for 30 s, extension at 72°C for 1 min per kb of target.
detailedSteps.zh: 循环 30–35 次：变性 95°C 30 s，退火 Tm−5°C 30 s，延伸 72°C（每 kb 目标片段 1 min）。

detailedSteps.en: Final extension at 72°C for 5 min, then hold at 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 终末延伸 72°C 5 min，然后保持在 4°C。

detailedSteps.en: Mix 5 µL PCR product with 1 µL 6× DNA loading dye. Load onto a 1–2% agarose TAE gel alongside an appropriate DNA ladder.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 5 µL PCR 产物与 1 µL 6× DNA 上样缓冲液混合，与 DNA Ladder 一同上样至 1–2% 琼脂糖 TAE 凝胶。

detailedSteps.en: Run gel at 5–8 V/cm for 30–45 min. Visualize under UV or blue-light transilluminator and photograph. Confirm band at expected size.
detailedSteps.zh: 以 5–8 V/cm 跑胶 30–45 min。在紫外灯或蓝光灯下观察并拍照，确认目的条带大小正确。

name: Subcellular Fractionation (Cytoplasmic / Nuclear / Membrane)
nameCn: 亚细胞分级分离（细胞质 / 细胞核 / 膜组分）

components.name: 1. Wash cells 2× ice-cold PBS; collect by scraping + 500×g 5 min 4°C

note.en: ≥2×10⁷ cells per fractionation. Work on ice throughout.
note.zh: 每次分级 ≥2×10⁷ 细胞。全程冰上操作。

components.name: 2. Resuspend in nuclei_isolation_buffer (0.1% NP-40); pipette 10× gently; ice 10–15 min

note.en: 200 µL per 10⁷ cells. Do NOT vortex. Adjust NP-40 (0.05–0.2%) by cell type.
note.zh: 每 10⁷ 细胞加 200 µL。不要涡旋。按细胞类型调 NP-40（0.05–0.2%）。

note.en: Supernatant = cytoplasmic fraction (keep on ice). Verify nuclei integrity by microscopy (dark/intact in pellet).
note.zh: 上清 = 细胞质组分（冰上保存）。显微镜验证核完整性。

components.name: 4. Wash nuclear pellet: 500 µL PBS, pipette gently, 600×g 5 min 4°C (×2)

note.en: Removes cytoplasmic contamination.
note.zh: 去除细胞质污染。

components.name: 5. Extract nuclei: RIPA or high-salt buffer (400 mM NaCl), rotate 30 min 4°C; brief sonication (3× 5 s, 20%)

note.en: Nuclear extract buffer: 20 mM HEPES pH 7.9, 400 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM DTT, 10% glycerol + protease inhibitors.
note.zh: 核提取缓冲液：20 mM HEPES pH 7.9、400 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA、1 mM DTT、10% 甘油 + 蛋白酶抑制剂。

note.en: Supernatant = nuclear extract. Pellet = insoluble chromatin.
note.zh: 上清 = 核提取物。沉淀 = 不溶性染色质。

components.name: 7. Optional membrane fraction: ultracentrifuge cytoplasmic sup at 100,000×g 1 h 4°C

note.en: Supernatant = soluble cytoplasm. Pellet = total membranes (resuspend in RIPA+1% SDS). Requires ultracentrifuge (SW-41 Ti or equivalent).
note.zh: 上清 = 可溶性细胞质。沉淀 = 总膜组分（RIPA+1% SDS 重悬）。需超速离心机（SW-41 Ti 或同等）。

components.name: 8. Quantify all fractions (Bradford/BCA); verify by WB with fraction markers

note.en: Markers: Cytoplasm → GAPDH/tubulin; Nucleus → Lamin B1/H3; Membrane → Na/K-ATPase/cadherin; Mito → VDAC/HSP60.
note.zh: 标记蛋白：细胞质 → GAPDH/tubulin；细胞核 → Lamin B1/H3；膜 → Na/K-ATPase/cadherin；线粒体 → VDAC/HSP60。

note.en: Add loading buffer + boil for WB. Load equal protein (10–20 µg/lane).
note.zh: 加上样缓冲液煮沸后做 WB。每泳道等量上样（10–20 µg）。

notes.en: QC: WB with compartment markers is mandatory. Cross-contamination = incomplete lysis or wrong centrifugation speed. Hard-to-lyse cells (primary neurons, muscle) may need 0.2–0.5% NP-40. For RNA fractionation: add RNase inhibitor (RNaseOUT) to all buffers.
notes.zh: 质控：必须用标记蛋白 WB 验证。交叉污染 = 裂解不充分或离心不当。难裂解细胞可增加 NP-40 至 0.2–0.5%。RNA 分级需全程加 RNase 抑制剂。

ref: Dignam et al. (1983) Nucleic Acids Res 11:1475; Herrmann et al. (2018) Nat Protoc 13:2548

usage.en: Separate cytoplasmic and nuclear fractions to analyze protein localization by western blot.
usage.zh: 分离细胞质和细胞核组分，WB 分析蛋白质亚细胞定位。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 3 hours

note.en: For cytoplasmic buffer
note.zh: 用于胞浆缓冲液

note.en: For nuclear extraction buffer
note.zh: 用于核提取缓冲液

note.en: Sigma I8896
note.zh: Sigma I8896

note.en: Store -20°C in aliquots
note.zh: 分装-20°C保存

note.en: Add fresh — t½ ~30 min in aqueous solution
note.zh: 新鲜加入——水溶液中半衰期~30分钟

note.en: Roche cOmplete EDTA-free
note.zh: Roche cOmplete 无EDTA

note.en: NEB M0247S (optional, for chromatin fraction)
note.zh: NEB M0247S（可选，用于染色质组分）

note.en: Cytoplasmic fraction can be stored at −80°C while nuclear extraction is done on a separate day.
note.zh: 细胞质组分可 −80°C 保存，核提取可另日进行。

note.en: All fractions (cytoplasmic and nuclear extract) can be stored at −80°C for up to 1 month before western blot analysis.
note.zh: 所有组分（细胞质和核提取物）可 −80°C 保存最多 1 个月后再进行 WB 分析。

briefSteps.en: Wash and pellet cells → lyse with 0.1% NP-40 buffer on ice → pellet nuclei at 600×g → save cytoplasmic supernatant → wash nuclei 2× → extract nuclear proteins with high-salt buffer → optional 100,000×g ultracentrifuge for membrane fraction → quantify all fractions → verify by western blot with compartment markers
briefSteps.zh: 清洗并收集细胞 → 冰上 0.1% NP-40 裂解液裂解 → 600×g 沉淀细胞核 → 保留细胞质上清 → 洗涤细胞核 2 次 → 高盐缓冲液提取核蛋白 → 可选 100,000×g 超速离心获取膜组分 → 定量所有组分 → WB 用区室标志蛋白验证

detailedSteps.en: Wash cells twice with ice-cold PBS. Collect by scraping (adherent cells) or centrifuge at 500×g for 5 min at 4°C (suspension cells). Start with ≥2×10⁷ cells. Work on ice throughout.
detailedSteps.zh: 用冰冷 PBS 洗涤细胞两次。贴壁细胞用细胞刮刀收集，悬浮细胞 500×g、4°C 离心 5 min 收集。起始量 ≥2×10⁷ 细胞。全程冰上操作。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend cell pellet in nuclei isolation buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.9, 10 mM KCl, 0.1 mM EDTA, 0.1% NP-40 + protease inhibitors) at 200 µL per 10⁷ cells. Pipette gently 10 times. Incubate on ice for 10–15 min. Do NOT vortex.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 10⁷ 细胞加 200 µL 核分离缓冲液（10 mM HEPES pH 7.9、10 mM KCl、0.1 mM EDTA、0.1% NP-40 + 蛋白酶抑制剂）重悬。轻柔吹打 10 次。冰上孵育 10–15 min。不要涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: Pellet nuclei by centrifugation at 600×g for 5 min at 4°C. Transfer supernatant to a fresh tube — this is the cytoplasmic fraction. Verify nuclear integrity by microscopy (nuclei appear dark and intact in pellet).
detailedSteps.zh: 600×g、4°C 离心 5 min 沉淀细胞核。将上清转至新管——即细胞质组分。显微镜验证核完整性（沉淀中的细胞核应呈暗色且完整）。

detailedSteps.en: Wash nuclear pellet: gently resuspend in 500 µL ice-cold PBS, pipette carefully, and centrifuge at 600×g for 5 min at 4°C. Repeat wash twice to remove cytoplasmic contamination.
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤核沉淀：轻柔重悬于 500 µL 冰冷 PBS，小心吹打，600×g、4°C 离心 5 min。重复洗涤两次去除细胞质污染。

detailedSteps.en: Extract nuclear proteins: resuspend washed nuclear pellet in high-salt nuclear extraction buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.9, 400 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM DTT, 10% glycerol + protease inhibitors). Rotate at 4°C for 30 min, then briefly sonicate (3 × 5 s pulses, 20% amplitude).
detailedSteps.zh: 提取核蛋白：用高盐核提取缓冲液（20 mM HEPES pH 7.9、400 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA、1 mM DTT、10% 甘油 + 蛋白酶抑制剂）重悬洗涤后的核沉淀。4°C 旋转 30 min，再短暂超声（3 × 5 s，20% 振幅）。

detailedSteps.en: Clarify nuclear extract by centrifugation at 16,000×g for 15 min at 4°C. Collect supernatant (nuclear extract). The pellet is insoluble chromatin and can be discarded or extracted separately with SDS buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 16,000×g、4°C 离心 15 min 澄清核提取物。收集上清（核提取物）。沉淀为不溶性染色质，可丢弃或用 SDS 缓冲液单独提取。

detailedSteps.en: Optional membrane fraction: ultracentrifuge the cytoplasmic supernatant at 100,000×g for 1 h at 4°C (requires SW-41 Ti rotor or equivalent). Resulting supernatant = soluble cytoplasm; pellet = total membrane fraction (resuspend in RIPA + 1% SDS).
detailedSteps.zh: 可选膜组分：将细胞质上清在 100,000×g、4°C 超速离心 1 h（需 SW-41 Ti 转头或同等设备）。上清 = 可溶性细胞质；沉淀 = 总膜组分（用 RIPA + 1% SDS 重悬）。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify all fractions by BCA or Bradford assay. Verify fractionation quality by western blot using compartment markers: GAPDH or tubulin (cytoplasm), Lamin B1 or Histone H3 (nucleus), Na/K-ATPase or E-cadherin (membrane), VDAC or HSP60 (mitochondria).
detailedSteps.zh: BCA 或 Bradford 法定量所有组分。用区室标志蛋白 WB 验证分级质量：GAPDH 或 tubulin（细胞质）、Lamin B1 或 Histone H3（细胞核）、Na/K-ATPase 或 E-cadherin（膜）、VDAC 或 HSP60（线粒体）。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare fractions for western blot: add 2× Laemmli sample buffer, boil at 95°C for 5 min, load 10–20 µg protein per lane. Store remaining fractions at −80°C; use within 3 months.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备 WB 上样：加 2× Laemmli 上样缓冲液，95°C 煮沸 5 min，每泳道上样 10–20 µg 蛋白。剩余组分 −80°C 保存，3 个月内使用。

name: Therapeutic Antibody Dilution for In Vivo Dosing
nameCn: 治疗性抗体稀释（体内给药）

components.name: Step 1: Calculate dilution volume. Given: A mg total at B mg/mL stock (volume C = A/B mL). Target: B' mg/mL. Need X mL D-PBS where A = B' × (C + X), so X = (A/B') - C.

note.en: Example: 50 mg at 2.15 mg/mL (23.26 mL), target 2.0 mg/mL → X = 1.74 mL PBS.
note.zh: 示例：50 mg, 2.15 mg/mL (23.26 mL), 目标 2.0 mg/mL → X = 1.74 mL PBS。

components.name: Step 2: Add X mL cold D-PBS to stock bottle (or transfer stock to 50 mL tube first if bottle is small). Mix well by gentle inversion.
Step 3: Aliquot 1 mL per microcentrifuge tube. Do not waste any antibody solution.

note.en: Example: 50 mg at 2 mg/mL = 25 mL total → ~25 tubes of 1 mL each.
note.zh: 示例：50 mg, 2 mg/mL = 25 mL → 约 25 管，每管 1 mL。

components.name: Step 4: Label tube caps with critical info (antibody name, concentration, date).
Step 5: Keep original stock label as a record. Store diluted antibody tubes at 4°C.

notes.en: Handle therapeutic antibodies carefully — they are expensive. Use cold sterile D-PBS for dilution. Keep antibodies at 4°C (do NOT freeze unless specified by manufacturer). Common suppliers: BioLegend, BioXcell, Leinco. Always verify stock concentration matches label before diluting.
notes.zh: 治疗性抗体昂贵——小心操作。使用冷的无菌 D-PBS 稀释。4°C 保存（除非厂家另有说明，勿冷冻）。常见供应商：BioLegend、BioXcell、Leinco。稀释前务必核实库存浓度与标签一致。

ref: Weiner LM, Surana R & Wang S (2010) Nat Rev Immunol 10:317–327; NRC (2011) Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals, 8th ed., National Academies Press

usage.en: Protocol for diluting therapeutic antibodies (e.g. anti-PD-1, anti-CTLA-4) from stock concentration to desired in vivo dosing concentration using sterile D-PBS.
usage.zh: 将治疗性抗体（如 anti-PD-1、anti-CTLA-4）从库存浓度稀释至所需体内给药浓度的操作方案。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 30 min，实操: 30 min

materials.name: 50 mL conical tube (if needed for transfer)

note.en: Diluted antibody aliquots can be stored at 4°C for weeks (per manufacturer's recommendation; do NOT freeze unless specified)
note.zh: 稀释后的抗体分装管可 4°C 保存数周（按厂家建议；除非特别说明否则勿冷冻）

briefSteps.en: Verify stock concentration → calculate PBS volume (X = A/B' − C) → add cold D-PBS, mix gently → aliquot 1 mL/tube → label → store 4°C
briefSteps.zh: 核实库存浓度 → 计算 PBS 体积（X = A/B' − C）→ 加冷 D-PBS 轻柔混匀 → 分装 1 mL/管 → 标记 → 4°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Dilution Calculation & Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **稀释计算与配制**

detailedSteps.en: Verify stock antibody concentration matches the label (e.g., by Nanodrop A₂₈₀ if needed). Record: total mass (A mg), stock concentration (B mg/mL), stock volume (C = A/B mL), target concentration (B' mg/mL)
detailedSteps.zh: 核实抗体库存浓度与标签一致（必要时 Nanodrop A₂₈₀ 确认）。记录：总质量（A mg）、库存浓度（B mg/mL）、库存体积（C = A/B mL）、目标浓度（B' mg/mL）

detailedSteps.en: Calculate D-PBS volume to add: X = (A / B') − C mL. Example: 50 mg at 2.15 mg/mL (23.26 mL stock), target 2.0 mg/mL → X = (50/2.0) − 23.26 = 1.74 mL PBS
detailedSteps.zh: 计算需加入的 D-PBS 体积：X = (A / B') − C mL。示例：50 mg，2.15 mg/mL（23.26 mL 库存），目标 2.0 mg/mL → X = (50/2.0) − 23.26 = 1.74 mL PBS

detailedSteps.en: Add calculated volume of cold sterile D-PBS (cell culture grade) to stock bottle. If bottle is too small, transfer stock to a sterile 50 mL conical tube first. Mix by gentle inversion 10–15 times — do NOT vortex
detailedSteps.zh: 将计算好的冷无菌 D-PBS（细胞培养级）加入库存瓶中。如瓶太小，先将库存转移至无菌 50 mL 锥形管。轻柔倒转混匀 10–15 次 — 勿涡旋

detailedSteps.en: **Aliquoting**
Aliquot 1 mL per labeled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. Do not waste any antibody solution. Example: 50 mg at 2 mg/mL = 25 mL total → ~25 tubes of 1 mL
detailedSteps.zh: 每管分装 1 mL 至已标记的 1.5 mL 离心管。不浪费任何抗体溶液。示例：50 mg，2 mg/mL = 25 mL → 约 25 管，每管 1 mL

detailedSteps.en: Label each tube cap with: antibody name, final concentration (mg/mL), date of dilution. Keep original stock label as a record
detailedSteps.zh: 每管盖标注：抗体名称、终浓度（mg/mL）、稀释日期。保留原始库存标签作为记录

detailedSteps.en: **Storage**

Store all diluted antibody aliquots at 4°C. Do NOT freeze unless manufacturer specifically recommends it. Typical therapeutic antibodies (BioXcell, BioLegend, Leinco) are stable at 4°C for the stated shelf life
detailedSteps.zh: 所有稀释后抗体分装管 4°C 保存。除非厂家特别建议，否则勿冷冻。典型治疗性抗体（BioXcell、BioLegend、Leinco）在 4°C 条件下可保存至标注有效期

name: Transwell Migration Assay

components.name: 2. 下室加含血清培养基，上室加细胞
4. 棉签擦除上表面未迁移细胞
6. 镜下计数 5 个随机视野

notes.en: Quantitative assay for cell migration/invasion using Boyden chamber principle. Cells migrate through 8 µm pores toward chemoattractant (serum). For invasion assay, coat inserts with Matrigel. Count migrated cells on lower surface after crystal violet staining.
notes.zh: 基于 Boyden 小室原理的定量细胞迁移/侵袭实验。细胞通过 8 µm 孔向趋化因子（血清）迁移。侵袭实验需在膜上涂 Matrigel。结晶紫染色后计数下表面迁移细胞。

ref: Justus et al. (2014) J Vis Exp 88:e51046

usage.en: Measure cell migration and invasion using Transwell (Boyden chamber) assay.
usage.zh: Transwell（Boyden 小室）实验检测细胞迁移和侵袭能力。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 days，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Corning #3422 or similar
note.zh: Corning #3422 或类似

note.en: Companion plate
note.zh: 配套培养板

note.en: Upper chamber
note.zh: 上室用

note.en: Lower chamber chemoattractant
note.zh: 下室趋化因子

note.en: For fixation
note.zh: 用于固定

note.en: To remove non-migrated cells
note.zh: 去除未迁移细胞

note.en: Serum starvation (12–24 h) is an overnight stopping point before setting up the assay
note.zh: 血清饥饿（12–24 h）为组装实验前的过夜停顿点

note.en: Migration incubation (16–24 h) is the natural overnight stop; proceed to staining in the morning
note.zh: 迁移孵育（16–24 h）为自然过夜停顿；次日早上进行染色

note.en: Fixed, stained, and air-dried inserts can be stored at room temperature indefinitely before counting
note.zh: 固定、染色并晾干的小室可在室温下无限期保存后再计数

briefSteps.en: Serum-starve cells 12–24 h → add complete medium (10% FBS) to lower chamber → seed 1–5×10⁴ serum-free cells in upper chamber → incubate 16–24 h at 37°C → remove non-migrated cells from upper surface with cotton swab → fix and stain with crystal violet → count migrated cells in 5 random fields
briefSteps.zh: 血清饥饿处理 12–24 h → 下室加完全培养基（10% FBS）→ 上室铺 1–5×10⁴ 细胞（无血清）→ 37°C 孵育 16–24 h → 棉签擦去上表面未迁移细胞 → 固定并结晶紫染色 → 镜下计数 5 个随机视野

detailedSteps.en: Day 0 – Serum Starvation
detailedSteps.zh: 第 0 天 – 血清饥饿

detailedSteps.en: Replace medium with serum-free medium and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 12–24 h to synchronize cells and sensitize them to the chemoattractant gradient.
detailedSteps.zh: 换液至无血清培养基，37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育 12–24 h，使细胞同步化并提高对趋化因子梯度的响应性。

detailedSteps.en: Assay Day – Setup
detailedSteps.zh: 实验日 – 组装

detailedSteps.en: For invasion assay only: coat transwell inserts (8 µm pore) by adding 50–100 µL diluted Matrigel (1:8 in cold serum-free medium) to the upper surface; incubate at 37°C for 1 h to polymerize; remove excess liquid without disturbing the gel.
detailedSteps.zh: 仅侵袭实验：向 Transwell 膜（8 µm 孔）上表面加 50–100 µL 稀释 Matrigel（1:8 冷无血清培养基）；37°C 孵育 1 h 聚合；去除多余液体，不要扰动胶层。

detailedSteps.en: Add 600 µL complete medium (10% FBS, ± chemoattractant such as growth factor or conditioned medium) to each well of a 24-well companion plate (lower chamber).
detailedSteps.zh: 向 24 孔配套板（下室）每孔加 600 µL 完全培养基（10% FBS，± 趋化因子如生长因子或条件培养基）。

detailedSteps.en: Harvest serum-starved cells, resuspend in serum-free medium at 1–5×10⁵ cells/mL; add 100–200 µL (1–5×10⁴ cells) to the upper chamber; include treatments ± compounds in the upper chamber at this point.
detailedSteps.zh: 收集血清饥饿细胞，用无血清培养基重悬至 1–5×10⁵ 细胞/mL；向上室加 100–200 µL（1–5×10⁴ 细胞）；如需处理，在此时向上室加入受试化合物。

detailedSteps.en: Place inserts into the companion wells; incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 16–24 h (optimize per cell line: fast migrators 6–12 h, slow cells 24 h).
detailedSteps.zh: 将小室放入配套孔板；37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育 16–24 h（按细胞系优化：迁移快的细胞 6–12 h，慢细胞 24 h）。

detailedSteps.en: Staining and Counting
detailedSteps.zh: 染色与计数

detailedSteps.en: Remove inserts; gently wipe the upper surface of the membrane with a cotton swab to remove non-migrated cells; rinse insert briefly in PBS.
detailedSteps.zh: 取出小室；用棉签轻柔擦去膜上表面未迁移的细胞；在 PBS 中短暂冲洗小室。

detailedSteps.en: Fix the lower surface of the membrane by immersing insert in 4% PFA or methanol for 10–15 min at room temperature.
detailedSteps.zh: 将小室浸入 4% PFA 或甲醇中，室温固定膜下表面 10–15 min。

detailedSteps.en: Stain with 0.5% crystal violet for 15 min; wash excess stain with water; air-dry.
detailedSteps.zh: 0.5% 结晶紫染色 15 min；水洗去除多余染料；晾干。

detailedSteps.en: Count migrated cells under light microscope in 5 random fields per insert (10× objective); calculate mean cell count per field; normalize to control; for automated quantification, extract crystal violet with 10% acetic acid and read OD at 595 nm.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 10× 物镜下计数每个小室 5 个随机视野中的迁移细胞数；计算每视野平均细胞数并归一化至对照；自动定量时可用 10% 乙酸提取结晶紫，读取 595 nm 吸光值。

name: TRIzol RNA Extraction

note.en: 1 mL per 5–10×10⁶ cells; tissue: 1 mL per 50–100 mg, homogenize
note.zh: 1 mL per 5–10×10⁶ cells; 组织: 1 mL per 50–100 mg, 匀浆器研磨

note.en: Ensure thorough lysis of nucleoprotein complexes
note.zh: 充分裂解核蛋白复合物

components.name: 3. 加 0.2 mL 氯仿 (per 1 mL TRIzol)

note.en: Cap tightly, shake vigorously 15 s, RT 2–3 min
note.zh: 盖紧, 剧烈摇晃 15 s, 室温 2–3 min

note.en: Three phases: upper aqueous (RNA) / interphase (DNA) / lower organic (protein)
note.zh: 分三层: 上层水相 (RNA) / 中间层 (DNA) / 下层有机相 (蛋白)

components.name: 5. 小心吸取上层水相至新管

note.en: Do not disturb the white interphase layer
note.zh: 勿碰中间白色界面层

components.name: 6. 加 0.5 mL 异丙醇 (per 1 mL TRIzol)

note.en: Mix and incubate 10 min at RT
note.zh: 混匀, 室温 10 min

note.en: RNA pellet appears white or translucent gel-like
note.zh: RNA 沉淀为白色/透明胶状颗粒

components.name: 8. 弃上清, 加 1 mL 75% 乙醇洗涤

note.en: Vortex briefly to mix
note.zh: 涡旋短暂混匀

note.en: Do not over-dry (pellet should just turn translucent); over-drying makes it insoluble
note.zh: 勿过度干燥 (沉淀变透明即可), 否则难溶解

components.name: 11. 加 20–50 µL RNase-free H₂O 溶解

note.en: Incubate at 55°C for 10 min to aid dissolution; flick to mix
note.zh: 55°C 孵育 10 min 助溶解; 轻弹混匀

notes.en: All steps use RNase-free consumables. TRIzol is toxic (phenol + guanidinium) — work in fume hood with gloves. Typical yield: 5–15 µg RNA per 10⁶ cells. For small amounts, add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) as carrier before isopropanol step. Store RNA at -80°C. DNase I treatment recommended before RT-qPCR.
notes.zh: 全程使用无 RNase 耗材。TRIzol 含苯酚和异硫氰酸胍，通风橱操作，戴手套。典型产量：每 10⁶ 细胞 5–15 µg RNA。微量样品在异丙醇沉淀前加 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) 做载体。RNA 保存 -80°C。RT-qPCR 前建议 DNase I 处理。

ref: Chomczynski & Sacchi (1987) Anal Biochem 162:156–159; Rio et al. (2010) CSH Protoc doi:10.1101/pdb.prot5439; Thermo Fisher TRIzol Reagent User Guide (Pub. No. MAN0001271)

usage.en: Extract total RNA from cells or tissues using TRIzol (guanidinium thiocyanate-phenol-chloroform) method.
usage.zh: TRIzol 法（异硫氰酸胍-苯酚-氯仿）从细胞或组织中提取总 RNA。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Commercial reagent
note.zh: 商品化试剂

note.en: ACS grade
note.zh: 分析纯

note.en: Molecular biology grade
note.zh: 分子生物学级

note.en: DEPC-H₂O diluted
note.zh: DEPC 水配制

note.en: DEPC-treated or commercial
note.zh: DEPC 处理或商品化

note.en: RNA pellet washed with 75% EtOH can be stored at −70°C for up to 1 week before proceeding to dissolution.
note.zh: 75% 乙醇洗涤后的 RNA 沉淀可在 −70°C 保存最多 1 周，之后再进行溶解步骤。

note.en: Dissolved RNA can be stored at −80°C for up to 12 months. Aliquot to avoid freeze-thaw cycles.
note.zh: 溶解后的 RNA 可在 −80°C 保存最多 12 个月。建议分装以避免反复冻融。

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells in TRIzol → add chloroform → centrifuge → collect aqueous phase → precipitate RNA with isopropanol → wash with 75% EtOH → air dry → dissolve in RNase-free water → quantify by NanoDrop.
briefSteps.zh: TRIzol 裂解细胞 → 加氯仿 → 离心 → 收集水相 → 异丙醇沉淀 RNA → 75% 乙醇洗涤 → 风干 → RNase-free 水溶解 → NanoDrop 定量。

detailedSteps.en: Lysis
detailedSteps.zh: 裂解

detailedSteps.en: Add 1 mL TRIzol per 5–10×10⁶ cells (or per 50–100 mg tissue); homogenize tissue with a rotor-stator homogenizer. Pipette repeatedly to ensure complete lysis.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 5–10×10⁶ 细胞（或每 50–100 mg 组织）加入 1 mL TRIzol；组织使用匀浆器研磨。反复吹打确保充分裂解。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at room temperature for 5 min to allow complete dissociation of nucleoprotein complexes.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 5 min，使核蛋白复合物充分解离。

detailedSteps.en: Phase Separation
detailedSteps.zh: 相分离

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.2 mL chloroform per 1 mL TRIzol. Cap tube tightly and shake vigorously for 15 seconds, then incubate at room temperature for 2–3 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 1 mL TRIzol 加入 0.2 mL 氯仿。拧紧管盖，剧烈振荡 15 秒，室温静置 2–3 min。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 12,000×g for 15 min at 4°C. Three phases form: upper aqueous (RNA), white interphase (DNA/protein), lower red organic phase (protein/lipid).
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C、12,000×g 离心 15 min。形成三层：上层水相（RNA）、白色中间层（DNA/蛋白）、下层红色有机相（蛋白/脂质）。

detailedSteps.en: Carefully transfer only the upper aqueous phase (~60% of TRIzol volume) to a fresh RNase-free tube, avoiding the white interphase.
detailedSteps.zh: 小心吸取上层水相（约为 TRIzol 用量的 60%）至新的无 RNase 管，勿碰白色中间层。

detailedSteps.en: RNA Precipitation
detailedSteps.zh: RNA 沉淀

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.5 mL isopropanol per 1 mL TRIzol used. Mix by inversion 10 times and incubate at room temperature for 10 min. For low-abundance samples, add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) as co-precipitant.
detailedSteps.zh: 每 1 mL TRIzol 加入 0.5 mL 异丙醇，颠倒混匀 10 次，室温静置 10 min。微量样品可加 1 µL glycogen（20 mg/mL）作为共沉淀剂。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 12,000×g for 10 min at 4°C. RNA pellet appears as a white or translucent gel-like pellet at the bottom/side of the tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C、12,000×g 离心 10 min。RNA 沉淀呈白色或半透明胶状颗粒附着于管底或管壁。

detailedSteps.en: Wash
detailedSteps.zh: 洗涤

detailedSteps.en: Discard supernatant completely. Add 1 mL of 75% ethanol (prepared with DEPC-treated water) per 1 mL TRIzol. Vortex briefly to resuspend pellet.
detailedSteps.zh: 彻底弃去上清。每 1 mL TRIzol 加入 1 mL 75% 乙醇（用 DEPC 水配制）。短暂涡旋重悬沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 7,500×g for 5 min at 4°C. Carefully remove all ethanol with a pipette; brief air-dry pellet for 5–10 min at room temperature until it turns translucent (do not over-dry).
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C、7,500×g 离心 5 min。用移液器彻底吸去乙醇；室温风干沉淀 5–10 min 至透明（勿过度干燥）。

detailedSteps.en: Dissolution & QC
detailedSteps.zh: 溶解与质检

detailedSteps.en: Dissolve RNA pellet in 20–50 µL RNase-free water. Incubate at 55°C for 10 min with occasional flicking to aid dissolution.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 RNA 沉淀溶于 20–50 µL 无 RNase 水中。55°C 孵育 10 min，间歇轻弹管底助溶。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify by NanoDrop (A260/280 ≈ 2.0; A260/230 > 1.8) and verify integrity by agarose gel (28S:18S ratio ≈ 2:1). Store at −80°C.

name: Trypan Blue Cell Counting

note.en: 1:1 dilution
note.zh: 1:1 稀释

components.name: 4. 轻柔混匀，室温 1–2 min (勿超 3 min)
5. 加入血球计数板 / 自动计数仪
6. 计数: 活细胞 (透明) vs 死细胞 (蓝色)

notes.en: Cell density = average cells per large square × dilution factor × 10⁴ cells/mL. Viability = live / (live + dead) × 100%. Staining beyond 3 min causes false positives (live cells begin to take up dye). Dilute further if concentration is too high.
notes.zh: 细胞密度 = 平均每大格细胞数 × 稀释倍数 × 10⁴ cells/mL。活率 = 活细胞/(活+死) × 100%。染色时间 >3 min 会导致假阳性 (活细胞也着色)。如浓度过高，进一步稀释后重新计数。

ref: Strober (2015) Curr Protoc Immunol 111:A.3B.1–A.3B.3

usage.en: Assess cell viability and count cells using trypan blue dye exclusion.
usage.zh: 台盼蓝排斥法评估细胞活力和计数。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 15 minutes，实操: 15 minutes

note.en: Commercial solution (Gibco/Sigma)
note.zh: 商品化溶液（Gibco/Sigma）

note.en: + coverslip
note.zh: + 盖玻片

note.en: Optional
note.zh: 可选

note.en: Cell suspension aliquot can be kept at RT briefly before trypan blue staining; do not exceed 30 min
note.zh: 细胞悬液取样后可室温短暂放置再染色；不超过 30 min

briefSteps.en: Collect and mix cell suspension → add equal volume 0.4% trypan blue → mix and incubate 1–2 min → load onto hemocytometer or automated counter → count live (clear) and dead (blue) cells → calculate concentration and viability
briefSteps.zh: 收集混匀细胞悬液 → 等体积 0.4% 台盼蓝混合 → 混匀室温 1–2 min → 加入血球计数板或自动计数仪 → 计数活细胞（透明）和死细胞（蓝色）→ 计算浓度和活率

detailedSteps.en: Collect the cell suspension (from trypsinized culture or existing suspension) and mix thoroughly by gentle pipetting to ensure a homogeneous single-cell suspension.
detailedSteps.zh: 收集细胞悬液（来自胰酶消化或已有的悬浮培养），轻柔吹打充分混匀，确保均匀单细胞悬液。

detailedSteps.en: If cell concentration is expected to be high (>5×10⁶/mL), dilute the suspension in complete medium first; note the additional dilution factor.
detailedSteps.zh: 若细胞浓度估计较高（>5×10⁶/mL），先用完全培养基稀释，记录稀释倍数。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer 10 µL of cell suspension to a microcentrifuge tube; add 10 µL of 0.4% trypan blue solution (1:1 dilution factor = 2).
detailedSteps.zh: 取 10 µL 细胞悬液至微量离心管，加入 10 µL 0.4% 台盼蓝溶液（1:1 混合，稀释因子 = 2）。

detailedSteps.en: Mix gently by pipetting 2–3 times; incubate at room temperature for 1–2 min. Do not exceed 3 min or live cells may begin to take up dye.
detailedSteps.zh: 轻柔吹打 2–3 次混匀，室温孵育 1–2 min，不超过 3 min（否则活细胞也会着色）。

detailedSteps.en: Load 10 µL of the trypan blue–cell mixture onto a hemocytometer (under coverslip) or insert a counting slide into an automated cell counter.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 10 µL 台盼蓝-细胞混合液加入血球计数板（盖玻片下）或插入自动计数仪计数槽。

detailedSteps.en: Under 10× objective, identify live cells (round, bright/clear, intact membrane) and dead cells (blue-stained, often shrunken or irregular).
detailedSteps.zh: 在 10× 物镜下区分活细胞（圆形、亮透明、膜完整）和死细胞（蓝色染色，常皱缩或不规则）。

detailedSteps.en: Count cells in 4 large corner squares of the hemocytometer (or use automated counter readout); aim for 100–200 cells per square for accuracy.
detailedSteps.zh: 计数血球计数板四个角大方格中的细胞（或使用自动计数仪读数），每格理想计数 100–200 个细胞以确保准确性。

detailedSteps.en: Calculate cell concentration: cells/mL = (average cells per large square) × dilution factor × 10⁴.
detailedSteps.zh: 计算细胞浓度：细胞数/mL = 每大格平均细胞数 × 稀释因子 × 10⁴。

detailedSteps.en: Calculate viability: viability (%) = live cells ÷ (live + dead cells) × 100. Record results for your lab notebook.
detailedSteps.zh: 计算活率（%）= 活细胞数 ÷（活 + 死细胞数）× 100，记录结果于实验记录本。

name: Tube Formation (Angiogenesis)

notes.en: Growth factor-reduced Matrigel. HUVECs passage 2-6. Positive: VEGF 50 ng/mL. Score tube length, branch points, meshes.
notes.zh: 用低生长因子 Matrigel。HUVECs 第 2-6 代。阳性对照：VEGF 50 ng/mL。评估管长、分支点、网格。

ref: Arnaoutova & Kleinman (2010) Nat Protoc 5:628

usage.en: Assess angiogenic potential by endothelial cell tube formation on Matrigel.
usage.zh: Matrigel 上内皮细胞管腔形成实验评估血管生成能力。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 6–24 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: Passage 2–6, > 90% viable
Endothelial cell basal medium
note.zh: 内皮细胞基础培养基

note.en: 0.5% for low serum conditions
note.zh: 0.5% 低血清条件

note.en: 10–50 ng/mL as positive control
note.zh: 10–50 ng/mL 作为阳性对照

note.en: Flat-bottom, tissue culture treated
note.zh: 平底，组织培养处理

note.en: 2 µg/mL for live-cell staining
note.zh: 2 µg/mL 活细胞染色

note.en: Matrigel thaws overnight at 4°C (required step)
note.zh: Matrigel 4°C 过夜解冻（必需步骤）

note.en: Polymerized Matrigel-coated plates can be used within 1 h; do not store
note.zh: 聚合后的Matrigel铺板应1 h内使用；勿长期保存

briefSteps.en: Thaw growth factor-reduced Matrigel on ice overnight → coat pre-chilled 96-well plate with 50 µL/well → polymerize 30 min at 37°C → seed 1–2×10⁴ HUVECs (passage 2–6) per well ± treatments → incubate 4–8 h at 37°C → image by phase-contrast → quantify tube length, branch points, and meshes with ImageJ Angiogenesis Analyzer
briefSteps.zh: 冰上过夜融化低生长因子 Matrigel → 每孔 50 µL 包被预冷 96 孔板 → 37°C 聚合 30 min → 每孔铺 1–2×10⁴ HUVECs（2–6 代）± 处理 → 37°C 孵育 4–8 h → 相差显微镜拍照 → ImageJ Angiogenesis Analyzer 定量管长、分支点和网格

detailedSteps.en: Day Before – Matrigel Thawing
detailedSteps.zh: 前一天 – 融化 Matrigel

detailedSteps.en: Thaw growth factor-reduced Matrigel on ice at 4°C overnight (never at room temperature — it polymerizes irreversibly above 10°C); keep all tips, plates, and tubes on ice throughout the procedure.
detailedSteps.zh: 将低生长因子 Matrigel 在冰上 4°C 过夜融化（切勿在室温融化——10°C 以上会不可逆聚合）；操作全程保持枪头、孔板和离心管置于冰上。

detailedSteps.en: Assay Day – Matrigel Coating
detailedSteps.zh: 实验日 – Matrigel 包被

detailedSteps.en: Pre-chill a 96-well plate on ice for 15 min; add 50 µL growth factor-reduced Matrigel per well using pre-chilled tips; avoid bubbles; work quickly to prevent premature gelation.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 96 孔板在冰上预冷 15 min；用预冷枪头每孔加 50 µL 低生长因子 Matrigel；避免气泡；动作要快防止提前凝胶化。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer plate to 37°C incubator and allow Matrigel to polymerize for 30 min; do not disturb plate during polymerization.
detailedSteps.zh: 将孔板转入 37°C 培养箱，孵育 30 min 使 Matrigel 聚合；聚合过程中不要晃动孔板。

detailedSteps.en: Cell Seeding
detailedSteps.zh: 铺板

detailedSteps.en: Harvest HUVECs at passage 2–6 (higher passages show reduced tube-forming capacity); resuspend in serum-free or EBM-2 basal medium at 1–2×10⁵ cells/mL.
detailedSteps.zh: 收集 2–6 代 HUVECs（传代越高管形成能力越弱）；用无血清或 EBM-2 基础培养基重悬至 1–2×10⁵ 细胞/mL。

detailedSteps.en: Seed 100–150 µL (1–2×10⁴ cells) per well on polymerized Matrigel; immediately add treatments (e.g., VEGF 50 ng/mL as positive control, anti-angiogenic agents at desired concentrations); include untreated and vehicle controls.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔铺 100–150 µL（1–2×10⁴ 细胞）于聚合好的 Matrigel 上；立即加入处理（如阳性对照 VEGF 50 ng/mL，或所需浓度的抗血管生成药物）；设未处理和溶剂对照。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂; tube formation typically begins within 2–4 h and reaches maximum complexity at 4–8 h; collapse occurs after 12–24 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 孵育；管形成通常在 2–4 h 内开始，4–8 h 达到最复杂状态；12–24 h 后开始崩塌。

detailedSteps.en: Image at the optimal timepoint (4–8 h) using phase-contrast microscopy (4× or 5× objective); capture 3–5 images per well at random positions.
detailedSteps.zh: 在最佳时间点（4–8 h）用相差显微镜（4× 或 5× 物镜）拍照；每孔随机拍 3–5 张图。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify tube formation parameters using ImageJ Angiogenesis Analyzer plugin: measure total tube length, number of branch points (junctions), number of closed meshes, and number of master segments; report all parameters normalized to control.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 ImageJ Angiogenesis Analyzer 插件定量管形成参数：测量总管长、分支点（节点）数、封闭网格数和主干节段数；所有参数归一化至对照组后报告。

name: Tumor Dissociation Protocol (Enzymatic)
nameCn: 肿瘤组织消化分离方案（酶消化法）

components.name: Step 1: Prepare digestion medium — dilute collagenase stock to 1 mg/mL in dissecting media. 10 mL per tumor. Keep on ice.
Step 2: Mince tumor on sterile petri dish with razor blades. Add 0.5 mL digestion medium to prevent drying.
Step 3: Transfer minced tissue to 9.5 mL digestion medium in 15 mL tube. Rotate 1–2 h at 37°C.

note.en: Immunophenotyping: 1 h is enough. Epithelial cell isolation: 2 h needed.
note.zh: 免疫分型：1 小时足够。上皮细胞分离：需 2 小时。
