components.name: Step 4: Spin 300 g, 5 min, 4°C. Remove supernatant. Add 2 mL warm 0.05% trypsin/EDTA. Mix with P1000. Incubate 37°C for 5 min.

note.en: Caution: trypsin trims surface receptors — limit exposure time.
note.zh: 注意：胰蛋白酶会切割表面受体——限制作用时间。

components.name: Step 5: Add 3 mL dissecting media + 125 µL DNase I (~500 Kunitz U). Pass through 18G syringe 5–10×, then 20G syringe 5–10×. Avoid bubbles.
Step 6: Spin 300 g, 5 min, 4°C. Add 1 mL 1× RBC lysis, 1 min on ice. Add 2 mL media. Filter through 70 µm strainer into 50 mL tube. Transfer to new 15 mL tube.

note.en: RBC lysis is critical — do not omit.
note.zh: 红细胞裂解很关键——不可省略。

components.name: Step 7: Spin 300 g, 5 min, 4°C. Resuspend in 2 mL dissecting media (or FACS buffer for immunophenotyping). Count cells.

note.en: If RBCs still abundant, repeat lysis step.
note.zh: 如红细胞仍多，重复裂解步骤。

components.name: Step 8: For cell line establishment — spin, resuspend in appropriate medium, seed into plates.

notes.en: Collagenase Type IV is preferred over Type I for preserving surface antigens (lacks tryptic activity). Avoid repeated freeze-thaw of enzyme stocks. Use HBSS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ for trypsin/EDTA dilution. 15 mL tubes form better pellets than 50 mL tubes. For very fibrous tumors: increase collagenase concentration to 2 mg/mL or add 0.5 mg/mL hyaluronidase.
notes.zh: 胶原酶 IV 型优于 I 型（无胰蛋白酶活性，保留表面抗原）。避免酶母液反复冻融。用无 Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ 的 HBSS 稀释胰蛋白酶/EDTA。15 mL 管比 50 mL 管沉淀效果更好。对于纤维化程度高的肿瘤：提高胶原酶浓度至 2 mg/mL 或加 0.5 mg/mL 透明质酸酶。

ref: Lukacs et al. Nat Protoc. 2010;5(4):702-13. PMID: 20360765

usage.en: Enzymatic dissociation of solid tumors into single-cell suspension using collagenase, trypsin, and DNase I for downstream FACS, scRNA-seq, or cell line establishment.
usage.zh: 使用胶原酶、胰蛋白酶和 DNase I 将实体瘤酶消化为单细胞悬液，用于 FACS、scRNA-seq 或细胞系建立。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 hours，实操: 1 hour

materials.name: Collagenase Type I or IV (10 mg/mL stock in RPMI, filter 0.22 µm, aliquot 1 mL at −20°C)
materials.note: Type IV preserves surface antigens better

materials.name: 0.05% Trypsin/EDTA (dilute 0.25% stock 5× with HBSS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺)
DNase I (2 mg/mL in PBS, ~4000 Kunitz U/mL, aliquot at −20°C)
Razor blades, hemostat, sterile petri dish

note.en: Single-cell suspension can be held on ice in FACS buffer for 1–2 hours before downstream processing
note.zh: 单细胞悬液在 FACS 缓冲液中冰上可保存 1–2 小时再进行下游处理

note.en: Cells for cell line establishment can be seeded immediately after counting — do not store
note.zh: 用于细胞系建立的细胞计数后应立即接种——不要保存

briefSteps.en: Mince tumor into 1–2 mm³ pieces → Collagenase digestion 1–2 h 37°C → Trypsin 5 min 37°C → DNase I + mechanical dissociation (18G→20G syringe) → Filter 70 µm → RBC lysis 1 min ice → Wash & count → Use fresh for FACS/scRNA-seq
briefSteps.zh: 肿瘤切碎 1–2 mm³ → 胶原酶消化 1–2 h 37°C → 胰酶 5 min 37°C → DNase I + 机械解离（18G→20G 针头）→ 70 µm 过滤 → RBC 裂解 1 min 冰上 → 洗涤计数 → 新鲜用于 FACS/scRNA-seq

detailedSteps.en: **Preparation**
Prepare digestion medium: dilute collagenase stock (10 mg/mL in RPMI) to 1 mg/mL in dissecting media (DMEM + 10% FBS + Pen/Strep). Use 10 mL per tumor piece. Keep on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 制备消化培养基：胶原酶母液（10 mg/mL RPMI）稀释至 1 mg/mL 溶解培养基（DMEM + 10% FBS + Pen/Strep）。每个肿瘤块用 10 mL。置于冰上。

detailedSteps.en: Prepare instruments: sterilize razor blades, forceps, and hemostats. Pre-chill centrifuge to 4°C. Label collection tubes.
detailedSteps.zh: 准备器械：手术刀片、镊子、止血钳灭菌。离心机预冷至 4°C。标记收集管。

detailedSteps.en: **Tumor mincing**
detailedSteps.zh: **肿瘤切碎**

detailedSteps.en: Place tumor tissue in a sterile 10 cm petri dish on ice. Mince finely with two razor blades (or scalpel) into ~1–2 mm³ pieces. Keep tissue cold throughout mincing.
detailedSteps.zh: 将肿瘤组织置于无菌 10 cm 培养皿中（放冰上）。两把手术刀片（或手术刀）切成约 1–2 mm³ 小块。切碎时保持组织低温。

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.5 mL cold digestion medium to the dish to prevent tissue from drying during mincing. Transfer minced tissue to a 15 mL tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 切碎过程中向皿中加 0.5 mL 冷消化培养基防止组织干燥。转移切碎组织到 15 mL 管中。

detailedSteps.en: Add 9.5 mL digestion medium (1 mg/mL collagenase in dissecting media) to the tube. Cap tightly.
detailedSteps.zh: 向管中加 9.5 mL 消化培养基（溶解培养基中 1 mg/mL 胶原酶）。拧紧盖子。

detailedSteps.en: **Enzymatic digestion**
detailedSteps.zh: **酶消化**

detailedSteps.en: Place tube in a tube rotator or shaking water bath at 37°C. Rotate/hshake gently. Digestion time: 1 h for immunophenotyping/FACS; 2 h for epithelial cell isolation.
detailedSteps.zh: 管放入旋转仪或摇水浴 37°C。轻柔旋转/摇动。消化时间：免疫分型/FACS 1 h；上皮细胞分离 2 h。

detailedSteps.en: After collagenase digestion, centrifuge at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C. Remove supernatant carefully.
detailedSteps.zh: 胶原酶消化后，4°C 300×g 离心 5 min。小心去除上清。

detailedSteps.en: **Trypsin treatment**
detailedSteps.zh: **胰蛋白酶处理**

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend pellet in 2 mL warm 0.05% Trypsin/EDTA (dilute 0.25% stock 5× with HBSS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺). Triturate 5–10 times with P1000. Incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 沉淀用 2 mL 温 0.05% 胰酶/EDTA 重悬（0.25% 母液用无 Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ HBSS 5 倍稀释）。P1000 吹打 5–10 次。37°C 孵育 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Add 3 mL cold dissecting media to inactivate trypsin. Add 125 µL DNase I (~500 Kunitz U) to degrade DNA released from lysed cells.
detailedSteps.zh: 加 3 mL 冷溶解培养基灭活胰酶。加 125 µL DNase I（约 500 Kunitz U）降解裂解细胞释放的 DNA。

detailedSteps.en: **Mechanical dissociation**
detailedSteps.zh: **机械解离**

detailedSteps.en: Pass the cell suspension through 18G syringe needle 5–10 times gently. Then pass through 20G syringe needle 5–10 times. Avoid creating bubbles — Frothing damages cells.
detailedSteps.zh: 细胞悬液用 18G 针头轻柔吹打 5–10 次。再用 20G 针头吹打 5–10 次。避免产生气泡——气泡会损伤细胞。

detailedSteps.en: Filter through 70 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL tube to remove debris. Rinse strainer with 5 mL FACS buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 通过 70 µm 细胞筛网过滤到 50 mL 管中去除碎片。用 5 mL FACS 缓冲液冲洗筛网。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer filtrate to a fresh 15 mL tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 滤液转移到新的 15 mL 管中。

detailedSteps.en: **RBC lysis & counting**
detailedSteps.zh: **红细胞裂解与计数**

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C. Remove supernatant. Add 1 mL 1× RBC lysis buffer. Incubate on ice for 1 min only (do NOT exceed 2 min).
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 300×g 离心 5 min。去上清。加 1 mL 1× RBC 裂解液。冰上孵育仅 1 min（勿超过 2 min）。

detailedSteps.en: Add 2 mL cold dissecting media or FACS buffer to stop lysis. Centrifuge 300×g, 5 min, 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 加 2 mL 冷溶解培养基或 FACS 缓冲液终止裂解。300×g 离心 5 min，4°C。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend pellet in 2 mL dissecting media (or FACS buffer if proceeding directly to flow staining). Count cells with hemocytometer. Assess viability with trypan blue.
detailedSteps.zh: 沉淀重悬于 2 mL 溶解培养基（或 FACS 缓冲液，如直接进行流式染色）。血球计数室计数。台盼蓝评估活率。

detailedSteps.en: If RBC contamination persists (red pellet), repeat RBC lysis step once.
detailedSteps.zh: 如仍有红细胞污染（红色沉淀），重复 RBC 裂解步骤一次。

detailedSteps.en: **Downstream use**
detailedSteps.zh: **下游应用**

detailedSteps.en: For FACS/scRNA-seq: resuspend cells in FACS buffer at 1–5×10⁶ cells/mL. Keep on ice. Proceed within 1–2 h.
detailedSteps.zh: FACS/scRNA-seq：用 FACS 缓冲液重悬细胞至 1–5×10⁶/mL。置于冰上。1–2 h 内处理。

detailedSteps.en: For cell line establishment: resuspend in appropriate complete medium, seed into culture plates. For tumor dissociation for PDX implantation (pdx_implantation): do NOT dissociate — use minced tissue directly.
detailedSteps.zh: 细胞系建立：适当完全培养基重悬，接种培养板。PDX 移植（pdx_implantation）用肿瘤解离：不要解离——直接用切碎组织。

name: Western Blot Full Protocol

components.name: 1. 样品制备: RIPA 裂解

note.en: 20–50 µg per lane
note.zh: 每泳道 20–50 µg

components.name: 3. 加 Loading Buffer, 煮沸 5 min

note.en: 80 V for stacking → 120 V for separation
note.zh: 80V 浓缩 → 120V 分离

note.en: 100 V for 60–90 min, or 30 V overnight
note.zh: 100V 60–90 min 或 30V 过夜

notes.en: Primary antibody: 1:500–1:2000; HRP secondary: 1:5000–1:10000. Use BSA blocking for phospho-proteins. Semi-dry transfer suitable for proteins <100 kDa.
notes.zh: 一抗稀释比通常 1:500–1:2000；HRP 二抗 1:5000–1:10000。磷酸化蛋白用 BSA 封闭。半干转适合 <100 kDa 蛋白。PVDF 需甲醇活化。

ref: Mahmood & Yang (2012) N Am J Med Sci 4:429–434; Towbin et al. (1979) PNAS 76:4350

usage.en: Detect specific proteins by SDS-PAGE separation, membrane transfer, and immunodetection (Western blot).
usage.zh: Western blot：SDS-PAGE 分离蛋白、转膜、免疫检测特定蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–2 days，实操: 3–4 hours

note.en: PVDF: activate in methanol
note.zh: PVDF: 甲醇活化

note.en: Commercial kit
note.zh: 商品化试剂盒

note.en: Pre-stained, 10–250 kDa
note.zh: 预染 Marker, 10–250 kDa

note.en: Boiled samples in Laemmli buffer can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 month.
note.zh: 煮沸后的 Laemmli 上样缓冲液样品可 −20°C 保存最长 1 个月。

note.en: After blocking, membrane can be stored at 4°C in TBST in a sealed bag overnight before adding primary antibody.
note.zh: 封闭完成后，膜可封入密封袋加 TBST 在 4°C 放置过夜，次日再加一抗。

note.en: After primary antibody incubation, membrane can remain at 4°C in TBST for up to 24 h before proceeding to secondary antibody.
note.zh: 一抗孵育完成后，膜在 TBST 中 4°C 最多可放置 24 h 再进行二抗步骤。

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells → quantify protein → add loading buffer and boil → SDS-PAGE → transfer to membrane → block → primary antibody overnight → wash → secondary antibody (HRP) → wash → ECL detection.
briefSteps.zh: 细胞裂解 → 蛋白定量 → 加上样缓冲液煮沸 → SDS-PAGE 电泳 → 转膜 → 封闭 → 一抗过夜孵育 → 洗涤 → 二抗（HRP）孵育 → 洗涤 → ECL 显色。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1
detailedSteps.zh: 第一天

detailedSteps.en: Lyse cells on ice in RIPA buffer (150 mM NaCl, 1% NP-40, 0.5% DOC, 0.1% SDS, 50 mM Tris pH 8.0) supplemented with protease inhibitor cocktail. Incubate on ice for 30 min with occasional vortexing.
detailedSteps.zh: 在冰上用含蛋白酶抑制剂的 RIPA 裂解液（150 mM NaCl、1% NP-40、0.5% DOC、0.1% SDS、50 mM Tris pH 8.0）裂解细胞，冰上孵育 30 min，间歇涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 14,000×g for 15 min at 4°C; carefully transfer supernatant to new tube, discard pellet.
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min，小心吸取上清至新管，弃去沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify protein concentration by BCA or Bradford assay. Adjust all samples to the same concentration (typically 1–2 µg/µL) with lysis buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: BCA 或 Bradford 法定量蛋白浓度，用裂解液将所有样品调至同一浓度（通常 1–2 µg/µL）。

detailedSteps.en: Mix 20–50 µg protein with 1/4 volume 4× Laemmli sample buffer (final: 62.5 mM Tris pH 6.8, 2% SDS, 10% glycerol, 5% β-ME, 0.01% bromophenol blue). Boil at 95°C for 5 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 取 20–50 µg 蛋白与 1/4 体积 4× Laemmli 上样缓冲液混合，95°C 煮沸 5 min。

detailedSteps.en: Load samples onto SDS-PAGE gel (8–12% depending on target protein size). Run at 80V through stacking gel, then 120V through resolving gel (~1.5 h total) in 1× running buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 将样品上 SDS-PAGE 胶（8–12%，根据目标蛋白大小选择），1× 电泳缓冲液中 80V 过浓缩胶，120V 过分离胶（约 1.5 h）。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane (pre-activated in 100% methanol for 30 s) or nitrocellulose membrane in 1× transfer buffer. Wet transfer: 100V for 60–90 min at 4°C, or 30V overnight.
detailedSteps.zh: 将蛋白转移至 PVDF 膜（先用 100% 甲醇活化 30 s）或 NC 膜，1× 转膜缓冲液，湿转 100V 60–90 min（4°C）或 30V 过夜。

detailedSteps.en: Stain membrane with Ponceau S (0.1% in 5% acetic acid) for 5 min to verify transfer efficiency, then wash with ddH₂O to remove background.
detailedSteps.zh: 丽春红 S（0.1%，5% 乙酸）染膜 5 min 验证转膜效果，ddH₂O 洗去背景。

detailedSteps.en: Block membrane in 5% non-fat milk (for total protein) or 5% BSA (for phospho-proteins) in TBST for 1 h at room temperature with gentle rocking.
detailedSteps.zh: TBST 中 5% 脱脂奶粉（检测总蛋白）或 5% BSA（检测磷酸化蛋白）封闭 1 h，室温轻柔摇晃。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate with primary antibody (diluted 1:500–1:2000 in blocking buffer) overnight at 4°C with gentle rocking.
detailedSteps.zh: 用封闭液按 1:500–1:2000 稀释一抗，4°C 过夜孵育，轻柔摇晃。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2
detailedSteps.zh: 第二天

detailedSteps.en: Wash membrane 3 times × 10 min each with TBST (0.1% Tween-20 in TBS) at room temperature with rocking.
detailedSteps.zh: TBST（含 0.1% Tween-20 的 TBS）洗膜 3 次，每次 10 min，室温摇晃。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate with HRP-conjugated secondary antibody (diluted 1:5000–1:10000 in blocking buffer) for 1 h at room temperature.
detailedSteps.zh: 用封闭液按 1:5000–1:10000 稀释 HRP 偶联二抗，室温孵育 1 h。

detailedSteps.en: Wash membrane 3 times × 10 min each with TBST. Ensure thorough washing to minimize background.
detailedSteps.zh: TBST 洗膜 3 次，每次 10 min，充分洗涤以降低背景。

detailedSteps.en: Apply ECL substrate (mix Reagent A and B 1:1 immediately before use) to membrane for 1–5 min. Expose to X-ray film or capture with chemiluminescence imaging system.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 ECL 底物（A 液与 B 液 1:1 混合，即用即配）均匀覆盖膜面 1–5 min，X 光胶片曝光或化学发光成像仪采集。

name: Wound Healing (Scratch) Assay

components.name: 1. Seed cells in 6-well plate; grow to >95% confluency

note.en: Use 2–3×10⁵ cells/well for fast-growing lines (24 h); slower lines may need 48 h. Coat plate with Matrigel or fibronectin for weakly adherent cells.
note.zh: 快速增殖细胞（HeLa、MCF-7）每孔 2–3×10⁵，培养 24 h；缓慢增殖细胞可能需要 48 h。弱贴壁细胞可预包被 Matrigel 或纤连蛋白。

components.name: 2. Optional: pre-treat with Mitomycin C (10 µg/mL, 2 h, 37°C) to inhibit proliferation

note.en: Wash 3× PBS after MMC treatment. MMC isolates migration from proliferation. Omit if growth rate is low. Alternative: serum-free medium alone.
note.zh: MMC 处理后 PBS 洗 3 次。MMC 将迁移与增殖分离。生长缓慢的细胞可省略。替代方案：仅用无血清培养基。

components.name: 3. Create scratch with 200 µL pipette tip held perpendicular to plate

note.en: Drag tip firmly in one straight line. Use ruler as guide for consistent width. Mark bottom of plate with pen perpendicular to scratch for consistent imaging position.
note.zh: 垂直持枪头，用力划直线。用直尺保证一致宽度。在划痕垂直方向用记号笔标记培养皿底部，确保每次拍摄位置一致。

note.en: Gentle wash to remove detached cells and debris without disturbing wound edge.
note.zh: 轻柔冲洗，去除脱落细胞和碎片，避免扰动划痕边缘。

components.name: 5. Add serum-free (or low-serum, 0.5–1% FBS) medium ± treatments

note.en: Vehicle/DMSO controls must be at same concentration as treatment. For cytokines/growth factors: add to serum-free medium.
note.zh: 溶剂/DMSO 对照需与处理组等浓度。细胞因子/生长因子加入无血清培养基中。

components.name: 6. Image at 0 h immediately (4× or 10× objective, phase contrast)

note.en: Take 3–5 images per well at marked positions. Record stage coordinates (automated microscopes). ImageXpress/EVOS/Operetta all suitable.
note.zh: 在标记位置每孔拍 3–5 张图。记录载物台坐标（自动显微镜）。ImageXpress/EVOS/Operetta 均适用。

components.name: 7. Image at regular intervals: 6 h, 12 h, 24 h, 48 h

note.en: Frequency depends on cell migration speed. Fast migrators (MDA-MB-231): 6–12 h endpoint. Slow (primary cells): 24–48 h. Keep cells at 37°C during imaging if possible (live cell imager).
note.zh: 频率取决于细胞迁移速度。快速迁移细胞（MDA-MB-231）：6–12 h 终点。缓慢（原代细胞）：24–48 h。可能时保持 37°C 拍摄（活细胞成像系统）。

components.name: 8. Quantify: measure wound area with ImageJ (MRI Wound Healing Tool plugin)

note.en: % Wound Closure = (Area₀ₕ − Areaₜₕ) / Area₀ₕ × 100. Or measure wound width manually (5 positions/image). Report as % closure or migration distance (µm/h).
note.zh: % 愈合 = (面积₀ₕ − 面积ₜₕ) / 面积₀ₕ × 100。或手动测量 5 个位置的划痕宽度。报告愈合百分比或迁移距离（µm/h）。

notes.en: Controls: (1) untreated cells (baseline), (2) no-serum negative control, (3) MMC-treated + serum (pure migration). Triplicate wells per condition. For 3D migration: transwell_migration (Boyden chamber). Limitations: does not distinguish migration vs proliferation without MMC treatment.
notes.zh: 对照：(1) 未处理细胞（基线）；(2) 无血清阴性对照；(3) MMC 处理 + 血清（纯迁移）。每组 3 个平行孔。3D 迁移实验参见 transwell_migration（Boyden 小室）。局限性：未用 MMC 时无法区分迁移与增殖。

ref: Liang et al. (2007) Nat Protoc 2:329–333; Jonkman et al. (2014) J Biomech 47:9–13; Zordan et al. (2011) J Immunol Methods 370:56

usage.en: Measure cell migration by wound healing (scratch) assay.
usage.zh: 划痕实验（wound healing）检测细胞迁移能力。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 24–48 hours，实操: 2 hours

note.en: For scratch
note.zh: 用于划痕

note.en: For consistent scratch width
note.zh: 控制划痕宽度一致

note.en: To inhibit proliferation
note.zh: 抑制增殖

note.en: Cells grow to >95% confluency overnight (24–48 h); proceed when ready
note.zh: 细胞过夜生长至 >95% 汇合度（24–48 h）；准备好后继续

note.en: After 0 h imaging, plate returns to incubator; next imaging at 6–12 h is an overnight stopping point for slow-migrating cells
note.zh: 0 h 拍照后放回培养箱；迁移慢的细胞可在 6–12 h 成像间隔过夜

briefSteps.en: Seed cells → grow to >95% confluency → optional Mitomycin C treatment (10 µg/mL, 2 h) → scratch with 200 µL tip → wash 2× PBS → add serum-free medium ± treatment → image at 0 h → image at 6/12/24/48 h → quantify wound closure % with ImageJ
briefSteps.zh: 铺细胞 → 生长至 >95% 汇合 → 可选丝裂霉素 C 处理（10 µg/mL，2 h）→ 200 µL 枪头划痕 → PBS 洗 2 次 → 加无血清培养基 ± 处理 → 0 h 拍照 → 6/12/24/48 h 拍照 → ImageJ 定量划痕愈合百分比

detailedSteps.en: Day 0 – Cell Seeding
detailedSteps.zh: 第 0 天 – 铺板

detailedSteps.en: Seed 2–3×10⁵ cells per well in a 6-well plate in 2 mL complete medium; for weakly adherent cells, pre-coat wells with fibronectin (5 µg/mL, 30 min RT) or Matrigel before seeding.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔铺 2–3×10⁵ 个细胞（6 孔板，2 mL 完全培养基）；对弱贴壁细胞，铺板前用纤连蛋白（5 µg/mL，室温 30 min）或 Matrigel 预包被孔板。

detailedSteps.en: Grow to >95% confluency at 37°C, 5% CO₂ (typically 24–48 h depending on cell line).
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C、5% CO₂ 培养至 >95% 汇合度（通常 24–48 h，取决于细胞系）。

detailedSteps.en: Assay Day – Scratch and Treatment
detailedSteps.zh: 实验日 – 划痕与处理

detailedSteps.en: Optional proliferation inhibition: replace medium with complete medium containing Mitomycin C (10 µg/mL) and incubate at 37°C for 2 h; wash 3× with PBS to remove MMC; this step isolates migration from proliferation.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选增殖抑制步骤：换液至含丝裂霉素 C（10 µg/mL）的完全培养基，37°C 孵育 2 h；用 PBS 洗 3 次去除 MMC；此步将迁移与增殖分离。

detailedSteps.en: Create a straight scratch: hold a sterile 200 µL pipette tip perpendicular to the plate surface; drag firmly across the well in a single straight line using a ruler as a guide; mark the outside bottom of the plate perpendicularly to the scratch for consistent reimaging.
detailedSteps.zh: 制作直线划痕：将无菌 200 µL 枪头垂直置于孔板表面；以直尺为参照用力在孔内直线划过；在孔板外底部垂直于划痕方向画记号线，确保重复成像位置一致。

detailedSteps.en: Wash wells gently twice with PBS to remove detached cells and debris without disturbing the wound edges.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 PBS 轻柔洗涤两次，去除脱落细胞和碎片，避免扰动划痕边缘。

detailedSteps.en: Add 2 mL serum-free medium (or 0.5–1% FBS) ± test compounds; include untreated and solvent controls at matching DMSO concentration.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 2 mL 无血清培养基（或 0.5–1% FBS）± 受试化合物；设未处理对照及与处理组等浓度 DMSO 的溶剂对照。

detailedSteps.en: Immediately image at 0 h: capture 3–5 images per well at the marked positions using 4× or 10× phase-contrast objective; record stage coordinates if using an automated microscope.
detailedSteps.zh: 立即进行 0 h 拍照：在标记位置用 4× 或 10× 相差物镜每孔拍 3–5 张图；使用自动显微镜时记录载物台坐标。

detailedSteps.en: Return plate to incubator; image at subsequent timepoints (6 h, 12 h, 24 h, 48 h) at exactly the same positions; endpoint depends on migration speed — fast lines (MDA-MB-231): 6–12 h; slow lines/primary cells: 24–48 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 将培养板放回培养箱；在完全相同位置依次拍摄后续时间点（6 h、12 h、24 h、48 h）；终点取决于迁移速度——快速细胞（MDA-MB-231）：6–12 h；缓慢细胞/原代细胞：24–48 h。

detailedSteps.en: Quantify wound closure using ImageJ (MRI Wound Healing Tool plugin): % Wound Closure = (Area₀ₕ − Areaₜₕ) / Area₀ₕ × 100; alternatively measure wound width at 5 positions per image and report migration distance (µm/h).
detailedSteps.zh: 用 ImageJ（MRI 划痕愈合插件）定量：% 愈合 = (面积₀ₕ − 面积ₜₕ) / 面积₀ₕ × 100；也可每张图手动测量 5 个位置的划痕宽度，报告迁移距离（µm/h）。

name: CUT&RUN Library Prep (NEBNext Ultra II, small fragments)
nameCn: CUT&RUN 建库（NEBNext Ultra II，小片段）

notes.en: This variant is optimized for the short fragments of transcription-factor CUT&RUN; for histone-modification libraries follow the standard NEBNext manufacturer protocol instead. NEB stem-loop adaptors differ in length from Illumina adaptors, which is why USER treatment is needed. Adaptor amount is the main dimer lever — scale it to input. The two-sided AMPure selection (0.8× then 1.2×) is what removes both large PCR products and adaptor dimers.
notes.zh: 此变体针对转录因子 CUT&RUN 的短片段优化；组蛋白修饰文库请改用 NEBNext 厂商标准流程。NEB 茎环接头与 Illumina 接头长度不同，故需 USER 处理。接头用量是控制二聚体的主要杠杆——按投入量调整。双向 AMPure 筛选（先 0.8× 再 1.2×）同时去掉大 PCR 产物和接头二聚体。

ref: Liu N. Library Prep for CUT&RUN with NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (E7645). protocols.io

usage.en: Build Illumina sequencing libraries from CUT&RUN DNA using NEBNext Ultra II (E7645), tuned to recover the short transcription-factor footprints; do NOT use for histone-modification CUT&RUN libraries — follow the manufacturer protocol for those.
usage.zh: 用 NEBNext Ultra II（E7645）把 CUT&RUN 富集的 DNA 建成 Illumina 测序文库，针对短的转录因子足迹片段优化；组蛋白修饰 CUT&RUN 文库**不要**用此方案——那种情况按厂商标准流程做。

label.zh: 实验方案 — ~1 day，实操: 4–5 hours

materials.name: NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (NEB #E7645)
NEBNext Adaptor + USER enzyme (from NEB index primer kits)
Magnetic stand, thermal cycler, Agilent Bioanalyzer HS or TapeStation

note.en: After the post-ligation cleanup, the 13 µl adaptor-ligated eluate can be stored at −20°C before PCR.
note.zh: 连接后纯化得到的 13 µl 加接头产物，可在 PCR 前 −20°C 保存。

note.en: The final size-selected library (13 µl) can be stored at −20°C before QC/sequencing.
note.zh: 最终筛选好的文库（13 µl）可在 QC/测序前 −20°C 保存。

briefSteps.en: End prep 60 µl (20/65°C) → ligate NEBNext adaptor 20°C → USER 37°C → 1.75× AMPure → index PCR 4–12 cyc → 0.8× (drop >350 bp) then 1.2× (drop <150 bp) → elute 13 µl → Bioanalyzer 160–350 bp → PE sequencing
briefSteps.zh: 末端修复 60 µl（20/65°C）→ 连 NEBNext 接头 20°C → USER 37°C → 1.75× AMPure → 加索引 PCR 4–12 循环 → 0.8×（去 >350 bp）再 1.2×（去 <150 bp）→ 洗脱 13 µl → Bioanalyzer 160–350 bp → 双端测序

detailedSteps.en: **End preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **末端修复**

detailedSteps.en: In a nuclease-free tube combine **55.5 µl fragmented DNA** with the NEBNext **End Prep Enzyme Mix** (green cap) and **End Prep Reaction Buffer** per the E7645 kit to a **60 µl** reaction. Run in a thermocycler with **lid ≥ 60°C**: **20°C 30 min → 65°C 30 min → hold 4°C**.
detailedSteps.zh: 无核酸酶管中，将 **55.5 µl 片段化 DNA** 与 E7645 试剂盒的 **End Prep 酶混合液**（绿盖）和 **End Prep 反应缓冲液**混匀成 **60 µl** 反应。热盖 **≥ 60°C** 下运行：**20°C 30 min → 65°C 30 min → 4°C 保持**。

detailedSteps.en: **Adaptor ligation**
detailedSteps.zh: **接头连接**

detailedSteps.en: Dilute the NEBNext adaptor to match input: for **~6 ng input** dilute the stock 15 µM adaptor to **3 µM** and use ~**1.25 µL (~4 pmol)** — roughly a 20-fold molar excess over the DNA. Lower adaptor cuts adaptor-dimer but can lose yield.
detailedSteps.zh: 按投入量稀释 NEBNext 接头：**~6 ng 投入**时把 15 µM 母液稀释到 **3 µM**，用约 **1.25 µL（~4 pmol）**——约为 DNA 的 20 倍摩尔量。接头减量可降低接头二聚体，但可能损失产量。

detailedSteps.en: Add directly to the End Prep mix: **Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix 15 µl** (red) + **Ligation Enhancer 1 µl** + **diluted NEBNext Adaptor 2.5 µl**. Mix and incubate at **20°C for 15 min** in the thermal cycler.
detailedSteps.zh: 直接向 End Prep 反应中加入：**Blunt/TA 连接酶 Master Mix 15 µl**（红盖）+ **Ligation Enhancer 1 µl** + **稀释后的 NEBNext 接头 2.5 µl**。混匀，PCR 仪 **20°C 温育 15 min**。

detailedSteps.en: Add **1.5 µl USER enzyme**, mix, and incubate at **37°C for 15 min** with lid ≥ 47°C. (USER is required only with NEBNext hairpin adaptors.)
detailedSteps.zh: 加 **1.5 µl USER 酶**，混匀，热盖 ≥ 47°C 下 **37°C 温育 15 min**。（仅 NEBNext 发夹接头需要 USER。）

detailedSteps.en: **Post-ligation cleanup (1.75×)**

Add **80 µl (~1.75×) AMPure XP beads**, mix well (≥10 pipettings), 5 min RT. On magnet 5 min, discard supernatant. Wash **twice with 200 µl fresh 80% ethanol** (30 s each on magnet). Air-dry ≤5 min (do not over-dry). Elute in **15 µl** 10 mM Tris-HCl / 0.1× TE, 2 min RT; on magnet, transfer **13 µl** to a fresh PCR tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 加 **80 µl（~1.75×）AMPure XP 磁珠**，充分混匀（≥10 次吹打），室温 5 min。上磁架 5 min，弃上清。用 **200 µl 新配 80% 乙醇洗两次**（每次磁架上 30 s）。风干 ≤5 min（勿过干）。用 **15 µl** 10 mM Tris-HCl / 0.1× TE 洗脱，室温 2 min；上磁架后取 **13 µl** 转入新 PCR 管。

detailedSteps.en: **Index PCR**
detailedSteps.zh: **加索引 PCR**

detailedSteps.en: Mix **15 µl adaptor-ligated DNA** + **NEBNext Q5 Hot Start HiFi Master Mix 25 µl** (blue) + **i7 index primer 5 µl** + **i5 universal primer 5 µl**. Cycle: **98°C 30 s**; then **[98°C 10 s → 65°C 75 s] × 4–12** (12 cycles from 6 ng gives ~10–40 ng); **65°C 5 min**; hold 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 混合 **15 µl 加接头 DNA** + **NEBNext Q5 Hot Start HiFi Master Mix 25 µl**（蓝盖）+ **i7 索引引物 5 µl** + **i5 通用引物 5 µl**。程序：**98°C 30 s**；**[98°C 10 s → 65°C 75 s] × 4–12**（6 ng 投入、12 个循环约得 10–40 ng）；**65°C 5 min**；4°C 保持。

detailedSteps.en: **Double-sided size selection**
detailedSteps.zh: **双向片段筛选**

detailedSteps.en: **Round 1 (0.8×, remove >350 bp):** add **24 µl** AMPure XP to the PCR, mix, 5 min RT, on magnet, and **keep the supernatant** (large fragments are on the beads — discard beads).
detailedSteps.zh: **第一轮（0.8×，去除 >350 bp）：** 向 PCR 加 **24 µl** AMPure XP，混匀，室温 5 min，上磁架，**保留上清**（大片段在磁珠上——弃磁珠）。

detailedSteps.en: **Round 2 (final 1.2×, remove <150 bp):** add **12 µl** AMPure XP to the supernatant, mix, 5 min RT. On magnet, discard supernatant; wash **twice with 200 µl 80% ethanol**; air-dry ≤5 min. Elute in **15 µl 0.1× TE**, 2 min RT; on magnet, transfer **13 µl** to a fresh PCR tube and store at −20°C.
detailedSteps.zh: **第二轮（终 1.2×，去除 <150 bp）：** 向上清加 **12 µl** AMPure XP，混匀，室温 5 min。上磁架弃上清；用 **200 µl 80% 乙醇洗两次**；风干 ≤5 min。用 **15 µl 0.1× TE** 洗脱，室温 2 min；上磁架取 **13 µl** 转入新 PCR 管，−20°C 保存。

detailedSteps.en: **QC & sequencing**
detailedSteps.zh: **质检与测序**

detailedSteps.en: Check size distribution on an **Agilent Bioanalyzer HS DNA chip or TapeStation** (dilute if needed); expect **160–350 bp**. A residual primer-dimer peak near 128 bp of ~1–20% is common. **Sequence paired-end** — fragments <120 bp carry most TF-binding information; trim read-through adaptor from short reads.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 **Agilent Bioanalyzer HS DNA 芯片或 TapeStation** 上查片段分布（必要时稀释）；应在 **160–350 bp**。128 bp 附近约 1–20% 的残余引物二聚体常见。**双端测序**——<120 bp 的片段携带大部分转录因子结合信息；短读长要修剪读通接头序列。

name: CUT&Tag (Cleavage Under Targets & Tagmentation, bench top)
nameCn: CUT&Tag（靶向切割与标签化片段化，台式版）

components.name: 2. Activate ConA beads in Binding buffer
4. Primary antibody, 2 h RT or overnight 4°C
6. Bind pA-Tn5 in Dig-300, 1 h RT; wash

notes.en: Henikoff-lab bench-top protocol: because pA-Tn5 tagments in situ, backgrounds are very low and 100k–500k cells (or fewer) suffice. A guinea-pig/rabbit secondary antibody is used to boost pA-Tn5 tethering even though CUT&RUN does not need it. Fragments <120 bp carry most binding information; run paired-end so you keep fragment-size data. Standard ChIP-seq tools (deepTools, Picard, bedtools) plus the SEACR peak caller work on the output.
notes.zh: Henikoff 实验室台式方案：pA-Tn5 原位标签化，背景极低，10 万–50 万（甚至更少）细胞即可。加二抗（豚鼠/兔）以增强 pA-Tn5 拴系，尽管 CUT&RUN 并不需要。<120 bp 的片段携带大部分结合信息；做双端测序以保留片段大小信息。输出可用常规 ChIP-seq 工具（deepTools、Picard、bedtools）及 SEACR peak caller 分析。

ref: Kaya-Okur HS, Janssens DH, Henikoff S, et al. Bench top CUT&Tag. protocols.io (Henikoff Lab)

usage.en: Antibody-tethered pA-Tn5 profiling of histone marks or chromatin proteins that goes straight from bead-bound nuclei to a sequencing library with very low cell input; use for genome-wide mapping (an alternative to ChIP-seq/CUT&RUN), not when only a bulk locus readout is needed.
usage.zh: 用抗体拴系的 pA-Tn5 对组蛋白修饰或染色质蛋白做全基因组图谱，从磁珠结合的细胞核直接得到测序文库，起始细胞量极低；用于全基因组定位（ChIP-seq/CUT&RUN 的替代），不适合只需单一位点的批量读出。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 5–6 hours

materials.name: Fresh or lightly-fixed cells/nuclei (up to ~500,000 per sample)
Binding, Wash, Antibody, Dig-wash, Dig-300 & Tagmentation buffers (digitonin-based)
0.5 M EDTA, 10% SDS, 20 mg/mL Proteinase K
PCI / chloroform / ethanol; SPRI beads; NEBNext HiFi 2× PCR Master Mix + i5/i7 primers
Magnet stand, nutator, thermal cycler, TapeStation/Bioanalyzer

note.en: Nuclei can be slow-frozen (900 µL in 100 µL DMSO, Mr. Frosty, −80°C overnight) and stored at −80°C before starting CUT&Tag.
note.zh: 细胞核可慢冻（900 µL 加 100 µL DMSO，Mr. Frosty，−80°C 过夜）后 −80°C 保存，再开始 CUT&Tag。

note.en: Amplified library can be held before SPRI cleanup; the final library stores at −20°C.
note.zh: 扩增后的文库可在 SPRI 纯化前暂存；最终文库 −20°C 保存。

briefSteps.en: Bind cells to ConA beads → 1° antibody (2 h/overnight) → 2° antibody → pA-Tn5 in Dig-300 1 h → tagment 37°C 1 h → ProtK/SDS 55°C → PCI extract + EtOH ppt → PCR (gap-fill + 13 cyc) → 1.3× SPRI → TapeStation → PE sequencing
briefSteps.zh: 细胞结合 ConA 磁珠 → 一抗（2 h/过夜）→ 二抗 → Dig-300 中 pA-Tn5 1 h → 37°C 标签化 1 h → 蛋白酶K/SDS 55°C → PCI 抽提+乙醇沉淀 → PCR（补平+13 循环）→ 1.3× SPRI → TapeStation → 双端测序

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Bead binding & antibodies**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 磁珠结合与抗体**

detailedSteps.en: Harvest cells at RT and count; **up to ~500,000 cells per sample**. Optional light fixation: add 16% formaldehyde to **0.1% for 2 min** at RT, quench with 1.25 M glycine to 2× the formaldehyde molarity. For nuclei, resuspend in ice-cold **NE1 buffer** 10 min on ice, spin **1300 × g 4 min 4°C**. Resuspend in Wash buffer to ~1 × 10⁶/mL.
detailedSteps.zh: 室温收获细胞并计数；**每样最多 ~500,000 个细胞**。可选轻度固定：加 16% 甲醛至 **0.1%、室温 2 min**，用 1.25 M 甘氨酸（甲醛摩尔数的 2×）终止。若制核，冰冷 **NE1 缓冲液**冰上 10 min，**1300 × g 4 min 4°C** 离心。用 Wash buffer 重悬至 ~1 × 10⁶/mL。
detailedSteps.warning: ⚠️ Keep fresh (unfixed) cells at RT through permeabilization to minimize stress.

detailedSteps.en: Activate ConA beads: withdraw **10 µL slurry per sample**, wash twice in **Binding buffer** on the magnet, and resuspend in **10 µL Binding buffer per sample**. Hold at RT.
detailedSteps.zh: 活化 ConA 磁珠：**每样取 10 µL** 珠浆，在磁架上用 **Binding buffer** 洗两次，重悬于**每样 10 µL Binding buffer**。室温备用。

detailedSteps.en: While gently vortexing (~1100 rpm), slowly add bead slurry to the cells/nuclei; rotate end-over-end **5–10 min** RT. On magnet, remove liquid. Resuspend in **50 µL ice-cold Antibody buffer per sample**.
detailedSteps.zh: 轻柔涡旋（~1100 rpm）下缓慢把珠浆加入细胞/核；端对端旋转 **5–10 min**（室温）。上磁架去液。用**每样 50 µL 冰冷 Antibody buffer** 重悬。

detailedSteps.en: Add **0.5–1 µL primary antibody** per sample (default 1:50–1:100). Nutate **2 h at RT or overnight to several days at 4°C**. Keep liquid at the bottom/side while rocking.
detailedSteps.zh: 每样加 **0.5–1 µL 一抗**（默认 1:50–1:100）。摇摆温育 **室温 2 h 或 4°C 过夜至数天**。摇动时使液体留在管底/管壁。

detailedSteps.en: On magnet, remove liquid. Add secondary antibody **1:100 in Dig-wash buffer, 100 µL/sample**; nutate **30–60 min RT**. Remove liquid on magnet, then wash **twice**: add 1 mL Dig-wash, invert to dislodge beads, clear on magnet, remove.
detailedSteps.zh: 上磁架去液。加二抗 **1:100 于 Dig-wash buffer，100 µL/样**；摇摆 **室温 30–60 min**。磁架去液后**洗两次**：加 1 mL Dig-wash，颠倒使磁珠散开，磁架澄清后弃去。

detailedSteps.en: **pA-Tn5 binding & tagmentation**
detailedSteps.zh: **pA-Tn5 结合与标签化片段化**

detailedSteps.en: Mix **pA-Tn5 1:250 in Dig-300 buffer, 100 µL/sample**; add while gently vortexing. Nutate **1 h RT**. Remove liquid on magnet, wash **twice with 1 mL Dig-300**.
detailedSteps.zh: 配 **pA-Tn5 1:250 于 Dig-300 buffer，100 µL/样**；轻柔涡旋下加入。摇摆 **室温 1 h**。磁架去液，用 **1 mL Dig-300 洗两次**。
detailedSteps.warning: ⚠️ The higher NaCl in Dig-300 prevents pA-Tn5 binding open chromatin but can clump beads — vortex gently to disperse.

detailedSteps.en: Remove liquid on magnet. Add **300 µL Tagmentation buffer** (Mg²⁺-containing) while gently vortexing. Incubate **37°C for 1 h** in a water bath or incubator.
detailedSteps.zh: 磁架去液。轻柔涡旋下加 **300 µL Tagmentation buffer**（含 Mg²⁺）。水浴或培养箱 **37°C 温育 1 h**。

detailedSteps.en: **DNA release & purification**
detailedSteps.zh: **DNA 释放与纯化**

detailedSteps.en: Stop and solubilize: add **10 µL 0.5 M EDTA, 3 µL 10% SDS, 2.5 µL 20 mg/mL Proteinase K** per sample. Vortex ~2 s and incubate **55°C for 1 h** to digest and reverse cross-links (beads may clump — normal).
detailedSteps.zh: 终止并溶出：每样加 **10 µL 0.5 M EDTA、3 µL 10% SDS、2.5 µL 20 mg/mL 蛋白酶 K**。涡旋 ~2 s，**55°C 温育 1 h** 消化并解交联（磁珠可能结块——正常）。

detailedSteps.en: Add **300 µL PCI**, vortex ~2 s, transfer to a phase-lock tube, spin **16,000 × g 3 min RT**. Add **300 µL chloroform**, invert ~10×, spin 16,000 × g 3 min. Pipette the aqueous layer into **750 µL 100% ethanol**; chill on ice and spin **≥10 min 16,000 × g 4°C**.
detailedSteps.zh: 加 **300 µL PCI**，涡旋 ~2 s，转入 phase-lock 管，**16,000 × g 3 min 室温**离心。加 **300 µL 氯仿**，颠倒 ~10 次，16,000 × g 3 min。把水相移入 **750 µL 100% 乙醇**；冰浴后 **≥10 min 16,000 × g 4°C** 离心。
detailedSteps.warning: ⚠️ Do not add glycogen — it inhibits the downstream PCR; endogenous RNA acts as carrier.

detailedSteps.en: Pour off liquid (often no visible pellet), rinse in 1 mL 100% ethanol, spin **1 min 4°C**, drain and air-dry. Dissolve in **25–30 µL 1 mM Tris-HCl pH 8 / 0.1 mM EDTA**, vortex to dissolve.
detailedSteps.zh: 倒去液体（常无可见沉淀），用 1 mL 100% 乙醇漂洗，**4°C 1 min** 离心，沥干并风干。用 **25–30 µL 1 mM Tris-HCl pH 8 / 0.1 mM EDTA** 溶解，涡旋助溶。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Library PCR & cleanup**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 文库 PCR 与纯化**

detailedSteps.en: In a thin-wall PCR tube mix **21 µL DNA + 2 µL 10 µM i5 primer + 2 µL 10 µM uniquely-barcoded i7 primer + 25 µL NEBNext HiFi 2× Master Mix**. Cycle (heated lid): **72°C 5 min** (gap-fill) → **98°C 30 s** → **[98°C 10 s → 63°C 10 s] × 13** → **72°C 1 min** → hold. Use a different i7 barcode per sample.
detailedSteps.zh: 薄壁 PCR 管中混合 **21 µL DNA + 2 µL 10 µM i5 引物 + 2 µL 10 µM 独立条码 i7 引物 + 25 µL NEBNext HiFi 2× Master Mix**。程序（热盖）：**72°C 5 min**（补平）→ **98°C 30 s** → **[98°C 10 s → 63°C 10 s] × 13** → **72°C 1 min** → 保持。每样用不同 i7 条码。

detailedSteps.en: Add **1.3 volumes (65 µL) SPRI bead slurry**, mix, sit **5–10 min RT**. On magnet, remove liquid; wash **twice with 200 µL 80% ethanol** on the magnet. Quick-spin, remove residual liquid with a 20 µL tip; **do not air-dry**. Elute in **25 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8**, 5 min, transfer cleared eluate to a fresh tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 加 **1.3 倍体积（65 µL）SPRI 珠浆**，混匀，**室温静置 5–10 min**。上磁架去液；磁架上用 **200 µL 80% 乙醇洗两次**。短暂离心，用 20 µL 枪头吸净残液；**不要风干**。用 **25 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8** 洗脱 5 min，把澄清洗脱液转入新管。

detailedSteps.en: **QC & sequencing**
detailedSteps.zh: **质检与测序**

detailedSteps.en: Check size/concentration by capillary electrophoresis (**Agilent TapeStation D1000** or equivalent). Pool barcoded libraries to equal representation (an extra SPRI cleanup removes residual primers if needed). **Paired-end Illumina sequencing** (e.g. PE25×25 with ~1% PhiX). Align with Bowtie2 `--end-to-end --very-sensitive --no-mixed --no-discordant -I 10 -X 700`.
detailedSteps.zh: 用毛细管电泳查片段大小/浓度（**Agilent TapeStation D1000** 或等效）。等量混合各条码文库（必要时再做一次 SPRI 去残余引物）。**Illumina 双端测序**（如 PE25×25，加 ~1% PhiX）。用 Bowtie2 `--end-to-end --very-sensitive --no-mixed --no-discordant -I 10 -X 700` 比对。

name: Cryopreservation of Organoid Cultures

components.name: 2. Transfer suspension; wash wells with cold PBS
4. Aspirate supernatant; (if hazy) PBS wash + re-spin
5. Optional cell count for defined banking density
6. Resuspend in freezing medium; fill cryovials

notes.en: Developed by the organoid derivation team at the Wellcome Sanger Institute, mainly for colon, pancreas and oesophageal cancer organoids. 5 mL Eppendorf tubes aid sterility. Keep cold PBS on hand to resolve hazy/loose pellets. The brake-4 setting and gentle aspiration protect the loose organoid pellet. Thaw by warming quickly at 37°C, dilute out the freezing medium, pellet, and re-plate in BME2 as in the passaging protocol.
notes.zh: 由 Wellcome Sanger 研究所类器官团队开发，主要用于结肠、胰腺、食管癌类器官。5 mL Eppendorf 管有助无菌。常备冷 PBS 解决发雾/松散沉淀。刹车档 4 与轻柔吸取可保护松散的类器官沉淀。复苏时 37°C 快速回温，稀释掉冻存液，离心成团，按传代方案重新铺入 BME2。

ref: Souster E, Rogers H, Letchford L, et al. Cryopreservation of organoid cultures. protocols.io (Wellcome Sanger Institute)

usage.en: Bank BME2/Matrigel-embedded organoids in liquid nitrogen for long-term storage; freeze healthy, actively growing cultures a few days after passage, not sparse or over-confluent ones.
usage.zh: 把包埋在基质胶（BME2/Matrigel）里的类器官冻存于液氮长期保存；冻存传代后几天、生长良好的健康培养物，别用稀疏或过度融合的。

label.zh: 实验方案 — ~45 min + overnight −80°C，实操: 40 min

materials.name: Recovery Cell Culture Freezing Medium (or equivalent)
Swinging-bucket centrifuge, −80°C freezer, liquid nitrogen storage

note.en: Vials may sit at −80°C for 24–72 h in the freezing container before moving to liquid nitrogen; do not leave them at −80°C long-term.
note.zh: 冻存管可在冻存盒中于 −80°C 放置 24–72 h 再转液氮；不要长期停在 −80°C。

briefSteps.en: Detach domes (1 well/vial) → cold-PBS wash → 800×g 2 min → aspirate → (opt. count aggregates) → resuspend in freezing medium 1 mL/vial → CoolCell −80°C overnight → liquid nitrogen
briefSteps.zh: 刮离圆顶（1 孔/管）→ 冷 PBS 洗 → 800×g 2 min → 吸上清 →（可选按聚集体计数）→ 冻存液重悬 1 mL/管 → CoolCell −80°C 过夜 → 液氮

detailedSteps.en: Using a P1000 or a **cell scraper**, detach the BME2 domes from as many wells as needed. Aim for **~1 × 10⁶ cells per cryovial** — generally **1 well → 1 cryovial**.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 P1000 或**细胞刮刀**刮离所需孔数的 BME2 圆顶。目标**每支冻存管 ~1 × 10⁶ 个细胞**——一般 **1 孔 → 1 支冻存管**。

detailedSteps.en: Transfer the organoid suspension to a **5 mL Eppendorf or 15 mL Falcon tube**. Wash the wells with **cold PBS (~4°C)** to collect remaining organoids; pipette up and down several times with a stripette to free organoids from the BME2 and add to the collection tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 把类器官悬液转入 **5 mL Eppendorf 或 15 mL Falcon 管**。用**冷 PBS（~4°C）**冲洗孔以收集残余类器官；用血清移液管反复吹打让类器官脱离 BME2，并入收集管。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at **800 × g for 2 min with the brake set to 4**. Seal centrifuge buckets with safety caps and only open them inside a microbiological safety cabinet.
detailedSteps.zh: **800 × g 离心 2 min，刹车档设为 4**。离心吊篮用安全盖密封，仅在生物安全柜内开启。
detailedSteps.warning: ⚠️ Open sealed centrifuge buckets only inside a biosafety cabinet.

detailedSteps.en: Aspirate the supernatant, leaving the (loose) organoid pellet — aspirate gently. If the pellet is unclear or has a BME2 haze, aspirate as close to the haze as possible, resuspend in **cold PBS**, re-spin (800 × g, 2 min, brake 4), and aspirate again.
detailedSteps.zh: 吸去上清，保留（松散的）类器官沉淀——轻柔吸取。若沉淀不清晰或有 BME2 雾层，尽量贴近雾层吸除，用**冷 PBS** 重悬后再离心（800 × g，2 min，刹车 4），再次吸除上清。

detailedSteps.en: **Optional — defined-density banking:** to freeze a specific cell number, take a count from the whole suspension or from a representative well (resuspend that pellet in organoid medium and count). Organoids are counted as **aggregates**; take two aggregate counts within 10% of each other (otherwise a third, then average). Target **1 × 10⁶ cells per cryovial**.
detailedSteps.zh: **可选——按定量密度冻存：** 若要冻定量细胞，从整份悬液或一个代表孔取样计数（把该孔沉淀重悬于类器官培养基后计数）。类器官按**聚集体**计数；取两次聚集体计数、彼此相差 <10%（否则计第三次取平均）。目标**每管 1 × 10⁶ 个细胞**。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend the pellet in **Recovery Cell Culture Freezing Medium** (~**1 mL per cryovial**) and transfer into the pre-labelled cryovials.
detailedSteps.zh: 用**Recovery 细胞冻存液**重悬沉淀（每管约 **1 mL**），分装入预先标记的冻存管。

detailedSteps.en: Place the cryovials in a **CoolCell** (or Mr. Frosty) freezing container and put into a **−80°C** freezer. For an odd number of vials, add a 'balance' vial for even cooling.
detailedSteps.zh: 把冻存管放入 **CoolCell**（或 Mr. Frosty）冻存盒，置于 **−80°C** 冰箱。管数为奇数时加一支“配平”管，使降温均匀。

detailedSteps.en: After **24 h (up to 72 h)**, transfer the cryovials to **liquid nitrogen** for long-term storage.
detailedSteps.zh: **24 h（最长 72 h）**后，把冻存管转入**液氮**长期保存。

name: Droplet Digital PCR (ddPCR) for Absolute Quantification

components.name: 1. Assay design: FAM/HEX (or FAM/VIC) TaqMan probe-based primer-probe sets for target and reference loci; validate in silico specificity
2. Optional RT step (RNA samples): One-Step RT-ddPCR with RT SuperMix; 42°C 60 min → 95°C 5 min; use cDNA directly in reaction
3. Reaction setup (22 μL): 10 μL ddPCR Supermix for Probes (no dUTP) + primers (900 nM each final) + probes (250 nM each final) + 1–10 ng template DNA + nuclease-free water to 22 μL
4. Droplet generation: 20 μL sample + 70 μL Droplet Generation Oil into DG8 cartridge; QX200 Droplet Generator produces ~20,000 droplets
5. Droplet transfer: transfer 40 μL droplet emulsion to 96-well plate using wide-bore tip; seal with pierceable foil heat seal at 180°C
6. PCR thermal cycling: 95°C 10 min → [94°C 30s + 55–60°C 1 min] × 40 cycles → 98°C 10 min; ramp rate 2°C/s (critical for droplet integrity)
7. Droplet reading: QX200 Droplet Reader reads ~15,000–20,000 droplets per well; measures FAM and HEX fluorescence amplitude
8. QuantaSoft analysis: set threshold between positive and negative clusters; read copies/μL for each channel
9. Absolute copy number calculation: copies/μL × total reaction volume / input volume = copies in original sample
10. Quality control: total droplet count >10,000; positive/negative cluster separation amplitude ratio >2×; NTC = 0 positives; check rain droplets

notes.en: The ramp rate of 2°C/s is critical — faster ramp rates will rupture the water-in-oil droplets during thermal cycling, leading to massive droplet loss and invalid results. | Use wide-bore or cut pipette tips for all droplet transfer steps. Standard tips shear droplets and significantly reduce droplet count. | Restriction enzyme digestion of template DNA (e.g., with HindIII or EcoRI) prior to ddPCR can improve accuracy for CNV assays by improving amplification uniformity. | For ctDNA or rare mutation detection, input DNA should be ≥10 ng (ideally ≥20 ng) to ensure statistical confidence in detecting variants at <0.1% allele frequency. | Each assay's optimal annealing temperature should be determined empirically by gradient PCR (50–65°C) on the droplet platform; the same temperature validated in conventional qPCR may differ. | Multiplexed 2-plex assays (FAM + HEX) can be run simultaneously in one well. 4-plex assays are possible with spectral differentiation but require careful validation.
notes.zh: 2°C/s的升温速率至关重要——升温过快会在热循环过程中破裂油包水微滴，导致大量微滴损失和无效结果。 | 微滴转移所有步骤均须使用宽口或剪口移液枪头。普通枪头会剪切微滴，显著降低微滴数量。 | 对于CNV检测，ddPCR前用限制性内切酶（如HindIII或EcoRI）消化模板DNA可改善扩增均一性，提高定量准确性。 | 对于ctDNA或稀有突变检测，输入DNA应≥10 ng（理想情况下≥20 ng），以确保在等位基因频率<0.1%时具有统计显著性。 | 每种检测方案的最优退火温度应通过梯度PCR（50–65°C）在微滴平台上实验确定；常规qPCR验证的温度可能与之不同。 | FAM + HEX双重检测可在同一孔中同时进行。四重检测通过光谱区分技术也可实现，但需要仔细验证。

ref: Hindson BJ, et al. (2011). High-throughput droplet digital PCR system for absolute quantitation of DNA copy number. Anal Chem 83(22):8604–8610; Pinheiro LB, et al. (2012). Evaluation of a droplet digital polymerase chain reaction format for DNA copy number quantification. Anal Chem 84(2):1003–1011; Bio-Rad. (2023). Droplet Digital PCR Applications Guide.

usage.en: Absolute quantification of nucleic acid targets without a standard curve using water-in-oil droplet partitioning. Applications include circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) detection, copy number variation (CNV) analysis, viral load quantification, rare somatic mutation detection (e.g., KRAS, EGFR, TP53), and absolute gene expression from RNA.
usage.zh: Absolute quantification of nucleic acid targets without a standard curve using water-in-oil droplet partitioning. Applications include circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) detection, copy number variation (CNV) analysis, viral load quantification, rare somatic mutation detection (e.g., KRAS, EGFR, TP53), and absolute gene expression from RNA.

note.en: Safe stop: after droplet generation, the sealed DG8 cartridge (with gasket on) can be stored at 4°C for up to 4 hours before transferring to the PCR plate. Avoid agitation.
note.zh: 安全停点：微滴生成后，盖上密封垫的DG8芯片可在4°C保存最长4小时，再转移至PCR板。避免震动。

note.en: Safe stop: after thermal cycling, the sealed PCR plate can be stored at 4°C overnight (up to 8 hours) before reading on the QX200. Do not freeze the plate as this will destroy the droplets.
note.zh: 安全停点：热循环完成后，密封PCR板可在4°C过夜保存（最长8小时）再上机读取。切勿冷冻密封板，否则会破坏微滴。

briefSteps.en: Design FAM/HEX probe assay → (RT step for RNA) → prepare 22 μL reaction (Supermix + primers 900 nM + probes 250 nM + 1–10 ng DNA) → droplet generation (DG8 cartridge + 70 μL oil → ~20,000 droplets) → transfer to 96-well plate → seal → PCR (95°C 10 min → [94°C 30s/55–60°C 1 min] × 40 → 98°C 10 min, 2°C/s ramp) → read on QX200 → QuantaSoft threshold → calculate copies/μL
briefSteps.zh: 设计FAM/HEX探针检测方案 → （RNA需RT步骤）→ 配制22 μL反应体系（Supermix + 引物900 nM + 探针250 nM + 1–10 ng DNA）→ 微滴生成（DG8芯片 + 70 μL油 → ~20,000微滴）→ 转至96孔板 → 封板 → PCR（95°C 10 min → [94°C 30s/55–60°C 1 min] × 40 → 98°C 10 min，2°C/s升温速率）→ QX200读取 → QuantaSoft设阈值 → 计算拷贝数/μL

detailedSteps.en: 1. Assay Design and Validation
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 检测方案设计与验证

detailedSteps.en: 1. Design or select validated TaqMan primer-probe sets. Use FAM-labeled probe for target locus and HEX (or VIC) probe for reference/control locus. Primer concentration: 900 nM final each; probe concentration: 250 nM final each. Verify primer specificity using BLAST; check for genomic duplications that could confound CNV assays. Preferred amplicon size: 60–200 bp for optimal droplet PCR efficiency. For rare mutation detection (e.g., KRAS, EGFR), use ddPCR mutation assays from Bio-Rad catalog.
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 设计或选取经过验证的TaqMan引物探针组合。目标基因座使用FAM标记探针，参考/对照基因座使用HEX（或VIC）探针。引物终浓度：各900 nM；探针终浓度：各250 nM。使用BLAST验证引物特异性；检查基因组重复区域，避免CNV分析混淆。推荐扩增子大小：60–200 bp，以获得最佳微滴PCR扩增效率。稀有突变检测（如KRAS、EGFR）可使用Bio-Rad目录中的ddPCR突变检测试剂盒。

detailedSteps.en: 2. Optional: Reverse Transcription for RNA Samples
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 可选：RNA样品的逆转录步骤

detailedSteps.en: 2. For RNA quantification, use Bio-Rad One-Step RT-ddPCR Advanced Kit for Probes. Prepare RT reaction: 5 μL 4× One-Step RT-ddPCR Supermix + 2 μL Reverse Transcriptase + primers (900 nM final) + probes (250 nM final) + 5–250 ng total RNA + nuclease-free water to 20 μL. Thermal cycling: 42°C 60 min (RT), 95°C 5 min (RT inactivation), hold at 4°C. Use resulting cDNA directly in subsequent ddPCR steps without further purification.
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 对于RNA定量，使用Bio-Rad One-Step RT-ddPCR Advanced Kit（探针版）。配制RT反应：5 μL 4× One-Step RT-ddPCR Supermix + 2 μL逆转录酶 + 引物（终浓度900 nM）+ 探针（终浓度250 nM）+ 5–250 ng总RNA + 无核酸酶水补至20 μL。热循环程序：42°C 60 min（逆转录）、95°C 5 min（灭活RT酶），4°C保温。所得cDNA无需纯化，直接用于后续ddPCR步骤。

detailedSteps.en: 3. ddPCR Reaction Preparation
detailedSteps.zh: 3. ddPCR反应体系配制

detailedSteps.en: 3. Prepare a 22 μL reaction per well (2 μL excess over 20 μL used for droplets). Combine in order: 10 μL ddPCR Supermix for Probes (No dUTP) (2×) + 1.8 μL forward primer (10 μM stock → 900 nM final) + 1.8 μL reverse primer (10 μM stock) + 0.5 μL FAM probe (11 μM stock → 250 nM final) + 0.5 μL HEX probe (11 μM stock) + template DNA (1–10 ng; dilute genomic DNA to avoid overloading; target ≤2 positive droplets per 3 droplets) + nuclease-free water to 22 μL. Mix by pipetting; spin briefly. Keep on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 3. 每孔配制22 μL反应体系（多出2 μL，取20 μL用于微滴生成）。依次加入：10 μL ddPCR Supermix for Probes（无dUTP，2×）+ 1.8 μL正向引物（10 μM储液，终浓度900 nM）+ 1.8 μL反向引物（10 μM储液）+ 0.5 μL FAM探针（11 μM储液，终浓度250 nM）+ 0.5 μL HEX探针（11 μM储液）+ 模板DNA（1–10 ng；对基因组DNA进行适当稀释以避免过载；目标每3个微滴中阳性微滴≤2个）+ 无核酸酶水补至22 μL。吸管吹打混匀，短暂离心。置冰上备用。

detailedSteps.en: 4. Droplet Generation
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 微滴生成

detailedSteps.en: 4. Load DG8 cartridge in the cartridge holder. Pipette 20 μL of prepared reaction into the sample wells (middle row, 8 wells). Pipette 70 μL of Droplet Generation Oil for Probes into the oil wells (bottom row). Apply the DG8 gasket firmly over the cartridge. Insert the loaded cartridge into the QX200 Droplet Generator. Run the program (~2 min); the instrument generates ~20,000 water-in-oil droplets per well by microfluidic partitioning. Handle the cartridge gently after generation — avoid tilting or agitation.
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 将DG8芯片置于卡槽中。向样品孔（中间一排，8孔）各加入20 μL配制好的反应液。向油孔（底部一排）各加入70 μL Droplet Generation Oil for Probes。将DG8密封垫牢固压在芯片上。将已装载的芯片插入QX200微滴发生器。运行程序（约2 min）；仪器通过微流控分割每孔生成约20,000个油包水微滴。生成后轻拿轻放，避免倾斜或震动芯片。

detailedSteps.en: 5. Droplet Transfer and Plate Sealing
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 微滴转移与封板

detailedSteps.en: 5. Carefully remove the DG8 gasket. Using a wide-bore or cut-tip pipette set to 40 μL, slowly aspirate droplets from the sample wells — excessive pipetting force will break droplets. Transfer each 40 μL droplet emulsion to a well of a 96-well semi-skirted PCR plate. Seal the plate with pierceable foil heat seal using the PX1 PCR Plate Sealer at 180°C for 5 s. Confirm all wells are fully sealed. Briefly centrifuge plate at 200 × g for 30 s to settle droplets.
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 小心移除DG8密封垫。使用宽口或剪口移液枪头，调至40 μL，缓慢吸取样品孔中的微滴——过大的吸液力会破坏微滴。将每孔40 μL微滴乳液转移至半裙边96孔PCR板对应孔中。使用PX1 PCR封板仪，180°C热封5 s，覆盖可穿刺铝箔封膜。确认所有孔完全密封。200 × g短暂离心30 s，使微滴沉降。

detailedSteps.en: 6. PCR Thermal Cycling
detailedSteps.zh: 6. PCR热循环

detailedSteps.en: 6. Run PCR on a conventional thermal cycler with a heated lid (105°C). Critical: set ramp rate to 2°C/s for all steps to maintain droplet integrity. Program: (1) 95°C 10 min (enzyme activation); (2) 40 cycles of 94°C 30 s (denaturation) + 55–60°C 1 min (combined annealing/extension — optimize temperature by gradient PCR if needed); (3) 98°C 10 min (droplet stabilization); (4) 4°C hold. Do not exceed 40 cycles. After PCR, plate can be stored at 4°C up to 4 h before reading; do not freeze.
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 在带加热盖（105°C）的常规热循环仪上运行PCR。关键：所有步骤升温速率设为2°C/s，以维持微滴完整性。程序：（1）95°C 10 min（酶激活）；（2）40个循环：94°C 30 s（变性）+ 55–60°C 1 min（退火/延伸合并，可通过梯度PCR优化温度）；（3）98°C 10 min（微滴稳定化）；（4）4°C保温。循环数不超过40次。PCR完成后，密封板可在4°C保存最长4 h再读取；切勿冷冻。

detailedSteps.en: 7. Droplet Reading on QX200
detailedSteps.zh: 7. QX200微滴读取

detailedSteps.en: 7. Load the sealed PCR plate into the QX200 Droplet Reader. In QuantaSoft software, set up a new plate map: assign sample names, experiment type (Absolute Quantification, CNV, Rare Event Detection), and channel assignments (Ch1 = FAM, Ch2 = HEX). Start the run; the reader pierces each well's foil seal and flows droplets single-file through a laser detection system. Each droplet is measured for FAM and HEX fluorescence. Typical read time: ~30 min for a full 96-well plate.
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 将密封PCR板放入QX200微滴读取仪。在QuantaSoft软件中建立新板图：分配样品名称、实验类型（绝对定量、CNV、稀有事件检测）及通道分配（Ch1 = FAM，Ch2 = HEX）。启动运行；读取仪穿刺每孔铝箔密封膜，使微滴单列通过激光检测系统，逐一测量FAM和HEX荧光强度。完整96孔板读取时间约30 min。

detailedSteps.en: 8. Data Analysis in QuantaSoft
detailedSteps.zh: 8. QuantaSoft数据分析

detailedSteps.en: 8. In QuantaSoft, view the 1D or 2D amplitude plot. Positive droplets (target amplified) cluster at high fluorescence; negative droplets cluster at low fluorescence. Set the fluorescence threshold manually between the two clusters — the threshold line should bisect the gap, not touch either cluster. For rare mutation assays, use the mutant channel (FAM) vs. wild-type channel (HEX) 2D plot to separate mutation-only, wild-type-only, both, and empty droplets. QuantaSoft automatically calculates copies/μL using Poisson statistics.
detailedSteps.zh: 8. 在QuantaSoft中查看一维或二维振幅散点图。阳性微滴（目标扩增）聚集于高荧光区，阴性微滴聚集于低荧光区。在两个簇之间手动设定荧光阈值——阈值线应平分两簇间隙，不可接触任一簇。对于稀有突变检测，使用突变通道（FAM）vs. 野生型通道（HEX）二维散点图，区分仅含突变、仅含野生型、两者均含及空微滴。QuantaSoft自动基于泊松统计计算拷贝数/μL。

detailedSteps.en: 9. Absolute Copy Number Calculation
detailedSteps.zh: 9. 绝对拷贝数计算

detailedSteps.en: 9. QuantaSoft reports copies/μL in the 20 μL droplet generation reaction. To calculate copies in the original sample: Copies/μL (QuantaSoft output) × 20 μL (reaction volume) / volume of template added (μL) = copies/μL in original sample. For CNV analysis: ratio = target copies/μL ÷ reference copies/μL × ploidy factor (e.g., × 2 for diploid reference). For fractional abundance (rare mutations): %mutant = mutant copies ÷ (mutant + wild-type copies) × 100. Report with 95% Poisson confidence intervals from QuantaSoft.
detailedSteps.zh: 9. QuantaSoft报告20 μL微滴生成反应中的拷贝数/μL。计算原始样品中的拷贝数：QuantaSoft输出的拷贝数/μL × 20 μL（反应体积）÷ 加入模板的体积（μL）= 原始样品中拷贝数/μL。CNV分析：比值 = 目标拷贝数/μL ÷ 参考拷贝数/μL × 倍性系数（二倍体参考乘以2）。稀有突变比例：%突变 = 突变拷贝数 ÷（突变 + 野生型拷贝数）× 100。结合QuantaSoft输出的95%泊松置信区间一并报告。

detailedSteps.en: 10. Quality Control Assessment
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 质量控制评估

detailedSteps.en: 10. Evaluate each well against QC criteria: (1) Total accepted droplet count: >10,000 acceptable; >15,000 optimal; wells with <10,000 droplets should be flagged or repeated. (2) Cluster separation: positive cluster amplitude should be ≥2× the amplitude of the negative cluster; poor separation indicates suboptimal annealing temperature or inhibitors. (3) No Template Control (NTC): must show 0 positive droplets in the target channel; any NTC positives indicate contamination. (4) Rain droplets: intermediate-amplitude droplets between clusters indicate incomplete amplification — consider higher annealing temperature or reducing DNA input.
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 按以下质控标准评估每孔数据：（1）总有效微滴数：>10,000为合格，>15,000为最佳；低于10,000的孔应标记或重做。（2）簇分离度：阳性簇振幅应≥阴性簇振幅的2倍；分离不佳提示退火温度不优或存在抑制物。（3）无模板对照（NTC）：目标通道阳性微滴数必须为0；NTC出现阳性提示污染。（4）【雨】微滴：两簇之间出现中间振幅微滴提示扩增不完全——考虑提高退火温度或降低DNA投入量。

name: First-Strand cDNA Synthesis (Reverse Transcription)
nameCn: 第一链 cDNA 合成（逆转录）

components.name: 1. Assemble RNA/primer/dNTP mix on ice (14.5 µl)

note.en: Add components in the listed order in a nuclease-free tube on ice.
note.zh: 在冰上、无核酸酶管中按顺序加入各组分。

components.name: 3. Add reverse transcriptase mix to 20 µl total
5. Dilute to 80 µl; use in qPCR or store

notes.en: Use DNase-treated RNA to avoid genomic-DNA carryover into qPCR. Random hexamers prime across the whole transcript (good for general expression profiling); switch to oligo-dT for 3'-biased full-length priming or gene-specific primers for a single target. Keep everything RNase-free and on ice until the RT step.
notes.zh: 用经 DNase 处理的 RNA，避免基因组 DNA 带入 qPCR。随机六聚体在整条转录本上起始（适合常规表达定量）；若要偏 3′ 的全长起始改用 oligo-dT，只测单一靶点则用基因特异引物。RT 步骤前全程无 RNase、保持冰上操作。

ref: Dietsch M. First strand cDNA synthesis. protocols.io

usage.en: Reverse-transcribe total or purified RNA into first-strand cDNA for two-step RT-qPCR; not for direct one-step RT-qPCR where reverse transcription and amplification share a single tube.
usage.zh: 把总 RNA 或纯化 RNA 逆转录成第一链 cDNA，用于两步法 RT-qPCR；不适用于逆转录与扩增同管进行的一步法 RT-qPCR。

label.zh: 实验方案 — ~1 hour，实操: 15 min

materials.name: Template RNA (DNase-treated total RNA or purified mRNA)

note.en: Finished cDNA can be used directly in qPCR or stored at −20°C for up to 1 week.
note.zh: 合成好的 cDNA 可直接用于 qPCR，或 −20°C 保存最长 1 周。

briefSteps.en: RNA + hexamer + dNTP on ice → (opt. 65°C denature) → add RT mix to 20 µl → 25/50/85°C program → dilute to 80 µl → qPCR-ready cDNA
briefSteps.zh: RNA+六聚体+dNTP 冰上配 → （可选 65°C 变性）→ 加 RT 混合至 20 µl → 25/50/85°C 程序 → 稀释至 80 µl → 可用 cDNA

detailedSteps.en: In a sterile, nuclease-free tube **on ice**, combine in this order: **Template RNA** 100 ng (usable range 1 pg – 5 µg), **random hexamer** 1 µl (100 pmol), **dNTP mix** 1 µl, and nuclease-free **water to 14.5 µl**.
detailedSteps.zh: 在无菌、无核酸酶管中、**冰上**按顺序加入：**模板 RNA** 100 ng（可用范围 1 pg – 5 µg）、**随机六聚体引物** 1 µl（100 pmol）、**dNTP 混合液** 1 µl，无核酸酶**水补至 14.5 µl**。

detailedSteps.en: **Optional (GC-rich or structured RNA):** mix gently, spin briefly, incubate at 65°C for 5 min to denature secondary structure, then chill on ice and spin again.
detailedSteps.zh: **可选（GC 富集或有二级结构的 RNA）：** 轻轻混匀、短暂离心，65°C 温育 5 min 打开二级结构，随后冰浴并再次短暂离心。

detailedSteps.en: Add reverse transcriptase, its 5× reaction buffer, and (recommended) RNase inhibitor per your kit's instructions to bring the reaction to a final volume of **20 µl**. Mix gently and centrifuge briefly.
detailedSteps.zh: 按所用试剂盒说明加入逆转录酶、其 5× 反应缓冲液及（推荐的）RNase 抑制剂，使反应终体积为 **20 µl**。轻轻混匀后短暂离心。
detailedSteps.warning: ⚠️ Exact enzyme/buffer volumes are kit-specific — follow the manufacturer's table; do not guess.

detailedSteps.en: Incubate in a thermal cycler: **25°C 10 min** (primer annealing) → **50°C 30 min** (extension; for GC-rich RNA the extension can be raised to 65°C) → **85°C 5 min** (enzyme inactivation).
detailedSteps.zh: 在 PCR 仪中温育：**25°C 10 min**（引物退火）→ **50°C 30 min**（延伸；GC 富集 RNA 可提高到 65°C）→ **85°C 5 min**（灭活酶）。

detailedSteps.en: Add nuclease-free water to bring the reaction to **80 µl**. The diluted cDNA can be used directly as qPCR template or stored at −20°C for up to 1 week.
detailedSteps.zh: 加无核酸酶水将反应稀释至 **80 µl**。稀释后的 cDNA 可直接作为 qPCR 模板，或 −20°C 保存最长 1 周。

name: HiChIP (Hi-C Chromatin Immunoprecipitation)
nameCn: HiChIP 染色质免疫共沉淀结合邻近连接技术

components.name: 1. Harvest 12–15 million cells in log-phase; add formaldehyde to 1% final, 10 min RT with rocking
2. Quench crosslinking with glycine to 125 mM final, 5 min RT; wash 2× cold PBS, snap-freeze pellet at -80°C or proceed
3. Input estimation: digest 0.5M cell aliquot with Buffer E + Proteinase K (55°C 30 min, 68°C 3h); purify with AMPure XP beads
4. Lyse nuclei in Arima lysis buffer; digest chromatin with restriction enzyme mix (MboI+HinfI) from Arima-HiC+ Kit
5. End-fill restriction overhangs with biotin-dCTP using DNA Polymerase I (Klenow fragment), 37°C 30 min
6. Intra-molecular ligation: 16°C 4h then RT 30 min with T4 DNA Ligase
7. Reverse crosslinks with Proteinase K: 55°C 45 min then 68°C 90 min; purify proximity-ligated DNA
8. Sonicate proximity-ligated DNA to 200–500 bp; preclear with Protein A/G beads 1h 4°C
9. Add ChIP-grade antibody (e.g., H3K27ac, CTCF, cohesin), rotate overnight 4°C
10. Capture with Protein A/G beads 2h 4°C; wash 4× (low salt → high salt → LiCl → TE); elute and reverse crosslinks
11. Purify enriched ChIP DNA with SPRI beads; streptavidin bead pulldown for biotin-labeled ligation junctions
12. End repair, A-tailing, and adapter ligation on streptavidin beads (NEBNext or Arima library prep kit)
13. PCR amplification 8–12 cycles; final SPRI size selection (0.5×–0.7×)
14. QC: Bioanalyzer fragment size 300–500 bp; sequence and validate >30% valid Hi-C pairs

notes.en: HiChIP combines Hi-C proximity ligation with ChIP enrichment to map protein-centric chromatin interactions at much lower cell numbers than HiC (12–15M vs. 100M+ cells). Key considerations: (1) antibody quality is critical — use well-validated ChIP-grade antibodies; (2) sonication must follow proximity ligation, not precede it — do not reverse the order; (3) biotin fill-in efficiency determines junction capture rate; (4) valid pair rate >30% indicates good library quality; H3K27ac and cohesin are the most common targets. Compare against HiC input without ChIP to distinguish 3D interactions from ChIP enrichment artifacts.
notes.zh: HiChIP 将 Hi-C 邻近连接与 ChIP 富集相结合，以远低于 Hi-C（12–15M vs. 100M+ 细胞）的细胞数量绘制以蛋白质为中心的染色质相互作用图谱。关键注意事项：(1) 抗体质量至关重要——使用经充分验证的 ChIP-grade 抗体；(2) 超声破碎必须在邻近连接之后进行，不得颠倒顺序；(3) 生物素填充效率决定连接位点的捕获率；(4) 有效配对率 >30% 表示文库质量良好；H3K27ac 和凝聚素是最常见的靶标。与不含 ChIP 的 HiC 投入量样品比较，以区分三维相互作用与 ChIP 富集伪影。

ref: Mumbach MR et al. (2016) Nat Methods 13:919–922; Schmitt AD et al. (2016) Cell Stem Cell 19:690–703; Arima-HiC+ Kit protocol doi:10.17504/protocols.io.ewov1qq67gr2/v1

usage.en: Map protein-centric chromatin loops and enhancer-promoter interactions genome-wide using HiChIP, which couples Hi-C proximity ligation with chromatin immunoprecipitation.
usage.zh: 使用 HiChIP 在全基因组范围内绘制以蛋白质为中心的染色质环和增强子-启动子相互作用图谱，该方法将 Hi-C 邻近连接与染色质免疫共沉淀相结合。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–4 days，实操: ~16 hours

materials.name: Arima-HiC+ Kit (restriction enzymes MboI+HinfI, ligase, lysis buffer)
NEBNext Ultra II End Repair/A-Tailing Module
Q5 or KAPA HiFi PCR polymerase

note.en: Safe stop: store at −80°C for up to months.
note.zh: 可在此暂停：−80°C 可保存数月。

note.en: Safe stop: store at −20°C for up to weeks.
note.zh: 可在此暂停：−20°C 可保存数周。

note.zh: 可在此暂停：4°C 过夜。

note.zh: 可在此暂停：−20°C 可保存数月。

briefSteps.en: Crosslink 12–15M cells with 1% formaldehyde → lyse nuclei → digest chromatin with MboI+HinfI → fill ends with biotin-dCTP → intra-molecular ligation → reverse crosslinks → purify proximity-ligated DNA → sonicate to 200–500 bp → ChIP with target antibody (overnight 4°C) → capture/wash/elute → streptavidin pulldown of biotin junctions → library prep with adapter ligation → PCR 8–12 cycles → SPRI size selection → QC and sequencing
briefSteps.zh: 用 1% 甲醛交联 12–15M 个细胞 → 裂解细胞核 → MboI+HinfI 酶切染色质 → 生物素-dCTP 末端填充 → 分子内连接 → 逆转交联 → 纯化邻近连接 DNA → 超声破碎至 200–500 bp → 目标抗体 ChIP（4°C 过夜）→ 磁珠捕获/洗涤/洗脱 → 链霉亲和素磁珠富集生物素化连接位点 → 文库制备与接头连接 → PCR 扩增 8–12 个循环 → SPRI 大小选择 → QC 与测序

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Crosslinking and Input Estimation
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：交联与投入量估算

detailedSteps.en: Harvest 12–15 million cells in log-phase growth. Add formaldehyde directly to culture media to a final concentration of 1%. Rock at RT for 10 min to ensure uniform crosslinking of chromatin complexes.
detailedSteps.zh: 收取处于对数生长期的 12–15 百万个细胞。将甲醛直接加入培养基，终浓度为 1%。室温摇动 10 min，确保染色质复合物均匀交联。

detailedSteps.en: Quench formaldehyde by adding glycine to 125 mM final concentration. Rock 5 min at RT. Wash pellet 2× with ice-cold PBS (600×g, 5 min). Snap-freeze cell pellet in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C, or proceed immediately to lysis.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入甘氨酸至终浓度 125 mM 以淬灭甲醛，室温摇动 5 min。用冰冷 PBS 洗涤细胞沉淀 2 次（600×g，5 min）。将细胞沉淀在液氮中速冻，储存于 -80°C，或立即进行裂解。

detailedSteps.en: Input DNA estimation: thaw one 0.5M cell aliquot. Add Buffer E + Proteinase K (100 µg/mL); incubate 55°C 30 min, then 68°C 3h to reverse crosslinks and digest protein. Purify DNA with AMPure XP beads (1× volume), wash 2× with 80% EtOH, air dry, elute in 50 µL TE. Quantify by Qubit. Typical yield: ~2 µg DNA per 0.5M cells. Each HiChIP reaction requires cells containing ~15 µg DNA.
detailedSteps.zh: 投入量 DNA 估算：融化一个 0.5M 细胞分装管。加入 Buffer E + Proteinase K（100 µg/mL），55°C 孵育 30 min，再 68°C 孵育 3h 以逆转交联并消化蛋白质。用 AMPure XP 磁珠（1× 体积）纯化 DNA，80% 乙醇洗涤 2 次，风干，50 µL TE 洗脱。Qubit 定量。典型产量：每 0.5M 细胞约 2 µg DNA。每个 HiChIP 反应需含 ~15 µg DNA 的细胞量。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1–2: HiC Proximity Ligation (Arima-HiC+ Kit)
detailedSteps.zh: 第1–2天：HiC 邻近连接（Arima-HiC+ 试剂盒）

detailedSteps.en: Lyse nuclei: resuspend crosslinked cell pellet in Arima lysis buffer with protease inhibitors; incubate on ice 30 min with periodic vortexing. Pellet nuclei at 2,500×g, 5 min, 4°C; wash once.
detailedSteps.zh: 裂解细胞核：将交联细胞沉淀重悬于含蛋白酶抑制剂的 Arima 裂解缓冲液中，冰上孵育 30 min，期间间歇涡旋。2,500×g，4°C 离心 5 min 收集细胞核，洗涤一次。

detailedSteps.en: Chromatin digestion: add restriction enzyme mix (MboI + HinfI) from Arima-HiC+ Kit in NEBuffer. Incubate 37°C 1h with rotation to achieve uniform chromatin digestion. Inactivate enzymes at 62°C for 10 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 染色质消化：在 NEBuffer 中加入 Arima-HiC+ 试剂盒提供的限制性酶混合液（MboI + HinfI）。37°C 旋转孵育 1h，使染色质均匀消化。62°C 灭活酶 10 min。

detailedSteps.en: Biotin fill-in of restriction fragment overhangs: add biotinylated nucleotide mix (biotin-dCTP, dATP, dGTP, dTTP) with DNA Polymerase I Large (Klenow) fragment. Incubate 37°C for 30 min. This labels all ligation junctions with biotin for downstream pulldown.
detailedSteps.zh: 生物素填充限制性片段突出末端：加入生物素化核苷酸混合液（生物素-dCTP、dATP、dGTP、dTTP）和 DNA 聚合酶 I 大片段（Klenow）。37°C 孵育 30 min。该步骤用生物素标记所有连接位点，用于后续富集。

detailedSteps.en: Intra-molecular proximity ligation: add T4 DNA Ligase (200 U) and ligation buffer. Ligate at 16°C for 4h, then at RT for an additional 30 min. Dilute conditions (1–4 µg/mL DNA) favor intra-molecular over inter-molecular ligation.
detailedSteps.zh: 分子内邻近连接：加入 T4 DNA 连接酶（200 U）和连接缓冲液。16°C 连接 4h，再在 RT 延长 30 min。稀释条件（DNA 1–4 µg/mL）有利于分子内连接而非分子间连接。

detailedSteps.en: Reverse crosslinks: add Proteinase K (200 µg/mL final) and SDS (0.5% final). Incubate 55°C for 45 min, then 68°C for 90 min. Purify proximity-ligated DNA by phenol-chloroform extraction or SPRI beads (0.55× then 0.7× double selection for 300–500 bp). Elute in 100 µL TE. Quantify by Qubit.
detailedSteps.zh: 逆转交联：加入 Proteinase K（终浓度 200 µg/mL）和 SDS（终浓度 0.5%）。55°C 孵育 45 min，再 68°C 孵育 90 min。通过苯酚-氯仿抽提或 SPRI 磁珠（0.55× 后 0.7× 双重选择，富集 300–500 bp）纯化邻近连接 DNA。100 µL TE 洗脱。Qubit 定量。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Chromatin Immunoprecipitation (ChIP)
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天：染色质免疫共沉淀（ChIP）

detailedSteps.en: Sonicate proximity-ligated DNA to 200–500 bp average fragment size. Use Bioruptor (high setting, 30s on/30s off, 10–15 cycles) or equivalent sonicator. Verify size by agarose gel. Preclear with Protein A/G beads (20 µL) for 1h at 4°C with rotation to reduce non-specific binding.
detailedSteps.zh: 将邻近连接 DNA 超声破碎至平均片段大小 200–500 bp。使用 Bioruptor（高档，30s 开/30s 关，10–15 个循环）或同等超声仪。琼脂糖凝胶验证片段大小。用 Protein A/G 磁珠（20 µL）预清除 4°C 旋转 1h，以减少非特异性结合。

detailedSteps.en: Add ChIP-grade antibody (2–5 µg; e.g., anti-H3K27ac, anti-CTCF, or anti-cohesin/RAD21/SMC1) to precleared chromatin. Rotate overnight at 4°C. Include IgG negative control and, if possible, an input sample (10% of chromatin).
detailedSteps.zh: 向预清除染色质中加入 ChIP-grade 抗体（2–5 µg；如抗 H3K27ac、抗 CTCF 或抗凝聚素/RAD21/SMC1）。4°C 旋转孵育过夜。设 IgG 阴性对照，并保留投入量样品（染色质的 10%）。

detailedSteps.en: Day 3: Bead Capture, Elution, and Library Prep
detailedSteps.zh: 第3天：磁珠捕获、洗脱与文库制备

detailedSteps.en: Add 30 µL Protein A/G magnetic beads pre-equilibrated in ChIP dilution buffer. Rotate 2h at 4°C to capture antibody–chromatin complexes. Wash beads sequentially: 1× Low Salt Wash Buffer (0.1% SDS, 1% Triton X-100, 2 mM EDTA, 20 mM Tris pH 8, 150 mM NaCl), 1× High Salt Wash (same + 500 mM NaCl), 1× LiCl Wash (0.25 M LiCl, 1% NP-40, 1% deoxycholate, 1 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris pH 8), 2× TE.
detailedSteps.zh: 加入 30 µL 在 ChIP 稀释缓冲液中预平衡的 Protein A/G 磁珠。4°C 旋转 2h 以捕获抗体–染色质复合物。依次洗涤磁珠：1× 低盐洗涤缓冲液（0.1% SDS、1% Triton X-100、2 mM EDTA、20 mM Tris pH 8、150 mM NaCl），1× 高盐洗涤液（同上 + 500 mM NaCl），1× LiCl 洗涤液（0.25 M LiCl、1% NP-40、1% 脱氧胆酸、1 mM EDTA、10 mM Tris pH 8），2× TE。

detailedSteps.en: Elute ChIP DNA: add 250 µL elution buffer (1% SDS, 0.1 M NaHCO₃) to beads; vortex and incubate 65°C for 15 min. Reverse crosslinks by adding NaCl to 200 mM and Proteinase K to 100 µg/mL; incubate 65°C overnight. Purify with SPRI beads (1.8×); elute in 30 µL TE.
detailedSteps.zh: 洗脱 ChIP DNA：向磁珠中加入 250 µL 洗脱缓冲液（1% SDS、0.1 M NaHCO₃），涡旋后 65°C 孵育 15 min。加入 NaCl 至 200 mM、Proteinase K 至 100 µg/mL，65°C 孵育过夜以逆转交联。SPRI 磁珠（1.8×）纯化，30 µL TE 洗脱。

detailedSteps.en: Streptavidin bead pulldown: wash Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin C1 beads (5 µL) 2× with Tween Wash Buffer (5 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 0.5 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl, 0.05% Tween-20). Resuspend in 2× Binding Buffer (10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 1 mM EDTA, 2 M NaCl). Add ChIP-enriched DNA; rotate 30 min at RT. Capture beads; wash 2× with Tween Wash Buffer, 2× with 10 mM Tris pH 8. Beads are now ready for on-bead library prep.
detailedSteps.zh: 链霉亲和素磁珠富集：Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin C1 磁珠（5 µL）用 Tween 洗涤缓冲液（5 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5、0.5 mM EDTA、1 M NaCl、0.05% Tween-20）洗涤 2 次。重悬于 2× 结合缓冲液（10 mM Tris pH 7.5、1 mM EDTA、2 M NaCl）。加入 ChIP 富集 DNA，RT 旋转 30 min。捕获磁珠，Tween 洗涤缓冲液洗 2 次，10 mM Tris pH 8 洗 2 次。磁珠即可用于磁珠上文库制备。

detailedSteps.en: On-bead library preparation: perform end repair and A-tailing (NEBNext Ultra II End Prep, 20°C 30 min then 65°C 30 min) directly on streptavidin beads. Without eluting, perform adapter ligation (NEBNext Universal Adapter, 20°C 20 min). USER enzyme treatment (37°C 15 min). Wash beads 2× with Tween Wash Buffer.
detailedSteps.zh: 磁珠上文库制备：直接在链霉亲和素磁珠上进行末端修复和加 A 尾（NEBNext Ultra II End Prep，20°C 30 min 后 65°C 30 min）。无需洗脱，直接进行接头连接（NEBNext Universal Adapter，20°C 20 min）。USER 酶处理（37°C 15 min）。Tween 洗涤缓冲液洗涤磁珠 2 次。

detailedSteps.en: PCR amplification: elute library from streptavidin beads by heating to 95°C for 2 min in PCR master mix. Amplify with NEBNext indexed primers for 8–12 cycles (98°C 30s; [98°C 10s, 65°C 75s] × 8–12 cycles; 65°C 5 min). Final SPRI double size selection (0.5× to remove large fragments, then 0.7× to remove adapters). Quantify by Qubit; assess size distribution by Bioanalyzer (target: 300–500 bp). Valid Hi-C pair rate should be >30% upon sequencing.
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 扩增：在 PCR 混合液中 95°C 加热 2 min，从链霉亲和素磁珠上洗脱文库。使用 NEBNext 索引引物扩增 8–12 个循环（98°C 30s；[98°C 10s、65°C 75s] × 8–12 个循环；65°C 5 min）。最终 SPRI 双重大小选择（0.5× 去除大片段，再 0.7× 去除接头）。Qubit 定量；Bioanalyzer 检测片段大小分布（目标：300–500 bp）。测序后有效 Hi-C 配对率应 >30%。

name: Intestinal Organoid Generation from Crypts (Mouse)
nameCn: 小鼠肠道类器官（迷你肠）培养方案

components.name: 1. Sacrifice mouse and isolate 10–15 cm proximal small intestine; flush lumen with cold PBS
2. Open intestine longitudinally; scrape mucus and villi with glass coverslip; wash 5× cold PBS until supernatant clear
3. Incubate tissue in 2 mM EDTA/PBS on ice 30 min with gentle rocking; then shake vigorously 2–3 min to release crypts
4. Filter through 70 μm cell strainer; inspect under microscope — crypts are compact oval structures (20–50 cells), distinct from elongated villi fragments
5. Centrifuge 200×g, 3 min, 4°C; aspirate supernatant; wash with cold Advanced DMEM/F12; repeat 2–3× until supernatant clear
6. Count crypts by hemocytometer; resuspend 500 crypts in 100 μL 50:50 cold growth-factor-reduced phenol-free Matrigel:Advanced DMEM/F12
7. Pre-warm 24-well plate at 37°C; plate 50 μL/well dome; incubate 5 min 37°C to solidify Matrigel
8. Overlay each well with 500 μL ENR medium (Advanced DMEM/F12 + 1× GlutaMAX + 10 mM HEPES + 100 U/mL Pen/Strep + 1× N2 + 1× B27 + 50 ng/mL murine EGF + 100 ng/mL Noggin + 500 ng/mL R-spondin1)
9. Change medium every 2 days; organoids form budding crypt-like domains within 3–5 days
10. Passage every 5–7 days: dissolve Matrigel on ice 30 min in cold Advanced DMEM/F12; pipette 100× to fragment organoids; centrifuge 400×g 5 min; re-embed at 1:3–1:5 split ratio

notes.en: Use growth-factor-reduced, phenol-red-free Matrigel (e.g., Corning 356231) for optimal organoid formation. Standard Matrigel contains undefined growth factors that interfere with ENR signaling. | Keep Matrigel and all materials cold (4°C or on ice) at all times during resuspension and plating. Matrigel gels irreversibly at temperatures above 10°C. | R-spondin1 is critical for Wnt-mediated Lgr5+ stem cell maintenance. If recombinant R-spondin1 is cost-prohibitive, use 10–20% conditioned medium from Rspo1-secreting HEK293T cells (ATCC CRL-3276). | Organoid efficiency varies by mouse age (8–10 week adults recommended), genetic background (C57BL/6 most robust), and intestinal segment (jejunum yields most crypts). | For drug-screening applications, remove Matrigel coating (use BME type 2 or Basement Membrane Extract, 8%) and switch to monolayer or 2D organoid format on fibronectin-coated plates for uniform compound access.
notes.zh: 使用无生长因子、无酚红的Matrigel（如Corning 356231）以获得最佳类器官形成效果。标准Matrigel含有未定义的生长因子，会干扰ENR信号。 | 重悬和铺板全程保持Matrigel及所有材料冷藏（4°C或置于冰上）。Matrigel在10°C以上会不可逆凝胶化。 | R-spondin1对Wnt介导的Lgr5+干细胞维持至关重要。若重组R-spondin1成本过高，可使用10–20%来自Rspo1分泌型HEK293T细胞（ATCC CRL-3276）的条件培养基替代。 | 类器官形成效率因小鼠年龄（推荐8–10周成年鼠）、遗传背景（C57BL/6最稳健）和肠段（空肠产隐窝最多）而异。 | 用于药物筛选时，可去除Matrigel包被（使用BME 2型或8%基底膜提取物），改用纤连蛋白包被板上的单层或2D类器官格式，以实现均匀的化合物接触。

ref: Sato T et al. (2009). Single Lgr5 stem cells build crypt-villus structures in vitro without a mesenchymal niche. Nature. 459(7244):262–265. Also: Sato T & Clevers H (2013). Growing self-organizing mini-guts from a single intestinal stem cell: mechanism and applications. Science. 340(6137):1190–1194.

usage.en: Generate self-organizing 3D intestinal organoids (mini-guts) from mouse crypts for studies of intestinal stem cell biology, epithelial homeostasis, host-pathogen interactions, cancer initiation modeling, and drug/toxicity screening
usage.zh: Generate self-organizing 3D intestinal organoids (mini-guts) from mouse crypts for studies of intestinal stem cell biology, epithelial homeostasis, host-pathogen interactions, cancer initiation modeling, and drug/toxicity screening

note.en: Washed crypt pellet can be held on ice in cold Advanced DMEM/F12 for up to 30 min before embedding. Do not leave longer as crypt viability declines.
note.zh: 洗涤后的隐窝沉淀可在冰上冷Advanced DMEM/F12中保存至多30 min，再进行包埋。不宜保存更长时间，否则隐窝活力下降。

note.en: Solidified Matrigel dome (before medium overlay) can be held at 37°C for up to 10 min. Add ENR medium promptly and return to incubator; extended dry incubation will kill crypts.
note.zh: 凝固的Matrigel穹顶（加培养基之前）可在37°C保存至多10 min。须尽快加入ENR培养基并返回培养箱；长时间干燥孵育会导致隐窝死亡。

note.en: Established organoids (passage 1+) can be cryopreserved in CryoStor CS10 in liquid nitrogen for long-term storage. Thaw rapidly in 37°C water bath and re-embed immediately.
note.zh: 已建立的类器官（传代1次及以上）可在液氮中以CryoStor CS10冻存，用于长期保存。解冻时在37°C水浴中快速融化，立即重新包埋。

briefSteps.en: Isolate intestine → scrape villi → EDTA dissociation → filter crypts → wash pellet → resuspend in Matrigel → dome plate → overlay ENR medium → feed every 2d → passage day 5–7
briefSteps.zh: 分离小肠 → 刮除绒毛 → EDTA解离 → 过滤隐窝 → 洗涤沉淀 → 重悬于Matrigel → 铺穹顶 → 加ENR培养基 → 每2天换液 → 第5–7天传代

detailedSteps.en: Tissue Isolation
detailedSteps.zh: 组织分离

detailedSteps.en: 1. Sacrifice mouse by CO2 asphyxiation or cervical dislocation per IACUC-approved protocol. Under sterile conditions, open abdomen, excise 10–15 cm of proximal small intestine (starting ~1 cm distal to pylorus). Flush lumen twice with 10 mL ice-cold PBS using a blunt-end gavage needle to remove intestinal contents.
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 依据IACUC批准方案，通过CO2窒息或颈椎脱臼处死小鼠。在无菌条件下打开腹腔，切取幽门远端约1 cm处起始的10–15 cm近端小肠。用钝端灌胃针注入10 mL冰冷PBS冲洗肠腔两次，去除肠道内容物。

detailedSteps.en: 2. Cut intestine open longitudinally with scissors. Lay flat on a cold surface and use a glass coverslip held at 45° to scrape off mucus and villi with 5–6 firm strokes. Transfer tissue to a 50 mL conical and wash 5× with 20 mL ice-cold PBS, inverting gently each time, until the supernatant is clear and no longer cloudy.
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 用剪刀沿纵轴剪开肠管。平铺于冷台面上，以45°角持玻璃盖玻片刮除黏液和绒毛（5–6次有力刮擦）。将组织转入50 mL离心管，用20 mL冰冷PBS洗涤5次，每次轻柔翻转，直至上清液澄清不再浑浊。

detailedSteps.en: Crypt Isolation
detailedSteps.zh: 隐窝分离

detailedSteps.en: 3. Transfer tissue to 10 mL of 2 mM EDTA in PBS (pH 7.4, ice-cold) in a 15 mL conical tube. Rock gently on a rotating mixer at 4°C for 30 min to chelate calcium and disrupt crypt-villus junctions. After incubation, remove the tube and shake vigorously by hand for 2–3 min (approximately 100 shakes) to mechanically release crypts from the tissue.
detailedSteps.zh: 3. 将组织转入15 mL离心管中的10 mL 2 mM EDTA/PBS（pH 7.4，冰冷）。在4°C旋转混合仪上轻柔摇动30 min，以螯合钙离子并破坏隐窝-绒毛连接。孵育后，取出离心管用手剧烈振荡2–3 min（约100次），机械性释放隐窝。

detailedSteps.en: 4. Filter the crypt suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer into a new 50 mL conical tube. Inspect an aliquot (10 μL) under a brightfield microscope at 10× magnification. Crypts appear as compact, oval structures comprising 20–50 cells with a distinct lumen; villi fragments are elongated and finger-like. Discard fractions that contain predominantly villi.
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 将隐窝悬液经70 μm细胞滤网过滤至新的50 mL离心管中。取10 μL在10倍亮场显微镜下检查。隐窝呈紧密卵圆形结构，含20–50个细胞，具有明显管腔；绒毛片段则呈细长指状。丢弃主要含绒毛的组分。

detailedSteps.en: 5. Centrifuge crypt suspension at 200×g for 3 min at 4°C. Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant without disturbing the pellet. Resuspend pellet in 10 mL ice-cold Advanced DMEM/F12. Repeat centrifugation and wash 2–3 times until the supernatant is clear, indicating removal of single cells and debris.
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 将隐窝悬液于4°C以200×g离心3 min。小心吸去上清液，勿扰动沉淀。将沉淀重悬于10 mL冰冷Advanced DMEM/F12。重复离心和洗涤2–3次，直至上清液澄清，表明单细胞和碎片已被去除。

detailedSteps.en: Matrigel Embedding and Plating
detailedSteps.zh: Matrigel包埋与铺板

detailedSteps.en: 6. After final wash, resuspend crypt pellet in a small volume of cold Advanced DMEM/F12 and count crypts using a hemocytometer. Calculate volume needed for 500 crypts/100 μL. Resuspend crypts at the appropriate concentration in ice-cold 50:50 mixture of growth-factor-reduced, phenol-red-free Matrigel and Advanced DMEM/F12. Keep all materials on ice at all times to prevent premature gelation.
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 最终洗涤后，将隐窝沉淀重悬于少量冰冷Advanced DMEM/F12中，并用血细胞计数板计数。计算500隐窝/100 μL所需体积。将隐窝以适当浓度重悬于冰冷的50:50无生长因子无酚红Matrigel与Advanced DMEM/F12混合液中。全程保持材料置于冰上，防止过早凝胶化。

detailedSteps.en: 7. Pre-warm a 24-well tissue culture plate at 37°C for at least 10 min. Working quickly on ice, pipette 50 μL of the crypt–Matrigel suspension per well, forming a dome shape in the center. Immediately transfer the plate to a 37°C incubator and incubate for 5 min to allow Matrigel to solidify completely. Do not disturb the plate during solidification.
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 将24孔培养板在37°C预热至少10 min。在冰上迅速移液，每孔加入50 μL隐窝–Matrigel悬液，在孔中央形成穹顶形。立即将培养板转至37°C培养箱孵育5 min，使Matrigel完全凝固。凝固过程中不要移动培养板。

detailedSteps.en: 8. Once the Matrigel dome has solidified, gently overlay with 500 μL pre-warmed ENR medium per well. ENR composition: Advanced DMEM/F12 supplemented with 1× GlutaMAX, 10 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 100 U/mL Penicillin/Streptomycin, 1× N2 supplement, 1× B27 supplement (without vitamin A), 50 ng/mL murine EGF (E), 100 ng/mL recombinant Noggin (N), and 500 ng/mL recombinant R-spondin1 (R) or 10% Rspo1-conditioned medium. Return plate to 37°C, 5% CO2.
detailedSteps.zh: 8. Matrigel穹顶凝固后，每孔轻柔加入500 μL预温ENR培养基。ENR配方：Advanced DMEM/F12 + 1× GlutaMAX + 10 mM HEPES（pH 7.4）+ 100 U/mL 青/链霉素 + 1× N2补充剂 + 1× B27补充剂（不含维生素A）+ 50 ng/mL 鼠源EGF（E）+ 100 ng/mL 重组Noggin（N）+ 500 ng/mL 重组R-spondin1（R）或10%条件培养基。将培养板置于37°C、5% CO2培养箱。

detailedSteps.en: Maintenance and Passaging
detailedSteps.zh: 维持培养与传代

detailedSteps.en: 9. Change medium every 2 days by gently aspirating spent medium and adding 500 μL fresh ENR. Avoid disturbing the Matrigel dome. Organoids will begin forming visible buds with crypt-like domains (budding organoids) within 3–5 days. Organoid efficiency is typically 10–40% of plated crypts. Healthy organoids are translucent with a clear lumen and multiple crypt domains; dark, amorphous structures indicate dying organoids and should be noted.
detailedSteps.zh: 9. 每2天换液一次：轻柔吸去废培养基，加入500 μL新鲜ENR。避免触碰Matrigel穹顶。类器官在3–5天内开始形成可见芽状结构（出芽类器官）和隐窝样区域。类器官形成效率通常为铺板隐窝的10–40%。健康类器官呈半透明状，具有清晰管腔和多个隐窝域；暗色无定形结构表示类器官正在死亡。

detailedSteps.en: 10. Passage organoids every 5–7 days (or when organoids fill the dome and show signs of necrosis). To passage: add 1 mL ice-cold Advanced DMEM/F12 per well and pipette vigorously 100× to dissolve Matrigel and mechanically fragment organoids. Transfer to 15 mL conical, centrifuge at 400×g for 5 min at 4°C. Aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in fresh cold Matrigel mixture, and re-embed at a 1:3–1:5 split ratio. Do not over-fragment or passage ratio will drop.
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 每5–7天传代一次（或当类器官充满穹顶并出现坏死迹象时）。传代方法：每孔加入1 mL冰冷Advanced DMEM/F12，用力吹打100次以溶解Matrigel并机械性打碎类器官。转移至15 mL离心管，于4°C以400×g离心5 min。吸去上清液，将沉淀重悬于新鲜冷Matrigel混合液，以1:3–1:5的比例传代。避免过度打碎，否则传代效率会下降。

name: Lentivirus Concentration by PEG Precipitation and Ultracentrifugation
nameCn: PEG 沉淀结合超速离心浓缩慢病毒

components.name: 1. Collect lentiviral supernatant and filter through 0.45 µm membrane

note.en: Remove cells and debris before concentration.
note.zh: 先去除细胞和碎片，再进行浓缩。

components.name: 2. Add 40% PEG stock to final PEG concentration of 10%; incubate on ice for 3–6 h

note.en: Mix gently but thoroughly. Avoid foaming.
note.zh: 轻柔但充分混匀，避免起泡。

note.en: A visible pellet may be loose; handle carefully after spin.
note.zh: 沉淀可能较松散，离心后操作要轻。

components.name: 4. Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in PBS using 1/20 of the original sample volume

note.en: Resuspend completely before the next concentration step.
note.zh: 进入下一步前要把沉淀充分重悬。

components.name: 5. Transfer resuspended virus into sterile ultracentrifuge tube and balance with PBS

note.en: Use matched tubes and precise balancing for rotor safety.
note.zh: 使用配对离心管并精确配平，保证转头安全。

components.name: 6. Load tubes into SW 32 Ti buckets

note.en: Keep samples cold and use the rotor limits recommended by the manufacturer.
note.zh: 全程低温操作，并遵守转头厂家规定的转速上限。

components.name: 8. Carefully remove supernatant without disturbing viral pellet

note.en: Decant or aspirate slowly; the pellet may be invisible.
note.zh: 可缓慢倒出或吸走上清；病毒沉淀可能肉眼不明显。

components.name: 9. Resuspend pellet in PBS or viral storage buffer and pool samples if needed

note.en: Use the smallest practical volume to maximize final titer.
note.zh: 尽量用较小体积重悬，以获得更高终滴度。

note.en: Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
note.zh: 避免反复冻融。

notes.en: This method is useful when the starting lentiviral titer is not enough for primary cells or otherwise difficult-to-infect targets. PEG precipitation is convenient but may co-precipitate proteins and impurities, so the follow-up ultracentrifugation step helps improve concentration and cleanliness. If maximum purity is more important than convenience, a sucrose cushion method is often preferable.
notes.zh: 当原始慢病毒滴度不足以感染原代细胞或其他难感染细胞时，此法很实用。PEG 沉淀操作方便，但也容易把蛋白和杂质一起沉下来，因此后续超速离心有助于进一步提高浓度和纯度。如果更看重纯度而不是操作便捷性，通常更推荐蔗糖垫液法。

ref: Tiscornia et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:241–245; Boroujeni & Gardaneh (2018) Mol Biotechnol 60:185–193

usage.en: Concentrate lentiviral supernatant by PEG precipitation followed by ultracentrifugation when higher titer is needed for difficult-to-infect cells.
usage.zh: 使用 PEG 沉淀结合超速离心浓缩慢病毒上清，在原代细胞或难感染细胞需要更高滴度时使用。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 6–10 hours，实操: 1–1.5 hours

note.en: PEG 8000 is most common; PEG 6000 or PEG 4000 can also be used if already validated in-house.
note.zh: 最常用 PEG8000；若实验室已有验证方案，也可使用 PEG6000 或 PEG4000。

materials.name: SW 32 Ti rotor or equivalent swing-bucket rotor

note.en: PEG-mixed supernatant can remain on ice or at 4°C for several hours before centrifugation.
note.zh: 加入 PEG 后的病毒上清可在冰上或 4°C 放置数小时后再离心。
