note.en: Aliquoted virus can be stored at −80°C for long-term use; avoid multiple freeze-thaw cycles.
note.zh: 分装后的病毒可长期保存在 −80°C；避免多次冻融。

briefSteps.en: Filter supernatant → add PEG to 10% and incubate on ice → centrifuge 2,000×g 30 min → resuspend pellet in 1/20 PBS → ultracentrifuge 100,000×g 90 min → resuspend → aliquot at −80°C
briefSteps.zh: 过滤病毒上清 → 加 PEG 至终浓度 10% 并冰上孵育 → 2,000×g 离心 30 min → 用 1/20 体积 PBS 重悬 → 100,000×g 超速离心 90 min → 重悬 → 分装后 −80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Preparation**
Collect lentiviral supernatant from producer cells and filter through a 0.45 µm membrane to remove cells and debris.
detailedSteps.zh: 收集包装细胞产生的慢病毒上清，并用 0.45 µm 滤膜过滤，去除细胞和细胞碎片。

detailedSteps.en: Add 40% PEG stock solution to the filtered supernatant so that the final PEG concentration is 10%. PEG 8000 is most common, but PEG 6000 or PEG 4000 may also be used if validated. Mix gently and incubate on ice for 3–6 h.
detailedSteps.zh: 向过滤后的病毒上清中加入 40% PEG 母液，使最终 PEG 浓度达到 10%。最常用的是 PEG8000，若实验室已有验证也可用 PEG6000 或 PEG4000。轻柔混匀后在冰上孵育 3–6 小时。

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge the PEG-incubated supernatant at 2,000×g for 30 min to pellet the PEG-precipitated viral material.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 PEG 处理后的病毒上清以 2,000×g 离心 30 min，使 PEG 沉淀下来的病毒物质成团。

detailedSteps.en: Carefully discard the supernatant. Resuspend the pellet thoroughly in PBS using 1/20 of the original sample volume.
detailedSteps.zh: 小心弃去上清。用 PBS 以原始样品体积的 1/20 充分重悬沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: **Ultracentrifugation**
detailedSteps.zh: **超速离心**

detailedSteps.en: Transfer the resuspended virus into pre-sterilized ultracentrifuge tubes and balance with PBS. Place tubes into SW 32 Ti buckets.
detailedSteps.zh: 将重悬后的病毒样品转入预先灭菌的超速离心管中，并用 PBS 配平。将离心管放入 SW 32 Ti 吊桶。

detailedSteps.en: Load the SW 32 Ti rotor into an ultracentrifuge such as Optima XPN-100 and centrifuge at 100,000×g (about 24,500 rpm) for 90 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 将 SW 32 Ti 转头装入超速离心机（如 Optima XPN-100），以 100,000×g（约 24,500 rpm）离心 90 min。

detailedSteps.en: Carefully decant or aspirate the supernatant. Do not disturb the viral pellet, which may be faint or invisible.
detailedSteps.zh: 小心倾倒或吸去上清，不要扰动病毒沉淀；沉淀可能很淡甚至肉眼不可见。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend the pellet in PBS or viral storage buffer. Pool samples from multiple tubes if desired, using the smallest practical volume.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 PBS 或病毒保存液重悬沉淀。如有需要，可将多个管中的样品合并，并尽量使用较小体积。

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot the concentrated virus into single-use tubes and store at −80°C. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles because they reduce infectivity.
detailedSteps.zh: 将浓缩后的病毒分装成单次使用小份，置于 −80°C 保存。避免反复冻融，因为这会降低感染活性。

name: Lentivirus Concentration by Sucrose Cushion Ultracentrifugation
nameCn: 蔗糖垫液超速离心浓缩慢病毒

components.name: 1. Collect lentiviral supernatant and filter through 0.45 µm membrane

note.en: Remove cells and debris before loading onto the cushion.
note.zh: 上样到蔗糖垫液前，先去除细胞和碎片。

components.name: 2. Add 3–5 mL of sterile 20% sucrose cushion to the bottom of the ultracentrifuge tube

note.en: Underlay carefully to keep a clean cushion interface.
note.zh: 沿管底小心加样，尽量保持清晰界面。

components.name: 3. Layer viral supernatant gently on top of the sucrose cushion
4. Balance tubes and place into ultracentrifuge buckets

note.en: Use no brake if your rotor and workflow benefit from gentler deceleration.
note.zh: 如设备与流程允许，建议不刹车减速，以减少界面扰动。

components.name: 6. Carefully remove supernatant without losing viral pellet

note.en: The pellet may be nearly invisible.
note.zh: 病毒沉淀可能几乎看不见。

components.name: 7. Add PBS or viral storage buffer to resuspend pellet; optionally dissolve at 4°C for 2 h with gentle mixing every 20 min

note.en: Gentle resuspension preserves infectivity and avoids foaming.
note.zh: 轻柔重悬有助于保持感染活性，并避免起泡。

components.name: 8. Aliquot concentrated virus and store at −80°C

note.en: Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
note.zh: 避免反复冻融。

notes.en: A sucrose cushion helps reduce mechanical stress on lentiviral particles and usually yields cleaner preparations than simple chemical precipitation. This method is especially useful when transducing sensitive cells or when downstream assays are affected by protein contaminants. Keep the workflow cold and avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles after concentration.
notes.zh: 蔗糖垫液有助于减轻慢病毒颗粒在离心过程中的机械损伤，通常比单纯化学沉淀得到更干净的制备物。对于敏感细胞转导，或下游实验容易受蛋白杂质干扰的情况，这种方法尤其合适。整个流程尽量保持低温，浓缩后避免反复冻融。

ref: Boroujeni & Gardaneh (2018) Mol Biotechnol 60:185–193; Jiang et al. (2015) Sci Rep 5:13875

usage.en: Concentrate lentiviral particles through a 20% sucrose cushion when higher purity and preservation of particle integrity are desired.
usage.zh: 当希望获得更高纯度并尽量保持病毒颗粒完整性时，使用 20% 蔗糖垫液超速离心浓缩慢病毒。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–5 hours，实操: 45–60 minutes

note.en: Prepare sterile 20% sucrose in PBS or other compatible virus storage buffer.
note.zh: 使用无菌 20% 蔗糖溶液，溶于 PBS 或其他兼容的病毒保存液。

note.en: Filtered viral supernatant can be kept at 4°C briefly before ultracentrifugation, but process the same day for best infectivity.
note.zh: 过滤后的病毒上清可在 4°C 短暂放置后再超速离心，但最好当天处理以保持感染活性。

note.en: Aliquoted concentrated virus can be stored at −80°C for long-term use; avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
note.zh: 分装后的浓缩病毒可长期保存在 −80°C；避免多次冻融。

briefSteps.en: Filter supernatant → underlay 3–5 mL 20% sucrose cushion → layer virus on top → ultracentrifuge 125,000×g 90 min at 4°C → remove supernatant → resuspend pellet → aliquot at −80°C
briefSteps.zh: 过滤病毒上清 → 管底加入 3–5 mL 20% 蔗糖垫液 → 将病毒上清铺在上层 → 4°C、125,000×g 离心 90 min → 去上清 → 重悬沉淀 → 分装后 −80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Preparation**
Collect lentiviral supernatant and filter through a 0.45 µm membrane to remove cells and debris.
detailedSteps.zh: 收集慢病毒上清，并用 0.45 µm 滤膜过滤，去除细胞和细胞碎片。

detailedSteps.en: In a sterile ultracentrifuge tube, carefully underlay 3–5 mL of sterile 20% sucrose cushion solution at the bottom of the tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 在无菌超速离心管底部小心加入 3–5 mL 无菌 20% 蔗糖垫液。

detailedSteps.en: Gently layer the filtered viral supernatant above the sucrose cushion without disturbing the interface.
detailedSteps.zh: 将过滤后的病毒上清轻轻铺在蔗糖垫液上方，尽量不要扰动界面。

detailedSteps.en: Balance the ultracentrifuge tubes carefully and load them into the buckets.
detailedSteps.zh: 仔细配平超速离心管，并装入吊桶。

detailedSteps.en: **Ultracentrifugation**
detailedSteps.zh: **超速离心**

detailedSteps.en: Ultracentrifuge at 125,000×g for 90 min at 4°C. If appropriate for the rotor and workflow, use gentle deceleration or no brake to minimize disturbance of the cushion interface.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 4°C 下以 125,000×g 超速离心 90 min。如设备与流程适用，可使用缓慢减速或不刹车，以减少对蔗糖界面的扰动。

detailedSteps.en: After centrifugation, carefully decant or aspirate the supernatant. Do not lose the viral pellet at the bottom of the tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 离心结束后，小心倾倒或吸去上清，不要丢失管底的病毒沉淀。

detailedSteps.en: Add PBS or another viral storage buffer to the pellet. For gentler recovery, allow the pellet to dissolve at 4°C for up to 2 h, gently mixing every 20 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 向沉淀中加入 PBS 或其他病毒保存液。为更温和地回收病毒，可在 4°C 放置最多 2 h，每 20 min 轻轻混匀一次，使其逐渐溶解。

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot the concentrated virus into single-use tubes and store at −80°C.
detailedSteps.zh: 将浓缩病毒分装成单次使用小份，并保存于 −80°C。

name: Oxford Nanopore Ligation Sequencing Library Preparation (SQK-LSK114)
nameCn: 牛津纳米孔连接测序文库制备（SQK-LSK114）

components.name: 1. DNA QC: Qubit dsDNA BR quantification (≥1 μg in ≤45 μL); TapeStation integrity check (DIN >8 for WGS)
2. Optional DNA shearing: Megaruptor or g-TUBE at 1500 rpm × 2 min to target 20–50 kb fragments (skip for amplicons)
3. DNA repair: NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix; 37°C 30 min (if FFPE input)
4. End-prep: NEBNext Ultra II End Repair/dA-Tail Module; 20°C 5 min → 65°C 5 min
5. SPRI cleanup (1× AMPure XP beads): 5 min bind, magnet pellet, 2× 70% EtOH wash, elute in 61 μL nuclease-free water
6. Adapter ligation: LAVT adapter + NEBNext Quick Ligation Buffer + Quick T4 DNA Ligase; room temperature 10 min
7. Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) cleanup: 0.3× AMPure XP + 2× SFB wash; removes short fragments and free adapters
8. Elution and QC: elute in 15 μL EB; Qubit quantification of final library (target ≥5 ng/μL, ≥20 fmol)
9. Flow cell priming: flush MinION/PromethION flow cell with priming mix (FLB + FLT); equilibrate 5 min
10. Sequencing mix preparation: 12 μL library + 37.5 μL SQB + 25.5 μL LB; load dropwise via SpotON port
11. MinKNOW run setup: select flow cell, kit SQK-LSK114, basecalling config (super accuracy or high accuracy); start sequencing run

notes.en: Use lo-bind (DNA lo-bind) microcentrifuge tubes throughout to minimize DNA loss, especially for dilute or precious samples. | Do NOT vortex after adapter ligation — the motor protein attached to LAVT is sensitive to mechanical shearing. | Loading Beads (LB) must be vortexed immediately before use; they settle rapidly and uneven loading reduces active pore count. | For DNA inputs <1 μg, reduce input to 200–500 ng with adjusted AMPure bead volumes, but expect lower output and potentially lower N50. | Check flow cell pore count before loading: R10.4.1 flow cells should show ≥800 active pores; below 500 significantly impacts output. | SFB wash step is critical — do NOT substitute with 70% ethanol at this stage, as ethanol will remove adapter-ligated molecules.
notes.zh: 全程使用低吸附（DNA lo-bind）微量离心管，以减少DNA损失，尤其是稀释样品或珍贵样品。 | 接头连接后切勿涡旋——LAVT上预装的马达蛋白对机械剪切力敏感。 | 上样磁珠（LB）必须在使用前立即涡旋；磁珠沉降迅速，分布不均会降低活性孔数量。 | 若输入DNA不足1 μg，可将投入量降至200–500 ng并相应调整AMPure磁珠用量，但预期产出和N50可能降低。 | 上样前检查流动池孔数：R10.4.1流动池应显示≥800个活性孔；低于500个会显著影响产出。 | SFB洗涤步骤至关重要——此步骤切勿用70%乙醇代替，乙醇会洗脱掉已连接接头的分子。

ref: Oxford Nanopore Technologies. (2023). Ligation sequencing DNA V14 (SQK-LSK114). Protocol document EXP-PTC114 v114_revJ_26Oct2023.

usage.en: Prepare Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing libraries from high-molecular-weight DNA for whole genome sequencing, amplicon sequencing, and metagenomic applications using the SQK-LSK114 ligation kit. Enables sequencing on MinION, GridION, and PromethION platforms.
usage.zh: Prepare Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing libraries from high-molecular-weight DNA for whole genome sequencing, amplicon sequencing, and metagenomic applications using the SQK-LSK114 ligation kit. Enables sequencing on MinION, GridION, and PromethION platforms.

note.en: Safe stop: after SPRI cleanup post end-prep, end-prepped DNA can be stored at -20°C overnight (or up to 1 week). Thaw on ice and proceed to adapter ligation the next day.
note.zh: 安全停点：末端制备后SPRI纯化完成后，end-prepped DNA可在-20°C保存过夜（或最长1周）。次日取出置冰上解冻后继续进行接头连接。

note.en: Safe stop: final library can be stored at 4°C for up to 1 week or at -20°C for longer-term storage (avoid repeated freeze-thaw). Add 0.5× volume of EB before freezing to reduce adapter damage.
note.zh: 安全停点：最终文库可在4°C保存最长1周，或在-20°C长期保存（避免反复冻融）。冻存前可加入0.5×体积的洗脱缓冲液以减少接头损伤。

briefSteps.en: DNA QC (Qubit + TapeStation) → optional shearing (g-TUBE 1500 rpm) → end repair/dA-tail (20°C→65°C) → 1× SPRI cleanup → adapter ligation (LAVT, 10 min RT) → 0.3× SPRI + SFB wash → elute 15 μL → prime flow cell → load library → start MinKNOW
briefSteps.zh: DNA质控（Qubit + TapeStation）→ 可选剪切（g-TUBE 1500 rpm）→ 末端修复/加A尾（20°C→65°C）→ 1× SPRI纯化 → 接头连接（LAVT，室温10 min）→ 0.3× SPRI + SFB洗涤 → 洗脱15 μL → 冲洗流动池 → 上样 → 启动MinKNOW

detailedSteps.en: 1. Input DNA Quality Control
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 输入DNA质量控制

detailedSteps.en: 1. Quantify input DNA using Qubit dsDNA BR Assay Kit. Require ≥1 μg total DNA in a volume of ≤45 μL. For WGS applications, assess DNA integrity by running on Agilent TapeStation (genomic DNA ScreenTape); target DIN score >8. Fragment size should ideally be ≥30 kb for optimal long-read performance.
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 使用Qubit dsDNA BR试剂盒对输入DNA进行定量，需要≥1 μg总量且体积≤45 μL。对于全基因组测序，使用Agilent TapeStation（基因组DNA ScreenTape）评估DNA完整性，目标DIN评分>8。理想片段大小≥30 kb，以获得最佳长读长性能。

detailedSteps.en: 2. Optional DNA Shearing (WGS only)
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 可选DNA剪切（仅限WGS）

detailedSteps.en: 2. For WGS with high-molecular-weight DNA, shear to 20–50 kb target size. Using Megaruptor 3: program appropriate shearing settings per manufacturer guidelines. Using g-TUBE (Covaris): centrifuge at 1500 rpm × 2 min in a fixed-angle rotor (repeat for both orientations if needed). For amplicon or targeted sequencing, skip this step entirely.
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 对于高分子量DNA的全基因组测序，剪切至20–50 kb目标片段大小。使用Megaruptor 3时按厂商指导设置剪切参数。使用g-TUBE（Covaris）时在固定角度转子中1500 rpm离心2 min（必要时双向重复）。扩增子或靶向测序跳过此步骤。

detailedSteps.en: 3. DNA Repair and End-Preparation
detailedSteps.zh: 3. DNA修复与末端制备

detailedSteps.en: 3. Prepare DNA repair reaction: combine ≤1 μg DNA (up to 47 μL) + 3.5 μL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Buffer + 2 μL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix + 3.5 μL Ultra II End-Prep Reaction Buffer + 3 μL Ultra II End-Prep Enzyme Mix (total 60 μL). Incubate: 20°C 5 min (end repair/dA-tailing), then 65°C 5 min (enzyme inactivation). Place on ice immediately after.
detailedSteps.zh: 3. 配制DNA修复反应体系：≤1 μg DNA（最多47 μL）+ 3.5 μL NEBNext FFPE DNA修复缓冲液 + 2 μL NEBNext FFPE DNA修复酶混合液 + 3.5 μL Ultra II末端制备反应缓冲液 + 3 μL Ultra II末端制备酶混合液（共60 μL）。孵育：20°C 5 min（末端修复/加A尾），65°C 5 min（酶灭活）。完成后立即置冰上。

detailedSteps.en: 4. SPRI Bead Cleanup After End-Prep
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 末端制备后的SPRI磁珠纯化

detailedSteps.en: 4. Add 60 μL resuspended AMPure XP beads (1× ratio) to 60 μL end-prepped DNA. Mix thoroughly by pipetting ≥10 times. Incubate 5 min at room temperature. Place on magnet 2 min until supernatant clears. Remove and discard supernatant. Wash pellet twice with 200 μL freshly prepared 70% ethanol (do not disturb pellet; discard wash). Air-dry briefly (30–60 s; do not over-dry). Elute in 61 μL nuclease-free water by pipetting; incubate 2 min at room temperature; transfer to clean tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 向60 μL末端制备产物中加入60 μL重悬的AMPure XP磁珠（1×比例），吸打≥10次充分混匀。室温孵育5 min。置于磁铁上2 min至上清澄清。吸弃上清。用200 μL新鲜配制的70%乙醇洗涤磁珠两次（勿扰动磁珠；弃去洗涤液）。短暂风干30–60 s（勿过干）。加入61 μL无核酸酶水，吸打洗脱，室温孵育2 min，转移至新管。

detailedSteps.en: 5. Adapter Ligation
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 接头连接

detailedSteps.en: 5. To 61 μL cleaned DNA add: 5 μL NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (5×), 10 μL LAVT Ligation Adapter (from SQK-LSK114 kit), 20 μL Quick T4 DNA Ligase (total 96 μL). Mix gently by flicking; do NOT vortex. Incubate at room temperature for 10 min. The LAVT adapter contains a motor protein pre-loaded for nanopore translocation.
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 向61 μL纯化DNA中加入：5 μL NEBNext Quick连接反应缓冲液（5×）、10 μL LAVT连接接头（来自SQK-LSK114试剂盒）、20 μL Quick T4 DNA连接酶（共96 μL）。轻弹管壁混匀，切勿涡旋。室温孵育10 min。LAVT接头已预装马达蛋白，用于纳米孔转位。

detailedSteps.en: 6. Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) Cleanup
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 短片段缓冲液（SFB）纯化

detailedSteps.en: 6. Add 40 μL resuspended AMPure XP beads (0.3× volume relative to 96 μL reaction = ~29 μL beads) — use 0.3× ratio to retain long fragments and exclude short fragments. Incubate 5 min room temperature. Pellet on magnet 2 min. Discard supernatant. Wash pellet TWICE with 250 μL Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) from kit — SFB selectively removes unligated adapters and short fragments while preserving large adapter-ligated DNA. Air-dry 30 s.
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 向96 μL连接反应中加入约29 μL重悬AMPure XP磁珠（0.3×比例），以保留长片段并去除短片段。室温孵育5 min。磁铁上静置2 min。弃去上清。用250 μL Short Fragment Buffer（SFB，来自试剂盒）洗涤磁珠两次——SFB可选择性去除未连接接头和短片段，同时保留大分子接头连接DNA。风干30 s。

detailedSteps.en: 7. Library Elution and Final QC
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 文库洗脱与最终质控

detailedSteps.en: 7. Elute library in 15 μL Elution Buffer (EB) from kit. Pipette to mix; incubate 10 min at 37°C to maximize recovery. Pellet on magnet 2 min; transfer supernatant to clean 1.5 mL lo-bind tube. Quantify with Qubit dsDNA HS Assay. Target: ≥5 ng/μL (≥75 ng total in 15 μL), equivalent to ≥20 fmol for 10 kb mean library size. Optional: check fragment size distribution on TapeStation or Bioanalyzer.
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 用15 μL洗脱缓冲液（EB，来自试剂盒）洗脱文库，吸打混匀，37°C孵育10 min以最大化回收率。磁铁上静置2 min，将上清转移至新的1.5 mL低吸附管。使用Qubit dsDNA HS试剂盒定量。目标：≥5 ng/μL（15 μL中≥75 ng总量），对应10 kb均值文库≥20 fmol。可选：在TapeStation或Bioanalyzer上检查片段大小分布。

detailedSteps.en: 8. Flow Cell Priming
detailedSteps.zh: 8. 流动池冲洗

detailedSteps.en: 8. Thaw FLB (Flow Cell Buffer) and FLT (Flow Cell Tether) at room temperature. Prepare priming mix: 30 μL FLT into 1 tube FLB (1170 μL); mix by inversion. Open MinION/GridION flow cell priming port. Load 800 μL priming mix without introducing air bubbles. Wait 5 min to allow equilibration. Load remaining 200 μL priming mix. The SpotON port should show a small meniscus.
detailedSteps.zh: 8. 将FLB（流动池缓冲液）和FLT（流动池锚定剂）室温解冻。配制冲洗混合液：30 μL FLT加入1管FLB（1170 μL），倒置混匀。打开MinION/GridION流动池冲洗孔。加入800 μL冲洗混合液，勿引入气泡。等待5 min平衡。加入剩余200 μL冲洗混合液。SpotON孔应可见液面。

detailedSteps.en: 9. Sequencing Mix Preparation and Loading
detailedSteps.zh: 9. 测序混合液制备与上样

detailedSteps.en: 9. Prepare sequencing mix in a lo-bind tube: 37.5 μL Sequencing Buffer (SQB) + 25.5 μL Loading Beads (LB; mix LB thoroughly before use by vortexing) + 12 μL library (from step 7; adjust volume with EB if <12 μL). Mix gently by pipetting. Open the SpotON port on the flow cell. Pipette 75 μL total sequencing mix dropwise onto the SpotON port — do NOT introduce air. Close port after loading.
detailedSteps.zh: 9. 在低吸附管中配制测序混合液：37.5 μL测序缓冲液（SQB）+ 25.5 μL上样磁珠（LB；使用前充分涡旋混匀LB）+ 12 μL文库（来自步骤7；体积不足时用EB补至12 μL）。轻柔吸打混匀。打开流动池SpotON孔。将75 μL测序混合液逐滴加入SpotON孔——勿引入气泡。上样后关闭孔。

detailedSteps.en: 10. MinKNOW Run Configuration and Start
detailedSteps.zh: 10. MinKNOW运行配置与启动

detailedSteps.en: 10. In MinKNOW software: select flow cell position and verify flow cell type (e.g., FLO-MIN114 for R10.4.1). Select kit: SQK-LSK114. Configure basecalling: choose super accuracy (SUP) for highest accuracy or high accuracy (HAC) for faster processing. Set run duration (4–72 h depending on coverage target). Enable adaptive sampling (ReadFish) if targeting specific genomic regions. Click 'Start Run'.
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 在MinKNOW软件中：选择流动池位置并确认流动池型号（如FLO-MIN114对应R10.4.1孔型）。选择试剂盒：SQK-LSK114。配置碱基识别：选择超高精度（SUP）获得最高准确率，或高精度（HAC）加快处理速度。设置运行时长（4–72 h，取决于覆盖度目标）。如需靶向特定基因组区域，启用自适应采样（ReadFish）。点击【开始运行】。

name: Passaging Organoid Cultures

components.name: 1. Assess domes; add TrypLE to wells
6. Resuspend in 80% BME2 and plate as droplets
7. Set BME2 at 37°C, add medium, return to incubator

notes.en: Developed by the organoid derivation team at the Wellcome Sanger Institute, mainly for cancer organoids. Use low split ratios (1:2–1:3); passage to the same or fewer wells if organoids grow poorly. 5 mL Eppendorf tubes help maintain sterility. If pellets stay hazy with residual BME2, a cold-PBS wash and re-spin resolves it. Keeping a bottle of cold PBS in the fridge is handy.
notes.zh: 由 Wellcome Sanger 研究所类器官团队开发，主要用于癌症类器官。用低分传比（1:2–1:3）；生长不佳时传到相同或更少的孔。5 mL Eppendorf 管有助保持无菌。若沉淀因残余 BME2 发雾，用冷 PBS 洗一次再离心即可。冰箱常备一瓶冷 PBS 很方便。

ref: Rogers H, Letchford L, Vieira S, et al. Passaging cancer organoid cultures. protocols.io (Wellcome Sanger Institute)

usage.en: Dissociate and re-plate BME2/Matrigel-embedded organoids to expand a culture; use when domes are dense or organoids are large/dark-centred, not for single-cell dissociation (stop at small clumps to preserve viability).
usage.zh: 把包埋在基质胶（BME2/Matrigel）里的类器官解离并重新铺板以扩增培养；在圆顶致密、类器官变大或中心发暗时传代，不用于单细胞解离（解离到小细胞团即停，保活力）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–1.5 hours，实操: 45 min

materials.name: Organoid culture in BME2/Matrigel domes (6-well plate)
BME2 / Matrigel (basement membrane extract), kept on ice
Swinging-bucket centrifuge, 37°C incubator, microscope, cool block

note.en: No true stopping point — organoids should be moving through dissociation → plating in one continuous sitting. Do not leave dissociated organoids in TrypLE.
note.zh: 无真正的暂停点——解离→铺板应一次连续完成。不要让解离后的类器官长时间停留在 TrypLE 中。

briefSteps.en: TrypLE onto domes → detach & pipette out organoids → 37°C dissociate to small clumps → 800×g 2 min pellet → resuspend in 80% BME2 → plate 10–15 µL droplets → set 37°C 15–30 min → add medium
briefSteps.zh: TrypLE 加到圆顶 → 刮离并吹出类器官 → 37°C 解离成小团 → 800×g 2 min 成团 → 80% BME2 重悬 → 滴 10–15 µL 液滴 → 37°C 凝固 15–30 min → 加培养基

detailedSteps.en: **Dissociation**

Assess the domes under a microscope to decide split ratio (typically **1:2–1:3**; split to the same or fewer wells if organoids are growing slowly). Aspirate medium and add **1–2 mL TrypLE per well** of a 6-well plate. If domes have already detached, or there are many free-floating cells/organoids or attached fibroblasts, first collect medium + organoids into a tube and pellet before adding TrypLE.
detailedSteps.zh: 镜下评估圆顶以决定分传比例（通常 **1:2–1:3**；生长慢时传到相同或更少的孔）。吸去培养基，每孔（6 孔板）加 **1–2 mL TrypLE**。若圆顶已脱落、或培养基中有大量游离细胞/类器官或贴壁成纤维细胞，先把培养基+类器官收进管里离心成团，再加 TrypLE。

detailedSteps.en: Using a P1000, detach the BME2 domes from the plate (a **cell scraper** is recommended when passaging many plates). Pipette the suspension up and down several times to break organoids out of the BME2, then transfer to an appropriately sized tube with a P1000 or a 10 mL stripette.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 P1000 把 BME2 圆顶从板底刮离（传很多板时推荐用**细胞刮刀**）。反复吹打几次让类器官从 BME2 中脱出，再用 P1000 或 10 mL 血清移液管转入合适大小的管中。

detailedSteps.en: Wash the wells with **~1 mL TrypLE per well** to collect remaining organoids and add to the collection tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔再用 **~1 mL TrypLE** 冲洗，收集残余类器官并入收集管。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at **37°C**. Check under the microscope after 5 min, then as needed; pipette up and down with a P1000 to aid dissociation. **Stop when organoids are broken into small clumps of cells — avoid dissociating to single cells** (single cells hurt recovery).
detailedSteps.zh: **37°C** 温育。5 min 后镜检，随后按需查看；用 P1000 反复吹打助解离。**当类器官解离成小细胞团时即停——避免打成单细胞**（单细胞会降低恢复率）。
detailedSteps.warning: ⚠️ Over-digestion to single cells markedly reduces re-formation efficiency.

detailedSteps.en: **Pelleting & plating**
detailedSteps.zh: **离心与铺板**

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at **800 × g for 2 min**. Aspirate the supernatant, leaving the organoid pellet. If the suspension does not pellet cleanly or a grey BME2 haze sits above the pellet, aspirate as much as possible, resuspend in **ice-cold PBS**, and repeat the spin.
detailedSteps.zh: **800 × g 离心 2 min**。吸去上清，留下类器官沉淀。若不易成团、或沉淀上方有灰色 BME2 雾层，尽量吸除，用**冰冷 PBS** 重悬后再离心一次。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend the pellet in **80% BME2** (~**200 µL per well** of a 6-well plate). Resuspend in a small volume first to break up the pellet, then top up with BME2. **Keep BME2 cold** (use a cool block) — it sets at room temperature — and dispense quickly. Avoid bubbles.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 **80% BME2** 重悬沉淀（6 孔板每孔约 **200 µL**）。先用少量重悬打散沉淀，再补足 BME2。**BME2 全程保持低温**（用冷块）——室温会凝固——并尽快分装。避免气泡。

detailedSteps.en: Using a P200, dispense **200 µL organoid/BME2 per well** as **10–15 µL droplets**. Place the plate in a **37°C, 5% CO₂** incubator for **15–30 min** to let the BME2 set.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 P200 每孔滴 **200 µL 类器官/BME2**，做成 **10–15 µL 的小液滴**。将板放入 **37°C、5% CO₂** 培养箱 **15–30 min** 使 BME2 凝固。

detailedSteps.en: Add **2 mL of the appropriate organoid medium per well** and return to the incubator. Change medium twice a week until ready to passage again.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 **2 mL 相应类器官培养基**，放回培养箱。之后每周换液两次，直到可再次传代。

name: Prime Editing (PE2) — Precise Gene Editing without Double-Strand Breaks
nameCn: 先导编辑（PE2）——无双链断裂的精准基因组编辑

components.name: 1. Design pegRNA: identify target + PAM (NGG), design 20 nt spacer, RT template (desired edit + 10–15 nt downstream), and PBS (10–13 nt complementary to nicked strand 3' of nick); use PrimeDesign or BE-Designer
2. Clone pegRNA into pU6-pegRNA-GG-BSMBI scaffold or order synthetic pegRNA from IDT/Horizon
3. (PE3 optional) Design nicking sgRNA targeting non-edited strand ~40–90 bp from the pegRNA nick site; clone into pX330 or BbsI-digested vector
4. Transfect 300,000 target cells/24-well with 750 ng PE2 plasmid + 250 ng pegRNA plasmid + 250 ng nicking sgRNA using Lipofectamine 3000 (1 μL L3000 + 2 μL P3000 reagent/well)
5. Alternative RNP delivery: electroporate PE2 protein + IVT pegRNA ± nicking sgRNA using Neon (1200V, 20 ms, 2 pulses for HEK293T) or 4D-Nucleofector SE kit
6. Replace medium 24h post-transfection; culture 48–72h total for editing to complete
7. Harvest cells; extract genomic DNA using QuickExtract (Lucigen) or silica-column method; elute in TE or nuclease-free water
8. PCR amplify 300–500 bp amplicon spanning edit site using high-fidelity polymerase (Q5 or KAPA HiFi); verify amplicon by gel electrophoresis
9. Initial screen: Sanger sequence amplicon + analyze with EditR or ICE (Synthego); for quantification use amplicon deep sequencing (MiSeq 250PE, amplicons <400 bp)
10. Clone validation: single-cell sort or limiting dilution → expand clones → Sanger or amplicon-seq of both alleles; confirm protein-level change by Western blot if applicable

notes.en: Prime editing efficiency is highly site-dependent and typically ranges from 1–50% in HEK293T cells for PE2, increasing 2–5× with PE3 (nicking sgRNA). Optimize PBS length (Tm 30–45°C) and RT template length if efficiency is low. | Unintended indels at the nick site (from endogenous NHEJ repair of the PE nick) can occur at 1–10% frequency with PE3. If indels are problematic, use PE3b strategy: design nicking sgRNA that only cuts after the edit is installed (spacer overlaps edit site), reducing bystander indels. | For difficult cell types (neurons, hematopoietic cells, iPSCs), use electroporation of PE2 RNP + synthetic pegRNA (chemically modified with 2'-O-methyl and phosphorothioate at 3' terminus). Electroporation conditions must be optimized per cell type. | Always include appropriate controls: (1) cells transfected with PE2 + non-targeting pegRNA (scramble spacer) to assess off-target editing; (2) untransfected cells as baseline sequencing control; (3) cells transfected with pegRNA only (no PE2) to assess pegRNA-mediated template effects. | Check for pegRNA scaffold incorporation: a common artifact where reverse transcriptase reads through the pegRNA scaffold sequence, inserting scaffold-derived sequence at the edit site. Analyze amplicon-seq data with CRISPResso2 to detect this. Use epegRNA scaffold (with structured 3' end) to reduce scaffold incorporation.
notes.zh: 先导编辑效率高度位点依赖，在HEK293T细胞中PE2通常为1–50%，PE3（切口sgRNA）可提高2–5倍。若效率偏低，优化PBS长度（Tm 30–45°C）和RT模板长度。 | PE3中PE切口处的非预期插入缺失（来自内源性NHEJ修复）频率可达1–10%。若插入缺失影响实验，使用PE3b策略：设计仅在编辑安装后才切割的切口sgRNA（间隔序列与编辑位点重叠），以减少旁观者插入缺失。 | 对于难以操作的细胞类型（神经元、造血细胞、iPSCs），使用PE2 RNP + 合成pegRNA（3'端含2'-O-甲基和硫代磷酸酯化学修饰）进行电穿孔。电穿孔条件须针对不同细胞类型优化。 | 始终包括适当对照：（1）转染PE2 + 非靶向pegRNA（乱序间隔序列）的细胞，评估脱靶编辑；（2）未转染细胞作为基线测序对照；（3）仅转染pegRNA（不含PE2）的细胞，评估pegRNA介导的模板效应。 | 检查pegRNA支架序列整合这一常见伪迹：逆转录酶通读pegRNA支架序列，在编辑位点插入支架来源序列。使用CRISPResso2分析扩增子测序数据以检测此现象。使用epegRNA支架（含结构化3'端）以减少支架整合。

ref: Anzalone AV, Randolph PB, Davis JR, Sousa AA, Koblan LW, Levy JM, Chen PJ, Wilson C, Newby GA, Raguram A, Liu DR (2019). Search-and-replace genome editing without double-strand breaks or donor DNA. Nature. 576(7785):149–157.

usage.en: Install precise point mutations, small insertions (≤44 nt), or small deletions (≤80 nt) into the genome of mammalian cells without introducing double-strand breaks; used for disease variant modeling, correction of pathogenic mutations, functional annotation of genomic variants, and construction of isogenic cell lines
usage.zh: Install precise point mutations, small insertions (≤44 nt), or small deletions (≤80 nt) into the genome of mammalian cells without introducing double-strand breaks; used for disease variant modeling, correction of pathogenic mutations, functional annotation of genomic variants, and construction of isogenic cell lines

note.en: Sequence-verified pegRNA plasmid (or received synthetic pegRNA) can be stored at -20°C (plasmid) or -80°C (RNA) indefinitely. Proceed to transfection when ready.
note.zh: 序列验证后的pegRNA质粒（或收到的合成pegRNA）可无限期储存于-20°C（质粒）或-80°C（RNA）。准备好后再进行转染。

note.en: Cells at 48h post-transfection are actively editing but can be paused by replacing medium and continuing culture. Do not extend beyond 72h total as efficiency does not improve and cell passage effects accumulate.
note.zh: 转染后48h的细胞正在进行活跃编辑，可通过更换培养基继续培养来暂停操作。不要延长至总计72h以上，因为效率不会提高，且细胞传代效应会累积。

note.en: Extracted genomic DNA (gDNA) can be stored at -20°C for weeks or -80°C indefinitely. All downstream PCR and sequencing steps can be resumed from frozen gDNA at any time.
note.zh: 提取的基因组DNA（gDNA）可在-20°C储存数周，或在-80°C无限期保存。所有下游PCR和测序步骤均可在任何时间从冻存gDNA重新开始。

briefSteps.en: Design pegRNA (spacer + RT template + PBS) → clone/order pegRNA → transfect PE2 + pegRNA ± nicking sgRNA → change medium 24h → harvest gDNA at 72h → PCR amplify edit site → Sanger/ICE screen → amplicon-seq quantify → validate clones
briefSteps.zh: 设计pegRNA（间隔序列+RT模板+PBS）→ 克隆/订购pegRNA → 转染PE2 + pegRNA ± 切口sgRNA → 24h换液 → 72h收获gDNA → PCR扩增编辑位点 → Sanger/ICE筛查 → 扩增子深度测序定量 → 验证克隆

detailedSteps.en: pegRNA Design
detailedSteps.zh: pegRNA设计

detailedSteps.en: 1. Identify the target genomic site: locate an NGG PAM adjacent to the desired edit position. The PE2 spacer (20 nt) must target a strand whose nicking positions the 3' flap within ~1–3 nt of the edit. Use PrimeDesign (http://primedesign.pinellolab.org) or BE-Designer to automate candidate spacer, RT template, and PBS design. Key parameters: RT template length 10–30 nt (include 10–15 nt of unedited sequence 3' of the edit for context); PBS length 10–13 nt (Tm 30–45°C). For PE3 strategy, design a second nicking sgRNA targeting the non-edited strand 40–90 bp from the pegRNA nick, on the same side as the nick. Avoid guide sequences with predicted off-targets (check with Cas-OFFinder).
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 确定目标基因组位点：在目标编辑位置附近定位NGG PAM。PE2间隔序列（20 nt）必须靶向一条链，使其切口位置将3'悬臂定位于编辑位点~1–3 nt以内。使用PrimeDesign（http://primedesign.pinellolab.org）或BE-Designer自动设计候选间隔序列、RT模板和PBS。关键参数：RT模板长度10–30 nt（在编辑位点3'端包含10–15 nt未编辑序列作为背景）；PBS长度10–13 nt（Tm 30–45°C）。若采用PE3策略，设计第二个切口sgRNA，靶向非编辑链距pegRNA切口40–90 bp处，位于切口同侧。用Cas-OFFinder检查避免脱靶预测阳性的引导序列。

detailedSteps.en: pegRNA Cloning or Synthesis
detailedSteps.zh: pegRNA克隆或合成

detailedSteps.en: 2. Clone the pegRNA spacer into a pU6-pegRNA-GG-BSMBI expression vector (Addgene #132777) using Golden Gate assembly with BsmBI restriction enzyme. Anneal and phosphorylate spacer oligos (10 μM each oligo, T4 PNK, 37°C 30 min; ramp 95°C→25°C 5°C/min), then ligate into BsmBI-digested, gel-purified backbone. Transform into Stbl3 bacteria; sequence-verify with U6 promoter sequencing primer. Alternatively, order chemically modified synthetic pegRNA (Integrated DNA Technologies, Horizon Discovery) for faster turnaround; synthetic pegRNAs have improved stability due to 3' modifications.
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 使用BsmBI限制酶通过Golden Gate组装将pegRNA间隔序列克隆入pU6-pegRNA-GG-BSMBI表达载体（Addgene #132777）。退火并磷酸化间隔序列寡核苷酸（各10 μM，T4 PNK，37°C 30 min；以5°C/min从95°C降至25°C），然后连接入BsmBI酶切、凝胶纯化的骨架。转化至Stbl3感受态菌；使用U6启动子测序引物进行序列验证。也可订购化学修饰的合成pegRNA（Integrated DNA Technologies、Horizon Discovery），以缩短周转时间；合成pegRNA因3'端修饰而具有更高稳定性。

detailedSteps.en: 3. (PE3 strategy, optional but recommended for efficiency): Clone the nicking sgRNA spacer into a standard SpCas9-H840A nickase vector (e.g., Addgene #132778) or into a pX330 derivative encoding Cas9-H840A. Nicking the opposite strand ~40–90 bp from the primary nick stimulates the cell's mismatch repair machinery to preferentially incorporate the 3' flap sequence, increasing prime editing efficiency 2–5 fold. Validate nicking guide by TIDE or Sanger sequencing after transient transfection.
detailedSteps.zh: 3. （PE3策略，可选但推荐以提高效率）：将切口sgRNA间隔序列克隆入标准SpCas9-H840A切口酶载体（如Addgene #132778）或编码Cas9-H840A的pX330衍生物中。在主切口40–90 bp处切割对侧链，可刺激细胞错配修复机制优先整合3'悬臂序列，将先导编辑效率提高2–5倍。通过瞬时转染后的TIDE或Sanger测序验证切口引导RNA。

detailedSteps.en: Transfection
detailedSteps.zh: 转染

detailedSteps.en: 4. One day before transfection, seed 300,000 target cells per well of a 24-well plate in 500 μL antibiotic-free complete medium. For HEK293T cells: DMEM + 10% FBS. On transfection day, prepare Lipofectamine 3000 complex: in tube A, mix 1.5 μL Lipofectamine 3000 reagent in 25 μL Opti-MEM; in tube B, mix 750 ng PE2 plasmid (Addgene #132775) + 250 ng pegRNA plasmid + 250 ng nicking sgRNA plasmid (total 1.25 μg DNA) + 2.5 μL P3000 reagent in 25 μL Opti-MEM. Combine tubes A and B, vortex briefly, incubate 15 min at RT, then add dropwise to cells. For primary cells or hard-to-transfect lines, see step 5.
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 转染前一天，在24孔板每孔中以500 μL无抗生素完全培养基接种300,000个靶细胞。HEK293T细胞用DMEM + 10% FBS。转染当天，配制Lipofectamine 3000复合物：A管中，将1.5 μL Lipofectamine 3000试剂混入25 μL Opti-MEM；B管中，将750 ng PE2质粒（Addgene #132775）+ 250 ng pegRNA质粒 + 250 ng切口sgRNA质粒（总DNA 1.25 μg）+ 2.5 μL P3000试剂混入25 μL Opti-MEM。合并A管和B管，短暂涡旋，室温孵育15 min，然后逐滴加入细胞。难转染细胞系或原代细胞请参考步骤5。

detailedSteps.en: 5. RNP electroporation (alternative for primary cells or high-viability requirement): Produce or purchase recombinant PE2 protein (NEB M0658, Addgene pET28a-PE2 #132776). In vitro transcribe pegRNA and nicking sgRNA using HiScribe T7 kit; purify by column. Assemble RNP: mix 2 μg PE2 protein + 200 pmol pegRNA + 200 pmol nicking sgRNA in SE buffer; incubate 10 min on ice. Electroporate 200,000 cells in 20 μL SE solution using Neon Transfection System (1200V, 20 ms, 2 pulses for HEK293T) or Lonza 4D-Nucleofector (SE Cell Line kit, program CM-130 for HEK293T). Transfer immediately to pre-warmed antibiotic-free medium.
detailedSteps.zh: 5. RNP电穿孔（原代细胞或高细胞活力需求的替代方案）：生产或购买重组PE2蛋白（NEB M0658，Addgene pET28a-PE2 #132776）。使用HiScribe T7试剂盒体外转录pegRNA和切口sgRNA；柱纯化。组装RNP：在SE缓冲液中混合2 μg PE2蛋白 + 200 pmol pegRNA + 200 pmol切口sgRNA；冰上孵育10 min。使用Neon转染系统（HEK293T：1200V、20 ms、2脉冲）或Lonza 4D-Nucleofector（SE细胞系试剂盒，HEK293T程序CM-130）电穿孔20 μL SE溶液中的200,000个细胞。立即转移至预温无抗生素培养基中。

detailedSteps.en: Editing and Harvest
detailedSteps.zh: 编辑与收获

detailedSteps.en: 6. At 24h post-transfection, aspirate and replace medium with fresh complete medium (with antibiotics if desired). Continue culture for a total of 48–72h from transfection. Editing efficiency plateaus by 72h; longer culture does not substantially increase efficiency and may enrich for non-edited clones. Verify transfection efficiency at 24h using co-transfected GFP plasmid (should be >70% GFP+ for HEK293T) as a quality control.
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 转染后24h，吸去培养基并更换为新鲜完全培养基（如需可加入抗生素）。从转染开始继续培养共48–72h。编辑效率在72h时趋于平稳；更长培养时间不会显著提高效率，且可能富集未编辑克隆。在24h时使用共转染GFP质粒（HEK293T应>70% GFP+）作为质量控制，验证转染效率。

detailedSteps.en: 7. At 72h, harvest cells by trypsinization (0.25% Trypsin-EDTA, 3 min, 37°C); quench with complete medium; pellet at 300×g for 5 min. Extract genomic DNA using QuickExtract DNA Extraction Solution (Lucigen): resuspend pellet in 50 μL QuickExtract, incubate 65°C 6 min then 98°C 2 min. Alternatively, use a silica-column kit (Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue). Quantify DNA by NanoDrop. Elute in TE buffer or nuclease-free water; store at -20°C short-term or -80°C long-term.
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 72h时，用胰蛋白酶（0.25% Trypsin-EDTA，37°C 3 min）消化收获细胞；用完全培养基终止，300×g离心5 min收集沉淀。使用QuickExtract DNA提取液（Lucigen）提取基因组DNA：将沉淀重悬于50 μL QuickExtract，65°C孵育6 min，再98°C 2 min。也可使用硅胶柱试剂盒（Qiagen DNeasy血液与组织试剂盒）。用NanoDrop定量DNA。洗脱至TE缓冲液或无核酸酶水中；短期-20°C保存，长期-80°C保存。

detailedSteps.en: Analysis and Validation
detailedSteps.zh: 分析与验证

detailedSteps.en: 8. Design PCR primers flanking the edit site to generate a 300–500 bp amplicon; primers should be ≥50 bp from the edit and avoid repetitive sequences. Use a high-fidelity polymerase (NEB Q5 or Roche KAPA HiFi) to minimize PCR-introduced errors. PCR: 98°C 30s; 35 cycles of 98°C 10s / 65°C 30s / 72°C 20s; final 72°C 2 min. Run on 2% agarose gel to confirm single amplicon of correct size. Use 20–50 ng gDNA per reaction.
detailedSteps.zh: 8. 设计跨越编辑位点两侧的PCR引物，扩增300–500 bp产物；引物距编辑位点应≥50 bp，避免重复序列。使用高保真聚合酶（NEB Q5或罗氏KAPA HiFi）以减少PCR引入的错误。PCR程序：98°C 30s；35个循环（98°C 10s / 65°C 30s / 72°C 20s）；最终72°C 2 min。在2%琼脂糖凝胶上验证单一正确大小的扩增子。每反应使用20–50 ng基因组DNA。

detailedSteps.en: 9. Initial screening: Submit PCR amplicon for Sanger sequencing using a sequencing primer ~100 bp from the edit site. Upload .ab1 trace files to EditR (http://editr.medgenome.com) or ICE (Synthego) analysis tools to deconvolve mixed traces and quantify editing efficiency (% alleles edited). For accurate quantification or samples with <10% editing efficiency, proceed to amplicon deep sequencing: add Illumina adapter sequences via a second PCR step (2-step library prep) and sequence on MiSeq (2×250 PE reads). Analyze with CRISPResso2.
detailedSteps.zh: 9. 初步筛查：提交PCR扩增子进行Sanger测序，使用距编辑位点~100 bp的测序引物。将.ab1 trace文件上传至EditR（http://editr.medgenome.com）或ICE（Synthego）分析工具，解卷积混合测序峰并量化编辑效率（%等位基因编辑率）。若需精确定量或样品编辑效率<10%，进行扩增子深度测序：通过第二轮PCR添加Illumina接头序列（两步建库法），在MiSeq上测序（2×250 PE reads）。使用CRISPResso2分析数据。

detailedSteps.en: 10. Clone validation: Seed edited bulk cells by limiting dilution (0.3 cells/well) in 96-well plates, or single-cell sort by FACS into 96-well plates. Expand clones for 7–14 days. Extract gDNA from each clone using QuickExtract (20 μL/well). PCR amplify edit site and Sanger sequence. Identify heterozygous edits (dual peak in trace) vs. homozygous edits (single edited peak). For clones carrying the desired edit, perform amplicon deep sequencing to characterize both alleles precisely. If the edit changes protein function, confirm by Western blot, immunofluorescence, or functional assay. Screen 48–96 clones to identify biallelic edits (typically 5–20% of PE3-edited clones).
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 克隆验证：将编辑后的混合细胞以有限稀释法（0.3个细胞/孔）接种于96孔板，或通过FACS单细胞分选至96孔板。扩增克隆7–14天。使用QuickExtract（每孔20 μL）提取各克隆的基因组DNA。PCR扩增编辑位点并Sanger测序。识别杂合编辑（测序峰双峰）vs.纯合编辑（单一编辑峰）。对携带目标编辑的克隆进行扩增子深度测序，精确鉴定两个等位基因。若编辑改变蛋白质功能，通过Western blot、免疫荧光或功能实验确认。筛查48–96个克隆以鉴定双等位基因编辑克隆（通常占PE3编辑克隆的5–20%）。

name: RNA Immunoprecipitation (RIP)

components.name: 1. Harvest 2×10^7 cells in log phase; wash 2× with ice-cold PBS
2. Lyse in polysome lysis buffer (100 mM KCl, 5 mM MgCl2, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 0.5% NP-40, 1 mM DTT, 100 U/mL RNase inhibitor, 1× protease inhibitor cocktail); 4°C 10 min with rotation
3. Centrifuge lysate 13,000 × g, 4°C, 10 min; collect supernatant
4. Preclear lysate with 30 μL Protein A/G beads (blocked with BSA + yeast tRNA) at 4°C 1h rotating; centrifuge and collect precleared supernatant
5. Save 5% of precleared lysate as input RNA control; freeze at −80°C
6. Add 5–10 μg anti-RBP antibody (or IgG isotype control) to remaining lysate; rotate overnight at 4°C
7. Add 30 μL pre-washed Protein A/G beads; rotate 2h at 4°C to capture immune complexes
8. Wash beads 5× with NT2 buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM MgCl2, 0.05% NP-40); spin 1,000 × g 1 min each wash
9. Elute: resuspend beads in 100 μL NT2 + Proteinase K (100 μg/mL) + 0.1% SDS; incubate 55°C 30 min with shaking at 1,000 rpm
10. RNA extraction: add TRIzol to eluate (or column-based kit); include DNase I treatment (2 U, 37°C 20 min) to remove genomic DNA
11. Precipitate RNA: isopropanol + glycogen carrier; wash with 75% ethanol; resuspend in RNase-free H2O
12. Analyze co-precipitated RNA by qRT-PCR (RIP-qPCR) or prepare library for RNA-seq (RIP-seq)

notes.en: Always include a non-specific IgG isotype control immunoprecipitation in parallel to distinguish specific from background RNA enrichment. | Use RNase-free plasticware and filter tips throughout. Work quickly on ice to minimize RNA degradation. | Antibody quality is the most critical variable. Validate the antibody by western blot before RIP. The same lot of antibody should be used for all biological replicates. | For RIP-seq, input and IP libraries should be sequenced to ≥20M reads. Enrichment is typically reported as log2(IP/input) per gene after normalization. | Cell number can be adjusted: 1×10^7 cells is the minimum for low-abundance RBPs; scale up to 5×10^7 for weak interactions. Maintain the same buffer volumes proportionally. | For UV-CLIP or eCLIP applications that involve UV crosslinking, irradiate cells at 254 nm (0.15 J/cm2) on ice before lysis, and do NOT use formaldehyde fixation.
notes.zh: 实验中始终应设置非特异性 IgG 同型对照免疫沉淀组，以区分特异性富集与背景信号。 | 全程使用无 RNase 的耗材和滤芯吸头。操作应迅速，全程置于冰上，以减少 RNA 降解。 | 抗体质量是最关键的变量。使用前应通过 Western blot 验证抗体性能。所有生物学重复实验应使用同一批次抗体。 | 用于 RIP-seq 时，输入对照和 IP 文库的测序深度应各 ≥2000 万 reads。富集程度通常在标准化后以 log2(IP/input) 每基因的方式报告。 | 细胞数量可以调整：对于低丰度 RBP，最少需要 1×10^7 个细胞；弱相互作用可扩展至 5×10^7 个细胞。相应等比例调整缓冲液用量。 | 对于需要 UV 交联的 UV-CLIP 或 eCLIP 实验，应在裂解前在冰上用 254 nm 紫外线（0.15 J/cm²）照射细胞，且不得使用甲醛固定。

ref: Keene JD, Komisarow JM, Friedersdorf MB. (2006). RIP-Chip: the isolation and identification of mRNAs, microRNAs and protein components of ribonucleoprotein complexes from cell extracts. Nature Protocols

usage.en: RIP identifies RNA targets of a specific RNA-binding protein (RBP) in vivo. By immunoprecipitating the RBP along with its associated RNAs, and analyzing the co-precipitated RNA fraction by qRT-PCR or high-throughput sequencing (RIP-seq), researchers can comprehensively map the RNA interactome of the RBP. Commonly used to study post-transcriptional regulation, mRNA stability, splicing, and translational control.
usage.zh: RIP identifies RNA targets of a specific RNA-binding protein (RBP) in vivo. By immunoprecipitating the RBP along with its associated RNAs, and analyzing the co-precipitated RNA fraction by qRT-PCR or high-throughput sequencing (RIP-seq), researchers can comprehensively map the RNA interactome of the RBP. Commonly used to study post-transcriptional regulation, mRNA stability, splicing, and translational control.

note.en: After overnight antibody incubation, before adding beads: samples can be held at 4°C for up to 2h if bead capture cannot proceed immediately. Do not freeze at this stage.
note.zh: 完成过夜抗体孵育、加入磁珠之前：如不能立即进行磁珠捕获，样品可在 4°C 保存最多 2 小时。此阶段不可冷冻。

note.en: After 5× NT2 washes, beads can be held in 500 μL ice-cold NT2 buffer at 4°C for up to 2h before proceeding to Proteinase K elution.
note.zh: 完成 5 次 NT2 缓冲液洗涤后，磁珠可重悬于 500 μL 冰冷 NT2 缓冲液中，在 4°C 保存最多 2 小时，再进行 Proteinase K 洗脱。

briefSteps.en: Cell harvest → lysis (polysome buffer, 4°C 10 min) → centrifuge → preclear (Protein A/G beads, 1h) → save 5% input → antibody incubation (overnight 4°C) → bead capture (2h 4°C) → 5× NT2 wash → Proteinase K elution (55°C 30 min) → RNA extraction + DNase → qRT-PCR or RNA-seq
briefSteps.zh: 细胞收获 → 裂解（多核糖体裂解缓冲液，4°C 10 分钟）→ 离心 → 预清除（Protein A/G 磁珠，1 小时）→ 保留 5% 输入对照 → 抗体孵育（4°C 过夜）→ 磁珠捕获（4°C 2 小时）→ NT2 缓冲液洗涤 5 次 → Proteinase K 洗脱（55°C 30 分钟）→ RNA 提取 + DNase 处理 → qRT-PCR 或 RNA-seq

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Cell Lysis and Preclearing
detailedSteps.zh: 第 1 天：细胞裂解与预清除

detailedSteps.en: 1. Grow cells to log phase. Harvest 2×10^7 cells by scraping or trypsinization. Wash twice with ice-cold PBS (5 mL each). Pellet at 300 × g, 4°C, 5 min. Aspirate PBS completely.
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 将细胞培养至对数生长期。收获 2×10^7 个细胞（刮取法或胰酶消化法）。用冰冷 PBS（每次 5 mL）洗涤两次，300 × g、4°C 离心 5 分钟。彻底吸去 PBS。

detailedSteps.en: 2. Resuspend pellet in 1 mL polysome lysis buffer (100 mM KCl, 5 mM MgCl2, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 0.5% NP-40, 1 mM DTT; freshly add 100 U/mL RNase inhibitor and 1× protease inhibitor cocktail). Incubate on ice with rotation, 10 min. Vortex briefly.
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 将细胞沉淀重悬于 1 mL 多核糖体裂解缓冲液中（100 mM KCl、5 mM MgCl2、10 mM HEPES pH 7.0、0.5% NP-40、1 mM DTT；临用前加入 100 U/mL RNase 抑制剂和 1× 蛋白酶抑制剂混合物）。冰上旋转孵育 10 分钟，短暂涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: 3. Centrifuge lysate at 13,000 × g, 4°C, 10 min. Carefully transfer supernatant to a new tube, avoiding the pellet. Keep on ice at all times.
detailedSteps.zh: 3. 将裂解液于 13,000 × g、4°C 离心 10 分钟。小心将上清液转移至新管，避免触碰沉淀。全程置于冰上。

detailedSteps.en: 4. Block 30 μL Protein A/G beads with 0.5 mg/mL BSA + 0.2 mg/mL yeast tRNA in NT2 buffer (1h, 4°C rotating). Wash beads 3× with NT2. Add washed beads to lysate; rotate 1h at 4°C to preclear. Centrifuge 1,000 × g, 1 min; transfer precleared supernatant to fresh tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 用含 0.5 mg/mL BSA 和 0.2 mg/mL 酵母 tRNA 的 NT2 缓冲液封闭 30 μL Protein A/G 磁珠（4°C 旋转 1 小时）。用 NT2 洗涤磁珠 3 次。将洗涤后的磁珠加入裂解液，4°C 旋转 1 小时进行预清除。1,000 × g 离心 1 分钟，将预清除后的上清液转入新管。

detailedSteps.en: 5. Remove 50 μL (5%) as input control. Add equal volume TRIzol and freeze at −80°C until RNA extraction.
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 取出 50 μL（5%）作为输入对照，加入等体积 TRIzol，−80°C 保存至提取 RNA 时使用。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1 (continued): Antibody Incubation
detailedSteps.zh: 第 1 天（续）：抗体孵育

detailedSteps.en: 6. Add 5–10 μg target anti-RBP antibody (and 5–10 μg IgG isotype control to the parallel negative-control tube) to precleared lysate. Rotate overnight at 4°C (12–16h). Keep RNase inhibitor present (add additional 40 U if needed).
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 将 5–10 μg 目标抗 RBP 抗体加入预清除后的裂解液（同时在阴性对照管中加入等量 IgG 同型对照抗体）。4°C 旋转孵育过夜（12–16 小时）。保持 RNase 抑制剂存在（如需可补加 40 U）。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Bead Capture, Wash, and Elution
detailedSteps.zh: 第 2 天：磁珠捕获、洗涤与洗脱

detailedSteps.en: 7. Add 30 μL fresh blocked Protein A/G beads to each antibody-lysate mixture. Rotate 2h at 4°C. Centrifuge 1,000 × g, 1 min; discard supernatant. Beads now contain the RBP–RNA complex.
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 向每管抗体-裂解液混合物中加入 30 μL 新鲜封闭的 Protein A/G 磁珠，4°C 旋转 2 小时。1,000 × g 离心 1 分钟，弃去上清。磁珠上现已富集 RBP–RNA 复合物。

detailedSteps.en: 8. Wash beads 5× with 1 mL ice-cold NT2 buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM MgCl2, 0.05% NP-40). Spin 1,000 × g, 1 min per wash; aspirate supernatant completely between washes.
detailedSteps.zh: 8. 用 1 mL 冰冷 NT2 缓冲液（50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4、150 mM NaCl、1 mM MgCl2、0.05% NP-40）洗涤磁珠 5 次，每次 1,000 × g 离心 1 分钟，两次洗涤之间彻底吸去上清。

detailedSteps.en: 9. Elute RNA–protein complexes: resuspend beads in 100 μL NT2 supplemented with 100 μg/mL Proteinase K and 0.1% SDS. Incubate 55°C, 30 min with vigorous shaking (1,000 rpm). Spin 10,000 × g, 2 min; transfer supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: 9. 洗脱 RNA–蛋白质复合物：将磁珠重悬于含 100 μg/mL Proteinase K 和 0.1% SDS 的 100 μL NT2 缓冲液中，55°C 剧烈振荡（1,000 rpm）孵育 30 分钟。10,000 × g 离心 2 分钟，转移上清。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2 (continued): RNA Extraction and Analysis
detailedSteps.zh: 第 2 天（续）：RNA 提取与分析

detailedSteps.en: 10. Add TRIzol LS (3 volumes) to eluate. Vortex 15 s. Add chloroform (0.2× TRIzol volume); vortex 15 s; incubate RT 3 min. Centrifuge 12,000 × g, 15 min, 4°C. Transfer aqueous phase. Alternatively, use a spin-column RNA cleanup kit (e.g., Qiagen RNeasy MinElute).
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 向洗脱液中加入 3 体积 TRIzol LS，涡旋 15 秒。加入 0.2× TRIzol 体积的氯仿，涡旋 15 秒，室温静置 3 分钟。12,000 × g、4°C 离心 15 分钟，转移水相。也可使用离心柱 RNA 纯化试剂盒（如 Qiagen RNeasy MinElute）。

detailedSteps.en: 11. Precipitate RNA: add 1 μL glycogen (20 mg/mL), 1/10 volume 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2, and 2.5 volumes 100% ethanol; −80°C ≥30 min. Centrifuge 15,000 × g, 4°C, 20 min. Wash pellet with 500 μL 75% ethanol; air-dry; resuspend in 15 μL RNase-free H2O.
detailedSteps.zh: 11. 沉淀 RNA：加入 1 μL 糖原（20 mg/mL）、1/10 体积 3 M 醋酸钠（pH 5.2）和 2.5 体积无水乙醇；−80°C 静置 ≥30 分钟。15,000 × g、4°C 离心 20 分钟，用 500 μL 75% 乙醇洗涤沉淀，风干后重悬于 15 μL 无 RNase 的水中。

detailedSteps.en: 12. DNase treatment: add 2 U DNase I + 1× DNase buffer; incubate 37°C, 20 min. Heat-inactivate 75°C, 10 min. Quantify RNA (Qubit RNA HS assay). Proceed to qRT-PCR for validation or rRNA-depleted/poly(A)-selected RNA-seq library preparation for genome-wide profiling.
detailedSteps.zh: 12. DNase 处理：加入 2 U DNase I 和 1× DNase 缓冲液，37°C 孵育 20 分钟，75°C 灭活 10 分钟。用 Qubit RNA HS 检测定量 RNA。继续进行 qRT-PCR 验证，或制备去除 rRNA/富集 poly(A) 的 RNA-seq 文库以进行全基因组分析。

name: Reduced Representation Bisulfite Sequencing (RRBS)
nameCn: 简化代表性亚硫酸氢盐测序

components.name: 1. Extract high-quality genomic DNA (≥500 ng input); quantify by Qubit dsDNA BR assay; assess purity (A260/280 >1.8, A260/230 >2.0)
2. MspI restriction digest: 1 μg DNA + 10 U MspI in 1× CutSmart buffer, 37°C 2–4h; heat-inactivate 65°C 20 min (cuts C↓CGG, enriches CpG-dense regions)
3. End-repair and dA-tailing: add Klenow fragment (3'→5' exo-, 5 U) + 0.4 mM dNTPs to MspI digest; 37°C 30 min (fills 3' recesses, removes 3' overhangs); heat-inactivate 75°C 20 min
4. Adapter ligation: add pre-methylated (fully CpG-methylated) Illumina adapters (working concentration 15 μM) + T4 DNA ligase (2000 U) + 1× T4 ligase buffer + 1 mM ATP; 16°C overnight 12–16h
5. Size selection: perform 2-step AMPure XP bead cleanup (0.8× then 1.2× ratio) to select adapter-ligated fragments of 150–350 bp; elute in 20 μL nuclease-free H2O
6. Bisulfite conversion: use EZ DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research); incubate with CT conversion reagent at 98°C 8 min then 64°C 3.5h (converts unmethylated cytosines to uracil)
7. Desulphonation and column cleanup per kit instructions; elute in 20 μL M-Elution Buffer (low TE)
8. PCR amplification: 8–15 cycles using KAPA HiFi Uracil+ ReadyMix; 98°C 45s initial; then cycles of 98°C 15s → 65°C 30s → 72°C 30s; 72°C 1 min final extension
9. Post-PCR SPRI cleanup: 0.8× AMPure XP beads; elute in 25 μL low TE
10. QC: quantify by Qubit dsDNA HS; size profile on Bioanalyzer/TapeStation (expect broad peak 250–400 bp); check library complexity by qPCR
11. Sequencing: pool equimolar libraries; sequence on Illumina platform (PE100 or PE150 recommended; minimum 30M read pairs per sample)
12. Bioinformatics: trim adapters (Trim Galore); align bisulfite reads to genome with Bismark (--non_directional for RRBS); call CpG methylation; filter CpGs with ≥10× coverage

notes.en: Input DNA quality is paramount. Degraded or low-quality DNA yields poor libraries. Assess with Bioanalyzer before starting: majority of DNA should be >20 kb for optimal results. | RRBS covers approximately 1–5% of the genome but captures ~80% of CpG islands and most promoter-associated CpGs, making it highly cost-effective for methylation profiling of regulatory regions. | Pre-methylated adapters are essential. Using standard (unmethylated) adapters will result in adapter sequences being converted by bisulfite treatment, causing adapter trimming failure and alignment errors. | Bisulfite conversion efficiency should be >99%. In data QC, check non-CpG cytosine methylation rates (CHH and CHG context); these should be <1% in mammalian somatic cells and serve as a proxy for conversion efficiency. | For mouse or human samples using GRCh38/mm10 references, run Bismark with --genome_folder pointing to a bisulfite-prepared genome (bismark_genome_preparation). Use --non_directional if library was not directional. | Aim for ≥5× coverage at CpG sites for binary methylation calls; ≥10× is recommended for quantitative analysis. At 30M reads, RRBS typically covers 1–3 million CpG sites at ≥10× in human samples.
notes.zh: 输入 DNA 的质量至关重要。降解或低质量 DNA 会导致文库质量差。建议在实验开始前用 Bioanalyzer 评估：大部分 DNA 片段应 >20 kb 以获得最佳效果。 | RRBS 覆盖约 1–5% 的基因组，但能捕获约 80% 的 CpG 岛及大多数启动子相关 CpG 位点，在调控区甲基化分析中具有极高的性价比。 | 必须使用预甲基化接头。若使用普通（未甲基化）接头，接头序列将被亚硫酸氢盐转化，导致接头修剪失败和比对错误。 | 亚硫酸氢盐转化效率应 >99%。在数据质控中，应检查非 CpG 胞嘧啶甲基化率（CHH 和 CHG 环境）；在哺乳动物体细胞中该值应 <1%，可作为转化效率的间接指标。 | 对于使用 GRCh38/mm10 参考基因组的人类或小鼠样本，运行 Bismark 时需用 --genome_folder 指向亚硫酸氢盐处理后的基因组（bismark_genome_preparation 生成）。若文库为非定向文库，需添加 --non_directional 参数。 | CpG 位点覆盖度：二分类甲基化分析建议 ≥5×；定量分析建议 ≥10×。在 3000 万 reads 的测序深度下，RRBS 通常可覆盖人类样本中 100–300 万个 ≥10× 的 CpG 位点。

ref: Meissner A, Gnirke A, Bell GW, Ramsahoye B, Lander ES, Jaenisch R. (2008). Reduced representation bisulfite sequencing for comparative high-resolution DNA methylation analysis. Nucleic Acids Research

usage.en: RRBS is a cost-effective method for genome-wide DNA methylation profiling that focuses sequencing power on CpG-rich regulatory regions. By combining MspI restriction digestion (which specifically cuts CCGG motifs enriched at CpG islands) with bisulfite sequencing, RRBS achieves deep, quantitative methylation measurement at promoters, CpG islands, and gene regulatory elements without sequencing the entire genome. It is widely used for comparing methylation patterns between cell types, developmental stages, tissues, and disease states, and requires as little as 100–500 ng starting material.
usage.zh: RRBS is a cost-effective method for genome-wide DNA methylation profiling that focuses sequencing power on CpG-rich regulatory regions. By combining MspI restriction digestion (which specifically cuts CCGG motifs enriched at CpG islands) with bisulfite sequencing, RRBS achieves deep, quantitative methylation measurement at promoters, CpG islands, and gene regulatory elements without sequencing the entire genome. It is widely used for comparing methylation patterns between cell types, developmental stages, tissues, and disease states, and requires as little as 100–500 ng starting material.

note.en: After MspI digestion and heat-inactivation, the digested DNA can be stored at −20°C for up to 1 week before proceeding to end-repair.
note.zh: MspI 消化及热失活后，消化 DNA 可在 −20°C 保存最多 1 周，再进行末端修复步骤。

note.en: After AMPure size selection, adapter-ligated and size-selected DNA can be stored at −20°C for up to 2 weeks before bisulfite conversion. Do not proceed to bisulfite conversion on an uncertain schedule, as conversion is a time-sensitive workflow.
note.zh: AMPure 大小筛选后，接头连接并已大小筛选的 DNA 可在 −20°C 保存最多 2 周，再进行亚硫酸氢盐转化。亚硫酸氢盐转化流程有时间要求，请在准备充分后再开始此步骤。

briefSteps.en: Genomic DNA extraction (≥500 ng) → MspI digest (37°C 2–4h) → end-repair + dA-tail (37°C 30 min) → methylated adapter ligation (16°C overnight) → size selection (AMPure 0.8×–1.2×, 150–350 bp) → bisulfite conversion (EZ Methylation Kit, 98°C 8 min + 64°C 3.5h) → desulphonation + cleanup → PCR amplification (8–15 cycles, KAPA HiFi Uracil+) → SPRI cleanup → Bioanalyzer QC → Illumina sequencing (PE100/150) → Bismark alignment + CpG methylation calling
briefSteps.zh: 基因组 DNA 提取（≥500 ng）→ MspI 消化（37°C 2–4 小时）→ 末端修复 + dA 加尾（37°C 30 分钟）→ 甲基化接头连接（16°C 过夜）→ 大小筛选（AMPure 0.8×–1.2×，150–350 bp）→ 亚硫酸氢盐转化（EZ Methylation Kit，98°C 8 分钟 + 64°C 3.5 小时）→ 脱磺酸化及纯化 → PCR 扩增（8–15 个循环，KAPA HiFi Uracil+）→ SPRI 纯化 → Bioanalyzer QC → Illumina 测序（PE100/150）→ Bismark 比对 + CpG 甲基化分析

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Genomic DNA QC and MspI Digestion
detailedSteps.zh: 第 1 天：基因组 DNA 质控与 MspI 消化

detailedSteps.en: 1. Extract high-quality genomic DNA using a column-based kit or phenol-chloroform method. Quantify with Qubit dsDNA BR Assay (fluorometric, not spectrophotometric). A260/280 must be >1.8; A260/230 >2.0. RNA contamination must be absent (treat with RNase A 20 μg/mL, 37°C 30 min if needed). Use at least 500 ng–1 μg per RRBS reaction.
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 使用离心柱法或苯酚-氯仿法提取高质量基因组 DNA。用 Qubit dsDNA BR 试剂盒定量（荧光法，不建议仅用分光光度计）。A260/280 须 >1.8，A260/230 须 >2.0。需确认无 RNA 污染（如有需要，加入 RNase A 20 μg/mL，37°C 处理 30 分钟）。每次 RRBS 反应至少使用 500 ng–1 μg DNA。

detailedSteps.en: 2. Set up MspI digestion: combine 1 μg gDNA + 10 U MspI + 1× CutSmart Buffer in 50 μL total volume. Incubate at 37°C for 2–4h with gentle mixing. MspI cleaves at C↓CGG regardless of internal CpG methylation status, generating fragments enriched for CpG island-dense regions. Heat-inactivate at 65°C for 20 min.
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 配制 MspI 消化反应体系：1 μg 基因组 DNA + 10 U MspI + 1× CutSmart 缓冲液，总体积 50 μL。37°C 轻柔混匀孵育 2–4 小时。MspI 在 C↓CGG 位点切割（不受内部 CpG 甲基化状态影响），所得片段富含 CpG 岛密集区域。65°C 灭活 20 分钟。

detailedSteps.en: 3. End-repair and dA-tailing: add 5 U Klenow fragment (3'→5' exo-) and dNTPs (final 0.4 mM each) to the heat-inactivated MspI digest in the same tube. Incubate 37°C, 30 min. Klenow fills 5' overhangs and removes 3' overhangs, creating blunt ends, then adds a 3' dA overhang for adapter ligation. Heat-inactivate 75°C, 20 min; chill on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 3. 末端修复与 dA 加尾：向热失活后的 MspI 消化产物中直接加入 5 U Klenow 片段（3'→5' 外切酶活性缺失型）和 dNTPs（终浓度各 0.4 mM）。37°C 孵育 30 分钟。Klenow 可填补 5' 突出端并去除 3' 突出端，生成平末端，随后添加 3' dA 突出以备接头连接。75°C 灭活 20 分钟，置于冰上冷却。

detailedSteps.en: Day 1 (continued): Adapter Ligation
detailedSteps.zh: 第 1 天（续）：接头连接

detailedSteps.en: 4. Prepare pre-methylated Illumina adapters at 15 μM working concentration in annealing buffer. CRITICAL: adapters must be pre-methylated at all cytosines so they survive bisulfite conversion without sequence alteration. Set up ligation: end-repaired DNA + 1 μL adapter mix (15 μM) + 2000 U T4 DNA ligase + 1× T4 ligase buffer + 1 mM ATP in 50 μL total. Ligate at 16°C for 12–16h overnight.
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 将预甲基化 Illumina 接头用退火缓冲液配至 15 μM 工作浓度。关键：接头所有胞嘧啶必须预先甲基化，以确保其在亚硫酸氢盐转化后序列不变。配制连接反应：末端修复 DNA + 1 μL 接头混合液（15 μM）+ 2000 U T4 DNA 连接酶 + 1× T4 连接酶缓冲液 + 1 mM ATP，总体积 50 μL，16°C 过夜（12–16 小时）。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Size Selection and Bisulfite Conversion
detailedSteps.zh: 第 2 天：大小筛选与亚硫酸氢盐转化

detailedSteps.en: 5. Perform 2-step AMPure XP size selection to remove unligated adapters and very large fragments. Step 1: Add 0.8× volume AMPure XP beads; mix well; incubate RT 5 min; place on magnet; transfer supernatant (contains target fragments) to a new tube. Discard beads (large fragments). Step 2: Add additional AMPure XP to supernatant to 1.2× final ratio; incubate RT 5 min; place on magnet; discard supernatant; wash beads 2× with 80% ethanol; elute in 20 μL nuclease-free water. This step enriches 150–350 bp adapter-ligated fragments. Verify size on Bioanalyzer (optional at this step).
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 进行两步 AMPure XP 大小筛选，去除未连接的接头及过大片段。步骤一：加入 0.8× 体积 AMPure XP 磁珠，充分混匀，室温静置 5 分钟，置于磁力架上，将含目标片段的上清转入新管（弃去磁珠，即去除大片段）。步骤二：在上清中继续补加 AMPure XP 磁珠至终比例 1.2×，室温静置 5 分钟，置于磁力架，弃去上清，用 80% 乙醇洗涤磁珠 2 次，用 20 μL 无核酸酶水洗脱。此步骤富集 150–350 bp 的接头连接片段。可选择在此步骤用 Bioanalyzer 验证片段大小分布。

detailedSteps.en: 6. Bisulfite conversion using EZ DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research): add CT Conversion Reagent to size-selected DNA per kit instructions. Thermocycler conditions: 98°C 8 min (denaturation), then 64°C 3.5h (conversion of unmethylated cytosines to uracil via sulfonation → deamination). Proceed immediately to column cleanup; do not store at this stage. Efficiency should be >99% as validated by non-CpG cytosine conversion rate in data.
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 使用 EZ DNA Methylation Kit（Zymo Research）进行亚硫酸氢盐转化：按照试剂盒说明，将 CT 转化试剂加入大小筛选后的 DNA 中。热循环仪程序：98°C 8 分钟（变性），随后 64°C 3.5 小时（未甲基化胞嘧啶经磺化→脱氨基转化为尿嘧啶）。应立即进行柱纯化，此阶段不可保存样品。转化效率应 >99%（可通过数据中非 CpG 胞嘧啶转化率来验证）。

detailedSteps.en: 7. Desulphonation and cleanup per kit instructions: bind sample to Zymo-Spin IC column; add M-Wash buffer; add M-Desulphonation buffer (stand 15–20 min at RT); wash 2× with M-Wash buffer; elute in 20 μL M-Elution Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, 0.1 mM EDTA). This removes sulfonate groups from uracil residues, making them full uracils readable by polymerase.
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 按试剂盒说明脱磺酸化并纯化：将样品结合到 Zymo-Spin IC 离心柱上；加入 M-Wash 缓冲液；加入 M-Desulphonation 缓冲液（室温静置 15–20 分钟）；用 M-Wash 缓冲液洗涤 2 次；用 20 μL M-Elution 缓冲液（10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5，0.1 mM EDTA）洗脱。此步骤去除尿嘧啶残基上的磺酸基团，使之成为可被聚合酶读取的完整尿嘧啶。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2 (continued): PCR Amplification and QC
detailedSteps.zh: 第 2 天（续）：PCR 扩增与质控

detailedSteps.en: 8. PCR amplification: set up 50 μL reaction with 25 μL KAPA HiFi Uracil+ ReadyMix, 10 μL bisulfite-converted template, 2.5 μL each of indexing primers (10 μM). KAPA HiFi Uracil+ is essential as standard polymerases stall at uracil. Cycle conditions: 98°C 45s initial denaturation; [98°C 15s → 65°C 30s → 72°C 30s] × 8–15 cycles; 72°C 1 min final extension; hold at 4°C. Use the minimum cycle number needed to achieve ≥10 nM final yield (assess with qPCR if uncertain). Excess PCR cycles increase duplicates and reduce library complexity.
detailedSteps.zh: 8. PCR 扩增：配制 50 μL 反应体系：25 μL KAPA HiFi Uracil+ ReadyMix、10 μL 亚硫酸氢盐转化模板、各 2.5 μL 带索引引物（10 μM）。必须使用 KAPA HiFi Uracil+，因标准聚合酶会在尿嘧啶处停滞。循环参数：98°C 45 秒初始变性；[98°C 15 秒 → 65°C 30 秒 → 72°C 30 秒] × 8–15 个循环；72°C 1 分钟最终延伸；4°C 保存。应使用能达到 ≥10 nM 最终产量的最少循环数（如不确定可通过 qPCR 预判）。PCR 循环数过多会增加重复序列比例，降低文库复杂度。

detailedSteps.en: 9. Post-PCR cleanup: add 0.8× volume AMPure XP beads to PCR product; mix well; incubate 5 min RT; magnet 2 min; wash 2× with 200 μL 80% ethanol; air-dry 5 min; elute in 25 μL low TE (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA). Quantify by Qubit dsDNA HS assay. Run 1 μL on Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA chip or TapeStation D1000 ScreenTape; expect a broad peak centered at 250–400 bp. Acceptable yield: 2–30 nM for sequencing.
detailedSteps.zh: 9. PCR 后纯化：向 PCR 产物中加入 0.8× 体积 AMPure XP 磁珠，充分混匀，室温孵育 5 分钟，置于磁力架 2 分钟，用 200 μL 80% 乙醇洗涤 2 次，风干 5 分钟，用 25 μL 低浓度 TE 缓冲液（10 mM Tris pH 8.0，0.1 mM EDTA）洗脱。用 Qubit dsDNA HS 试剂盒定量。取 1 μL 在 Bioanalyzer 高灵敏度 DNA 芯片或 TapeStation D1000 上检测，预期可见以 250–400 bp 为中心的宽峰。上机浓度要求：2–30 nM。

detailedSteps.en: 10. Sequencing and bioinformatics: pool equimolar libraries; sequence on Illumina (NovaSeq or NextSeq recommended; PE100 or PE150; ≥30M paired-end reads per sample). Adapter trim with Trim Galore (--rrbs flag automatically clips filled-in C and the complementary G of MspI overhangs). Align with Bismark to bisulfite-converted genome; extract CpG methylation calls; filter CpGs with ≥10× coverage for downstream analysis (DMR calling, clustering, visualization with IGV or MethylKit).
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 测序与生物信息学分析：等摩尔混合文库；在 Illumina 平台测序（推荐 NovaSeq 或 NextSeq；PE100 或 PE150；每样本 ≥3000 万条配对末端 reads）。用 Trim Galore（--rrbs 参数可自动去除 MspI 切割产生的填充 C 及互补 G）进行接头修剪。用 Bismark 将 reads 比对至亚硫酸氢盐转化基因组；提取 CpG 甲基化信息；筛选覆盖深度 ≥10× 的 CpG 位点用于后续分析（差异甲基化区域检测、聚类分析、IGV 或 MethylKit 可视化）。

name: iPSC Maintenance and Passaging (Feeder-Free)
nameCn: 诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）无饲养层维持与传代

components.name: 1. Coat plates with Matrigel (1:60 in cold DMEM/F12, 0.5 mL/well, 37°C 1h or 4°C overnight)
2. Daily medium change: aspirate spent medium; add 2 mL/well pre-warmed E8 or mTeSR1; return to 37°C 5% CO2
3. Monitor colonies daily for spontaneous differentiation; remove differentiated areas with pipette tip
4. At 70–80% confluence (every 3–5 days): aspirate medium; wash once with 1× PBS (2 mL/well)
5. Add 1 mL/well ReLeSR or 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS; incubate 37°C 5–7 min (ReLeSR) or RT 5 min (EDTA)
6. Aspirate enzyme; add 2 mL fresh E8/mTeSR1; dislodge colonies into clumps by gentle scraping — do NOT single-cell dissociate
7. Transfer colony clumps to new Matrigel-coated plates at 1:3–1:6 split ratio
8. Incubate at 37°C 5% CO2; feed daily; colonies re-establish in 24–48h
9. (Optional) For freezing: dissociate with Accutase (37°C 5 min); count; pellet at 300×g 5 min; resuspend in CryoStor CS10
10. Freeze in Mr. Frosty at -80°C overnight; transfer to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage

notes.en: Always pre-warm media to 37°C before adding to cells. Cold medium induces thermal shock and increases spontaneous differentiation. | Never use trypsin for routine iPSC passaging — it causes single-cell dissociation, massive apoptosis (anoikis), and requires ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632, 10 μM) supplementation for 24h post-passage. Reserve trypsin/Accutase for counting or freezing only. | Matrigel lot-to-lot variability can affect growth. Perform a growth factor reduced (GFR) Matrigel lot qualification before switching batches. | iPSC lines differ in optimal passage ratio and timing. Establish line-specific passage schedules during initial expansion. | Regularly confirm pluripotency by OCT4/NANOG/SOX2 immunostaining and karyotype every 10–15 passages.
notes.zh: 培养基须预热至37°C再加入细胞。冷培养基会造成温度冲击并促进自发分化。 | 日常iPSC传代切勿使用胰酶——胰酶会导致单细胞解离和大量凋亡（失巢凋亡），需在传代后24小时补充ROCK抑制剂（Y-27632，10 μM）。胰酶/Accutase仅用于细胞计数或冻存。 | 不同批次Matrigel性能存在差异，可能影响细胞生长。更换批次前须进行生长因子减少型（GFR）Matrigel批次质检。 | 不同iPSC系的最佳传代比例和时机各异，在初步扩增阶段须建立针对各细胞系的传代时间表。 | 每10–15次传代须通过OCT4/NANOG/SOX2免疫染色及核型分析定期确认多能性。

ref: Chen G et al. (2011). Chemically defined conditions for human iPSC derivation and culture. Nat Methods 8(5):424–429. Stemcell Technologies mTeSR1 Technical Manual.

usage.en: Feeder-free maintenance and passaging of human iPSCs on Matrigel or vitronectin-coated plates. Standard upstream step before neuronal, cardiac, hepatic, or other differentiation protocols.
usage.zh: Feeder-free maintenance and passaging of human iPSCs on Matrigel or vitronectin-coated plates. Standard upstream step before neuronal, cardiac, hepatic, or other differentiation protocols.

note.en: iPSC cultures can be maintained at 37°C 5% CO2 between passages with daily medium changes. No safe stop exists mid-passage once EDTA or ReLeSR has been added — complete the passaging procedure without interruption.
note.zh: iPSC培养物可在37°C 5% CO2条件下通过每日换液维持。一旦加入EDTA或ReLeSR开始传代，中途无安全停顿点，须一次性完成传代操作。

briefSteps.en: Coat plates with Matrigel → daily E8/mTeSR1 medium change → monitor for differentiation → passage at 70–80% confluence with EDTA/ReLeSR → split 1:3–1:6 as colony clumps → recover 24–48h
briefSteps.zh: Matrigel包被培养板 → 每日更换E8/mTeSR1培养基 → 监测分化 → 70–80%融合时用EDTA/ReLeSR传代 → 1:3–1:6比例以克隆团块接种 → 24–48h恢复

detailedSteps.en: Plate Coating
detailedSteps.zh: 培养板包被

detailedSteps.en: 1. Thaw Matrigel aliquot on ice (4°C overnight or on ice ~30 min). Dilute 1:60 in cold DMEM/F12 (keep everything ice-cold to prevent gelation). Add 0.5 mL per well of a 6-well plate. Rock gently to coat evenly.
detailedSteps.zh: 1. 将Matrigel分装管在4°C或冰上解冻（约30分钟）。用冷DMEM/F12按1:60稀释（全程保持低温，防止提前胶化）。每孔（6孔板）加入0.5 mL，轻轻摇动使其均匀铺展。

detailedSteps.en: 2. Incubate coated plates at 37°C for 1h, or seal with parafilm and store at 4°C overnight. Aspirate Matrigel just before seeding cells — do not let wells dry out.
detailedSteps.zh: 2. 包被后的培养板在37°C孵育1小时，或用封口膜封好后4°C过夜保存。铺细胞前立即抽去Matrigel液，不可让孔内干燥。

detailedSteps.en: Daily Maintenance
detailedSteps.zh: 日常维护

detailedSteps.en: 3. Daily medium change: aspirate spent E8 or mTeSR1 medium. Add 2 mL/well of pre-warmed (37°C) fresh medium. Return plates to 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
detailedSteps.zh: 3. 每日换液：吸去用过的E8或mTeSR1培养基，加入2 mL/孔预热至37°C的新鲜培养基，将培养板放回37°C、5% CO2培养箱。

detailedSteps.en: 4. Monitor colonies daily under phase-contrast microscope. Healthy iPSC colonies are compact, dome-shaped with smooth, well-defined borders. Differentiated cells appear flat with dark, irregular borders. Remove differentiated areas immediately by gentle scraping with a pipette tip under sterile conditions.
detailedSteps.zh: 4. 每日在相差显微镜下观察克隆形态。健康iPSC克隆致密、呈穹顶状、边界清晰光滑。分化细胞呈扁平状、边界不规则且颜色较深。在无菌条件下用移液枪头轻刮及时去除分化区域。

detailedSteps.en: Passaging
detailedSteps.zh: 传代操作

detailedSteps.en: 5. When colonies reach 70–80% confluence (typically every 3–5 days), prepare for passaging. Aspirate medium and wash wells once with 2 mL room-temperature 1× PBS per well. Aspirate PBS completely.
detailedSteps.zh: 5. 当克隆达到70–80%融合度（通常每3–5天），准备传代。吸去培养基，每孔用2 mL室温1× PBS洗涤一次，完全吸去PBS。

detailedSteps.en: 6. Add 1 mL/well ReLeSR (preferred for clump passaging) or 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS. For ReLeSR: incubate at 37°C for 5–7 min until colony edges begin to round up and detach. For EDTA: incubate at room temperature for 5 min. Watch carefully — over-digestion causes single-cell dissociation which reduces survival.
detailedSteps.zh: 6. 每孔加入1 mL ReLeSR（推荐用于克隆团块传代）或0.5 mM EDTA/PBS。ReLeSR处理：37°C孵育5–7分钟，直至克隆边缘开始回缩脱离。EDTA处理：室温孵育5分钟。须密切观察——处理过度会导致单细胞解离，降低存活率。

detailedSteps.en: 7. Aspirate ReLeSR/EDTA solution completely. Add 2 mL fresh E8 or mTeSR1 medium per well. Dislodge colonies by gently pipetting across the surface or scraping with a cell scraper. Aim to generate colony clumps of 50–200 cells — avoid single-cell dissociation.
detailedSteps.zh: 7. 完全吸去ReLeSR/EDTA溶液。每孔加入2 mL新鲜E8或mTeSR1培养基。用移液枪轻柔吹打或细胞刮刀将克隆刮下，目标是产生50–200个细胞的克隆团块——避免单细胞解离。

detailedSteps.en: 8. Transfer colony suspension to fresh Matrigel-coated plates at a 1:3 to 1:6 split ratio depending on confluence and downstream needs. Distribute evenly across wells. Place at 37°C, 5% CO2.
detailedSteps.zh: 8. 根据融合度和下游需求，将克隆悬液按1:3至1:6比例转入新的Matrigel包被培养板，均匀分配至各孔。放入37°C、5% CO2培养箱。

detailedSteps.en: Recovery and Quality
detailedSteps.zh: 恢复与质量控制

detailedSteps.en: 9. Feed daily with pre-warmed medium. Colonies re-attach and re-establish compact morphology within 24–48h. Confirm pluripotent morphology before the next passage. Do not allow cultures to overgrow (>90% confluence), as this promotes spontaneous differentiation.
detailedSteps.zh: 9. 每日用预热培养基换液。克隆在24–48小时内重新贴壁并恢复致密形态。下次传代前确认多能性形态。不可使培养物过度生长（>90%融合），否则易发生自发分化。

detailedSteps.en: Cryopreservation (Optional)
detailedSteps.zh: 冻存（可选）

detailedSteps.en: 10. For cryopreservation: dissociate with Accutase (1 mL/well, 37°C 5 min) to single cells. Quench with equal volume E8; pellet at 300×g 5 min 4°C. Count viable cells. Resuspend at 1–3 × 10^6 cells/mL in CryoStor CS10. Aliquot into cryovials (1 mL/vial). Place in Mr. Frosty container with isopropanol at -80°C overnight. Transfer to liquid nitrogen vapor phase for long-term storage.
detailedSteps.zh: 10. 冻存操作：加入Accutase（1 mL/孔，37°C 5分钟）消化至单细胞，加等量E8终止，300×g 4°C离心5分钟收集细胞。计数活细胞，用CryoStor CS10重悬至1–3×10^6个细胞/mL，分装至冻存管（1 mL/管）。放入含异丙醇的程序降温盒，-80°C过夜，次日转至液氮气相长期保存。

name: scCUT&TAG (Single-cell CUT&TAG on 10x Genomics)
nameCn: 单细胞 CUT&TAG（10x Genomics 平台）

components.name: 1. Prepare single-cell/nuclei suspension: dissociate tissue, 150,000–250,000 cells input; spin 300×g 5 min

note.en: Fresh or flash-frozen tissue; nuclei isolation recommended for difficult tissues. Keep on ice throughout.
note.zh: 新鲜或闪冻组织均可；难处理组织建议提取细胞核。全程置于冰上。

components.name: 2. Centrifuge 600×g 3 min; resuspend pellet in 200 µL Antibody Buffer

note.en: Antibody buffer: digitonin-based buffer to maintain membrane permeability.
note.zh: 抗体缓冲液为含 digitonin 的缓冲液，维持膜通透性。

components.name: 3. Primary antibody: 1:50 dilution in 100 µL Antibody Buffer; incubate overnight 4°C rotating

note.en: Validated Abs: H3K4me3 (Diagenode C15410030), H3K27ac (Abcam). Include IgG negative control.
note.zh: 验证抗体：H3K4me3（Diagenode C15410030）、H3K27ac（Abcam）。设 IgG 阴性对照。

components.name: 4. Wash 3× Dig-Wash Buffer; remove unbound primary antibody

note.en: 600×g 3 min each wash. Digitonin-based wash maintains nuclear integrity.
note.zh: 每次 600×g 3 min 洗涤。含 digitonin 洗涤液维持核完整性。

components.name: 5. Secondary antibody: guinea pig anti-rabbit 1:50 in Dig-Wash-BSA; 1 h RT rotating

note.en: Secondary Ab bridges primary Ab to pA-Tn5. Required when primary is not rabbit-derived.
note.zh: 二抗桥接一抗与 pA-Tn5。当一抗非兔源时必须使用。

components.name: 6. Wash 3× Dig-300-BSA Buffer; remove unbound secondary antibody

note.en: Dig-300-BSA: high salt (300 mM NaCl) + BSA buffer reduces non-specific pA-Tn5 binding.
note.zh: Dig-300-BSA：高盐（300 mM NaCl）+ BSA 缓冲液，减少 pA-Tn5 非特异性结合。

components.name: 7. pA-Tn5 binding: 1:100 in 200 µL Dig-300-BSA Buffer; 1 h RT rotating

note.en: pA-Tn5 loaded with sequencing adapters tethers to antibody-bound chromatin.
note.zh: 携带测序接头的 pA-Tn5 通过 Protein A 与抗体结合染色质。

components.name: 8. Wash 3× Dig-300-BSA Buffer; remove unbound pA-Tn5

note.en: Critical to minimize background tagmentation. 600×g 3 min each.
note.zh: 彻底洗去游离 pA-Tn5，降低背景标记。每次 600×g 3 min。

components.name: 9. Tagmentation: resuspend in 200 µL tagmentation buffer; 1 h 37°C water bath; tap tubes 3–4× during incubation

note.en: Mg²⁺ in tagmentation buffer activates Tn5 transposase. Gently tapping prevents bead settling.
note.zh: 标记缓冲液中 Mg²⁺ 激活 Tn5 转座酶。轻拍管壁防止细胞/核沉淀。

components.name: 10. Stop tagmentation: add STOP buffer (200 µL Dig-300 + 10 µL 500 mM EDTA)

note.en: EDTA chelates Mg²⁺ to halt Tn5 activity.
note.zh: EDTA 螯合 Mg²⁺，终止 Tn5 转座活性。

components.name: 11. Optional qPCR cycle check: take 10% aliquot, lyse with 0.1% SDS + Proteinase K; 50°C 30 min; Zymo cleanup; qPCR with ATAC primers

note.en: Expect CT ~15 for successful tagmentation. Proceed to 10x loading only if CT is satisfactory.
note.zh: 成功标记预期 CT ~15。CT 合格后再进行 10x 上样。

components.name: 12. Count nuclei: spin 300×g 3 min; resuspend in 15–25 µL 1×DNB + 2% BSA; count with trypan blue

note.en: Diluted Nuclei Buffer (DNB) from 10x ATAC kit. Target 70–80% viability.
note.zh: 使用 10x ATAC 试剂盒中的稀释核缓冲液（DNB）。目标活率 70–80%。

components.name: 13. 10x Chromium loading: skip step 1 of scATAC manual; begin at GEM generation; use 16–20 PCR cycles

note.en: Use 10x Chromium ATAC v1 or v1.1 kit. Increased PCR cycles compensate for lower input complexity.
note.zh: 使用 10x Chromium ATAC v1 或 v1.1 试剂盒。增加 PCR 循环数以补偿低起始复杂度。

notes.en: Key differences from bulk CUT&TAG: (1) Skip ConA bead capture — cells/nuclei are kept in suspension for single-cell compatibility. (2) Use 1:50 primary Ab dilution (higher than bulk). (3) Tagmentation is performed at 37°C for 1 h with gentle agitation. (4) Skip ATAC transposition step when loading on 10x. (5) Increase PCR cycles to 16–20. Quality control: always run a qPCR cycle check before 10x loading to avoid wasting expensive cartridges. Validated histone marks: H3K4me3 and H3K27ac work well; H3K27me3 may require optimization. pA-Tn5 can be produced in-house (Addgene plasmid) or purchased (Epicypher).
notes.zh: 与 bulk CUT&TAG 的关键差异：(1) 跳过 ConA 磁珠捕获——细胞/核保持悬浮以兼容单细胞模式；(2) 一抗稀释比 1:50（高于 bulk）；(3) 标记在 37°C 进行 1 h，期间轻拍管壁；(4) 10x 上样时跳过 ATAC 转座步骤；(5) PCR 循环增至 16–20 次。质控：10x 上样前必须进行 qPCR 循环数检测，避免浪费昂贵芯片。验证修饰：H3K4me3 和 H3K27ac 效果良好；H3K27me3 可能需要优化。pA-Tn5 可自制（Addgene 质粒）或购买（Epicypher）。

ref: Bartosovic & Castelo-Branco, protocols.io (doi:10.17504/protocols.io.bqbnmsme); Bartosovic et al. (2021) Nature Biotechnology 39:1452–1461

usage.en: Single-cell CUT&TAG profiling of histone modifications (H3K4me3, H3K27ac, H3K27me3) using 10x Genomics Chromium. Suitable for <10,000 input cells per sample.
usage.zh: 使用 10x Genomics Chromium 对组蛋白修饰（H3K4me3、H3K27ac、H3K27me3）进行单细胞 CUT&TAG 分析，每样品输入细胞数 <10,000。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 days，实操: 8 hours

materials.name: Primary antibody (ChIP/CUT&TAG validated, e.g., H3K4me3 Diagenode C15410030)
pA-Tn5 fusion protein (homemade or Epicypher SNAP-CUTANA)
10x Chromium Single Cell ATAC Kit v1 or v1.1
Diluted Nuclei Buffer (DNB, from 10x ATAC kit)

note.en: Safe stop: hold at 4°C overnight and continue on Day 2.
note.zh: 可在此暂停：4°C 过夜，第二天继续。

safeStops.duration: up to 2 h before nuclei counting

note.en: Safe stop: hold at 4°C for up to 2 h before counting nuclei.
note.zh: 可在此暂停：4°C 最多 2 小时，然后进行细胞核计数。

briefSteps.en: Prepare nuclei suspension (150,000–250,000 cells) → centrifuge 600×g 3 min, resuspend in Antibody Buffer → add primary antibody 1:50 (100 µL, overnight 4°C rotating) → wash 3× Dig-Wash → add secondary antibody 1:50 in Dig-Wash-BSA (1 h RT rotating) → wash 3× Dig-300-BSA → add pA-Tn5 1:100 (200 µL Dig-300-BSA, 1 h RT rotating) → wash 3× Dig-300-BSA → tagmentation (200 µL tagmentation buffer, 37°C 1 h water bath, tap tubes 3–4×) → stop with EDTA → optional qPCR cycle check → count nuclei in DNB+2%BSA → load onto 10x Chromium (skip step 1, 16–20 PCR cycles)
briefSteps.zh: 制备细胞核悬液（15–25 万细胞）→ 600×g 3 min 离心，重悬于抗体缓冲液 → 1:50 一抗孵育（100 µL，4°C 过夜旋转）→ Dig-Wash 洗涤 3 次 → 1:50 二抗孵育（Dig-Wash-BSA，RT 1 h 旋转）→ Dig-300-BSA 洗涤 3 次 → 1:100 pA-Tn5（200 µL Dig-300-BSA，RT 1 h 旋转）→ Dig-300-BSA 洗涤 3 次 → 标记（200 µL 标记缓冲液，37°C 1 h 水浴，轻拍管壁 3–4 次）→ EDTA 终止 → 可选 qPCR 循环数检测 → DNB+2%BSA 计数 → 10x Chromium 上样（跳过步骤 1，16–20 PCR 循环）

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Nuclei Preparation and Primary Antibody Incubation
detailedSteps.zh: 第1天：细胞核制备与一抗孵育

detailedSteps.en: Dissociate tissue or cells into a single-cell/single-nuclei suspension with 150,000–250,000 cells input. For nuclei isolation, use a Dounce homogenizer in nuclei isolation buffer. Spin at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C to pellet nuclei.
detailedSteps.zh: 将组织或细胞解离为单细胞/单核悬液，起始量 15–25 万个细胞。核分离可用 Dounce 匀浆器在核分离缓冲液中操作。4°C 300×g 离心 5 min 收集细胞核。

detailedSteps.en: Discard supernatant; centrifuge at 600×g for 3 min at 4°C. Resuspend pellet in 200 µL Antibody Buffer (digitonin-based permeabilization buffer). Keep on ice.
detailedSteps.zh: 弃上清；4°C 600×g 离心 3 min。将沉淀重悬于 200 µL 抗体缓冲液（含 digitonin 透化缓冲液）。置于冰上。

detailedSteps.en: Add primary antibody at 1:50 dilution; transfer to a clean tube and adjust volume to 100 µL with Antibody Buffer. Incubate overnight at 4°C on a rotating wheel. Validated antibodies: H3K4me3 (Diagenode C15410030-100), H3K27ac (Abcam). Always include IgG negative control.
detailedSteps.zh: 按 1:50 稀释一抗，转移至新管，用抗体缓冲液补至 100 µL。4°C 旋转孵育过夜。验证抗体：H3K4me3（Diagenode C15410030-100）、H3K27ac（Abcam）。必须设 IgG 阴性对照。

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Secondary Antibody, pA-Tn5 Binding, Tagmentation, and 10x Loading
detailedSteps.zh: 第2天：二抗结合、pA-Tn5 标记与 10x 上样

detailedSteps.en: Wash nuclei 3× with Dig-Wash Buffer: add 200 µL Dig-Wash, spin 600×g 3 min 4°C, discard supernatant. After final wash, resuspend in 200 µL Dig-Wash-BSA.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 Dig-Wash 缓冲液洗涤细胞核 3 次：加入 200 µL Dig-Wash，4°C 600×g 3 min，弃上清。最后一次洗涤后重悬于 200 µL Dig-Wash-BSA。

detailedSteps.en: Add guinea pig anti-rabbit secondary antibody at 1:50 in Dig-Wash-BSA buffer. Incubate 1 h at RT on a rotating wheel. This secondary antibody bridges the primary antibody to pA-Tn5.
detailedSteps.zh: 按 1:50 在 Dig-Wash-BSA 中加入豚鼠抗兔二抗。室温旋转孵育 1 h。二抗桥接一抗与 pA-Tn5 融合蛋白。

detailedSteps.en: Wash nuclei 3× with Dig-300-BSA Buffer (high-salt wash: 300 mM NaCl + BSA): 600×g 3 min 4°C each. After final wash, resuspend in 200 µL Dig-300-BSA.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 Dig-300-BSA 缓冲液（高盐洗涤：300 mM NaCl + BSA）洗涤 3 次：每次 4°C 600×g 3 min。最后一次后重悬于 200 µL Dig-300-BSA。

detailedSteps.en: Add pA-Tn5 fusion protein at 1:100 dilution in 200 µL Dig-300-BSA Buffer. Incubate 1 h at RT on a rotating wheel. pA-Tn5 (homemade or commercially available, e.g., Epicypher SNAP-CUTANA pA-Tn5) is pre-loaded with Illumina-compatible sequencing adapters.
detailedSteps.zh: 在 200 µL Dig-300-BSA 中按 1:100 稀释 pA-Tn5 融合蛋白。室温旋转孵育 1 h。pA-Tn5（自制或商品化，如 Epicypher SNAP-CUTANA pA-Tn5）已预加载兼容 Illumina 的测序接头。

detailedSteps.en: Wash nuclei 3× with Dig-300-BSA Buffer to remove unbound pA-Tn5: 600×g 3 min 4°C each. After final wash, discard supernatant completely.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 Dig-300-BSA 洗涤 3 次，去除未结合 pA-Tn5：每次 4°C 600×g 3 min。最后一次彻底弃上清。

detailedSteps.en: Tagmentation: resuspend pellet in 200 µL Tagmentation Buffer (containing MgCl₂ to activate Tn5). Incubate 1 h in a 37°C water bath. Gently tap tubes 3–4 times during incubation to resuspend settled nuclei and ensure uniform tagmentation.
detailedSteps.zh: 标记：将沉淀重悬于 200 µL 标记缓冲液（含 MgCl₂ 激活 Tn5）。37°C 水浴孵育 1 h。孵育过程中轻拍管壁 3–4 次，使沉降的核重悬，确保均匀标记。

detailedSteps.en: Stop tagmentation: add STOP buffer consisting of 200 µL Dig-300 Buffer plus 10 µL of 500 mM EDTA (final EDTA ~24 mM). Mix gently. EDTA chelates Mg²⁺ and halts Tn5 activity.
detailedSteps.zh: 终止标记：加入 200 µL Dig-300 缓冲液 + 10 µL 500 mM EDTA（终浓度 EDTA ~24 mM）组成 STOP 缓冲液。轻柔混匀。EDTA 螯合 Mg²⁺，终止 Tn5 活性。

detailedSteps.en: Optional — qPCR cycle check: take 10% of the tagmented sample. Lyse with 0.1% SDS + Proteinase K at 50°C for 30 min. Clean up with Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator-5. Run qPCR with ATAC-seq primers: 2 µL template + SYBR Green mix. Expect CT ~15 for a successful reaction. If CT > 20, tagmentation may have failed.
detailedSteps.zh: 可选——qPCR 循环数检测：取标记样品的 10%。用 0.1% SDS + Proteinase K 在 50°C 裂解 30 min。Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 纯化。用 ATAC-seq 引物 qPCR：2 µL 模板 + SYBR Green 混合液。成功反应预期 CT ~15；CT > 20 提示标记可能失败。

detailedSteps.en: Count nuclei: spin at 300×g for 3 min at 4°C. Resuspend pellet in 15–25 µL of 1×Diluted Nuclei Buffer (DNB, from 10x ATAC kit) + 2% BSA. Count using a hemocytometer with Trypan Blue. Target 70–80% viability and concentration suitable for 10x loading.
detailedSteps.zh: 计数细胞核：4°C 300×g 离心 3 min。将沉淀重悬于 15–25 µL 1× 稀释核缓冲液（DNB，来自 10x ATAC 试剂盒）+ 2% BSA。用台盼蓝在血球计数板上计数。目标活率 70–80%，浓度达到 10x 上样要求。

detailedSteps.en: 10x Chromium loading: skip Step 1 (ATAC transposition) of the standard 10x scATAC-seq manual — tagmentation has already been performed. Start directly at GEM generation. Use 10x Chromium ATAC v1 or v1.1 kit. Increase PCR cycles to 16–20 (vs. standard 12) to compensate for the lower complexity of the scCUT&TAG library. Process libraries according to standard 10x ATAC library prep thereafter.
detailedSteps.zh: 10x Chromium 上样：跳过标准 10x scATAC-seq 手册的步骤 1（ATAC 转座）——标记已完成。直接从 GEM 生成步骤开始。使用 10x Chromium ATAC v1 或 v1.1 试剂盒。将 PCR 循环数增加至 16–20 次（对比标准 12 次），以弥补 scCUT&TAG 文库的低复杂度。后续按标准 10x ATAC 文库制备流程操作。

name: snRNA-seq Nucleus Isolation from Frozen Tissue
nameCn: 冻存组织单核RNA测序细胞核分离

components.name: 1. Section or chunk 20–30 mg frozen tissue on dry ice; keep frozen until lysis step
2. Homogenize tissue in 500 μL homogenization buffer using Dounce homogenizer (8× loose + 8× tight pestle) on ice
3. Filter homogenate sequentially through 40 μm then 30 μm cell strainer into 15 mL tube on ice
4. Underlay with 900 μL sucrose cushion buffer; centrifuge 1000×g 10 min 4°C in swing-out rotor
5. Aspirate and discard supernatant (myelin, debris); wash pellet with 500 μL resuspension buffer
6. Centrifuge 300×g 3 min 4°C; aspirate supernatant; resuspend pellet in 100–500 μL resuspension buffer
7. Count nuclei on hemocytometer with DAPI or trypan blue; assess morphology; target viability >80%
8. Quality check under microscope: nuclei should be round, intact, minimal debris; filter through 20 μm strainer if clumps present
9. Adjust concentration to 700–1200 nuclei/μL; proceed immediately to 10x Chromium loading or snap-freeze aliquots in LN2

notes.en: Speed and cold are critical. Work on ice at all times; complete the entire protocol within 2–3h of tissue dissection.
